documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.1
documents.summary: Dhritarashtra said, "What did my people and the sons of Pandu do when they had assembled together, eager for battle, on the holy plain of Kurukshetra, O Sanjaya?"
documents.searchText: bg.1.1 bg.1.1 chapter 1 verse 1 धतरषटर उवच धरमकषतर करकषतर समवत ययतसव ममक पणडवशचव कमकरवत सञजय 1.1 dhritarashtra uvacha dharma-kshetre kuru-kshetre samaveta yuyutsavah mamakah pandavashchaiva kimakurvata sanjaya dhritarashtra said what did my people and the sons of pandu do when they had assembled together eager for battle on the holy plain of kurukshetra o sanjaya
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.1 bg.1.1 chapter 1 verse 1 धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः।

मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय।।1.1।। dhṛitarāśhtra uvācha
dharma-kṣhetre kuru-kṣhetre samavetā yuyutsavaḥ
māmakāḥ pāṇḍavāśhchaiva kimakurvata sañjaya dhritarashtra said, "what did my people and the sons of pandu do when they had assembled together, eager for battle, on the holy plain of kurukshetra, o sanjaya?"

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.10
documents.summary: Our army, marshalled by Bhishma, is insufficient, whereas theirs, marshalled by Bhima, is sufficient.
documents.searchText: bg.1.10 bg.1.10 chapter 1 verse 10 अपरयपत तदसमक बल भषमभरकषतम परयपत तवदमतष बल भमभरकषतम 1.10 aparyaptam tadasmakam balam bhishmabhirakshitam paryaptam tvidametesham balam bhimabhirakshitam our army marshalled by bhishma is insufficient whereas theirs marshalled by bhima is sufficient.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.10 bg.1.10 chapter 1 verse 10 अपर्याप्तं तदस्माकं बलं भीष्माभिरक्षितम्।

पर्याप्तं त्विदमेतेषां बलं भीमाभिरक्षितम्।।1.10।। aparyāptaṁ tadasmākaṁ balaṁ bhīṣhmābhirakṣhitam
paryāptaṁ tvidameteṣhāṁ balaṁ bhīmābhirakṣhitam our army, marshalled by bhishma, is insufficient, whereas theirs, marshalled by bhima, is sufficient.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.11
documents.summary: Therefore, do all of you, stationed in your respective positions in the several divisions of the army, protect Bhishma alone.
documents.searchText: bg.1.11 bg.1.11 chapter 1 verse 11 अयनष च सरवष यथभगमवसथत भषममवभरकषनत भवनत सरव एव ह 1.11 ayaneshu cha sarveshu yatha-bhagamavasthitah bhishmamevabhirakshantu bhavantah sarva eva hi therefore do all of you stationed in your respective positions in the several divisions of the army protect bhishma alone.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.11 bg.1.11 chapter 1 verse 11 अयनेषु च सर्वेषु यथाभागमवस्थिताः।

भीष्ममेवाभिरक्षन्तु भवन्तः सर्व एव हि।।1.11।। ayaneṣhu cha sarveṣhu yathā-bhāgamavasthitāḥ
bhīṣhmamevābhirakṣhantu bhavantaḥ sarva eva hi therefore, do all of you, stationed in your respective positions in the several divisions of the army, protect bhishma alone.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.12
documents.summary: His glorious grandsire, the oldest of the Kauravas, roared like a lion to cheer Duryodhana and blew his conch.
documents.searchText: bg.1.12 bg.1.12 chapter 1 verse 12 तसय सजनयनहरष करवदध पतमह सहनद वनदयचच शङख दधम परतपवन 1.12 tasya sanjanayan harsham kuru-vriddhah pitamahah simha-nadam vinadyochchaih shankham dadhmau pratapavan his glorious grandsire the oldest of the kauravas roared like a lion to cheer duryodhana and blew his conch.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.12 bg.1.12 chapter 1 verse 12 तस्य संजनयन्हर्षं कुरुवृद्धः पितामहः।

सिंहनादं विनद्योच्चैः शङ्खं दध्मौ प्रतापवान्।।1.12।। tasya sañjanayan harṣhaṁ kuru-vṛiddhaḥ pitāmahaḥ
siṁha-nādaṁ vinadyochchaiḥ śhaṅkhaṁ dadhmau pratāpavān his glorious grandsire, the oldest of the kauravas, roared like a lion to cheer duryodhana and blew his conch.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.13
documents.summary: Then, suddenly, conches, kettledrums, tabors, drums, and cow horns blared forth from the Kaurava side, and the sound was tremendous.
documents.searchText: bg.1.13 bg.1.13 chapter 1 verse 13 तत शङखशच भरयशच पणवनकगमख सहसवभयहनयनत स शबदसतमलऽभवत 1.13 tatah shankhashcha bheryashcha panavanaka-gomukhah sahasaivabhyahanyanta sa shabdastumulo bhavat then suddenly conches kettledrums tabors drums and cow horns blared forth from the kaurava side and the sound was tremendous.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.13 bg.1.13 chapter 1 verse 13 ततः शङ्खाश्च भेर्यश्च पणवानकगोमुखाः।

सहसैवाभ्यहन्यन्त स शब्दस्तुमुलोऽभवत्।।1.13।। tataḥ śhaṅkhāśhcha bheryaśhcha paṇavānaka-gomukhāḥ
sahasaivābhyahanyanta sa śhabdastumulo ’bhavat then, suddenly, conches, kettledrums, tabors, drums, and cow horns blared forth from the kaurava side, and the sound was tremendous.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.14
documents.summary: Then, Madhava (Krishna) and the son of Pandu (Arjuna), seated in the magnificent chariot yoked with white horses, blew divine conches.
documents.searchText: bg.1.14 bg.1.14 chapter 1 verse 14 तत शवतरहयरयकत महत सयनदन सथत मधव पणडवशचव दवय शङख परदधमत 1.14 tatah shvetairhayairyukte mahati syandane sthitau madhavah pandavashchaiva divyau shankhau pradadhmatuh then madhava krishna and the son of pandu arjuna seated in the magnificent chariot yoked with white horses blew divine conches.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.14 bg.1.14 chapter 1 verse 14 ततः श्वेतैर्हयैर्युक्ते महति स्यन्दने स्थितौ।

माधवः पाण्डवश्चैव दिव्यौ शङ्खौ प्रदध्मतुः।।1.14।। tataḥ śhvetairhayairyukte mahati syandane sthitau
mādhavaḥ pāṇḍavaśhchaiva divyau śhaṅkhau pradadhmatuḥ then, madhava (krishna) and the son of pandu (arjuna), seated in the magnificent chariot yoked with white horses, blew divine conches.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.15
documents.summary: Hrishikesha blew the Panchajanya, Arjuna blew the Devadatta, and Bhima, the wolf-bellied doer of terrible deeds, blew the great conch Paundra.
documents.searchText: bg.1.15 bg.1.15 chapter 1 verse 15 पञचजनय हषकश दवदतत धनजय पणडर दधम महशङख भमकरम वकदर 1.15 panchajanyam hrishikesho devadattam dhananjayah paundram dadhmau maha-shankham bhima-karma vrikodarah hrishikesha blew the panchajanya arjuna blew the devadatta and bhima the wolf-bellied doer of terrible deeds blew the great conch paundra.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.15 bg.1.15 chapter 1 verse 15 पाञ्चजन्यं हृषीकेशो देवदत्तं धनंजयः।

पौण्ड्रं दध्मौ महाशङ्खं भीमकर्मा वृकोदरः।।1.15।। pāñchajanyaṁ hṛiṣhīkeśho devadattaṁ dhanañjayaḥ
pauṇḍraṁ dadhmau mahā-śhaṅkhaṁ bhīma-karmā vṛikodaraḥ hrishikesha blew the panchajanya, arjuna blew the devadatta, and bhima, the wolf-bellied doer of terrible deeds, blew the great conch paundra.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.16
documents.summary: King Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, blew the Anantavijaya; Nakula and Sahadeva blew the Sughosha and the Manipushpaka.
documents.searchText: bg.1.16 bg.1.16 chapter 1 verse 16 अननतवजय रज कनतपतर यधषठर नकल सहदवशच सघषमणपषपक 1.16 anantavijayam raja kunti-putro yudhishthirah nakulah sahadevashcha sughosha-manipushpakau king yudhishthira the son of kunti blew the anantavijaya nakula and sahadeva blew the sughosha and the manipushpaka.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.16 bg.1.16 chapter 1 verse 16 अनन्तविजयं राजा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः।

नकुलः सहदेवश्च सुघोषमणिपुष्पकौ।।1.16।। anantavijayaṁ rājā kuntī-putro yudhiṣhṭhiraḥ
nakulaḥ sahadevaśhcha sughoṣha-maṇipuṣhpakau king yudhishthira, the son of kunti, blew the anantavijaya; nakula and sahadeva blew the sughosha and the manipushpaka.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.17
documents.summary: The king of Kasi, an excellent archer, Sikhandi, the mighty car-warrior, Dhrishtadyumna, Virata, and Satyaki, the unconquered.
documents.searchText: bg.1.17 bg.1.17 chapter 1 verse 17 कशयशच परमषवस शखणड च महरथ धषटदयमन वरटशच सतयकशचपरजत 1.17 kashyashcha parameshvasah shikhandi cha maha-rathah dhrishtadyumno viratashcha satyakish chaparajitah the king of kasi an excellent archer sikhandi the mighty car-warrior dhrishtadyumna virata and satyaki the unconquered.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.17 bg.1.17 chapter 1 verse 17 काश्यश्च परमेष्वासः शिखण्डी च महारथः।

धृष्टद्युम्नो विराटश्च सात्यकिश्चापराजितः।।1.17।। kāśhyaśhcha parameṣhvāsaḥ śhikhaṇḍī cha mahā-rathaḥ
dhṛiṣhṭadyumno virāṭaśhcha sātyakiśh chāparājitaḥ the king of kasi, an excellent archer, sikhandi, the mighty car-warrior, dhrishtadyumna, virata, and satyaki, the unconquered.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.18
documents.summary: Drupada and the sons of Draupadi, O Lord of the Earth, and the son of Subhadra, the mighty-armed, blew their conches each separately.
documents.searchText: bg.1.18 bg.1.18 chapter 1 verse 18 दरपद दरपदयशच सरवश पथवपत सभदरशच महबह शङखनदधम पथकपथक 1.18 drupado draupadeyashcha sarvashah prithivi-pate saubhadrashcha maha-bahuh shankhandadhmuh prithak prithak drupada and the sons of draupadi o lord of the earth and the son of subhadra the mighty-armed blew their conches each separately.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.18 bg.1.18 chapter 1 verse 18 द्रुपदो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्वशः पृथिवीपते।

सौभद्रश्च महाबाहुः शङ्खान्दध्मुः पृथक्पृथक्।।1.18।। drupado draupadeyāśhcha sarvaśhaḥ pṛithivī-pate
saubhadraśhcha mahā-bāhuḥ śhaṅkhāndadhmuḥ pṛithak pṛithak drupada and the sons of draupadi, o lord of the earth, and the son of subhadra, the mighty-armed, blew their conches each separately.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.19
documents.summary: The tumultuous sound rent the hearts of Dhritarashtra's party, reverberating through both heaven and earth.
documents.searchText: bg.1.19 bg.1.19 chapter 1 verse 19 स घष धरतरषटरण हदयन वयदरयत नभशच पथव चव तमल वयननदयन 1.19 sa ghosho dhartarashtranam hridayani vyadarayat nabhashcha prithivim chaiva tumulo nunadayan the tumultuous sound rent the hearts of dhritarashtra s party reverberating through both heaven and earth.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.19 bg.1.19 chapter 1 verse 19 स घोषो धार्तराष्ट्राणां हृदयानि व्यदारयत्।

नभश्च पृथिवीं चैव तुमुलो व्यनुनादयन्।।1.19।। sa ghoṣho dhārtarāṣhṭrāṇāṁ hṛidayāni vyadārayat
nabhaśhcha pṛithivīṁ chaiva tumulo nunādayan the tumultuous sound rent the hearts of dhritarashtra's party, reverberating through both heaven and earth.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.2
documents.summary: Sanjaya said: Having seen the army of the Pandavas drawn up in battle array, King Duryodhana approached his teacher, Drona, and spoke these words.
documents.searchText: bg.1.2 bg.1.2 chapter 1 verse 2 सञजय उवच दषटव त पणडवनक वयढ दरयधनसतद आचरयमपसङगमय रज वचनमबरवत 1.2 sanjaya uvacha drishtva tu pandavanikam vyudham duryodhanastada acharyamupasangamya raja vachanamabravit sanjaya said having seen the army of the pandavas drawn up in battle array king duryodhana approached his teacher drona and spoke these words.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.2 bg.1.2 chapter 1 verse 2 सञ्जय उवाच

दृष्ट्वा तु पाण्डवानीकं व्यूढं दुर्योधनस्तदा।

आचार्यमुपसङ्गम्य राजा वचनमब्रवीत्।।1.2।। sañjaya uvācha
dṛiṣhṭvā tu pāṇḍavānīkaṁ vyūḍhaṁ duryodhanastadā
āchāryamupasaṅgamya rājā vachanamabravīt sanjaya said: having seen the army of the pandavas drawn up in battle array, king duryodhana approached his teacher, drona, and spoke these words.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.20
documents.summary: Then, seeing the people of Dhritarashtra's party standing arrayed and the discharge of weapons about to begin, Arjuna, the son of Pandu whose ensign was a monkey, took up his bow a
documents.searchText: bg.1.20 bg.1.20 chapter 1 verse 20 अथ वयवसथतन दषटव धरतरषटरनकपधवज परवतत शसतरसपत धनरदयमय पणडव 1.20 atha vyavasthitan drishtva dhartarashtran kapi-dhwajah pravritte shastra-sampate dhanurudyamya pandavah hrishikesham tada vakyam idam aha mahi-pate then seeing the people of dhritarashtra s party standing arrayed and the discharge of weapons about to begin arjuna the son of pandu whose ensign was a monkey took up his bow and said the following to krishna o lord of the earth.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.20 bg.1.20 chapter 1 verse 20 अथ व्यवस्थितान् दृष्ट्वा धार्तराष्ट्रान्कपिध्वजः।

प्रवृत्ते शस्त्रसंपाते धनुरुद्यम्य पाण्डवः।।1.20।। atha vyavasthitān dṛiṣhṭvā dhārtarāṣhṭrān kapi-dhwajaḥ
pravṛitte śhastra-sampāte dhanurudyamya pāṇḍavaḥ
hṛiṣhīkeśhaṁ tadā vākyam idam āha mahī-pate then, seeing the people of dhritarashtra's party standing arrayed and the discharge of weapons about to begin, arjuna, the son of pandu whose ensign was a monkey, took up his bow and said the following to krishna, o lord of the earth.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.21
documents.summary: Arjuna said, "O Krishna, place my chariot in the middle between the two armies, so that I may behold those who stand here, desirous to fight, and know with whom I must fight when t
documents.searchText: bg.1.21 bg.1.21 chapter 1 verse 21 अरजन उवच हषकश तद वकयमदमह महपत सनयरभयरमधय रथ सथपय मऽचयत 1.21 arjuna uvacha senayor ubhayor madhye ratham sthapaya me chyuta arjuna said o krishna place my chariot in the middle between the two armies so that i may behold those who stand here desirous to fight and know with whom i must fight when the battle is about to commence.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.21 bg.1.21 chapter 1 verse 21 अर्जुन उवाच

हृषीकेशं तदा वाक्यमिदमाह महीपते।

सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये रथं स्थापय मेऽच्युत।।1.21।। arjuna uvācha
senayor ubhayor madhye rathaṁ sthāpaya me ’chyuta arjuna said, "o krishna, place my chariot in the middle between the two armies, so that i may behold those who stand here, desirous to fight, and know with whom i must fight when the battle is about to commence."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.22
documents.summary: Arjuna said, "O Krishna, place my chariot in the middle between the two armies, so that I may behold those who stand here, desirous to fight, and know with whom I must fight when t
documents.searchText: bg.1.22 bg.1.22 chapter 1 verse 22 यवदतननरकषऽह यदधकमनवसथतन करमय सह यदधवयमसमनरणसमदयम 1.22 yavadetan nirikshe ham yoddhu-kaman avasthitan kairmaya saha yoddhavyam asmin rana-samudyame arjuna said o krishna place my chariot in the middle between the two armies so that i may behold those who stand here desirous to fight and know with whom i must fight when the battle is about to commence.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.22 bg.1.22 chapter 1 verse 22 यावदेतान्निरीक्षेऽहं योद्धुकामानवस्थितान्।

कैर्मया सह योद्धव्यमस्मिन्रणसमुद्यमे।।1.22।। yāvadetān nirīkṣhe ’haṁ yoddhu-kāmān avasthitān
kairmayā saha yoddhavyam asmin raṇa-samudyame arjuna said, "o krishna, place my chariot in the middle between the two armies, so that i may behold those who stand here, desirous to fight, and know with whom i must fight when the battle is about to commence."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.23
documents.summary: For I desire to observe those who are assembled here to fight, wishing to please in battle the evil-minded Duryodhana—the son of Dhritarashtra.
documents.searchText: bg.1.23 bg.1.23 chapter 1 verse 23 यतसयमननवकषऽह य एतऽतर समगत धरतरषटरसय दरबदधरयदध परयचकरषव 1.23 yotsyamanan avekshe ham ya ete tra samagatah dhartarashtrasya durbuddher yuddhe priya-chikirshavah for i desire to observe those who are assembled here to fight wishing to please in battle the evil-minded duryodhana the son of dhritarashtra.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.23 bg.1.23 chapter 1 verse 23 योत्स्यमानानवेक्षेऽहं य एतेऽत्र समागताः।

धार्तराष्ट्रस्य दुर्बुद्धेर्युद्धे प्रियचिकीर्षवः।।1.23।। yotsyamānān avekṣhe ’haṁ ya ete ’tra samāgatāḥ
dhārtarāṣhṭrasya durbuddher yuddhe priya-chikīrṣhavaḥ for i desire to observe those who are assembled here to fight, wishing to please in battle the evil-minded duryodhana—the son of dhritarashtra.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.24
documents.summary: Sanjaya said, Thus addressed by Arjuna, Krishna stationed the best of chariots, O Dhritarashtra, in the midst of the two armies.
documents.searchText: bg.1.24 bg.1.24 chapter 1 verse 24 सजय उवच एवमकत हषकश गडकशन भरत सनयरभयरमधय सथपयतव रथततमम 1.24 sanjaya uvacha evam ukto hrishikesho gudakeshena bharata senayor ubhayor madhye sthapayitva rathottamam sanjaya said thus addressed by arjuna krishna stationed the best of chariots o dhritarashtra in the midst of the two armies.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.24 bg.1.24 chapter 1 verse 24 संजय उवाच

एवमुक्तो हृषीकेशो गुडाकेशेन भारत।

सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये स्थापयित्वा रथोत्तमम्।।1.24।। sañjaya uvācha
evam ukto hṛiṣhīkeśho guḍākeśhena bhārata
senayor ubhayor madhye sthāpayitvā rathottamam sanjaya said, thus addressed by arjuna, krishna stationed the best of chariots, o dhritarashtra, in the midst of the two armies.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.25
documents.summary: In front of Bhishma and Drona, and all the rulers of the earth, he said: "O Arjuna, son of Pritha, behold these Kurus gathered together."
documents.searchText: bg.1.25 bg.1.25 chapter 1 verse 25 भषमदरणपरमखत सरवष च महकषतम उवच परथ पशयतनसमवतनकरनत 1.25 bhishma-drona-pramukhatah sarvesham cha mahi-kshitam uvacha partha pashyaitan samavetan kurun iti in front of bhishma and drona and all the rulers of the earth he said o arjuna son of pritha behold these kurus gathered together.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.25 bg.1.25 chapter 1 verse 25 भीष्मद्रोणप्रमुखतः सर्वेषां च महीक्षिताम्।

उवाच पार्थ पश्यैतान्समवेतान्कुरूनिति।।1.25।। bhīṣhma-droṇa-pramukhataḥ sarveṣhāṁ cha mahī-kṣhitām
uvācha pārtha paśhyaitān samavetān kurūn iti in front of bhishma and drona, and all the rulers of the earth, he said: "o arjuna, son of pritha, behold these kurus gathered together."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.26
documents.iast: tatrāpaśhyat sthitān pārthaḥ pitṝīn atha pitāmahān
documents.summary: Then, Arjuna (son of Pritha) saw there (in the armies) stationed fathers, grandfathers, teachers, maternal uncles, brothers, sons, grandsons, and friends.
documents.searchText: bg.1.26 bg.1.26 chapter 1 verse 26 ततरपशयतसथतनपरथ पतनथ पतमहन आचरयनमतलनभरतनपतरनपतरनसखसतथ 1.26 tatrapashyat sthitan parthah pitrin atha pitamahan acharyan matulan bhratrin putran pautran sakhims tatha shvashuran suhridash chaiva senayor ubhayor api then arjuna son of pritha saw there in the armies stationed fathers grandfathers teachers maternal uncles brothers sons grandsons and friends.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.26 bg.1.26 chapter 1 verse 26 तत्रापश्यत्स्थितान्पार्थः पितृ़नथ पितामहान्।

आचार्यान्मातुलान्भ्रातृ़न्पुत्रान्पौत्रान्सखींस्तथा।।1.26।। tatrāpaśhyat sthitān pārthaḥ pitṝīn atha pitāmahān
āchāryān mātulān bhrātṝīn putrān pautrān sakhīṁs tathā
śhvaśhurān suhṛidaśh chaiva senayor ubhayor api then, arjuna (son of pritha) saw there (in the armies) stationed fathers, grandfathers, teachers, maternal uncles, brothers, sons, grandsons, and friends.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.27
documents.iast: tān samīkṣhya sa kaunteyaḥ sarvān bandhūn avasthitān
documents.summary: He saw fathers-in-law and friends in both the armies. The son of Kunti, Arjuna, seeing all those kinsmen thus standing arrayed, spoke sorrowfully, deeply filled with pity.
documents.searchText: bg.1.27 bg.1.27 chapter 1 verse 27 शवशरनसहदशचव सनयरभयरप तनसमकषय स कनतय सरवनबनधनवसथतन 1.27 tan samikshya sa kaunteyah sarvan bandhun avasthitan kripaya parayavishto vishidann idam abravit he saw fathers-in-law and friends in both the armies. the son of kunti arjuna seeing all those kinsmen thus standing arrayed spoke sorrowfully deeply filled with pity.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.27 bg.1.27 chapter 1 verse 27 श्वशुरान्सुहृदश्चैव सेनयोरुभयोरपि।

तान्समीक्ष्य स कौन्तेयः सर्वान्बन्धूनवस्थितान्।।1.27।। tān samīkṣhya sa kaunteyaḥ sarvān bandhūn avasthitān
kṛipayā parayāviṣhṭo viṣhīdann idam abravīt he saw fathers-in-law and friends in both the armies. the son of kunti, arjuna, seeing all those kinsmen thus standing arrayed, spoke sorrowfully, deeply filled with pity.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.28
documents.summary: Arjuna said, "O Krishna, seeing my kinsmen arrayed here, eager to fight,
documents.searchText: bg.1.28 bg.1.28 chapter 1 verse 28 अरजन उवच कपय परयऽऽवषट वषदननदमबरवत दषटवम सवजन कषण ययतस समपसथतम 1.28 arjuna uvacha drishtvemam sva-janam krishna yuyutsum samupasthitam arjuna said o krishna seeing my kinsmen arrayed here eager to fight
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.28 bg.1.28 chapter 1 verse 28 अर्जुन उवाच

कृपया परयाऽऽविष्टो विषीदन्निदमब्रवीत्।

दृष्ट्वेमं स्वजनं कृष्ण युयुत्सुं समुपस्थितम्।।1.28।। arjuna uvācha
dṛiṣhṭvemaṁ sva-janaṁ kṛiṣhṇa yuyutsuṁ samupasthitam arjuna said, "o krishna, seeing my kinsmen arrayed here, eager to fight,

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.29
documents.iast: sīdanti mama gātrāṇi mukhaṁ cha pariśhuṣhyati
documents.sanskrit: सीदन्ति मम गात्राणि मुखं च परिशुष्यति।
documents.summary: My limbs fail, my mouth is parched, my body quivers, and my hair stands on end.
documents.searchText: bg.1.29 bg.1.29 chapter 1 verse 29 सदनत मम गतरण मख च परशषयत वपथशच शरर म रमहरषशच जयत 1.29 sidanti mama gatrani mukham cha parishushyati vepathush cha sharire me roma-harshash cha jayate my limbs fail my mouth is parched my body quivers and my hair stands on end.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.29 bg.1.29 chapter 1 verse 29 सीदन्ति मम गात्राणि मुखं च परिशुष्यति।

वेपथुश्च शरीरे मे रोमहर्षश्च जायते।।1.29।। sīdanti mama gātrāṇi mukhaṁ cha pariśhuṣhyati
vepathuśh cha śharīre me roma-harṣhaśh cha jāyate my limbs fail, my mouth is parched, my body quivers, and my hair stands on end.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.3
documents.summary: Behold, O Teacher! This mighty army of the sons of Pandu, arrayed by the son of Drupada, thy wise disciple.
documents.searchText: bg.1.3 bg.1.3 chapter 1 verse 3 पशयत पणडपतरणमचरय महत चमम वयढ दरपदपतरण तव शषयण धमत 1.3 pashyaitam pandu-putranam acharya mahatim chamum vyudham drupada-putrena tava shishyena dhimata behold o teacher this mighty army of the sons of pandu arrayed by the son of drupada thy wise disciple.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.3 bg.1.3 chapter 1 verse 3 पश्यैतां पाण्डुपुत्राणामाचार्य महतीं चमूम्।

व्यूढां द्रुपदपुत्रेण तव शिष्येण धीमता।।1.3।। paśhyaitāṁ pāṇḍu-putrāṇām āchārya mahatīṁ chamūm
vyūḍhāṁ drupada-putreṇa tava śhiṣhyeṇa dhīmatā behold, o teacher! this mighty army of the sons of pandu, arrayed by the son of drupada, thy wise disciple.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.30
documents.iast: gāṇḍīvaṁ sraṁsate hastāt tvak chaiva paridahyate
documents.summary: The Gandiva slips from my hand, and my skin burns all over; I am unable to stand, and my mind is reeling, as it were.
documents.searchText: bg.1.30 bg.1.30 chapter 1 verse 30 गणडव सरसत हसतततवकचव परदहयत न च शकनमयवसथत भरमतव च म मन 1.30 gandivam sramsate hastat tvak chaiva paridahyate na cha shaknomy avasthatum bhramativa cha me manah the gandiva slips from my hand and my skin burns all over i am unable to stand and my mind is reeling as it were.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.30 bg.1.30 chapter 1 verse 30 गाण्डीवं स्रंसते हस्तात्त्वक्चैव परिदह्यते।

न च शक्नोम्यवस्थातुं भ्रमतीव च मे मनः।।1.30।। gāṇḍīvaṁ sraṁsate hastāt tvak chaiva paridahyate
na cha śhaknomy avasthātuṁ bhramatīva cha me manaḥ the gandiva slips from my hand, and my skin burns all over; i am unable to stand, and my mind is reeling, as it were.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.31
documents.summary: And I see ill omens, O Kesava. I do not see any good in slaying my kinsmen in battle.
documents.searchText: bg.1.31 bg.1.31 chapter 1 verse 31 नमततन च पशयम वपरतन कशव न च शरयऽनपशयम हतव सवजनमहव 1.31 nimittani cha pashyami viparitani keshava na cha shreyo nupashyami hatva sva-janam ahave and i see ill omens o kesava. i do not see any good in slaying my kinsmen in battle.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.31 bg.1.31 chapter 1 verse 31 निमित्तानि च पश्यामि विपरीतानि केशव।

न च श्रेयोऽनुपश्यामि हत्वा स्वजनमाहवे।।1.31।। nimittāni cha paśhyāmi viparītāni keśhava
na cha śhreyo ’nupaśhyāmi hatvā sva-janam āhave and i see ill omens, o kesava. i do not see any good in slaying my kinsmen in battle.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.32
documents.iast: na kāṅkṣhe vijayaṁ kṛiṣhṇa na cha rājyaṁ sukhāni cha
documents.sanskrit: न काङ्क्षे विजयं कृष्ण न च राज्यं सुखानि च।
documents.summary:
I desire not victory, O Krishna, nor kingdom, nor pleasures.
What use is dominion to us, O Krishna, or pleasures or even life?
documents.searchText: bg.1.32 bg.1.32 chapter 1 verse 32 न कङकष वजय कषण न च रजय सखन च क न रजयन गवनद क भगरजवतन व 1.32 na kankshe vijayam krishna na cha rajyam sukhani cha kim no rajyena govinda kim bhogair jivitena va i desire not victory o krishna nor kingdom nor pleasures. what use is dominion to us o krishna or pleasures or even life
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.32 bg.1.32 chapter 1 verse 32 न काङ्क्षे विजयं कृष्ण न च राज्यं सुखानि च।

किं नो राज्येन गोविन्द किं भोगैर्जीवितेन वा।।1.32।। na kāṅkṣhe vijayaṁ kṛiṣhṇa na cha rājyaṁ sukhāni cha
kiṁ no rājyena govinda kiṁ bhogair jīvitena vā i desire not victory, o krishna, nor kingdom, nor pleasures.
what use is dominion to us, o krishna, or pleasures or even life?

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.33
documents.iast: yeṣhām arthe kāṅkṣhitaṁ no rājyaṁ bhogāḥ sukhāni cha
documents.sanskrit: येषामर्थे काङ्क्षितं नो राज्यं भोगाः सुखानि च।
documents.summary: Those for whose sake we desire kingdom, enjoyments, and pleasures stand here in battle, having renounced life and wealth.
documents.searchText: bg.1.33 bg.1.33 chapter 1 verse 33 यषमरथ कङकषत न रजय भग सखन च त इमऽवसथत यदध परणसतयकतव धनन च 1.33 yesham arthe kankshitam no rajyam bhogah sukhani cha ta ime vasthita yuddhe pranams tyaktva dhanani cha those for whose sake we desire kingdom enjoyments and pleasures stand here in battle having renounced life and wealth.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.33 bg.1.33 chapter 1 verse 33 येषामर्थे काङ्क्षितं नो राज्यं भोगाः सुखानि च।

त इमेऽवस्थिता युद्धे प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा धनानि च।।1.33।। yeṣhām arthe kāṅkṣhitaṁ no rājyaṁ bhogāḥ sukhāni cha
ta ime ’vasthitā yuddhe prāṇāṁs tyaktvā dhanāni cha those for whose sake we desire kingdom, enjoyments, and pleasures stand here in battle, having renounced life and wealth.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.34
documents.iast: āchāryāḥ pitaraḥ putrās tathaiva cha pitāmahāḥ
documents.summary: Teachers, fathers, sons, and grandfathers, maternal uncles, fathers-in-law, grandsons, brothers-in-law, and other relatives—
documents.searchText: bg.1.34 bg.1.34 chapter 1 verse 34 आचरय पतर पतरसतथव च पतमह मतल शचशर पतर शयल समबनधनसतथ 1.34 acharyah pitarah putras tathaiva cha pitamahah matulah shvashurah pautrah shyalah sambandhinas tatha teachers fathers sons and grandfathers maternal uncles fathers-in-law grandsons brothers-in-law and other relatives
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.34 bg.1.34 chapter 1 verse 34 आचार्याः पितरः पुत्रास्तथैव च पितामहाः।

मातुलाः श्चशुराः पौत्राः श्यालाः सम्बन्धिनस्तथा।।1.34।। āchāryāḥ pitaraḥ putrās tathaiva cha pitāmahāḥ
mātulāḥ śhvaśhurāḥ pautrāḥ śhyālāḥ sambandhinas tathā teachers, fathers, sons, and grandfathers, maternal uncles, fathers-in-law, grandsons, brothers-in-law, and other relatives—

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.35
documents.iast: etān na hantum ichchhāmi ghnato ’pi madhusūdana
documents.summary: These I do not wish to kill, O Krishna, even though they kill me, for the sake of dominion over the three worlds; leave alone killing them for the sake of the earth."
documents.searchText: bg.1.35 bg.1.35 chapter 1 verse 35 एतनन हनतमचछम घनतऽप मधसदन अप तरलकयरजयसय हत क न महकत 1.35 etan na hantum ichchhami ghnato pi madhusudana api trailokya-rajyasya hetoh kim nu mahi-krite these i do not wish to kill o krishna even though they kill me for the sake of dominion over the three worlds leave alone killing them for the sake of the earth.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.35 bg.1.35 chapter 1 verse 35 एतान्न हन्तुमिच्छामि घ्नतोऽपि मधुसूदन।

अपि त्रैलोक्यराज्यस्य हेतोः किं नु महीकृते।।1.35।। etān na hantum ichchhāmi ghnato ’pi madhusūdana
api trailokya-rājyasya hetoḥ kiṁ nu mahī-kṛite these i do not wish to kill, o krishna, even though they kill me, for the sake of dominion over the three worlds; leave alone killing them for the sake of the earth."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.36
documents.iast: nihatya dhārtarāṣhṭrān naḥ kā prītiḥ syāj janārdana
documents.summary: By killing these sons of Dhritarashtra, what pleasure could be ours, O Janardana? Only sin would accrue to us from killing these felons.
documents.searchText: bg.1.36 bg.1.36 chapter 1 verse 36 नहतय धरतरषटरनन क परत सयजजनरदन पपमवशरयदसमनहतवतनततयन 1.36 nihatya dhartarashtran nah ka pritih syaj janardana papam evashrayed asman hatvaitan atatayinah by killing these sons of dhritarashtra what pleasure could be ours o janardana only sin would accrue to us from killing these felons.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.36 bg.1.36 chapter 1 verse 36 निहत्य धार्तराष्ट्रान्नः का प्रीतिः स्याज्जनार्दन।

पापमेवाश्रयेदस्मान्हत्वैतानाततायिनः।।1.36।। nihatya dhārtarāṣhṭrān naḥ kā prītiḥ syāj janārdana
pāpam evāśhrayed asmān hatvaitān ātatāyinaḥ by killing these sons of dhritarashtra, what pleasure could be ours, o janardana? only sin would accrue to us from killing these felons.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.37
documents.iast: tasmān nārhā vayaṁ hantuṁ dhārtarāṣhṭrān sa-bāndhavān
documents.summary: Therefore, we should not kill the sons of Dhritarashtra, our relatives; for how can we be happy by killing our own kin, O Madhava (Krishna)?
documents.searchText: bg.1.37 bg.1.37 chapter 1 verse 37 तसमननरह वय हनत धरतरषटरनसवबनधवन सवजन ह कथ हतव सखन सयम मधव 1.37 tasman narha vayam hantum dhartarashtran sa-bandhavan sva-janam hi katham hatva sukhinah syama madhava therefore we should not kill the sons of dhritarashtra our relatives for how can we be happy by killing our own kin o madhava krishna
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.37 bg.1.37 chapter 1 verse 37 तस्मान्नार्हा वयं हन्तुं धार्तराष्ट्रान्स्वबान्धवान्।

स्वजनं हि कथं हत्वा सुखिनः स्याम माधव।।1.37।। tasmān nārhā vayaṁ hantuṁ dhārtarāṣhṭrān sa-bāndhavān 
sva-janaṁ hi kathaṁ hatvā sukhinaḥ syāma mādhava therefore, we should not kill the sons of dhritarashtra, our relatives; for how can we be happy by killing our own kin, o madhava (krishna)?

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.38
documents.iast: yady apy ete na paśhyanti lobhopahata-chetasaḥ
documents.summary: Though they, with intelligence overpowered by greed, see no evil in the destruction of families and no sin in hostility to friends,
documents.searchText: bg.1.38 bg.1.38 chapter 1 verse 38 यदयपयत न पशयनत लभपहतचतस कलकषयकत दष मतरदरह च पतकम 1.38 yady apy ete na pashyanti lobhopahata-chetasah kula-kshaya-kritam dosham mitra-drohe cha patakam though they with intelligence overpowered by greed see no evil in the destruction of families and no sin in hostility to friends
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.38 bg.1.38 chapter 1 verse 38 यद्यप्येते न पश्यन्ति लोभोपहतचेतसः।

कुलक्षयकृतं दोषं मित्रद्रोहे च पातकम्।।1.38।। yady apy ete na paśhyanti lobhopahata-chetasaḥ
kula-kṣhaya-kṛitaṁ doṣhaṁ mitra-drohe cha pātakam though they, with intelligence overpowered by greed, see no evil in the destruction of families and no sin in hostility to friends,

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.39
documents.iast: kathaṁ na jñeyam asmābhiḥ pāpād asmān nivartitum
documents.summary: Why should we not, who clearly see the evil in the destruction of families, learn to turn away from this sin, O Janardana (Krishna)?
documents.searchText: bg.1.39 bg.1.39 chapter 1 verse 39 कथ न जञयमसमभ पपदसमननवरततम कलकषयकत दष परपशयदभरजनरदन 1.39 katham na jneyam asmabhih papad asman nivartitum kula-kshaya-kritam dosham prapashyadbhir janardana why should we not who clearly see the evil in the destruction of families learn to turn away from this sin o janardana krishna
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.39 bg.1.39 chapter 1 verse 39 कथं न ज्ञेयमस्माभिः पापादस्मान्निवर्तितुम्।

कुलक्षयकृतं दोषं प्रपश्यद्भिर्जनार्दन।।1.39।। kathaṁ na jñeyam asmābhiḥ pāpād asmān nivartitum
kula-kṣhaya-kṛitaṁ doṣhaṁ prapaśhyadbhir janārdana why should we not, who clearly see the evil in the destruction of families, learn to turn away from this sin, o janardana (krishna)?

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.4
documents.summary: Here are heroes, mighty archers, equal in battle to Bhima and Arjuna, Yuyudhana (Satyaki), Virata, and Drupada—all mighty warriors.
documents.searchText: bg.1.4 bg.1.4 chapter 1 verse 4 अतर शर महषवस भमरजनसम यध ययधन वरटशच दरपदशच महरथ 1.4 atra shura maheshvasa bhimarjuna-sama yudhi yuyudhano viratashcha drupadashcha maha-rathah here are heroes mighty archers equal in battle to bhima and arjuna yuyudhana satyaki virata and drupada all mighty warriors.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.4 bg.1.4 chapter 1 verse 4 अत्र शूरा महेष्वासा भीमार्जुनसमा युधि।

युयुधानो विराटश्च द्रुपदश्च महारथः।।1.4।। atra śhūrā maheṣhvāsā bhīmārjuna-samā yudhi
yuyudhāno virāṭaśhcha drupadaśhcha mahā-rathaḥ here are heroes, mighty archers, equal in battle to bhima and arjuna, yuyudhana (satyaki), virata, and drupada—all mighty warriors.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.40
documents.summary: In the destruction of a family, the immemorial religious rites of that family perish; on the destruction of spirituality, impiety indeed, overwhelms the whole family.
documents.searchText: bg.1.40 bg.1.40 chapter 1 verse 40 कलकषय परणशयनत कलधरम सनतन धरम नषट कल कतसनमधरमऽभभवतयत 1.40 kula-kshaye pranashyanti kula-dharmah sanatanah dharme nashte kulam kritsnam adharmo bhibhavaty uta in the destruction of a family the immemorial religious rites of that family perish on the destruction of spirituality impiety indeed overwhelms the whole family.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.40 bg.1.40 chapter 1 verse 40 कुलक्षये प्रणश्यन्ति कुलधर्माः सनातनाः।

धर्मे नष्टे कुलं कृत्स्नमधर्मोऽभिभवत्युत।।1.40।। kula-kṣhaye praṇaśhyanti kula-dharmāḥ sanātanāḥ
dharme naṣhṭe kulaṁ kṛitsnam adharmo ’bhibhavaty uta in the destruction of a family, the immemorial religious rites of that family perish; on the destruction of spirituality, impiety indeed, overwhelms the whole family.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.41
documents.summary: O Krishna, by the prevalence of impiety, the women of the family become corrupt; and, when women are corrupted, O Varshenya (descendant of Vrishni), intermingling of castes arises.
documents.searchText: bg.1.41 bg.1.41 chapter 1 verse 41 अधरमभभवतकषण परदषयनत कलसतरय सतरष दषटस वरषणय जयत वरणसङकर 1.41 adharmabhibhavat krishna pradushyanti kula-striyah strishu dushtasu varshneya jayate varna-sankarah o krishna by the prevalence of impiety the women of the family become corrupt and when women are corrupted o varshenya descendant of vrishni intermingling of castes arises.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.41 bg.1.41 chapter 1 verse 41 अधर्माभिभवात्कृष्ण प्रदुष्यन्ति कुलस्त्रियः।

स्त्रीषु दुष्टासु वार्ष्णेय जायते वर्णसङ्करः।।1.41।। adharmābhibhavāt kṛiṣhṇa praduṣhyanti kula-striyaḥ
strīṣhu duṣhṭāsu vārṣhṇeya jāyate varṇa-saṅkaraḥ o krishna, by the prevalence of impiety, the women of the family become corrupt; and, when women are corrupted, o varshenya (descendant of vrishni), intermingling of castes arises.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.42
documents.summary: Confusion of castes leads to hell for the slayers of the family, for their forebears fall, deprived of the offerings of rice-balls and libations of water.
documents.searchText: bg.1.42 bg.1.42 chapter 1 verse 42 सङकर नरकयव कलघनन कलसय च पतनत पतर हयष लपतपणडदककरय 1.42 sankaro narakayaiva kula-ghnanam kulasya cha patanti pitaro hy esham lupta-pindodaka-kriyah confusion of castes leads to hell for the slayers of the family for their forebears fall deprived of the offerings of rice-balls and libations of water.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.42 bg.1.42 chapter 1 verse 42 सङ्करो नरकायैव कुलघ्नानां कुलस्य च।

पतन्ति पितरो ह्येषां लुप्तपिण्डोदकक्रियाः।।1.42।। saṅkaro narakāyaiva kula-ghnānāṁ kulasya cha
patanti pitaro hy eṣhāṁ lupta-piṇḍodaka-kriyāḥ confusion of castes leads to hell for the slayers of the family, for their forebears fall, deprived of the offerings of rice-balls and libations of water.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.43
documents.summary: By these evil deeds of the destroyers of the family, which cause confusion of castes, the eternal religious rites of the caste and the family are destroyed.
documents.searchText: bg.1.43 bg.1.43 chapter 1 verse 43 दषरत कलघनन वरणसङकरकरक उतसदयनत जतधरम कलधरमशच शशवत 1.43 doshair etaih kula-ghnanam varna-sankara-karakaih utsadyante jati-dharmah kula-dharmash cha shashvatah by these evil deeds of the destroyers of the family which cause confusion of castes the eternal religious rites of the caste and the family are destroyed.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.43 bg.1.43 chapter 1 verse 43 दोषैरेतैः कुलघ्नानां वर्णसङ्करकारकैः।

उत्साद्यन्ते जातिधर्माः कुलधर्माश्च शाश्वताः।।1.43।। doṣhair etaiḥ kula-ghnānāṁ varṇa-saṅkara-kārakaiḥ
utsādyante jāti-dharmāḥ kula-dharmāśh cha śhāśhvatāḥ by these evil deeds of the destroyers of the family, which cause confusion of castes, the eternal religious rites of the caste and the family are destroyed.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.44
documents.summary: We have heard, O Janardana, that those men in whose families the religious practices have been destroyed are inevitably destined to dwell in hell for an unknown period.
documents.searchText: bg.1.44 bg.1.44 chapter 1 verse 44 उतसननकलधरमण मनषयण जनरदन नरकऽनयत वस भवततयनशशरम 1.44 utsanna-kula-dharmanam manushyanam janardana narake niyatam vaso bhavatityanushushruma we have heard o janardana that those men in whose families the religious practices have been destroyed are inevitably destined to dwell in hell for an unknown period.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.44 bg.1.44 chapter 1 verse 44 उत्सन्नकुलधर्माणां मनुष्याणां जनार्दन।

नरकेऽनियतं वासो भवतीत्यनुशुश्रुम।।1.44।। utsanna-kula-dharmāṇāṁ manuṣhyāṇāṁ janārdana
narake ‘niyataṁ vāso bhavatītyanuśhuśhruma we have heard, o janardana, that those men in whose families the religious practices have been destroyed are inevitably destined to dwell in hell for an unknown period.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.45
documents.iast: aho bata mahat pāpaṁ kartuṁ vyavasitā vayam
documents.sanskrit: अहो बत महत्पापं कर्तुं व्यवसिता वयम्।
documents.summary: Alas! We are involved in a great sin, for we are prepared to kill our kinsmen, out of greed for the pleasures of a kingdom.
documents.searchText: bg.1.45 bg.1.45 chapter 1 verse 45 अह बत महतपप करत वयवसत वयम यदरजयसखलभन हनत सवजनमदयत 1.45 aho bata mahat papam kartum vyavasita vayam yad rajya-sukha-lobhena hantum sva-janam udyatah alas we are involved in a great sin for we are prepared to kill our kinsmen out of greed for the pleasures of a kingdom.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.45 bg.1.45 chapter 1 verse 45 अहो बत महत्पापं कर्तुं व्यवसिता वयम्।

यद्राज्यसुखलोभेन हन्तुं स्वजनमुद्यताः।।1.45।। aho bata mahat pāpaṁ kartuṁ vyavasitā vayam
yad rājya-sukha-lobhena hantuṁ sva-janam udyatāḥ alas! we are involved in a great sin, for we are prepared to kill our kinsmen, out of greed for the pleasures of a kingdom.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.46
documents.summary: If the sons of Dhritarashtra, with weapons in hand, should slay me in battle, unresisting and unarmed, that would be better for me.
documents.searchText: bg.1.46 bg.1.46 chapter 1 verse 46 यद ममपरतकरमशसतर शसतरपणय धरतरषटर रण हनयसतनम कषमतर भवत 1.46 yadi mam apratikaram ashastram shastra-panayah dhartarashtra rane hanyus tan me kshemataram bhavet if the sons of dhritarashtra with weapons in hand should slay me in battle unresisting and unarmed that would be better for me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.46 bg.1.46 chapter 1 verse 46 यदि मामप्रतीकारमशस्त्रं शस्त्रपाणयः।

धार्तराष्ट्रा रणे हन्युस्तन्मे क्षेमतरं भवेत्।।1.46।। yadi mām apratīkāram aśhastraṁ śhastra-pāṇayaḥ
dhārtarāṣhṭrā raṇe hanyus tan me kṣhemataraṁ bhavet if the sons of dhritarashtra, with weapons in hand, should slay me in battle, unresisting and unarmed, that would be better for me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.47
documents.summary: Sanjaya said, Having thus spoken in the midst of the battlefield, Arjuna cast away his bow and arrow and, his mind overwhelmed with sorrow, sat down on the seat of the chariot.
documents.searchText: bg.1.47 bg.1.47 chapter 1 verse 47 सञजय उवच एवमकतवऽरजन सखय रथपसथ उपवशत वसजय सशर चप शकसवगनमनस 1.47 sanjaya uvacha evam uktvarjunah sankhye rathopastha upavishat visrijya sa-sharam chapam shoka-samvigna-manasah sanjaya said having thus spoken in the midst of the battlefield arjuna cast away his bow and arrow and his mind overwhelmed with sorrow sat down on the seat of the chariot.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.47 bg.1.47 chapter 1 verse 47 सञ्जय उवाच

एवमुक्त्वाऽर्जुनः संख्ये रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्।

विसृज्य सशरं चापं शोकसंविग्नमानसः।।1.47।। sañjaya uvācha
evam uktvārjunaḥ saṅkhye rathopastha upāviśhat
visṛijya sa-śharaṁ chāpaṁ śhoka-saṁvigna-mānasaḥ sanjaya said, having thus spoken in the midst of the battlefield, arjuna cast away his bow and arrow and, his mind overwhelmed with sorrow, sat down on the seat of the chariot.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.5
documents.summary: Dhrishtaketu, Chekitana, the valiant king of Kasi, Purujit, Kuntibhoja, and Saibya—the best of men.
documents.searchText: bg.1.5 bg.1.5 chapter 1 verse 5 धषटकतशचकतन कशरजशच वरयवन परजतकनतभजशच शबयशच नरपङगव 1.5 dhrishtaketushchekitanah kashirajashcha viryavan purujit kuntibhojashcha shaibyashcha nara-pungavah yudhamanyushcha vikranta uttamaujashcha viryavan dhrishtaketu chekitana the valiant king of kasi purujit kuntibhoja and saibya the best of men.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.5 bg.1.5 chapter 1 verse 5 धृष्टकेतुश्चेकितानः काशिराजश्च वीर्यवान्।

पुरुजित्कुन्तिभोजश्च शैब्यश्च नरपुङ्गवः।।1.5।। dhṛiṣhṭaketuśhchekitānaḥ kāśhirājaśhcha vīryavān
purujit kuntibhojaśhcha śhaibyaśhcha nara-puṅgavaḥ
yudhāmanyuśhcha vikrānta uttamaujāśhcha vīryavān dhrishtaketu, chekitana, the valiant king of kasi, purujit, kuntibhoja, and saibya—the best of men.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.6
documents.summary: The strong Yudhamanyu and the brave Uttamaujas, the son of Subhadra (Abhimanyu, the son of Subhadra and Arjuna), and the sons of Draupadi, all of them great charioteers (great hero
documents.searchText: bg.1.6 bg.1.6 chapter 1 verse 6 यधमनयशच वकरनत उततमजशच वरयवन सभदर दरपदयशच सरव एव महरथ 1.6 saubhadro draupadeyashcha sarva eva maha-rathah the strong yudhamanyu and the brave uttamaujas the son of subhadra abhimanyu the son of subhadra and arjuna and the sons of draupadi all of them great charioteers great heroes .
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.6 bg.1.6 chapter 1 verse 6 युधामन्युश्च विक्रान्त उत्तमौजाश्च वीर्यवान्।

सौभद्रो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्व एव महारथाः।।1.6।। saubhadro draupadeyāśhcha sarva eva mahā-rathāḥ the strong yudhamanyu and the brave uttamaujas, the son of subhadra (abhimanyu, the son of subhadra and arjuna), and the sons of draupadi, all of them great charioteers (great heroes)."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.7
documents.iast: asmākaṁ tu viśhiṣhṭā ye tānnibodha dwijottama
documents.sanskrit: अस्माकं तु विशिष्टा ये तान्निबोध द्विजोत्तम।
documents.summary: Know also, O best among the twice-born! the names of those who are the most distinguished amongst ourselves, the leaders of my army; these I name to you for your information.
documents.searchText: bg.1.7 bg.1.7 chapter 1 verse 7 असमक त वशषट य तननबध दवजततम नयक मम सनयसय सजञरथ तनबरवम त 1.7 asmakam tu vishishta ye tannibodha dwijottama nayaka mama sainyasya sanjnartham tanbravimi te know also o best among the twice-born the names of those who are the most distinguished amongst ourselves the leaders of my army these i name to you for your information.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.7 bg.1.7 chapter 1 verse 7 अस्माकं तु विशिष्टा ये तान्निबोध द्विजोत्तम।

नायका मम सैन्यस्य संज्ञार्थं तान्ब्रवीमि ते।।1.7।। asmākaṁ tu viśhiṣhṭā ye tānnibodha dwijottama
nāyakā mama sainyasya sanjñārthaṁ tānbravīmi te know also, o best among the twice-born! the names of those who are the most distinguished amongst ourselves, the leaders of my army; these i name to you for your information.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.8
documents.summary: "Thou thyself, Bhishma, Karna, Kripa, the victorious in war, Asvatthama, Vikarna, and Bhurisrava, the son of Somadatta—all these are ready for battle."
documents.searchText: bg.1.8 bg.1.8 chapter 1 verse 8 भवनभषमशच करणशच कपशच समतञजय अशवतथम वकरणशच समदततसतथव च 1.8 bhavanbhishmashcha karnashcha kripashcha samitinjayah ashvatthama vikarnashcha saumadattis tathaiva cha thou thyself bhishma karna kripa the victorious in war asvatthama vikarna and bhurisrava the son of somadatta all these are ready for battle.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.8 bg.1.8 chapter 1 verse 8 भवान्भीष्मश्च कर्णश्च कृपश्च समितिञ्जयः।

अश्वत्थामा विकर्णश्च सौमदत्तिस्तथैव च।।1.8।। bhavānbhīṣhmaśhcha karṇaśhcha kṛipaśhcha samitiñjayaḥ
aśhvatthāmā vikarṇaśhcha saumadattis tathaiva cha "thou thyself, bhishma, karna, kripa, the victorious in war, asvatthama, vikarna, and bhurisrava, the son of somadatta—all these are ready for battle."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 1.9
documents.iast: anye cha bahavaḥ śhūrā madarthe tyaktajīvitāḥ
documents.sanskrit: अन्ये च बहवः शूरा मदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः।
documents.summary: And also many other heroes, ready to give up their lives for my sake, armed with various weapons and missiles, all well-skilled in battle.
documents.searchText: bg.1.9 bg.1.9 chapter 1 verse 9 अनय च बहव शर मदरथ तयकतजवत ननशसतरपरहरण सरव यदधवशरद 1.9 anye cha bahavah shura madarthe tyaktajivitah nana-shastra-praharanah sarve yuddha-visharadah and also many other heroes ready to give up their lives for my sake armed with various weapons and missiles all well-skilled in battle.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.1.9 bg.1.9 chapter 1 verse 9 अन्ये च बहवः शूरा मदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः।

नानाशस्त्रप्रहरणाः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः।।1.9।। anye cha bahavaḥ śhūrā madarthe tyaktajīvitāḥ
nānā-śhastra-praharaṇāḥ sarve yuddha-viśhāradāḥ and also many other heroes, ready to give up their lives for my sake, armed with various weapons and missiles, all well-skilled in battle.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.1
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, Again, O mighty-armed Arjuna, listen to my supreme word which I will declare to you, who are beloved, for your welfare.
documents.searchText: bg.10.1 bg.10.1 chapter 10 verse 1 शर भगवनवच भय एव महबह शरण म परम वच यततऽह परयमणय वकषयम हतकमयय 10.1 shri bhagavan uvacha bhuya eva maha-baho shrinu me paramam vachah yatte ham priyamanaya vakshyami hita-kamyaya the blessed lord said again o mighty-armed arjuna listen to my supreme word which i will declare to you who are beloved for your welfare.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.1 bg.10.1 chapter 10 verse 1 श्री भगवानुवाच

भूय एव महाबाहो श्रृणु मे परमं वचः।

यत्तेऽहं प्रीयमाणाय वक्ष्यामि हितकाम्यया।।10.1।। śhrī bhagavān uvācha
bhūya eva mahā-bāho śhṛiṇu me paramaṁ vachaḥ
yatte ’haṁ prīyamāṇāya vakṣhyāmi hita-kāmyayā the blessed lord said, again, o mighty-armed arjuna, listen to my supreme word which i will declare to you, who are beloved, for your welfare.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.10
documents.summary: To those who are ever steadfast, worshipping me with love, I give the yoga of discrimination, by which they come to me.
documents.searchText: bg.10.10 bg.10.10 chapter 10 verse 10 तष सततयकतन भजत परतपरवकम ददम बदधयग त यन ममपयनत त 10.10 tesham satata-yuktanam bhajatam priti-purvakam dadami buddhi-yogam tam yena mam upayanti te to those who are ever steadfast worshipping me with love i give the yoga of discrimination by which they come to me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.10 bg.10.10 chapter 10 verse 10 तेषां सततयुक्तानां भजतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम्।

ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते।।10.10।। teṣhāṁ satata-yuktānāṁ bhajatāṁ prīti-pūrvakam
dadāmi buddhi-yogaṁ taṁ yena mām upayānti te to those who are ever steadfast, worshipping me with love, i give the yoga of discrimination, by which they come to me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.11
documents.summary: Out of mere compassion for them, I, dwelling within their selves, destroy the darkness born of ignorance with the luminous lamp of knowledge.
documents.searchText: bg.10.11 bg.10.11 chapter 10 verse 11 तषमवनकमपरथमहमजञनज तम नशयमयतमभवसथ जञनदपन भसवत 10.11 tesham evanukampartham aham ajnana-jam tamah nashayamyatma-bhava-stho jnana-dipena bhasvata out of mere compassion for them i dwelling within their selves destroy the darkness born of ignorance with the luminous lamp of knowledge.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.11 bg.10.11 chapter 10 verse 11 तेषामेवानुकम्पार्थमहमज्ञानजं तमः।

नाशयाम्यात्मभावस्थो ज्ञानदीपेन भास्वता।।10.11।। teṣhām evānukampārtham aham ajñāna-jaṁ tamaḥ
nāśhayāmyātma-bhāva-stho jñāna-dīpena bhāsvatā out of mere compassion for them, i, dwelling within their selves, destroy the darkness born of ignorance with the luminous lamp of knowledge.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.12
documents.summary: Arjuna said, "You are the Supreme Brahman, the supreme abode, the supreme purifier, eternal, divine Person, the primeval God, unborn, and omnipresent."
documents.searchText: bg.10.12 bg.10.12 chapter 10 verse 12 अरजन उवच पर बरहम पर धम पवतर परम भवन परष शशवत दवयमददवमज वभम 10.12 arjuna uvacha param brahma param dhama pavitram paramam bhavan purusham shashvatam divyam adi-devam ajam vibhum arjuna said you are the supreme brahman the supreme abode the supreme purifier eternal divine person the primeval god unborn and omnipresent.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.12 bg.10.12 chapter 10 verse 12 अर्जुन उवाच

परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान्।

पुरुषं शाश्वतं दिव्यमादिदेवमजं विभुम्।।10.12।। arjuna uvācha
paraṁ brahma paraṁ dhāma pavitraṁ paramaṁ bhavān
puruṣhaṁ śhāśhvataṁ divyam ādi-devam ajaṁ vibhum arjuna said, "you are the supreme brahman, the supreme abode, the supreme purifier, eternal, divine person, the primeval god, unborn, and omnipresent."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.13
documents.iast: āhus tvām ṛiṣhayaḥ sarve devarṣhir nāradas tathā
documents.summary: All the sages have thus declared Thee, as also the divine sage Narada; so also Asita, Devala, and Vyasa; and now Thou Thyself dost say so to me.
documents.searchText: bg.10.13 bg.10.13 chapter 10 verse 13 आहसतवमषय सरव दवरषरनरदसतथ असत दवल वयस सवय चव बरवष म 10.13 ahus tvam rishayah sarve devarshir naradas tatha asito devalo vyasah svayam chaiva bravishi me all the sages have thus declared thee as also the divine sage narada so also asita devala and vyasa and now thou thyself dost say so to me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.13 bg.10.13 chapter 10 verse 13 आहुस्त्वामृषयः सर्वे देवर्षिर्नारदस्तथा।

असितो देवलो व्यासः स्वयं चैव ब्रवीषि मे।।10.13।। āhus tvām ṛiṣhayaḥ sarve devarṣhir nāradas tathā
asito devalo vyāsaḥ svayaṁ chaiva bravīṣhi me all the sages have thus declared thee, as also the divine sage narada; so also asita, devala, and vyasa; and now thou thyself dost say so to me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.14
documents.iast: sarvam etad ṛitaṁ manye yan māṁ vadasi keśhava
documents.summary: I believe all that You have said to me to be true, O Krishna; indeed, O blessed Lord! Neither the gods nor the demons know Your manifestation (origin).
documents.searchText: bg.10.14 bg.10.14 chapter 10 verse 14 सरवमतदत मनय यनम वदस कशव न ह त भगवन वयकत वदरदव न दनव 10.14 sarvam etad ritam manye yan mam vadasi keshava na hi te bhagavan vyaktim vidur deva na danavah i believe all that you have said to me to be true o krishna indeed o blessed lord neither the gods nor the demons know your manifestation origin .
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.14 bg.10.14 chapter 10 verse 14 सर्वमेतदृतं मन्ये यन्मां वदसि केशव।

न हि ते भगवन् व्यक्तिं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः।।10.14।। sarvam etad ṛitaṁ manye yan māṁ vadasi keśhava
na hi te bhagavan vyaktiṁ vidur devā na dānavāḥ i believe all that you have said to me to be true, o krishna; indeed, o blessed lord! neither the gods nor the demons know your manifestation (origin).

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.15
documents.summary: Verily, Thou Thyself knowest Thyself by Thyself, O Supreme Person, O source and Lord of all beings, O God of gods, O ruler of the world!
documents.searchText: bg.10.15 bg.10.15 chapter 10 verse 15 सवयमवतमनऽतमन वतथ तव परषततम भतभवन भतश दवदव जगतपत 10.15 swayam evatmanatmanam vettha tvam purushottama bhuta-bhavana bhutesha deva-deva jagat-pate verily thou thyself knowest thyself by thyself o supreme person o source and lord of all beings o god of gods o ruler of the world
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.15 bg.10.15 chapter 10 verse 15 स्वयमेवात्मनाऽत्मानं वेत्थ त्वं पुरुषोत्तम।

भूतभावन भूतेश देवदेव जगत्पते।।10.15।। swayam evātmanātmānaṁ vettha tvaṁ puruṣhottama
bhūta-bhāvana bhūteśha deva-deva jagat-pate verily, thou thyself knowest thyself by thyself, o supreme person, o source and lord of all beings, o god of gods, o ruler of the world!

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.16
documents.summary: You should indeed tell, without reserve, of your divine glories by which you exist, pervading all these worlds. (No one else can do so.)
documents.searchText: bg.10.16 bg.10.16 chapter 10 verse 16 वकतमरहसयशषण दवय हयतमवभतय यभरवभतभरलकनमसतव वयपय तषठस 10.16 vaktum arhasyasheshena divya hyatma-vibhutayah yabhir vibhutibhir lokan imams tvam vyapya tishthasi you should indeed tell without reserve of your divine glories by which you exist pervading all these worlds. no one else can do so.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.16 bg.10.16 chapter 10 verse 16 वक्तुमर्हस्यशेषेण दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः।

याभिर्विभूतिभिर्लोकानिमांस्त्वं व्याप्य तिष्ठसि।।10.16।। vaktum arhasyaśheṣheṇa divyā hyātma-vibhūtayaḥ
yābhir vibhūtibhir lokān imāṁs tvaṁ vyāpya tiṣhṭhasi you should indeed tell, without reserve, of your divine glories by which you exist, pervading all these worlds. (no one else can do so.)

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.17
documents.iast: kathaṁ vidyām ahaṁ yogins tvāṁ sadā parichintayan
documents.summary: How shall I, ever meditating, know you, O Yogin? In what aspects or things, O blessed Lord, should I think of you?
documents.searchText: bg.10.17 bg.10.17 chapter 10 verse 17 कथ वदयमह यगसतव सद परचनतयन कष कष च भवष चनतयऽस भगवनमय 10.17 katham vidyam aham yogins tvam sada parichintayan keshu keshu cha bhaveshu chintyo si bhagavan maya how shall i ever meditating know you o yogin in what aspects or things o blessed lord should i think of you
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.17 bg.10.17 chapter 10 verse 17 कथं विद्यामहं योगिंस्त्वां सदा परिचिन्तयन्।

केषु केषु च भावेषु चिन्त्योऽसि भगवन्मया।।10.17।। kathaṁ vidyām ahaṁ yogins tvāṁ sadā parichintayan
keṣhu keṣhu cha bhāveṣhu chintyo ’si bhagavan mayā how shall i, ever meditating, know you, o yogin? in what aspects or things, o blessed lord, should i think of you?

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.18
documents.summary: Tell me again in detail, O Krishna, of your yogic power and glory; for I am not satiated with what I have heard of your life-giving and nectar-like speech.
documents.searchText: bg.10.18 bg.10.18 chapter 10 verse 18 वसतरणतमन यग वभत च जनरदन भय कथय तपतरह शरणवत नसत मऽमतम 10.18 vistarenatmano yogam vibhutim cha janardana bhuyah kathaya triptir hi shrinvato nasti me mritam tell me again in detail o krishna of your yogic power and glory for i am not satiated with what i have heard of your life-giving and nectar-like speech.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.18 bg.10.18 chapter 10 verse 18 विस्तरेणात्मनो योगं विभूतिं च जनार्दन।

भूयः कथय तृप्तिर्हि श्रृण्वतो नास्ति मेऽमृतम्।।10.18।। vistareṇātmano yogaṁ vibhūtiṁ cha janārdana
bhūyaḥ kathaya tṛiptir hi śhṛiṇvato nāsti me ’mṛitam tell me again in detail, o krishna, of your yogic power and glory; for i am not satiated with what i have heard of your life-giving and nectar-like speech.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.19
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, "Very well! Now I will declare to you My divine glories in their prominence, O Arjuna; there is no end to their detailed description."
documents.searchText: bg.10.19 bg.10.19 chapter 10 verse 19 शर भगवनवच हनत त कथयषयम दवय हयतमवभतय परधनयत करशरषठ नसतयनत वसतरसय म 10.19 shri bhagavan uvacha hanta te kathayishyami divya hyatma-vibhutayah pradhanyatah kuru-shreshtha nastyanto vistarasya me the blessed lord said very well now i will declare to you my divine glories in their prominence o arjuna there is no end to their detailed description.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.19 bg.10.19 chapter 10 verse 19 श्री भगवानुवाच

हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः।

प्राधान्यतः कुरुश्रेष्ठ नास्त्यन्तो विस्तरस्य मे।।10.19।। śhrī bhagavān uvācha
hanta te kathayiṣhyāmi divyā hyātma-vibhūtayaḥ
prādhānyataḥ kuru-śhreṣhṭha nāstyanto vistarasya me the blessed lord said, "very well! now i will declare to you my divine glories in their prominence, o arjuna; there is no end to their detailed description."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.2
documents.iast: na me viduḥ sura-gaṇāḥ prabhavaṁ na maharṣhayaḥ
documents.sanskrit: न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः।
documents.summary: Neither the hosts of the gods nor the great sages know My origin; for I am the source of all the gods and the great sages in every way.
documents.searchText: bg.10.2 bg.10.2 chapter 10 verse 2 न म वद सरगण परभव न महरषय अहमदरह दवन महरषण च सरवश 10.2 na me viduh sura-ganah prabhavam na maharshayah aham adir hi devanam maharshinam cha sarvashah neither the hosts of the gods nor the great sages know my origin for i am the source of all the gods and the great sages in every way.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.2 bg.10.2 chapter 10 verse 2 न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः।

अहमादिर्हि देवानां महर्षीणां च सर्वशः।।10.2।। na me viduḥ sura-gaṇāḥ prabhavaṁ na maharṣhayaḥ
aham ādir hi devānāṁ maharṣhīṇāṁ cha sarvaśhaḥ neither the hosts of the gods nor the great sages know my origin; for i am the source of all the gods and the great sages in every way.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.20
documents.summary: I am the Self, O Gudakesa, seated in the hearts of all beings; I am the beginning, the middle, and the end of all beings.
documents.searchText: bg.10.20 bg.10.20 chapter 10 verse 20 अहमतम गडकश सरवभतशयसथत अहमदशच मधय च भतनमनत एव च 10.20 aham atma gudakesha sarva-bhutashaya-sthitah aham adish cha madhyam cha bhutanam anta eva cha i am the self o gudakesa seated in the hearts of all beings i am the beginning the middle and the end of all beings.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.20 bg.10.20 chapter 10 verse 20 अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः।

अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च।।10.20।। aham ātmā guḍākeśha sarva-bhūtāśhaya-sthitaḥ
aham ādiśh cha madhyaṁ cha bhūtānām anta eva cha i am the self, o gudakesa, seated in the hearts of all beings; i am the beginning, the middle, and the end of all beings.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.21
documents.iast: ādityānām ahaṁ viṣhṇur jyotiṣhāṁ ravir anśhumān
documents.summary: Among the twelve Adityas, I am Vishnu; among luminaries, the radiant sun; among the seven or forty-nine Maruts, I am Marichi; among stars, I am the moon.
documents.searchText: bg.10.21 bg.10.21 chapter 10 verse 21 आदतयनमह वषणरजयतष रवरशमन मरचरमरतमसम नकषतरणमह शश 10.21 adityanam aham vishnur jyotisham ravir anshuman marichir marutam asmi nakshatranam aham shashi among the twelve adityas i am vishnu among luminaries the radiant sun among the seven or forty-nine maruts i am marichi among stars i am the moon.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.21 bg.10.21 chapter 10 verse 21 आदित्यानामहं विष्णुर्ज्योतिषां रविरंशुमान्।

मरीचिर्मरुतामस्मि नक्षत्राणामहं शशी।।10.21।। ādityānām ahaṁ viṣhṇur jyotiṣhāṁ ravir anśhumān
marīchir marutām asmi nakṣhatrāṇām ahaṁ śhaśhī among the twelve adityas, i am vishnu; among luminaries, the radiant sun; among the seven or forty-nine maruts, i am marichi; among stars, i am the moon.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.22
documents.summary: Among the Vedas, I am the Sama-Veda; among the gods, I am Vasava; among the senses, I am the mind; and among living beings, I am intelligence.
documents.searchText: bg.10.22 bg.10.22 chapter 10 verse 22 वदन समवदऽसम दवनमसम वसव इनदरयण मनशचसम भतनमसम चतन 10.22 vedanam sama-vedo smi devanam asmi vasavah indriyanam manash chasmi bhutanam asmi chetana among the vedas i am the sama-veda among the gods i am vasava among the senses i am the mind and among living beings i am intelligence.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.22 bg.10.22 chapter 10 verse 22 वेदानां सामवेदोऽस्मि देवानामस्मि वासवः।

इन्द्रियाणां मनश्चास्मि भूतानामस्मि चेतना।।10.22।। vedānāṁ sāma-vedo ’smi devānām asmi vāsavaḥ
indriyāṇāṁ manaśh chāsmi bhūtānām asmi chetanā among the vedas, i am the sama-veda; among the gods, i am vasava; among the senses, i am the mind; and among living beings, i am intelligence.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.23
documents.summary: And among the Rudras, I am Sankara; among the Yakshas and Rakshasas, the Lord of Wealth (Kubera); among the Vasus, I am Pavaka (Fire); and among the seven mountains, I am Meru.
documents.searchText: bg.10.23 bg.10.23 chapter 10 verse 23 रदरण शङकरशचसम वततश यकषरकषसम वसन पवकशचसम मर शखरणमहम 10.23 rudranam shankarash chasmi vittesho yaksha-rakshasam vasunam pavakash chasmi meruh shikharinam aham and among the rudras i am sankara among the yakshas and rakshasas the lord of wealth kubera among the vasus i am pavaka fire and among the seven mountains i am meru.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.23 bg.10.23 chapter 10 verse 23 रुद्राणां शङ्करश्चास्मि वित्तेशो यक्षरक्षसाम्।

वसूनां पावकश्चास्मि मेरुः शिखरिणामहम्।।10.23।। rudrāṇāṁ śhaṅkaraśh chāsmi vitteśho yakṣha-rakṣhasām
vasūnāṁ pāvakaśh chāsmi meruḥ śhikhariṇām aham and among the rudras, i am sankara; among the yakshas and rakshasas, the lord of wealth (kubera); among the vasus, i am pavaka (fire); and among the seven mountains, i am meru.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.24
documents.iast: purodhasāṁ cha mukhyaṁ māṁ viddhi pārtha bṛihaspatim
documents.sanskrit: पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम्।
documents.summary: And, among the household priests of kings, O Arjuna, know Me to be the chief, Brihaspati; among the army generals, I am Skanda; among lakes, I am the ocean.
documents.searchText: bg.10.24 bg.10.24 chapter 10 verse 24 परधस च मखय म वदध परथ बहसपतम सनननमह सकनद सरसमसम सगर 10.24 purodhasam cha mukhyam mam viddhi partha brihaspatim senaninam aham skandah sarasam asmi sagarah and among the household priests of kings o arjuna know me to be the chief brihaspati among the army generals i am skanda among lakes i am the ocean.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.24 bg.10.24 chapter 10 verse 24 पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम्।

सेनानीनामहं स्कन्दः सरसामस्मि सागरः।।10.24।। purodhasāṁ cha mukhyaṁ māṁ viddhi pārtha bṛihaspatim
senānīnām ahaṁ skandaḥ sarasām asmi sāgaraḥ and, among the household priests of kings, o arjuna, know me to be the chief, brihaspati; among the army generals, i am skanda; among lakes, i am the ocean.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.25
documents.iast: maharṣhīṇāṁ bhṛigur ahaṁ girām asmyekam akṣharam
documents.summary: Among the great sages, I am Bhrigu; among words, I am the one syllable (Om); among sacrifices, I am the sacrifice of silent repetition; among the immovable things, I am the Himalay
documents.searchText: bg.10.25 bg.10.25 chapter 10 verse 25 महरषण भगरह गरमसमयकमकषरम यजञन जपयजञऽसम सथवरण हमलय 10.25 maharshinam bhrigur aham giram asmyekam aksharam yajnanam japa-yajno smi sthavaranam himalayah among the great sages i am bhrigu among words i am the one syllable om among sacrifices i am the sacrifice of silent repetition among the immovable things i am the himalayas.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.25 bg.10.25 chapter 10 verse 25 महर्षीणां भृगुरहं गिरामस्म्येकमक्षरम्।

यज्ञानां जपयज्ञोऽस्मि स्थावराणां हिमालयः।।10.25।। maharṣhīṇāṁ bhṛigur ahaṁ girām asmyekam akṣharam
yajñānāṁ japa-yajño ’smi sthāvarāṇāṁ himālayaḥ among the great sages, i am bhrigu; among words, i am the one syllable (om); among sacrifices, i am the sacrifice of silent repetition; among the immovable things, i am the himalayas.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.26
documents.summary: Among all the trees, I am the Peepul; among the divine sages, I am Narada; among the Gandharvas, I am Chitraratha; among the perfected, I am the sage Kapila.
documents.searchText: bg.10.26 bg.10.26 chapter 10 verse 26 अशवतथ सरववकषण दवरषण च नरद गनधरवण चतररथ सदधन कपल मन 10.26 ashvatthah sarva-vrikshanam devarshinam cha naradah gandharvanam chitrarathah siddhanam kapilo munih among all the trees i am the peepul among the divine sages i am narada among the gandharvas i am chitraratha among the perfected i am the sage kapila.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.26 bg.10.26 chapter 10 verse 26 अश्वत्थः सर्ववृक्षाणां देवर्षीणां च नारदः।

गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः।।10.26।। aśhvatthaḥ sarva-vṛikṣhāṇāṁ devarṣhīṇāṁ cha nāradaḥ
gandharvāṇāṁ chitrarathaḥ siddhānāṁ kapilo muniḥ among all the trees, i am the peepul; among the divine sages, i am narada; among the gandharvas, i am chitraratha; among the perfected, i am the sage kapila.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.27
documents.summary: Know Me as Ucchaisravas, born of nectar, among horses; Airavata among lordly elephants; and the king among men.
documents.searchText: bg.10.27 bg.10.27 chapter 10 verse 27 उचचशरवसमशवन वदध मममतदभवम ऐरवत गजनदरण नरण च नरधपम 10.27 uchchaihshravasam ashvanam viddhi mam amritodbhavam airavatam gajendranam naranam cha naradhipam know me as ucchaisravas born of nectar among horses airavata among lordly elephants and the king among men.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.27 bg.10.27 chapter 10 verse 27 उच्चैःश्रवसमश्वानां विद्धि माममृतोद्भवम्।

ऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणां नराणां च नराधिपम्।।10.27।। uchchaiḥśhravasam aśhvānāṁ viddhi mām amṛitodbhavam
airāvataṁ gajendrāṇāṁ narāṇāṁ cha narādhipam know me as ucchaisravas, born of nectar, among horses; airavata among lordly elephants; and the king among men.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.28
documents.iast: āyudhānām ahaṁ vajraṁ dhenūnām asmi kāmadhuk
documents.summary: Among weapons, I am the thunderbolt; among cows, I am the wish-fulfilling cow called Kamadhenu; I am the progenitor, the god of love; among serpents, I am Vasuki.
documents.searchText: bg.10.28 bg.10.28 chapter 10 verse 28 आयधनमह वजर धननमसम कमधक परजनशचसम कनदरप सरपणमसम वसक 10.28 ayudhanam aham vajram dhenunam asmi kamadhuk prajanash chasmi kandarpah sarpanam asmi vasukih among weapons i am the thunderbolt among cows i am the wish-fulfilling cow called kamadhenu i am the progenitor the god of love among serpents i am vasuki.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.28 bg.10.28 chapter 10 verse 28 आयुधानामहं वज्रं धेनूनामस्मि कामधुक्।

प्रजनश्चास्मि कन्दर्पः सर्पाणामस्मि वासुकिः।।10.28।। āyudhānām ahaṁ vajraṁ dhenūnām asmi kāmadhuk
prajanaśh chāsmi kandarpaḥ sarpāṇām asmi vāsukiḥ among weapons, i am the thunderbolt; among cows, i am the wish-fulfilling cow called kamadhenu; i am the progenitor, the god of love; among serpents, i am vasuki.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.29
documents.iast: anantaśh chāsmi nāgānāṁ varuṇo yādasām aham
documents.summary: I am Ananta among the Nagas; I am Varuna among water-deities; Aryaman among the Manes; I am Yama among the governors.
documents.searchText: bg.10.29 bg.10.29 chapter 10 verse 29 अननतशचसम नगन वरण यदसमहम पतणमरयम चसम यम सयमतमहम 10.29 anantash chasmi naganam varuno yadasam aham pitrinam aryama chasmi yamah sanyamatam aham i am ananta among the nagas i am varuna among water-deities aryaman among the manes i am yama among the governors.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.29 bg.10.29 chapter 10 verse 29 अनन्तश्चास्मि नागानां वरुणो यादसामहम्।

पितृ़णामर्यमा चास्मि यमः संयमतामहम्।।10.29।। anantaśh chāsmi nāgānāṁ varuṇo yādasām aham
pitṝīṇām aryamā chāsmi yamaḥ sanyamatām aham i am ananta among the nagas; i am varuna among water-deities; aryaman among the manes; i am yama among the governors.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.3
documents.iast: yo māmajam anādiṁ cha vetti loka-maheśhvaram
documents.summary: He who knows Me as unborn and beginningless, as the great Lord of the worlds, he among mortals is undeluded and is liberated from all sins.
documents.searchText: bg.10.3 bg.10.3 chapter 10 verse 3 य ममजमनद च वतत लकमहशवरम असममढ स मरतयष सरवपप परमचयत 10.3 yo mamajam anadim cha vetti loka-maheshvaram asammudhah sa martyeshu sarva-papaih pramuchyate he who knows me as unborn and beginningless as the great lord of the worlds he among mortals is undeluded and is liberated from all sins.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.3 bg.10.3 chapter 10 verse 3 यो मामजमनादिं च वेत्ति लोकमहेश्वरम्।

असम्मूढः स मर्त्येषु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते।।10.3।। yo māmajam anādiṁ cha vetti loka-maheśhvaram
asammūḍhaḥ sa martyeṣhu sarva-pāpaiḥ pramuchyate he who knows me as unborn and beginningless, as the great lord of the worlds, he among mortals is undeluded and is liberated from all sins.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.30
documents.iast: prahlādaśh chāsmi daityānāṁ kālaḥ kalayatām aham
documents.summary: And I am Prahlada among the demons, I am Time among reckoners, I am the lion among beasts, and Vainateya (Garuda) among birds.
documents.searchText: bg.10.30 bg.10.30 chapter 10 verse 30 परहलदशचसम दतयन कल कलयतमहम मगण च मगनदरऽह वनतयशच पकषणम 10.30 prahladash chasmi daityanam kalah kalayatam aham mriganam cha mrigendro ham vainateyash cha pakshinam and i am prahlada among the demons i am time among reckoners i am the lion among beasts and vainateya garuda among birds.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.30 bg.10.30 chapter 10 verse 30 प्रह्लादश्चास्मि दैत्यानां कालः कलयतामहम्।

मृगाणां च मृगेन्द्रोऽहं वैनतेयश्च पक्षिणाम्।।10.30।। prahlādaśh chāsmi daityānāṁ kālaḥ kalayatām aham
mṛigāṇāṁ cha mṛigendro ’haṁ vainateyaśh cha pakṣhiṇām and i am prahlada among the demons, i am time among reckoners, i am the lion among beasts, and vainateya (garuda) among birds.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.31
documents.iast: pavanaḥ pavatām asmi rāmaḥ śhastra-bhṛitām aham
documents.summary: Among the purifiers, I am the wind; among the warriors, I am Rama; among the fishes, I am the shark; among the streams, I am the Ganga.
documents.searchText: bg.10.31 bg.10.31 chapter 10 verse 31 पवन पवतमसम रम शसतरभतमहम झषण मकरशचसम सरतसमसम जहनव 10.31 pavanah pavatam asmi ramah shastra-bhritam aham jhashanam makarash chasmi srotasam asmi jahnavi among the purifiers i am the wind among the warriors i am rama among the fishes i am the shark among the streams i am the ganga.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.31 bg.10.31 chapter 10 verse 31 पवनः पवतामस्मि रामः शस्त्रभृतामहम्।

झषाणां मकरश्चास्मि स्रोतसामस्मि जाह्नवी।।10.31।। pavanaḥ pavatām asmi rāmaḥ śhastra-bhṛitām aham
jhaṣhāṇāṁ makaraśh chāsmi srotasām asmi jāhnavī among the purifiers, i am the wind; among the warriors, i am rama; among the fishes, i am the shark; among the streams, i am the ganga.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.32
documents.iast: sargāṇām ādir antaśh cha madhyaṁ chaivāham arjuna
documents.summary: Among creations I am the beginning, the middle, and the end, O Arjuna; among the sciences, I am the science of the Self; and I am the logic among controversialists.
documents.searchText: bg.10.32 bg.10.32 chapter 10 verse 32 सरगणमदरनतशच मधय चवहमरजन अधयतमवदय वदयन वद परवदतमहम 10.32 sarganam adir antash cha madhyam chaivaham arjuna adhyatma-vidya vidyanam vadah pravadatam aham among creations i am the beginning the middle and the end o arjuna among the sciences i am the science of the self and i am the logic among controversialists.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.32 bg.10.32 chapter 10 verse 32 सर्गाणामादिरन्तश्च मध्यं चैवाहमर्जुन।

अध्यात्मविद्या विद्यानां वादः प्रवदतामहम्।।10.32।। sargāṇām ādir antaśh cha madhyaṁ chaivāham arjuna
adhyātma-vidyā vidyānāṁ vādaḥ pravadatām aham among creations i am the beginning, the middle, and the end, o arjuna; among the sciences, i am the science of the self; and i am the logic among controversialists.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.33
documents.summary: Among the letters of the alphabet, I am the letter 'A' and the dual among compounds. I am verily the inexhaustible and everlasting time; I am the dispenser of the fruits of actions
documents.searchText: bg.10.33 bg.10.33 chapter 10 verse 33 अकषरणमकरऽसम दवनदव समसकसय च अहमवकषय कल धतऽह वशवतमख 10.33 अहमवकषय कल धतह वशवतमख 33 aksharanam a-karo smi dvandvah samasikasya cha aham evakshayah kalo dhataham vishvato-mukhah among the letters of the alphabet i am the letter a and the dual among compounds. i am verily the inexhaustible and everlasting time i am the dispenser of the fruits of actions having faces in all directions.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.33 bg.10.33 chapter 10 verse 33 अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि द्वन्द्वः सामासिकस्य च।

अहमेवाक्षयः कालो धाताऽहं विश्वतोमुखः।।10.33।। अहमेवाक्षय: कालो धाताहं विश्वतोमुख: || 33||

akṣharāṇām a-kāro ’smi dvandvaḥ sāmāsikasya cha
aham evākṣhayaḥ kālo dhātāhaṁ viśhvato-mukhaḥ among the letters of the alphabet, i am the letter 'a' and the dual among compounds. i am verily the inexhaustible and everlasting time; i am the dispenser of the fruits of actions, having faces in all directions.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.34
documents.iast: mṛityuḥ sarva-haraśh chāham udbhavaśh cha bhaviṣhyatām
documents.summary: And I am the all-devouring Death, and the source of prosperity for those who are to be prosperous; among the feminine qualities, I am fame, prosperity, speech, memory, intelligence
documents.searchText: bg.10.34 bg.10.34 chapter 10 verse 34 मतय सरवहरशचहमदभवशच भवषयतम करत शररवकच नरण समतरमध धत कषम 10.34 mrityuh sarva-harash chaham udbhavash cha bhavishyatam kirtih shrir vak cha narinam smritir medha dhritih kshama and i am the all-devouring death and the source of prosperity for those who are to be prosperous among the feminine qualities i am fame prosperity speech memory intelligence firmness and forgiveness.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.34 bg.10.34 chapter 10 verse 34 मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च भविष्यताम्।

कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा।।10.34।। mṛityuḥ sarva-haraśh chāham udbhavaśh cha bhaviṣhyatām
kīrtiḥ śhrīr vāk cha nārīṇāṁ smṛitir medhā dhṛitiḥ kṣhamā and i am the all-devouring death, and the source of prosperity for those who are to be prosperous; among the feminine qualities, i am fame, prosperity, speech, memory, intelligence, firmness, and forgiveness.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.35
documents.iast: bṛihat-sāma tathā sāmnāṁ gāyatrī chhandasām aham
documents.summary: Among the hymns, I am the Brihatsaman; among meters, I am Gayatri; among months, I am Margasirsha; among seasons, I am the flowery season.
documents.searchText: bg.10.35 bg.10.35 chapter 10 verse 35 बहतसम तथ समन गयतर छनदसमहम मसन मरगशरषऽहमतन कसमकर 10.35 brihat-sama tatha samnam gayatri chhandasam aham masanam marga-shirsho ham ritunam kusumakarah among the hymns i am the brihatsaman among meters i am gayatri among months i am margasirsha among seasons i am the flowery season.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.35 bg.10.35 chapter 10 verse 35 बृहत्साम तथा साम्नां गायत्री छन्दसामहम्।

मासानां मार्गशीर्षोऽहमृतूनां कुसुमाकरः।।10.35।। bṛihat-sāma tathā sāmnāṁ gāyatrī chhandasām aham
māsānāṁ mārga-śhīrṣho ’ham ṛitūnāṁ kusumākaraḥ among the hymns, i am the brihatsaman; among meters, i am gayatri; among months, i am margasirsha; among seasons, i am the flowery season.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.36
documents.iast: dyūtaṁ chhalayatām asmi tejas tejasvinām aham
documents.summary: I am the gambling of the deceitful; I am the splendor of the splendid; I am victory; I am the resolve of the resolute; I am the goodness of the good.
documents.searchText: bg.10.36 bg.10.36 chapter 10 verse 36 दयत छलयतमसम तजसतजसवनमहम जयऽसम वयवसयऽसम सततव सततववतमहम 10.36 dyutam chhalayatam asmi tejas tejasvinam aham jayo smi vyavasayo smi sattvam sattvavatam aham i am the gambling of the deceitful i am the splendor of the splendid i am victory i am the resolve of the resolute i am the goodness of the good.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.36 bg.10.36 chapter 10 verse 36 द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम्।

जयोऽस्मि व्यवसायोऽस्मि सत्त्वं सत्त्ववतामहम्।।10.36।। dyūtaṁ chhalayatām asmi tejas tejasvinām aham
jayo ’smi vyavasāyo ’smi sattvaṁ sattvavatām aham i am the gambling of the deceitful; i am the splendor of the splendid; i am victory; i am the resolve of the resolute; i am the goodness of the good.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.37
documents.summary: Among the Vrishnis, I am Vaasudeva; among the Pandavas, I am Arjuna; among the sages, I am Vyasa; among the poets, I am Usanas, the poet.
documents.searchText: bg.10.37 bg.10.37 chapter 10 verse 37 वषणन वसदवऽसम पणडवन धनजय मननमपयह वयस कवनमशन कव 10.37 vrishninam vasudevo smi pandavanam dhananjayah muninam apyaham vyasah kavinam ushana kavih among the vrishnis i am vaasudeva among the pandavas i am arjuna among the sages i am vyasa among the poets i am usanas the poet.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.37 bg.10.37 chapter 10 verse 37 वृष्णीनां वासुदेवोऽस्मि पाण्डवानां धनंजयः।

मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः कवीनामुशना कविः।।10.37।। vṛiṣhṇīnāṁ vāsudevo ’smi pāṇḍavānāṁ dhanañjayaḥ
munīnām apyahaṁ vyāsaḥ kavīnām uśhanā kaviḥ among the vrishnis, i am vaasudeva; among the pandavas, i am arjuna; among the sages, i am vyasa; among the poets, i am usanas, the poet.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.38
documents.iast: daṇḍo damayatām asmi nītir asmi jigīṣhatām
documents.summary: Of those who punish, I am the scepter; among those who seek victory, I am statesmanship; and among secrets, I am silence; I am knowledge among knowers.
documents.searchText: bg.10.38 bg.10.38 chapter 10 verse 38 दणड दमयतमसम नतरसम जगषतम मन चवसम गहयन जञन जञनवतमहम 10.38 dando damayatam asmi nitir asmi jigishatam maunam chaivasmi guhyanam jnanam jnanavatam aham of those who punish i am the scepter among those who seek victory i am statesmanship and among secrets i am silence i am knowledge among knowers.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.38 bg.10.38 chapter 10 verse 38 दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरस्मि जिगीषताम्।

मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम्।।10.38।। daṇḍo damayatām asmi nītir asmi jigīṣhatām
maunaṁ chaivāsmi guhyānāṁ jñānaṁ jñānavatām aham of those who punish, i am the scepter; among those who seek victory, i am statesmanship; and among secrets, i am silence; i am knowledge among knowers.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.39
documents.iast: yach chāpi sarva-bhūtānāṁ bījaṁ tad aham arjuna
documents.summary: And whatever is the seed of all beings, that too am I, O Arjuna; there is no being, be it moving or unmoving, that can exist without Me.
documents.searchText: bg.10.39 bg.10.39 chapter 10 verse 39 यचचप सरवभतन बज तदहमरजन न तदसत वन यतसयनमय भत चरचरम 10.39 yach chapi sarva-bhutanam bijam tad aham arjuna na tad asti vina yat syan maya bhutam characharam and whatever is the seed of all beings that too am i o arjuna there is no being be it moving or unmoving that can exist without me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.39 bg.10.39 chapter 10 verse 39 यच्चापि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तदहमर्जुन।

न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम्।।10.39।। yach chāpi sarva-bhūtānāṁ bījaṁ tad aham arjuna
na tad asti vinā yat syān mayā bhūtaṁ charācharam and whatever is the seed of all beings, that too am i, o arjuna; there is no being, be it moving or unmoving, that can exist without me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.4
documents.iast: buddhir jñānam asammohaḥ kṣhamā satyaṁ damaḥ śhamaḥ
documents.summary: Intellect, wisdom, non-delusion, forgiveness, truth, self-restraint, calmness, happiness, pain, existence or birth, non-existence or death, fear, and also fearlessness.
documents.searchText: bg.10.4 bg.10.4 chapter 10 verse 4 बदधरजञनमसमह कषम सतय दम शम सख दख भवऽभव भय चभयमव च 10.4 buddhir jnanam asammohah kshama satyam damah shamah sukham duhkham bhavo bhavo bhayam chabhayameva cha intellect wisdom non-delusion forgiveness truth self-restraint calmness happiness pain existence or birth non-existence or death fear and also fearlessness.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.4 bg.10.4 chapter 10 verse 4 बुद्धिर्ज्ञानमसंमोहः क्षमा सत्यं दमः शमः।

सुखं दुःखं भवोऽभावो भयं चाभयमेव च।।10.4।। buddhir jñānam asammohaḥ kṣhamā satyaṁ damaḥ śhamaḥ
sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ bhavo ’bhāvo bhayaṁ chābhayameva cha intellect, wisdom, non-delusion, forgiveness, truth, self-restraint, calmness, happiness, pain, existence or birth, non-existence or death, fear, and also fearlessness.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.40
documents.summary: There is no end to My divine glories, O Arjuna, but this is a brief statement by Me of the particulars of My divine glory.
documents.searchText: bg.10.40 bg.10.40 chapter 10 verse 40 ननतऽसत मम दवयन वभतन परतप एष तददशत परकत वभतरवसतर मय 10.40 nanto sti mama divyanam vibhutinam parantapa esha tuddeshatah prokto vibhuter vistaro maya there is no end to my divine glories o arjuna but this is a brief statement by me of the particulars of my divine glory.
documents.searchTextRaw:
