bg.10.40 bg.10.40 chapter 10 verse 40 नान्तोऽस्ति मम दिव्यानां विभूतीनां परंतप।

एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया।।10.40।। nānto ’sti mama divyānāṁ vibhūtīnāṁ parantapa
eṣha tūddeśhataḥ prokto vibhūter vistaro mayā there is no end to my divine glories, o arjuna, but this is a brief statement by me of the particulars of my divine glory.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.41
documents.iast: yad yad vibhūtimat sattvaṁ śhrīmad ūrjitam eva vā
documents.summary: Whatever being there is glorious, prosperous, or powerful, know that to be a manifestation of a part of My splendor.
documents.searchText: bg.10.41 bg.10.41 chapter 10 verse 41 यदयदवभतमतसततव शरमदरजतमव व तततदववगचछ तव मम तजऽशसभवम 10.41 yad yad vibhutimat sattvam shrimad urjitam eva va tat tad evavagachchha tvam mama tejo nsha-sambhavam whatever being there is glorious prosperous or powerful know that to be a manifestation of a part of my splendor.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.41 bg.10.41 chapter 10 verse 41 यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा।

तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसंभवम्।।10.41।। yad yad vibhūtimat sattvaṁ śhrīmad ūrjitam eva vā
tat tad evāvagachchha tvaṁ mama tejo ’nśha-sambhavam whatever being there is glorious, prosperous, or powerful, know that to be a manifestation of a part of my splendor.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.42
documents.iast: atha vā bahunaitena kiṁ jñātena tavārjuna
documents.summary: But, of what avail is the knowledge of all these details to you, O Arjuna? I exist, supporting this whole world with one part of Myself.
documents.searchText: bg.10.42 bg.10.42 chapter 10 verse 42 अथव बहनतन क जञतन तवरजन वषटभयहमद कतसनमकशन सथत जगत 10.42 atha va bahunaitena kim jnatena tavarjuna vishtabhyaham idam kritsnam ekanshena sthito jagat but of what avail is the knowledge of all these details to you o arjuna i exist supporting this whole world with one part of myself.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.42 bg.10.42 chapter 10 verse 42 अथवा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञातेन तवार्जुन।

विष्टभ्याहमिदं कृत्स्नमेकांशेन स्थितो जगत्।।10.42।। atha vā bahunaitena kiṁ jñātena tavārjuna
viṣhṭabhyāham idaṁ kṛitsnam ekānśhena sthito jagat but, of what avail is the knowledge of all these details to you, o arjuna? i exist, supporting this whole world with one part of myself.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.5
documents.iast: ahiṁsā   samatā  tuṣṭis tapo dānaṁ   yaśo    'yaśaḥ  bhavanti    bhāvā   bhūtānāṁ    matta   eva pṛthag-vidhāḥ
documents.summary: Non-injury, equanimity, contentment, austerity, beneficence, fame, and ill-fame—these different qualities of beings arise from Me alone.
documents.searchText: bg.10.5 bg.10.5 chapter 10 verse 5 अहस समत तषटसतप दन यशऽयश भवनत भव भतन मतत एव पथगवध 10.5 ahimsa samata tustis tapo danam yaso yasah bhavanti bhava bhutanam matta eva prthag-vidhah non-injury equanimity contentment austerity beneficence fame and ill-fame these different qualities of beings arise from me alone.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.5 bg.10.5 chapter 10 verse 5 अहिंसा समता तुष्टिस्तपो दानं यशोऽयशः।

भवन्ति भावा भूतानां मत्त एव पृथग्विधाः।।10.5।। ahiṁsā   samatā  tuṣṭis tapo dānaṁ   yaśo    'yaśaḥ  bhavanti    bhāvā   bhūtānāṁ    matta   eva pṛthag-vidhāḥ non-injury, equanimity, contentment, austerity, beneficence, fame, and ill-fame—these different qualities of beings arise from me alone.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.6
documents.iast: maharṣhayaḥ sapta pūrve chatvāro manavas tathā
documents.summary: The seven great sages, the ancient four, and the Manus, possessing powers like Mine (due to their minds being fixed on Me), were born from My mind; from them, these creatures have
documents.searchText: bg.10.6 bg.10.6 chapter 10 verse 6 महरषय सपत परव चतवर मनवसतथ मदभव मनस जत यष लक इम परज 10.6 maharshayah sapta purve chatvaro manavas tatha mad-bhava manasa jata yesham loka imah prajah the seven great sages the ancient four and the manus possessing powers like mine due to their minds being fixed on me were born from my mind from them these creatures have been born in this world.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.6 bg.10.6 chapter 10 verse 6 महर्षयः सप्त पूर्वे चत्वारो मनवस्तथा।

मद्भावा मानसा जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः।।10.6।। maharṣhayaḥ sapta pūrve chatvāro manavas tathā
mad-bhāvā mānasā jātā yeṣhāṁ loka imāḥ prajāḥ the seven great sages, the ancient four, and the manus, possessing powers like mine (due to their minds being fixed on me), were born from my mind; from them, these creatures have been born in this world.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.7
documents.iast: etāṁ vibhūtiṁ yogaṁ cha mama yo vetti tattvataḥ
documents.sanskrit: एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः।
documents.summary: He who truly knows these manifold manifestations of My Being and this Yoga-power of Mine, becomes established in unshakable Yoga; there is no doubt about it.
documents.searchText: bg.10.7 bg.10.7 chapter 10 verse 7 एत वभत यग च मम य वतत तततवत सऽवकमपन यगन यजयत नतर सशय 10.7 etam vibhutim yogam cha mama yo vetti tattvatah so vikampena yogena yujyate natra sanshayah he who truly knows these manifold manifestations of my being and this yoga-power of mine becomes established in unshakable yoga there is no doubt about it.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.7 bg.10.7 chapter 10 verse 7 एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः।

सोऽविकम्पेन योगेन युज्यते नात्र संशयः।।10.7।। etāṁ vibhūtiṁ yogaṁ cha mama yo vetti tattvataḥ
so ’vikampena yogena yujyate nātra sanśhayaḥ he who truly knows these manifold manifestations of my being and this yoga-power of mine, becomes established in unshakable yoga; there is no doubt about it.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.8
documents.iast: ahaṁ sarvasya prabhavo mattaḥ sarvaṁ pravartate
documents.sanskrit: अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते।
documents.summary: I am the source of all; from me everything evolves; Understanding this, the wise, endowed with meditation, worship me.
documents.searchText: bg.10.8 bg.10.8 chapter 10 verse 8 अह सरवसय परभव मतत सरव परवरतत इत मतव भजनत म बध भवसमनवत 10.8 aham sarvasya prabhavo mattah sarvam pravartate iti matva bhajante mam budha bhava-samanvitah i am the source of all from me everything evolves understanding this the wise endowed with meditation worship me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.8 bg.10.8 chapter 10 verse 8 अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते।

इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः।।10.8।। ahaṁ sarvasya prabhavo mattaḥ sarvaṁ pravartate
iti matvā bhajante māṁ budhā bhāva-samanvitāḥ i am the source of all; from me everything evolves; understanding this, the wise, endowed with meditation, worship me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 10.9
documents.summary: With their minds and lives wholly absorbed in Me, they enlighten each other and ever speak of Me, being satisfied and delighted.
documents.searchText: bg.10.9 bg.10.9 chapter 10 verse 9 मचचतत मदगतपरण बधयनत परसपरम कथयनतशच म नतय तषयनत च रमनत च 10.9 mach-chitta mad-gata-prana bodhayantah parasparam kathayantash cha mam nityam tushyanti cha ramanti cha with their minds and lives wholly absorbed in me they enlighten each other and ever speak of me being satisfied and delighted.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.10.9 bg.10.9 chapter 10 verse 9 मच्चित्ता मद्गतप्राणा बोधयन्तः परस्परम्।

कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च।।10.9।। mach-chittā mad-gata-prāṇā bodhayantaḥ parasparam
kathayantaśh cha māṁ nityaṁ tuṣhyanti cha ramanti cha with their minds and lives wholly absorbed in me, they enlighten each other and ever speak of me, being satisfied and delighted.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.1
documents.summary: Arjuna said, By this explanation of the highest secret concerning the Self which Thou hast spoken, for the sake of blessing me, my delusion has been dispelled.
documents.searchText: bg.11.1 bg.11.1 chapter 11 verse 1 अरजन उवच मदनगरहय परम गहयमधयतमसजञतम यततवयकत वचसतन महऽय वगत मम 11.1 arjuna uvacha mad-anugrahaya paramam guhyam adhyatma-sanjnitam yat tvayoktam vachas tena moho yam vigato mama arjuna said by this explanation of the highest secret concerning the self which thou hast spoken for the sake of blessing me my delusion has been dispelled.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.1 bg.11.1 chapter 11 verse 1 अर्जुन उवाच

मदनुग्रहाय परमं गुह्यमध्यात्मसंज्ञितम्।

यत्त्वयोक्तं वचस्तेन मोहोऽयं विगतो मम।।11.1।। arjuna uvācha
mad-anugrahāya paramaṁ guhyam adhyātma-sanjñitam
yat tvayoktaṁ vachas tena moho ’yaṁ vigato mama arjuna said, by this explanation of the highest secret concerning the self which thou hast spoken, for the sake of blessing me, my delusion has been dispelled.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.10
documents.summary: With numerous mouths and eyes, with numerous wondrous sights, with numerous divine adornments, with numerous divine weapons uplifted, such a form He showed.
documents.searchText: bg.11.10 bg.11.10 chapter 11 verse 10 अनकवकतरनयनमनकदभतदरशनम अनकदवयभरण दवयनकदयतयधम 11.10 aneka-vaktra-nayanam anekadbhuta-darshanam aneka-divyabharanam divyanekodyatayudham with numerous mouths and eyes with numerous wondrous sights with numerous divine adornments with numerous divine weapons uplifted such a form he showed.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.10 bg.11.10 chapter 11 verse 10 अनेकवक्त्रनयनमनेकाद्भुतदर्शनम्।

अनेकदिव्याभरणं दिव्यानेकोद्यतायुधम्।।11.10।। aneka-vaktra-nayanam anekādbhuta-darśhanam
aneka-divyābharaṇaṁ divyānekodyatāyudham with numerous mouths and eyes, with numerous wondrous sights, with numerous divine adornments, with numerous divine weapons uplifted, such a form he showed.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.11
documents.summary: Wearing divine garlands and apparel, anointed with divine unguents, the all-wonderful, resplendent Being is endless with faces on all sides.
documents.searchText: bg.11.11 bg.11.11 chapter 11 verse 11 दवयमलयमबरधर दवयगनधनलपनम सरवशचरयमय दवमननत वशवतमखम 11.11 divya-malyambara-dharam divya-gandhanulepanam sarvashcharya-mayam devam anantam vishvato-mukham wearing divine garlands and apparel anointed with divine unguents the all-wonderful resplendent being is endless with faces on all sides.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.11 bg.11.11 chapter 11 verse 11 दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम्।

सर्वाश्चर्यमयं देवमनन्तं विश्वतोमुखम्।।11.11।। divya-mālyāmbara-dharaṁ divya-gandhānulepanam
sarvāśhcharya-mayaṁ devam anantaṁ viśhvato-mukham wearing divine garlands and apparel, anointed with divine unguents, the all-wonderful, resplendent being is endless with faces on all sides.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.12
documents.summary: If the splendour of a thousand suns were to blaze out simultaneously in the sky, that would be the splendour of that mighty being.
documents.searchText: bg.11.12 bg.11.12 chapter 11 verse 12 दव सरयसहसरसय भवदयगपदतथत यद भ सदश स सयदभससतसय महतमन 11.12 divi surya-sahasrasya bhaved yugapad utthita yadi bhah sadrishi sa syad bhasas tasya mahatmanah if the splendour of a thousand suns were to blaze out simultaneously in the sky that would be the splendour of that mighty being.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.12 bg.11.12 chapter 11 verse 12 दिवि सूर्यसहस्रस्य भवेद्युगपदुत्थिता।

यदि भाः सदृशी सा स्याद्भासस्तस्य महात्मनः।।11.12।। divi sūrya-sahasrasya bhaved yugapad utthitā
yadi bhāḥ sadṛiśhī sā syād bhāsas tasya mahātmanaḥ if the splendour of a thousand suns were to blaze out simultaneously in the sky, that would be the splendour of that mighty being.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.13
documents.summary: There, in the body of the God of gods, Arjuna then saw the entire universe resting in one, with its myriad of divisions.
documents.searchText: bg.11.13 bg.11.13 chapter 11 verse 13 ततरकसथ जगतकतसन परवभकतमनकध अपशयददवदवसय शरर पणडवसतद 11.13 tatraika-stham jagat kritsnam pravibhaktam anekadha apashyad deva-devasya sharire pandavas tada there in the body of the god of gods arjuna then saw the entire universe resting in one with its myriad of divisions.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.13 bg.11.13 chapter 11 verse 13 तत्रैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं प्रविभक्तमनेकधा।

अपश्यद्देवदेवस्य शरीरे पाण्डवस्तदा।।11.13।। tatraika-sthaṁ jagat kṛitsnaṁ pravibhaktam anekadhā
apaśhyad deva-devasya śharīre pāṇḍavas tadā there, in the body of the god of gods, arjuna then saw the entire universe resting in one, with its myriad of divisions.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.14
documents.summary: Then, Arjuna, filled with wonder and his hair standing on end, bowed his head to the God and spoke with palms joined.
documents.searchText: bg.11.14 bg.11.14 chapter 11 verse 14 तत स वसमयवषट हषटरम धनञजय परणमय शरस दव कतञजलरभषत 11.14 tatah sa vismayavishto hrishta-roma dhananjayah pranamya shirasa devam kritanjalir abhashata then arjuna filled with wonder and his hair standing on end bowed his head to the god and spoke with palms joined.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.14 bg.11.14 chapter 11 verse 14 ततः स विस्मयाविष्टो हृष्टरोमा धनञ्जयः।

प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं कृताञ्जलिरभाषत।।11.14।। tataḥ sa vismayāviṣhṭo hṛiṣhṭa-romā dhanañjayaḥ
praṇamya śhirasā devaṁ kṛitāñjalir abhāṣhata then, arjuna, filled with wonder and his hair standing on end, bowed his head to the god and spoke with palms joined.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.15
documents.summary: Arjuna said, "O God, I see all the gods in Your body, as well as hosts of various classes of beings, Brahma the Lord seated on the lotus, all the sages, and the celestial serpents.
documents.searchText: bg.11.15 bg.11.15 chapter 11 verse 15 अरजन उवच पशयम दवसतव दव दह सरवसतथ भतवशषसङघन बरहमणमश कमलसनसथ मषशच सरवनरगशच दवयन 11.15 arjuna uvacha pashyami devans tava deva dehe sarvans tatha bhuta-vishesha-sanghan brahmanam isham kamalasana-stham rishinsh cha sarvan uragansh cha divyan arjuna said o god i see all the gods in your body as well as hosts of various classes of beings brahma the lord seated on the lotus all the sages and the celestial serpents.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.15 bg.11.15 chapter 11 verse 15 अर्जुन उवाच

पश्यामि देवांस्तव देव देहे

सर्वांस्तथा भूतविशेषसङ्घान्।

ब्रह्माणमीशं कमलासनस्थ

मृषींश्च सर्वानुरगांश्च दिव्यान्।।11.15।। arjuna uvācha
paśhyāmi devāns tava deva dehe
sarvāns tathā bhūta-viśheṣha-saṅghān
brahmāṇam īśhaṁ kamalāsana-stham
ṛiṣhīnśh cha sarvān uragānśh cha divyān arjuna said, "o god, i see all the gods in your body, as well as hosts of various classes of beings, brahma the lord seated on the lotus, all the sages, and the celestial serpents."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.16
documents.summary: I see You with boundless form on every side, with many arms, stomachs, mouths, and eyes; neither the end nor the middle nor the beginning do I see, O Lord of the Universe, O Cosmic
documents.searchText: bg.11.16 bg.11.16 chapter 11 verse 16 अनकबहदरवकतरनतर पशयम तव सरवतऽननतरपम ननत न मधय न पनसतवद पशयम वशवशवर वशवरप 11.16 aneka-bahudara-vaktra-netram pashyami tvam sarvato nanta-rupam nantam na madhyam na punas tavadim pashyami vishveshvara vishva-rupa i see you with boundless form on every side with many arms stomachs mouths and eyes neither the end nor the middle nor the beginning do i see o lord of the universe o cosmic form.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.16 bg.11.16 chapter 11 verse 16 अनेकबाहूदरवक्त्रनेत्रं

पश्यामि त्वां सर्वतोऽनन्तरूपम्।

नान्तं न मध्यं न पुनस्तवादिं

पश्यामि विश्वेश्वर विश्वरूप।।11.16।। aneka-bāhūdara-vaktra-netraṁ
paśhyāmi tvāṁ sarvato ’nanta-rūpam
nāntaṁ na madhyaṁ na punas tavādiṁ
paśhyāmi viśhveśhvara viśhva-rūpa i see you with boundless form on every side, with many arms, stomachs, mouths, and eyes; neither the end nor the middle nor the beginning do i see, o lord of the universe, o cosmic form.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.17
documents.summary: I see You with the diadem, club, and discus, a mass of radiance shining everywhere, very hard to look at, blazing all around like a burning fire and the sun, and immeasurable.
documents.searchText: bg.11.17 bg.11.17 chapter 11 verse 17 करटन गदन चकरण च तजरश सरवतदपतमनतम पशयम तव दरनरकषय समनत ददपतनलरकदयतमपरमयम 11.17 kiritinam gadinam chakrinam cha tejo-rashim sarvato diptimantam pashyami tvam durnirikshyam samantad diptanalarka-dyutim aprameyam i see you with the diadem club and discus a mass of radiance shining everywhere very hard to look at blazing all around like a burning fire and the sun and immeasurable.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.17 bg.11.17 chapter 11 verse 17 किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रिणं च

तेजोराशिं सर्वतोदीप्तिमन्तम्।

पश्यामि त्वां दुर्निरीक्ष्यं समन्ता

द्दीप्तानलार्कद्युतिमप्रमेयम्।।11.17।। kirīṭinaṁ gadinaṁ chakriṇaṁ cha
tejo-rāśhiṁ sarvato dīptimantam
paśhyāmi tvāṁ durnirīkṣhyaṁ samantād
dīptānalārka-dyutim aprameyam i see you with the diadem, club, and discus, a mass of radiance shining everywhere, very hard to look at, blazing all around like a burning fire and the sun, and immeasurable.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.18
documents.summary: You are the Imperishable, the Supreme Being, worthy of being known. You are the great treasure-house of this universe; You are the imperishable protector of the eternal Dharma; You
documents.searchText: bg.11.18 bg.11.18 chapter 11 verse 18 तवमकषर परम वदतवय तवमसय वशवसय पर नधनम तवमवयय शशवतधरमगपत सनतनसतव परष मत म 11.18 tvam aksharam paramam veditavyam tvam asya vishvasya param nidhanam tvam avyayah shashvata-dharma-gopta sanatanas tvam purusho mato me you are the imperishable the supreme being worthy of being known. you are the great treasure-house of this universe you are the imperishable protector of the eternal dharma you are the primal person i believe.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.18 bg.11.18 chapter 11 verse 18 त्वमक्षरं परमं वेदितव्यं

त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम्।

त्वमव्ययः शाश्वतधर्मगोप्ता

सनातनस्त्वं पुरुषो मतो मे।।11.18।। tvam akṣharaṁ paramaṁ veditavyaṁ
tvam asya viśhvasya paraṁ nidhānam
tvam avyayaḥ śhāśhvata-dharma-goptā
sanātanas tvaṁ puruṣho mato me you are the imperishable, the supreme being, worthy of being known. you are the great treasure-house of this universe; you are the imperishable protector of the eternal dharma; you are the primal person, i believe.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.19
documents.summary: I see You without beginning, middle, or end, infinite in power, with endless arms, the sun and moon as Your eyes, the burning fire Your mouth, heating the entire universe with Your
documents.searchText: bg.11.19 bg.11.19 chapter 11 verse 19 अनदमधयनतमननतवरय मननतबह शशसरयनतरम पशयम तव दपतहतशवकतरम सवतजस वशवमद तपनतम 11.19 सवतजस वशवमद तपनतम 19 i see you without beginning middle or end infinite in power with endless arms the sun and moon as your eyes the burning fire your mouth heating the entire universe with your radiance.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.19 bg.11.19 chapter 11 verse 19 अनादिमध्यान्तमनन्तवीर्य

मनन्तबाहुं शशिसूर्यनेत्रम्।

पश्यामि त्वां दीप्तहुताशवक्त्रम्

स्वतेजसा विश्वमिदं तपन्तम्।।11.19।। स्वतेजसा विश्वमिदं तपन्तम् || 19|| i see you without beginning, middle, or end, infinite in power, with endless arms, the sun and moon as your eyes, the burning fire your mouth, heating the entire universe with your radiance.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.2
documents.iast: bhavāpyayau hi bhūtānāṁ śhrutau vistaraśho mayā
documents.sanskrit: भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया।
documents.summary: The origin and destruction of beings have been heard in detail from You, O lotus-eyed Lord, and also Your inexhaustible greatness.
documents.searchText: bg.11.2 bg.11.2 chapter 11 verse 2 भवपयय ह भतन शरत वसतरश मय तवतत कमलपतरकष महतमयमप चवययम 11.2 bhavapyayau hi bhutanam shrutau vistarasho maya tvattah kamala-patraksha mahatmyam api chavyayam the origin and destruction of beings have been heard in detail from you o lotus-eyed lord and also your inexhaustible greatness.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.2 bg.11.2 chapter 11 verse 2 भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया।

त्वत्तः कमलपत्राक्ष माहात्म्यमपि चाव्ययम्।।11.2।। bhavāpyayau hi bhūtānāṁ śhrutau vistaraśho mayā
tvattaḥ kamala-patrākṣha māhātmyam api chāvyayam the origin and destruction of beings have been heard in detail from you, o lotus-eyed lord, and also your inexhaustible greatness.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.20
documents.summary: This space between the earth and the heavens, and all the quarters, is filled by You alone; having seen this, Your wonderful and terrible form, the three worlds are trembling with
documents.searchText: bg.11.20 bg.11.20 chapter 11 verse 20 दयवपथवयरदमनतर ह वयपत तवयकन दशशच सरव दषटवऽदभत रपमगर तवद लकतरय परवयथत महतमन 11.20 dyav a-prithivyor idam antaram hi vyaptam tvayaikena dishash cha sarvah drishtvadbhutam rupam ugram tavedam loka-trayam pravyathitam mahatman this space between the earth and the heavens and all the quarters is filled by you alone having seen this your wonderful and terrible form the three worlds are trembling with fear o great-souled being.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.20 bg.11.20 chapter 11 verse 20 द्यावापृथिव्योरिदमन्तरं हि

व्याप्तं त्वयैकेन दिशश्च सर्वाः।

दृष्ट्वाऽद्भुतं रूपमुग्रं तवेदं

लोकत्रयं प्रव्यथितं महात्मन्।।11.20।। dyāv ā-pṛithivyor idam antaraṁ hi
vyāptaṁ tvayaikena diśhaśh cha sarvāḥ
dṛiṣhṭvādbhutaṁ rūpam ugraṁ tavedaṁ
loka-trayaṁ pravyathitaṁ mahātman this space between the earth and the heavens, and all the quarters, is filled by you alone; having seen this, your wonderful and terrible form, the three worlds are trembling with fear, o great-souled being.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.21
documents.summary: Verily, these hosts of gods enter into Thee; some extol Thee with joined palms in fear, saying, 'May it be well!' Bands of great sages and perfected ones praise Thee with complete
documents.searchText: bg.11.21 bg.11.21 chapter 11 verse 21 अम ह तव सरसङघ वशनत कचदभत परञजलय गणनत सवसततयकतव महरषसदधसङघ सतवनत तव सततभ पषकलभ 11.21 ami hi tvam sura-sangha vishanti kechid bhitah pranjalayo grinanti svastity uktva maharshi-siddha-sanghah stuvanti tvam stutibhih pushkalabhih verily these hosts of gods enter into thee some extol thee with joined palms in fear saying may it be well bands of great sages and perfected ones praise thee with complete hymns.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.21 bg.11.21 chapter 11 verse 21 अमी हि त्वां सुरसङ्घाः विशन्ति

केचिद्भीताः प्राञ्जलयो गृणन्ति।

स्वस्तीत्युक्त्वा महर्षिसिद्धसङ्घाः

स्तुवन्ति त्वां स्तुतिभिः पुष्कलाभिः।।11.21।। amī hi tvāṁ sura-saṅghā viśhanti
kechid bhītāḥ prāñjalayo gṛiṇanti
svastīty uktvā maharṣhi-siddha-saṅghāḥ
stuvanti tvāṁ stutibhiḥ puṣhkalābhiḥ verily, these hosts of gods enter into thee; some extol thee with joined palms in fear, saying, 'may it be well!' bands of great sages and perfected ones praise thee with complete hymns.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.22
documents.summary: The Rudras, Adityas, Vasus, Sadhyas, Visvedevas, the two Asvins, Maruts, the Manus, and the hosts of celestial singers, Yakshas, demons, and the perfected ones, all look upon Thee
documents.searchText: bg.11.22 bg.11.22 chapter 11 verse 22 रदरदतय वसव य च सधय वशवऽशवन मरतशचषमपशच गनधरवयकषसरसदधसङघ वकषनत तव वसमतशचव सरव 11.22 rudraditya vasavo ye cha sadhya vishve shvinau marutash choshmapash cha gandharva-yakshasura-siddha-sangha vikshante tvam vismitash chaiva sarve the rudras adityas vasus sadhyas visvedevas the two asvins maruts the manus and the hosts of celestial singers yakshas demons and the perfected ones all look upon thee with great amazement.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.22 bg.11.22 chapter 11 verse 22 रुद्रादित्या वसवो ये च साध्या

विश्वेऽश्विनौ मरुतश्चोष्मपाश्च।

गन्धर्वयक्षासुरसिद्धसङ्घा

वीक्षन्ते त्वां विस्मिताश्चैव सर्वे।।11.22।। rudrādityā vasavo ye cha sādhyā
viśhve ’śhvinau marutaśh choṣhmapāśh cha
gandharva-yakṣhāsura-siddha-saṅghā
vīkṣhante tvāṁ vismitāśh chaiva sarve the rudras, adityas, vasus, sadhyas, visvedevas, the two asvins, maruts, the manus, and the hosts of celestial singers, yakshas, demons, and the perfected ones, all look upon thee with great amazement.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.23
documents.summary: Having seen Your immeasurable form with many mouths and eyes, O mighty-armed one, with many arms, thighs, and feet, with many stomachs and fearsome with many teeth, the worlds are
documents.searchText: bg.11.23 bg.11.23 chapter 11 verse 23 रप महतत बहवकतरनतर महबह बहबहरपदम बहदर बहदषटरकरल दषटव लक परवयथतसतथऽहम 11.23 rupam mahat te bahu-vaktra-netram maha-baho bahu-bahuru-padam bahudaram bahu-danshtra-karalam drishtva lokah pravyathitas tathaham having seen your immeasurable form with many mouths and eyes o mighty-armed one with many arms thighs and feet with many stomachs and fearsome with many teeth the worlds are terrified and so am i.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.23 bg.11.23 chapter 11 verse 23 रूपं महत्ते बहुवक्त्रनेत्रं

महाबाहो बहुबाहूरुपादम्।

बहूदरं बहुदंष्ट्राकरालं

दृष्ट्वा लोकाः प्रव्यथितास्तथाऽहम्।।11.23।। rūpaṁ mahat te bahu-vaktra-netraṁ
mahā-bāho bahu-bāhūru-pādam
bahūdaraṁ bahu-danṣhṭrā-karālaṁ
dṛiṣhṭvā lokāḥ pravyathitās tathāham having seen your immeasurable form with many mouths and eyes, o mighty-armed one, with many arms, thighs, and feet, with many stomachs and fearsome with many teeth, the worlds are terrified, and so am i.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.24
documents.summary: On seeing Thee, touching the sky, shining in many colors, with mouths wide open, with large fiery eyes, I am terrified at heart and find neither courage nor peace, O Vishnu.
documents.searchText: bg.11.24 bg.11.24 chapter 11 verse 24 नभसपश दपतमनकवरण वयततनन दपतवशलनतरम दषटव ह तव परवयथतनतरतम धत न वनदम शम च वषण 11.24 nabhah-sprisham diptam aneka-varnam vyattananam dipta-vishala-netram drishtva hi tvam pravyathitantar-atma dhritim na vindami shamam cha vishno on seeing thee touching the sky shining in many colors with mouths wide open with large fiery eyes i am terrified at heart and find neither courage nor peace o vishnu.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.24 bg.11.24 chapter 11 verse 24 नभःस्पृशं दीप्तमनेकवर्णं

व्यात्ताननं दीप्तविशालनेत्रम्।

दृष्ट्वा हि त्वां प्रव्यथितान्तरात्मा

धृतिं न विन्दामि शमं च विष्णो।।11.24।। nabhaḥ-spṛiśhaṁ dīptam aneka-varṇaṁ
vyāttānanaṁ dīpta-viśhāla-netram
dṛiṣhṭvā hi tvāṁ pravyathitāntar-ātmā
dhṛitiṁ na vindāmi śhamaṁ cha viṣhṇo on seeing thee, touching the sky, shining in many colors, with mouths wide open, with large fiery eyes, i am terrified at heart and find neither courage nor peace, o vishnu.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.25
documents.summary: Having seen Thy mouths fearful with teeth blazing like the fires of cosmic dissolution, I know not the four quarters, nor do I find peace. Have mercy, O Lord of the gods, O abode o
documents.searchText: bg.11.25 bg.11.25 chapter 11 verse 25 दषटरकरलन च त मखन दषटवव कलनलसननभन दश न जन न लभ च शरम परसद दवश जगननवस 11.25 danshtra-karalani cha te mukhani drishtvaiva kalanala-sannibhani disho na jane na labhe cha sharma prasida devesha jagan-nivasa having seen thy mouths fearful with teeth blazing like the fires of cosmic dissolution i know not the four quarters nor do i find peace. have mercy o lord of the gods o abode of the universe.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.25 bg.11.25 chapter 11 verse 25 दंष्ट्राकरालानि च ते मुखानि

दृष्ट्वैव कालानलसन्निभानि।

दिशो न जाने न लभे च शर्म

प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास।।11.25।। danṣhṭrā-karālāni cha te mukhāni
dṛiṣhṭvaiva kālānala-sannibhāni
diśho na jāne na labhe cha śharma
prasīda deveśha jagan-nivāsa having seen thy mouths fearful with teeth blazing like the fires of cosmic dissolution, i know not the four quarters, nor do i find peace. have mercy, o lord of the gods, o abode of the universe.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.26
documents.summary: All the sons of Dhritarashtra, along with the hosts of kings of the earth, Bhishma, Drona, and Karna, as well as the chief among our warriors.
documents.searchText: bg.11.26 bg.11.26 chapter 11 verse 26 अम च तव धतरषटरसय पतर सरव सहववनपलसङघ भषम दरण सतपतरसतथऽस सहसमदयरप यधमखय 11.26 ami cha tvam dhritarashtrasya putrah sarve sahaivavani-pala-sanghaih bhishmo dronah suta-putras tathasau sahasmadiyair api yodha-mukhyaih vaktrani te tvaramana vishanti danshtra-karalani bhayanakani kechid vilagna dashanantareshu sandrishy all the sons of dhritarashtra along with the hosts of kings of the earth bhishma drona and karna as well as the chief among our warriors.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.26 bg.11.26 chapter 11 verse 26 अमी च त्वां धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राः

सर्वे सहैवावनिपालसङ्घैः।

भीष्मो द्रोणः सूतपुत्रस्तथाऽसौ

सहास्मदीयैरपि योधमुख्यैः।।11.26।। amī cha tvāṁ dhṛitarāśhtrasya putrāḥ
sarve sahaivāvani-pāla-saṅghaiḥ
bhīṣhmo droṇaḥ sūta-putras tathāsau
sahāsmadīyair api yodha-mukhyaiḥ
 vaktrāṇi te tvaramāṇā viśhanti
danṣhṭrā-karālāni bhayānakāni
kechid vilagnā daśhanāntareṣhu
sandṛiśhy all the sons of dhritarashtra, along with the hosts of kings of the earth, bhishma, drona, and karna, as well as the chief among our warriors.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.27
documents.iast: vaktrāṇi te  tvaramāṇā   viśanti daṁṣṭrā-karālāni    bhayānakāni kecid   vilagnā daśanāntareṣu   sandṛśyante cūrṇitair
documents.summary: Some hurry into Your mouths with their terrible teeth, fearful to behold. Some are found stuck in the gaps between the teeth, their heads crushed to powder.
documents.searchText: bg.11.27 bg.11.27 chapter 11 verse 27 वकतरण त तवरमण वशनत दषटरकरलन भयनकन कचदवलगन दशननतरष सदशयनत चरणतरततमङग 11.27 vaktrani te tvaramana visanti damstra-karalani bhayanakani kecid vilagna dasanantaresu sandrsyante curnitair uttamangaih some hurry into your mouths with their terrible teeth fearful to behold. some are found stuck in the gaps between the teeth their heads crushed to powder.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.27 bg.11.27 chapter 11 verse 27 वक्त्राणि ते त्वरमाणा विशन्ति

दंष्ट्राकरालानि भयानकानि।

केचिद्विलग्ना दशनान्तरेषु

संदृश्यन्ते चूर्णितैरुत्तमाङ्गैः।।11.27।। vaktrāṇi te  tvaramāṇā   viśanti daṁṣṭrā-karālāni    bhayānakāni kecid   vilagnā daśanāntareṣu   sandṛśyante cūrṇitair   uttamāṅgaiḥ some hurry into your mouths with their terrible teeth, fearful to behold. some are found stuck in the gaps between the teeth, their heads crushed to powder.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.28
documents.summary: Verily, just as many torrents of rivers flow towards the ocean, so too these heroes in the world of men enter Thy flaming mouths.
documents.searchText: bg.11.28 bg.11.28 chapter 11 verse 28 यथ नदन बहवऽमबवग समदरमवभमख दरवनत तथ तवम नरलकवर वशनत वकतरणयभवजवलनत 11.28 yatha nadinam bahavo mbu-vegah samudram evabhimukha dravanti tatha tavami nara-loka-vira vishanti vaktrany abhivijvalanti verily just as many torrents of rivers flow towards the ocean so too these heroes in the world of men enter thy flaming mouths.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.28 bg.11.28 chapter 11 verse 28 यथा नदीनां बहवोऽम्बुवेगाः

समुद्रमेवाभिमुखाः द्रवन्ति।

तथा तवामी नरलोकवीरा

विशन्ति वक्त्राण्यभिविज्वलन्ति।।11.28।। yathā nadīnāṁ bahavo ’mbu-vegāḥ
samudram evābhimukhā dravanti
tathā tavāmī nara-loka-vīrā
viśhanti vaktrāṇy abhivijvalanti verily, just as many torrents of rivers flow towards the ocean, so too these heroes in the world of men enter thy flaming mouths.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.29
documents.summary: As moths hurriedly rush into a blazing fire, leading to their own destruction, so too these creatures hurry into Your mouths, leading to their own destruction.
documents.searchText: bg.11.29 bg.11.29 chapter 11 verse 29 यथ परदपत जवलन पतङग वशनत नशय समदधवग तथव नशय वशनत लक सतवप वकतरण समदधवग 11.29 yatha pradiptam jvalanam patanga vishanti nashaya samriddha-vegah tathaiva nashaya vishanti lokas tavapi vaktrani samriddha-vegah as moths hurriedly rush into a blazing fire leading to their own destruction so too these creatures hurry into your mouths leading to their own destruction.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.29 bg.11.29 chapter 11 verse 29 यथा प्रदीप्तं ज्वलनं पतङ्गा

विशन्ति नाशाय समृद्धवेगाः।

तथैव नाशाय विशन्ति लोका

स्तवापि वक्त्राणि समृद्धवेगाः।।11.29।। yathā pradīptaṁ jvalanaṁ pataṅgā
viśhanti nāśhāya samṛiddha-vegāḥ
tathaiva nāśhāya viśhanti lokās
tavāpi vaktrāṇi samṛiddha-vegāḥ as moths hurriedly rush into a blazing fire, leading to their own destruction, so too these creatures hurry into your mouths, leading to their own destruction.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.3
documents.iast: evam etad yathāttha tvam ātmānaṁ parameśhvara
documents.summary: Now, O Supreme Lord, as Thou hast thus described Thyself, O Supreme Person, I wish to behold Thy divine form.
documents.searchText: bg.11.3 bg.11.3 chapter 11 verse 3 एवमतदयथतथ तवमतमन परमशवर दरषटमचछम त रपमशवर परषततम 11.3 evam etad yathattha tvam atmanam parameshvara drashtum ichchhami te rupam aishwaram purushottama now o supreme lord as thou hast thus described thyself o supreme person i wish to behold thy divine form.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.3 bg.11.3 chapter 11 verse 3 एवमेतद्यथात्थ त्वमात्मानं परमेश्वर।

द्रष्टुमिच्छामि ते रूपमैश्वरं पुरुषोत्तम।।11.3।। evam etad yathāttha tvam ātmānaṁ parameśhvara
draṣhṭum ichchhāmi te rūpam aiśhwaraṁ puruṣhottama now, o supreme lord, as thou hast thus described thyself, o supreme person, i wish to behold thy divine form.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.30
documents.summary: Thou lickest up, devouring all the worlds on every side with Thy flaming mouths. Thy fierce rays, filling the whole world with radiance, burn, O Vishnu!
documents.searchText: bg.11.30 bg.11.30 chapter 11 verse 30 ललहयस गरसमन समनत ललकनसमगरनवदनरजवलदभ तजभरपरय जगतसमगर भससतवगर परतपनत वषण 11.30 lelihyase grasamanah samantal lokan samagran vadanair jvaladbhih tejobhir apurya jagat samagram bhasas tavograh pratapanti vishno thou lickest up devouring all the worlds on every side with thy flaming mouths. thy fierce rays filling the whole world with radiance burn o vishnu
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.30 bg.11.30 chapter 11 verse 30 लेलिह्यसे ग्रसमानः समन्ता

ल्लोकान्समग्रान्वदनैर्ज्वलद्भिः।

तेजोभिरापूर्य जगत्समग्रं

भासस्तवोग्राः प्रतपन्ति विष्णो।।11.30।। lelihyase grasamānaḥ samantāl
lokān samagrān vadanair jvaladbhiḥ
tejobhir āpūrya jagat samagraṁ
bhāsas tavogrāḥ pratapanti viṣhṇo thou lickest up, devouring all the worlds on every side with thy flaming mouths. thy fierce rays, filling the whole world with radiance, burn, o vishnu!

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.31
documents.summary: Tell me, who you are, so fierce of form. I offer my salutations to you, O God Supreme; have mercy on me. I desire to know you, the original Being. I do not indeed know your working
documents.searchText: bg.11.31 bg.11.31 chapter 11 verse 31 आखयह म क भवनगररप नमऽसत त दववर परसद वजञतमचछम भवनतमदय न ह परजनम तव परवततम 11.31 akhyahi me ko bhavan ugra-rupo namo stu te deva-vara prasida vijnatum ichchhami bhavantam adyam na hi prajanami tava pravrittim tell me who you are so fierce of form. i offer my salutations to you o god supreme have mercy on me. i desire to know you the original being. i do not indeed know your workings.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.31 bg.11.31 chapter 11 verse 31 आख्याहि मे को भवानुग्ररूपो

नमोऽस्तु ते देववर प्रसीद।

विज्ञातुमिच्छामि भवन्तमाद्यं

न हि प्रजानामि तव प्रवृत्तिम्।।11.31।। ākhyāhi me ko bhavān ugra-rūpo
namo ’stu te deva-vara prasīda
vijñātum ichchhāmi bhavantam ādyaṁ
na hi prajānāmi tava pravṛittim tell me, who you are, so fierce of form. i offer my salutations to you, o god supreme; have mercy on me. i desire to know you, the original being. i do not indeed know your workings.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.32
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, "I am the full-grown, world-destroying Time, now engaged in destroying the worlds. Even without you, none of the warriors arrayed in the hostile armies will
documents.searchText: bg.11.32 bg.11.32 chapter 11 verse 32 शर भगवनवच कलऽसम लककषयकतपरवदध लकनसमहरतमह परवतत ऋतऽप तव न भवषयनत सरव यऽवसथत परतयनकष यध 11.32 shri-bhagavan uvacha kalo smi loka-kshaya-krit pravriddho lokan samahartum iha pravrittah rite pi tvam na bhavishyanti sarve ye vasthitah pratyanikeshu yodhah the blessed lord said i am the full-grown world-destroying time now engaged in destroying the worlds. even without you none of the warriors arrayed in the hostile armies will live.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.32 bg.11.32 chapter 11 verse 32 श्री भगवानुवाच

कालोऽस्मि लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धो

लोकान्समाहर्तुमिह प्रवृत्तः।

ऋतेऽपि त्वां न भविष्यन्ति सर्वे

येऽवस्थिताः प्रत्यनीकेषु योधाः।।11.32।। śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
kālo ’smi loka-kṣhaya-kṛit pravṛiddho
lokān samāhartum iha pravṛittaḥ
ṛite ’pi tvāṁ na bhaviṣhyanti sarve
ye ’vasthitāḥ pratyanīkeṣhu yodhāḥ the blessed lord said, "i am the full-grown, world-destroying time, now engaged in destroying the worlds. even without you, none of the warriors arrayed in the hostile armies will live."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.33
documents.summary: Therefore, stand up and obtain fame. Conquer the enemies and enjoy the unparalleled kingdom. Verily, by Me they have already been slain; be thou a mere instrument, O Arjuna.
documents.searchText: bg.11.33 bg.11.33 chapter 11 verse 33 तसमततवमततषठ यश लभसव जतव शतरन भङकषव रजय समदधम मयवत नहत परवमव नमततमतर भव सवयसचन 11.33 tasmat tvam uttishtha yasho labhasva jitva shatrun bhunkshva rajyam samriddham mayaivaite nihatah purvam eva nimitta-matram bhava savya-sachin therefore stand up and obtain fame. conquer the enemies and enjoy the unparalleled kingdom. verily by me they have already been slain be thou a mere instrument o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.33 bg.11.33 chapter 11 verse 33 तस्मात्त्वमुत्तिष्ठ यशो लभस्व

जित्वा शत्रून् भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यं समृद्धम्।

मयैवैते निहताः पूर्वमेव

निमित्तमात्रं भव सव्यसाचिन्।।11.33।। tasmāt tvam uttiṣhṭha yaśho labhasva
jitvā śhatrūn bhuṅkṣhva rājyaṁ samṛiddham
mayaivaite nihatāḥ pūrvam eva
nimitta-mātraṁ bhava savya-sāchin therefore, stand up and obtain fame. conquer the enemies and enjoy the unparalleled kingdom. verily, by me they have already been slain; be thou a mere instrument, o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.34
documents.iast: droṇaṁ cha bhīṣhmaṁ cha jayadrathaṁ cha
documents.sanskrit: द्रोणं च भीष्मं च जयद्रथं च
documents.summary: Drona, Bhishma, Jayadratha, Karna, and other brave warriors have already been slain by Me; do not be distressed with fear; fight and you shall conquer your enemies in battle.
documents.searchText: bg.11.34 bg.11.34 chapter 11 verse 34 दरण च भषम च जयदरथ च करण तथऽनयनप यधवरन मय हतसतव जह म वयथषठ यधयसव जतस रण सपतनन 11.34 dronam cha bhishmam cha jayadratham cha karnam tathanyan api yodha-viran maya hatams tvam jahi ma vyathishtha yudhyasva jetasi rane sapatnan drona bhishma jayadratha karna and other brave warriors have already been slain by me do not be distressed with fear fight and you shall conquer your enemies in battle.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.34 bg.11.34 chapter 11 verse 34 द्रोणं च भीष्मं च जयद्रथं च

कर्णं तथाऽन्यानपि योधवीरान्।

मया हतांस्त्वं जहि मा व्यथिष्ठा

युध्यस्व जेतासि रणे सपत्नान्।।11.34।। droṇaṁ cha bhīṣhmaṁ cha jayadrathaṁ cha
karṇaṁ tathānyān api yodha-vīrān
mayā hatāṁs tvaṁ jahi mā vyathiṣhṭhā
yudhyasva jetāsi raṇe sapatnān drona, bhishma, jayadratha, karna, and other brave warriors have already been slain by me; do not be distressed with fear; fight and you shall conquer your enemies in battle.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.35
documents.summary: Sanjaya said, Having heard that speech of Lord Krishna, Arjuna, with joined palms, trembling, prostrated himself, again addressing Krishna in a choked voice, bowing down, overwhelm
documents.searchText: bg.11.35 bg.11.35 chapter 11 verse 35 सञजय उवच एतचछरतव वचन कशवसय कतञजलरवपमन करट नमसकतव भय एवह कषण सगदगद भतभत परणमय 11.35 sanjaya uvacha etach chhrutva vachanam keshavasya kritanjalir vepamanah kiriti namaskritva bhuya evaha krishnam sa-gadgadam bhita-bhitah pranamya sanjaya said having heard that speech of lord krishna arjuna with joined palms trembling prostrated himself again addressing krishna in a choked voice bowing down overwhelmed with fear.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.35 bg.11.35 chapter 11 verse 35 सञ्जय उवाच

एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं केशवस्य

कृताञ्जलिर्वेपमानः किरीटी।

नमस्कृत्वा भूय एवाह कृष्णं

सगद्गदं भीतभीतः प्रणम्य।।11.35।। sañjaya uvācha
etach chhrutvā vachanaṁ keśhavasya
kṛitāñjalir vepamānaḥ kirīṭī
namaskṛitvā bhūya evāha kṛiṣhṇaṁ
sa-gadgadaṁ bhīta-bhītaḥ praṇamya sanjaya said, having heard that speech of lord krishna, arjuna, with joined palms, trembling, prostrated himself, again addressing krishna in a choked voice, bowing down, overwhelmed with fear.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.36
documents.summary: Arjuna said, "It is fitting, O Krishna, that the world delights and rejoices in Your praise; demons fly in fear in all directions and the hosts of the perfected ones bow to You."
documents.searchText: bg.11.36 bg.11.36 chapter 11 verse 36 अरजन उवच सथन हषकश तव परकरतय जगत परहषयतयनरजयत च रकषस भतन दश दरवनत सरव नमसयनत च सदधसङघ 11.36 arjuna uvacha sthane hrishikesha tava prakirtya jagat prahrishyaty anurajyate cha rakshansi bhitani disho dravanti sarve namasyanti cha siddha-sanghah arjuna said it is fitting o krishna that the world delights and rejoices in your praise demons fly in fear in all directions and the hosts of the perfected ones bow to you.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.36 bg.11.36 chapter 11 verse 36 अर्जुन उवाच

स्थाने हृषीकेश तव प्रकीर्त्या

जगत् प्रहृष्यत्यनुरज्यते च।

रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवन्ति

सर्वे नमस्यन्ति च सिद्धसङ्घाः।।11.36।। arjuna uvācha
sthāne hṛiṣhīkeśha tava prakīrtyā
jagat prahṛiṣhyaty anurajyate cha
rakṣhānsi bhītāni diśho dravanti
sarve namasyanti cha siddha-saṅghāḥ arjuna said, "it is fitting, o krishna, that the world delights and rejoices in your praise; demons fly in fear in all directions and the hosts of the perfected ones bow to you."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.37
documents.iast: kasmāch cha te na nameran mahātman
documents.summary: And why should they not, O great Soul, bow to Thee Who art greater than all else, the primal cause even of the Creator (Brahma), O Infinite Being, O Lord of the gods, O Abode of th
documents.searchText: bg.11.37 bg.11.37 chapter 11 verse 37 कसमचच त न नमरनमहतमन गरयस बरहमणऽपयदकरतर अननत दवश जगननवस तवमकषर सदसतततपर यत 11.37 kasmach cha te na nameran mahatman gariyase brahmano py adi-kartre ananta devesha jagan-nivasa tvam aksharam sad-asat tat param yat and why should they not o great soul bow to thee who art greater than all else the primal cause even of the creator brahma o infinite being o lord of the gods o abode of the universe thou art the imperishable the being the non-being and that which is supreme that which is beyond the being and the non-being.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.37 bg.11.37 chapter 11 verse 37 कस्माच्च ते न नमेरन्महात्मन्

गरीयसे ब्रह्मणोऽप्यादिकर्त्रे।

अनन्त देवेश जगन्निवास

त्वमक्षरं सदसत्तत्परं यत्।।11.37।। kasmāch cha te na nameran mahātman
garīyase brahmaṇo ’py ādi-kartre
ananta deveśha jagan-nivāsa
tvam akṣharaṁ sad-asat tat paraṁ yat and why should they not, o great soul, bow to thee who art greater than all else, the primal cause even of the creator (brahma), o infinite being, o lord of the gods, o abode of the universe; thou art the imperishable, the being, the non-being, and that which is supreme—that which is beyond the being and the non-being.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.38
documents.summary: You are the primal God, the ancient Purusha, the supreme refuge of this universe, the knower, the knowable, and the supreme Abode. Through You, the universe is pervaded, O Being of
documents.searchText: bg.11.38 bg.11.38 chapter 11 verse 38 तवमददव परष परण सतवमसय वशवसय पर नधनम वततस वदय च पर च धम तवय तत वशवमननतरप 11.38 tvam adi-devah purushah puranas tvam asya vishvasya param nidhanam vettasi vedyam cha param cha dhama tvaya tatam vishvam ananta-rupa you are the primal god the ancient purusha the supreme refuge of this universe the knower the knowable and the supreme abode. through you the universe is pervaded o being of infinite forms.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.38 bg.11.38 chapter 11 verse 38 त्वमादिदेवः पुरुषः पुराण

स्त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम्।

वेत्तासि वेद्यं च परं च धाम

त्वया ततं विश्वमनन्तरूप।।11.38।। tvam ādi-devaḥ puruṣhaḥ purāṇas
tvam asya viśhvasya paraṁ nidhānam
vettāsi vedyaṁ cha paraṁ cha dhāma
tvayā tataṁ viśhvam ananta-rūpa you are the primal god, the ancient purusha, the supreme refuge of this universe, the knower, the knowable, and the supreme abode. through you, the universe is pervaded, o being of infinite forms.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.39
documents.summary: You are Vayu, Yama, Agni, Varuna, the moon, the Creator, and the great-grandfather. I offer my salutations to You a thousand times, and again I offer my salutations to You.
documents.searchText: bg.11.39 bg.11.39 chapter 11 verse 39 वयरयमऽगनरवरण शशङक परजपतसतव परपतमहशच नम नमसतऽसत सहसरकतव पनशच भयऽप नम नमसत 11.39 vayur yamo gnir varunah shashankah prajapatis tvam prapitamahash cha namo namas te stu sahasra-kritvah punash cha bhuyo pi namo namas te you are vayu yama agni varuna the moon the creator and the great-grandfather. i offer my salutations to you a thousand times and again i offer my salutations to you.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.39 bg.11.39 chapter 11 verse 39 वायुर्यमोऽग्निर्वरुणः शशाङ्कः

प्रजापतिस्त्वं प्रपितामहश्च।

नमो नमस्तेऽस्तु सहस्रकृत्वः

पुनश्च भूयोऽपि नमो नमस्ते।।11.39।। vāyur yamo ’gnir varuṇaḥ śhaśhāṅkaḥ
prajāpatis tvaṁ prapitāmahaśh cha
namo namas te ’stu sahasra-kṛitvaḥ
punaśh cha bhūyo ’pi namo namas te you are vayu, yama, agni, varuna, the moon, the creator, and the great-grandfather. i offer my salutations to you a thousand times, and again i offer my salutations to you.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.4
documents.iast: manyase yadi tach chhakyaṁ mayā draṣhṭum iti prabho
documents.sanskrit: मन्यसे यदि तच्छक्यं मया द्रष्टुमिति प्रभो।
documents.summary: If Thou, O Lord, thinkest it possible for me to see it, do Thou, then, O Lord of the Yogis, show me Thy imperishable Self.
documents.searchText: bg.11.4 bg.11.4 chapter 11 verse 4 मनयस यद तचछकय मय दरषटमत परभ यगशवर तत म तव दरशयऽतमनमवययम 11.4 manyase yadi tach chhakyam maya drashtum iti prabho yogeshvara tato me tvam darshayatmanam avyayam if thou o lord thinkest it possible for me to see it do thou then o lord of the yogis show me thy imperishable self.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.4 bg.11.4 chapter 11 verse 4 मन्यसे यदि तच्छक्यं मया द्रष्टुमिति प्रभो।

योगेश्वर ततो मे त्वं दर्शयाऽत्मानमव्ययम्।।11.4।। manyase yadi tach chhakyaṁ mayā draṣhṭum iti prabho
yogeśhvara tato me tvaṁ darśhayātmānam avyayam if thou, o lord, thinkest it possible for me to see it, do thou, then, o lord of the yogis, show me thy imperishable self.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.40
documents.summary: Salutations to You in front and behind! Salutations to You on every side! O All! You, infinite in power and prowess, pervade all; therefore You are all.
documents.searchText: bg.11.40 bg.11.40 chapter 11 verse 40 नम परसतदथ पषठतसत नमऽसत त सरवत एव सरव अननतवरयमतवकरमसतव सरव समपनष ततऽस सरव 11.40 namah purastad atha prishthatas te namo stu te sarvata eva sarva ananta-viryamita-vikramas tvam sarvam samapnoshi tato si sarvah salutations to you in front and behind salutations to you on every side o all you infinite in power and prowess pervade all therefore you are all.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.40 bg.11.40 chapter 11 verse 40 नमः पुरस्तादथ पृष्ठतस्ते

नमोऽस्तु ते सर्वत एव सर्व।

अनन्तवीर्यामितविक्रमस्त्वं

सर्वं समाप्नोषि ततोऽसि सर्वः।।11.40।। namaḥ purastād atha pṛiṣhṭhatas te
namo ’stu te sarvata eva sarva
ananta-vīryāmita-vikramas tvaṁ
sarvaṁ samāpnoṣhi tato ’si sarvaḥ salutations to you in front and behind! salutations to you on every side! o all! you, infinite in power and prowess, pervade all; therefore you are all.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.41
documents.summary: Whatever I have presumptuously said from carelessness or love, addressing You as O Krishna! O Yadava! O Friend! regarding You merely as a friend, unknowing of Your greatness.
documents.searchText: bg.11.41 bg.11.41 chapter 11 verse 41 सखत मतव परसभ यदकत ह कषण ह यदव ह सखत अजनत महमन तवद मय परमदतपरणयन वप 11.41 sakheti matva prasabham yad uktam he krishna he yadava he sakheti ajanata mahimanam tavedam maya pramadat pranayena vapi whatever i have presumptuously said from carelessness or love addressing you as o krishna o yadava o friend regarding you merely as a friend unknowing of your greatness.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.41 bg.11.41 chapter 11 verse 41 सखेति मत्वा प्रसभं यदुक्तं

हे कृष्ण हे यादव हे सखेति।

अजानता महिमानं तवेदं

मया प्रमादात्प्रणयेन वापि।।11.41।। sakheti matvā prasabhaṁ yad uktaṁ
he kṛiṣhṇa he yādava he sakheti
ajānatā mahimānaṁ tavedaṁ
mayā pramādāt praṇayena vāpi whatever i have presumptuously said from carelessness or love, addressing you as o krishna! o yadava! o friend! regarding you merely as a friend, unknowing of your greatness.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.42

documents.searchText: bg.11.42 bg.11.42 chapter 11 verse 42 यचचवहसरथमसतकतऽस वहरशययसनभजनष एकऽथवपयचयत ततसमकष ततकषमय तवमहमपरमयम 11.42 yach chavahasartham asat-krito si vihara-shayyasana-bhojaneshu eko tha vapy achyuta tat-samaksham tat kshamaye tvam aham aprameyam in whatever way i may have insulted you for the sake of fun while at play reposing sitting or at meals when alone with you o krishna or in company that i implore you immeasurable one to forgive.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.42 bg.11.42 chapter 11 verse 42 यच्चावहासार्थमसत्कृतोऽसि

विहारशय्यासनभोजनेषु।

एकोऽथवाप्यच्युत तत्समक्षं

तत्क्षामये त्वामहमप्रमेयम्।।11.42।। yach chāvahāsārtham asat-kṛito ’si
vihāra-śhayyāsana-bhojaneṣhu
eko ’tha vāpy achyuta tat-samakṣhaṁ
tat kṣhāmaye tvām aham aprameyam in whatever way i may have insulted you for the sake of fun, while at play, reposing, sitting, or at meals, when alone (with you), o krishna, or in company, that i implore you, immeasurable one, to forgive.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.43
documents.summary: Thou art the Father of this world, both moving and unmoving. Thou art to be adored by this world; Thou, the greatest Guru; for none exists who is equal to Thee; how then could ther
documents.searchText: bg.11.43 bg.11.43 chapter 11 verse 43 पतस लकसय चरचरसय तवमसय पजयशच गररगरयन न तवतसमऽसतयभयधक कतऽनय लकतरयऽपयपरतमपरभव 11.43 pitasi lokasya characharasya tvam asya pujyash cha gurur gariyan na tvat-samo sty abhyadhikah kuto nyo loka-traye py apratima-prabhava thou art the father of this world both moving and unmoving. thou art to be adored by this world thou the greatest guru for none exists who is equal to thee how then could there be another superior to thee in the three worlds o being of unrivaled power
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.43 bg.11.43 chapter 11 verse 43 पितासि लोकस्य चराचरस्य

त्वमस्य पूज्यश्च गुरुर्गरीयान्।

न त्वत्समोऽस्त्यभ्यधिकः कुतोऽन्यो

लोकत्रयेऽप्यप्रतिमप्रभाव।।11.43।। pitāsi lokasya charācharasya
tvam asya pūjyaśh cha gurur garīyān
na tvat-samo ’sty abhyadhikaḥ kuto ’nyo
loka-traye ’py apratima-prabhāva thou art the father of this world, both moving and unmoving. thou art to be adored by this world; thou, the greatest guru; for none exists who is equal to thee; how then could there be another superior to thee in the three worlds, o being of unrivaled power?

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.44
documents.summary: Therefore, bowing down and prostrating my body, I crave Thy forgiveness, O adorable Lord. As a father forgives his son, a friend his dear friend, a lover his beloved, even so may T
documents.searchText: bg.11.44 bg.11.44 chapter 11 verse 44 तसमतपरणमय परणधय कय परसदय तवमहमशमडयम पतव पतरसय सखव सखय परय परययरहस दव सढम 11.44 tasmat pranamya pranidhaya kayam prasadaye tvam aham isham idyam piteva putrasya sakheva sakhyuh priyah priyayarhasi deva sodhum therefore bowing down and prostrating my body i crave thy forgiveness o adorable lord. as a father forgives his son a friend his dear friend a lover his beloved even so may thou forgive me o god.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.44 bg.11.44 chapter 11 verse 44 तस्मात्प्रणम्य प्रणिधाय कायं

प्रसादये त्वामहमीशमीड्यम्।

पितेव पुत्रस्य सखेव सख्युः

प्रियः प्रियायार्हसि देव सोढुम्।।11.44।। tasmāt praṇamya praṇidhāya kāyaṁ
prasādaye tvām aham īśham īḍyam
piteva putrasya sakheva sakhyuḥ
priyaḥ priyāyārhasi deva soḍhum therefore, bowing down and prostrating my body, i crave thy forgiveness, o adorable lord. as a father forgives his son, a friend his dear friend, a lover his beloved, even so may thou forgive me, o god.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.45
documents.summary: I am delighted, having seen something never seen before; yet my mind is distressed with fear. Show me that form only, O God; have mercy, O God of gods, O Abode of the universe.
documents.searchText: bg.11.45 bg.11.45 chapter 11 verse 45 अदषटपरव हषतऽसम दषटव भयन च परवयथत मन म तदव म दरशय दव रप परसद दवश जगननवस 11.45 adrishta-purvam hrishito smi drishtva bhayena cha pravyathitam mano me tad eva me darshaya deva rupam prasida devesha jagan-nivasa i am delighted having seen something never seen before yet my mind is distressed with fear. show me that form only o god have mercy o god of gods o abode of the universe.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.45 bg.11.45 chapter 11 verse 45 अदृष्टपूर्वं हृषितोऽस्मि दृष्ट्वा

भयेन च प्रव्यथितं मनो मे।

तदेव मे दर्शय देव रूपं

प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास।।11.45।। adṛiṣhṭa-pūrvaṁ hṛiṣhito ’smi dṛiṣhṭvā
bhayena cha pravyathitaṁ mano me
tad eva me darśhaya deva rūpaṁ
prasīda deveśha jagan-nivāsa i am delighted, having seen something never seen before; yet my mind is distressed with fear. show me that form only, o god; have mercy, o god of gods, o abode of the universe.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.46
documents.summary: I desire to see You as before, crowned, bearing a mace, with the discus in hand, in Your former form only, having four arms, O thousand-armed, Cosmic Being.
documents.searchText: bg.11.46 bg.11.46 chapter 11 verse 46 करटन गदन चकरहसत मचछम तव दरषटमह तथव तनव रपण चतरभजन सहसरबह भव वशवमरत 11.46 kiritinam gadinam chakra-hastam ichchhami tvam drashtum aham tathaiva tenaiva rupena chatur-bhujena sahasra-baho bhava vishva-murte i desire to see you as before crowned bearing a mace with the discus in hand in your former form only having four arms o thousand-armed cosmic being.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.46 bg.11.46 chapter 11 verse 46 किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रहस्त

मिच्छामि त्वां द्रष्टुमहं तथैव।

तेनैव रूपेण चतुर्भुजेन

सहस्रबाहो भव विश्वमूर्ते।।11.46।। kirīṭinaṁ gadinaṁ chakra-hastam
ichchhāmi tvāṁ draṣhṭum ahaṁ tathaiva
tenaiva rūpeṇa chatur-bhujena
sahasra-bāho bhava viśhva-mūrte i desire to see you as before, crowned, bearing a mace, with the discus in hand, in your former form only, having four arms, o thousand-armed, cosmic being.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.47
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, "O Arjuna, this Cosmic Form has graciously been shown to you by Me through My own Yogic power. It is full of splendour, primeval, and infinite; this Cosmic F
documents.searchText: bg.11.47 bg.11.47 chapter 11 verse 47 शर भगवनवच मय परसननन तवरजनद रप पर दरशतमतमयगत तजमय वशवमननतमदय यनम तवदनयन न दषटपरवम 11.47 shri-bhagavan uvacha maya prasannena tavarjunedam rupam param darshitam atma-yogat tejo-mayam vishvam anantam adyam yan me tvad anyena na drishta-purvam the blessed lord said o arjuna this cosmic form has graciously been shown to you by me through my own yogic power. it is full of splendour primeval and infinite this cosmic form of mine has never been seen before by anyone other than you.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.47 bg.11.47 chapter 11 verse 47 श्री भगवानुवाच

मया प्रसन्नेन तवार्जुनेदं

रूपं परं दर्शितमात्मयोगात्।

तेजोमयं विश्वमनन्तमाद्यं

यन्मे त्वदन्येन न दृष्टपूर्वम्।।11.47।। śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
mayā prasannena tavārjunedaṁ
rūpaṁ paraṁ darśhitam ātma-yogāt
tejo-mayaṁ viśhvam anantam ādyaṁ
yan me tvad anyena na dṛiṣhṭa-pūrvam the blessed lord said, "o arjuna, this cosmic form has graciously been shown to you by me through my own yogic power. it is full of splendour, primeval, and infinite; this cosmic form of mine has never been seen before by anyone other than you."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.48
documents.summary: Neither by the study of the Vedas, nor by gifts, nor by sacrifices, nor by severe austerities, can I be seen in this form in the world of men by any other than yourself, O great he
documents.searchText: bg.11.48 bg.11.48 chapter 11 verse 48 न वदयजञधययनरन दन रन च करयभरन तपभरगर एवरप शकय अह नलक दरषट तवदनयन करपरवर 11.48 na veda-yajnadhyayanair na danair na cha kriyabhir na tapobhir ugraih evam-rupah shakya aham nri-loke drashtum tvad anyena kuru-pravira neither by the study of the vedas nor by gifts nor by sacrifices nor by severe austerities can i be seen in this form in the world of men by any other than yourself o great hero of the kurus arjuna .
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.48 bg.11.48 chapter 11 verse 48 न वेदयज्ञाध्ययनैर्न दानै

र्न च क्रियाभिर्न तपोभिरुग्रैः।

एवंरूपः शक्य अहं नृलोके

द्रष्टुं त्वदन्येन कुरुप्रवीर।।11.48।। na veda-yajñādhyayanair na dānair
na cha kriyābhir na tapobhir ugraiḥ
evaṁ-rūpaḥ śhakya ahaṁ nṛi-loke
draṣhṭuṁ tvad anyena kuru-pravīra neither by the study of the vedas, nor by gifts, nor by sacrifices, nor by severe austerities, can i be seen in this form in the world of men by any other than yourself, o great hero of the kurus (arjuna).

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.49
documents.iast: mā te vyathā mā cha vimūḍha-bhāvo
documents.sanskrit: मा ते व्यथा मा च विमूढभावो
documents.summary: Do not be afraid, nor be bewildered on seeing such a terrible form of Mine; with your fear dispelled and with a gladdened heart, now behold again this former form of Mine.
documents.searchText: bg.11.49 bg.11.49 chapter 11 verse 49 म त वयथ म च वमढभव दषटव रप घरमदङममदम वयपतभ परतमन पनसतव तदव म रपमद परपशय 11.49 ma te vyatha ma cha vimudha-bhavo drishtva rupam ghoram idrin mamedam vyapeta-bhih prita-manah punas tvam tad eva me rupam idam prapashya do not be afraid nor be bewildered on seeing such a terrible form of mine with your fear dispelled and with a gladdened heart now behold again this former form of mine.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.49 bg.11.49 chapter 11 verse 49 मा ते व्यथा मा च विमूढभावो

दृष्ट्वा रूपं घोरमीदृङ्ममेदम्।

व्यपेतभीः प्रीतमनाः पुनस्त्वं

तदेव मे रूपमिदं प्रपश्य।।11.49।। mā te vyathā mā cha vimūḍha-bhāvo
dṛiṣhṭvā rūpaṁ ghoram īdṛiṅ mamedam
vyapeta-bhīḥ prīta-manāḥ punas tvaṁ
tad eva me rūpam idaṁ prapaśhya do not be afraid, nor be bewildered on seeing such a terrible form of mine; with your fear dispelled and with a gladdened heart, now behold again this former form of mine.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.5
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, "Behold, O Arjuna, forms of Mine, by the hundreds and thousands, of different sorts, divine, and of various colors and shapes."
documents.searchText: bg.11.5 bg.11.5 chapter 11 verse 5 शर भगवनवच पशय म परथ रपण शतशऽथ सहसरश ननवधन दवयन ननवरणकतन च 11.5 shri-bhagavan uvacha pashya me partha rupani shatasho tha sahasrashah nana-vidhani divyani nana-varnakritini cha the blessed lord said behold o arjuna forms of mine by the hundreds and thousands of different sorts divine and of various colors and shapes.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.5 bg.11.5 chapter 11 verse 5 श्री भगवानुवाच

पश्य मे पार्थ रूपाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।

नानाविधानि दिव्यानि नानावर्णाकृतीनि च।।11.5।। śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
paśhya me pārtha rūpāṇi śhataśho ’tha sahasraśhaḥ
nānā-vidhāni divyāni nānā-varṇākṛitīni cha the blessed lord said, "behold, o arjuna, forms of mine, by the hundreds and thousands, of different sorts, divine, and of various colors and shapes."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.50
documents.summary: Sanjaya said, Having thus spoken to Arjuna, Krishna again showed His own form. The great Soul, assuming His gentle form, then consoled Arjuna, who was terrified.
documents.searchText: bg.11.50 bg.11.50 chapter 11 verse 50 सञजय उवच इतयरजन वसदवसतथकतव सवक रप दरशयमस भय आशवसयमस च भतमन भतव पन समयवपरमहतम 11.50 sanjaya uvacha ity arjunam vasudevas tathoktva svakam rupam darshayam asa bhuyah ashvasayam asa cha bhitam enam bhutva punah saumya-vapur mahatma sanjaya said having thus spoken to arjuna krishna again showed his own form. the great soul assuming his gentle form then consoled arjuna who was terrified.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.50 bg.11.50 chapter 11 verse 50 सञ्जय उवाच

इत्यर्जुनं वासुदेवस्तथोक्त्वा

स्वकं रूपं दर्शयामास भूयः।

आश्वासयामास च भीतमेनं

भूत्वा पुनः सौम्यवपुर्महात्मा।।11.50।। sañjaya uvācha
ity arjunaṁ vāsudevas tathoktvā
svakaṁ rūpaṁ darśhayām āsa bhūyaḥ
āśhvāsayām āsa cha bhītam enaṁ
bhūtvā punaḥ saumya-vapur mahātmā sanjaya said, having thus spoken to arjuna, krishna again showed his own form. the great soul, assuming his gentle form, then consoled arjuna, who was terrified.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.51
documents.summary: Arjuna said, "Having seen this Thy gentle human form, O Krishna, now I am composed and have been restored to my own nature."
documents.searchText: bg.11.51 bg.11.51 chapter 11 verse 51 अरजन उवच दषटवद मनष रप तवसमय जनरदन इदनमसम सवतत सचत परकत गत 11.51 arjuna uvacha drishtvedam manusham rupam tava saumyam janardana idanim asmi samvrittah sa-chetah prakritim gatah arjuna said having seen this thy gentle human form o krishna now i am composed and have been restored to my own nature.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.51 bg.11.51 chapter 11 verse 51 अर्जुन उवाच

दृष्ट्वेदं मानुषं रूपं तवसौम्यं जनार्दन।

इदानीमस्मि संवृत्तः सचेताः प्रकृतिं गतः।।11.51।। arjuna uvācha
dṛiṣhṭvedaṁ mānuṣhaṁ rūpaṁ tava saumyaṁ janārdana
idānīm asmi saṁvṛittaḥ sa-chetāḥ prakṛitiṁ gataḥ arjuna said, "having seen this thy gentle human form, o krishna, now i am composed and have been restored to my own nature."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.52
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, "It is very hard indeed to see this form of Mine which thou hast seen; even the gods are ever longing to behold it."
documents.searchText: bg.11.52 bg.11.52 chapter 11 verse 52 शर भगवनवच सदरदरशमद रप दषटवनस यनमम दव अपयसय रपसय नतय दरशनकङकषण 11.52 shri-bhagavan uvacha su-durdarsham idam rupam drishtavan asi yan mama deva apy asya rupasya nityam darshana-kankshinah the blessed lord said it is very hard indeed to see this form of mine which thou hast seen even the gods are ever longing to behold it.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.52 bg.11.52 chapter 11 verse 52 श्री भगवानुवाच

सुदुर्दर्शमिदं रूपं दृष्टवानसि यन्मम।

देवा अप्यस्य रूपस्य नित्यं दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः।।11.52।। śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
su-durdarśham idaṁ rūpaṁ dṛiṣhṭavān asi yan mama
devā apy asya rūpasya nityaṁ darśhana-kāṅkṣhiṇaḥ the blessed lord said, "it is very hard indeed to see this form of mine which thou hast seen; even the gods are ever longing to behold it."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.53
documents.iast: nāhaṁ vedair na tapasā na dānena na chejyayā
documents.sanskrit: नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया।
documents.summary: Neither by the Vedas, nor by austerity, nor by gift, nor by sacrifice can I be seen in this form as thou hast seen Me so easily.
documents.searchText: bg.11.53 bg.11.53 chapter 11 verse 53 नह वदरन तपस न दनन न चजयय शकय एववध दरषट दषटवनस म यथ 11.53 naham vedair na tapasa na danena na chejyaya shakya evam-vidho drashtum drishtavan asi mam yatha neither by the vedas nor by austerity nor by gift nor by sacrifice can i be seen in this form as thou hast seen me so easily.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.53 bg.11.53 chapter 11 verse 53 नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया।

शक्य एवंविधो द्रष्टुं दृष्टवानसि मां यथा।।11.53।। nāhaṁ vedair na tapasā na dānena na chejyayā
śhakya evaṁ-vidho draṣhṭuṁ dṛiṣhṭavān asi māṁ yathā neither by the vedas, nor by austerity, nor by gift, nor by sacrifice can i be seen in this form as thou hast seen me so easily.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.54
documents.iast: bhaktyā tv ananyayā śhakya aham evaṁ-vidho ’rjuna
documents.summary: But by single-minded devotion, I can be known, seen, and entered into in reality, O Arjuna.
documents.searchText: bg.11.54 bg.11.54 chapter 11 verse 54 भकतय तवननयय शकयमहमववधऽरजन जञत दषट च तततवन परवषट च परतप 11.54 bhaktya tv ananyaya shakya aham evam-vidho rjuna jnatum drashtum cha tattvena praveshtum cha parantapa but by single-minded devotion i can be known seen and entered into in reality o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.54 bg.11.54 chapter 11 verse 54 भक्त्या त्वनन्यया शक्यमहमेवंविधोऽर्जुन।

ज्ञातुं दृष्टुं च तत्त्वेन प्रवेष्टुं च परंतप।।11.54।। bhaktyā tv ananyayā śhakya aham evaṁ-vidho ’rjuna
jñātuṁ draṣhṭuṁ cha tattvena praveṣhṭuṁ cha parantapa but by single-minded devotion, i can be known, seen, and entered into in reality, o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.55
documents.summary: He who does all actions for Me, who regards Me as the Supreme, who is devoted to Me, who is free from attachment, who bears no enmity towards any creature, he comes to Me, O Arjuna
documents.searchText: bg.11.55 bg.11.55 chapter 11 verse 55 मतकरमकनमतपरम मदभकत सङगवरजत नरवर सरवभतष य स ममत पणडव 11.55 mat-karma-krin mat-paramo mad-bhaktah sanga-varjitah nirvairah sarva-bhuteshu yah sa mam eti pandava he who does all actions for me who regards me as the supreme who is devoted to me who is free from attachment who bears no enmity towards any creature he comes to me o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.55 bg.11.55 chapter 11 verse 55 मत्कर्मकृन्मत्परमो मद्भक्तः सङ्गवर्जितः।

निर्वैरः सर्वभूतेषु यः स मामेति पाण्डव।।11.55।। mat-karma-kṛin mat-paramo mad-bhaktaḥ saṅga-varjitaḥ
nirvairaḥ sarva-bhūteṣhu yaḥ sa mām eti pāṇḍava he who does all actions for me, who regards me as the supreme, who is devoted to me, who is free from attachment, who bears no enmity towards any creature, he comes to me, o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.6
documents.iast: paśhyādityān vasūn rudrān aśhvinau marutas tathā
documents.summary: Behold the Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the two Asvins, and the Maruts; behold many wonders never before seen, O Arjuna.
documents.searchText: bg.11.6 bg.11.6 chapter 11 verse 6 पशयदतयनवसनरदरनशवन मरतसतथ बहनयदषटपरवण पशयऽशचरयण भरत 11.6 pashyadityan vasun rudran ashvinau marutas tatha bahuny adrishta-purvani pashyashcharyani bharata behold the adityas the vasus the rudras the two asvins and the maruts behold many wonders never before seen o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.6 bg.11.6 chapter 11 verse 6 पश्यादित्यान्वसून्रुद्रानश्विनौ मरुतस्तथा।

बहून्यदृष्टपूर्वाणि पश्याऽश्चर्याणि भारत।।11.6।। paśhyādityān vasūn rudrān aśhvinau marutas tathā
bahūny adṛiṣhṭa-pūrvāṇi paśhyāśhcharyāṇi bhārata behold the adityas, the vasus, the rudras, the two asvins, and the maruts; behold many wonders never before seen, o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.7
documents.summary: Now, behold, O Arjuna, in this My body, the entire universe centered in one, including the moving and the unmoving, and whatever else you desire to see.
documents.searchText: bg.11.7 bg.11.7 chapter 11 verse 7 इहकसथ जगतकतसन पशयदय सचरचरम मम दह गडकश यचचनयददरषटमचछस 11.7 ihaika-stham jagat kritsnam pashyadya sa-characharam mama dehe gudakesha yach chanyad drashtum ichchhasi now behold o arjuna in this my body the entire universe centered in one including the moving and the unmoving and whatever else you desire to see.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.7 bg.11.7 chapter 11 verse 7 इहैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं पश्याद्य सचराचरम्।

मम देहे गुडाकेश यच्चान्यद्द्रष्टुमिच्छसि।।11.7।। ihaika-sthaṁ jagat kṛitsnaṁ paśhyādya sa-charācharam
mama dehe guḍākeśha yach chānyad draṣhṭum ichchhasi now, behold, o arjuna, in this my body, the entire universe centered in one, including the moving and the unmoving, and whatever else you desire to see.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.8
documents.iast: na tu māṁ śhakyase draṣhṭum anenaiva sva-chakṣhuṣhā
documents.sanskrit: न तु मां शक्यसे द्रष्टुमनेनैव स्वचक्षुषा।
documents.summary: But you are not able to behold Me with these your own eyes; I give you the divine eye; behold My lordly Yoga.
documents.searchText: bg.11.8 bg.11.8 chapter 11 verse 8 न त म शकयस दरषटमननव सवचकषष दवय ददम त चकष पशय म यगमशवरम 11.8 na tu mam shakyase drashtum anenaiva sva-chakshusha divyam dadami te chakshuh pashya me yogam aishwaram but you are not able to behold me with these your own eyes i give you the divine eye behold my lordly yoga.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.8 bg.11.8 chapter 11 verse 8 न तु मां शक्यसे द्रष्टुमनेनैव स्वचक्षुषा।

दिव्यं ददामि ते चक्षुः पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्।।11.8।। na tu māṁ śhakyase draṣhṭum anenaiva sva-chakṣhuṣhā
divyaṁ dadāmi te chakṣhuḥ paśhya me yogam aiśhwaram but you are not able to behold me with these your own eyes; i give you the divine eye; behold my lordly yoga.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 11.9
documents.summary: Sanjaya said, Having thus spoken, O king, the great Lord of Yoga, Hari (Krishna), showed Arjuna His supreme form as the Lord.
documents.searchText: bg.11.9 bg.11.9 chapter 11 verse 9 सञजय उवच एवमकतव तत रजनमहयगशवर हर दरशयमस परथय परम रपमशवरम 11.9 sanjaya uvacha evam uktva tato rajan maha-yogeshvaro harih darshayam asa parthaya paramam rupam aishwaram sanjaya said having thus spoken o king the great lord of yoga hari krishna showed arjuna his supreme form as the lord.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.11.9 bg.11.9 chapter 11 verse 9 सञ्जय उवाच

एवमुक्त्वा ततो राजन्महायोगेश्वरो हरिः।

दर्शयामास पार्थाय परमं रूपमैश्वरम्।।11.9।। sañjaya uvācha
evam uktvā tato rājan mahā-yogeśhvaro hariḥ
darśhayām āsa pārthāya paramaṁ rūpam aiśhwaram sanjaya said, having thus spoken, o king, the great lord of yoga, hari (krishna), showed arjuna his supreme form as the lord.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 12.1
documents.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाचएवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते।येचाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के
documents.summary: Arjuna said, "Which of them are better versed in Yoga—those who steadfastly worship You, or those who worship the imperishable and the unmanifested?"
documents.searchText: bg.12.1 bg.12.1 chapter 12 verse 1 अरजन उवचएव सततयकत य भकतसतव परयपसत यचपयकषरमवयकत तष क यगवततम 12.1 arjuna uvacha evam satata-yukta ye bhaktas tvam paryupasate ye chapy aksharam avyaktam tesham ke yoga-vittamah arjuna said which of them are better versed in yoga those who steadfastly worship you or those who worship the imperishable and the unmanifested
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.12.1 bg.12.1 chapter 12 verse 1 अर्जुन उवाचएवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते।येचाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः।।12.1।। arjuna uvācha
evaṁ satata-yuktā ye bhaktās tvāṁ paryupāsate
ye chāpy akṣharam avyaktaṁ teṣhāṁ ke yoga-vittamāḥ arjuna said, "which of them are better versed in yoga—those who steadfastly worship you, or those who worship the imperishable and the unmanifested?"

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 12.10
documents.sanskrit: अभ्यासेऽप्यसमर्थोऽसि मत्कर्मपरमो भव।मदर्थमपि कर्माणि कुर्वन् सिद्धिमवाप्स्यसि।।1
documents.summary: If you are unable to practice even this Abhyasa Yoga, be intent on doing actions for My sake; even by doing actions for My sake, you will attain perfection.
documents.searchText: bg.12.10 bg.12.10 chapter 12 verse 10 अभयसऽपयसमरथऽस मतकरमपरम भव मदरथमप करमण करवन सदधमवपसयस 12.10 abhyase py asamartho si mat-karma-paramo bhava mad-artham api karmani kurvan siddhim avapsyasi if you are unable to practice even this abhyasa yoga be intent on doing actions for my sake even by doing actions for my sake you will attain perfection.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.12.10 bg.12.10 chapter 12 verse 10 अभ्यासेऽप्यसमर्थोऽसि मत्कर्मपरमो भव।मदर्थमपि कर्माणि कुर्वन् सिद्धिमवाप्स्यसि।।12.10।। abhyāse ’py asamartho ’si mat-karma-paramo bhava
mad-artham api karmāṇi kurvan siddhim avāpsyasi if you are unable to practice even this abhyasa yoga, be intent on doing actions for my sake; even by doing actions for my sake, you will attain perfection.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 12.11
documents.iast: athaitad apy aśhakto ’si kartuṁ mad-yogam āśhritaḥ
documents.sanskrit: अथैतदप्यशक्तोऽसि कर्तुं मद्योगमाश्रितः।सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं ततः कुरु यतात्मवान्।।12.
documents.summary: If you are unable to do even this, then, resort to union with Me and renounce the fruits of all actions with self-control.
documents.searchText: bg.12.11 bg.12.11 chapter 12 verse 11 अथतदपयशकतऽस करत मदयगमशरत सरवकरमफलतयग तत कर यततमवन 12.11 athaitad apy ashakto si kartum mad-yogam ashritah sarva-karma-phala-tyagam tatah kuru yatatmavan if you are unable to do even this then resort to union with me and renounce the fruits of all actions with self-control.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.12.11 bg.12.11 chapter 12 verse 11 अथैतदप्यशक्तोऽसि कर्तुं मद्योगमाश्रितः।सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं ततः कुरु यतात्मवान्।।12.11।। athaitad apy aśhakto ’si kartuṁ mad-yogam āśhritaḥ
sarva-karma-phala-tyāgaṁ tataḥ kuru yatātmavān if you are unable to do even this, then, resort to union with me and renounce the fruits of all actions with self-control.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 12.12
documents.iast: śhreyo hi jñānam abhyāsāj jñānād dhyānaṁ viśhiṣhyate
documents.summary: Better indeed is knowledge than practice; better than knowledge is meditation; better than meditation is the renunciation of the fruits of actions: peace immediately follows renunc
documents.searchText: bg.12.12 bg.12.12 chapter 12 verse 12 शरय ह जञनमभयसजजञनदधयन वशषयत धयनतकरमफलतयगसतयगचछनतरननतरम 12.12 shreyo hi jnanam abhyasaj jnanad dhyanam vishishyate dhyanat karma-phala-tyagas tyagach chhantir anantaram better indeed is knowledge than practice better than knowledge is meditation better than meditation is the renunciation of the fruits of actions peace immediately follows renunciation.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.12.12 bg.12.12 chapter 12 verse 12 श्रेयो हि ज्ञानमभ्यासाज्ज्ञानाद्ध्यानं विशिष्यते।ध्यानात्कर्मफलत्यागस्त्यागाच्छान्तिरनन्तरम्।।12.12।। śhreyo hi jñānam abhyāsāj jñānād dhyānaṁ viśhiṣhyate
dhyānāt karma-phala-tyāgas tyāgāch chhāntir anantaram better indeed is knowledge than practice; better than knowledge is meditation; better than meditation is the renunciation of the fruits of actions: peace immediately follows renunciation.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 12.13
documents.iast: adveṣhṭā sarva-bhūtānāṁ maitraḥ karuṇa eva cha
documents.sanskrit: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च।निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी।।12.1
documents.summary: He who hates no creature, is friendly and compassionate to all, is free from attachment and egoism, is balanced in pleasure and pain, and is forgiving.
documents.searchText: bg.12.13 bg.12.13 chapter 12 verse 13 अदवषट सरवभतन मतर करण एव च नरमम नरहङकर समदखसख कषम 12.13 adveshta sarva-bhutanam maitrah karuna eva cha nirmamo nirahankarah sama-duhkha-sukhah kshami he who hates no creature is friendly and compassionate to all is free from attachment and egoism is balanced in pleasure and pain and is forgiving.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.12.13 bg.12.13 chapter 12 verse 13 अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च।निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी।।12.13।। adveṣhṭā sarva-bhūtānāṁ maitraḥ karuṇa eva cha
nirmamo nirahankāraḥ sama-duḥkha-sukhaḥ kṣhamī he who hates no creature, is friendly and compassionate to all, is free from attachment and egoism, is balanced in pleasure and pain, and is forgiving.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 12.14
documents.sanskrit: सन्तुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः।मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रि
documents.summary: Ever content, steady in meditation, self-controlled, possessing firm conviction, with the mind and intellect dedicated to Me, he, My devotee, is dear to Me.
documents.searchText: bg.12.14 bg.12.14 chapter 12 verse 14 सनतषट सतत यग यततम दढनशचय मययरपतमनबदधरय मदभकत स म परय 12.14 santushtah satatam yogi yatatma dridha-nishchayah mayy arpita-mano-buddhir yo mad-bhaktah sa me priyah ever content steady in meditation self-controlled possessing firm conviction with the mind and intellect dedicated to me he my devotee is dear to me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.12.14 bg.12.14 chapter 12 verse 14 सन्तुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः।मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः।।12.14।। santuṣhṭaḥ satataṁ yogī yatātmā dṛiḍha-niśhchayaḥ
mayy arpita-mano-buddhir yo mad-bhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ ever content, steady in meditation, self-controlled, possessing firm conviction, with the mind and intellect dedicated to me, he, my devotee, is dear to me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 12.15
documents.iast: yasmān nodvijate loko lokān nodvijate cha yaḥ
documents.sanskrit: यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः।हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे
documents.summary: He whom the world does not agitate, and who cannot be agitated by the world, and who is freed from joy, anger, fear, and anxiety—he is dear to Me.
documents.searchText: bg.12.15 bg.12.15 chapter 12 verse 15 यसमननदवजत लक लकननदवजत च य हरषमरषभयदवगरमकत य स च म परय 12.15 yasman nodvijate loko lokan nodvijate cha yah harshamarsha-bhayodvegair mukto yah sa cha me priyah he whom the world does not agitate and who cannot be agitated by the world and who is freed from joy anger fear and anxiety he is dear to me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.12.15 bg.12.15 chapter 12 verse 15 यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः।हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः।।12.15।। yasmān nodvijate loko lokān nodvijate cha yaḥ
harṣhāmarṣha-bhayodvegair mukto yaḥ sa cha me priyaḥ he whom the world does not agitate, and who cannot be agitated by the world, and who is freed from joy, anger, fear, and anxiety—he is dear to me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 12.16
documents.sanskrit: अनपेक्षः शुचिर्दक्ष उदासीनो गतव्यथः।सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः।।
documents.summary: He who is free from wants, pure, expert, unconcerned, and free from pain, renouncing all undertakings and commencements, he who is devoted to Me is dear to Me.
documents.searchText: bg.12.16 bg.12.16 chapter 12 verse 16 अनपकष शचरदकष उदसन गतवयथ सरवरमभपरतयग य मदभकत स म परय 12.16 anapekshah shuchir daksha udasino gata-vyathah sarvarambha-parityagi yo mad-bhaktah sa me priyah he who is free from wants pure expert unconcerned and free from pain renouncing all undertakings and commencements he who is devoted to me is dear to me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.12.16 bg.12.16 chapter 12 verse 16 अनपेक्षः शुचिर्दक्ष उदासीनो गतव्यथः।सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः।।12.16।। anapekṣhaḥ śhuchir dakṣha udāsīno gata-vyathaḥ
sarvārambha-parityāgī yo mad-bhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ he who is free from wants, pure, expert, unconcerned, and free from pain, renouncing all undertakings and commencements, he who is devoted to me is dear to me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 12.17
documents.iast: yo na hṛiṣhyati na dveṣhṭi na śhochati na kāṅkṣhati
documents.sanskrit: यो न हृष्यति न द्वेष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति।शुभाशुभपरित्यागी भक्तिमान्यः स मे प्
documents.summary: He who neither rejoices nor hates, nor grieves nor desires, renouncing both good and evil, and who is full of devotion, is dear to Me.
documents.searchText: bg.12.17 bg.12.17 chapter 12 verse 17 य न हषयत न दवषट न शचत न कङकषत शभशभपरतयग भकतमनय स म परय 12.17 yo na hrishyati na dveshti na shochati na kankshati shubhashubha-parityagi bhaktiman yah sa me priyah he who neither rejoices nor hates nor grieves nor desires renouncing both good and evil and who is full of devotion is dear to me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.12.17 bg.12.17 chapter 12 verse 17 यो न हृष्यति न द्वेष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति।शुभाशुभपरित्यागी भक्तिमान्यः स मे प्रियः।।12.17।। yo na hṛiṣhyati na dveṣhṭi na śhochati na kāṅkṣhati
śhubhāśhubha-parityāgī bhaktimān yaḥ sa me priyaḥ he who neither rejoices nor hates, nor grieves nor desires, renouncing both good and evil, and who is full of devotion, is dear to me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 12.18
documents.iast: samaḥ śhatrau cha mitre cha tathā mānāpamānayoḥ
documents.sanskrit: समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः।शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु समः सङ्गविवर्जितः।।12.18।
documents.summary: He who is the same to foe and friend, and also in honor and dishonor, who is the same in cold and heat, in pleasure and pain, and who is free from attachment.
documents.searchText: bg.12.18 bg.12.18 chapter 12 verse 18 सम शतर च मतर च तथ मनपमनय शतषणसखदखष सम सङगववरजत 12.18 samah shatrau cha mitre cha tatha manapamanayoh shitoshna-sukha-duhkheshu samah sanga-vivarjitah he who is the same to foe and friend and also in honor and dishonor who is the same in cold and heat in pleasure and pain and who is free from attachment.
documents.searchTextRaw:
