bg.12.18 bg.12.18 chapter 12 verse 18 समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः।शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु समः सङ्गविवर्जितः।।12.18।। samaḥ śhatrau cha mitre cha tathā mānāpamānayoḥ
śhītoṣhṇa-sukha-duḥkheṣhu samaḥ saṅga-vivarjitaḥ he who is the same to foe and friend, and also in honor and dishonor, who is the same in cold and heat, in pleasure and pain, and who is free from attachment.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 12.19
documents.summary: He to whom censure and praise are equal, who is silent, content with anything, homeless, of a steady mind, and full of devotion; that man is dear to me.
documents.searchText: bg.12.19 bg.12.19 chapter 12 verse 19 तलयननदसततरमन सनतषट यनकनचत अनकत सथरमतरभकतमनम परय नर 12.19 tulya-ninda-stutir mauni santushto yena kenachit aniketah sthira-matir bhaktiman me priyo narah he to whom censure and praise are equal who is silent content with anything homeless of a steady mind and full of devotion that man is dear to me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.12.19 bg.12.19 chapter 12 verse 19 तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्मौनी सन्तुष्टो येनकेनचित्।अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्भक्तिमान्मे प्रियो नरः।।12.19।। tulya-nindā-stutir maunī santuṣhṭo yena kenachit
aniketaḥ sthira-matir bhaktimān me priyo naraḥ he to whom censure and praise are equal, who is silent, content with anything, homeless, of a steady mind, and full of devotion; that man is dear to me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 12.2
documents.sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाचमय्यावेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते।श्रद्धया परयोपेतास्ते मे
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, "In My opinion, those who fix their minds on Me, worship Me ever steadfastly, and are endowed with supreme faith, are the best in Yoga."
documents.searchText: bg.12.2 bg.12.2 chapter 12 verse 2 शर भगवनवचमययवशय मन य म नतययकत उपसत शरदधय परयपतसत म यकततम मत 12.2 shri-bhagavan uvacha mayy aveshya mano ye mam nitya-yukta upasate shraddhaya parayopetas te me yuktatama matah the blessed lord said in my opinion those who fix their minds on me worship me ever steadfastly and are endowed with supreme faith are the best in yoga.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.12.2 bg.12.2 chapter 12 verse 2 श्री भगवानुवाचमय्यावेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते।श्रद्धया परयोपेतास्ते मे युक्ततमा मताः।।12.2।। śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
mayy āveśhya mano ye māṁ nitya-yuktā upāsate
śhraddhayā parayopetās te me yuktatamā matāḥ the blessed lord said, "in my opinion, those who fix their minds on me, worship me ever steadfastly, and are endowed with supreme faith, are the best in yoga."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 12.20
documents.iast: ye tu dharmyāmṛitam idaṁ yathoktaṁ paryupāsate
documents.sanskrit: ये तु धर्म्यामृतमिदं यथोक्तं पर्युपासते।श्रद्दधाना मत्परमा भक्तास्तेऽतीव मे प्रि
documents.summary: They who follow this immortal Dharma, endowed with faith and regarding Me as their supreme goal, are exceedingly dear to Me.
documents.searchText: bg.12.20 bg.12.20 chapter 12 verse 20 य त धरमयमतमद यथकत परयपसत शरददधन मतपरम भकतसतऽतव म परय 12.20 ye tu dharmyamritam idam yathoktam paryupasate shraddadhana mat-parama bhaktas te tiva me priyah they who follow this immortal dharma endowed with faith and regarding me as their supreme goal are exceedingly dear to me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.12.20 bg.12.20 chapter 12 verse 20 ये तु धर्म्यामृतमिदं यथोक्तं पर्युपासते।श्रद्दधाना मत्परमा भक्तास्तेऽतीव मे प्रियाः।।12.20।। ye tu dharmyāmṛitam idaṁ yathoktaṁ paryupāsate
śhraddadhānā mat-paramā bhaktās te ’tīva me priyāḥ they who follow this immortal dharma, endowed with faith and regarding me as their supreme goal, are exceedingly dear to me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 12.3
documents.iast: ye tv akṣharam anirdeśhyam avyaktaṁ paryupāsate
documents.sanskrit: ये त्वक्षरमनिर्देश्यमव्यक्तं पर्युपासते।सर्वत्रगमचिन्त्यं च कूटस्थमचलं ध्रुवम्।।
documents.summary: Those who worship the imperishable, the indefinable, the unmanifest, the omnipresent, the unthinkable, the immovable, and the eternal.
documents.searchText: bg.12.3 bg.12.3 chapter 12 verse 3 य तवकषरमनरदशयमवयकत परयपसत सरवतरगमचनतय च कटसथमचल धरवम 12.3 ye tv aksharam anirdeshyam avyaktam paryupasate sarvatra-gam achintyancha kuta-stham achalandhruvam sanniyamyendriya-gramam sarvatra sama-buddhayah te prapnuvanti mam eva sarva-bhuta-hite ratah those who worship the imperishable the indefinable the unmanifest the omnipresent the unthinkable the immovable and the eternal.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.12.3 bg.12.3 chapter 12 verse 3 ये त्वक्षरमनिर्देश्यमव्यक्तं पर्युपासते।सर्वत्रगमचिन्त्यं च कूटस्थमचलं ध्रुवम्।।12.3।। ye tv akṣharam anirdeśhyam avyaktaṁ paryupāsate
sarvatra-gam achintyañcha kūṭa-stham achalandhruvam
 sanniyamyendriya-grāmaṁ sarvatra sama-buddhayaḥ
te prāpnuvanti mām eva sarva-bhūta-hite ratāḥ those who worship the imperishable, the indefinable, the unmanifest, the omnipresent, the unthinkable, the immovable, and the eternal.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 12.4
documents.iast: sanniyamyendriya-grāmaṁ  sarvatra    sama-buddhayaḥ  te  prāpnuvanti mām eva sarva-bhūta-hite    ratāḥ
documents.sanskrit: संनियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं सर्वत्र समबुद्धयः।ते प्राप्नुवन्ति मामेव सर्वभूतहिते रताः
documents.summary: Having restrained all the senses, being even-minded everywhere, and intent on the welfare of all beings, they verily come unto Me.
documents.searchText: bg.12.4 bg.12.4 chapter 12 verse 4 सनयमयनदरयगरम सरवतर समबदधय त परपनवनत ममव सरवभतहत रत 12.4 sanniyamyendriya-gramam sarvatra sama-buddhayah te prapnuvanti mam eva sarva-bhuta-hite ratah having restrained all the senses being even-minded everywhere and intent on the welfare of all beings they verily come unto me.
documents.searchTextRaw: bg.12.4 bg.12.4 chapter 12 verse 4 संनियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं सर्वत्र समबुद्धयः।ते प्राप्नुवन्ति मामेव सर्वभूतहिते रताः।।12.4।। sanniyamyendriya-grāmaṁ  sarvatra    sama-buddhayaḥ  te  prāpnuvanti mām eva sarva-bhūta-hite    ratāḥ having restrained all the senses, being even-minded everywhere, and intent on the welfare of all beings, they verily come unto me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 12.5
documents.summary: Greater is their trouble whose minds are set on the unmanifested, for the goal of the unmanifested is very hard for the embodied to reach.
documents.searchText: bg.12.5 bg.12.5 chapter 12 verse 5 कलशऽधकतरसतषमवयकतसकतचतसम अवयकत ह गतरदख दहवदभरवपयत 12.5 klesho dhikataras tesham avyaktasakta-chetasam avyakta hi gatir duhkham dehavadbhir avapyate greater is their trouble whose minds are set on the unmanifested for the goal of the unmanifested is very hard for the embodied to reach.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.12.5 bg.12.5 chapter 12 verse 5 क्लेशोऽधिकतरस्तेषामव्यक्तासक्तचेतसाम्।

अव्यक्ता हि गतिर्दुःखं देहवद्भिरवाप्यते।।12.5।। kleśho ’dhikataras teṣhām avyaktāsakta-chetasām
avyaktā hi gatir duḥkhaṁ dehavadbhir avāpyate greater is their trouble whose minds are set on the unmanifested, for the goal of the unmanifested is very hard for the embodied to reach.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 12.6
documents.iast: ye tu sarvāṇi karmāṇi mayi sannyasya mat-paraḥ
documents.sanskrit: ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्पराः।अनन्येनैव योगेन मां ध्यायन्त उपासते।।
documents.summary: But to those who worship Me, renouncing all actions in Me, regarding Me as the supreme goal, meditating on Me with single-minded yoga.
documents.searchText: bg.12.6 bg.12.6 chapter 12 verse 6 य त सरवण करमण मय सनयसय मतपर अननयनव यगन म धययनत उपसत 12.6 ye tu sarvani karmani mayi sannyasya mat-parah ananyenaiva yogena mam dhyayanta upasate but to those who worship me renouncing all actions in me regarding me as the supreme goal meditating on me with single-minded yoga.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.12.6 bg.12.6 chapter 12 verse 6 ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्पराः।अनन्येनैव योगेन मां ध्यायन्त उपासते।।12.6।। ye tu sarvāṇi karmāṇi mayi sannyasya mat-paraḥ
ananyenaiva yogena māṁ dhyāyanta upāsate but to those who worship me, renouncing all actions in me, regarding me as the supreme goal, meditating on me with single-minded yoga.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 12.7
documents.summary: To those whose minds are set on Me, O Arjuna, verily I soon become the savior out of the ocean of Samsara.
documents.searchText: bg.12.7 bg.12.7 chapter 12 verse 7 तषमह समदधरत मतयससरसगरत भवम नचरतपरथ मययवशतचतसम 12.7 tesham aham samuddharta mrityu-samsara-sagarat bhavami na chirat partha mayy aveshita-chetasam to those whose minds are set on me o arjuna verily i soon become the savior out of the ocean of samsara.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.12.7 bg.12.7 chapter 12 verse 7 तेषामहं समुद्धर्ता मृत्युसंसारसागरात्।भवामि नचिरात्पार्थ मय्यावेशितचेतसाम्।।12.7।। teṣhām ahaṁ samuddhartā mṛityu-saṁsāra-sāgarāt
bhavāmi na chirāt pārtha mayy āveśhita-chetasām to those whose minds are set on me, o arjuna, verily i soon become the savior out of the ocean of samsara.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 12.8
documents.iast: mayy eva mana ādhatsva mayi buddhiṁ niveśhaya
documents.sanskrit: मय्येव मन आधत्स्व मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय।निवसिष्यसि मय्येव अत ऊर्ध्वं न संशयः।।12.8।
documents.summary: Fix your mind on Me, and your intellect in Me. Then you will certainly live in Me alone hereafter.
documents.searchText: bg.12.8 bg.12.8 chapter 12 verse 8 मययव मन आधतसव मय बदध नवशय नवसषयस मययव अत ऊरधव न सशय 12.8 mayy eva mana adhatsva mayi buddhim niveshaya nivasishyasi mayy eva ata urdhvam na sanshayah fix your mind on me and your intellect in me. then you will certainly live in me alone hereafter.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.12.8 bg.12.8 chapter 12 verse 8 मय्येव मन आधत्स्व मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय।निवसिष्यसि मय्येव अत ऊर्ध्वं न संशयः।।12.8।। mayy eva mana ādhatsva mayi buddhiṁ niveśhaya
nivasiṣhyasi mayy eva ata ūrdhvaṁ na sanśhayaḥ fix your mind on me, and your intellect in me. then you will certainly live in me alone hereafter.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 12.9
documents.iast: atha chittaṁ samādhātuṁ na śhaknoṣhi mayi sthiram
documents.sanskrit: अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नोषि मयि स्थिरम्।अभ्यासयोगेन ततो मामिच्छाप्तुं धनञ्जय।।1
documents.summary: If you are unable to fix your mind steadily on Me, then seek to reach Me through the yoga of constant practice, O Arjuna.
documents.searchText: bg.12.9 bg.12.9 chapter 12 verse 9 अथ चतत समधत न शकनष मय सथरम अभयसयगन तत ममचछपत धनञजय 12.9 atha chittam samadhatum na shaknoshi mayi sthiram abhyasa-yogena tato mam ichchhaptum dhananjaya if you are unable to fix your mind steadily on me then seek to reach me through the yoga of constant practice o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.12.9 bg.12.9 chapter 12 verse 9 अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नोषि मयि स्थिरम्।अभ्यासयोगेन ततो मामिच्छाप्तुं धनञ्जय।।12.9।। atha chittaṁ samādhātuṁ na śhaknoṣhi mayi sthiram
abhyāsa-yogena tato mām ichchhāptuṁ dhanañjaya if you are unable to fix your mind steadily on me, then seek to reach me through the yoga of constant practice, o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.1
documents.summary: Arjuna said, "I wish to learn about Nature and the Spirit, the field and the knower of the field, knowledge and that which ought to be known, O Kesava."
documents.searchText: bg.13.1 bg.13.1 chapter 13 verse 1 अरजन उवच परकत परष चव कषतर कषतरजञमव च एतदवदतमचछम जञन जञय च कशव 13.1 arjuna uvacha prakritim purusham chaiva kshetram kshetra-jnam eva cha etad veditum ichchhami jnanam jneyam cha keshava arjuna said i wish to learn about nature and the spirit the field and the knower of the field knowledge and that which ought to be known o kesava.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.1 bg.13.1 chapter 13 verse 1 अर्जुन उवाच

प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रज्ञमेव च।

एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामि ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं च केशव।।13.1।। arjuna uvācha
prakṛitiṁ puruṣhaṁ chaiva kṣhetraṁ kṣhetra-jñam eva cha
etad veditum ichchhāmi jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ cha keśhava arjuna said, "i wish to learn about nature and the spirit, the field and the knower of the field, knowledge and that which ought to be known, o kesava."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.10
documents.summary: Non-attachment, non-identification of the Self with son, wife, home, and the rest, and constant even-mindedness in the face of the attainment of both desirable and undesirable.
documents.searchText: bg.13.10 bg.13.10 chapter 13 verse 10 असकतरनभषवङग पतरदरगहदष नतय च समचतततवमषटनषटपपततष 13.10 asaktir anabhishvangah putra-dara-grihadishu nityam cha sama-chittatvam ishtanishtopapattishu non-attachment non-identification of the self with son wife home and the rest and constant even-mindedness in the face of the attainment of both desirable and undesirable.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.10 bg.13.10 chapter 13 verse 10 असक्तिरनभिष्वङ्गः पुत्रदारगृहादिषु।नित्यं च समचित्तत्वमिष्टानिष्टोपपत्तिषु।।13.10।। asaktir anabhiṣhvaṅgaḥ putra-dāra-gṛihādiṣhu
nityaṁ cha sama-chittatvam iṣhṭāniṣhṭopapattiṣhu non-attachment, non-identification of the self with son, wife, home, and the rest, and constant even-mindedness in the face of the attainment of both desirable and undesirable.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.11
documents.summary: Unswerving devotion to Me through the Yoga of non-separation, resorting to solitary places, and a distaste for the company of people.
documents.searchText: bg.13.11 bg.13.11 chapter 13 verse 11 मय चननययगन भकतरवयभचरण ववकतदशसवतवमरतरजनससद 13.11 mayi chananya-yogena bhaktir avyabhicharini vivikta-desha-sevitvam aratir jana-sansadi unswerving devotion to me through the yoga of non-separation resorting to solitary places and a distaste for the company of people.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.11 bg.13.11 chapter 13 verse 11 मयि चानन्ययोगेन भक्तिरव्यभिचारिणी।विविक्तदेशसेवित्वमरतिर्जनसंसदि।।13.11।। mayi chānanya-yogena bhaktir avyabhichāriṇī
vivikta-deśha-sevitvam aratir jana-sansadi unswerving devotion to me through the yoga of non-separation, resorting to solitary places, and a distaste for the company of people.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.12
documents.summary: Constancy in Self-knowledge, the perception of the end of true knowledge—this is declared to be knowledge, and what is opposed to it is ignorance.
documents.searchText: bg.13.12 bg.13.12 chapter 13 verse 12 अधयतमजञननतयतव तततवजञनरथदरशनम एतजजञनमत परकतमजञन यदतनयथ 13.12 adhyatma-jnana-nityatvam tattva-jnanartha-darshanam etaj jnanam iti proktam ajnanam yad ato nyatha constancy in self-knowledge the perception of the end of true knowledge this is declared to be knowledge and what is opposed to it is ignorance.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.12 bg.13.12 chapter 13 verse 12 अध्यात्मज्ञाननित्यत्वं तत्त्वज्ञानार्थदर्शनम्।एतज्ज्ञानमिति प्रोक्तमज्ञानं यदतोन्यथा।।13.12।। adhyātma-jñāna-nityatvaṁ tattva-jñānārtha-darśhanam
etaj jñānam iti proktam ajñānaṁ yad ato ’nyathā constancy in self-knowledge, the perception of the end of true knowledge—this is declared to be knowledge, and what is opposed to it is ignorance.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.13
documents.iast: jñeyaṁ yat tat pravakṣhyāmi yaj jñātvāmṛitam aśhnute
documents.sanskrit: ज्ञेयं यत्तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वाऽमृतमश्नुते।अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासद
documents.summary: I will declare that which is to be known, knowing which one attains immortality; the beginningless Supreme Brahman, which is neither being nor non-being.
documents.searchText: bg.13.13 bg.13.13 chapter 13 verse 13 जञय यतततपरवकषयम यजजञतवऽमतमशनत अनदमतपर बरहम न सततननसदचयत 13.13 jneyam yat tat pravakshyami yaj jnatvamritam ashnute anadi mat-param brahma na sat tan nasad uchyate i will declare that which is to be known knowing which one attains immortality the beginningless supreme brahman which is neither being nor non-being.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.13 bg.13.13 chapter 13 verse 13 ज्ञेयं यत्तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वाऽमृतमश्नुते।अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासदुच्यते।।13.13।। jñeyaṁ yat tat pravakṣhyāmi yaj jñātvāmṛitam aśhnute
anādi mat-paraṁ brahma na sat tan nāsad uchyate i will declare that which is to be known, knowing which one attains immortality; the beginningless supreme brahman, which is neither being nor non-being.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.14
documents.sanskrit: सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत्सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम्।सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति
documents.summary: With hands and feet everywhere, with eyes, heads, and mouths everywhere, with ears everywhere, He exists in the worlds, enveloping all.
documents.searchText: bg.13.14 bg.13.14 chapter 13 verse 14 सरवत पणपद ततसरवतऽकषशरमखम सरवत शरतमललक सरवमवतय तषठत 13.14 sarvatah pani-padam tat sarvato kshi-shiro-mukham sarvatah shrutimal loke sarvam avritya tishthati with hands and feet everywhere with eyes heads and mouths everywhere with ears everywhere he exists in the worlds enveloping all.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.14 bg.13.14 chapter 13 verse 14 सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत्सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम्।सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति।।13.14।। sarvataḥ pāṇi-pādaṁ tat sarvato ’kṣhi-śhiro-mukham
sarvataḥ śhrutimal loke sarvam āvṛitya tiṣhṭhati with hands and feet everywhere, with eyes, heads, and mouths everywhere, with ears everywhere, he exists in the worlds, enveloping all.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.15
documents.summary: Shining by the functions of all the senses, yet without being attached to them; unattached, yet supporting all; devoid of qualities, yet the experiencer of them.
documents.searchText: bg.13.15 bg.13.15 chapter 13 verse 15 सरवनदरयगणभस सरवनदरयववरजतम असकत सरवभचचव नरगण गणभकत च 13.15 sarvendriya-gunabhasam sarvendriya-vivarjitam asaktam sarva-bhrich chaiva nirgunam guna-bhoktri cha shining by the functions of all the senses yet without being attached to them unattached yet supporting all devoid of qualities yet the experiencer of them.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.15 bg.13.15 chapter 13 verse 15 सर्वेन्द्रियगुणाभासं सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितम्।असक्तं सर्वभृच्चैव निर्गुणं गुणभोक्तृ च।।13.15।। sarvendriya-guṇābhāsaṁ sarvendriya-vivarjitam
asaktaṁ sarva-bhṛich chaiva nirguṇaṁ guṇa-bhoktṛi cha shining by the functions of all the senses, yet without being attached to them; unattached, yet supporting all; devoid of qualities, yet the experiencer of them.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.16
documents.iast: bahir antaśh cha bhūtānām acharaṁ charam eva cha
documents.sanskrit: बहिरन्तश्च भूतानामचरं चरमेव च।सूक्ष्मत्वात्तदविज्ञेयं दूरस्थं चान्तिके च तत्।।13
documents.summary: It is within and without all beings, both the unmoving and the moving; It is subtle and unknowable, and It is near and far away.
documents.searchText: bg.13.16 bg.13.16 chapter 13 verse 16 बहरनतशच भतनमचर चरमव च सकषमतवततदवजञय दरसथ चनतक च तत 13.16 bahir antash cha bhutanam acharam charam eva cha sukshmatvat tad avijneyam dura-stham chantike cha tat it is within and without all beings both the unmoving and the moving it is subtle and unknowable and it is near and far away.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.16 bg.13.16 chapter 13 verse 16 बहिरन्तश्च भूतानामचरं चरमेव च।सूक्ष्मत्वात्तदविज्ञेयं दूरस्थं चान्तिके च तत्।।13.16।। bahir antaśh cha bhūtānām acharaṁ charam eva cha
sūkṣhmatvāt tad avijñeyaṁ dūra-sthaṁ chāntike cha tat it is within and without all beings, both the unmoving and the moving; it is subtle and unknowable, and it is near and far away.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.17
documents.iast: avibhaktaṁ cha bhūteṣhu vibhaktam iva cha sthitam
documents.sanskrit: अविभक्तं च भूतेषु विभक्तमिव च स्थितम्।भूतभर्तृ च तज्ज्ञेयं ग्रसिष्णु प्रभविष्णु
documents.summary: Undivided yet, It exists as if divided in beings; It is to be known as the supporter of beings; It devours and It generates.
documents.searchText: bg.13.17 bg.13.17 chapter 13 verse 17 अवभकत च भतष वभकतमव च सथतम भतभरत च तजजञय गरसषण परभवषण च 13.17 avibhaktam cha bhuteshu vibhaktam iva cha sthitam bhuta-bhartri cha taj jneyam grasishnu prabhavishnu cha undivided yet it exists as if divided in beings it is to be known as the supporter of beings it devours and it generates.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.17 bg.13.17 chapter 13 verse 17 अविभक्तं च भूतेषु विभक्तमिव च स्थितम्।भूतभर्तृ च तज्ज्ञेयं ग्रसिष्णु प्रभविष्णु च।।13.17।। avibhaktaṁ cha bhūteṣhu vibhaktam iva cha sthitam
bhūta-bhartṛi cha taj jñeyaṁ grasiṣhṇu prabhaviṣhṇu cha undivided yet, it exists as if divided in beings; it is to be known as the supporter of beings; it devours and it generates.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.18
documents.iast: jyotiṣhām api taj jyotis tamasaḥ param uchyate
documents.sanskrit: ज्योतिषामपि तज्ज्योतिस्तमसः परमुच्यते।ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं हृदि सर्वस्य विष्
documents.summary: That Light of all lights is said to be beyond darkness: knowledge, the knowable, and the goal of knowledge, seated in the hearts of all.
documents.searchText: bg.13.18 bg.13.18 chapter 13 verse 18 जयतषमप तजजयतसतमस परमचयत जञन जञय जञनगमय हद सरवसय वषठतम 13.18 jyotisham api taj jyotis tamasah param uchyate jnanam jneyam jnana-gamyam hridi sarvasya vishthitam that light of all lights is said to be beyond darkness knowledge the knowable and the goal of knowledge seated in the hearts of all.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.18 bg.13.18 chapter 13 verse 18 ज्योतिषामपि तज्ज्योतिस्तमसः परमुच्यते।ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं हृदि सर्वस्य विष्ठितम्।।13.18।। jyotiṣhām api taj jyotis tamasaḥ param uchyate
jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ jñāna-gamyaṁ hṛidi sarvasya viṣhṭhitam that light of all lights is said to be beyond darkness: knowledge, the knowable, and the goal of knowledge, seated in the hearts of all.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.19
documents.iast: iti kṣhetraṁ tathā jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ choktaṁ samāsataḥ
documents.sanskrit: इति क्षेत्रं तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं चोक्तं समासतः।मद्भक्त एतद्विज्ञाय मद्भावायोपपद्यत
documents.summary: Thus, the field, as well as knowledge and the knowable, have been briefly stated. My devotee, knowing this, enters into My being.
documents.searchText: bg.13.19 bg.13.19 chapter 13 verse 19 इत कषतर तथ जञन जञय चकत समसत मदभकत एतदवजञय मदभवयपपदयत 13.19 iti kshetram tatha jnanam jneyam choktam samasatah mad-bhakta etad vijnaya mad-bhavayopapadyate thus the field as well as knowledge and the knowable have been briefly stated. my devotee knowing this enters into my being.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.19 bg.13.19 chapter 13 verse 19 इति क्षेत्रं तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं चोक्तं समासतः।मद्भक्त एतद्विज्ञाय मद्भावायोपपद्यते।।13.19।। iti kṣhetraṁ tathā jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ choktaṁ samāsataḥ
mad-bhakta etad vijñāya mad-bhāvāyopapadyate thus, the field, as well as knowledge and the knowable, have been briefly stated. my devotee, knowing this, enters into my being.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.2
documents.sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाचइदं शरीरं कौन्तेय क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते।एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्ष
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, "O Arjuna, this body is called the field; he who knows it is called the knower of the field by those who know them."
documents.searchText: bg.13.2 bg.13.2 chapter 13 verse 2 शर भगवनवचइद शरर कनतय कषतरमतयभधयत एतदय वतत त परह कषतरजञ इत तदवद 13.2 shri-bhagavan uvacha idam shariram kaunteya kshetram ity abhidhiyate etad yo vetti tam prahuh kshetra-jna iti tad-vidah the blessed lord said o arjuna this body is called the field he who knows it is called the knower of the field by those who know them.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.2 bg.13.2 chapter 13 verse 2 श्री भगवानुवाचइदं शरीरं कौन्तेय क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते।एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः।।13.2।। śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
idaṁ śharīraṁ kaunteya kṣhetram ity abhidhīyate
etad yo vetti taṁ prāhuḥ kṣhetra-jña iti tad-vidaḥ the blessed lord said, "o arjuna, this body is called the field; he who knows it is called the knower of the field by those who know them."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.20
documents.iast: prakṛitiṁ puruṣhaṁ chaiva viddhy anādī ubhāv api
documents.sanskrit: प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव विद्ध्यनादी उभावपि।विकारांश्च गुणांश्चैव विद्धि प्रकृतिसंभवा
documents.summary: Know that Nature (matter) and the Spirit are both beginningless, and know also that all modifications and qualities are born from Nature.
documents.searchText: bg.13.20 bg.13.20 chapter 13 verse 20 परकत परष चव वदधयनद उभवप वकरशच गणशचव वदध परकतसभवन 13.20 prakritim purusham chaiva viddhy anadi ubhav api vikaransh cha gunansh chaiva viddhi prakriti-sambhavan know that nature matter and the spirit are both beginningless and know also that all modifications and qualities are born from nature.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.20 bg.13.20 chapter 13 verse 20 प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव विद्ध्यनादी उभावपि।विकारांश्च गुणांश्चैव विद्धि प्रकृतिसंभवान्।।13.20।। prakṛitiṁ puruṣhaṁ chaiva viddhy anādī ubhāv api
vikārānśh cha guṇānśh chaiva viddhi prakṛiti-sambhavān know that nature (matter) and the spirit are both beginningless, and know also that all modifications and qualities are born from nature.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.21
documents.sanskrit: कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे हेतुः प्रकृतिरुच्यते।पुरुषः सुखदुःखानां भोक्तृत्वे हेतुरुच्यत
documents.summary: In the production of the effect and the cause, Nature (matter) is said to be the cause; in the experience of pleasure and pain, the soul is said to be the one responsible.
documents.searchText: bg.13.21 bg.13.21 chapter 13 verse 21 करयकरणकरततव हत परकतरचयत परष सखदखन भकततव हतरचयत 13.21 karya-karana-kartritve hetuh prakritir uchyate purushah sukha-duhkhanam bhoktritve hetur uchyate in the production of the effect and the cause nature matter is said to be the cause in the experience of pleasure and pain the soul is said to be the one responsible.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.21 bg.13.21 chapter 13 verse 21 कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे हेतुः प्रकृतिरुच्यते।पुरुषः सुखदुःखानां भोक्तृत्वे हेतुरुच्यते।।13.21।। kārya-kāraṇa-kartṛitve hetuḥ prakṛitir uchyate
puruṣhaḥ sukha-duḥkhānāṁ bhoktṛitve hetur uchyate in the production of the effect and the cause, nature (matter) is said to be the cause; in the experience of pleasure and pain, the soul is said to be the one responsible.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.22
documents.iast: puruṣhaḥ prakṛiti-stho hi bhuṅkte prakṛiti-jān guṇān
documents.sanskrit: पुरुषः प्रकृतिस्थो हि भुङ्क्ते प्रकृतिजान्गुणान्।कारणं गुणसङ्गोऽस्य सदसद्योनिजन्
documents.summary: The soul seated in Nature experiences the qualities born of Nature; attachment to the qualities is the cause of its birth in good and evil wombs.
documents.searchText: bg.13.22 bg.13.22 chapter 13 verse 22 परष परकतसथ ह भङकत परकतजनगणन करण गणसङगऽसय सदसदयनजनमस 13.22 purushah prakriti-stho hi bhunkte prakriti-jan gunan karanam guna-sango sya sad-asad-yoni-janmasu the soul seated in nature experiences the qualities born of nature attachment to the qualities is the cause of its birth in good and evil wombs.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.22 bg.13.22 chapter 13 verse 22 पुरुषः प्रकृतिस्थो हि भुङ्क्ते प्रकृतिजान्गुणान्।कारणं गुणसङ्गोऽस्य सदसद्योनिजन्मसु।।13.22।। puruṣhaḥ prakṛiti-stho hi bhuṅkte prakṛiti-jān guṇān
kāraṇaṁ guṇa-saṅgo ’sya sad-asad-yoni-janmasu the soul seated in nature experiences the qualities born of nature; attachment to the qualities is the cause of its birth in good and evil wombs.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.23
documents.sanskrit: उपद्रष्टाऽनुमन्ता च भर्ता भोक्ता महेश्वरः।परमात्मेति चाप्युक्तो देहेऽस्मिन्पुरुष
documents.summary: The Supreme Soul in this body is also called the observer, the permitter, the sustainer, the enjoyer, the great Lord, and the Supreme Self.
documents.searchText: bg.13.23 bg.13.23 chapter 13 verse 23 उपदरषटऽनमनत च भरत भकत महशवर परमतमत चपयकत दहऽसमनपरष पर 13.23 upadrashtanumanta cha bharta bhokta maheshvarah paramatmeti chapy ukto dehe smin purushah parah the supreme soul in this body is also called the observer the permitter the sustainer the enjoyer the great lord and the supreme self.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.23 bg.13.23 chapter 13 verse 23 उपद्रष्टाऽनुमन्ता च भर्ता भोक्ता महेश्वरः।परमात्मेति चाप्युक्तो देहेऽस्मिन्पुरुषः परः।।13.23।। upadraṣhṭānumantā cha bhartā bhoktā maheśhvaraḥ
paramātmeti chāpy ukto dehe ’smin puruṣhaḥ paraḥ the supreme soul in this body is also called the observer, the permitter, the sustainer, the enjoyer, the great lord, and the supreme self.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.24
documents.iast: ya evaṁ vetti puruṣhaṁ prakṛitiṁ cha guṇaiḥ saha
documents.sanskrit: य एवं वेत्ति पुरुषं प्रकृतिं च गुणैःसह।सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि न स भूयोऽभिजायते।।13.2
documents.summary: He who thus knows the Spirit and Matter together with their qualities, in whatever condition he may be, he is not reborn.
documents.searchText: bg.13.24 bg.13.24 chapter 13 verse 24 य एव वतत परष परकत च गणसह सरवथ वरतमनऽप न स भयऽभजयत 13.24 ya evam vetti purusham prakritim cha gunaih saha sarvatha vartamano pi na sa bhuyo bhijayate he who thus knows the spirit and matter together with their qualities in whatever condition he may be he is not reborn.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.24 bg.13.24 chapter 13 verse 24 य एवं वेत्ति पुरुषं प्रकृतिं च गुणैःसह।सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि न स भूयोऽभिजायते।।13.24।। ya evaṁ vetti puruṣhaṁ prakṛitiṁ cha guṇaiḥ saha
sarvathā vartamāno ’pi na sa bhūyo ’bhijāyate he who thus knows the spirit and matter together with their qualities, in whatever condition he may be, he is not reborn.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.25
documents.sanskrit: ध्यानेनात्मनि पश्यन्ति केचिदात्मानमात्मना।अन्ये सांख्येन योगेन कर्मयोगेन चापरे।।
documents.summary: Some behold the Self within themselves through meditation, others through the Yoga of knowledge, and still others through the Yoga of action.
documents.searchText: bg.13.25 bg.13.25 chapter 13 verse 25 धयननतमन पशयनत कचदतमनमतमन अनय सखयन यगन करमयगन चपर 13.25 dhyanenatmani pashyanti kechid atmanam atmana anye sankhyena yogena karma-yogena chapare some behold the self within themselves through meditation others through the yoga of knowledge and still others through the yoga of action.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.25 bg.13.25 chapter 13 verse 25 ध्यानेनात्मनि पश्यन्ति केचिदात्मानमात्मना।अन्ये सांख्येन योगेन कर्मयोगेन चापरे।।13.25।। dhyānenātmani paśhyanti kechid ātmānam ātmanā
anye sānkhyena yogena karma-yogena chāpare some behold the self within themselves through meditation, others through the yoga of knowledge, and still others through the yoga of action.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.26
documents.iast: anye tv evam ajānantaḥ śhrutvānyebhya upāsate
documents.sanskrit: अन्ये त्वेवमजानन्तः श्रुत्वाऽन्येभ्य उपासते।तेऽपि चातितरन्त्येव मृत्युं श्रुतिपर
documents.summary: Others, too, who do not know thus, worship, having heard of It from others; they, too, cross beyond death, regarding what they have heard as the supreme refuge.
documents.searchText: bg.13.26 bg.13.26 chapter 13 verse 26 अनय तववमजननत शरतवऽनयभय उपसत तऽप चततरनतयव मतय शरतपरयण 13.26 anye tv evam ajanantah shrutvanyebhya upasate te pi chatitaranty eva mrityum shruti-parayanah others too who do not know thus worship having heard of it from others they too cross beyond death regarding what they have heard as the supreme refuge.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.26 bg.13.26 chapter 13 verse 26 अन्ये त्वेवमजानन्तः श्रुत्वाऽन्येभ्य उपासते।तेऽपि चातितरन्त्येव मृत्युं श्रुतिपरायणाः।।13.26।। anye tv evam ajānantaḥ śhrutvānyebhya upāsate
te ’pi chātitaranty eva mṛityuṁ śhruti-parāyaṇāḥ others, too, who do not know thus, worship, having heard of it from others; they, too, cross beyond death, regarding what they have heard as the supreme refuge.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.27
documents.summary: Wherever a being is born, whether unmoving or moving, know thou, O best of the Bharatas (Arjuna), that it is from the union of the field and its knower.
documents.searchText: bg.13.27 bg.13.27 chapter 13 verse 27 यवतसञजयत कञचतसततव सथवरजङगमम कषतरकषतरजञसयगततदवदध भरतरषभ 13.27 yavat sanjayate kinchit sattvam sthavara-jangamam kshetra-kshetrajna-sanyogat tad viddhi bharatarshabha wherever a being is born whether unmoving or moving know thou o best of the bharatas arjuna that it is from the union of the field and its knower.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.27 bg.13.27 chapter 13 verse 27 यावत्सञ्जायते किञ्चित्सत्त्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम्।क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञसंयोगात्तद्विद्धि भरतर्षभ।।13.27।। yāvat sañjāyate kiñchit sattvaṁ sthāvara-jaṅgamam
kṣhetra-kṣhetrajña-sanyogāt tad viddhi bharatarṣhabha wherever a being is born, whether unmoving or moving, know thou, o best of the bharatas (arjuna), that it is from the union of the field and its knower.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.28
documents.sanskrit: समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम्।विनश्यत्स्वविनश्यन्तं यः पश्यति स पश्यति
documents.summary: He who sees the Supreme Lord existing truly in all beings, the imperishable within the perishable, sees indeed.
documents.searchText: bg.13.28 bg.13.28 chapter 13 verse 28 सम सरवष भतष तषठनत परमशवरम वनशयतसववनशयनत य पशयत स पशयत 13.28 samam sarveshu bhuteshu tishthantam parameshvaram vinashyatsv avinashyantam yah pashyati sa pashyati he who sees the supreme lord existing truly in all beings the imperishable within the perishable sees indeed.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.28 bg.13.28 chapter 13 verse 28 समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम्।विनश्यत्स्वविनश्यन्तं यः पश्यति स पश्यति।।13.28।। samaṁ sarveṣhu bhūteṣhu tiṣhṭhantaṁ parameśhvaram
vinaśhyatsv avinaśhyantaṁ yaḥ paśhyati sa paśhyati he who sees the supreme lord existing truly in all beings, the imperishable within the perishable, sees indeed.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.29
documents.iast: samaṁ paśhyan hi sarvatra samavasthitam īśhvaram
documents.sanskrit: समं पश्यन्हि सर्वत्र समवस्थितमीश्वरम्।न हिनस्त्यात्मनाऽऽत्मानं ततो याति परां गति
documents.summary: For he who truly sees the same Lord dwelling everywhere does not destroy the Self by the self; rather, he attains the highest goal.
documents.searchText: bg.13.29 bg.13.29 chapter 13 verse 29 सम पशयनह सरवतर समवसथतमशवरम न हनसतयतमनऽऽतमन तत यत पर गतम 13.29 samam pashyan hi sarvatra samavasthitam ishvaram na hinasty atmanatmanam tato yati param gatim for he who truly sees the same lord dwelling everywhere does not destroy the self by the self rather he attains the highest goal.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.29 bg.13.29 chapter 13 verse 29 समं पश्यन्हि सर्वत्र समवस्थितमीश्वरम्।न हिनस्त्यात्मनाऽऽत्मानं ततो याति परां गतिम्।।13.29।। samaṁ paśhyan hi sarvatra samavasthitam īśhvaram
na hinasty ātmanātmānaṁ tato yāti parāṁ gatim for he who truly sees the same lord dwelling everywhere does not destroy the self by the self; rather, he attains the highest goal.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.3
documents.iast: kṣhetra-jñaṁ chāpi māṁ viddhi sarva-kṣhetreṣhu bhārata
documents.sanskrit: क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत।
documents.summary: Do thou also know Me as the knower of the field in all fields, O Arjuna. Knowledge of both the field and the knower of the field is considered by Me to be the knowledge.
documents.searchText: bg.13.3 bg.13.3 chapter 13 verse 3 कषतरजञ चप म वदध सरवकषतरष भरत कषतरकषतरजञयरजञन यततजजञन मत मम 13.3 kshetra-jnam chapi mam viddhi sarva-kshetreshu bharata kshetra-kshetrajnayor jnanam yat taj jnanam matam mama do thou also know me as the knower of the field in all fields o arjuna. knowledge of both the field and the knower of the field is considered by me to be the knowledge.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.3 bg.13.3 chapter 13 verse 3 क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत।

क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ज्ञानं यत्तज्ज्ञानं मतं मम।।13.3।। kṣhetra-jñaṁ chāpi māṁ viddhi sarva-kṣhetreṣhu bhārata
kṣhetra-kṣhetrajñayor jñānaṁ yat taj jñānaṁ mataṁ mama do thou also know me as the knower of the field in all fields, o arjuna. knowledge of both the field and the knower of the field is considered by me to be the knowledge.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.30
documents.sanskrit: प्रकृत्यैव च कर्माणि क्रियमाणानि सर्वशः।यः पश्यति तथाऽऽत्मानमकर्तारं स पश्यति।।1
documents.summary: He sees, who sees that all actions are performed solely by Nature and that the Self is without action.
documents.searchText: bg.13.30 bg.13.30 chapter 13 verse 30 परकतयव च करमण करयमणन सरवश य पशयत तथऽऽतमनमकरतर स पशयत 13.30 prakrityaiva cha karmani kriyamanani sarvashah yah pashyati tathatmanam akartaram sa pashyati he sees who sees that all actions are performed solely by nature and that the self is without action.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.30 bg.13.30 chapter 13 verse 30 प्रकृत्यैव च कर्माणि क्रियमाणानि सर्वशः।यः पश्यति तथाऽऽत्मानमकर्तारं स पश्यति।।13.30।। prakṛityaiva cha karmāṇi kriyamāṇāni sarvaśhaḥ
yaḥ paśhyati tathātmānam akartāraṁ sa paśhyati he sees, who sees that all actions are performed solely by nature and that the self is without action.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.31
documents.sanskrit: यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति।तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा।।13.31।।
documents.summary: When a person sees all beings as resting in the One and emanating from the One alone, they then become Brahman.
documents.searchText: bg.13.31 bg.13.31 chapter 13 verse 31 यद भतपथगभवमकसथमनपशयत तत एव च वसतर बरहम समपदयत तद 13.31 yada bhuta-prithag-bhavam eka-stham anupashyati tata eva cha vistaram brahma sampadyate tada when a person sees all beings as resting in the one and emanating from the one alone they then become brahman.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.31 bg.13.31 chapter 13 verse 31 यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति।तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा।।13.31।। yadā bhūta-pṛithag-bhāvam eka-stham anupaśhyati
tata eva cha vistāraṁ brahma sampadyate tadā when a person sees all beings as resting in the one and emanating from the one alone, they then become brahman.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.32
documents.summary: Being without beginning, devoid of any qualities, the Supreme Self, imperishable, though dwelling in the body, O Arjuna, neither acts nor is tainted.
documents.searchText: bg.13.32 bg.13.32 chapter 13 verse 32 अनदतवननरगणतवतपरमतमयमवयय शररसथऽप कनतय न करत न लपयत 13.32 anaditvan nirgunatvat paramatmayam avyayah sharira-stho pi kaunteya na karoti na lipyate being without beginning devoid of any qualities the supreme self imperishable though dwelling in the body o arjuna neither acts nor is tainted.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.32 bg.13.32 chapter 13 verse 32 अनादित्वान्निर्गुणत्वात्परमात्मायमव्ययः।शरीरस्थोऽपि कौन्तेय न करोति न लिप्यते।।13.32।। anāditvān nirguṇatvāt paramātmāyam avyayaḥ
śharīra-stho ’pi kaunteya na karoti na lipyate being without beginning, devoid of any qualities, the supreme self, imperishable, though dwelling in the body, o arjuna, neither acts nor is tainted.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.33
documents.sanskrit: यथा सर्वगतं सौक्ष्म्यादाकाशं नोपलिप्यते।सर्वत्रावस्थितो देहे तथाऽऽत्मा नोपलिप्यत
documents.summary: As the all-pervading ether is not tainted, due to its subtlety, so the Self seated everywhere in the body is not tainted either.
documents.searchText: bg.13.33 bg.13.33 chapter 13 verse 33 यथ सरवगत सकषमयदकश नपलपयत सरवतरवसथत दह तथऽऽतम नपलपयत 13.33 yatha sarva-gatam saukshmyad akasham nopalipyate sarvatravasthito dehe tathatma nopalipyate as the all-pervading ether is not tainted due to its subtlety so the self seated everywhere in the body is not tainted either.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.33 bg.13.33 chapter 13 verse 33 यथा सर्वगतं सौक्ष्म्यादाकाशं नोपलिप्यते।सर्वत्रावस्थितो देहे तथाऽऽत्मा नोपलिप्यते।।13.33।। yathā sarva-gataṁ saukṣhmyād ākāśhaṁ nopalipyate
sarvatrāvasthito dehe tathātmā nopalipyate as the all-pervading ether is not tainted, due to its subtlety, so the self seated everywhere in the body is not tainted either.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.34
documents.iast: yathā prakāśhayaty ekaḥ kṛitsnaṁ lokam imaṁ raviḥ
documents.sanskrit: यथा प्रकाशयत्येकः कृत्स्नं लोकमिमं रविः।क्षेत्रं क्षेत्री तथा कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति
documents.summary: Just as the one sun illuminates the entire world, so too does the Lord of the field (Supreme Self) illuminate the entire field, O Arjuna.
documents.searchText: bg.13.34 bg.13.34 chapter 13 verse 34 यथ परकशयतयक कतसन लकमम रव कषतर कषतर तथ कतसन परकशयत भरत 13.34 yatha prakashayaty ekah kritsnam lokam imam ravih kshetram kshetri tatha kritsnam prakashayati bharata just as the one sun illuminates the entire world so too does the lord of the field supreme self illuminate the entire field o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.34 bg.13.34 chapter 13 verse 34 यथा प्रकाशयत्येकः कृत्स्नं लोकमिमं रविः।क्षेत्रं क्षेत्री तथा कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति भारत।।13.34।। yathā prakāśhayaty ekaḥ kṛitsnaṁ lokam imaṁ raviḥ
kṣhetraṁ kṣhetrī tathā kṛitsnaṁ prakāśhayati bhārata just as the one sun illuminates the entire world, so too does the lord of the field (supreme self) illuminate the entire field, o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.35
documents.sanskrit: क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोरेवमन्तरं ज्ञानचक्षुषा।भूतप्रकृतिमोक्षं च ये विदुर्यान्ति ते
documents.summary: They who, by the eye of knowledge, perceive the distinction between the field and its knower, as well as the liberation from the Nature of being, go to the Supreme.
documents.searchText: bg.13.35 bg.13.35 chapter 13 verse 35 कषतरकषतरजञयरवमनतर जञनचकषष भतपरकतमकष च य वदरयनत त परम 13.35 kshetra-kshetrajnayor evam antaram jnana-chakshusha bhuta-prakriti-moksham cha ye vidur yanti te param they who by the eye of knowledge perceive the distinction between the field and its knower as well as the liberation from the nature of being go to the supreme.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.35 bg.13.35 chapter 13 verse 35 क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोरेवमन्तरं ज्ञानचक्षुषा।भूतप्रकृतिमोक्षं च ये विदुर्यान्ति ते परम्।।13.35।। kṣhetra-kṣhetrajñayor evam antaraṁ jñāna-chakṣhuṣhā
bhūta-prakṛiti-mokṣhaṁ cha ye vidur yānti te param they who, by the eye of knowledge, perceive the distinction between the field and its knower, as well as the liberation from the nature of being, go to the supreme.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.4
documents.iast: tat kṣhetraṁ yach cha yādṛik cha yad-vikāri yataśh cha yat
documents.sanskrit: तत्क्षेत्रं यच्च यादृक् च यद्विकारि यतश्च यत्।स च यो यत्प्रभावश्च तत्समासेन मे श
documents.summary: Hear from Me in brief what the field is, of what nature it is, what its modifications are, whence it is, who He is, and what His powers are.
documents.searchText: bg.13.4 bg.13.4 chapter 13 verse 4 ततकषतर यचच यदक च यदवकर यतशच यत स च य यतपरभवशच ततसमसन म शरण 13.4 tat kshetram yach cha yadrik cha yad-vikari yatash cha yat sa cha yo yat-prabhavash cha tat samasena me shrinu hear from me in brief what the field is of what nature it is what its modifications are whence it is who he is and what his powers are.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.4 bg.13.4 chapter 13 verse 4 तत्क्षेत्रं यच्च यादृक् च यद्विकारि यतश्च यत्।स च यो यत्प्रभावश्च तत्समासेन मे श्रृणु।।13.4।। tat kṣhetraṁ yach cha yādṛik cha yad-vikāri yataśh cha yat
sa cha yo yat-prabhāvaśh cha tat samāsena me śhṛiṇu hear from me in brief what the field is, of what nature it is, what its modifications are, whence it is, who he is, and what his powers are.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.5
documents.iast: ṛiṣhibhir bahudhā gītaṁ chhandobhir vividhaiḥ pṛithak
documents.summary: Sages have sung in many ways, with various distinctive chants and also with suggestive words indicative of the Absolute, full of reasoning and decisive.
documents.searchText: bg.13.5 bg.13.5 chapter 13 verse 5 ऋषभरबहध गत छनदभरववध पथक बरहमसतरपदशचव हतमदभरवनशचत 13.5 rishibhir bahudha gitam chhandobhir vividhaih prithak brahma-sutra-padaish chaiva hetumadbhir vinishchitaih sages have sung in many ways with various distinctive chants and also with suggestive words indicative of the absolute full of reasoning and decisive.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.5 bg.13.5 chapter 13 verse 5 ऋषिभिर्बहुधा गीतं छन्दोभिर्विविधैः पृथक्।ब्रह्मसूत्रपदैश्चैव हेतुमद्भिर्विनिश्चितैः।।13.5।। ṛiṣhibhir bahudhā gītaṁ chhandobhir vividhaiḥ pṛithak
brahma-sūtra-padaiśh chaiva hetumadbhir viniśhchitaiḥ sages have sung in many ways, with various distinctive chants and also with suggestive words indicative of the absolute, full of reasoning and decisive.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.6
documents.iast: mahā-bhūtāny ahankāro buddhir avyaktam eva cha
documents.sanskrit: महाभूतान्यहङ्कारो बुद्धिरव्यक्तमेव च।इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च पञ्च चेन्द्रियगोचराः।।1
documents.summary: The great elements, egoism, intellect, and also the Unmanifested Nature, the ten senses, and one mind, and the five objects of the senses.
documents.searchText: bg.13.6 bg.13.6 chapter 13 verse 6 महभतनयहङकर बदधरवयकतमव च इनदरयण दशक च पञच चनदरयगचर 13.6 maha-bhutany ahankaro buddhir avyaktam eva cha indriyani dashaikam cha pancha chendriya-gocharah the great elements egoism intellect and also the unmanifested nature the ten senses and one mind and the five objects of the senses.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.6 bg.13.6 chapter 13 verse 6 महाभूतान्यहङ्कारो बुद्धिरव्यक्तमेव च।इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च पञ्च चेन्द्रियगोचराः।।13.6।। mahā-bhūtāny ahankāro buddhir avyaktam eva cha
indriyāṇi daśhaikaṁ cha pañcha chendriya-gocharāḥ the great elements, egoism, intellect, and also the unmanifested nature, the ten senses, and one mind, and the five objects of the senses.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.7
documents.iast: ichchhā dveṣhaḥ sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ saṅghātaśh chetanā dhṛitiḥ
documents.sanskrit: इच्छा द्वेषः सुखं दुःखं सङ्घातश्चेतनाधृतिः।एतत्क्षेत्रं समासेन सविकारमुदाहृतम्।।
documents.summary: Desire, hatred, pleasure, pain, the aggregate (body), intelligence, and fortitude—the field has thus been briefly described with its modifications.
documents.searchText: bg.13.7 bg.13.7 chapter 13 verse 7 इचछ दवष सख दख सङघतशचतनधत एततकषतर समसन सवकरमदहतम 13.7 ichchha dveshah sukham duhkham sanghatash chetana dhritih etat kshetram samasena sa-vikaram udahritam desire hatred pleasure pain the aggregate body intelligence and fortitude the field has thus been briefly described with its modifications.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.7 bg.13.7 chapter 13 verse 7 इच्छा द्वेषः सुखं दुःखं सङ्घातश्चेतनाधृतिः।एतत्क्षेत्रं समासेन सविकारमुदाहृतम्।।13.7।। ichchhā dveṣhaḥ sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ saṅghātaśh chetanā dhṛitiḥ
etat kṣhetraṁ samāsena sa-vikāram udāhṛitam desire, hatred, pleasure, pain, the aggregate (body), intelligence, and fortitude—the field has thus been briefly described with its modifications.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.8
documents.summary: Humility, unpretentiousness, non-injury, forgiveness, uprightness, service to the teacher, purity, steadfastness, and self-control.
documents.searchText: bg.13.8 bg.13.8 chapter 13 verse 8 अमनतवमदमभतवमहस कषनतररजवम आचरयपसन शच सथरयमतमवनगरह 13.8 amanitvam adambhitvam ahinsa kshantir arjavam acharyopasanam shaucham sthairyam atma-vinigrahah humility unpretentiousness non-injury forgiveness uprightness service to the teacher purity steadfastness and self-control.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.8 bg.13.8 chapter 13 verse 8 अमानित्वमदम्भित्वमहिंसा क्षान्तिरार्जवम्।आचार्योपासनं शौचं स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः।।13.8।। amānitvam adambhitvam ahinsā kṣhāntir ārjavam
āchāryopāsanaṁ śhauchaṁ sthairyam ātma-vinigrahaḥ humility, unpretentiousness, non-injury, forgiveness, uprightness, service to the teacher, purity, steadfastness, and self-control.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 13.9
documents.summary: Indifference to the objects of the senses and also absence of egoism; perceiving the evil in birth, death, old age, sickness, and pain.
documents.searchText: bg.13.9 bg.13.9 chapter 13 verse 9 इनदरयरथष वरगयमनहङकर एव च जनममतयजरवयधदखदषनदरशनम 13.9 indriyartheshu vairagyam anahankara eva cha janma-mrityu-jara-vyadhi-duhkha-doshanudarshanam indifference to the objects of the senses and also absence of egoism perceiving the evil in birth death old age sickness and pain.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.13.9 bg.13.9 chapter 13 verse 9 इन्द्रियार्थेषु वैराग्यमनहङ्कार एव च।जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिदुःखदोषानुदर्शनम्।।13.9।। indriyārtheṣhu vairāgyam anahankāra eva cha
janma-mṛityu-jarā-vyādhi-duḥkha-doṣhānudarśhanam indifference to the objects of the senses and also absence of egoism; perceiving the evil in birth, death, old age, sickness, and pain.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.1
documents.sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाचपरं भूयः प्रवक्ष्यामि ज्ञानानां ज्ञानमुत्तमम्।यज्ज्ञात्वा मुनयः सर
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, "I will again declare to thee that supreme knowledge, the best of all knowledge, having known which all the sages have gone to supreme perfection after this
documents.searchText: bg.14.1 bg.14.1 chapter 14 verse 1 शर भगवनवचपर भय परवकषयम जञनन जञनमततमम यजजञतव मनय सरव पर सदधमत गत 14.1 shri-bhagavan uvacha param bhuyah pravakshyami jnananam jnanam uttamam yaj jnatva munayah sarve param siddhim ito gatah the blessed lord said i will again declare to thee that supreme knowledge the best of all knowledge having known which all the sages have gone to supreme perfection after this life.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.1 bg.14.1 chapter 14 verse 1 श्री भगवानुवाचपरं भूयः प्रवक्ष्यामि ज्ञानानां ज्ञानमुत्तमम्।यज्ज्ञात्वा मुनयः सर्वे परां सिद्धिमितो गताः।।14.1।। śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
paraṁ bhūyaḥ pravakṣhyāmi jñānānāṁ jñānam uttamam
yaj jñātvā munayaḥ sarve parāṁ siddhim ito gatāḥ the blessed lord said, "i will again declare to thee that supreme knowledge, the best of all knowledge, having known which all the sages have gone to supreme perfection after this life."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.10
documents.iast: rajas tamaśh chābhibhūya sattvaṁ bhavati bhārata
documents.sanskrit: रजस्तमश्चाभिभूय सत्त्वं भवति भारत।रजः सत्त्वं तमश्चैव तमः सत्त्वं रजस्तथा।।14.10
documents.summary: Now, O Arjuna, Sattva prevails, having overpowered Rajas and Tamas; then Rajas, having overpowered Sattva and Tamas; and then Tamas, having overpowered Sattva and Rajas.
documents.searchText: bg.14.10 bg.14.10 chapter 14 verse 10 रजसतमशचभभय सततव भवत भरत रज सततव तमशचव तम सततव रजसतथ 14.10 rajas tamash chabhibhuya sattvam bhavati bharata rajah sattvam tamash chaiva tamah sattvam rajas tatha now o arjuna sattva prevails having overpowered rajas and tamas then rajas having overpowered sattva and tamas and then tamas having overpowered sattva and rajas.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.10 bg.14.10 chapter 14 verse 10 रजस्तमश्चाभिभूय सत्त्वं भवति भारत।रजः सत्त्वं तमश्चैव तमः सत्त्वं रजस्तथा।।14.10।। rajas tamaśh chābhibhūya sattvaṁ bhavati bhārata
rajaḥ sattvaṁ tamaśh chaiva tamaḥ sattvaṁ rajas tathā now, o arjuna, sattva prevails, having overpowered rajas and tamas; then rajas, having overpowered sattva and tamas; and then tamas, having overpowered sattva and rajas.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.11
documents.sanskrit: सर्वद्वारेषु देहेऽस्मिन्प्रकाश उपजायते।ज्ञानं यदा तदा विद्याद्विवृद्धं सत्त्वमित
documents.summary: When the wisdom-light shines through every gate of this body, then it may be known that Sattva is predominant.
documents.searchText: bg.14.11 bg.14.11 chapter 14 verse 11 सरवदवरष दहऽसमनपरकश उपजयत जञन यद तद वदयदववदध सततवमतयत 14.11 sarva-dvareshu dehe smin prakasha upajayate jnanam yada tada vidyad vivriddham sattvam ity uta when the wisdom-light shines through every gate of this body then it may be known that sattva is predominant.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.11 bg.14.11 chapter 14 verse 11 सर्वद्वारेषु देहेऽस्मिन्प्रकाश उपजायते।ज्ञानं यदा तदा विद्याद्विवृद्धं सत्त्वमित्युत।।14.11।। sarva-dvāreṣhu dehe ’smin prakāśha upajāyate
jñānaṁ yadā tadā vidyād vivṛiddhaṁ sattvam ity uta when the wisdom-light shines through every gate of this body, then it may be known that sattva is predominant.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.12
documents.iast: lobhaḥ pravṛittir ārambhaḥ karmaṇām aśhamaḥ spṛihā
documents.sanskrit: लोभः प्रवृत्तिरारम्भः कर्मणामशमः स्पृहा।रजस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे भरतर्षभ।।14.
documents.summary: Greed, activity, the undertaking of actions, restlessness, and longing—these arise when Rajas is predominant, O Arjuna.
documents.searchText: bg.14.12 bg.14.12 chapter 14 verse 12 लभ परवततररमभ करमणमशम सपह रजसयतन जयनत ववदध भरतरषभ 14.12 lobhah pravrittir arambhah karmanam ashamah spriha rajasy etani jayante vivriddhe bharatarshabha greed activity the undertaking of actions restlessness and longing these arise when rajas is predominant o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.12 bg.14.12 chapter 14 verse 12 लोभः प्रवृत्तिरारम्भः कर्मणामशमः स्पृहा।रजस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे भरतर्षभ।।14.12।। lobhaḥ pravṛittir ārambhaḥ karmaṇām aśhamaḥ spṛihā
rajasy etāni jāyante vivṛiddhe bharatarṣhabha greed, activity, the undertaking of actions, restlessness, and longing—these arise when rajas is predominant, o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.13
documents.iast: aprakāśho ’pravṛittiśh cha pramādo moha eva cha
documents.sanskrit: अप्रकाशोऽप्रवृत्तिश्च प्रमादो मोह एव च।तमस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे कुरुनन्दन।।14
documents.summary: Darkness, inertia, carelessness, and delusion—these arise when Tamas is predominant, O Arjuna.
documents.searchText: bg.14.13 bg.14.13 chapter 14 verse 13 अपरकशऽपरवततशच परमद मह एव च तमसयतन जयनत ववदध करननदन 14.13 aprakasho pravrittish cha pramado moha eva cha tamasy etani jayante vivriddhe kuru-nandana darkness inertia carelessness and delusion these arise when tamas is predominant o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.13 bg.14.13 chapter 14 verse 13 अप्रकाशोऽप्रवृत्तिश्च प्रमादो मोह एव च।तमस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे कुरुनन्दन।।14.13।। aprakāśho ’pravṛittiśh cha pramādo moha eva cha
tamasy etāni jāyante vivṛiddhe kuru-nandana darkness, inertia, carelessness, and delusion—these arise when tamas is predominant, o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.14
documents.iast: yadā sattve pravṛiddhe tu pralayaṁ yāti deha-bhṛit
documents.sanskrit: यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत्।तदोत्तमविदां लोकानमलान्प्रतिपद्यते।
documents.summary: If the embodied one meets death when Sattva is predominant, then they attain the spotless worlds of the knowers of the Highest.
documents.searchText: bg.14.14 bg.14.14 chapter 14 verse 14 यद सततव परवदध त परलय यत दहभत तदततमवद लकनमलनपरतपदयत 14.14 yada sattve pravriddhe tu pralayam yati deha-bhrit tadottama-vidam lokan amalan pratipadyate if the embodied one meets death when sattva is predominant then they attain the spotless worlds of the knowers of the highest.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.14 bg.14.14 chapter 14 verse 14 यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत्।तदोत्तमविदां लोकानमलान्प्रतिपद्यते।।14.14।। yadā sattve pravṛiddhe tu pralayaṁ yāti deha-bhṛit
tadottama-vidāṁ lokān amalān pratipadyate if the embodied one meets death when sattva is predominant, then they attain the spotless worlds of the knowers of the highest.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.15
documents.sanskrit: रजसि प्रलयं गत्वा कर्मसङ्गिषु जायते।तथा प्रलीनस्तमसि मूढयोनिषु जायते।।14.15।।
documents.summary: Meeting death in Rajas, he is born among those who are attached to action; and dying in Tamas, he is born in the womb of the thoughtless.
documents.searchText: bg.14.15 bg.14.15 chapter 14 verse 15 रजस परलय गतव करमसङगष जयत तथ परलनसतमस मढयनष जयत 14.15 rajasi pralayam gatva karma-sangishu jayate tatha pralinas tamasi mudha-yonishu jayate meeting death in rajas he is born among those who are attached to action and dying in tamas he is born in the womb of the thoughtless.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.15 bg.14.15 chapter 14 verse 15 रजसि प्रलयं गत्वा कर्मसङ्गिषु जायते।तथा प्रलीनस्तमसि मूढयोनिषु जायते।।14.15।। rajasi pralayaṁ gatvā karma-saṅgiṣhu jāyate
tathā pralīnas tamasi mūḍha-yoniṣhu jāyate meeting death in rajas, he is born among those who are attached to action; and dying in tamas, he is born in the womb of the thoughtless.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.16
documents.sanskrit: कर्मणः सुकृतस्याहुः सात्त्विकं निर्मलं फलम्।रजसस्तु फलं दुःखमज्ञानं तमसः फलम्।।1
documents.summary: They say that the fruit of good action is Sattvic and pure; indeed, the fruit of Rajas is pain, and the fruit of Tamas is ignorance.
documents.searchText: bg.14.16 bg.14.16 chapter 14 verse 16 करमण सकतसयह सततवक नरमल फलम रजससत फल दखमजञन तमस फलम 14.16 karmanah sukritasyahuh sattvikam nirmalam phalam rajasas tu phalam duhkham ajnanam tamasah phalam they say that the fruit of good action is sattvic and pure indeed the fruit of rajas is pain and the fruit of tamas is ignorance.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.16 bg.14.16 chapter 14 verse 16 कर्मणः सुकृतस्याहुः सात्त्विकं निर्मलं फलम्।रजसस्तु फलं दुःखमज्ञानं तमसः फलम्।।14.16।। karmaṇaḥ sukṛitasyāhuḥ sāttvikaṁ nirmalaṁ phalam
rajasas tu phalaṁ duḥkham ajñānaṁ tamasaḥ phalam they say that the fruit of good action is sattvic and pure; indeed, the fruit of rajas is pain, and the fruit of tamas is ignorance.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.17
documents.iast: sattvāt sañjāyate jñānaṁ rajaso lobha eva cha
documents.sanskrit: सत्त्वात्सञ्जायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च।प्रमादमोहौ तमसो भवतोऽज्ञानमेव च।।14.17।।
documents.summary: From Sattva arises knowledge, and greed from Rajas; heedlessness and delusion arise from Tamas, and also ignorance.
documents.searchText: bg.14.17 bg.14.17 chapter 14 verse 17 सततवतसञजयत जञन रजस लभ एव च परमदमह तमस भवतऽजञनमव च 14.17 sattvat sanjayate jnanam rajaso lobha eva cha pramada-mohau tamaso bhavato jnanam eva cha from sattva arises knowledge and greed from rajas heedlessness and delusion arise from tamas and also ignorance.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.17 bg.14.17 chapter 14 verse 17 सत्त्वात्सञ्जायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च।प्रमादमोहौ तमसो भवतोऽज्ञानमेव च।।14.17।। sattvāt sañjāyate jñānaṁ rajaso lobha eva cha
pramāda-mohau tamaso bhavato ’jñānam eva cha from sattva arises knowledge, and greed from rajas; heedlessness and delusion arise from tamas, and also ignorance.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.18
documents.iast: ūrdhvaṁ gachchhanti sattva-sthā madhye tiṣhṭhanti rājasāḥ
documents.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः।जघन्यगुणवृत्तिस्था अधो गच्छन्
documents.summary: Those seated in Sattva ascend; those of Rajasic nature dwell in the middle; and those of Tamasic nature, abiding in the function of the lowest Guna, descend.
documents.searchText: bg.14.18 bg.14.18 chapter 14 verse 18 ऊरधव गचछनत सततवसथ मधय तषठनत रजस जघनयगणवततसथ अध गचछनत तमस 14.18 urdhvam gachchhanti sattva-stha madhye tishthanti rajasah jaghanya-guna-vritti-stha adho gachchhanti tamasah those seated in sattva ascend those of rajasic nature dwell in the middle and those of tamasic nature abiding in the function of the lowest guna descend.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.18 bg.14.18 chapter 14 verse 18 ऊर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः।जघन्यगुणवृत्तिस्था अधो गच्छन्ति तामसाः।।14.18।। ūrdhvaṁ gachchhanti sattva-sthā madhye tiṣhṭhanti rājasāḥ
jaghanya-guṇa-vṛitti-sthā adho gachchhanti tāmasāḥ those seated in sattva ascend; those of rajasic nature dwell in the middle; and those of tamasic nature, abiding in the function of the lowest guna, descend.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.19
documents.sanskrit: नान्यं गुणेभ्यः कर्तारं यदा द्रष्टानुपश्यति।गुणेभ्यश्च परं वेत्ति मद्भावं सोऽधिग
documents.summary: When the seer beholds no agent other than the Gunas and knows that which is higher than them, he attains to My Being.
documents.searchText: bg.14.19 bg.14.19 chapter 14 verse 19 ननय गणभय करतर यद दरषटनपशयत गणभयशच पर वतत मदभव सऽधगचछत 14.19 nanyam gunebhyah kartaram yada drashtanupashyati gunebhyash cha param vetti mad-bhavam so dhigachchhati when the seer beholds no agent other than the gunas and knows that which is higher than them he attains to my being.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.19 bg.14.19 chapter 14 verse 19 नान्यं गुणेभ्यः कर्तारं यदा द्रष्टानुपश्यति।गुणेभ्यश्च परं वेत्ति मद्भावं सोऽधिगच्छति।।14.19।। nānyaṁ guṇebhyaḥ kartāraṁ yadā draṣhṭānupaśhyati
guṇebhyaśh cha paraṁ vetti mad-bhāvaṁ so ’dhigachchhati when the seer beholds no agent other than the gunas and knows that which is higher than them, he attains to my being.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.2
documents.iast: idaṁ jñānam upāśhritya mama sādharmyam āgatāḥ
documents.sanskrit: इदं ज्ञानमुपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यमागताः।सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च।।
documents.summary: Those who, having taken refuge in this knowledge, have attained unity with Me, are neither born at the time of creation nor disturbed at the time of dissolution.
documents.searchText: bg.14.2 bg.14.2 chapter 14 verse 2 इद जञनमपशरतय मम सधरमयमगत सरगऽप नपजयनत परलय न वयथनत च 14.2 idam jnanam upashritya mama sadharmyam agatah sarge pi nopajayante pralaye na vyathanti cha those who having taken refuge in this knowledge have attained unity with me are neither born at the time of creation nor disturbed at the time of dissolution.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.2 bg.14.2 chapter 14 verse 2 इदं ज्ञानमुपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यमागताः।सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च।।14.2।। idaṁ jñānam upāśhritya mama sādharmyam āgatāḥ
sarge ’pi nopajāyante pralaye na vyathanti cha those who, having taken refuge in this knowledge, have attained unity with me, are neither born at the time of creation nor disturbed at the time of dissolution.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.20
documents.iast: guṇān etān atītya trīn dehī deha-samudbhavān
documents.summary: The embodied one, having crossed beyond these three Gunas from which the body is evolved, is freed from birth, death, decay, and pain, and attains immortality.
documents.searchText: bg.14.20 bg.14.20 chapter 14 verse 20 गणनतनततय तरनदह दहसमदभवन जनममतयजरदखरवमकतऽमतमशनत 14.20 gunan etan atitya trin dehi deha-samudbhavan janma-mrityu-jara-duhkhair vimukto mritam ashnute the embodied one having crossed beyond these three gunas from which the body is evolved is freed from birth death decay and pain and attains immortality.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.20 bg.14.20 chapter 14 verse 20 गुणानेतानतीत्य त्रीन्देही देहसमुद्भवान्।जन्ममृत्युजरादुःखैर्विमुक्तोऽमृतमश्नुते।।14.20।। guṇān etān atītya trīn dehī deha-samudbhavān
janma-mṛityu-jarā-duḥkhair vimukto ’mṛitam aśhnute the embodied one, having crossed beyond these three gunas from which the body is evolved, is freed from birth, death, decay, and pain, and attains immortality.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.21
documents.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाचकैर्लिंगैस्त्रीन्गुणानेतानतीतो भवति प्रभो।किमाचारः कथं चैतांस्त्रीन्ग
documents.summary: Arjuna said, "What are the marks of one who has transcended the three qualities, O Lord? What is their conduct, and how do they go beyond these three qualities?"
documents.searchText: bg.14.21 bg.14.21 chapter 14 verse 21 अरजन उवचकरलगसतरनगणनतनतत भवत परभ कमचर कथ चतसतरनगणनतवरतत 14.21 arjuna uvacha kair lingais trin gunan etan atito bhavati prabho kim acharah katham chaitans trin gunan ativartate arjuna said what are the marks of one who has transcended the three qualities o lord what is their conduct and how do they go beyond these three qualities
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.21 bg.14.21 chapter 14 verse 21 अर्जुन उवाचकैर्लिंगैस्त्रीन्गुणानेतानतीतो भवति प्रभो।किमाचारः कथं चैतांस्त्रीन्गुणानतिवर्तते।।14.21।। arjuna uvācha
kair liṅgais trīn guṇān etān atīto bhavati prabho
kim āchāraḥ kathaṁ chaitāns trīn guṇān ativartate arjuna said, "what are the marks of one who has transcended the three qualities, o lord? what is their conduct, and how do they go beyond these three qualities?"

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.22
documents.sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाचप्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव।न द्वेष्टि सम्प्रवृत्तानि न
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, "When light, activity, and delusion are present, he does not hate them, nor does he long for them when they are absent.
documents.searchText: bg.14.22 bg.14.22 chapter 14 verse 22 शर भगवनवचपरकश च परवतत च महमव च पणडव न दवषट समपरवततन न नवततन कङकषत 14.22 shri-bhagavan uvacha prakasham cha pravrittim cha moham eva cha pandava na dveshti sampravrittani na nivrittani kankshati the blessed lord said when light activity and delusion are present he does not hate them nor does he long for them when they are absent.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.22 bg.14.22 chapter 14 verse 22 श्री भगवानुवाचप्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव।न द्वेष्टि सम्प्रवृत्तानि न निवृत्तानि काङ्क्षति।।14.22।। śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
prakāśhaṁ cha pravṛittiṁ cha moham eva cha pāṇḍava
na dveṣhṭi sampravṛittāni na nivṛittāni kāṅkṣhati the blessed lord said, "when light, activity, and delusion are present, he does not hate them, nor does he long for them when they are absent.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.23
documents.iast: udāsīna-vad āsīno guṇair yo na vichālyate
documents.sanskrit: उदासीनवदासीनो गुणैर्यो न विचाल्यते।गुणा वर्तन्त इत्येव योऽवतिष्ठति नेङ्गते।।14.2
documents.summary: He who, seated like one unconcerned, is not moved by the dualities, and who, knowing that the dualities are active, is self-centered and does not move.
documents.searchText: bg.14.23 bg.14.23 chapter 14 verse 23 उदसनवदसन गणरय न वचलयत गण वरतनत इतयव यऽवतषठत नङगत 14.23 udasina-vad asino gunair yo na vichalyate guna vartanta ity evam yo vatishthati nengate he who seated like one unconcerned is not moved by the dualities and who knowing that the dualities are active is self-centered and does not move.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.23 bg.14.23 chapter 14 verse 23 उदासीनवदासीनो गुणैर्यो न विचाल्यते।गुणा वर्तन्त इत्येव योऽवतिष्ठति नेङ्गते।।14.23।। udāsīna-vad āsīno guṇair yo na vichālyate
guṇā vartanta ity evaṁ yo ’vatiṣhṭhati neṅgate he who, seated like one unconcerned, is not moved by the dualities, and who, knowing that the dualities are active, is self-centered and does not move.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.24
documents.summary: Who is the same in pleasure and pain, who dwells in the Self, to whom a clod of earth, a stone, and gold are all alike, who is the same to the dear and the unfriendly, who is firm,
documents.searchText: bg.14.24 bg.14.24 chapter 14 verse 24 समदखसख सवसथ समलषटशमकञचन तलयपरयपरय धरसतलयननदतमससतत 14.24 sama-duhkha-sukhah sva-sthah sama-loshtashma-kanchanah tulya-priyapriyo dhiras tulya-nindatma-sanstutih who is the same in pleasure and pain who dwells in the self to whom a clod of earth a stone and gold are all alike who is the same to the dear and the unfriendly who is firm and to whom censure and praise are one and the same.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.24 bg.14.24 chapter 14 verse 24 समदुःखसुखः स्वस्थः समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः।तुल्यप्रियाप्रियो धीरस्तुल्यनिन्दात्मसंस्तुतिः।।14.24।। sama-duḥkha-sukhaḥ sva-sthaḥ sama-loṣhṭāśhma-kāñchanaḥ
tulya-priyāpriyo dhīras tulya-nindātma-sanstutiḥ who is the same in pleasure and pain, who dwells in the self, to whom a clod of earth, a stone, and gold are all alike, who is the same to the dear and the unfriendly, who is firm, and to whom censure and praise are one and the same.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.25
documents.summary: Who is the same in honor and dishonor, the same to friend and foe, abandoning all undertakings, he is said to have transcended the dualities.
documents.searchText: bg.14.25 bg.14.25 chapter 14 verse 25 मनपमनयसतलयसतलय मतररपकषय सरवरमभपरतयग गणतत स उचयत 14.25 manapamanayos tulyas tulyo mitrari-pakshayoh sarvarambha-parityagi gunatitah sa uchyate who is the same in honor and dishonor the same to friend and foe abandoning all undertakings he is said to have transcended the dualities.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.25 bg.14.25 chapter 14 verse 25 मानापमानयोस्तुल्यस्तुल्यो मित्रारिपक्षयोः।सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी गुणातीतः स उच्यते।।14.25।। mānāpamānayos tulyas tulyo mitrāri-pakṣhayoḥ
sarvārambha-parityāgī guṇātītaḥ sa uchyate who is the same in honor and dishonor, the same to friend and foe, abandoning all undertakings, he is said to have transcended the dualities.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.26
documents.sanskrit: मां च योऽव्यभिचारेण भक्तियोगेन सेवते।स गुणान्समतीत्यैतान् ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते।।14
documents.summary: And he who serves Me with unwavering devotion, he, crossing beyond the dualities, is fit for becoming Brahman.
documents.searchText: bg.14.26 bg.14.26 chapter 14 verse 26 म च यऽवयभचरण भकतयगन सवत स गणनसमततयतन बरहमभयय कलपत 14.26 mam cha yo vyabhicharena bhakti-yogena sevate sa gunan samatityaitan brahma-bhuyaya kalpate and he who serves me with unwavering devotion he crossing beyond the dualities is fit for becoming brahman.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.26 bg.14.26 chapter 14 verse 26 मां च योऽव्यभिचारेण भक्तियोगेन सेवते।स गुणान्समतीत्यैतान् ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते।।14.26।। māṁ cha yo ’vyabhichāreṇa bhakti-yogena sevate
sa guṇān samatītyaitān brahma-bhūyāya kalpate and he who serves me with unwavering devotion, he, crossing beyond the dualities, is fit for becoming brahman.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.27
documents.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणो हि प्रतिष्ठाऽहममृतस्याव्ययस्य च।शाश्वतस्य च धर्मस्य सुखस्यैकान्तिकस्य च
documents.summary: For I am the abode of Brahman, the immortal, immutable, and everlasting Dharma, and absolute bliss.
documents.searchText: bg.14.27 bg.14.27 chapter 14 verse 27 बरहमण ह परतषठऽहममतसयवययसय च शशवतसय च धरमसय सखसयकनतकसय च 14.27 brahmano hi pratishthaham amritasyavyayasya cha shashvatasya cha dharmasya sukhasyaikantikasya cha for i am the abode of brahman the immortal immutable and everlasting dharma and absolute bliss.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.27 bg.14.27 chapter 14 verse 27 ब्रह्मणो हि प्रतिष्ठाऽहममृतस्याव्ययस्य च।शाश्वतस्य च धर्मस्य सुखस्यैकान्तिकस्य च।।14.27।। brahmaṇo hi pratiṣhṭhāham amṛitasyāvyayasya cha
śhāśhvatasya cha dharmasya sukhasyaikāntikasya cha for i am the abode of brahman, the immortal, immutable, and everlasting dharma, and absolute bliss.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.3
documents.iast: mama yonir mahad brahma tasmin garbhaṁ dadhāmy aham
documents.sanskrit: मम योनिर्महद्ब्रह्म तस्मिन् गर्भं दधाम्यहम्।संभवः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवति भारत।।14.
documents.summary: My womb is the great Brahma; in it I place the germ; thence, O Arjuna, is the birth of all beings.
documents.searchText: bg.14.3 bg.14.3 chapter 14 verse 3 मम यनरमहदबरहम तसमन गरभ दधमयहम सभव सरवभतन तत भवत भरत 14.3 mama yonir mahad brahma tasmin garbham dadhamy aham sambhavah sarva-bhutanam tato bhavati bharata my womb is the great brahma in it i place the germ thence o arjuna is the birth of all beings.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.3 bg.14.3 chapter 14 verse 3 मम योनिर्महद्ब्रह्म तस्मिन् गर्भं दधाम्यहम्।संभवः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवति भारत।।14.3।। mama yonir mahad brahma tasmin garbhaṁ dadhāmy aham
sambhavaḥ sarva-bhūtānāṁ tato bhavati bhārata my womb is the great brahma; in it i place the germ; thence, o arjuna, is the birth of all beings.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.4
documents.sanskrit: सर्वयोनिषु कौन्तेय मूर्तयः सम्भवन्ति याः।तासां ब्रह्म महद्योनिरहं बीजप्रदः पिता।
documents.summary: Whatever forms are produced, O Arjuna, in any womb whatsoever, the great Brahma is their womb, and I am the seed-giving father.
documents.searchText: bg.14.4 bg.14.4 chapter 14 verse 4 सरवयनष कनतय मरतय समभवनत य तस बरहम महदयनरह बजपरद पत 14.4 sarva-yonishu kaunteya murtayah sambhavanti yah tasam brahma mahad yonir aham bija-pradah pita whatever forms are produced o arjuna in any womb whatsoever the great brahma is their womb and i am the seed-giving father.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.4 bg.14.4 chapter 14 verse 4 सर्वयोनिषु कौन्तेय मूर्तयः सम्भवन्ति याः।तासां ब्रह्म महद्योनिरहं बीजप्रदः पिता।।14.4।। sarva-yoniṣhu kaunteya mūrtayaḥ sambhavanti yāḥ
tāsāṁ brahma mahad yonir ahaṁ bīja-pradaḥ pitā whatever forms are produced, o arjuna, in any womb whatsoever, the great brahma is their womb, and i am the seed-giving father.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.5
documents.iast: sattvaṁ rajas tama iti guṇāḥ prakṛiti-sambhavāḥ
documents.sanskrit: सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसंभवाः।निबध्नन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम्।।14.
documents.summary: These qualities, O Arjuna, born of Nature, bind fast in the body of the embodied, the indestructible: purity, passion, and inertia.
documents.searchText: bg.14.5 bg.14.5 chapter 14 verse 5 सततव रजसतम इत गण परकतसभव नबधननत महबह दह दहनमवययम 14.5 sattvam rajas tama iti gunah prakriti-sambhavah nibadhnanti maha-baho dehe dehinam avyayam these qualities o arjuna born of nature bind fast in the body of the embodied the indestructible purity passion and inertia.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.5 bg.14.5 chapter 14 verse 5 सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसंभवाः।निबध्नन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम्।।14.5।। sattvaṁ rajas tama iti guṇāḥ prakṛiti-sambhavāḥ
nibadhnanti mahā-bāho dehe dehinam avyayam these qualities, o arjuna, born of nature, bind fast in the body of the embodied, the indestructible: purity, passion, and inertia.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.6
documents.sanskrit: तत्र सत्त्वं निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकमनामयम्।सुखसङ्गेन बध्नाति ज्ञानसङ्गेन चानघ।।14.6
documents.summary: Of these, sattva, which is luminous and healthy due to its stainlessness, binds one by attachment to happiness and knowledge, O sinless one.
documents.searchText: bg.14.6 bg.14.6 chapter 14 verse 6 ततर सततव नरमलतवतपरकशकमनमयम सखसङगन बधनत जञनसङगन चनघ 14.6 tatra sattvam nirmalatvat prakashakam anamayam sukha-sangena badhnati jnana-sangena chanagha of these sattva which is luminous and healthy due to its stainlessness binds one by attachment to happiness and knowledge o sinless one.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.6 bg.14.6 chapter 14 verse 6 तत्र सत्त्वं निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकमनामयम्।सुखसङ्गेन बध्नाति ज्ञानसङ्गेन चानघ।।14.6।। tatra sattvaṁ nirmalatvāt prakāśhakam anāmayam
sukha-saṅgena badhnāti jñāna-saṅgena chānagha of these, sattva, which is luminous and healthy due to its stainlessness, binds one by attachment to happiness and knowledge, o sinless one.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.7
documents.sanskrit: रजो रागात्मकं विद्धि तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम्।तन्निबध्नाति कौन्तेय कर्मसङ्गेन देहिनम्
documents.summary: Know, O Arjuna, that Rajas is of the nature of passion, the source of thirst and attachment; it binds fast the embodied one by attachment to action.
documents.searchText: bg.14.7 bg.14.7 chapter 14 verse 7 रज रगतमक वदध तषणसङगसमदभवम तननबधनत कनतय करमसङगन दहनम 14.7 rajo ragatmakam viddhi trishna-sanga-samudbhavam tan nibadhnati kaunteya karma-sangena dehinam know o arjuna that rajas is of the nature of passion the source of thirst and attachment it binds fast the embodied one by attachment to action.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.7 bg.14.7 chapter 14 verse 7 रजो रागात्मकं विद्धि तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम्।तन्निबध्नाति कौन्तेय कर्मसङ्गेन देहिनम्।।14.7।। rajo rāgātmakaṁ viddhi tṛiṣhṇā-saṅga-samudbhavam
tan nibadhnāti kaunteya karma-saṅgena dehinam know, o arjuna, that rajas is of the nature of passion, the source of thirst and attachment; it binds fast the embodied one by attachment to action.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.8
documents.iast: tamas tv ajñāna-jaṁ viddhi mohanaṁ sarva-dehinām
documents.summary: But know thou Tamas to be born of ignorance, deluding all embodied beings; it binds fast, O Arjuna, through heedlessness, indolence, and sleep.
documents.searchText: bg.14.8 bg.14.8 chapter 14 verse 8 तमसतवजञनज वदध महन सरवदहनम परमदलसयनदरभसतननबधनत भरत 14.8 tamas tv ajnana-jam viddhi mohanam sarva-dehinam pramadalasya-nidrabhis tan nibadhnati bharata but know thou tamas to be born of ignorance deluding all embodied beings it binds fast o arjuna through heedlessness indolence and sleep.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.8 bg.14.8 chapter 14 verse 8 तमस्त्वज्ञानजं विद्धि मोहनं सर्वदेहिनाम्।प्रमादालस्यनिद्राभिस्तन्निबध्नाति भारत।।14.8।। tamas tv ajñāna-jaṁ viddhi mohanaṁ sarva-dehinām
pramādālasya-nidrābhis tan nibadhnāti bhārata but know thou tamas to be born of ignorance, deluding all embodied beings; it binds fast, o arjuna, through heedlessness, indolence, and sleep.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 14.9
documents.iast: sattvaṁ sukhe sañjayati rajaḥ karmaṇi bhārata
documents.sanskrit: सत्त्वं सुखे सञ्जयति रजः कर्मणि भारत।ज्ञानमावृत्य तु तमः प्रमादे सञ्जयत्युत।।14.
documents.summary: Sattva attaches to happiness, Rajas to action, O Arjuna, while Tamas, verily shrouding knowledge, attaches to heedlessness.
documents.searchText: bg.14.9 bg.14.9 chapter 14 verse 9 सततव सख सञजयत रज करमण भरत जञनमवतय त तम परमद सञजयतयत 14.9 sattvam sukhe sanjayati rajah karmani bharata jnanam avritya tu tamah pramade sanjayaty uta sattva attaches to happiness rajas to action o arjuna while tamas verily shrouding knowledge attaches to heedlessness.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.14.9 bg.14.9 chapter 14 verse 9 सत्त्वं सुखे सञ्जयति रजः कर्मणि भारत।ज्ञानमावृत्य तु तमः प्रमादे सञ्जयत्युत।।14.9।। sattvaṁ sukhe sañjayati rajaḥ karmaṇi bhārata
jñānam āvṛitya tu tamaḥ pramāde sañjayaty uta sattva attaches to happiness, rajas to action, o arjuna, while tamas, verily shrouding knowledge, attaches to heedlessness.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 15.1
documents.sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाचऊर्ध्वमूलमधःशाखमश्वत्थं प्राहुरव्ययम्।छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said: They (the wise) speak of the indestructible peepul tree, with its roots above and branches below, whose leaves are the meters or hymns; he who knows it is a
documents.searchText: bg.15.1 bg.15.1 chapter 15 verse 1 शर भगवनवचऊरधवमलमधशखमशवतथ परहरवययम छनदस यसय परणन यसत वद स वदवत 15.1 shri-bhagavan uvacha urdhva-mulam adhah-shakham ashvattham prahur avyayam chhandansi yasya parnani yas tam veda sa veda-vit the blessed lord said they the wise speak of the indestructible peepul tree with its roots above and branches below whose leaves are the meters or hymns he who knows it is a knower of the vedas.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.15.1 bg.15.1 chapter 15 verse 1 श्री भगवानुवाचऊर्ध्वमूलमधःशाखमश्वत्थं प्राहुरव्ययम्।छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित्।।15.1।। śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
ūrdhva-mūlam adhaḥ-śhākham aśhvatthaṁ prāhur avyayam
chhandānsi yasya parṇāni yas taṁ veda sa veda-vit the blessed lord said: they (the wise) speak of the indestructible peepul tree, with its roots above and branches below, whose leaves are the meters or hymns; he who knows it is a knower of the vedas.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 15.10
documents.iast: utkrāmantaṁ sthitaṁ vāpi bhuñjānaṁ vā guṇānvitam
documents.sanskrit: उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितं वापि भुञ्जानं वा गुणान्वितम्।विमूढा नानुपश्यन्ति पश्यन्ति ज्
documents.summary: The deluded do not see Him who departs, stays, and enjoys; but those who possess the eye of knowledge behold Him.
documents.searchText: bg.15.10 bg.15.10 chapter 15 verse 10 उतकरमनत सथत वप भञजन व गणनवतम वमढ ननपशयनत पशयनत जञनचकषष 15.10 utkramantam sthitam vapi bhunjanam va gunanvitam vimudha nanupashyanti pashyanti jnana-chakshushah the deluded do not see him who departs stays and enjoys but those who possess the eye of knowledge behold him.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.15.10 bg.15.10 chapter 15 verse 10 उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितं वापि भुञ्जानं वा गुणान्वितम्।विमूढा नानुपश्यन्ति पश्यन्ति ज्ञानचक्षुषः।।15.10।। utkrāmantaṁ sthitaṁ vāpi bhuñjānaṁ vā guṇānvitam
vimūḍhā nānupaśhyanti paśhyanti jñāna-chakṣhuṣhaḥ the deluded do not see him who departs, stays, and enjoys; but those who possess the eye of knowledge behold him.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 15.11
documents.iast: yatanto yoginaśh chainaṁ paśhyanty ātmany avasthitam
documents.summary: The yogis striving for perfection behold Him dwelling in the Self; but, the unrefined and unintelligent, even though striving, do not see Him.
documents.searchText: bg.15.11 bg.15.11 chapter 15 verse 11 यतनत यगनशचन पशयनतयतमनयवसथतम यतनतऽपयकततमन नन पशयनतयचतस 15.11 yatanto yoginash chainam pashyanty atmany avasthitam yatanto py akritatmano nainam pashyanty achetasah the yogis striving for perfection behold him dwelling in the self but the unrefined and unintelligent even though striving do not see him.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.15.11 bg.15.11 chapter 15 verse 11 यतन्तो योगिनश्चैनं पश्यन्त्यात्मन्यवस्थितम्।यतन्तोऽप्यकृतात्मानो नैनं पश्यन्त्यचेतसः।।15.11।। yatanto yoginaśh chainaṁ paśhyanty ātmany avasthitam
yatanto ‘py akṛitātmāno nainaṁ paśhyanty achetasaḥ the yogis striving for perfection behold him dwelling in the self; but, the unrefined and unintelligent, even though striving, do not see him.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 15.12
documents.sanskrit: यदादित्यगतं तेजो जगद्भासयतेऽखिलम्।यच्चन्द्रमसि यच्चाग्नौ तत्तेजो विद्धि मामकम्।।
documents.summary: That light which resides in the sun, illuminating the whole world; that which is in the moon and in the fire—know that light to be Mine.
documents.searchText: bg.15.12 bg.15.12 chapter 15 verse 12 यददतयगत तज जगदभसयतऽखलम यचचनदरमस यचचगन तततज वदध ममकम 15.12 yad aditya-gatam tejo jagad bhasayate khilam yach chandramasi yach chagnau tat tejo viddhi mamakam that light which resides in the sun illuminating the whole world that which is in the moon and in the fire know that light to be mine.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.15.12 bg.15.12 chapter 15 verse 12 यदादित्यगतं तेजो जगद्भासयतेऽखिलम्।यच्चन्द्रमसि यच्चाग्नौ तत्तेजो विद्धि मामकम्।।15.12।। yad āditya-gataṁ tejo jagad bhāsayate ’khilam
