yach chandramasi yach chāgnau tat tejo viddhi māmakam that light which resides in the sun, illuminating the whole world; that which is in the moon and in the fire—know that light to be mine.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 15.13
documents.iast: gām āviśhya cha bhūtāni dhārayāmy aham ojasā
documents.sanskrit: गामाविश्य च भूतानि धारयाम्यहमोजसा।पुष्णामि चौषधीः सर्वाः सोमो भूत्वा रसात्मकः।।1
documents.summary: Permeating the earth, I support all beings with My energy; and having become the watery moon, I nourish all herbs.
documents.searchText: bg.15.13 bg.15.13 chapter 15 verse 13 गमवशय च भतन धरयमयहमजस पषणम चषध सरव सम भतव रसतमक 15.13 gam avishya cha bhutani dharayamy aham ojasa pushnami chaushadhih sarvah somo bhutva rasatmakah permeating the earth i support all beings with my energy and having become the watery moon i nourish all herbs.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.15.13 bg.15.13 chapter 15 verse 13 गामाविश्य च भूतानि धारयाम्यहमोजसा।पुष्णामि चौषधीः सर्वाः सोमो भूत्वा रसात्मकः।।15.13।। gām āviśhya cha bhūtāni dhārayāmy aham ojasā
puṣhṇāmi chauṣhadhīḥ sarvāḥ somo bhūtvā rasātmakaḥ permeating the earth, i support all beings with my energy; and having become the watery moon, i nourish all herbs.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 15.14
documents.iast: ahaṁ vaiśhvānaro bhūtvā prāṇināṁ deham āśhritaḥ
documents.sanskrit: अहं वैश्वानरो भूत्वा प्राणिनां देहमाश्रितः।प्राणापानसमायुक्तः पचाम्यन्नं चतुर्वि
documents.summary: Having become the fire Vaisvanara, I abide in the bodies of living beings and, associated with the Prana and the Apana, digest the fourfold food.
documents.searchText: bg.15.14 bg.15.14 chapter 15 verse 14 अह वशवनर भतव परणन दहमशरत परणपनसमयकत पचमयनन चतरवधम 15.14 aham vaishvanaro bhutva praninam deham ashritah pranapana-samayuktah pachamy annam chatur-vidham having become the fire vaisvanara i abide in the bodies of living beings and associated with the prana and the apana digest the fourfold food.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.15.14 bg.15.14 chapter 15 verse 14 अहं वैश्वानरो भूत्वा प्राणिनां देहमाश्रितः।प्राणापानसमायुक्तः पचाम्यन्नं चतुर्विधम्।।15.14।। ahaṁ vaiśhvānaro bhūtvā prāṇināṁ deham āśhritaḥ
prāṇāpāna-samāyuktaḥ pachāmy annaṁ chatur-vidham having become the fire vaisvanara, i abide in the bodies of living beings and, associated with the prana and the apana, digest the fourfold food.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 15.15
documents.sanskrit: सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि सन्निविष्टो    मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनं च।वेदैश्च सर्वैरहमेव
documents.summary: And I am seated in the hearts of all; from Me come memory and knowledge, as well as their absence. I am verily That which has to be known by all the Vedas; I am indeed the author o
documents.searchText: bg.15.15 bg.15.15 chapter 15 verse 15 सरवसय चह हद सननवषट मतत समतरजञनमपहन च वदशच सरवरहमव वदय वदनतकदवदवदव चहम 15.15 sarvasya chaham hridi sannivishto mattah smritir jnanam apohanam cha vedaish cha sarvair aham eva vedyo vedanta-krid veda-vid eva chaham and i am seated in the hearts of all from me come memory and knowledge as well as their absence. i am verily that which has to be known by all the vedas i am indeed the author of the vedanta and the knower of the vedas.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.15.15 bg.15.15 chapter 15 verse 15 सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि सन्निविष्टो    मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनं च।वेदैश्च सर्वैरहमेव वेद्यो    वेदान्तकृद्वेदविदेव चाहम्।।15.15।। sarvasya chāhaṁ hṛidi sanniviṣhṭo

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 15.16
documents.iast: dvāv imau puruṣhau loke kṣharaśh chākṣhara eva cha
documents.sanskrit: द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च।क्षरः सर्वाणि भूतानि कूटस्थोऽक्षर उच्यते।
documents.summary: Two Purushas there are in this world: the perishable and the imperishable. All beings are perishable, and the Kutastha—the unchanging—is called the imperishable.
documents.searchText: bg.15.16 bg.15.16 chapter 15 verse 16 दववम परष लक कषरशचकषर एव च कषर सरवण भतन कटसथऽकषर उचयत 15.16 dvav imau purushau loke ksharash chakshara eva cha ksharah sarvani bhutani kuta-stho kshara uchyate two purushas there are in this world the perishable and the imperishable. all beings are perishable and the kutastha the unchanging is called the imperishable.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.15.16 bg.15.16 chapter 15 verse 16 द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च।क्षरः सर्वाणि भूतानि कूटस्थोऽक्षर उच्यते।।15.16।। dvāv imau puruṣhau loke kṣharaśh chākṣhara eva cha
kṣharaḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni kūṭa-stho ’kṣhara uchyate two purushas there are in this world: the perishable and the imperishable. all beings are perishable, and the kutastha—the unchanging—is called the imperishable.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 15.17
documents.iast: uttamaḥ puruṣhas tv anyaḥ paramātmety udāhṛitaḥ
documents.sanskrit: उत्तमः पुरुषस्त्वन्यः परमात्मेत्युदाहृतः।यो लोकत्रयमाविश्य बिभर्त्यव्यय ईश्वरः।।
documents.summary: But distinct is the Supreme Purusha, called the highest Self, indestructible and Lord, who pervades the three worlds and sustains them.
documents.searchText: bg.15.17 bg.15.17 chapter 15 verse 17 उततम परषसतवनय परमतमतयदहत य लकतरयमवशय बभरतयवयय ईशवर 15.17 uttamah purushas tv anyah paramatmety udahritah yo loka-trayam avishya bibharty avyaya ishvarah but distinct is the supreme purusha called the highest self indestructible and lord who pervades the three worlds and sustains them.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.15.17 bg.15.17 chapter 15 verse 17 उत्तमः पुरुषस्त्वन्यः परमात्मेत्युदाहृतः।यो लोकत्रयमाविश्य बिभर्त्यव्यय ईश्वरः।।15.17।। uttamaḥ puruṣhas tv anyaḥ paramātmety udāhṛitaḥ
yo loka-trayam āviśhya bibharty avyaya īśhvaraḥ but distinct is the supreme purusha, called the highest self, indestructible and lord, who pervades the three worlds and sustains them.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 15.18
documents.iast: yasmāt kṣharam atīto ’ham akṣharād api chottamaḥ
documents.sanskrit: यस्मात्क्षरमतीतोऽहमक्षरादपि चोत्तमः।अतोऽस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः।।15
documents.summary: As I transcend the perishable and am even higher than the imperishable, I am declared to be the highest Purusha in the world and in the Vedas.
documents.searchText: bg.15.18 bg.15.18 chapter 15 verse 18 यसमतकषरमततऽहमकषरदप चततम अतऽसम लक वद च परथत परषततम 15.18 yasmat ksharam atito ham aksharad api chottamah ato smi loke vede cha prathitah purushottamah as i transcend the perishable and am even higher than the imperishable i am declared to be the highest purusha in the world and in the vedas.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.15.18 bg.15.18 chapter 15 verse 18 यस्मात्क्षरमतीतोऽहमक्षरादपि चोत्तमः।अतोऽस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः।।15.18।। yasmāt kṣharam atīto ’ham akṣharād api chottamaḥ
ato ’smi loke vede cha prathitaḥ puruṣhottamaḥ as i transcend the perishable and am even higher than the imperishable, i am declared to be the highest purusha in the world and in the vedas.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 15.19
documents.iast: yo mām evam asammūḍho jānāti puruṣhottamam
documents.sanskrit: यो मामेवमसम्मूढो जानाति पुरुषोत्तमम्।स सर्वविद्भजति मां सर्वभावेन भारत।।15.19।।
documents.summary: He who, undeluded, knows Me as the highest Purusha, he, knowing all, worships Me with his whole being (heart), O Arjuna.
documents.searchText: bg.15.19 bg.15.19 chapter 15 verse 19 य ममवमसममढ जनत परषततमम स सरववदभजत म सरवभवन भरत 15.19 yo mam evam asammudho janati purushottamam sa sarva-vid bhajati mam sarva-bhavena bharata he who undeluded knows me as the highest purusha he knowing all worships me with his whole being heart o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.15.19 bg.15.19 chapter 15 verse 19 यो मामेवमसम्मूढो जानाति पुरुषोत्तमम्।स सर्वविद्भजति मां सर्वभावेन भारत।।15.19।। yo mām evam asammūḍho jānāti puruṣhottamam
sa sarva-vid bhajati māṁ sarva-bhāvena bhārata he who, undeluded, knows me as the highest purusha, he, knowing all, worships me with his whole being (heart), o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 15.2
documents.sanskrit: अधश्चोर्ध्वं प्रसृतास्तस्य शाखा     गुणप्रवृद्धा विषयप्रवालाः।अधश्च मूलान्यनुसन्
documents.summary: Its branches spread below and above, nourished by the Gunas; its buds are sense-objects, and its roots stretch forth below in the world of men, originating action.
documents.searchText: bg.15.2 bg.15.2 chapter 15 verse 2 अधशचरधव परसतसतसय शख गणपरवदध वषयपरवल अधशच मलनयनसनततन करमनबनधन मनषयलक 15.2 adhash chordhvam prasritas tasya shakha guna-pravriddha vishaya-pravalah adhash cha mulany anusantatani karmanubandhini manushya-loke its branches spread below and above nourished by the gunas its buds are sense-objects and its roots stretch forth below in the world of men originating action.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.15.2 bg.15.2 chapter 15 verse 2 अधश्चोर्ध्वं प्रसृतास्तस्य शाखा     गुणप्रवृद्धा विषयप्रवालाः।अधश्च मूलान्यनुसन्ततानि     कर्मानुबन्धीनि मनुष्यलोके।।15.2।। adhaśh chordhvaṁ prasṛitās tasya śhākhā
guṇa-pravṛiddhā viṣhaya-pravālāḥ
adhaśh cha mūlāny anusantatāni
karmānubandhīni manuṣhya-loke its branches spread below and above, nourished by the gunas; its buds are sense-objects, and its roots stretch forth below in the world of men, originating action.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 15.20
documents.iast: iti guhyatamaṁ śhāstram idam uktaṁ mayānagha
documents.sanskrit: इति गुह्यतमं शास्त्रमिदमुक्तं मयाऽनघ।एतद्बुद्ध्वा बुद्धिमान्स्यात्कृतकृत्यश्च भा
documents.summary: Thus, I have imparted to you this most secret science, O sinless one; by knowing this, one becomes wise, and all their duties are accomplished, O Arjuna.
documents.searchText: bg.15.20 bg.15.20 chapter 15 verse 20 इत गहयतम शसतरमदमकत मयऽनघ एतदबदधव बदधमनसयतकतकतयशच भरत 15.20 iti guhyatamam shastram idam uktam mayanagha etad buddhva buddhiman syat krita-krityash cha bharata thus i have imparted to you this most secret science o sinless one by knowing this one becomes wise and all their duties are accomplished o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.15.20 bg.15.20 chapter 15 verse 20 इति गुह्यतमं शास्त्रमिदमुक्तं मयाऽनघ।एतद्बुद्ध्वा बुद्धिमान्स्यात्कृतकृत्यश्च भारत।।15.20।। iti guhyatamaṁ śhāstram idam uktaṁ mayānagha
etad buddhvā buddhimān syāt kṛita-kṛityaśh cha bhārata thus, i have imparted to you this most secret science, o sinless one; by knowing this, one becomes wise, and all their duties are accomplished, o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 15.3
documents.sanskrit: न रूपमस्येह तथोपलभ्यते    नान्तो न चादिर्न च संप्रतिष्ठा।अश्वत्थमेनं सुविरूढमूल
documents.summary: Its form is not perceived here as such, nor its end, origin, foundation, or resting place; having cut asunder this firmly rooted peepul tree with the strong axe of non-attachment.
documents.searchText: bg.15.3 bg.15.3 chapter 15 verse 3 न रपमसयह तथपलभयत ननत न चदरन च सपरतषठ अशवतथमन सवरढमल मसङगशसतरण दढन छततव 15.3 na rupam asyeha tathopalabhyate nanto na chadir na cha sampratishtha ashvattham enam su-virudha-mulam asanga-shastrena dridhena chhittva its form is not perceived here as such nor its end origin foundation or resting place having cut asunder this firmly rooted peepul tree with the strong axe of non-attachment.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.15.3 bg.15.3 chapter 15 verse 3 न रूपमस्येह तथोपलभ्यते    नान्तो न चादिर्न च संप्रतिष्ठा।अश्वत्थमेनं सुविरूढमूल    मसङ्गशस्त्रेण दृढेन छित्त्वा।।15.3।। na rūpam asyeha tathopalabhyate
nānto na chādir na cha sampratiṣhṭhā
aśhvattham enaṁ su-virūḍha-mūlam
asaṅga-śhastreṇa dṛiḍhena chhittvā its form is not perceived here as such, nor its end, origin, foundation, or resting place; having cut asunder this firmly rooted peepul tree with the strong axe of non-attachment.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 15.4
documents.sanskrit: ततः पदं तत्परिमार्गितव्य    यस्मिन्गता न निवर्तन्ति भूयः।तमेव चाद्यं पुरुषं प्रप
documents.summary: Then, that goal should be sought for, to which, having gone, none returns again. I seek refuge in that Primeval Purusha, from whence streamed forth the ancient activity or energy.
documents.searchText: bg.15.4 bg.15.4 chapter 15 verse 4 तत पद ततपरमरगतवय यसमनगत न नवरतनत भय तमव चदय परष परपदय यत परवतत परसत परण 15.4 tatah padam tat parimargitavyam yasmin gata na nivartanti bhuyah tam eva chadyam purusham prapadye yatah pravrittih prasrita purani then that goal should be sought for to which having gone none returns again. i seek refuge in that primeval purusha from whence streamed forth the ancient activity or energy.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.15.4 bg.15.4 chapter 15 verse 4 ततः पदं तत्परिमार्गितव्य    यस्मिन्गता न निवर्तन्ति भूयः।तमेव चाद्यं पुरुषं प्रपद्ये    यतः प्रवृत्तिः प्रसृता पुराणी।।15.4।। tataḥ padaṁ tat parimārgitavyaṁ
yasmin gatā na nivartanti bhūyaḥ
tam eva chādyaṁ puruṣhaṁ prapadye
yataḥ pravṛittiḥ prasṛitā purāṇī then, that goal should be sought for, to which, having gone, none returns again. i seek refuge in that primeval purusha, from whence streamed forth the ancient activity or energy.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 15.5
documents.summary: Free from pride and delusion, victorious over the evil of attachment, dwelling constantly in the Self, their desires having completely turned away, freed from the pairs of opposite
documents.searchText: bg.15.5 bg.15.5 chapter 15 verse 5 नरमनमह जतसङगदष अधयतमनतय वनवततकम दवनदवरवमकत सखदखसजञ रगचछनतयमढ पदमवयय तत 15.5 nirmana-moha jita-sanga-dosha adhyatma-nitya vinivritta-kamah dvandvair vimuktah sukha-duhkha-sanjnair gachchhanty amudhah padam avyayam tat free from pride and delusion victorious over the evil of attachment dwelling constantly in the self their desires having completely turned away freed from the pairs of opposites known as pleasure and pain they the undeluded reach the eternal goal.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.15.5 bg.15.5 chapter 15 verse 5 निर्मानमोहा जितसङ्गदोषा    अध्यात्मनित्या विनिवृत्तकामाः।द्वन्द्वैर्विमुक्ताः सुखदुःखसंज्ञै    र्गच्छन्त्यमूढाः पदमव्ययं तत्।।15.5।। nirmāna-mohā jita-saṅga-doṣhā
adhyātma-nityā vinivṛitta-kāmāḥ
dvandvair vimuktāḥ sukha-duḥkha-sanjñair
gachchhanty amūḍhāḥ padam avyayaṁ tat free from pride and delusion, victorious over the evil of attachment, dwelling constantly in the self, their desires having completely turned away, freed from the pairs of opposites known as pleasure and pain, they, the undeluded, reach the eternal goal.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 15.6
documents.iast: na tad bhāsayate sūryo na śhaśhāṅko na pāvakaḥ
documents.sanskrit: न तद्भासयते सूर्यो न शशाङ्को न पावकः।यद्गत्वा न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम।।15.6।
documents.summary: Neither does the sun illuminate there, nor the moon, nor the fire; having gone there, they do not return; that is My supreme abode.
documents.searchText: bg.15.6 bg.15.6 chapter 15 verse 6 न तदभसयत सरय न शशङक न पवक यदगतव न नवरतनत तदधम परम मम 15.6 na tad bhasayate suryo na shashanko na pavakah yad gatva na nivartante tad dhama paramam mama neither does the sun illuminate there nor the moon nor the fire having gone there they do not return that is my supreme abode.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.15.6 bg.15.6 chapter 15 verse 6 न तद्भासयते सूर्यो न शशाङ्को न पावकः।यद्गत्वा न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम।।15.6।। na tad bhāsayate sūryo na śhaśhāṅko na pāvakaḥ
yad gatvā na nivartante tad dhāma paramaṁ mama neither does the sun illuminate there, nor the moon, nor the fire; having gone there, they do not return; that is my supreme abode.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 15.7
documents.sanskrit: ममैवांशो जीवलोके जीवभूतः सनातनः।मनःषष्ठानीन्द्रियाणि प्रकृतिस्थानि कर्षति।।15.7।
documents.summary: An eternal portion of Myself having become a living soul in the world of life, draws to itself the five senses, with the mind as the sixth, abiding in Nature.
documents.searchText: bg.15.7 bg.15.7 chapter 15 verse 7 ममवश जवलक जवभत सनतन मनषषठननदरयण परकतसथन करषत 15.7 mamaivansho jiva-loke jiva-bhutah sanatanah manah-shashthanindriyani prakriti-sthani karshati an eternal portion of myself having become a living soul in the world of life draws to itself the five senses with the mind as the sixth abiding in nature.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.15.7 bg.15.7 chapter 15 verse 7 ममैवांशो जीवलोके जीवभूतः सनातनः।मनःषष्ठानीन्द्रियाणि प्रकृतिस्थानि कर्षति।।15.7।। mamaivānśho jīva-loke jīva-bhūtaḥ sanātanaḥ
manaḥ-ṣhaṣhṭhānīndriyāṇi prakṛiti-sthāni karṣhati an eternal portion of myself having become a living soul in the world of life, draws to itself the five senses, with the mind as the sixth, abiding in nature.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 15.8
documents.iast: śharīraṁ yad avāpnoti yach chāpy utkrāmatīśhvaraḥ
documents.summary: When the Lord, as the individual soul, obtains a body and when He leaves it, He takes these with Him, just as the wind takes the scents from their seats (flowers, etc.).
documents.searchText: bg.15.8 bg.15.8 chapter 15 verse 8 शरर यदवपनत यचचपयतकरमतशवर गहतवतन सयत वयरगनधनवशयत 15.8 shariram yad avapnoti yach chapy utkramatishvarah grihitvaitani sanyati vayur gandhan ivashayat when the lord as the individual soul obtains a body and when he leaves it he takes these with him just as the wind takes the scents from their seats flowers etc. .
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.15.8 bg.15.8 chapter 15 verse 8 शरीरं यदवाप्नोति यच्चाप्युत्क्रामतीश्वरः।गृहीत्वैतानि संयाति वायुर्गन्धानिवाशयात्।।15.8।। śharīraṁ yad avāpnoti yach chāpy utkrāmatīśhvaraḥ
gṛihītvaitāni sanyāti vāyur gandhān ivāśhayāt when the lord, as the individual soul, obtains a body and when he leaves it, he takes these with him, just as the wind takes the scents from their seats (flowers, etc.).

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 15.9
documents.iast: śhrotraṁ chakṣhuḥ sparśhanaṁ cha rasanaṁ ghrāṇam eva cha
documents.sanskrit: श्रोत्रं चक्षुः स्पर्शनं च रसनं घ्राणमेव च।अधिष्ठाय मनश्चायं विषयानुपसेवते।।15.9
documents.summary: Presiding over the ears, eyes, touch, taste, smell, and mind, it enjoys the objects of the senses.
documents.searchText: bg.15.9 bg.15.9 chapter 15 verse 9 शरतर चकष सपरशन च रसन घरणमव च अधषठय मनशचय वषयनपसवत 15.9 shrotram chakshuh sparshanam cha rasanam ghranam eva cha adhishthaya manash chayam vishayan upasevate presiding over the ears eyes touch taste smell and mind it enjoys the objects of the senses.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.15.9 bg.15.9 chapter 15 verse 9 श्रोत्रं चक्षुः स्पर्शनं च रसनं घ्राणमेव च।अधिष्ठाय मनश्चायं विषयानुपसेवते।।15.9।। śhrotraṁ chakṣhuḥ sparśhanaṁ cha rasanaṁ ghrāṇam eva cha
adhiṣhṭhāya manaśh chāyaṁ viṣhayān upasevate presiding over the ears, eyes, touch, taste, smell, and mind, it enjoys the objects of the senses.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 16.1
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said: Fearlessness, purity of heart, steadfastness in knowledge and yoga, almsgiving, control of the senses, sacrifice, study of scriptures, austerity, and straigh
documents.searchText: bg.16.1 bg.16.1 chapter 16 verse 1 शर भगवनवच अभय सततवसशदध जञनयगवयवसथत दन दमशच यजञशच सवधययसतप आरजवम 16.1 shri-bhagavan uvacha abhayam sattva-sanshuddhir jnana-yoga-vyavasthitih danam damash cha yajnash cha svadhyayas tapa arjavam the blessed lord said fearlessness purity of heart steadfastness in knowledge and yoga almsgiving control of the senses sacrifice study of scriptures austerity and straightforwardness.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.16.1 bg.16.1 chapter 16 verse 1 श्री भगवानुवाच

अभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिः ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः।

दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम्।।16.1।। śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
abhayaṁ sattva-sanśhuddhir jñāna-yoga-vyavasthitiḥ
dānaṁ damaśh cha yajñaśh cha svādhyāyas tapa ārjavam the blessed lord said: fearlessness, purity of heart, steadfastness in knowledge and yoga, almsgiving, control of the senses, sacrifice, study of scriptures, austerity, and straightforwardness.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 16.10
documents.summary: Filled with insatiable desires, full of hypocrisy, pride, and arrogance, holding evil ideas due to delusion, they work with impure intentions.
documents.searchText: bg.16.10 bg.16.10 chapter 16 verse 10 कममशरतय दषपर दमभमनमदनवत महदगहतवसदगरहनपरवरतनतऽशचवरत 16.10 kamam ashritya dushpuram dambha-mana-madanvitah mohad grihitvasad-grahan pravartante shuchi-vratah filled with insatiable desires full of hypocrisy pride and arrogance holding evil ideas due to delusion they work with impure intentions.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.16.10 bg.16.10 chapter 16 verse 10 काममाश्रित्य दुष्पूरं दम्भमानमदान्विताः।मोहाद्गृहीत्वासद्ग्राहान्प्रवर्तन्तेऽशुचिव्रताः।।16.10।। kāmam āśhritya duṣhpūraṁ dambha-māna-madānvitāḥ
mohād gṛihītvāsad-grāhān pravartante ’śhuchi-vratāḥ filled with insatiable desires, full of hypocrisy, pride, and arrogance, holding evil ideas due to delusion, they work with impure intentions.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 16.11
documents.summary: Giving themselves over to immeasurable cares that end only with death, regarding the gratification of lust as their highest aim, and feeling sure that that is all.
documents.searchText: bg.16.11 bg.16.11 chapter 16 verse 11 चनतमपरमय च परलयनतमपशरत कमपभगपरम एतवदत नशचत 16.11 chintam aparimeyam cha pralayantam upashritah kamopabhoga-parama etavad iti nishchitah giving themselves over to immeasurable cares that end only with death regarding the gratification of lust as their highest aim and feeling sure that that is all.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.16.11 bg.16.11 chapter 16 verse 11 चिन्तामपरिमेयां च प्रलयान्तामुपाश्रिताः।कामोपभोगपरमा एतावदिति निश्चिताः।।16.11।। chintām aparimeyāṁ cha pralayāntām upāśhritāḥ
kāmopabhoga-paramā etāvad iti niśhchitāḥ giving themselves over to immeasurable cares that end only with death, regarding the gratification of lust as their highest aim, and feeling sure that that is all.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 16.12
documents.summary: Bound by a hundred ties of hope, given over to lust and anger, they strive to obtain hoards of wealth by unlawful means for sensual enjoyment.
documents.searchText: bg.16.12 bg.16.12 chapter 16 verse 12 आशपशशतरबदध कमकरधपरयण ईहनत कमभगरथमनययनरथसञचयन 16.12 asha-pasha-shatair baddhah kama-krodha-parayanah ihante kama-bhogartham anyayenartha-sanchayan bound by a hundred ties of hope given over to lust and anger they strive to obtain hoards of wealth by unlawful means for sensual enjoyment.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.16.12 bg.16.12 chapter 16 verse 12 आशापाशशतैर्बद्धाः कामक्रोधपरायणाः।ईहन्ते कामभोगार्थमन्यायेनार्थसञ्चयान्।।16.12।। āśhā-pāśha-śhatair baddhāḥ kāma-krodha-parāyaṇāḥ
īhante kāma-bhogārtham anyāyenārtha-sañchayān bound by a hundred ties of hope, given over to lust and anger, they strive to obtain hoards of wealth by unlawful means for sensual enjoyment.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 16.13
documents.iast: idam adya mayā labdham imaṁ prāpsye manoratham
documents.sanskrit: इदमद्य मया लब्धमिमं प्राप्स्ये मनोरथम्।इदमस्तीदमपि मे भविष्यति पुनर्धनम्।।16.13।
documents.summary: "I have gained this today; I will fulfill this desire of mine; this is mine, and this wealth will be mine in the future."
documents.searchText: bg.16.13 bg.16.13 chapter 16 verse 13 इदमदय मय लबधमम परपसय मनरथम इदमसतदमप म भवषयत पनरधनम 16.13 idam adya maya labdham imam prapsye manoratham idam astidam api me bhavishyati punar dhanam i have gained this today i will fulfill this desire of mine this is mine and this wealth will be mine in the future.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.16.13 bg.16.13 chapter 16 verse 13 इदमद्य मया लब्धमिमं प्राप्स्ये मनोरथम्।इदमस्तीदमपि मे भविष्यति पुनर्धनम्।।16.13।। idam adya mayā labdham imaṁ prāpsye manoratham
idam astīdam api me bhaviṣhyati punar dhanam "i have gained this today; i will fulfill this desire of mine; this is mine, and this wealth will be mine in the future."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 16.14
documents.iast: asau mayā hataḥ śhatrur haniṣhye chāparān api
documents.sanskrit: असौ मया हतः शत्रुर्हनिष्ये चापरानपि।ईश्वरोऽहमहं भोगी सिद्धोऽहं बलवान्सुखी।।16.14
documents.summary: "I have slain that enemy, and I shall slay others too. I am the Lord; I enjoy, I am perfect, powerful, and happy."
documents.searchText: bg.16.14 bg.16.14 chapter 16 verse 14 अस मय हत शतररहनषय चपरनप ईशवरऽहमह भग सदधऽह बलवनसख 16.14 asau maya hatah shatrur hanishye chaparan api ishvaro ham aham bhogi siddho ham balavan sukhi i have slain that enemy and i shall slay others too. i am the lord i enjoy i am perfect powerful and happy.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.16.14 bg.16.14 chapter 16 verse 14 असौ मया हतः शत्रुर्हनिष्ये चापरानपि।ईश्वरोऽहमहं भोगी सिद्धोऽहं बलवान्सुखी।।16.14।। asau mayā hataḥ śhatrur haniṣhye chāparān api
īśhvaro ’ham ahaṁ bhogī siddho ’haṁ balavān sukhī "i have slain that enemy, and i shall slay others too. i am the lord; i enjoy, i am perfect, powerful, and happy."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 16.15
documents.sanskrit: आढ्योऽभिजनवानस्मि कोऽन्योऽस्ति सदृशो मया।यक्ष्ये दास्यामि मोदिष्य इत्यज्ञानविमोह
documents.summary: "I am wealthy and born into a noble family. Who is my equal? I shall perform sacrifices, give charity, and rejoice," thus deluded by ignorance.
documents.searchText: bg.16.15 bg.16.15 chapter 16 verse 15 आढयऽभजनवनसम कऽनयऽसत सदश मय यकषय दसयम मदषय इतयजञनवमहत 16.15 adhyo bhijanavan asmi ko nyo sti sadrisho maya yakshye dasyami modishya ity ajnana-vimohitah aneka-chitta-vibhranta moha-jala-samavritah prasaktah kama-bhogeshu patanti narake shuchau i am wealthy and born into a noble family. who is my equal i shall perform sacrifices give charity and rejoice thus deluded by ignorance.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.16.15 bg.16.15 chapter 16 verse 15 आढ्योऽभिजनवानस्मि कोऽन्योऽस्ति सदृशो मया।यक्ष्ये दास्यामि मोदिष्य इत्यज्ञानविमोहिताः।।16.15।। āḍhyo ’bhijanavān asmi ko ’nyo ’sti sadṛiśho mayā
yakṣhye dāsyāmi modiṣhya ity ajñāna-vimohitāḥ
 aneka-chitta-vibhrāntā moha-jāla-samāvṛitāḥ
prasaktāḥ kāma-bhogeṣhu patanti narake ’śhuchau "i am wealthy and born into a noble family. who is my equal? i shall perform sacrifices, give charity, and rejoice," thus deluded by ignorance.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 16.16
documents.iast: aneka-citta-vibhrāntā    moha-jāla-samāvṛtāḥ prasaktāḥ   kāma-bhogeṣu    patanti narake  'śucau
documents.summary: Bewildered by many fancies, entangled in the snare of delusion, addicted to the gratification of lust, they fall into a foul hell.
documents.searchText: bg.16.16 bg.16.16 chapter 16 verse 16 अनकचततवभरनत महजलसमवत परसकत कमभगष पतनत नरकऽशच 16.16 aneka-citta-vibhranta moha-jala-samavrtah prasaktah kama-bhogesu patanti narake sucau bewildered by many fancies entangled in the snare of delusion addicted to the gratification of lust they fall into a foul hell.
documents.searchTextRaw: bg.16.16 bg.16.16 chapter 16 verse 16 अनेकचित्तविभ्रान्ता मोहजालसमावृताः।प्रसक्ताः कामभोगेषु पतन्ति नरकेऽशुचौ।।16.16।। aneka-citta-vibhrāntā    moha-jāla-samāvṛtāḥ prasaktāḥ   kāma-bhogeṣu    patanti narake  'śucau bewildered by many fancies, entangled in the snare of delusion, addicted to the gratification of lust, they fall into a foul hell.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 16.17
documents.summary: Self-conceited, stubborn, filled with pride and intoxication of wealth, they perform sacrifices in name only for ostentation, contrary to scriptural ordinances.
documents.searchText: bg.16.17 bg.16.17 chapter 16 verse 17 आतमसमभवत सतबध धनमनमदनवत यजनत नमयजञसत दमभनवधपरवकम 16.17 atma-sambhavitah stabdha dhana-mana-madanvitah yajante nama-yajnais te dambhenavidhi-purvakam self-conceited stubborn filled with pride and intoxication of wealth they perform sacrifices in name only for ostentation contrary to scriptural ordinances.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.16.17 bg.16.17 chapter 16 verse 17 आत्मसम्भाविताः स्तब्धा धनमानमदान्विताः।यजन्ते नामयज्ञैस्ते दम्भेनाविधिपूर्वकम्।।16.17।। ātma-sambhāvitāḥ stabdhā dhana-māna-madānvitāḥ
yajante nāma-yajñais te dambhenāvidhi-pūrvakam self-conceited, stubborn, filled with pride and intoxication of wealth, they perform sacrifices in name only for ostentation, contrary to scriptural ordinances.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 16.18
documents.iast: ahankāraṁ balaṁ darpaṁ kāmaṁ krodhaṁ cha sanśhritāḥ
documents.sanskrit: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः।मामात्मपरदेहेषु प्रद्विषन्तोऽभ्यसूयका
documents.summary: Given over to egoism, power, haughtiness, lust, and anger, these malicious people hate Me in their own bodies and in the bodies of others.
documents.searchText: bg.16.18 bg.16.18 chapter 16 verse 18 अहङकर बल दरप कम करध च सशरत ममतमपरदहष परदवषनतऽभयसयक 16.18 ahankaram balam darpam kamam krodham cha sanshritah mam atma-para-deheshu pradvishanto bhyasuyakah given over to egoism power haughtiness lust and anger these malicious people hate me in their own bodies and in the bodies of others.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.16.18 bg.16.18 chapter 16 verse 18 अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः।मामात्मपरदेहेषु प्रद्विषन्तोऽभ्यसूयकाः।।16.18।। ahankāraṁ balaṁ darpaṁ kāmaṁ krodhaṁ cha sanśhritāḥ
mām ātma-para-deheṣhu pradviṣhanto ’bhyasūyakāḥ given over to egoism, power, haughtiness, lust, and anger, these malicious people hate me in their own bodies and in the bodies of others.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 16.19
documents.iast: tān ahaṁ dviṣhataḥ krūrān sansāreṣhu narādhamān
documents.summary: Those cruel haters, the worst among men in the world, I hurl those evil-doers into the wombs of demons only.
documents.searchText: bg.16.19 bg.16.19 chapter 16 verse 19 तनह दवषत कररनससरष नरधमन कषपमयजसरमशभनसरषवव यनष 16.19 tan aham dvishatah kruran sansareshu naradhaman kshipamy ajasram ashubhan asurishv eva yonishu those cruel haters the worst among men in the world i hurl those evil-doers into the wombs of demons only.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.16.19 bg.16.19 chapter 16 verse 19 तानहं द्विषतः क्रूरान्संसारेषु नराधमान्।क्षिपाम्यजस्रमशुभानासुरीष्वेव योनिषु।।16.19।। tān ahaṁ dviṣhataḥ krūrān sansāreṣhu narādhamān
kṣhipāmy ajasram aśhubhān āsurīṣhv eva yoniṣhu those cruel haters, the worst among men in the world, i hurl those evil-doers into the wombs of demons only.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 16.2
documents.iast: ahinsā satyam akrodhas tyāgaḥ śhāntir apaiśhunam
documents.sanskrit: अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोधस्त्यागः शान्तिरपैशुनम्।दया भूतेष्वलोलुप्त्वं मार्दवं ह्रीरचापल
documents.summary: Harmlessness, truth, absence of anger, renunciation, peacefulness, absence of crookedness, compassion for beings, non-covetousness, gentleness, modesty, and absence of fickleness.
documents.searchText: bg.16.2 bg.16.2 chapter 16 verse 2 अहस सतयमकरधसतयग शनतरपशनम दय भतषवललपतव मरदव हररचपलम 16.2 ahinsa satyam akrodhas tyagah shantir apaishunam daya bhuteshv aloluptvam mardavam hrir achapalam harmlessness truth absence of anger renunciation peacefulness absence of crookedness compassion for beings non-covetousness gentleness modesty and absence of fickleness.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.16.2 bg.16.2 chapter 16 verse 2 अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोधस्त्यागः शान्तिरपैशुनम्।दया भूतेष्वलोलुप्त्वं मार्दवं ह्रीरचापलम्।।16.2।। ahinsā satyam akrodhas tyāgaḥ śhāntir apaiśhunam
dayā bhūteṣhv aloluptvaṁ mārdavaṁ hrīr achāpalam harmlessness, truth, absence of anger, renunciation, peacefulness, absence of crookedness, compassion for beings, non-covetousness, gentleness, modesty, and absence of fickleness.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 16.20
documents.iast: āsurīṁ yonim āpannā mūḍhā janmani janmani
documents.sanskrit: असुरीं योनिमापन्ना मूढा जन्मनि जन्मनि।मामप्राप्यैव कौन्तेय ततो यान्त्यधमां गतिम्
documents.summary: Entering into demoniacal wombs and deluded, birth after birth, they do not attain Me, thus falling, O Arjuna, into a condition still lower than that.
documents.searchText: bg.16.20 bg.16.20 chapter 16 verse 20 असर यनमपनन मढ जनमन जनमन ममपरपयव कनतय तत यनतयधम गतम 16.20 asurim yonim apanna mudha janmani janmani mam aprapyaiva kaunteya tato yanty adhamam gatim entering into demoniacal wombs and deluded birth after birth they do not attain me thus falling o arjuna into a condition still lower than that.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.16.20 bg.16.20 chapter 16 verse 20 असुरीं योनिमापन्ना मूढा जन्मनि जन्मनि।मामप्राप्यैव कौन्तेय ततो यान्त्यधमां गतिम्।।16.20।। āsurīṁ yonim āpannā mūḍhā janmani janmani
mām aprāpyaiva kaunteya tato yānty adhamāṁ gatim entering into demoniacal wombs and deluded, birth after birth, they do not attain me, thus falling, o arjuna, into a condition still lower than that.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 16.21
documents.sanskrit: त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः।कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजे
documents.summary: There are three gates to this hell, destructive of the self: lust, anger, and greed; therefore, one should abandon these three.
documents.searchText: bg.16.21 bg.16.21 chapter 16 verse 21 तरवध नरकसयद दवर नशनमतमन कम करधसतथ लभसतसमदतततरय तयजत 16.21 tri-vidham narakasyedam dvaram nashanam atmanah kamah krodhas tatha lobhas tasmad etat trayam tyajet there are three gates to this hell destructive of the self lust anger and greed therefore one should abandon these three.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.16.21 bg.16.21 chapter 16 verse 21 त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः।कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत्।।16.21।। tri-vidhaṁ narakasyedaṁ dvāraṁ nāśhanam ātmanaḥ
kāmaḥ krodhas tathā lobhas tasmād etat trayaṁ tyajet there are three gates to this hell, destructive of the self: lust, anger, and greed; therefore, one should abandon these three.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 16.22
documents.iast: etair vimuktaḥ kaunteya tamo-dvārais tribhir naraḥ
documents.sanskrit: एतैर्विमुक्तः कौन्तेय तमोद्वारैस्त्रिभिर्नरः।आचरत्यात्मनः श्रेयस्ततो याति परां ग
documents.summary: A person who is liberated from these three gates of darkness, O Arjuna, practices what is beneficial for them and thus goes to the Supreme Goal.
documents.searchText: bg.16.22 bg.16.22 chapter 16 verse 22 एतरवमकत कनतय तमदवरसतरभरनर आचरतयतमन शरयसतत यत पर गतम 16.22 etair vimuktah kaunteya tamo-dvarais tribhir narah acharaty atmanah shreyas tato yati param gatim a person who is liberated from these three gates of darkness o arjuna practices what is beneficial for them and thus goes to the supreme goal.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.16.22 bg.16.22 chapter 16 verse 22 एतैर्विमुक्तः कौन्तेय तमोद्वारैस्त्रिभिर्नरः।आचरत्यात्मनः श्रेयस्ततो याति परां गतिम्।।16.22।। etair vimuktaḥ kaunteya tamo-dvārais tribhir naraḥ
ācharaty ātmanaḥ śhreyas tato yāti parāṁ gatim a person who is liberated from these three gates of darkness, o arjuna, practices what is beneficial for them and thus goes to the supreme goal.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 16.23
documents.sanskrit: यः शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य वर्तते कामकारतः।न स सिद्धिमवाप्नोति न सुखं न परां गतिम्।
documents.summary: He who, having cast aside the ordinances of the scriptures, acts under the impulse of desire, does not attain perfection, nor happiness, nor the Supreme Goal.
documents.searchText: bg.16.23 bg.16.23 chapter 16 verse 23 य शसतरवधमतसजय वरतत कमकरत न स सदधमवपनत न सख न पर गतम 16.23 yah shastra-vidhim utsrijya vartate kama-karatah na sa siddhim avapnoti na sukham na param gatim he who having cast aside the ordinances of the scriptures acts under the impulse of desire does not attain perfection nor happiness nor the supreme goal.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.16.23 bg.16.23 chapter 16 verse 23 यः शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य वर्तते कामकारतः।न स सिद्धिमवाप्नोति न सुखं न परां गतिम्।।16.23।। yaḥ śhāstra-vidhim utsṛijya vartate kāma-kārataḥ
na sa siddhim avāpnoti na sukhaṁ na parāṁ gatim he who, having cast aside the ordinances of the scriptures, acts under the impulse of desire, does not attain perfection, nor happiness, nor the supreme goal.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 16.24
documents.sanskrit: तस्माच्छास्त्रं प्रमाणं ते कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थितौ।ज्ञात्वा शास्त्रविधानोक्तं कर्म
documents.summary: Therefore, let the scripture be thy authority in determining what ought to be done and what ought not to be done. Having known what is said in the ordinance of the scriptures, thou
documents.searchText: bg.16.24 bg.16.24 chapter 16 verse 24 तसमचछसतर परमण त करयकरयवयवसथत जञतव शसतरवधनकत करम करतमहरहस 16.24 tasmach chhastram pramanam te karyakarya-vyavasthitau jnatva shastra-vidhanoktam karma kartum iharhasi therefore let the scripture be thy authority in determining what ought to be done and what ought not to be done. having known what is said in the ordinance of the scriptures thou shouldst act in this world.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.16.24 bg.16.24 chapter 16 verse 24 तस्माच्छास्त्रं प्रमाणं ते कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थितौ।ज्ञात्वा शास्त्रविधानोक्तं कर्म कर्तुमिहार्हसि।।16.24।। tasmāch chhāstraṁ pramāṇaṁ te kāryākārya-vyavasthitau
jñātvā śhāstra-vidhānoktaṁ karma kartum ihārhasi therefore, let the scripture be thy authority in determining what ought to be done and what ought not to be done. having known what is said in the ordinance of the scriptures, thou shouldst act in this world.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 16.3
documents.iast: tejaḥ kṣhamā dhṛitiḥ śhaucham adroho nāti-mānitā
documents.summary: Vigor, forgiveness, fortitude, purity, absence of hatred, absence of pride—these belong to one born for a divine state, O Arjuna.
documents.searchText: bg.16.3 bg.16.3 chapter 16 verse 3 तज कषम धत शचमदरह नतमनत भवनत समपद दवमभजतसय भरत 16.3 tejah kshama dhritih shaucham adroho nati-manita bhavanti sampadam daivim abhijatasya bharata vigor forgiveness fortitude purity absence of hatred absence of pride these belong to one born for a divine state o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.16.3 bg.16.3 chapter 16 verse 3 तेजः क्षमा धृतिः शौचमद्रोहो नातिमानिता।

भवन्ति सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातस्य भारत।।16.3।। tejaḥ kṣhamā dhṛitiḥ śhaucham adroho nāti-mānitā
bhavanti sampadaṁ daivīm abhijātasya bhārata vigor, forgiveness, fortitude, purity, absence of hatred, absence of pride—these belong to one born for a divine state, o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 16.4
documents.iast: dambho darpo ’bhimānaśh cha krodhaḥ pāruṣhyam eva cha
documents.sanskrit: दम्भो दर्पोऽभिमानश्च क्रोधः पारुष्यमेव च।अज्ञानं चाभिजातस्य पार्थ सम्पदमासुरीम्।
documents.summary: Hypocrisy, arrogance, and self-conceit, anger, harshness, and ignorance—these belong to one who is born for a demoniacal state, O Partha.
documents.searchText: bg.16.4 bg.16.4 chapter 16 verse 4 दमभ दरपऽभमनशच करध परषयमव च अजञन चभजतसय परथ समपदमसरम 16.4 dambho darpo bhimanash cha krodhah parushyam eva cha ajnanam chabhijatasya partha sampadam asurim hypocrisy arrogance and self-conceit anger harshness and ignorance these belong to one who is born for a demoniacal state o partha.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.16.4 bg.16.4 chapter 16 verse 4 दम्भो दर्पोऽभिमानश्च क्रोधः पारुष्यमेव च।अज्ञानं चाभिजातस्य पार्थ सम्पदमासुरीम्।।16.4।। dambho darpo ’bhimānaśh cha krodhaḥ pāruṣhyam eva cha
ajñānaṁ chābhijātasya pārtha sampadam āsurīm hypocrisy, arrogance, and self-conceit, anger, harshness, and ignorance—these belong to one who is born for a demoniacal state, o partha.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 16.5
documents.sanskrit: दैवी सम्पद्विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता।मा शुचः सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातोऽसि पाण्डव।।16.
documents.summary: The divine nature is deemed conducive to liberation, and the demonic to bondage. Grieve not, O Arjuna, for you are born with divine endowments.
documents.searchText: bg.16.5 bg.16.5 chapter 16 verse 5 दव समपदवमकषय नबनधयसर मत म शच समपद दवमभजतऽस पणडव 16.5 daivi sampad vimokshaya nibandhayasuri mata ma shuchah sampadam daivim abhijato si pandava the divine nature is deemed conducive to liberation and the demonic to bondage. grieve not o arjuna for you are born with divine endowments.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.16.5 bg.16.5 chapter 16 verse 5 दैवी सम्पद्विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता।मा शुचः सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातोऽसि पाण्डव।।16.5।। daivī sampad vimokṣhāya nibandhāyāsurī matā
mā śhuchaḥ sampadaṁ daivīm abhijāto ’si pāṇḍava the divine nature is deemed conducive to liberation, and the demonic to bondage. grieve not, o arjuna, for you are born with divine endowments.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 16.6
documents.iast: dvau bhūta-sargau loke ’smin daiva āsura eva cha
documents.sanskrit: द्वौ भूतसर्गौ लोकेऽस्मिन् दैव आसुर एव च।दैवो विस्तरशः प्रोक्त आसुरं पार्थ मे श्र
documents.summary: There are two types of beings in this world: the divine and the demoniacal. The divine has been described at length; hear from Me, O Arjuna, about the demoniacal.
documents.searchText: bg.16.6 bg.16.6 chapter 16 verse 6 दव भतसरग लकऽसमन दव आसर एव च दव वसतरश परकत आसर परथ म शरण 16.6 dvau bhuta-sargau loke smin daiva asura eva cha daivo vistarashah prokta asuram partha me shrinu there are two types of beings in this world the divine and the demoniacal. the divine has been described at length hear from me o arjuna about the demoniacal.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.16.6 bg.16.6 chapter 16 verse 6 द्वौ भूतसर्गौ लोकेऽस्मिन् दैव आसुर एव च।दैवो विस्तरशः प्रोक्त आसुरं पार्थ मे श्रृणु।।16.6।। dvau bhūta-sargau loke ’smin daiva āsura eva cha
daivo vistaraśhaḥ prokta āsuraṁ pārtha me śhṛiṇu there are two types of beings in this world: the divine and the demoniacal. the divine has been described at length; hear from me, o arjuna, about the demoniacal.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 16.7
documents.iast: pravṛittiṁ cha nivṛittiṁ cha janā na vidur āsurāḥ
documents.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुरासुराः।न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्य
documents.summary: The demoniacal do not know what to do and what to refrain from; they have neither purity, nor right conduct, nor truth.
documents.searchText: bg.16.7 bg.16.7 chapter 16 verse 7 परवतत च नवतत च जन न वदरसर न शच नप चचर न सतय तष वदयत 16.7 pravrittim cha nivrittim cha jana na vidur asurah na shaucham napi chacharo na satyam teshu vidyate the demoniacal do not know what to do and what to refrain from they have neither purity nor right conduct nor truth.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.16.7 bg.16.7 chapter 16 verse 7 प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुरासुराः।न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्यते।।16.7।। pravṛittiṁ cha nivṛittiṁ cha janā na vidur āsurāḥ
na śhauchaṁ nāpi chāchāro na satyaṁ teṣhu vidyate the demoniacal do not know what to do and what to refrain from; they have neither purity, nor right conduct, nor truth.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 16.8
documents.iast: asatyam apratiṣhṭhaṁ te jagad āhur anīśhvaram
documents.summary: They say, "This universe is without truth, without a moral basis, without a God, brought about by mutual union, with lust as its cause; what else?"
documents.searchText: bg.16.8 bg.16.8 chapter 16 verse 8 असतयमपरतषठ त जगदहरनशवरम अपरसपरसमभत कमनयतकमहतकम 16.8 asatyam apratishtham te jagad ahur anishvaram aparaspara-sambhutam kim anyat kama-haitukam they say this universe is without truth without a moral basis without a god brought about by mutual union with lust as its cause what else
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.16.8 bg.16.8 chapter 16 verse 8 असत्यमप्रतिष्ठं ते जगदाहुरनीश्वरम्।अपरस्परसम्भूतं किमन्यत्कामहैतुकम्।।16.8।। asatyam apratiṣhṭhaṁ te jagad āhur anīśhvaram
aparaspara-sambhūtaṁ kim anyat kāma-haitukam they say, "this universe is without truth, without a moral basis, without a god, brought about by mutual union, with lust as its cause; what else?"

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 16.9
documents.summary: Holding this view, these ruined souls of small intellect and fierce deeds come forth as enemies of the world, intent on its destruction.
documents.searchText: bg.16.9 bg.16.9 chapter 16 verse 9 एत दषटमवषटभय नषटतमनऽलपबदधय परभवनतयगरकरमण कषयय जगतऽहत 16.9 etam drishtim avashtabhya nashtatmano lpa-buddhayah prabhavanty ugra-karmanah kshayaya jagato hitah holding this view these ruined souls of small intellect and fierce deeds come forth as enemies of the world intent on its destruction.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.16.9 bg.16.9 chapter 16 verse 9 एतां दृष्टिमवष्टभ्य नष्टात्मानोऽल्पबुद्धयः।प्रभवन्त्युग्रकर्माणः क्षयाय जगतोऽहिताः।।16.9।। etāṁ dṛiṣhṭim avaṣhṭabhya naṣhṭātmāno ’lpa-buddhayaḥ
prabhavanty ugra-karmāṇaḥ kṣhayāya jagato ’hitāḥ holding this view, these ruined souls of small intellect and fierce deeds come forth as enemies of the world, intent on its destruction.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.1
documents.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाचये शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य यजन्ते श्रद्धयाऽन्विताः।तेषां निष्ठा तु का कृ
documents.summary: Arjuna said, "What is the condition of those who, disregarding the injunctions of the scriptures, perform sacrifice with faith—is it Sattva, Rajas, or Tamas, O Krishna?"
documents.searchText: bg.17.1 bg.17.1 chapter 17 verse 1 अरजन उवचय शसतरवधमतसजय यजनत शरदधयऽनवत तष नषठ त क कषण सततवमह रजसतम 17.1 arjuna uvacha ye shastra-vidhim utsrijya yajante shraddhayanvitah tesham nishtha tu ka krishna sattvam aho rajas tamah arjuna said what is the condition of those who disregarding the injunctions of the scriptures perform sacrifice with faith is it sattva rajas or tamas o krishna
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.1 bg.17.1 chapter 17 verse 1 अर्जुन उवाचये शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य यजन्ते श्रद्धयाऽन्विताः।तेषां निष्ठा तु का कृष्ण सत्त्वमाहो रजस्तमः।।17.1।। arjuna uvācha
ye śhāstra-vidhim utsṛijya yajante śhraddhayānvitāḥ
teṣhāṁ niṣhṭhā tu kā kṛiṣhṇa sattvam āho rajas tamaḥ arjuna said, "what is the condition of those who, disregarding the injunctions of the scriptures, perform sacrifice with faith—is it sattva, rajas, or tamas, o krishna?"

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.10
documents.iast: yāta-yāmaṁ gata-rasaṁ pūti paryuṣhitaṁ cha yat
documents.sanskrit: यातयामं गतरसं पूति पर्युषितं च यत्।उच्छिष्टमपि चामेध्यं भोजनं तामसप्रियम्।।17.10
documents.summary: That which is stale, tasteless, putrid, rotten, rejected, and impure is the food liked by the Tamasic.
documents.searchText: bg.17.10 bg.17.10 chapter 17 verse 10 यतयम गतरस पत परयषत च यत उचछषटमप चमधय भजन तमसपरयम 17.10 yata-yamam gata-rasam puti paryushitam cha yat uchchhishtam api chamedhyam bhojanam tamasa-priyam that which is stale tasteless putrid rotten rejected and impure is the food liked by the tamasic.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.10 bg.17.10 chapter 17 verse 10 यातयामं गतरसं पूति पर्युषितं च यत्।उच्छिष्टमपि चामेध्यं भोजनं तामसप्रियम्।।17.10।। yāta-yāmaṁ gata-rasaṁ pūti paryuṣhitaṁ cha yat
uchchhiṣhṭam api chāmedhyaṁ bhojanaṁ tāmasa-priyam that which is stale, tasteless, putrid, rotten, rejected, and impure is the food liked by the tamasic.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.11
documents.sanskrit: अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्यज्ञो विधिदृष्टो य इज्यते।यष्टव्यमेवेति मनः समाधाय स सात्त्विकः।
documents.summary: That sacrifice which is offered by men without desire for reward, as enjoined by the ordinance (scripture), with a firm faith that doing so is their duty, is Sattvic or pure.
documents.searchText: bg.17.11 bg.17.11 chapter 17 verse 11 अफलकङकषभरयजञ वधदषट य इजयत यषटवयमवत मन समधय स सततवक 17.11 aphalakankshibhir yajno vidhi-drishto ya ijyate yashtavyam eveti manah samadhaya sa sattvikah that sacrifice which is offered by men without desire for reward as enjoined by the ordinance scripture with a firm faith that doing so is their duty is sattvic or pure.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.11 bg.17.11 chapter 17 verse 11 अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्यज्ञो विधिदृष्टो य इज्यते।यष्टव्यमेवेति मनः समाधाय स सात्त्विकः।।17.11।। aphalākāṅkṣhibhir yajño vidhi-driṣhṭo ya ijyate
yaṣhṭavyam eveti manaḥ samādhāya sa sāttvikaḥ that sacrifice which is offered by men without desire for reward, as enjoined by the ordinance (scripture), with a firm faith that doing so is their duty, is sattvic or pure.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.12
documents.iast: abhisandhāya tu phalaṁ dambhārtham api chaiva yat
documents.sanskrit: अभिसंधाय तु फलं दम्भार्थमपि चैव यत्।इज्यते भरतश्रेष्ठ तं यज्ञं विद्धि राजसम्।।17
documents.summary: The sacrifice that is offered, O Arjuna, seeking a reward and for show, know that to be a Rajasic Yajna.
documents.searchText: bg.17.12 bg.17.12 chapter 17 verse 12 अभसधय त फल दमभरथमप चव यत इजयत भरतशरषठ त यजञ वदध रजसम 17.12 abhisandhaya tu phalam dambhartham api chaiva yat ijyate bharata-shreshtha tam yajnam viddhi rajasam the sacrifice that is offered o arjuna seeking a reward and for show know that to be a rajasic yajna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.12 bg.17.12 chapter 17 verse 12 अभिसंधाय तु फलं दम्भार्थमपि चैव यत्।इज्यते भरतश्रेष्ठ तं यज्ञं विद्धि राजसम्।।17.12।। abhisandhāya tu phalaṁ dambhārtham api chaiva yat
ijyate bharata-śhreṣhṭha taṁ yajñaṁ viddhi rājasam the sacrifice that is offered, o arjuna, seeking a reward and for show, know that to be a rajasic yajna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.13
documents.summary: They declare that sacrifice to be Tamasic which is contrary to the ordinances of the scriptures, in which no food is distributed, and which is devoid of mantras, gifts, and faith.
documents.searchText: bg.17.13 bg.17.13 chapter 17 verse 13 वधहनमसषटनन मनतरहनमदकषणम शरदधवरहत यजञ तमस परचकषत 17.13 vidhi-hinam asrishtannam mantra-hinam adakshinam shraddha-virahitam yajnam tamasam parichakshate they declare that sacrifice to be tamasic which is contrary to the ordinances of the scriptures in which no food is distributed and which is devoid of mantras gifts and faith.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.13 bg.17.13 chapter 17 verse 13 विधिहीनमसृष्टान्नं मन्त्रहीनमदक्षिणम्।श्रद्धाविरहितं यज्ञं तामसं परिचक्षते।।17.13।। vidhi-hīnam asṛiṣhṭānnaṁ mantra-hīnam adakṣhiṇam
śhraddhā-virahitaṁ yajñaṁ tāmasaṁ parichakṣhate they declare that sacrifice to be tamasic which is contrary to the ordinances of the scriptures, in which no food is distributed, and which is devoid of mantras, gifts, and faith.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.14
documents.sanskrit: देवद्विजगुरुप्राज्ञपूजनं शौचमार्जवम्।ब्रह्मचर्यमहिंसा च शारीरं तप उच्यते।।17.14।
documents.summary: Worship of the gods, the twice-born, the teachers, and the wise; purity, straightforwardness, celibacy, and non-injury are all called the austerities of the body.
documents.searchText: bg.17.14 bg.17.14 chapter 17 verse 14 दवदवजगरपरजञपजन शचमरजवम बरहमचरयमहस च शरर तप उचयत 17.14 deva-dwija-guru-prajna- pujanam shaucham arjavam brahmacharyam ahinsa cha shariram tapa uchyate worship of the gods the twice-born the teachers and the wise purity straightforwardness celibacy and non-injury are all called the austerities of the body.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.14 bg.17.14 chapter 17 verse 14 देवद्विजगुरुप्राज्ञपूजनं शौचमार्जवम्।ब्रह्मचर्यमहिंसा च शारीरं तप उच्यते।।17.14।। deva-dwija-guru-prājña- pūjanaṁ śhaucham ārjavam
brahmacharyam ahinsā cha śhārīraṁ tapa uchyate worship of the gods, the twice-born, the teachers, and the wise; purity, straightforwardness, celibacy, and non-injury are all called the austerities of the body.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.15
documents.iast: anudvega-karaṁ vākyaṁ satyaṁ priya-hitaṁ cha yat
documents.sanskrit: अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत्।स्वाध्यायाभ्यसनं चैव वाङ्मयं तप उच्यते।
documents.summary: Speech that causes no excitement, is truthful, pleasant, and beneficial; the practice of studying the Vedas is called austerity of speech.
documents.searchText: bg.17.15 bg.17.15 chapter 17 verse 15 अनदवगकर वकय सतय परयहत च यत सवधययभयसन चव वङमय तप उचयत 17.15 anudvega-karam vakyam satyam priya-hitam cha yat svadhyayabhyasanam chaiva van-mayam tapa uchyate speech that causes no excitement is truthful pleasant and beneficial the practice of studying the vedas is called austerity of speech.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.15 bg.17.15 chapter 17 verse 15 अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत्।स्वाध्यायाभ्यसनं चैव वाङ्मयं तप उच्यते।।17.15।। anudvega-karaṁ vākyaṁ satyaṁ priya-hitaṁ cha yat
svādhyāyābhyasanaṁ chaiva vāṅ-mayaṁ tapa uchyate speech that causes no excitement, is truthful, pleasant, and beneficial; the practice of studying the vedas is called austerity of speech.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.16
documents.summary: Serenity of mind, good-heartedness, self-control, and purity of nature—this is called mental austerity.
documents.searchText: bg.17.16 bg.17.16 chapter 17 verse 16 मनपरसद समयतव मनमतमवनगरह भवसशदधरतयतततप मनसमचयत 17.16 manah-prasadah saumyatvam maunam atma-vinigrahah bhava-sanshuddhir ity etat tapo manasam uchyate serenity of mind good-heartedness self-control and purity of nature this is called mental austerity.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.16 bg.17.16 chapter 17 verse 16 मनःप्रसादः सौम्यत्वं मौनमात्मविनिग्रहः।भावसंशुद्धिरित्येतत्तपो मानसमुच्यते।।17.16।। manaḥ-prasādaḥ saumyatvaṁ maunam ātma-vinigrahaḥ
bhāva-sanśhuddhir ity etat tapo mānasam uchyate serenity of mind, good-heartedness, self-control, and purity of nature—this is called mental austerity.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.17
documents.iast: śhraddhayā parayā taptaṁ tapas tat tri-vidhaṁ naraiḥ
documents.sanskrit: श्रद्धया परया तप्तं तपस्तत्ति्रविधं नरैः।अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्युक्तैः सात्त्विकं परिच
documents.summary: This threefold austerity, practiced by steadfast men, with the utmost faith, desiring no reward, is called Sattvic.
documents.searchText: bg.17.17 bg.17.17 chapter 17 verse 17 शरदधय परय तपत तपसतततरवध नर अफलकङकषभरयकत सततवक परचकषत 17.17 shraddhaya paraya taptam tapas tat tri-vidham naraih aphalakankshibhir yuktaih sattvikam parichakshate this threefold austerity practiced by steadfast men with the utmost faith desiring no reward is called sattvic.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.17 bg.17.17 chapter 17 verse 17 श्रद्धया परया तप्तं तपस्तत्ति्रविधं नरैः।अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्युक्तैः सात्त्विकं परिचक्षते।।17.17।। śhraddhayā parayā taptaṁ tapas tat tri-vidhaṁ naraiḥ
aphalākāṅkṣhibhir yuktaiḥ sāttvikaṁ parichakṣhate this threefold austerity, practiced by steadfast men, with the utmost faith, desiring no reward, is called sattvic.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.18
documents.sanskrit: सत्कारमानपूजार्थं तपो दम्भेन चैव यत्।क्रियते तदिह प्रोक्तं राजसं चलमध्रुवम्।।17.
documents.summary: The austerity that is practiced with the aim of gaining good reception, honor, and worship, and with hypocrisy, is said to be Rajasic, unstable, and transient.
documents.searchText: bg.17.18 bg.17.18 chapter 17 verse 18 सतकरमनपजरथ तप दमभन चव यत करयत तदह परकत रजस चलमधरवम 17.18 satkara-mana-pujartham tapo dambhena chaiva yat kriyate tad iha proktam rajasam chalam adhruvam the austerity that is practiced with the aim of gaining good reception honor and worship and with hypocrisy is said to be rajasic unstable and transient.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.18 bg.17.18 chapter 17 verse 18 सत्कारमानपूजार्थं तपो दम्भेन चैव यत्।क्रियते तदिह प्रोक्तं राजसं चलमध्रुवम्।।17.18।। satkāra-māna-pūjārthaṁ tapo dambhena chaiva yat
kriyate tad iha proktaṁ rājasaṁ chalam adhruvam the austerity that is practiced with the aim of gaining good reception, honor, and worship, and with hypocrisy, is said to be rajasic, unstable, and transient.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.19
documents.sanskrit: मूढग्राहेणात्मनो यत्पीडया क्रियते तपः।परस्योत्सादनार्थं वा तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्।।17.
documents.summary: That austerity which is practised out of a foolish notion, with self-torture, or for the purpose of destroying another, is declared to be of the Tamasic nature.
documents.searchText: bg.17.19 bg.17.19 chapter 17 verse 19 मढगरहणतमन यतपडय करयत तप परसयतसदनरथ व तततमसमदहतम 17.19 mudha-grahenatmano yat pidaya kriyate tapah parasyotsadanartham va tat tamasam udahritam that austerity which is practised out of a foolish notion with self-torture or for the purpose of destroying another is declared to be of the tamasic nature.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.19 bg.17.19 chapter 17 verse 19 मूढग्राहेणात्मनो यत्पीडया क्रियते तपः।परस्योत्सादनार्थं वा तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्।।17.19।। mūḍha-grāheṇātmano yat pīḍayā kriyate tapaḥ
parasyotsādanārthaṁ vā tat tāmasam udāhṛitam that austerity which is practised out of a foolish notion, with self-torture, or for the purpose of destroying another, is declared to be of the tamasic nature.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.2
documents.sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाचत्रिविधा भवति श्रद्धा देहिनां सा स्वभावजा।सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव ताम
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, "There are threefold faiths inherent in the nature of the embodied: the sattvic (pure), the rajasic (passionate), and the tamasic (dark). Hear of them."
documents.searchText: bg.17.2 bg.17.2 chapter 17 verse 2 शर भगवनवचतरवध भवत शरदध दहन स सवभवज सततवक रजस चव तमस चत त शरण 17.2 shri-bhagavan uvacha tri-vidha bhavati shraddha dehinam sa svabhava-ja sattviki rajasi chaiva tamasi cheti tam shrinu the blessed lord said there are threefold faiths inherent in the nature of the embodied the sattvic pure the rajasic passionate and the tamasic dark . hear of them.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.2 bg.17.2 chapter 17 verse 2 श्री भगवानुवाचत्रिविधा भवति श्रद्धा देहिनां सा स्वभावजा।सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी चेति तां श्रृणु।।17.2।। śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
tri-vidhā bhavati śhraddhā dehināṁ sā svabhāva-jā
sāttvikī rājasī chaiva tāmasī cheti tāṁ śhṛiṇu the blessed lord said, "there are threefold faiths inherent in the nature of the embodied: the sattvic (pure), the rajasic (passionate), and the tamasic (dark). hear of them."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.20
documents.sanskrit: दातव्यमिति यद्दानं दीयतेऽनुपकारिणे।देशे काले च पात्रे च तद्दानं सात्त्विकं स्मृत
documents.summary: That gift which is given to one who does nothing in return, knowing it to be a duty to give in a suitable place and time to a worthy person, is held to be Sattvic.
documents.searchText: bg.17.20 bg.17.20 chapter 17 verse 20 दतवयमत यददन दयतऽनपकरण दश कल च पतर च तददन सततवक समतम 17.20 datavyam iti yad danam diyate nupakarine deshe kale cha patre cha tad danam sattvikam smritam that gift which is given to one who does nothing in return knowing it to be a duty to give in a suitable place and time to a worthy person is held to be sattvic.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.20 bg.17.20 chapter 17 verse 20 दातव्यमिति यद्दानं दीयतेऽनुपकारिणे।देशे काले च पात्रे च तद्दानं सात्त्विकं स्मृतम्।।17.20।। dātavyam iti yad dānaṁ dīyate ‘nupakāriṇe
deśhe kāle cha pātre cha tad dānaṁ sāttvikaṁ smṛitam that gift which is given to one who does nothing in return, knowing it to be a duty to give in a suitable place and time to a worthy person, is held to be sattvic.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.21
documents.iast: yat tu pratyupakārārthaṁ phalam uddiśhya vā punaḥ
documents.sanskrit: यत्तु प्रत्युपकारार्थं फलमुद्दिश्य वा पुनः।दीयते च परिक्लिष्टं तद्दानं राजसं स्म
documents.summary: And, that gift which is given with the intention of receiving something in return, or expecting a reward, or begrudgingly, is considered to be Rajasic.
documents.searchText: bg.17.21 bg.17.21 chapter 17 verse 21 यतत परतयपकररथ फलमददशय व पन दयत च परकलषट तददन रजस समतम 17.21 yat tu pratyupakarartham phalam uddishya va punah diyate cha pariklishtam tad danam rajasam smritam and that gift which is given with the intention of receiving something in return or expecting a reward or begrudgingly is considered to be rajasic.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.21 bg.17.21 chapter 17 verse 21 यत्तु प्रत्युपकारार्थं फलमुद्दिश्य वा पुनः।दीयते च परिक्लिष्टं तद्दानं राजसं स्मृतम्।।17.21।। yat tu pratyupakārārthaṁ phalam uddiśhya vā punaḥ
dīyate cha parikliṣhṭaṁ tad dānaṁ rājasaṁ smṛitam and, that gift which is given with the intention of receiving something in return, or expecting a reward, or begrudgingly, is considered to be rajasic.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.22
documents.iast: adeśha-kāle yad dānam apātrebhyaśh cha dīyate
documents.summary: The gift that is given in the wrong place and at the wrong time, to unworthy persons, without respect or with insult, is declared to be of a Tamasic nature.
documents.searchText: bg.17.22 bg.17.22 chapter 17 verse 22 अदशकल यददनमपतरभयशच दयत असतकतमवजञत तततमसमदहतम 17.22 adesha-kale yad danam apatrebhyash cha diyate asat-kritam avajnatam tat tamasam udahritam the gift that is given in the wrong place and at the wrong time to unworthy persons without respect or with insult is declared to be of a tamasic nature.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.22 bg.17.22 chapter 17 verse 22 अदेशकाले यद्दानमपात्रेभ्यश्च दीयते।असत्कृतमवज्ञातं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्।।17.22।। adeśha-kāle yad dānam apātrebhyaśh cha dīyate
asat-kṛitam avajñātaṁ tat tāmasam udāhṛitam the gift that is given in the wrong place and at the wrong time, to unworthy persons, without respect or with insult, is declared to be of a tamasic nature.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.23
documents.iast: oṁ tat sad iti nirdeśho brahmaṇas tri-vidhaḥ smṛitaḥ
documents.sanskrit: तत्सदिति निर्देशो ब्रह्मणस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः।ब्राह्मणास्तेन वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च विहित
documents.summary: "Om Tat Sat": This has been declared to be the triple designation of Brahman. By that, the Brahmanas, the Vedas, and the sacrifices were created formerly.
documents.searchText: bg.17.23 bg.17.23 chapter 17 verse 23 ततसदत नरदश बरहमणसतरवध समत बरहमणसतन वदशच यजञशच वहत पर 17.23 om tat sad iti nirdesho brahmanas tri-vidhah smritah brahmanas tena vedash cha yajnash cha vihitah pura om tat sat this has been declared to be the triple designation of brahman. by that the brahmanas the vedas and the sacrifices were created formerly.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.23 bg.17.23 chapter 17 verse 23 तत्सदिति निर्देशो ब्रह्मणस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः।ब्राह्मणास्तेन वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च विहिताः पुरा।।17.23।। oṁ tat sad iti nirdeśho brahmaṇas tri-vidhaḥ smṛitaḥ
brāhmaṇās tena vedāśh cha yajñāśh cha vihitāḥ purā "om tat sat": this has been declared to be the triple designation of brahman. by that, the brahmanas, the vedas, and the sacrifices were created formerly.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.24
documents.summary: Therefore, with the utterance of "Om," the acts of sacrifice, gift, and austerity, as enjoined in the scriptures, are always begun by the students of Brahman.
documents.searchText: bg.17.24 bg.17.24 chapter 17 verse 24 तसमदमतयदहतय यजञदनतपकरय परवरतनत वधनकत सतत बरहमवदनम 17.24 tasmad om ity udahritya yajna-dana-tapah-kriyah pravartante vidhanoktah satatam brahma-vadinam therefore with the utterance of om the acts of sacrifice gift and austerity as enjoined in the scriptures are always begun by the students of brahman.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.24 bg.17.24 chapter 17 verse 24 तस्मादोमित्युदाहृत्य यज्ञदानतपःक्रियाः।प्रवर्तन्ते विधानोक्ताः सततं ब्रह्मवादिनाम्।।17.24।। tasmād oṁ ity udāhṛitya yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-kriyāḥ
pravartante vidhānoktāḥ satataṁ brahma-vādinām therefore, with the utterance of "om," the acts of sacrifice, gift, and austerity, as enjoined in the scriptures, are always begun by the students of brahman.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.25
documents.sanskrit: तदित्यनभिसन्धाय फलं यज्ञतपःक्रियाः।दानक्रियाश्च विविधाः क्रियन्ते मोक्षकाङ्क्षि।
documents.summary: Uttering "Tat," without aiming for the fruits, are the acts of sacrifice, austerity, and the various acts of gifts performed by those seeking liberation.
documents.searchText: bg.17.25 bg.17.25 chapter 17 verse 25 तदतयनभसनधय फल यजञतपकरय दनकरयशच ववध करयनत मकषकङकष 17.25 tad ity anabhisandhaya phalam yajna-tapah-kriyah dana-kriyash cha vividhah kriyante moksha-kankshibhih uttering tat without aiming for the fruits are the acts of sacrifice austerity and the various acts of gifts performed by those seeking liberation.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.25 bg.17.25 chapter 17 verse 25 तदित्यनभिसन्धाय फलं यज्ञतपःक्रियाः।दानक्रियाश्च विविधाः क्रियन्ते मोक्षकाङ्क्षि।।17.25।। tad ity anabhisandhāya phalaṁ yajña-tapaḥ-kriyāḥ
dāna-kriyāśh cha vividhāḥ kriyante mokṣha-kāṅkṣhibhiḥ uttering "tat," without aiming for the fruits, are the acts of sacrifice, austerity, and the various acts of gifts performed by those seeking liberation.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.26
documents.iast: sad-bhāve sādhu-bhāve cha sad ity etat prayujyate
documents.sanskrit: सद्भावे साधुभावे च सदित्येतत्प्रयुज्यते।प्रशस्ते कर्मणि तथा सच्छब्दः पार्थ युज्य
documents.summary: The word "Sat" is used to refer to reality and goodness; likewise, O Arjuna, the word "Sat" is used to refer to an auspicious act.
documents.searchText: bg.17.26 bg.17.26 chapter 17 verse 26 सदभव सधभव च सदतयततपरयजयत परशसत करमण तथ सचछबद परथ यजयत 17.26 sad-bhave sadhu-bhave cha sad ity etat prayujyate prashaste karmani tatha sach-chhabdah partha yujyate the word sat is used to refer to reality and goodness likewise o arjuna the word sat is used to refer to an auspicious act.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.26 bg.17.26 chapter 17 verse 26 सद्भावे साधुभावे च सदित्येतत्प्रयुज्यते।प्रशस्ते कर्मणि तथा सच्छब्दः पार्थ युज्यते।।17.26।। sad-bhāve sādhu-bhāve cha sad ity etat prayujyate
praśhaste karmaṇi tathā sach-chhabdaḥ pārtha yujyate the word "sat" is used to refer to reality and goodness; likewise, o arjuna, the word "sat" is used to refer to an auspicious act.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.27
documents.iast: yajñe tapasi dāne cha sthitiḥ sad iti chochyate
documents.sanskrit: यज्ञे तपसि दाने च स्थितिः सदिति चोच्यते।कर्म चैव तदर्थीयं सदित्येवाभिधीयते।।17.2
documents.summary: Steadfastness in sacrifice, austerity, and gift is also called 'Sat', and action in connection with these, or for the sake of the Supreme, is also called 'Sat'.
documents.searchText: bg.17.27 bg.17.27 chapter 17 verse 27 यजञ तपस दन च सथत सदत चचयत करम चव तदरथय सदतयवभधयत 17.27 yajne tapasi dane cha sthitih sad iti chochyate karma chaiva tad-arthiyam sad ity evabhidhiyate steadfastness in sacrifice austerity and gift is also called sat and action in connection with these or for the sake of the supreme is also called sat .
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.27 bg.17.27 chapter 17 verse 27 यज्ञे तपसि दाने च स्थितिः सदिति चोच्यते।कर्म चैव तदर्थीयं सदित्येवाभिधीयते।।17.27।। yajñe tapasi dāne cha sthitiḥ sad iti chochyate
karma chaiva tad-arthīyaṁ sad ity evābhidhīyate steadfastness in sacrifice, austerity, and gift is also called 'sat', and action in connection with these, or for the sake of the supreme, is also called 'sat'.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.28
documents.iast: aśhraddhayā hutaṁ dattaṁ tapas taptaṁ kṛitaṁ cha yat
documents.sanskrit: अश्रद्धया हुतं दत्तं तपस्तप्तं कृतं च यत्।असदित्युच्यते पार्थ न च तत्प्रेत्य नो
documents.summary: Whatever is sacrificed, given, or performed, and whatever austerity is practiced without faith, it is called 'Asat', O Arjuna; it is of no value here or hereafter (after death).
documents.searchText: bg.17.28 bg.17.28 chapter 17 verse 28 अशरदधय हत दतत तपसतपत कत च यत असदतयचयत परथ न च ततपरतय न इह 17.28 ashraddhaya hutam dattam tapas taptam kritam cha yat asad ity uchyate partha na cha tat pretya no iha whatever is sacrificed given or performed and whatever austerity is practiced without faith it is called asat o arjuna it is of no value here or hereafter after death .
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.28 bg.17.28 chapter 17 verse 28 अश्रद्धया हुतं दत्तं तपस्तप्तं कृतं च यत्।असदित्युच्यते पार्थ न च तत्प्रेत्य नो इह।।17.28।। aśhraddhayā hutaṁ dattaṁ tapas taptaṁ kṛitaṁ cha yat
asad ity uchyate pārtha na cha tat pretya no iha whatever is sacrificed, given, or performed, and whatever austerity is practiced without faith, it is called 'asat', o arjuna; it is of no value here or hereafter (after death).

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.3
documents.sanskrit: सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्धा भवति भारत।श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव
documents.summary: The faith of each is in accordance with their nature, O Arjuna. People consist of their faith; as a person's faith is, so are they.
documents.searchText: bg.17.3 bg.17.3 chapter 17 verse 3 सततवनरप सरवसय शरदध भवत भरत शरदधमयऽय परष य यचछरदध स एव स 17.3 sattvanurupa sarvasya shraddha bhavati bharata shraddha-mayo yam purusho yo yach-chhraddhah sa eva sah the faith of each is in accordance with their nature o arjuna. people consist of their faith as a person s faith is so are they.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.3 bg.17.3 chapter 17 verse 3 सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्धा भवति भारत।श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः।।17.3।। sattvānurūpā sarvasya śhraddhā bhavati bhārata
śhraddhā-mayo ‘yaṁ puruṣho yo yach-chhraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ the faith of each is in accordance with their nature, o arjuna. people consist of their faith; as a person's faith is, so are they.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.4
documents.sanskrit: यजन्ते सात्त्विका देवान्यक्षरक्षांसि राजसाः।प्रेतान्भूतगणांश्चान्ये यजन्ते तामसा
documents.summary: The sattvic, or pure, men worship the gods; the rajasic, or passionate, worship the yakshas and rakshasas; the others, the tamasic or deluded people, worship ghosts and hosts of na
documents.searchText: bg.17.4 bg.17.4 chapter 17 verse 4 यजनत सततवक दवनयकषरकषस रजस परतनभतगणशचनय यजनत तमस जन 17.4 yajante sattvika devan yaksha-rakshansi rajasah pretan bhuta-ganansh chanye yajante tamasa janah the sattvic or pure men worship the gods the rajasic or passionate worship the yakshas and rakshasas the others the tamasic or deluded people worship ghosts and hosts of nature-spirits.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.4 bg.17.4 chapter 17 verse 4 यजन्ते सात्त्विका देवान्यक्षरक्षांसि राजसाः।प्रेतान्भूतगणांश्चान्ये यजन्ते तामसा जनाः।।17.4।। yajante sāttvikā devān yakṣha-rakṣhānsi rājasāḥ
pretān bhūta-gaṇānśh chānye yajante tāmasā janāḥ the sattvic, or pure, men worship the gods; the rajasic, or passionate, worship the yakshas and rakshasas; the others, the tamasic or deluded people, worship ghosts and hosts of nature-spirits.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.5
documents.iast: aśhāstra-vihitaṁ ghoraṁ tapyante ye tapo janāḥ
documents.sanskrit: अशास्त्रविहितं घोरं तप्यन्ते ये तपो जनाः।दम्भाहङ्कारसंयुक्ताः कामरागबलान्विताः।।
documents.summary: Those men who practice terrific austerities not prescribed by the scriptures, given to hypocrisy and egoism, driven by the force of lust and attachment.
documents.searchText: bg.17.5 bg.17.5 chapter 17 verse 5 अशसतरवहत घर तपयनत य तप जन दमभहङकरसयकत कमरगबलनवत 17.5 ashastra-vihitam ghoram tapyante ye tapo janah dambhahankara-sanyuktah kama-raga-balanvitah those men who practice terrific austerities not prescribed by the scriptures given to hypocrisy and egoism driven by the force of lust and attachment.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.5 bg.17.5 chapter 17 verse 5 अशास्त्रविहितं घोरं तप्यन्ते ये तपो जनाः।दम्भाहङ्कारसंयुक्ताः कामरागबलान्विताः।।17.5।। aśhāstra-vihitaṁ ghoraṁ tapyante ye tapo janāḥ
dambhāhankāra-sanyuktāḥ kāma-rāga-balānvitāḥ those men who practice terrific austerities not prescribed by the scriptures, given to hypocrisy and egoism, driven by the force of lust and attachment.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.6
documents.summary: Know thou these to be of demonical resolves, senselessly torturing all the elements in the body and Me who dwell in the body.
documents.searchText: bg.17.6 bg.17.6 chapter 17 verse 6 करषयनत शररसथ भतगरममचतस म चवनतशररसथ तनवदधयसरनशचयन 17.6 karshayantah sharira-stham bhuta-gramam achetasah mam chaivantah sharira-stham tan viddhy asura-nishchayan know thou these to be of demonical resolves senselessly torturing all the elements in the body and me who dwell in the body.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.6 bg.17.6 chapter 17 verse 6 कर्षयन्तः शरीरस्थं भूतग्राममचेतसः।मां चैवान्तःशरीरस्थं तान्विद्ध्यासुरनिश्चयान्।।17.6।। karṣhayantaḥ śharīra-sthaṁ bhūta-grāmam achetasaḥ
māṁ chaivāntaḥ śharīra-sthaṁ tān viddhy āsura-niśhchayān know thou these to be of demonical resolves, senselessly torturing all the elements in the body and me who dwell in the body.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.7
documents.iast: āhāras tv api sarvasya tri-vidho bhavati priyaḥ
documents.sanskrit: आहारस्त्वपि सर्वस्य त्रिविधो भवति प्रियः।यज्ञस्तपस्तथा दानं तेषां भेदमिमं श्रृणु
documents.summary: The food that is dear to each is threefold, as well as sacrifice, austerity, and almsgiving. Hear the distinction of these.
documents.searchText: bg.17.7 bg.17.7 chapter 17 verse 7 आहरसतवप सरवसय तरवध भवत परय यजञसतपसतथ दन तष भदमम शरण 17.7 aharas tv api sarvasya tri-vidho bhavati priyah yajnas tapas tatha danam tesham bhedam imam shrinu the food that is dear to each is threefold as well as sacrifice austerity and almsgiving. hear the distinction of these.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.7 bg.17.7 chapter 17 verse 7 आहारस्त्वपि सर्वस्य त्रिविधो भवति प्रियः।यज्ञस्तपस्तथा दानं तेषां भेदमिमं श्रृणु।।17.7।। āhāras tv api sarvasya tri-vidho bhavati priyaḥ
yajñas tapas tathā dānaṁ teṣhāṁ bhedam imaṁ śhṛiṇu the food that is dear to each is threefold, as well as sacrifice, austerity, and almsgiving. hear the distinction of these.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.8
documents.summary: The foods that increase life, purity, strength, health, joy, and cheerfulness (good appetite), which are savory, oily, substantial, and agreeable, are dear to the Sattvic (pure) pe
documents.searchText: bg.17.8 bg.17.8 chapter 17 verse 8 आयसततवबलरगयसखपरतववरधन रसय सनगध सथर हदय आहर सततवकपरय 17.8 ayuh-sattva-balarogya-sukha-priti-vivardhanah rasyah snigdhah sthira hridya aharah sattvika-priyah the foods that increase life purity strength health joy and cheerfulness good appetite which are savory oily substantial and agreeable are dear to the sattvic pure people.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.8 bg.17.8 chapter 17 verse 8 आयुःसत्त्वबलारोग्यसुखप्रीतिविवर्धनाः।रस्याः स्निग्धाः स्थिरा हृद्या आहाराः सात्त्विकप्रियाः।।17.8।। āyuḥ-sattva-balārogya-sukha-prīti-vivardhanāḥ
rasyāḥ snigdhāḥ sthirā hṛidyā āhārāḥ sāttvika-priyāḥ the foods that increase life, purity, strength, health, joy, and cheerfulness (good appetite), which are savory, oily, substantial, and agreeable, are dear to the sattvic (pure) people.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 17.9
documents.summary: The foods that are bitter, sour, salty, overly hot, pungent, dry, and burning are liked by the Rajasic and are productive of pain, grief, and disease.
documents.searchText: bg.17.9 bg.17.9 chapter 17 verse 9 कटवमललवणतयषणतकषणरकषवदहन आहर रजससयषट दखशकमयपरद 17.9 katv-amla-lavanaty-ushna- tikshna-ruksha-vidahinah ahara rajasasyeshta duhkha-shokamaya-pradah the foods that are bitter sour salty overly hot pungent dry and burning are liked by the rajasic and are productive of pain grief and disease.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.17.9 bg.17.9 chapter 17 verse 9 कट्वम्ललवणात्युष्णतीक्ष्णरूक्षविदाहिनः।आहारा राजसस्येष्टा दुःखशोकामयप्रदाः।।17.9।। kaṭv-amla-lavaṇāty-uṣhṇa- tīkṣhṇa-rūkṣha-vidāhinaḥ
āhārā rājasasyeṣhṭā duḥkha-śhokāmaya-pradāḥ the foods that are bitter, sour, salty, overly hot, pungent, dry, and burning are liked by the rajasic and are productive of pain, grief, and disease.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.1
documents.summary: Arjuna said, "O mighty-armed Hrishikesa, I desire to know the essence or truth of renunciation and abandonment severally, O slayer of Kesi."
documents.searchText: bg.18.1 bg.18.1 chapter 18 verse 1 अरजन उवच सनयससय महबह तततवमचछम वदतम तयगसय च हषकश पथककशनषदन 18.1 arjuna uvacha sannyasasya maha-baho tattvam ichchhami veditum tyagasya cha hrishikesha prithak keshi-nishudana arjuna said o mighty-armed hrishikesa i desire to know the essence or truth of renunciation and abandonment severally o slayer of kesi.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.1 bg.18.1 chapter 18 verse 1 अर्जुन उवाच

संन्यासस्य महाबाहो तत्त्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम्।

त्यागस्य च हृषीकेश पृथक्केशिनिषूदन।।18.1।। arjuna uvācha
sannyāsasya mahā-bāho tattvam ichchhāmi veditum
tyāgasya cha hṛiṣhīkeśha pṛithak keśhi-niṣhūdana arjuna said, "o mighty-armed hrishikesa, i desire to know the essence or truth of renunciation and abandonment severally, o slayer of kesi."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.10
documents.iast: na dveṣhṭy akuśhalaṁ karma kuśhale nānuṣhajjate
documents.sanskrit: न द्वेष्ट्यकुशलं कर्म कुशले नानुषज्जते।त्यागी सत्त्वसमाविष्टो मेधावी छिन्नसंशयः।
documents.summary: The man of renunciation, pervaded by purity, intelligent, and with his doubts cut asunder, does not hate an unpleasant task nor is he attached to a pleasant one.
documents.searchText: bg.18.10 bg.18.10 chapter 18 verse 10 न दवषटयकशल करम कशल ननषजजत तयग सततवसमवषट मधव छननसशय 18.10 na dveshty akushalam karma kushale nanushajjate tyagi sattva-samavishto medhavi chhinna-sanshayah the man of renunciation pervaded by purity intelligent and with his doubts cut asunder does not hate an unpleasant task nor is he attached to a pleasant one.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.10 bg.18.10 chapter 18 verse 10 न द्वेष्ट्यकुशलं कर्म कुशले नानुषज्जते।त्यागी सत्त्वसमाविष्टो मेधावी छिन्नसंशयः।।18.10।। na dveṣhṭy akuśhalaṁ karma kuśhale nānuṣhajjate
tyāgī sattva-samāviṣhṭo medhāvī chhinna-sanśhayaḥ the man of renunciation, pervaded by purity, intelligent, and with his doubts cut asunder, does not hate an unpleasant task nor is he attached to a pleasant one.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.11
documents.iast: na hi deha-bhṛitā śhakyaṁ tyaktuṁ karmāṇy aśheṣhataḥ
documents.sanskrit: न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः।यस्तु कर्मफलत्यागी स त्यागीत्यभिधीयते।
documents.summary: Indeed, it is not possible for an embodied being to completely abandon actions; however, he who relinquishes the rewards of actions is truly called a man of renunciation.
documents.searchText: bg.18.11 bg.18.11 chapter 18 verse 11 न ह दहभत शकय तयकत करमणयशषत यसत करमफलतयग स तयगतयभधयत 18.11 na hi deha-bhrita shakyam tyaktum karmany asheshatah yas tu karma-phala-tyagi sa tyagity abhidhiyate indeed it is not possible for an embodied being to completely abandon actions however he who relinquishes the rewards of actions is truly called a man of renunciation.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.11 bg.18.11 chapter 18 verse 11 न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः।यस्तु कर्मफलत्यागी स त्यागीत्यभिधीयते।।18.11।। na hi deha-bhṛitā śhakyaṁ tyaktuṁ karmāṇy aśheṣhataḥ
yas tu karma-phala-tyāgī sa tyāgīty abhidhīyate indeed, it is not possible for an embodied being to completely abandon actions; however, he who relinquishes the rewards of actions is truly called a man of renunciation.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.12
documents.iast: aniṣhṭam iṣhṭaṁ miśhraṁ cha tri-vidhaṁ karmaṇaḥ phalam
documents.sanskrit: अनिष्टमिष्टं मिश्रं च त्रिविधं कर्मणः फलम्।भवत्यत्यागिनां प्रेत्य न तु संन्यासिन
documents.summary: The threefold fruit of action (evil, good, and mixed) accrues after death to those who do not abandon it, but never to those who do.
documents.searchText: bg.18.12 bg.18.12 chapter 18 verse 12 अनषटमषट मशर च तरवध करमण फलम भवतयतयगन परतय न त सनयसन कवचत 18.12 anishtam ishtam mishram cha tri-vidham karmanah phalam bhavaty atyaginam pretya na tu sannyasinam kvachit the threefold fruit of action evil good and mixed accrues after death to those who do not abandon it but never to those who do.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.12 bg.18.12 chapter 18 verse 12 अनिष्टमिष्टं मिश्रं च त्रिविधं कर्मणः फलम्।भवत्यत्यागिनां प्रेत्य न तु संन्यासिनां क्वचित्।।18.12।। aniṣhṭam iṣhṭaṁ miśhraṁ cha tri-vidhaṁ karmaṇaḥ phalam
bhavaty atyāgināṁ pretya na tu sannyāsināṁ kvachit the threefold fruit of action (evil, good, and mixed) accrues after death to those who do not abandon it, but never to those who do.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.13
documents.sanskrit: पञ्चैतानि महाबाहो कारणानि निबोध मे।सांख्ये कृतान्ते प्रोक्तानि सिद्धये सर्वकर्मण
documents.summary: Learn from Me, O mighty-armed Arjuna, these five causes, as declared in the Sankhya system, for the accomplishment of all actions.
documents.searchText: bg.18.13 bg.18.13 chapter 18 verse 13 पञचतन महबह करणन नबध म सखय कतनत परकतन सदधय सरवकरमणम 18.13 panchaitani maha-baho karanani nibodha me sankhye kritante proktani siddhaye sarva-karmanam learn from me o mighty-armed arjuna these five causes as declared in the sankhya system for the accomplishment of all actions.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.13 bg.18.13 chapter 18 verse 13 पञ्चैतानि महाबाहो कारणानि निबोध मे।सांख्ये कृतान्ते प्रोक्तानि सिद्धये सर्वकर्मणाम्।।18.13।। pañchaitāni mahā-bāho kāraṇāni nibodha me
sānkhye kṛitānte proktāni siddhaye sarva-karmaṇām learn from me, o mighty-armed arjuna, these five causes, as declared in the sankhya system, for the accomplishment of all actions.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.14
documents.iast: adhiṣhṭhānaṁ tathā kartā karaṇaṁ cha pṛithag-vidham
documents.sanskrit: अधिष्ठानं तथा कर्ता करणं च पृथग्विधम्।विविधाश्च पृथक्चेष्टा दैवं चैवात्र पञ्चमम्
documents.summary: The body, the doer, the various senses, the different functions of various kinds, and the presiding deity—the fifth.
documents.searchText: bg.18.14 bg.18.14 chapter 18 verse 14 अधषठन तथ करत करण च पथगवधम ववधशच पथकचषट दव चवतर पञचमम 18.14 adhishthanam tatha karta karanam cha prithag-vidham vividhash cha prithak cheshta daivam chaivatra panchamam the body the doer the various senses the different functions of various kinds and the presiding deity the fifth.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.14 bg.18.14 chapter 18 verse 14 अधिष्ठानं तथा कर्ता करणं च पृथग्विधम्।विविधाश्च पृथक्चेष्टा दैवं चैवात्र पञ्चमम्।।18.14।। adhiṣhṭhānaṁ tathā kartā karaṇaṁ cha pṛithag-vidham
