vividhāśh cha pṛithak cheṣhṭā daivaṁ chaivātra pañchamam the body, the doer, the various senses, the different functions of various kinds, and the presiding deity—the fifth.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.15
documents.sanskrit: शरीरवाङ्मनोभिर्यत्कर्म प्रारभते नरः।न्याय्यं वा विपरीतं वा पञ्चैते तस्य हेतवः।।1
documents.summary: Whatever action a person performs with their body, speech, and mind, whether right or wrong, these five are its causes.
documents.searchText: bg.18.15 bg.18.15 chapter 18 verse 15 शररवङमनभरयतकरम पररभत नर नययय व वपरत व पञचत तसय हतव 18.15 sharira-van-manobhir yat karma prarabhate narah nyayyam va viparitam va panchaite tasya hetavah whatever action a person performs with their body speech and mind whether right or wrong these five are its causes.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.15 bg.18.15 chapter 18 verse 15 शरीरवाङ्मनोभिर्यत्कर्म प्रारभते नरः।न्याय्यं वा विपरीतं वा पञ्चैते तस्य हेतवः।।18.15।। śharīra-vāṅ-manobhir yat karma prārabhate naraḥ
nyāyyaṁ vā viparītaṁ vā pañchaite tasya hetavaḥ whatever action a person performs with their body, speech, and mind, whether right or wrong, these five are its causes.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.16
documents.iast: tatraivaṁ sati kartāram ātmānaṁ kevalaṁ tu yaḥ
documents.sanskrit: तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवलं तु यः।पश्यत्यकृतबुद्धित्वान्न स पश्यति दुर्मतिः
documents.summary: Now, such being the case, verily he who, owing to an untrained understanding, looks upon his Self, which is isolated, as the agent, he of perverted intelligence does not see.
documents.searchText: bg.18.16 bg.18.16 chapter 18 verse 16 ततरव सत करतरमतमन कवल त य पशयतयकतबदधतवनन स पशयत दरमत 18.16 tatraivam sati kartaram atmanam kevalam tu yah pashyaty akrita-buddhitvan na sa pashyati durmatih now such being the case verily he who owing to an untrained understanding looks upon his self which is isolated as the agent he of perverted intelligence does not see.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.16 bg.18.16 chapter 18 verse 16 तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवलं तु यः।पश्यत्यकृतबुद्धित्वान्न स पश्यति दुर्मतिः।।18.16।। tatraivaṁ sati kartāram ātmānaṁ kevalaṁ tu yaḥ
paśhyaty akṛita-buddhitvān na sa paśhyati durmatiḥ now, such being the case, verily he who, owing to an untrained understanding, looks upon his self, which is isolated, as the agent, he of perverted intelligence does not see.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.17
documents.iast: yasya nāhankṛito bhāvo buddhir yasya na lipyate
documents.sanskrit: यस्य नाहंकृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते।हत्वापि स इमाँल्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबध्य
documents.summary: He who is free from the egoistic notion, whose intelligence is not tainted by good or evil, though he slays these people, he does not slay, nor is he bound by the action.
documents.searchText: bg.18.17 bg.18.17 chapter 18 verse 17 यसय नहकत भव बदधरयसय न लपयत हतवप स इमललकनन हनत न नबधयत 18.17 yasya nahankrito bhavo buddhir yasya na lipyate hatva pi sa imal lokan na hanti na nibadhyate he who is free from the egoistic notion whose intelligence is not tainted by good or evil though he slays these people he does not slay nor is he bound by the action.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.17 bg.18.17 chapter 18 verse 17 यस्य नाहंकृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते।हत्वापि स इमाँल्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबध्यते।।18.17।। yasya nāhankṛito bhāvo buddhir yasya na lipyate
hatvā ‘pi sa imāl lokān na hanti na nibadhyate he who is free from the egoistic notion, whose intelligence is not tainted by good or evil, though he slays these people, he does not slay, nor is he bound by the action.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.18
documents.sanskrit: ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं परिज्ञाता त्रिविधा कर्मचोदना।करणं कर्म कर्तेति त्रिविधः कर्मसंग्रह
documents.summary: Knowledge, the knowable, and the knower form the threefold impulse for action; the organ, the action, and the agent form the threefold basis of action.
documents.searchText: bg.18.18 bg.18.18 chapter 18 verse 18 जञन जञय परजञत तरवध करमचदन करण करम करतत तरवध करमसगरह 18.18 jnanam jneyam parijnata tri-vidha karma-chodana karanam karma karteti tri-vidhah karma-sangrahah knowledge the knowable and the knower form the threefold impulse for action the organ the action and the agent form the threefold basis of action.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.18 bg.18.18 chapter 18 verse 18 ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं परिज्ञाता त्रिविधा कर्मचोदना।करणं कर्म कर्तेति त्रिविधः कर्मसंग्रहः।।18.18।। jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ parijñātā tri-vidhā karma-chodanā
karaṇaṁ karma karteti tri-vidhaḥ karma-saṅgrahaḥ knowledge, the knowable, and the knower form the threefold impulse for action; the organ, the action, and the agent form the threefold basis of action.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.19
documents.iast: jñānaṁ karma cha kartā cha tridhaiva guṇa-bhedataḥ
documents.sanskrit: ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ता च त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः।प्रोच्यते गुणसंख्याने यथावच्छृणु तान्यपि।
documents.summary: Knowledge, action, and actor are declared in the science of the Gunas (Sankhya philosophy) to be of three kinds only, according to the distinction of the Gunas. Of these, hear duly
documents.searchText: bg.18.19 bg.18.19 chapter 18 verse 19 जञन करम च करत च तरधव गणभदत परचयत गणसखयन यथवचछण तनयप 18.19 jnanam karma cha karta cha tridhaiva guna-bhedatah prochyate guna-sankhyane yathavach chhrinu tany api knowledge action and actor are declared in the science of the gunas sankhya philosophy to be of three kinds only according to the distinction of the gunas. of these hear duly.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.19 bg.18.19 chapter 18 verse 19 ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ता च त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः।प्रोच्यते गुणसंख्याने यथावच्छृणु तान्यपि।।18.19।। jñānaṁ karma cha kartā cha tridhaiva guṇa-bhedataḥ
prochyate guṇa-saṅkhyāne yathāvach chhṛiṇu tāny api knowledge, action, and actor are declared in the science of the gunas (sankhya philosophy) to be of three kinds only, according to the distinction of the gunas. of these, hear duly.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.2
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, "The sages understand sannyasa to be the renunciation of action with desire; the wise declare the abandonment of the fruits of all actions to be tyaga."
documents.searchText: bg.18.2 bg.18.2 chapter 18 verse 2 शर भगवनवच कमयन करमण नयस सनयस कवय वद सरवकरमफलतयग परहसतयग वचकषण 18.2 shri-bhagavan uvacha kamyanam karmanam nyasam sannyasam kavayo viduh sarva-karma-phala-tyagam prahus tyagam vichakshanah the blessed lord said the sages understand sannyasa to be the renunciation of action with desire the wise declare the abandonment of the fruits of all actions to be tyaga.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.2 bg.18.2 chapter 18 verse 2 श्री भगवानुवाच

काम्यानां कर्मणां न्यासं संन्यासं कवयो विदुः।

सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं प्राहुस्त्यागं विचक्षणाः।।18.2।। śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
kāmyānāṁ karmaṇāṁ nyāsaṁ sannyāsaṁ kavayo viduḥ
sarva-karma-phala-tyāgaṁ prāhus tyāgaṁ vichakṣhaṇāḥ the blessed lord said, "the sages understand sannyasa to be the renunciation of action with desire; the wise declare the abandonment of the fruits of all actions to be tyaga."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.20
documents.sanskrit: सर्वभूतेषु येनैकं भावमव्ययमीक्षते।अविभक्तं विभक्तेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि सात्त्विकम
documents.summary: That by which one sees the indestructible Reality in all beings, not separate in any of them—know that knowledge to be Sattvic.
documents.searchText: bg.18.20 bg.18.20 chapter 18 verse 20 सरवभतष यनक भवमवययमकषत अवभकत वभकतष तजजञन वदध सततवकम 18.20 sarva-bhuteshu yenaikam bhavam avyayam ikshate avibhaktam vibhakteshu taj jnanam viddhi sattvikam that by which one sees the indestructible reality in all beings not separate in any of them know that knowledge to be sattvic.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.20 bg.18.20 chapter 18 verse 20 सर्वभूतेषु येनैकं भावमव्ययमीक्षते।अविभक्तं विभक्तेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि सात्त्विकम्।।18.20।। sarva-bhūteṣhu yenaikaṁ bhāvam avyayam īkṣhate
avibhaktaṁ vibhakteṣhu taj jñānaṁ viddhi sāttvikam that by which one sees the indestructible reality in all beings, not separate in any of them—know that knowledge to be sattvic.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.21
documents.iast: pṛithaktvena tu yaj jñānaṁ nānā-bhāvān pṛithag-vidhān
documents.sanskrit: पृथक्त्वेन तु यज्ज्ञानं नानाभावान्पृथग्विधान्।वेत्ति सर्वेषु भूतेषु तज्ज्ञानं वि
documents.summary: But that knowledge which sees in all beings various entities of distinct kinds as being distinct from one another, know thou that knowledge to be Rajasic.
documents.searchText: bg.18.21 bg.18.21 chapter 18 verse 21 पथकतवन त यजजञन ननभवनपथगवधन वतत सरवष भतष तजजञन वदध रजसम 18.21 prithaktvena tu yaj jnanam nana-bhavan prithag-vidhan vetti sarveshu bhuteshu taj jnanam viddhi rajasam but that knowledge which sees in all beings various entities of distinct kinds as being distinct from one another know thou that knowledge to be rajasic.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.21 bg.18.21 chapter 18 verse 21 पृथक्त्वेन तु यज्ज्ञानं नानाभावान्पृथग्विधान्।वेत्ति सर्वेषु भूतेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि राजसम्।।18.21।। pṛithaktvena tu yaj jñānaṁ nānā-bhāvān pṛithag-vidhān
vetti sarveṣhu bhūteṣhu taj jñānaṁ viddhi rājasam but that knowledge which sees in all beings various entities of distinct kinds as being distinct from one another, know thou that knowledge to be rajasic.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.22
documents.iast: yat tu kṛitsna-vad ekasmin kārye saktam ahaitukam
documents.summary: But that which clings to one single effect as if it were the whole, without reason, without any foundation in Truth, and is trivial—that is declared to be Tamasic.
documents.searchText: bg.18.22 bg.18.22 chapter 18 verse 22 यतत कतसनवदकसमनकरय सकतमहतकम अतततवरथवदलप च तततमसमदहतम 18.22 yat tu kritsna-vad ekasmin karye saktam ahaitukam atattvartha-vad alpam cha tat tamasam udahritam but that which clings to one single effect as if it were the whole without reason without any foundation in truth and is trivial that is declared to be tamasic.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.22 bg.18.22 chapter 18 verse 22 यत्तु कृत्स्नवदेकस्मिन्कार्ये सक्तमहैतुकम्।अतत्त्वार्थवदल्पं च तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्।।18.22।। yat tu kṛitsna-vad ekasmin kārye saktam ahaitukam
atattvārtha-vad alpaṁ cha tat tāmasam udāhṛitam but that which clings to one single effect as if it were the whole, without reason, without any foundation in truth, and is trivial—that is declared to be tamasic.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.23
documents.summary: An action that is ordained, free from attachment, done without love or hatred, and without desire for reward is declared to be Sattvic.
documents.searchText: bg.18.23 bg.18.23 chapter 18 verse 23 नयत सङगरहतमरगदवषत कतम अफलपरपसन करम यतततसततवकमचयत 18.23 niyatam sanga-rahitam araga-dveshatah kritam aphala-prepsuna karma yat tat sattvikam uchyate an action that is ordained free from attachment done without love or hatred and without desire for reward is declared to be sattvic.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.23 bg.18.23 chapter 18 verse 23 नियतं सङ्गरहितमरागद्वेषतः कृतम्।अफलप्रेप्सुना कर्म यत्तत्सात्त्विकमुच्यते।।18.23।। niyataṁ saṅga-rahitam arāga-dveṣhataḥ kṛitam
aphala-prepsunā karma yat tat sāttvikam uchyate an action that is ordained, free from attachment, done without love or hatred, and without desire for reward is declared to be sattvic.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.24
documents.iast: yat tu kāmepsunā karma sāhankāreṇa vā punaḥ
documents.sanskrit: यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहङ्कारेण वा पुनः।क्रियते बहुलायासं तद्राजसमुदाहृतम्।।18.
documents.summary: But that action which is done by one longing for the fulfillment of desires or gain with egotism or with much effort is declared to be Rajasic (passionate).
documents.searchText: bg.18.24 bg.18.24 chapter 18 verse 24 यतत कमपसन करम सहङकरण व पन करयत बहलयस तदरजसमदहतम 18.24 yat tu kamepsuna karma sahankarena va punah kriyate bahulayasam tad rajasam udahritam but that action which is done by one longing for the fulfillment of desires or gain with egotism or with much effort is declared to be rajasic passionate .
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.24 bg.18.24 chapter 18 verse 24 यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहङ्कारेण वा पुनः।क्रियते बहुलायासं तद्राजसमुदाहृतम्।।18.24।। yat tu kāmepsunā karma sāhankāreṇa vā punaḥ
kriyate bahulāyāsaṁ tad rājasam udāhṛitam but that action which is done by one longing for the fulfillment of desires or gain with egotism or with much effort is declared to be rajasic (passionate).

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.25
documents.iast: anubandhaṁ kṣhayaṁ hinsām anapekṣhya cha pauruṣham
documents.sanskrit: अनुबन्धं क्षयं हिंसामनपेक्ष्य च पौरुषम्।मोहादारभ्यते कर्म यत्तत्तामसमुच्यते।।18.
documents.summary: That action which is undertaken from delusion, without regard for the consequences, loss, injury, and one's own ability, is declared to be Tamasic (dark).
documents.searchText: bg.18.25 bg.18.25 chapter 18 verse 25 अनबनध कषय हसमनपकषय च परषम महदरभयत करम यततततमसमचयत 18.25 anubandham kshayam hinsam anapekshya cha paurusham mohad arabhyate karma yat tat tamasam uchyate that action which is undertaken from delusion without regard for the consequences loss injury and one s own ability is declared to be tamasic dark .
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.25 bg.18.25 chapter 18 verse 25 अनुबन्धं क्षयं हिंसामनपेक्ष्य च पौरुषम्।मोहादारभ्यते कर्म यत्तत्तामसमुच्यते।।18.25।। anubandhaṁ kṣhayaṁ hinsām anapekṣhya cha pauruṣham
mohād ārabhyate karma yat tat tāmasam uchyate that action which is undertaken from delusion, without regard for the consequences, loss, injury, and one's own ability, is declared to be tamasic (dark).

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.26
documents.summary: An agent who is free from attachment, non-egoistic, endowed with firmness and enthusiasm, and unaffected by success or failure, is considered to be of a Sattvic (pure) nature.
documents.searchText: bg.18.26 bg.18.26 chapter 18 verse 26 मकतसङगऽनहवद धतयतसहसमनवत सदधयसदधयरनरवकर करत सततवक उचयत 18.26 mukta-sango naham-vadi dhrity-utsaha-samanvitah siddhy-asiddhyor nirvikarah karta sattvika uchyate an agent who is free from attachment non-egoistic endowed with firmness and enthusiasm and unaffected by success or failure is considered to be of a sattvic pure nature.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.26 bg.18.26 chapter 18 verse 26 मुक्तसङ्गोऽनहंवादी धृत्युत्साहसमन्वितः।सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योर्निर्विकारः कर्ता सात्त्विक उच्यते।।18.26।। mukta-saṅgo ‘nahaṁ-vādī dhṛity-utsāha-samanvitaḥ
siddhy-asiddhyor nirvikāraḥ kartā sāttvika uchyate an agent who is free from attachment, non-egoistic, endowed with firmness and enthusiasm, and unaffected by success or failure, is considered to be of a sattvic (pure) nature.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.27
documents.sanskrit: रागी कर्मफलप्रेप्सुर्लुब्धो हिंसात्मकोऽशुचिः।हर्षशोकान्वितः कर्ता राजसः परिकीर्त
documents.summary: Passionate, desiring to obtain the reward of their actions, greedy, cruel, impure, moved by joy and sorrow, such an agent is said to be Rajasic.
documents.searchText: bg.18.27 bg.18.27 chapter 18 verse 27 रग करमफलपरपसरलबध हसतमकऽशच हरषशकनवत करत रजस परकरतत 18.27 ragi karma-phala-prepsur lubdho hinsatmako shuchih harsha-shokanvitah karta rajasah parikirtitah passionate desiring to obtain the reward of their actions greedy cruel impure moved by joy and sorrow such an agent is said to be rajasic.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.27 bg.18.27 chapter 18 verse 27 रागी कर्मफलप्रेप्सुर्लुब्धो हिंसात्मकोऽशुचिः।हर्षशोकान्वितः कर्ता राजसः परिकीर्तितः।।18.27।। rāgī karma-phala-prepsur lubdho hinsātmako ‘śhuchiḥ
harṣha-śhokānvitaḥ kartā rājasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ passionate, desiring to obtain the reward of their actions, greedy, cruel, impure, moved by joy and sorrow, such an agent is said to be rajasic.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.28
documents.sanskrit: अयुक्तः प्राकृतः स्तब्धः शठो नैष्कृतिकोऽलसः।विषादी दीर्घसूत्री च कर्ता तामस उच्य
documents.summary: Unsteady, vulgar, inflexible, deceitful, malicious, lazy, despondent, and procrastinating—such an agent is called Tamasic.
documents.searchText: bg.18.28 bg.18.28 chapter 18 verse 28 अयकत परकत सतबध शठ नषकतकऽलस वषद दरघसतर च करत तमस उचयत 18.28 ayuktah prakritah stabdhah shatho naishkritiko lasah vishadi dirgha-sutri cha karta tamasa uchyate unsteady vulgar inflexible deceitful malicious lazy despondent and procrastinating such an agent is called tamasic.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.28 bg.18.28 chapter 18 verse 28 अयुक्तः प्राकृतः स्तब्धः शठो नैष्कृतिकोऽलसः।विषादी दीर्घसूत्री च कर्ता तामस उच्यते।।18.28।। ayuktaḥ prākṛitaḥ stabdhaḥ śhaṭho naiṣhkṛitiko ‘lasaḥ
viṣhādī dīrgha-sūtrī cha kartā tāmasa uchyate unsteady, vulgar, inflexible, deceitful, malicious, lazy, despondent, and procrastinating—such an agent is called tamasic.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.29
documents.iast: buddher bhedaṁ dhṛiteśh chaiva guṇatas tri-vidhaṁ śhṛiṇu
documents.sanskrit: बुद्धेर्भेदं धृतेश्चैव गुणतस्त्रिविधं श्रृणु।प्रोच्यमानमशेषेण पृथक्त्वेन धनञ्जय।
documents.summary: Hear thou the threefold division of intellect and firmness, according to the Gunas, as I declare them fully and distinctly, O Arjuna.
documents.searchText: bg.18.29 bg.18.29 chapter 18 verse 29 बदधरभद धतशचव गणतसतरवध शरण परचयमनमशषण पथकतवन धनञजय 18.29 buddher bhedam dhritesh chaiva gunatas tri-vidham shrinu prochyamanam asheshena prithaktvena dhananjaya hear thou the threefold division of intellect and firmness according to the gunas as i declare them fully and distinctly o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.29 bg.18.29 chapter 18 verse 29 बुद्धेर्भेदं धृतेश्चैव गुणतस्त्रिविधं श्रृणु।प्रोच्यमानमशेषेण पृथक्त्वेन धनञ्जय।।18.29।। buddher bhedaṁ dhṛiteśh chaiva guṇatas tri-vidhaṁ śhṛiṇu
prochyamānam aśheṣheṇa pṛithaktvena dhanañjaya hear thou the threefold division of intellect and firmness, according to the gunas, as i declare them fully and distinctly, o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.3
documents.iast: tyājyaṁ doṣha-vad ity eke karma prāhur manīṣhiṇaḥ
documents.summary: Some philosophers declare that actions should be abandoned as evil; while others declare that acts of sacrifice, gift, and austerity should not be relinquished.
documents.searchText: bg.18.3 bg.18.3 chapter 18 verse 3 तयजय दषवदतयक करम परहरमनषण यजञदनतपकरम न तयजयमत चपर 18.3 tyajyam dosha-vad ity eke karma prahur manishinah yajna-dana-tapah-karma na tyajyam iti chapare some philosophers declare that actions should be abandoned as evil while others declare that acts of sacrifice gift and austerity should not be relinquished.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.3 bg.18.3 chapter 18 verse 3 त्याज्यं दोषवदित्येके कर्म प्राहुर्मनीषिणः।

यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यमिति चापरे।।18.3।। tyājyaṁ doṣha-vad ity eke karma prāhur manīṣhiṇaḥ
yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-karma na tyājyam iti chāpare some philosophers declare that actions should be abandoned as evil; while others declare that acts of sacrifice, gift, and austerity should not be relinquished.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.30
documents.iast: pravṛittiṁ cha nivṛittiṁ cha kāryākārye bhayābhaye
documents.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये।बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा
documents.summary: The intellect which knows the path of work and renunciation, what should be done and what should not be done, fear and fearlessness, bondage and liberation—that intellect is Sattvi
documents.searchText: bg.18.30 bg.18.30 chapter 18 verse 30 परवतत च नवतत च करयकरय भयभय बनध मकष च य वतत बदध स परथ सततवक 18.30 pravrittim cha nivrittim cha karyakarye bhayabhaye bandham moksham cha ya vetti buddhih sa partha sattviki the intellect which knows the path of work and renunciation what should be done and what should not be done fear and fearlessness bondage and liberation that intellect is sattvic pure o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.30 bg.18.30 chapter 18 verse 30 प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये।बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी।।18.30।। pravṛittiṁ cha nivṛittiṁ cha kāryākārye bhayābhaye
bandhaṁ mokṣhaṁ cha yā vetti buddhiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī the intellect which knows the path of work and renunciation, what should be done and what should not be done, fear and fearlessness, bondage and liberation—that intellect is sattvic (pure), o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.31
documents.iast: yayā dharmam adharmaṁ cha kāryaṁ chākāryam eva cha
documents.sanskrit: यया धर्ममधर्मं च कार्यं चाकार्यमेव च।अयथावत्प्रजानाति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ राजसी।।18
documents.summary: That by which one wrongly understands dharma and adharma, and also what ought to be done and what ought not to be done—that intellect, O Arjuna, is rajasic (passionate).
documents.searchText: bg.18.31 bg.18.31 chapter 18 verse 31 यय धरममधरम च करय चकरयमव च अयथवतपरजनत बदध स परथ रजस 18.31 yaya dharmam adharmam cha karyam chakaryam eva cha ayathavat prajanati buddhih sa partha rajasi that by which one wrongly understands dharma and adharma and also what ought to be done and what ought not to be done that intellect o arjuna is rajasic passionate .
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.31 bg.18.31 chapter 18 verse 31 यया धर्ममधर्मं च कार्यं चाकार्यमेव च।अयथावत्प्रजानाति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ राजसी।।18.31।। yayā dharmam adharmaṁ cha kāryaṁ chākāryam eva cha
ayathāvat prajānāti buddhiḥ sā pārtha rājasī that by which one wrongly understands dharma and adharma, and also what ought to be done and what ought not to be done—that intellect, o arjuna, is rajasic (passionate).

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.32
documents.iast: adharmaṁ dharmam iti yā manyate tamasāvṛitā
documents.sanskrit: अधर्मं धर्ममिति या मन्यते तमसाऽऽवृता।सर्वार्थान्विपरीतांश्च बुद्धिः सा पार्थ ताम
documents.summary: That intellect, O Arjuna, which is enveloped in darkness and sees Adharma as Dharma and all things perverted, is Tamasic (dark).
documents.searchText: bg.18.32 bg.18.32 chapter 18 verse 32 अधरम धरममत य मनयत तमसऽऽवत सरवरथनवपरतशच बदध स परथ तमस 18.32 adharmam dharmam iti ya manyate tamasavrita sarvarthan viparitansh cha buddhih sa partha tamasi that intellect o arjuna which is enveloped in darkness and sees adharma as dharma and all things perverted is tamasic dark .
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.32 bg.18.32 chapter 18 verse 32 अधर्मं धर्ममिति या मन्यते तमसाऽऽवृता।सर्वार्थान्विपरीतांश्च बुद्धिः सा पार्थ तामसी।।18.32।। adharmaṁ dharmam iti yā manyate tamasāvṛitā
sarvārthān viparītānśh cha buddhiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī that intellect, o arjuna, which is enveloped in darkness and sees adharma as dharma and all things perverted, is tamasic (dark).

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.33
documents.sanskrit: धृत्या यया धारयते मनःप्राणेन्द्रियक्रियाः।योगेनाव्यभिचारिण्या धृतिः सा पार्थ सात
documents.summary: The unwavering firmness, through which Yoga restrains the functions of the mind, life-force, and senses—that firmness, O Arjuna, is Sattvic (pure).
documents.searchText: bg.18.33 bg.18.33 chapter 18 verse 33 धतय यय धरयत मनपरणनदरयकरय यगनवयभचरणय धत स परथ सततवक 18.33 dhritya yaya dharayate manah-pranendriya-kriyah yogenavyabhicharinya dhritih sa partha sattviki the unwavering firmness through which yoga restrains the functions of the mind life-force and senses that firmness o arjuna is sattvic pure .
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.33 bg.18.33 chapter 18 verse 33 धृत्या यया धारयते मनःप्राणेन्द्रियक्रियाः।योगेनाव्यभिचारिण्या धृतिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी।।18.33।। dhṛityā yayā dhārayate manaḥ-prāṇendriya-kriyāḥ
yogenāvyabhichāriṇyā dhṛitiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī the unwavering firmness, through which yoga restrains the functions of the mind, life-force, and senses—that firmness, o arjuna, is sattvic (pure).

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.34
documents.sanskrit: यया तु धर्मकामार्थान् धृत्या धारयतेऽर्जुन।प्रसङ्गेन फलाकाङ्क्षी धृतिः सा पार्थ र
documents.summary: But that, O Arjuna, by which one holds fast to Dharma (duty), enjoyment of pleasures, and earning of wealth, on account of attachment and desire for reward—that firmness, O Arjuna,
documents.searchText: bg.18.34 bg.18.34 chapter 18 verse 34 यय त धरमकमरथन धतय धरयतऽरजन परसङगन फलकङकष धत स परथ रजस 18.34 yaya tu dharma-kamarthan dhritya dharayate rjuna prasangena phalakankshi dhritih sa partha rajasi but that o arjuna by which one holds fast to dharma duty enjoyment of pleasures and earning of wealth on account of attachment and desire for reward that firmness o arjuna is rajasic passionate .
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.34 bg.18.34 chapter 18 verse 34 यया तु धर्मकामार्थान् धृत्या धारयतेऽर्जुन।प्रसङ्गेन फलाकाङ्क्षी धृतिः सा पार्थ राजसी।।18.34।। yayā tu dharma-kāmārthān dhṛityā dhārayate ‘rjuna
prasaṅgena phalākāṅkṣhī dhṛitiḥ sā pārtha rājasī but that, o arjuna, by which one holds fast to dharma (duty), enjoyment of pleasures, and earning of wealth, on account of attachment and desire for reward—that firmness, o arjuna, is rajasic (passionate).

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.35
documents.iast: yayā svapnaṁ bhayaṁ śhokaṁ viṣhādaṁ madam eva cha
documents.sanskrit: यया स्वप्नं भयं शोकं विषादं मदमेव च।न विमुञ्चति दुर्मेधा धृतिः सा पार्थ तामसी।।1
documents.summary: That firmness, O Arjuna, by which a stupid man does not abandon sleep, fear, grief, despair, and conceit, is Tamasic.
documents.searchText: bg.18.35 bg.18.35 chapter 18 verse 35 यय सवपन भय शक वषद मदमव च न वमञचत दरमध धत स परथ तमस 18.35 yaya svapnam bhayam shokam vishadam madam eva cha na vimunchati durmedha dhritih sa partha tamasi that firmness o arjuna by which a stupid man does not abandon sleep fear grief despair and conceit is tamasic.

na vimuñchati durmedhā dhṛitiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī that firmness, o arjuna, by which a stupid man does not abandon sleep, fear, grief, despair, and conceit, is tamasic.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.36
documents.iast: sukhaṁ tv idānīṁ tri-vidhaṁ śhṛiṇu me bharatarṣhabha
documents.sanskrit: सुखं त्विदानीं त्रिविधं श्रृणु मे भरतर्षभ।अभ्यासाद्रमते यत्र दुःखान्तं च निगच्छत
documents.summary: And now, O Arjuna, hear from Me of the threefold pleasure, in which one rejoices through practice and surely comes to the end of pain.
documents.searchText: bg.18.36 bg.18.36 chapter 18 verse 36 सख तवदन तरवध शरण म भरतरषभ अभयसदरमत यतर दखनत च नगचछत 18.36 sukham tv idanim tri-vidham shrinu me bharatarshabha abhyasad ramate yatra duhkhantam cha nigachchhati yat tad agre visham iva pariname mritopamam tat sukham sattvikam proktam atma-buddhi-prasada-jam and now o arjuna hear from me of the threefold pleasure in which one rejoices through practice and surely comes to the end of pain.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.37
documents.iast: yat  tad agre    viṣam   iva pariṇāme    'mṛtopamam  tat sukhaṁ  sāttvikaṁ   proktam ātma-buddhi-prasāda-jam
documents.summary: That which is like poison at first but in the end like nectar—that happiness is declared to be sattvic, born of the purity of one's own mind due to self-realization.
documents.searchText: bg.18.37 bg.18.37 chapter 18 verse 37 यततदगर वषमव परणमऽमतपमम ततसख सततवक परकतमतमबदधपरसदजम 18.37 yat tad agre visam iva pariname mrtopamam tat sukham sattvikam proktam atma-buddhi-prasada-jam that which is like poison at first but in the end like nectar that happiness is declared to be sattvic born of the purity of one s own mind due to self-realization.
documents.searchTextRaw: bg.18.37 bg.18.37 chapter 18 verse 37 यत्तदग्रे विषमिव परिणामेऽमृतोपमम्।तत्सुखं सात्त्विकं प्रोक्तमात्मबुद्धिप्रसादजम्।।18.37।। yat  tad agre    viṣam   iva pariṇāme    'mṛtopamam  tat sukhaṁ  sāttvikaṁ   proktam ātma-buddhi-prasāda-jam that which is like poison at first but in the end like nectar—that happiness is declared to be sattvic, born of the purity of one's own mind due to self-realization.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.38
documents.summary: That happiness which arises from the contact of the senses with the objects, which is initially like nectar but eventually like poison, is said to be Rajasic.
documents.searchText: bg.18.38 bg.18.38 chapter 18 verse 38 वषयनदरयसयगदयततदगरऽमतपमम परणम वषमव ततसख रजस समतम 18.38 vishayendriya-sanyogad yat tad agre mritopamam pariname visham iva tat sukham rajasam smritam that happiness which arises from the contact of the senses with the objects which is initially like nectar but eventually like poison is said to be rajasic.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.38 bg.18.38 chapter 18 verse 38 विषयेन्द्रियसंयोगाद्यत्तदग्रेऽमृतोपमम्।परिणामे विषमिव तत्सुखं राजसं स्मृतम्।।18.38।। viṣhayendriya-sanyogād yat tad agre ’mṛitopamam
pariṇāme viṣham iva tat sukhaṁ rājasaṁ smṛitam that happiness which arises from the contact of the senses with the objects, which is initially like nectar but eventually like poison, is said to be rajasic.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.39
documents.iast: yad agre chānubandhe cha sukhaṁ mohanam ātmanaḥ
documents.sanskrit: यदग्रे चानुबन्धे च सुखं मोहनमात्मनः।निद्रालस्यप्रमादोत्थं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्।।18.3
documents.summary: That happiness which at first, as well as in the end, deludes the self, and which arises from sleep, indolence, and heedlessness—that is declared to be Tamasic.
documents.searchText: bg.18.39 bg.18.39 chapter 18 verse 39 यदगर चनबनध च सख महनमतमन नदरलसयपरमदतथ तततमसमदहतम 18.39 yad agre chanubandhe cha sukham mohanam atmanah nidralasya-pramadottham tat tamasam udahritam that happiness which at first as well as in the end deludes the self and which arises from sleep indolence and heedlessness that is declared to be tamasic.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.39 bg.18.39 chapter 18 verse 39 यदग्रे चानुबन्धे च सुखं मोहनमात्मनः।निद्रालस्यप्रमादोत्थं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्।।18.39।। yad agre chānubandhe cha sukhaṁ mohanam ātmanaḥ
nidrālasya-pramādotthaṁ tat tāmasam udāhṛitam that happiness which at first, as well as in the end, deludes the self, and which arises from sleep, indolence, and heedlessness—that is declared to be tamasic.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.4
documents.iast: niśhchayaṁ śhṛiṇu me tatra tyāge bharata-sattama
documents.sanskrit: निश्चयं श्रृणु मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम।त्यागो हि पुरुषव्याघ्र त्रिविधः संप्रकीर्
documents.summary: Hear from Me the conclusion or the final truth about this abandonment, O best of the Bharatas; abandonment, indeed, O best of men, has been declared to be of three kinds.
documents.searchText: bg.18.4 bg.18.4 chapter 18 verse 4 नशचय शरण म ततर तयग भरतसततम तयग ह परषवयघर तरवध सपरकरतत 18.4 nishchayam shrinu me tatra tyage bharata-sattama tyago hi purusha-vyaghra tri-vidhah samprakirtitah hear from me the conclusion or the final truth about this abandonment o best of the bharatas abandonment indeed o best of men has been declared to be of three kinds.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.4 bg.18.4 chapter 18 verse 4 निश्चयं श्रृणु मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम।त्यागो हि पुरुषव्याघ्र त्रिविधः संप्रकीर्तितः।।18.4।। niśhchayaṁ śhṛiṇu me tatra tyāge bharata-sattama
tyāgo hi puruṣha-vyāghra tri-vidhaḥ samprakīrtitaḥ hear from me the conclusion or the final truth about this abandonment, o best of the bharatas; abandonment, indeed, o best of men, has been declared to be of three kinds.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.40
documents.iast: na tad asti pṛithivyāṁ vā divi deveṣhu vā punaḥ
documents.sanskrit: न तदस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः।सत्त्वं प्रकृतिजैर्मुक्तं यदेभिः स्यात
documents.summary: There is no being on earth or in heaven among the gods that is liberated from the three qualities born of Nature.
documents.searchText: bg.18.40 bg.18.40 chapter 18 verse 40 न तदसत पथवय व दव दवष व पन सततव परकतजरमकत यदभ सयततरभरगण 18.40 na tad asti prithivyam va divi deveshu va punah sattvam prakriti-jair muktam yad ebhih syat tribhir gunaih there is no being on earth or in heaven among the gods that is liberated from the three qualities born of nature.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.40 bg.18.40 chapter 18 verse 40 न तदस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः।सत्त्वं प्रकृतिजैर्मुक्तं यदेभिः स्यात्ति्रभिर्गुणैः।।18.40।। na tad asti pṛithivyāṁ vā divi deveṣhu vā punaḥ
sattvaṁ prakṛiti-jair muktaṁ yad ebhiḥ syāt tribhir guṇaiḥ there is no being on earth or in heaven among the gods that is liberated from the three qualities born of nature.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.41
documents.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च परंतप।कर्माणि प्रविभक्तानि स्वभावप्रभवैर्गुणैः
documents.summary: Of Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaisyas, and Sudras, O Arjuna, the duties are distributed according to the qualities born of their own nature.
documents.searchText: bg.18.41 bg.18.41 chapter 18 verse 41 बरहमणकषतरयवश शदरण च परतप करमण परवभकतन सवभवपरभवरगण 18.41 brahmana-kshatriya-visham shudranam cha parantapa karmani pravibhaktani svabhava-prabhavair gunaih of brahmanas kshatriyas vaisyas and sudras o arjuna the duties are distributed according to the qualities born of their own nature.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.41 bg.18.41 chapter 18 verse 41 ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च परंतप।कर्माणि प्रविभक्तानि स्वभावप्रभवैर्गुणैः।।18.41।। brāhmaṇa-kṣhatriya-viśhāṁ śhūdrāṇāṁ cha parantapa
karmāṇi pravibhaktāni svabhāva-prabhavair guṇaiḥ of brahmanas, kshatriyas, vaisyas, and sudras, o arjuna, the duties are distributed according to the qualities born of their own nature.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.42
documents.iast: śhamo damas tapaḥ śhauchaṁ kṣhāntir ārjavam eva cha
documents.sanskrit: शमो दमस्तपः शौचं क्षान्तिरार्जवमेव च।ज्ञानं विज्ञानमास्तिक्यं ब्रह्मकर्म स्वभावज
documents.summary: Serenity, self-restraint, austerity, purity, forgiveness, and uprightness, as well as knowledge, realization, and belief in God, are the duties of Brahmanas, born of their own natu
documents.searchText: bg.18.42 bg.18.42 chapter 18 verse 42 शम दमसतप शच कषनतररजवमव च जञन वजञनमसतकय बरहमकरम सवभवजम 18.42 shamo damas tapah shaucham kshantir arjavam eva cha jnanam vijnanam astikyam brahma-karma svabhava-jam serenity self-restraint austerity purity forgiveness and uprightness as well as knowledge realization and belief in god are the duties of brahmanas born of their own nature.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.42 bg.18.42 chapter 18 verse 42 शमो दमस्तपः शौचं क्षान्तिरार्जवमेव च।ज्ञानं विज्ञानमास्तिक्यं ब्रह्मकर्म स्वभावजम्।।18.42।। śhamo damas tapaḥ śhauchaṁ kṣhāntir ārjavam eva cha
jñānaṁ vijñānam āstikyaṁ brahma-karma svabhāva-jam serenity, self-restraint, austerity, purity, forgiveness, and uprightness, as well as knowledge, realization, and belief in god, are the duties of brahmanas, born of their own nature.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.43
documents.iast: śhauryaṁ tejo dhṛitir dākṣhyaṁ yuddhe chāpy apalāyanam
documents.sanskrit: शौर्यं तेजो धृतिर्दाक्ष्यं युद्धे चाप्यपलायनम्।दानमीश्वरभावश्च क्षात्रं कर्म स्व
documents.summary: Prowess, splendor, firmness, dexterity, and not fleeing from battle, generosity, and lordliness are the duties of the Kshatriyas, born of their own nature.
documents.searchText: bg.18.43 bg.18.43 chapter 18 verse 43 शरय तज धतरदकषय यदध चपयपलयनम दनमशवरभवशच कषतर करम सवभवजम 18.43 shauryam tejo dhritir dakshyam yuddhe chapy apalayanam danam ishvara-bhavash cha kshatram karma svabhava-jam prowess splendor firmness dexterity and not fleeing from battle generosity and lordliness are the duties of the kshatriyas born of their own nature.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.43 bg.18.43 chapter 18 verse 43 शौर्यं तेजो धृतिर्दाक्ष्यं युद्धे चाप्यपलायनम्।दानमीश्वरभावश्च क्षात्रं कर्म स्वभावजम्।।18.43।। śhauryaṁ tejo dhṛitir dākṣhyaṁ yuddhe chāpy apalāyanam
dānam īśhvara-bhāvaśh cha kṣhātraṁ karma svabhāva-jam prowess, splendor, firmness, dexterity, and not fleeing from battle, generosity, and lordliness are the duties of the kshatriyas, born of their own nature.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.44
documents.sanskrit: कृषिगौरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं वैश्यकर्म स्वभावजम्।परिचर्यात्मकं कर्म शूद्रस्यापि स्वभावजम
documents.summary: Agriculture, cattle-rearing, and trade are the duties of the Vaisya (merchant), born of their own nature; and service is the duty of the Sudra (servant-class), born of their own na
documents.searchText: bg.18.44 bg.18.44 chapter 18 verse 44 कषगरकषयवणजय वशयकरम सवभवजम परचरयतमक करम शदरसयप सवभवजम 18.44 krishi-gau-rakshya-vanijyam vaishya-karma svabhava-jam paricharyatmakam karma shudrasyapi svabhava-jam agriculture cattle-rearing and trade are the duties of the vaisya merchant born of their own nature and service is the duty of the sudra servant-class born of their own nature.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.44 bg.18.44 chapter 18 verse 44 कृषिगौरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं वैश्यकर्म स्वभावजम्।परिचर्यात्मकं कर्म शूद्रस्यापि स्वभावजम्।।18.44।। kṛiṣhi-gau-rakṣhya-vāṇijyaṁ vaiśhya-karma svabhāva-jam
paricharyātmakaṁ karma śhūdrasyāpi svabhāva-jam agriculture, cattle-rearing, and trade are the duties of the vaisya (merchant), born of their own nature; and service is the duty of the sudra (servant-class), born of their own nature.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.45
documents.iast: sve sve karmaṇy abhirataḥ sansiddhiṁ labhate naraḥ
documents.sanskrit: स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः।स्वकर्मनिरतः सिद्धिं यथा विन्दति तच्छृ
documents.summary: Each person devoted to their own duty attains perfection. How they attain perfection while being engaged in their own duty, hear now.
documents.searchText: bg.18.45 bg.18.45 chapter 18 verse 45 सव सव करमणयभरत ससदध लभत नर सवकरमनरत सदध यथ वनदत तचछण 18.45 sve sve karmany abhiratah sansiddhim labhate narah sva-karma-niratah siddhim yatha vindati tach chhrinu each person devoted to their own duty attains perfection. how they attain perfection while being engaged in their own duty hear now.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.45 bg.18.45 chapter 18 verse 45 स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः।स्वकर्मनिरतः सिद्धिं यथा विन्दति तच्छृणु।।18.45।। sve sve karmaṇy abhirataḥ sansiddhiṁ labhate naraḥ
sva-karma-nirataḥ siddhiṁ yathā vindati tach chhṛiṇu each person devoted to their own duty attains perfection. how they attain perfection while being engaged in their own duty, hear now.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.46
documents.iast: yataḥ pravṛittir bhūtānāṁ yena sarvam idaṁ tatam
documents.sanskrit: यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम्।स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य सिद्धिं विन्दति मा
documents.summary: He from whom all the beings have evolved and by whom all this is pervaded, worshipping Him with his own duty, one attains perfection.
documents.searchText: bg.18.46 bg.18.46 chapter 18 verse 46 यत परवततरभतन यन सरवमद ततम सवकरमण तमभयरचय सदध वनदत मनव 18.46 yatah pravrittir bhutanam yena sarvam idam tatam sva-karmana tam abhyarchya siddhim vindati manavah he from whom all the beings have evolved and by whom all this is pervaded worshipping him with his own duty one attains perfection.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.46 bg.18.46 chapter 18 verse 46 यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम्।स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य सिद्धिं विन्दति मानवः।।18.46।। yataḥ pravṛittir bhūtānāṁ yena sarvam idaṁ tatam
sva-karmaṇā tam abhyarchya siddhiṁ vindati mānavaḥ he from whom all the beings have evolved and by whom all this is pervaded, worshipping him with his own duty, one attains perfection.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.47
documents.summary: Better is one's own duty, even if it is destitute of merits, than the duty of another well performed. He who does the duty ordained by his own nature incurs no sin.
documents.searchText: bg.18.47 bg.18.47 chapter 18 verse 47 शरयनसवधरम वगण परधरमतसवनषठतत सवभवनयत करम करवननपनत कलबषम 18.47 shreyan swa-dharmo vigunah para-dharmat sv-anushthitat svabhava-niyatam karma kurvan napnoti kilbisham better is one s own duty even if it is destitute of merits than the duty of another well performed. he who does the duty ordained by his own nature incurs no sin.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.47 bg.18.47 chapter 18 verse 47 श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात्।स्वभावनियतं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम्।।18.47।। śhreyān swa-dharmo viguṇaḥ para-dharmāt sv-anuṣhṭhitāt
svabhāva-niyataṁ karma kurvan nāpnoti kilbiṣham better is one's own duty, even if it is destitute of merits, than the duty of another well performed. he who does the duty ordained by his own nature incurs no sin.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.48
documents.iast: saha-jaṁ karma kaunteya sa-doṣham api na tyajet
documents.sanskrit: सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत्।सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनाग्निरिवावृताः।।18.
documents.summary: One should not, O Arjuna, abandon the duty to which one is born, though it may be faulty; for, all undertakings are enveloped by evil, just as fire is by smoke.
documents.searchText: bg.18.48 bg.18.48 chapter 18 verse 48 सहज करम कनतय सदषमप न तयजत सरवरमभ ह दषण धमनगनरववत 18.48 saha-jam karma kaunteya sa-dosham api na tyajet sarvarambha hi doshena dhumenagnir ivavritah one should not o arjuna abandon the duty to which one is born though it may be faulty for all undertakings are enveloped by evil just as fire is by smoke.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.48 bg.18.48 chapter 18 verse 48 सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत्।सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनाग्निरिवावृताः।।18.48।। saha-jaṁ karma kaunteya sa-doṣham api na tyajet
sarvārambhā hi doṣheṇa dhūmenāgnir ivāvṛitāḥ one should not, o arjuna, abandon the duty to which one is born, though it may be faulty; for, all undertakings are enveloped by evil, just as fire is by smoke.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.49
documents.sanskrit: असक्तबुद्धिः सर्वत्र जितात्मा विगतस्पृहः।नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धिं परमां संन्यासेनाधिगच्
documents.summary: He whose intellect is unattached everywhere, who has subdued his self, from whom desire has fled, he attains the supreme state of freedom from action through renunciation.
documents.searchText: bg.18.49 bg.18.49 chapter 18 verse 49 असकतबदध सरवतर जततम वगतसपह नषकरमयसदध परम सनयसनधगचछत 18.49 asakta-buddhih sarvatra jitatma vigata-sprihah naishkarmya-siddhim paramam sannyasenadhigachchhati he whose intellect is unattached everywhere who has subdued his self from whom desire has fled he attains the supreme state of freedom from action through renunciation.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.49 bg.18.49 chapter 18 verse 49 असक्तबुद्धिः सर्वत्र जितात्मा विगतस्पृहः।नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धिं परमां संन्यासेनाधिगच्छति।।18.49।। asakta-buddhiḥ sarvatra jitātmā vigata-spṛihaḥ
naiṣhkarmya-siddhiṁ paramāṁ sannyāsenādhigachchhati he whose intellect is unattached everywhere, who has subdued his self, from whom desire has fled, he attains the supreme state of freedom from action through renunciation.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.5
documents.iast: yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-karma na tyājyaṁ kāryam eva tat
documents.sanskrit: यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यं कार्यमेव तत्।यज्ञो दानं तपश्चैव पावनानि मनीषिणाम्।।18.
documents.summary: Acts of sacrifice, gift, and austerity should not be abandoned, but should be performed; for sacrifice, gift, and austerity are the purifiers of the wise.
documents.searchText: bg.18.5 bg.18.5 chapter 18 verse 5 यजञदनतपकरम न तयजय करयमव तत यजञ दन तपशचव पवनन मनषणम 18.5 yajna-dana-tapah-karma na tyajyam karyam eva tat yajno danam tapash chaiva pavanani manishinam acts of sacrifice gift and austerity should not be abandoned but should be performed for sacrifice gift and austerity are the purifiers of the wise.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.5 bg.18.5 chapter 18 verse 5 यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यं कार्यमेव तत्।यज्ञो दानं तपश्चैव पावनानि मनीषिणाम्।।18.5।। yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-karma na tyājyaṁ kāryam eva tat
yajño dānaṁ tapaśh chaiva pāvanāni manīṣhiṇām acts of sacrifice, gift, and austerity should not be abandoned, but should be performed; for sacrifice, gift, and austerity are the purifiers of the wise.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.50
documents.iast: siddhiṁ prāpto yathā brahma tathāpnoti nibodha me
documents.sanskrit: सिद्धिं प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाप्नोति निबोध मे।समासेनैव कौन्तेय निष्ठा ज्ञानस्य
documents.summary: Learn from Me, O Arjuna, in brief how one who has attained perfection reaches Brahman—the Eternal, that supreme state of knowledge.
documents.searchText: bg.18.50 bg.18.50 chapter 18 verse 50 सदध परपत यथ बरहम तथपनत नबध म समसनव कनतय नषठ जञनसय य पर 18.50 siddhim prapto yatha brahma tathapnoti nibodha me samasenaiva kaunteya nishtha jnanasya ya para learn from me o arjuna in brief how one who has attained perfection reaches brahman the eternal that supreme state of knowledge.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.50 bg.18.50 chapter 18 verse 50 सिद्धिं प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाप्नोति निबोध मे।समासेनैव कौन्तेय निष्ठा ज्ञानस्य या परा।।18.50।। siddhiṁ prāpto yathā brahma tathāpnoti nibodha me
samāsenaiva kaunteya niṣhṭhā jñānasya yā parā learn from me, o arjuna, in brief how one who has attained perfection reaches brahman—the eternal, that supreme state of knowledge.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.51
documents.iast: buddhyā viśhuddhayā yukto dhṛityātmānaṁ niyamya cha
documents.sanskrit: बुद्ध्या विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्याऽऽत्मानं नियम्य च।शब्दादीन् विषयांस्त्यक्त्वा रा
documents.summary: Endowed with a pure intellect, controlling the self through firmness, relinquishing sound and other objects and abandoning attraction and hatred.
documents.searchText: bg.18.51 bg.18.51 chapter 18 verse 51 बदधय वशदधय यकत धतयऽऽतमन नयमय च शबददन वषयसतयकतव रगदवष वयदसय च 18.51 buddhya vishuddhaya yukto dhrityatmanam niyamya cha shabdadin vishayans tyaktva raga-dveshau vyudasya cha endowed with a pure intellect controlling the self through firmness relinquishing sound and other objects and abandoning attraction and hatred.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.51 bg.18.51 chapter 18 verse 51 बुद्ध्या विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्याऽऽत्मानं नियम्य च।शब्दादीन् विषयांस्त्यक्त्वा रागद्वेषौ व्युदस्य च।।18.51।। buddhyā viśhuddhayā yukto dhṛityātmānaṁ niyamya cha
śhabdādīn viṣhayāns tyaktvā rāga-dveṣhau vyudasya cha endowed with a pure intellect, controlling the self through firmness, relinquishing sound and other objects and abandoning attraction and hatred.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.52
documents.sanskrit: विविक्तसेवी लघ्वाशी यतवाक्कायमानसः।ध्यानयोगपरो नित्यं वैराग्यं समुपाश्रितः।।18.5
documents.summary: Dwelling in solitude, eating sparingly, with speech, body, and mind subdued, always engaged in meditation and concentration, and resorting to dispassion.
documents.searchText: bg.18.52 bg.18.52 chapter 18 verse 52 ववकतसव लघवश यतवककयमनस धयनयगपर नतय वरगय समपशरत 18.52 vivikta-sevi laghv-ashi yata-vak-kaya-manasah dhyana-yoga-paro nityam vairagyam samupashritah dwelling in solitude eating sparingly with speech body and mind subdued always engaged in meditation and concentration and resorting to dispassion.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.52 bg.18.52 chapter 18 verse 52 विविक्तसेवी लघ्वाशी यतवाक्कायमानसः।ध्यानयोगपरो नित्यं वैराग्यं समुपाश्रितः।।18.52।। vivikta-sevī laghv-āśhī yata-vāk-kāya-mānasaḥ
dhyāna-yoga-paro nityaṁ vairāgyaṁ samupāśhritaḥ dwelling in solitude, eating sparingly, with speech, body, and mind subdued, always engaged in meditation and concentration, and resorting to dispassion.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.53
documents.iast: ahankāraṁ balaṁ darpaṁ kāmaṁ krodhaṁ parigraham
documents.sanskrit: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम्।विमुच्य निर्ममः शान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्प
documents.summary: Having abandoned egoism, strength, arrogance, desire, anger, and covetousness, and being free from the notion of 'mine' and peaceful, he is fit for becoming Brahman.
documents.searchText: bg.18.53 bg.18.53 chapter 18 verse 53 अहङकर बल दरप कम करध परगरहम वमचय नरमम शनत बरहमभयय कलपत 18.53 ahankaram balam darpam kamam krodham parigraham vimuchya nirmamah shanto brahma-bhuyaya kalpate having abandoned egoism strength arrogance desire anger and covetousness and being free from the notion of mine and peaceful he is fit for becoming brahman.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.53 bg.18.53 chapter 18 verse 53 अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम्।विमुच्य निर्ममः शान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते।।18.53।। ahankāraṁ balaṁ darpaṁ kāmaṁ krodhaṁ parigraham
vimuchya nirmamaḥ śhānto brahma-bhūyāya kalpate having abandoned egoism, strength, arrogance, desire, anger, and covetousness, and being free from the notion of 'mine' and peaceful, he is fit for becoming brahman.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.54
documents.iast: brahma-bhūtaḥ prasannātmā na śhochati na kāṅkṣhati
documents.sanskrit: ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति।समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्तिं लभते पर
documents.summary: Becoming Brahman, serene in the Self, he neither grieves nor desires; he is the same to all beings, and obtains supreme devotion to Me.
documents.searchText: bg.18.54 bg.18.54 chapter 18 verse 54 बरहमभत परसननतम न शचत न कङकषत सम सरवष भतष मदभकत लभत परम 18.54 brahma-bhutah prasannatma na shochati na kankshati samah sarveshu bhuteshu mad-bhaktim labhate param becoming brahman serene in the self he neither grieves nor desires he is the same to all beings and obtains supreme devotion to me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.54 bg.18.54 chapter 18 verse 54 ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति।समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्तिं लभते पराम्।।18.54।। brahma-bhūtaḥ prasannātmā na śhochati na kāṅkṣhati
samaḥ sarveṣhu bhūteṣhu mad-bhaktiṁ labhate parām becoming brahman, serene in the self, he neither grieves nor desires; he is the same to all beings, and obtains supreme devotion to me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.55
documents.iast: bhaktyā mām abhijānāti yāvān yaśh chāsmi tattvataḥ
documents.sanskrit: भक्त्या मामभिजानाति यावान्यश्चास्मि तत्त्वतः।ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदन
documents.summary: By devotion, he knows Me in truth, who and what I am; then, having known Me in truth, he immediately enters into the Supreme.
documents.searchText: bg.18.55 bg.18.55 chapter 18 verse 55 भकतय ममभजनत यवनयशचसम तततवत तत म तततवत जञतव वशत तदननतरम 18.55 bhaktya mam abhijanati yavan yash chasmi tattvatah tato mam tattvato jnatva vishate tad-anantaram by devotion he knows me in truth who and what i am then having known me in truth he immediately enters into the supreme.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.55 bg.18.55 chapter 18 verse 55 भक्त्या मामभिजानाति यावान्यश्चास्मि तत्त्वतः।ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम्।।18.55।। bhaktyā mām abhijānāti yāvān yaśh chāsmi tattvataḥ
tato māṁ tattvato jñātvā viśhate tad-anantaram by devotion, he knows me in truth, who and what i am; then, having known me in truth, he immediately enters into the supreme.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.56
documents.sanskrit: सर्वकर्माण्यपि सदा कुर्वाणो मद्व्यपाश्रयः।मत्प्रसादादवाप्नोति शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम्।
documents.summary: Having taken refuge in Me and doing all actions, by My grace he obtains the eternal, indestructible state of being.
documents.searchText: bg.18.56 bg.18.56 chapter 18 verse 56 सरवकरमणयप सद करवण मदवयपशरय मतपरसददवपनत शशवत पदमवययम 18.56 sarva-karmany api sada kurvano mad-vyapashrayah mat-prasadad avapnoti shashvatam padam avyayam having taken refuge in me and doing all actions by my grace he obtains the eternal indestructible state of being.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.56 bg.18.56 chapter 18 verse 56 सर्वकर्माण्यपि सदा कुर्वाणो मद्व्यपाश्रयः।मत्प्रसादादवाप्नोति शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम्।।18.56।। sarva-karmāṇy api sadā kurvāṇo mad-vyapāśhrayaḥ
mat-prasādād avāpnoti śhāśhvataṁ padam avyayam having taken refuge in me and doing all actions, by my grace he obtains the eternal, indestructible state of being.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.57
documents.sanskrit: चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः।बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव।।18
documents.summary: Mentally renouncing all actions in Me, having Me as the highest goal, and resorting to the yoga of discrimination, do thou ever fix thy mind on Me.
documents.searchText: bg.18.57 bg.18.57 chapter 18 verse 57 चतस सरवकरमण मय सनयसय मतपर बदधयगमपशरतय मचचतत सतत भव 18.57 chetasa sarva-karmani mayi sannyasya mat-parah buddhi-yogam upashritya mach-chittah satatam bhava mentally renouncing all actions in me having me as the highest goal and resorting to the yoga of discrimination do thou ever fix thy mind on me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.57 bg.18.57 chapter 18 verse 57 चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः।बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव।।18.57।। chetasā sarva-karmāṇi mayi sannyasya mat-paraḥ
buddhi-yogam upāśhritya mach-chittaḥ satataṁ bhava mentally renouncing all actions in me, having me as the highest goal, and resorting to the yoga of discrimination, do thou ever fix thy mind on me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.58
documents.sanskrit: मच्चित्तः सर्वदुर्गाणि मत्प्रसादात्तरिष्यसि।अथ चेत्त्वमहङ्कारान्न श्रोष्यसि विनङ
documents.summary: Fixing your mind on Me, you shall, by My grace, overcome all obstacles; but if you will not hear Me due to egoism, you shall perish.
documents.searchText: bg.18.58 bg.18.58 chapter 18 verse 58 मचचतत सरवदरगण मतपरसदततरषयस अथ चततवमहङकरनन शरषयस वनङकषयस 18.58 mach-chittah sarva-durgani mat-prasadat tarishyasi atha chet tvam ahankaran na shroshyasi vinankshyasi fixing your mind on me you shall by my grace overcome all obstacles but if you will not hear me due to egoism you shall perish.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.58 bg.18.58 chapter 18 verse 58 मच्चित्तः सर्वदुर्गाणि मत्प्रसादात्तरिष्यसि।अथ चेत्त्वमहङ्कारान्न श्रोष्यसि विनङ्क्ष्यसि।।18.58।। mach-chittaḥ sarva-durgāṇi mat-prasādāt tariṣhyasi
atha chet tvam ahankārān na śhroṣhyasi vinaṅkṣhyasi fixing your mind on me, you shall, by my grace, overcome all obstacles; but if you will not hear me due to egoism, you shall perish.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.59
documents.iast: yad ahankāram āśhritya na yotsya iti manyase
documents.sanskrit: यदहङ्कारमाश्रित्य न योत्स्य इति मन्यसे।मिथ्यैष व्यवसायस्ते प्रकृतिस्त्वां नियोक्
documents.summary: If, filled with egoism, thou thinkest, "I will not fight," then thy resolve is vain; nature will compel thee.
documents.searchText: bg.18.59 bg.18.59 chapter 18 verse 59 यदहङकरमशरतय न यतसय इत मनयस मथयष वयवसयसत परकतसतव नयकषयत 18.59 yad ahankaram ashritya na yotsya iti manyase mithyaisha vyavasayas te prakritis tvam niyokshyati if filled with egoism thou thinkest i will not fight then thy resolve is vain nature will compel thee.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.59 bg.18.59 chapter 18 verse 59 यदहङ्कारमाश्रित्य न योत्स्य इति मन्यसे।मिथ्यैष व्यवसायस्ते प्रकृतिस्त्वां नियोक्ष्यति।।18.59।। yad ahankāram āśhritya na yotsya iti manyase
mithyaiṣha vyavasāyas te prakṛitis tvāṁ niyokṣhyati if, filled with egoism, thou thinkest, "i will not fight," then thy resolve is vain; nature will compel thee.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.6
documents.iast: etāny api tu karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā phalāni cha
documents.sanskrit: एतान्यपि तु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलानि च।कर्तव्यानीति मे पार्थ निश्चितं मतमुत
documents.summary: But even these actions should be performed, leaving aside attachment and the desire for rewards, O Arjuna; this is my certain and most assured conviction.
documents.searchText: bg.18.6 bg.18.6 chapter 18 verse 6 एतनयप त करमण सङग तयकतव फलन च करतवयनत म परथ नशचत मतमततमम 18.6 etany api tu karmani sangam tyaktva phalani cha kartavyaniti me partha nishchitam matam uttamam but even these actions should be performed leaving aside attachment and the desire for rewards o arjuna this is my certain and most assured conviction.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.6 bg.18.6 chapter 18 verse 6 एतान्यपि तु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलानि च।कर्तव्यानीति मे पार्थ निश्चितं मतमुत्तमम्।।18.6।। etāny api tu karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā phalāni cha
kartavyānīti me pārtha niśhchitaṁ matam uttamam but even these actions should be performed, leaving aside attachment and the desire for rewards, o arjuna; this is my certain and most assured conviction.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.60
documents.sanskrit: स्वभावजेन कौन्तेय निबद्धः स्वेन कर्मणा।कर्तुं नेच्छसि यन्मोहात्करिष्यस्यवशोऽपि त
documents.summary: O Arjuna, bound by your own Karma (action) born of your own nature, that which from delusion you wish not to do, even that you shall do helplessly.
documents.searchText: bg.18.60 bg.18.60 chapter 18 verse 60 सवभवजन कनतय नबदध सवन करमण करत नचछस यनमहतकरषयसयवशऽप तत 18.60 swbhava-jena kaunteya nibaddhah svena karmana kartum nechchhasi yan mohat karishyasy avasho pi tat o arjuna bound by your own karma action born of your own nature that which from delusion you wish not to do even that you shall do helplessly.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.60 bg.18.60 chapter 18 verse 60 स्वभावजेन कौन्तेय निबद्धः स्वेन कर्मणा।कर्तुं नेच्छसि यन्मोहात्करिष्यस्यवशोऽपि तत्।।18.60।। swbhāva-jena kaunteya nibaddhaḥ svena karmaṇā
kartuṁ nechchhasi yan mohāt kariṣhyasy avaśho ’pi tat o arjuna, bound by your own karma (action) born of your own nature, that which from delusion you wish not to do, even that you shall do helplessly.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.61
documents.sanskrit: ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां हृद्देशेऽर्जुन तिष्ठति।भ्रामयन्सर्वभूतानि यन्त्रारूढानि मायया
documents.summary: The Lord dwells in the hearts of all beings, O Arjuna, causing all beings, by His illusory power, to revolve as if mounted on a machine.
documents.searchText: bg.18.61 bg.18.61 chapter 18 verse 61 ईशवर सरवभतन हददशऽरजन तषठत भरमयनसरवभतन यनतररढन मयय 18.61 ishvarah sarva-bhutanam hrid-deshe rjuna tishthati bhramayan sarva-bhutani yantrarudhani mayaya the lord dwells in the hearts of all beings o arjuna causing all beings by his illusory power to revolve as if mounted on a machine.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.61 bg.18.61 chapter 18 verse 61 ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां हृद्देशेऽर्जुन तिष्ठति।भ्रामयन्सर्वभूतानि यन्त्रारूढानि मायया।।18.61।। īśhvaraḥ sarva-bhūtānāṁ hṛid-deśhe ‘rjuna tiṣhṭhati
bhrāmayan sarva-bhūtāni yantrārūḍhāni māyayā the lord dwells in the hearts of all beings, o arjuna, causing all beings, by his illusory power, to revolve as if mounted on a machine.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.62
documents.iast: tam eva śharaṇaṁ gachchha sarva-bhāvena bhārata
documents.sanskrit: तमेव शरणं गच्छ सर्वभावेन भारत।तत्प्रसादात्परां शान्तिं स्थानं प्राप्स्यसि शाश्वत
documents.summary: Fly to Him for refuge with all your being, O Arjuna; by His grace you will obtain supreme peace and the eternal abode.
documents.searchText: bg.18.62 bg.18.62 chapter 18 verse 62 तमव शरण गचछ सरवभवन भरत ततपरसदतपर शनत सथन परपसयस शशवतम 18.62 tam eva sharanam gachchha sarva-bhavena bharata tat-prasadat param shantim sthanam prapsyasi shashvatam fly to him for refuge with all your being o arjuna by his grace you will obtain supreme peace and the eternal abode.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.62 bg.18.62 chapter 18 verse 62 तमेव शरणं गच्छ सर्वभावेन भारत।तत्प्रसादात्परां शान्तिं स्थानं प्राप्स्यसि शाश्वतम्।।18.62।। tam eva śharaṇaṁ gachchha sarva-bhāvena bhārata
tat-prasādāt parāṁ śhāntiṁ sthānaṁ prāpsyasi śhāśhvatam fly to him for refuge with all your being, o arjuna; by his grace you will obtain supreme peace and the eternal abode.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.63
documents.iast: iti te jñānam ākhyātaṁ guhyād guhyataraṁ mayā
documents.sanskrit: इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया।विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु।।18.
documents.summary: Thus, wisdom more secret than secrecy itself has been declared to you by me. Reflect on it fully, then act as you wish.
documents.searchText: bg.18.63 bg.18.63 chapter 18 verse 63 इत त जञनमखयत गहयदगहयतर मय वमशयतदशषण यथचछस तथ कर 18.63 iti te jnanam akhyatam guhyad guhyataram maya vimrishyaitad asheshena yathechchhasi tatha kuru thus wisdom more secret than secrecy itself has been declared to you by me. reflect on it fully then act as you wish.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.63 bg.18.63 chapter 18 verse 63 इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया।विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु।।18.63।। iti te jñānam ākhyātaṁ guhyād guhyataraṁ mayā
vimṛiśhyaitad aśheṣheṇa yathechchhasi tathā kuru thus, wisdom more secret than secrecy itself has been declared to you by me. reflect on it fully, then act as you wish.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.64
documents.iast: sarva-guhyatamaṁ bhūyaḥ śhṛiṇu me paramaṁ vachaḥ
documents.sanskrit: सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः श्रृणु मे परमं वचः।इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम्।
documents.summary: Hear again My supreme word, most secret of all; for you are dearly beloved of Me, I will tell you what is good.
documents.searchText: bg.18.64 bg.18.64 chapter 18 verse 64 सरवगहयतम भय शरण म परम वच इषटऽस म दढमत तत वकषयम त हतम 18.64 sarva-guhyatamam bhuyah shrinu me paramam vachah ishto si me dridham iti tato vakshyami te hitam hear again my supreme word most secret of all for you are dearly beloved of me i will tell you what is good.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.64 bg.18.64 chapter 18 verse 64 सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः श्रृणु मे परमं वचः।इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम्।।18.64।। sarva-guhyatamaṁ bhūyaḥ śhṛiṇu me paramaṁ vachaḥ
iṣhṭo ‘si me dṛiḍham iti tato vakṣhyāmi te hitam hear again my supreme word, most secret of all; for you are dearly beloved of me, i will tell you what is good.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.65
documents.iast: man-manā bhava mad-bhakto mad-yājī māṁ namaskuru
documents.sanskrit: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु।मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि
documents.summary: Fix your mind on Me, be devoted to Me, sacrifice to Me, bow down to Me. You will come to Me; I truly promise you this, for you are dear to Me.
documents.searchText: bg.18.65 bg.18.65 chapter 18 verse 65 मनमन भव मदभकत मदयज म नमसकर ममवषयस सतय त परतजन परयऽस म 18.65 man-mana bhava mad-bhakto mad-yaji mam namaskuru mam evaishyasi satyam te pratijane priyo si me fix your mind on me be devoted to me sacrifice to me bow down to me. you will come to me i truly promise you this for you are dear to me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.65 bg.18.65 chapter 18 verse 65 मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु।मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे।।18.65।। man-manā bhava mad-bhakto mad-yājī māṁ namaskuru
mām evaiṣhyasi satyaṁ te pratijāne priyo ‘si me fix your mind on me, be devoted to me, sacrifice to me, bow down to me. you will come to me; i truly promise you this, for you are dear to me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.66
documents.iast: sarva-dharmān parityajya mām ekaṁ śharaṇaṁ vraja
documents.sanskrit: सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज।अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुच
documents.summary: Abandon all duties and take refuge in Me alone; I will liberate you from all sins; do not grieve.
documents.searchText: bg.18.66 bg.18.66 chapter 18 verse 66 सरवधरमनपरतयजय ममक शरण वरज अह तव सरवपपभय मकषयषयम म शच 18.66 sarva-dharman parityajya mam ekam sharanam vraja aham tvam sarva-papebhyo mokshayishyami ma shuchah abandon all duties and take refuge in me alone i will liberate you from all sins do not grieve.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.66 bg.18.66 chapter 18 verse 66 सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज।अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः।।18.66।। sarva-dharmān parityajya mām ekaṁ śharaṇaṁ vraja
ahaṁ tvāṁ sarva-pāpebhyo mokṣhayiṣhyāmi mā śhuchaḥ abandon all duties and take refuge in me alone; i will liberate you from all sins; do not grieve.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.67
documents.sanskrit: इदं ते नातपस्काय नाभक्ताय कदाचन।न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां योऽभ्यसूयति।।18.67।
documents.summary: Never speak this to one who is devoid of austerities or devotion, who does not render service, who does not desire to listen, or who cavils at Me.
documents.searchText: bg.18.67 bg.18.67 chapter 18 verse 67 इद त नतपसकय नभकतय कदचन न चशशरषव वचय न च म यऽभयसयत 18.67 idam te natapaskyaya nabhaktaya kadachana na chashushrushave vachyam na cha mam yo bhyasutayi never speak this to one who is devoid of austerities or devotion who does not render service who does not desire to listen or who cavils at me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.67 bg.18.67 chapter 18 verse 67 इदं ते नातपस्काय नाभक्ताय कदाचन।न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां योऽभ्यसूयति।।18.67।। idaṁ te nātapaskyāya nābhaktāya kadāchana
na chāśhuśhruṣhave vāchyaṁ na cha māṁ yo ‘bhyasūtayi never speak this to one who is devoid of austerities or devotion, who does not render service, who does not desire to listen, or who cavils at me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.68
documents.iast: ya idaṁ paramaṁ guhyaṁ mad-bhakteṣhv abhidhāsyati
documents.sanskrit: य इमं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्वभिधास्यति।भक्तिं मयि परां कृत्वा मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः।
documents.summary: He who, with supreme devotion to Me, teaches this supreme secret to My devotees, shall undoubtedly come to Me.
documents.searchText: bg.18.68 bg.18.68 chapter 18 verse 68 य इम परम गहय मदभकतषवभधसयत भकत मय पर कतव ममवषयतयसशय 18.68 ya idam paramam guhyam mad-bhakteshv abhidhasyati bhaktim mayi param kritva mam evaishyaty asanshayah he who with supreme devotion to me teaches this supreme secret to my devotees shall undoubtedly come to me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.68 bg.18.68 chapter 18 verse 68 य इमं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्वभिधास्यति।भक्तिं मयि परां कृत्वा मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः।।18.68।। ya idaṁ paramaṁ guhyaṁ mad-bhakteṣhv abhidhāsyati
bhaktiṁ mayi parāṁ kṛitvā mām evaiṣhyaty asanśhayaḥ he who, with supreme devotion to me, teaches this supreme secret to my devotees, shall undoubtedly come to me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.69
documents.iast: na cha tasmān manuṣhyeṣhu kaśhchin me priya-kṛittamaḥ
documents.sanskrit: न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्चिन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः।भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुव
documents.summary: There is no one among men who does service dearer to Me, nor shall there be anyone on earth dearer to Me than him.
documents.searchText: bg.18.69 bg.18.69 chapter 18 verse 69 न च तसमनमनषयष कशचनम परयकततम भवत न च म तसमदनय परयतर भव 18.69 na cha tasman manushyeshu kashchin me priya-krittamah bhavita na cha me tasmad anyah priyataro bhuvi there is no one among men who does service dearer to me nor shall there be anyone on earth dearer to me than him.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.69 bg.18.69 chapter 18 verse 69 न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्चिन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः।भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि।।18.69।। na cha tasmān manuṣhyeṣhu kaśhchin me priya-kṛittamaḥ
bhavitā na cha me tasmād anyaḥ priyataro bhuvi there is no one among men who does service dearer to me, nor shall there be anyone on earth dearer to me than him.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.7
documents.sanskrit: नियतस्य तु संन्यासः कर्मणो नोपपद्यते।मोहात्तस्य परित्यागस्तामसः परिकीर्तितः।।18.
documents.summary: Verily, the renunciation of obligatory action is not proper; the abandonment of the same out of delusion is declared to be Tamasic.
documents.searchText: bg.18.7 bg.18.7 chapter 18 verse 7 नयतसय त सनयस करमण नपपदयत महततसय परतयगसतमस परकरतत 18.7 niyatasya tu sannyasah karmano nopapadyate mohat tasya parityagas tamasah parikirtitah verily the renunciation of obligatory action is not proper the abandonment of the same out of delusion is declared to be tamasic.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.7 bg.18.7 chapter 18 verse 7 नियतस्य तु संन्यासः कर्मणो नोपपद्यते।मोहात्तस्य परित्यागस्तामसः परिकीर्तितः।।18.7।। niyatasya tu sannyāsaḥ karmaṇo nopapadyate
mohāt tasya parityāgas tāmasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ verily, the renunciation of obligatory action is not proper; the abandonment of the same out of delusion is declared to be tamasic.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.70
documents.iast: adhyeṣhyate cha ya imaṁ dharmyaṁ saṁvādam āvayoḥ
documents.sanskrit: अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः।ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मतिः।
documents.summary: And he who studies this sacred dialogue of ours, by him I shall have been worshipped through the sacrifice of wisdom; such is my conviction.
documents.searchText: bg.18.70 bg.18.70 chapter 18 verse 70 अधयषयत च य इम धरमय सवदमवय जञनयजञन तनहमषट सयमत म मत 18.70 adhyeshyate cha ya imam dharmyam samvadam avayoh jnana-yajnena tenaham ishtah syam iti me matih and he who studies this sacred dialogue of ours by him i shall have been worshipped through the sacrifice of wisdom such is my conviction.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.70 bg.18.70 chapter 18 verse 70 अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः।ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मतिः।।18.70।। adhyeṣhyate cha ya imaṁ dharmyaṁ saṁvādam āvayoḥ
jñāna-yajñena tenāham iṣhṭaḥ syām iti me matiḥ and he who studies this sacred dialogue of ours, by him i shall have been worshipped through the sacrifice of wisdom; such is my conviction.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.71
documents.iast: śhraddhāvān anasūyaśh cha śhṛiṇuyād api yo naraḥ
documents.sanskrit: श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च श्रृणुयादपि यो नरः।सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्य
documents.summary: Also, the man who hears this, full of faith and free from malice, shall attain to the happy worlds of those of righteous deeds, and be liberated.
documents.searchText: bg.18.71 bg.18.71 chapter 18 verse 71 शरदधवननसयशच शरणयदप य नर सऽप मकत शभललकनपरपनयतपणयकरमणम 18.71 shraddhavan anasuyash cha shrinuyad api yo narah so pi muktah shubhal lokan prapnuyat punya-karmanam also the man who hears this full of faith and free from malice shall attain to the happy worlds of those of righteous deeds and be liberated.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.71 bg.18.71 chapter 18 verse 71 श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च श्रृणुयादपि यो नरः।सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यकर्मणाम्।।18.71।। śhraddhāvān anasūyaśh cha śhṛiṇuyād api yo naraḥ
so ‘pi muktaḥ śhubhāl lokān prāpnuyāt puṇya-karmaṇām also, the man who hears this, full of faith and free from malice, shall attain to the happy worlds of those of righteous deeds, and be liberated.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.72
documents.iast: kachchid etach chhrutaṁ pārtha tvayaikāgreṇa chetasā
documents.sanskrit: कच्चिदेतच्छ्रुतं पार्थ त्वयैकाग्रेण चेतसा।कच्चिदज्ञानसंमोहः प्रनष्टस्ते धनञ्जय।।
documents.summary: Has this been heard, O Arjuna, with one-pointed focus? Has the delusion of your ignorance been destroyed, O Dhananjaya?
documents.searchText: bg.18.72 bg.18.72 chapter 18 verse 72 कचचदतचछरत परथ तवयकगरण चतस कचचदजञनसमह परनषटसत धनञजय 18.72 kachchid etach chhrutam partha tvayaikagrena chetasa kachchid ajnana-sammohah pranashtas te dhananjaya has this been heard o arjuna with one-pointed focus has the delusion of your ignorance been destroyed o dhananjaya
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.72 bg.18.72 chapter 18 verse 72 कच्चिदेतच्छ्रुतं पार्थ त्वयैकाग्रेण चेतसा।कच्चिदज्ञानसंमोहः प्रनष्टस्ते धनञ्जय।।18.72।। kachchid etach chhrutaṁ pārtha tvayaikāgreṇa chetasā
kachchid ajñāna-sammohaḥ pranaṣhṭas te dhanañjaya has this been heard, o arjuna, with one-pointed focus? has the delusion of your ignorance been destroyed, o dhananjaya?

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.73
documents.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाचनष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत।स्थितोऽस्मि गतसन्देहः
documents.summary: Arjuna said, "My delusion has been destroyed, for I have gained my knowledge (memory) through Your grace, O Krishna. I am now free from doubts. I will act according to Your word."
documents.searchText: bg.18.73 bg.18.73 chapter 18 verse 73 अरजन उवचनषट मह समतरलबध तवतपरसदनमयचयत सथतऽसम गतसनदह करषय वचन तव 18.73 arjuna uvacha nashto mohah smritir labdha tvat-prasadan mayachyuta sthito smi gata-sandehah karishye vachanam tava arjuna said my delusion has been destroyed for i have gained my knowledge memory through your grace o krishna. i am now free from doubts. i will act according to your word.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.73 bg.18.73 chapter 18 verse 73 अर्जुन उवाचनष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत।स्थितोऽस्मि गतसन्देहः करिष्ये वचनं तव।।18.73।। arjuna uvācha
naṣhṭo mohaḥ smṛitir labdhā tvat-prasādān mayāchyuta
sthito ‘smi gata-sandehaḥ kariṣhye vachanaṁ tava arjuna said, "my delusion has been destroyed, for i have gained my knowledge (memory) through your grace, o krishna. i am now free from doubts. i will act according to your word."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.74
documents.sanskrit: सञ्जय उवाचइत्यहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः।संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम्
documents.summary: Sanjaya said, Thus, I have heard this wonderful dialogue between Krishna and the high-souled Arjuna, which causes one's hair to stand on end.
documents.searchText: bg.18.74 bg.18.74 chapter 18 verse 74 सञजय उवचइतयह वसदवसय परथसय च महतमन सवदमममशरषमदभत रमहरषणम 18.74 sanjaya uvacha ity aham vasudevasya parthasya cha mahatmanah samvadam imam ashrausham adbhutam roma-harshanam sanjaya said thus i have heard this wonderful dialogue between krishna and the high-souled arjuna which causes one s hair to stand on end.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.74 bg.18.74 chapter 18 verse 74 सञ्जय उवाचइत्यहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः।संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम्।।18.74।। sañjaya uvācha
ity ahaṁ vāsudevasya pārthasya cha mahātmanaḥ
saṁvādam imam aśhrauṣham adbhutaṁ roma-harṣhaṇam sanjaya said, thus, i have heard this wonderful dialogue between krishna and the high-souled arjuna, which causes one's hair to stand on end.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.75
documents.iast: vyāsa-prasādāch chhrutavān etad guhyam ahaṁ param
documents.summary: Through the grace of Vyasa, I have heard this supreme and most secret Yoga, directly from Krishna, the Lord of Yoga, Himself declaring it.
documents.searchText: bg.18.75 bg.18.75 chapter 18 verse 75 वयसपरसदचछरतवनतदगहयमह परम यग यगशवरतकषणतसकषतकथयत सवयम 18.75 vyasa-prasadach chhrutavan etad guhyam aham param yogam yogeshvarat krishnat sakshat kathayatah svayam through the grace of vyasa i have heard this supreme and most secret yoga directly from krishna the lord of yoga himself declaring it.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.75 bg.18.75 chapter 18 verse 75 व्यासप्रसादाच्छ्रुतवानेतद्गुह्यमहं परम्।योगं योगेश्वरात्कृष्णात्साक्षात्कथयतः स्वयम्।।18.75।। vyāsa-prasādāch chhrutavān etad guhyam ahaṁ param
yogaṁ yogeśhvarāt kṛiṣhṇāt sākṣhāt kathayataḥ svayam through the grace of vyasa, i have heard this supreme and most secret yoga, directly from krishna, the lord of yoga, himself declaring it.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.76
documents.iast: rājan sansmṛitya sansmṛitya saṁvādam imam adbhutam
documents.sanskrit: राजन्संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादमिममद्भुतम्।केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्
documents.summary: O King, remembering this wonderful and holy dialogue between Krishna and Arjuna, I continually rejoice.
documents.searchText: bg.18.76 bg.18.76 chapter 18 verse 76 रजनससमतय ससमतय सवदमममदभतम कशवरजनय पणय हषयम च महरमह 18.76 rajan sansmritya sansmritya samvadam imam adbhutam keshavarjunayoh punyam hrishyami cha muhur muhuh o king remembering this wonderful and holy dialogue between krishna and arjuna i continually rejoice.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.76 bg.18.76 chapter 18 verse 76 राजन्संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादमिममद्भुतम्।केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्मुहुः।।18.76।। rājan sansmṛitya sansmṛitya saṁvādam imam adbhutam
keśhavārjunayoḥ puṇyaṁ hṛiṣhyāmi cha muhur muhuḥ o king, remembering this wonderful and holy dialogue between krishna and arjuna, i continually rejoice.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.77
documents.iast: tach cha sansmṛitya saṁsmṛitya rūpam aty-adbhutaṁ hareḥ
documents.summary: And, remembering again and again that most wonderful form of Hari, I am filled with great wonder, O King; and I rejoice again and again.
documents.searchText: bg.18.77 bg.18.77 chapter 18 verse 77 तचच ससमतय ससमतय रपमतयदभत हर वसमय म महन रजन हषयम च पन पन 18.77 tach cha sansmritya samsmritya rupam aty-adbhutam hareh vismayo ye mahan rajan hrishyami cha punah punah and remembering again and again that most wonderful form of hari i am filled with great wonder o king and i rejoice again and again.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.77 bg.18.77 chapter 18 verse 77 तच्च संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य रूपमत्यद्भुतं हरेः।

विस्मयो मे महान् राजन् हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः।।18.77।। tach cha sansmṛitya saṁsmṛitya rūpam aty-adbhutaṁ hareḥ
vismayo ye mahān rājan hṛiṣhyāmi cha punaḥ punaḥ and, remembering again and again that most wonderful form of hari, i am filled with great wonder, o king; and i rejoice again and again.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.78
documents.iast: yatra yogeśhvaraḥ kṛiṣhṇo yatra pārtho dhanur-dharaḥ
documents.sanskrit: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः।
documents.summary: Wherever Krishna, the Lord of Yoga, is; and wherever Arjuna, the wielder of the bow, is; there is prosperity, victory, happiness, and a firm policy; this is my conviction.
documents.searchText: bg.18.78 bg.18.78 chapter 18 verse 78 यतर यगशवर कषण यतर परथ धनरधर ततर शररवजय भतरधरव नतरमतरमम 18.78 yatra yogeshvarah krishno yatra partho dhanur-dharah tatra shrir vijayo bhutir dhruva nitir matir mama wherever krishna the lord of yoga is and wherever arjuna the wielder of the bow is there is prosperity victory happiness and a firm policy this is my conviction.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.78 bg.18.78 chapter 18 verse 78 यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः।

तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम।।18.78। yatra yogeśhvaraḥ kṛiṣhṇo yatra pārtho dhanur-dharaḥ
tatra śhrīr vijayo bhūtir dhruvā nītir matir mama wherever krishna, the lord of yoga, is; and wherever arjuna, the wielder of the bow, is; there is prosperity, victory, happiness, and a firm policy; this is my conviction.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.8
documents.iast: duḥkham ity eva yat karma kāya-kleśha-bhayāt tyajet
documents.sanskrit: दुःखमित्येव यत्कर्म कायक्लेशभयात्त्यजेत्।स कृत्वा राजसं त्यागं नैव त्यागफलं लभेत
documents.summary: He who abandons action out of fear of bodily trouble (because it is painful), does not obtain the merit of renunciation by performing such Rajasic renunciation.
documents.searchText: bg.18.8 bg.18.8 chapter 18 verse 8 दखमतयव यतकरम कयकलशभयततयजत स कतव रजस तयग नव तयगफल लभत 18.8 duhkham ity eva yat karma kaya-klesha-bhayat tyajet sa kritva rajasam tyagam naiva tyaga-phalam labhet he who abandons action out of fear of bodily trouble because it is painful does not obtain the merit of renunciation by performing such rajasic renunciation.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.18.8 bg.18.8 chapter 18 verse 8 दुःखमित्येव यत्कर्म कायक्लेशभयात्त्यजेत्।स कृत्वा राजसं त्यागं नैव त्यागफलं लभेत्।।18.8।। duḥkham ity eva yat karma kāya-kleśha-bhayāt tyajet
sa kṛitvā rājasaṁ tyāgaṁ naiva tyāga-phalaṁ labhet he who abandons action out of fear of bodily trouble (because it is painful), does not obtain the merit of renunciation by performing such rajasic renunciation.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 18.9
documents.iast: kāryam ity eva yat karma niyataṁ kriyate ‘rjuna
documents.sanskrit: कार्यमित्येव यत्कर्म नियतं क्रियतेऽर्जुन।सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलं चैव स त्यागः सात्त्
documents.summary: Whatever obligatory action is done, O Arjuna, merely because it ought to be done, abandoning attachment and also the desire for reward, that renunciation is regarded as sattvic (pu

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.1
documents.summary: Sanjaya said: To him, who was thus overcome with pity, despondent, with eyes full of tears and agitated, Madhusudana (the destroyer of Madhu) or Krishna spoke these words.
documents.searchText: bg.2.1 bg.2.1 chapter 2 verse 1 सञजय उवच त तथ कपयऽवषटमशरपरणकलकषणम वषदनतमद वकयमवच मधसदन 2.1 sanjaya uvacha tam tatha kripayavishtamashru purnakulekshanam vishidantamidam vakyam uvacha madhusudanah sanjaya said to him who was thus overcome with pity despondent with eyes full of tears and agitated madhusudana the destroyer of madhu or krishna spoke these words.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.1 bg.2.1 chapter 2 verse 1 सञ्जय उवाच

तं तथा कृपयाऽविष्टमश्रुपूर्णाकुलेक्षणम्।

विषीदन्तमिदं वाक्यमुवाच मधुसूदनः।।2.1।। sañjaya uvācha
taṁ tathā kṛipayāviṣhṭamaśhru pūrṇākulekṣhaṇam
viṣhīdantamidaṁ vākyam uvācha madhusūdanaḥ sanjaya said: to him, who was thus overcome with pity, despondent, with eyes full of tears and agitated, madhusudana (the destroyer of madhu) or krishna spoke these words.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.10
documents.summary: To him who was despondent in the midst of the two armies, Krishna, smiling, O Bharata, spoke these words.
documents.searchText: bg.2.10 bg.2.10 chapter 2 verse 10 तमवच हषकश परहसननव भरत सनयरभयरमधय वषदनतमद वच 2.10 tam-uvacha hrishikeshah prahasanniva bharata senayorubhayor-madhye vishidantam-idam vachah to him who was despondent in the midst of the two armies krishna smiling o bharata spoke these words.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.10 bg.2.10 chapter 2 verse 10 तमुवाच हृषीकेशः प्रहसन्निव भारत।

सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये विषीदन्तमिदं वचः।।2.10।। tam-uvācha hṛiṣhīkeśhaḥ prahasanniva bhārata
senayorubhayor-madhye viṣhīdantam-idaṁ vachaḥ to him who was despondent in the midst of the two armies, krishna, smiling, o bharata, spoke these words.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.11
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, "You have grieved for those who should not be grieved for; yet, you speak words of wisdom. The wise grieve neither for the living nor for the dead."
