documents.searchText: bg.2.11 bg.2.11 chapter 2 verse 11 शर भगवनवच अशचयननवशचसतव परजञवदशच भषस गतसनगतसशच ननशचनत पणडत 2.11 shri bhagavan uvacha ashochyan-anvashochas-tvam prajna-vadansh cha bhashase gatasun-agatasunsh-cha nanushochanti panditah the blessed lord said you have grieved for those who should not be grieved for yet you speak words of wisdom. the wise grieve neither for the living nor for the dead.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.11 bg.2.11 chapter 2 verse 11 श्री भगवानुवाच

अशोच्यानन्वशोचस्त्वं प्रज्ञावादांश्च भाषसे।

गतासूनगतासूंश्च नानुशोचन्ति पण्डिताः।।2.11।। śhrī bhagavān uvācha
aśhochyān-anvaśhochas-tvaṁ prajñā-vādānśh cha bhāṣhase
gatāsūn-agatāsūnśh-cha nānuśhochanti paṇḍitāḥ the blessed lord said, "you have grieved for those who should not be grieved for; yet, you speak words of wisdom. the wise grieve neither for the living nor for the dead."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.12
documents.iast: na tvevāhaṁ jātu nāsaṁ na tvaṁ neme janādhipāḥ
documents.sanskrit: न त्वेवाहं जातु नासं न त्वं नेमे जनाधिपाः।
documents.summary: Nor, at any time, was I not, nor thou, nor these rulers of men; nor, verily, shall we ever cease to be hereafter.
documents.searchText: bg.2.12 bg.2.12 chapter 2 verse 12 न तववह जत नस न तव नम जनधप न चव न भवषयम सरव वयमत परम 2.12 na tvevaham jatu nasam na tvam neme janadhipah na chaiva na bhavishyamah sarve vayamatah param nor at any time was i not nor thou nor these rulers of men nor verily shall we ever cease to be hereafter.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.12 bg.2.12 chapter 2 verse 12 न त्वेवाहं जातु नासं न त्वं नेमे जनाधिपाः।

न चैव न भविष्यामः सर्वे वयमतः परम्।।2.12।। na tvevāhaṁ jātu nāsaṁ na tvaṁ neme janādhipāḥ
na chaiva na bhaviṣhyāmaḥ sarve vayamataḥ param nor, at any time, was i not, nor thou, nor these rulers of men; nor, verily, shall we ever cease to be hereafter.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.13
documents.iast: dehino ’smin yathā dehe kaumāraṁ yauvanaṁ jarā
documents.summary: Just as the embodied soul passes through childhood, youth, and old age in this body, so too does it pass into another body; the steadfast one does not grieve over this.
documents.searchText: bg.2.13 bg.2.13 chapter 2 verse 13 दहनऽसमनयथ दह कमर यवन जर तथ दहनतरपरपतरधरसततर न महयत 2.13 dehino smin yatha dehe kaumaram yauvanam jara tatha dehantara-praptir dhiras tatra na muhyati just as the embodied soul passes through childhood youth and old age in this body so too does it pass into another body the steadfast one does not grieve over this.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.13 bg.2.13 chapter 2 verse 13 देहिनोऽस्मिन्यथा देहे कौमारं यौवनं जरा।

तथा देहान्तरप्राप्तिर्धीरस्तत्र न मुह्यति।।2.13।। dehino ’smin yathā dehe kaumāraṁ yauvanaṁ jarā
tathā dehāntara-prāptir dhīras tatra na muhyati just as the embodied soul passes through childhood, youth, and old age in this body, so too does it pass into another body; the steadfast one does not grieve over this.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.14
documents.summary: The contact of the senses with the objects, O son of Kunti, which causes heat and cold, pleasure and pain, has a beginning and an end; they are impermanent; endure them bravely, O
documents.searchText: bg.2.14 bg.2.14 chapter 2 verse 14 मतरसपरशसत कनतय शतषणसखदखद आगमपयनऽनतयसतसततकषसव भरत 2.14 matra-sparshas tu kaunteya shitoshna-sukha-duhkha-dah agamapayino nityas tans-titikshasva bharata the contact of the senses with the objects o son of kunti which causes heat and cold pleasure and pain has a beginning and an end they are impermanent endure them bravely o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.14 bg.2.14 chapter 2 verse 14 मात्रास्पर्शास्तु कौन्तेय शीतोष्णसुखदुःखदाः।

आगमापायिनोऽनित्यास्तांस्तितिक्षस्व भारत।।2.14।। mātrā-sparśhās tu kaunteya śhītoṣhṇa-sukha-duḥkha-dāḥ
āgamāpāyino ’nityās tans-titikṣhasva bhārata the contact of the senses with the objects, o son of kunti, which causes heat and cold, pleasure and pain, has a beginning and an end; they are impermanent; endure them bravely, o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.15
documents.iast: yaṁ hi na vyathayantyete puruṣhaṁ puruṣharṣhabha
documents.sanskrit: यं हि न व्यथयन्त्येते पुरुषं पुरुषर्षभ।
documents.summary: That firm man, whom surely these afflictions do not, O chief among men, to whom pleasure and pain are the same, is fit for attaining immortality.
documents.searchText: bg.2.15 bg.2.15 chapter 2 verse 15 य ह न वयथयनतयत परष परषरषभ समदखसख धर सऽमततवय कलपत 2.15 yam hi na vyathayantyete purusham purusharshabha sama-duhkha-sukham dhiram so mritatvaya kalpate that firm man whom surely these afflictions do not o chief among men to whom pleasure and pain are the same is fit for attaining immortality.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.15 bg.2.15 chapter 2 verse 15 यं हि न व्यथयन्त्येते पुरुषं पुरुषर्षभ।

समदुःखसुखं धीरं सोऽमृतत्वाय कल्पते।।2.15।। yaṁ hi na vyathayantyete puruṣhaṁ puruṣharṣhabha
sama-duḥkha-sukhaṁ dhīraṁ so ’mṛitatvāya kalpate that firm man, whom surely these afflictions do not, o chief among men, to whom pleasure and pain are the same, is fit for attaining immortality.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.16
documents.iast: nāsato vidyate bhāvo nābhāvo vidyate sataḥ
documents.sanskrit: नासतो विद्यते भावो नाभावो विद्यते सतः।
documents.summary: The unreal has no being; there is no non-being of the real; the truth about both has been seen by the knowers of the truth (or the seers of the essence).
documents.searchText: bg.2.16 bg.2.16 chapter 2 verse 16 नसत वदयत भव नभव वदयत सत उभयरप दषटऽनतसतवनयसतततवदरशभ 2.16 nasato vidyate bhavo nabhavo vidyate satah ubhayorapi drishto nta stvanayos tattva-darshibhih the unreal has no being there is no non-being of the real the truth about both has been seen by the knowers of the truth or the seers of the essence .
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.16 bg.2.16 chapter 2 verse 16 नासतो विद्यते भावो नाभावो विद्यते सतः।

उभयोरपि दृष्टोऽन्तस्त्वनयोस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः।।2.16।। nāsato vidyate bhāvo nābhāvo vidyate sataḥ
ubhayorapi dṛiṣhṭo ’nta stvanayos tattva-darśhibhiḥ the unreal has no being; there is no non-being of the real; the truth about both has been seen by the knowers of the truth (or the seers of the essence).

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.17
documents.iast: avināśhi tu tadviddhi yena sarvam idaṁ tatam
documents.sanskrit: अविनाशि तु तद्विद्धि येन सर्वमिदं ततम्।
documents.summary: Know that to be indestructible, by which all this is pervaded. No one can cause the destruction of that, the Imperishable.
documents.searchText: bg.2.17 bg.2.17 chapter 2 verse 17 अवनश त तदवदध यन सरवमद ततम वनशमवययसयसय न कशचत करतमरहत 2.17 avinashi tu tadviddhi yena sarvam idam tatam vinasham avyayasyasya na kashchit kartum arhati know that to be indestructible by which all this is pervaded. no one can cause the destruction of that the imperishable.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.17 bg.2.17 chapter 2 verse 17 अविनाशि तु तद्विद्धि येन सर्वमिदं ततम्।

विनाशमव्ययस्यास्य न कश्चित् कर्तुमर्हति।।2.17।। avināśhi tu tadviddhi yena sarvam idaṁ tatam
vināśham avyayasyāsya na kaśhchit kartum arhati know that to be indestructible, by which all this is pervaded. no one can cause the destruction of that, the imperishable.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.18
documents.summary: These bodies of the embodied Self, which are eternal, indestructible, and immeasurable, are said to have an end. Therefore, fight, O Arjuna.
documents.searchText: bg.2.18 bg.2.18 chapter 2 verse 18 अनतवनत इम दह नतयसयकत शररण अनशनऽपरमयसय तसमदयधयसव भरत 2.18 antavanta ime deha nityasyoktah sharirinah anashino prameyasya tasmad yudhyasva bharata these bodies of the embodied self which are eternal indestructible and immeasurable are said to have an end. therefore fight o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.18 bg.2.18 chapter 2 verse 18 अन्तवन्त इमे देहा नित्यस्योक्ताः शरीरिणः।

अनाशिनोऽप्रमेयस्य तस्माद्युध्यस्व भारत।।2.18।। antavanta ime dehā nityasyoktāḥ śharīriṇaḥ
anāśhino ’prameyasya tasmād yudhyasva bhārata these bodies of the embodied self, which are eternal, indestructible, and immeasurable, are said to have an end. therefore, fight, o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.19
documents.iast: ya enaṁ vetti hantāraṁ yaśh chainaṁ manyate hatam
documents.sanskrit: य एनं वेत्ति हन्तारं यश्चैनं मन्यते हतम्।
documents.summary: He who takes the Self to be the slayer and he who thinks it is slain, neither of them knows. It does not slay, nor is it slain.
documents.searchText: bg.2.19 bg.2.19 chapter 2 verse 19 य एन वतत हनतर यशचन मनयत हतम उभ त न वजनत नय हनत न हनयत 2.19 ya enam vetti hantaram yash chainam manyate hatam ubhau tau na vijanito nayam hanti na hanyate he who takes the self to be the slayer and he who thinks it is slain neither of them knows. it does not slay nor is it slain.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.19 bg.2.19 chapter 2 verse 19 य एनं वेत्ति हन्तारं यश्चैनं मन्यते हतम्।

उभौ तौ न विजानीतो नायं हन्ति न हन्यते।।2.19।। ya enaṁ vetti hantāraṁ yaśh chainaṁ manyate hatam
ubhau tau na vijānīto nāyaṁ hanti na hanyate he who takes the self to be the slayer and he who thinks it is slain, neither of them knows. it does not slay, nor is it slain.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.2
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, "From whence has this perilous strait come upon you, this dejection which is unworthy of you, disgraceful, and which will close the gates of heaven upon you,
documents.searchText: bg.2.2 bg.2.2 chapter 2 verse 2 शर भगवनवच कतसतव कशमलमद वषम समपसथतम अनरयजषटमसवरगयमकरतकरमरजन 2.2 shri bhagavan uvacha kutastva kashmalamidam vishame samupasthitam anarya-jushtamaswargyam akirti-karam arjuna the blessed lord said from whence has this perilous strait come upon you this dejection which is unworthy of you disgraceful and which will close the gates of heaven upon you o arjuna
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.2 bg.2.2 chapter 2 verse 2 श्री भगवानुवाच

कुतस्त्वा कश्मलमिदं विषमे समुपस्थितम्।

अनार्यजुष्टमस्वर्ग्यमकीर्तिकरमर्जुन।।2.2।। śhrī bhagavān uvācha
kutastvā kaśhmalamidaṁ viṣhame samupasthitam
anārya-juṣhṭamaswargyam akīrti-karam arjuna the blessed lord said, "from whence has this perilous strait come upon you, this dejection which is unworthy of you, disgraceful, and which will close the gates of heaven upon you, o arjuna?"

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.20
documents.summary: It is not born, nor does it ever die; after having been, it again does not cease to be; unborn, eternal, changeless, and ancient, it is not killed when the body is killed.
documents.searchText: bg.2.20 bg.2.20 chapter 2 verse 20 न जयत मरयत व कदच ननय भतव भवत व न भय अज नतय शशवतऽय परण न हनयत हनयमन शरर 2.20 na jayate mriyate va kadachin nayam bhutva bhavita va na bhuyah ajo nityah shashvato yam purano na hanyate hanyamane sharire it is not born nor does it ever die after having been it again does not cease to be unborn eternal changeless and ancient it is not killed when the body is killed.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.20 bg.2.20 chapter 2 verse 20 न जायते म्रियते वा कदाचि

न्नायं भूत्वा भविता वा न भूयः।

अजो नित्यः शाश्वतोऽयं पुराणो

न हन्यते हन्यमाने शरीरे।।2.20।। na jāyate mriyate vā kadāchin
nāyaṁ bhūtvā bhavitā vā na bhūyaḥ
ajo nityaḥ śhāśhvato ’yaṁ purāṇo
na hanyate hanyamāne śharīre it is not born, nor does it ever die; after having been, it again does not cease to be; unborn, eternal, changeless, and ancient, it is not killed when the body is killed.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.21
documents.iast: vedāvināśhinaṁ nityaṁ ya enam ajam avyayam
documents.summary: Whoever knows it to be indestructible, eternal, unborn, and inexhaustible, how can that person slay, O Arjuna, or cause to be slain?
documents.searchText: bg.2.21 bg.2.21 chapter 2 verse 21 वदवनशन नतय य एनमजमवययम कथ स परष परथ क घतयत हनत कम 2.21 vedavinashinam nityam ya enam ajam avyayam katham sa purushah partha kam ghatayati hanti kam whoever knows it to be indestructible eternal unborn and inexhaustible how can that person slay o arjuna or cause to be slain
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.21 bg.2.21 chapter 2 verse 21 वेदाविनाशिनं नित्यं य एनमजमव्ययम्।

कथं स पुरुषः पार्थ कं घातयति हन्ति कम्।।2.21।। vedāvināśhinaṁ nityaṁ ya enam ajam avyayam
kathaṁ sa puruṣhaḥ pārtha kaṁ ghātayati hanti kam whoever knows it to be indestructible, eternal, unborn, and inexhaustible, how can that person slay, o arjuna, or cause to be slain?

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.22
documents.summary: Just as a man casts off worn-out clothes and puts on new ones, so too the embodied Self casts off worn-out bodies and enters others that are new.
documents.searchText: bg.2.22 bg.2.22 chapter 2 verse 22 वसस जरणन यथ वहय नवन गहणत नरऽपरण तथ शररण वहय जरण नयनयन सयत नवन दह 2.22 vasansi jirnani yatha vihaya navani grihnati naro parani tatha sharirani vihaya jirnanya nyani sanyati navani dehi just as a man casts off worn-out clothes and puts on new ones so too the embodied self casts off worn-out bodies and enters others that are new.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.22 bg.2.22 chapter 2 verse 22 वासांसि जीर्णानि यथा विहाय

नवानि गृह्णाति नरोऽपराणि।

तथा शरीराणि विहाय जीर्णा

न्यन्यानि संयाति नवानि देही।।2.22।। vāsānsi jīrṇāni yathā vihāya
navāni gṛihṇāti naro ’parāṇi
tathā śharīrāṇi vihāya jīrṇānya
nyāni sanyāti navāni dehī just as a man casts off worn-out clothes and puts on new ones, so too the embodied self casts off worn-out bodies and enters others that are new.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.23
documents.iast: nainaṁ chhindanti śhastrāṇi nainaṁ dahati pāvakaḥ
documents.sanskrit: नैनं छिन्दन्ति शस्त्राणि नैनं दहति पावकः।
documents.summary: Weapons cannot cut it, fire cannot burn it, water cannot wet it, wind cannot dry it.
documents.searchText: bg.2.23 bg.2.23 chapter 2 verse 23 नन छनदनत शसतरण नन दहत पवक न चन कलदयनतयप न शषयत मरत 2.23 nainam chhindanti shastrani nainam dahati pavakah na chainam kledayantyapo na shoshayati marutah weapons cannot cut it fire cannot burn it water cannot wet it wind cannot dry it.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.23 bg.2.23 chapter 2 verse 23 नैनं छिन्दन्ति शस्त्राणि नैनं दहति पावकः।

न चैनं क्लेदयन्त्यापो न शोषयति मारुतः।।2.23।। nainaṁ chhindanti śhastrāṇi nainaṁ dahati pāvakaḥ
na chainaṁ kledayantyāpo na śhoṣhayati mārutaḥ weapons cannot cut it, fire cannot burn it, water cannot wet it, wind cannot dry it.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.24
documents.summary: This Self cannot be cut, burned, wetted, nor dried up; it is eternal, all-pervasive, stable, immovable, and ancient.
documents.searchText: bg.2.24 bg.2.24 chapter 2 verse 24 अचछदयऽयमदहयऽयमकलदयऽशषय एव च नतय सरवगत सथणरचलऽय सनतन 2.24 achchhedyo yam adahyo yam akledyo shoshya eva cha nityah sarva-gatah sthanur achalo yam sanatanah this self cannot be cut burned wetted nor dried up it is eternal all-pervasive stable immovable and ancient.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.24 bg.2.24 chapter 2 verse 24 अच्छेद्योऽयमदाह्योऽयमक्लेद्योऽशोष्य एव च।

नित्यः सर्वगतः स्थाणुरचलोऽयं सनातनः।।2.24।। achchhedyo ’yam adāhyo ’yam akledyo ’śhoṣhya eva cha
nityaḥ sarva-gataḥ sthāṇur achalo ’yaṁ sanātanaḥ this self cannot be cut, burned, wetted, nor dried up; it is eternal, all-pervasive, stable, immovable, and ancient.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.25
documents.summary: This Self is said to be unmanifested, unthinkable, and unchangeable. Therefore, knowing this to be so, you should not grieve.
documents.searchText: bg.2.25 bg.2.25 chapter 2 verse 25 अवयकतऽयमचनतयऽयमवकरयऽयमचयत तसमदव वदतवन ननशचतमरहस 2.25 avyakto yam achintyo yam avikaryo yam uchyate tasmadevam viditvainam nanushochitum arhasi this self is said to be unmanifested unthinkable and unchangeable. therefore knowing this to be so you should not grieve.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.25 bg.2.25 chapter 2 verse 25 अव्यक्तोऽयमचिन्त्योऽयमविकार्योऽयमुच्यते।

तस्मादेवं विदित्वैनं नानुशोचितुमर्हसि।।2.25।। avyakto ’yam achintyo ’yam avikāryo ’yam uchyate
tasmādevaṁ viditvainaṁ nānuśhochitum arhasi this self is said to be unmanifested, unthinkable, and unchangeable. therefore, knowing this to be so, you should not grieve.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.26
documents.iast: atha chainaṁ nitya-jātaṁ nityaṁ vā manyase mṛitam
documents.sanskrit: अथ चैनं नित्यजातं नित्यं वा मन्यसे मृतम्।
documents.summary: But even if thou thinkest of It as constantly being born and constantly dying, even then, O mighty-armed one, thou shouldst not grieve.
documents.searchText: bg.2.26 bg.2.26 chapter 2 verse 26 अथ चन नतयजत नतय व मनयस मतम तथप तव महबह नव शचतमरहस 2.26 atha chainam nitya-jatam nityam va manyase mritam tathapi tvam maha-baho naivam shochitum arhasi but even if thou thinkest of it as constantly being born and constantly dying even then o mighty-armed one thou shouldst not grieve.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.26 bg.2.26 chapter 2 verse 26 अथ चैनं नित्यजातं नित्यं वा मन्यसे मृतम्।

तथापि त्वं महाबाहो नैवं शोचितुमर्हसि।।2.26।। atha chainaṁ nitya-jātaṁ nityaṁ vā manyase mṛitam
tathāpi tvaṁ mahā-bāho naivaṁ śhochitum arhasi but even if thou thinkest of it as constantly being born and constantly dying, even then, o mighty-armed one, thou shouldst not grieve.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.27
documents.iast: jātasya hi dhruvo mṛityur dhruvaṁ janma mṛitasya cha
documents.sanskrit: जातस्य हि ध्रुवो मृत्युर्ध्रुवं जन्म मृतस्य च।
documents.summary: For the born, death is certain, and for the dead, birth is certain; therefore, you should not grieve over the inevitable.
documents.searchText: bg.2.27 bg.2.27 chapter 2 verse 27 जतसय ह धरव मतयरधरव जनम मतसय च तसमदपरहरयऽरथ न तव शचतमरहस 2.27 jatasya hi dhruvo mrityur dhruvam janma mritasya cha tasmad apariharye rthe na tvam shochitum arhasi for the born death is certain and for the dead birth is certain therefore you should not grieve over the inevitable.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.27 bg.2.27 chapter 2 verse 27 जातस्य हि ध्रुवो मृत्युर्ध्रुवं जन्म मृतस्य च।

तस्मादपरिहार्येऽर्थे न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि।।2.27।। jātasya hi dhruvo mṛityur dhruvaṁ janma mṛitasya cha
tasmād aparihārye ’rthe na tvaṁ śhochitum arhasi for the born, death is certain, and for the dead, birth is certain; therefore, you should not grieve over the inevitable.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.28
documents.summary: Beings are unmanifest in their beginning, manifest in their middle state, O Arjuna, and unmanifest again in their end. What is there to grieve about?
documents.searchText: bg.2.28 bg.2.28 chapter 2 verse 28 अवयकतदन भतन वयकतमधयन भरत अवयकतनधननयव ततर क परदवन 2.28 avyaktadini bhutani vyakta-madhyani bharata avyakta-nidhananyeva tatra ka paridevana beings are unmanifest in their beginning manifest in their middle state o arjuna and unmanifest again in their end. what is there to grieve about
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.28 bg.2.28 chapter 2 verse 28 अव्यक्तादीनि भूतानि व्यक्तमध्यानि भारत।

अव्यक्तनिधनान्येव तत्र का परिदेवना।।2.28।। avyaktādīni bhūtāni vyakta-madhyāni bhārata
avyakta-nidhanānyeva tatra kā paridevanā beings are unmanifest in their beginning, manifest in their middle state, o arjuna, and unmanifest again in their end. what is there to grieve about?

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.29
documents.summary: One sees this (the Self) as a wonder; another speaks of it as a wonder; another hears of it as a wonder; yet, having heard, none understands it at all.
documents.searchText: bg.2.29 bg.2.29 chapter 2 verse 29 आशचरयवतपशयत कशचदन मशचरयवदवदत तथव चनय आशचरयवचचनमनय शरणत शरतवपयन वद न चव कशचत 2.29 ashcharya-vat pashyati kashchid enan ashcharya-vad vadati tathaiva chanyah ashcharya-vach chainam anyah shrinoti shrutvapyenam veda na chaiva kashchit one sees this the self as a wonder another speaks of it as a wonder another hears of it as a wonder yet having heard none understands it at all.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.29 bg.2.29 chapter 2 verse 29 आश्चर्यवत्पश्यति कश्चिदेन

माश्चर्यवद्वदति तथैव चान्यः।

आश्चर्यवच्चैनमन्यः श्रृणोति

श्रुत्वाप्येनं वेद न चैव कश्चित्।।2.29।। āśhcharya-vat paśhyati kaśhchid enan
āśhcharya-vad vadati tathaiva chānyaḥ
āśhcharya-vach chainam anyaḥ śhṛiṇoti
śhrutvāpyenaṁ veda na chaiva kaśhchit one sees this (the self) as a wonder; another speaks of it as a wonder; another hears of it as a wonder; yet, having heard, none understands it at all.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.3
documents.iast: klaibyaṁ mā sma gamaḥ pārtha naitat tvayyupapadyate
documents.sanskrit: क्लैब्यं मा स्म गमः पार्थ नैतत्त्वय्युपपद्यते।
documents.summary: Do not yield to impotence, O Arjuna, son of Pritha. It does not befit you. Cast off this mean weakness of the heart! Stand up, O conqueror of foes!
documents.searchText: bg.2.3 bg.2.3 chapter 2 verse 3 कलबय म सम गम परथ नतततवययपपदयत कषदर हदयदरबलय तयकतवततषठ परनतप 2.3 klaibyam ma sma gamah partha naitat tvayyupapadyate kshudram hridaya-daurbalyam tyaktvottishtha parantapa do not yield to impotence o arjuna son of pritha. it does not befit you. cast off this mean weakness of the heart stand up o conqueror of foes
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.3 bg.2.3 chapter 2 verse 3 क्लैब्यं मा स्म गमः पार्थ नैतत्त्वय्युपपद्यते।

क्षुद्रं हृदयदौर्बल्यं त्यक्त्वोत्तिष्ठ परन्तप।।2.3।। klaibyaṁ mā sma gamaḥ pārtha naitat tvayyupapadyate
kṣhudraṁ hṛidaya-daurbalyaṁ tyaktvottiṣhṭha parantapa do not yield to impotence, o arjuna, son of pritha. it does not befit you. cast off this mean weakness of the heart! stand up, o conqueror of foes!

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.30
documents.iast: dehī nityam avadhyo ’yaṁ dehe sarvasya bhārata
documents.summary: This indweller in the body of everyone is ever indestructible, O Arjuna; therefore, you should not grieve for any creature.
documents.searchText: bg.2.30 bg.2.30 chapter 2 verse 30 दह नतयमवधयऽय दह सरवसय भरत तसमतसरवण भतन न तव शचतमरहस 2.30 dehi nityam avadhyo yam dehe sarvasya bharata tasmat sarvani bhutani na tvam shochitum arhasi this indweller in the body of everyone is ever indestructible o arjuna therefore you should not grieve for any creature.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.30 bg.2.30 chapter 2 verse 30 देही नित्यमवध्योऽयं देहे सर्वस्य भारत।

तस्मात्सर्वाणि भूतानि न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि।।2.30।। dehī nityam avadhyo ’yaṁ dehe sarvasya bhārata
tasmāt sarvāṇi bhūtāni na tvaṁ śhochitum arhasi this indweller in the body of everyone is ever indestructible, o arjuna; therefore, you should not grieve for any creature.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.31
documents.iast: swa-dharmam api chāvekṣhya na vikampitum arhasi
documents.summary: Further, having regard to your duty, you should not waver, for there is nothing higher for a Kshatriya than a righteous war.
documents.searchText: bg.2.31 bg.2.31 chapter 2 verse 31 सवधरममप चवकषय न वकमपतमरहस धरमयदध यदधछरयऽनयतकषतरयसय न वदयत 2.31 swa-dharmam api chavekshya na vikampitum arhasi dharmyaddhi yuddhach chhreyo nyat kshatriyasya na vidyate further having regard to your duty you should not waver for there is nothing higher for a kshatriya than a righteous war.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.31 bg.2.31 chapter 2 verse 31 स्वधर्ममपि चावेक्ष्य न विकम्पितुमर्हसि।

धर्म्याद्धि युद्धाछ्रेयोऽन्यत्क्षत्रियस्य न विद्यते।।2.31।। swa-dharmam api chāvekṣhya na vikampitum arhasi
dharmyāddhi yuddhāch chhreyo ’nyat kṣhatriyasya na vidyate further, having regard to your duty, you should not waver, for there is nothing higher for a kshatriya than a righteous war.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.32
documents.summary: Happy are the Kshatriyas, O Arjuna! who are called to fight in such a battle that comes of its own accord as an open door to heaven.
documents.searchText: bg.2.32 bg.2.32 chapter 2 verse 32 यदचछय चपपनन सवरगदवरमपवतम सखन कषतरय परथ लभनत यदधमदशम 2.32 yadrichchhaya chopapannam swarga-dvaram apavritam sukhinah kshatriyah partha labhante yuddham idrisham happy are the kshatriyas o arjuna who are called to fight in such a battle that comes of its own accord as an open door to heaven.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.32 bg.2.32 chapter 2 verse 32 यदृच्छया चोपपन्नं स्वर्गद्वारमपावृतम्।

सुखिनः क्षत्रियाः पार्थ लभन्ते युद्धमीदृशम्।।2.32।। yadṛichchhayā chopapannaṁ swarga-dvāram apāvṛitam
sukhinaḥ kṣhatriyāḥ pārtha labhante yuddham īdṛiśham happy are the kshatriyas, o arjuna! who are called to fight in such a battle that comes of its own accord as an open door to heaven.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.33
documents.iast: atha chet tvam imaṁ dharmyaṁ saṅgrāmaṁ na kariṣhyasi
documents.sanskrit: अथ चैत्त्वमिमं धर्म्यं संग्रामं न करिष्यसि।
documents.summary: But if you will not fight this righteous war, then having abandoned your own duty and reputation, you will incur sin.
documents.searchText: bg.2.33 bg.2.33 chapter 2 verse 33 अथ चततवमम धरमय सगरम न करषयस तत सवधरम करत च हतव पपमवपसयस 2.33 atha chet tvam imam dharmyam sangramam na karishyasi tatah sva-dharmam kirtim cha hitva papam avapsyasi but if you will not fight this righteous war then having abandoned your own duty and reputation you will incur sin.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.33 bg.2.33 chapter 2 verse 33 अथ चैत्त्वमिमं धर्म्यं संग्रामं न करिष्यसि।

ततः स्वधर्मं कीर्तिं च हित्वा पापमवाप्स्यसि।।2.33।। atha chet tvam imaṁ dharmyaṁ saṅgrāmaṁ na kariṣhyasi
tataḥ sva-dharmaṁ kīrtiṁ cha hitvā pāpam avāpsyasi but if you will not fight this righteous war, then having abandoned your own duty and reputation, you will incur sin.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.34
documents.summary: People will also recount your everlasting dishonor; and for one who has been honored, dishonor is worse than death.
documents.searchText: bg.2.34 bg.2.34 chapter 2 verse 34 अकरत चप भतन कथयषयनत तऽवययम सभवतसय चकरतरमरणदतरचयत 2.34 akirtim chapi bhutani kathayishyanti te vyayam sambhavitasya chakirtir maranad atirichyate people will also recount your everlasting dishonor and for one who has been honored dishonor is worse than death.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.34 bg.2.34 chapter 2 verse 34 अकीर्तिं चापि भूतानि कथयिष्यन्ति तेऽव्ययाम्।

संभावितस्य चाकीर्तिर्मरणादतिरिच्यते।।2.34।। akīrtiṁ chāpi bhūtāni
kathayiṣhyanti te ’vyayām
sambhāvitasya chākīrtir
maraṇād atirichyate people will also recount your everlasting dishonor; and for one who has been honored, dishonor is worse than death.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.35
documents.iast: bhayād raṇād uparataṁ mansyante tvāṁ mahā-rathāḥ
documents.summary: The great chariot-warriors will think that you have withdrawn from the battle out of fear, and you will be held in low esteem by those who have held you in high regard.
documents.searchText: bg.2.35 bg.2.35 chapter 2 verse 35 भयदरणदपरत मसयनत तव महरथ यष च तव बहमत भतव यसयस लघवम 2.35 bhayad ranad uparatam mansyante tvam maha-rathah yesham cha tvam bahu-mato bhutva yasyasi laghavam the great chariot-warriors will think that you have withdrawn from the battle out of fear and you will be held in low esteem by those who have held you in high regard.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.35 bg.2.35 chapter 2 verse 35 भयाद्रणादुपरतं मंस्यन्ते त्वां महारथाः।

येषां च त्वं बहुमतो भूत्वा यास्यसि लाघवम्।।2.35।। bhayād raṇād uparataṁ mansyante tvāṁ mahā-rathāḥ
yeṣhāṁ cha tvaṁ bahu-mato bhūtvā yāsyasi lāghavam the great chariot-warriors will think that you have withdrawn from the battle out of fear, and you will be held in low esteem by those who have held you in high regard.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.36
documents.summary: Your enemies, scoffing at your power, will speak many abusive words—what could be more painful than this?
documents.searchText: bg.2.36 bg.2.36 chapter 2 verse 36 अवचयवदशच बहन वदषयनत तवहत ननदनतसतव समरथय तत दखतर न कम 2.36 avachya-vadansh cha bahun vadishyanti tavahitah nindantastava samarthyam tato duhkhataram nu kim your enemies scoffing at your power will speak many abusive words what could be more painful than this
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.36 bg.2.36 chapter 2 verse 36 अवाच्यवादांश्च बहून् वदिष्यन्ति तवाहिताः।

निन्दन्तस्तव सामर्थ्यं ततो दुःखतरं नु किम्।।2.36।। avāchya-vādānśh cha bahūn vadiṣhyanti tavāhitāḥ
nindantastava sāmarthyaṁ tato duḥkhataraṁ nu kim your enemies, scoffing at your power, will speak many abusive words—what could be more painful than this?

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.37
documents.iast: hato vā prāpsyasi swargaṁ jitvā vā bhokṣhyase mahīm
documents.sanskrit: हतो वा प्राप्स्यसि स्वर्गं जित्वा वा भोक्ष्यसे महीम्।
documents.summary: Slain, you will obtain heaven; victorious, you will enjoy the earth; therefore, stand up, O son of Kunti, resolved to fight.
documents.searchText: bg.2.37 bg.2.37 chapter 2 verse 37 हत व परपसयस सवरग जतव व भकषयस महम तसमदततषठ कनतय यदधय कतनशचय 2.37 hato va prapsyasi swargam jitva va bhokshyase mahim tasmad uttishtha kaunteya yuddhaya krita-nishchayah slain you will obtain heaven victorious you will enjoy the earth therefore stand up o son of kunti resolved to fight.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.37 bg.2.37 chapter 2 verse 37 हतो वा प्राप्स्यसि स्वर्गं जित्वा वा भोक्ष्यसे महीम्।

तस्मादुत्तिष्ठ कौन्तेय युद्धाय कृतनिश्चयः।।2.37।। hato vā prāpsyasi swargaṁ jitvā vā bhokṣhyase mahīm
tasmād uttiṣhṭha kaunteya yuddhāya kṛita-niśhchayaḥ slain, you will obtain heaven; victorious, you will enjoy the earth; therefore, stand up, o son of kunti, resolved to fight.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.38
documents.summary: Having made pleasure and pain, gain and loss, victory and defeat equal, engage in battle for the sake of battle; thus, you shall not incur sin.
documents.searchText: bg.2.38 bg.2.38 chapter 2 verse 38 सखदख सम कतव लभलभ जयजय तत यदधय यजयसव नव पपमवपसयस 2.38 sukha-duhkhe same kritva labhalabhau jayajayau tato yuddhaya yujyasva naivam papam avapsyasi having made pleasure and pain gain and loss victory and defeat equal engage in battle for the sake of battle thus you shall not incur sin.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.38 bg.2.38 chapter 2 verse 38 सुखदुःखे समे कृत्वा लाभालाभौ जयाजयौ।

ततो युद्धाय युज्यस्व नैवं पापमवाप्स्यसि।।2.38।। sukha-duḥkhe same kṛitvā lābhālābhau jayājayau
tato yuddhāya yujyasva naivaṁ pāpam avāpsyasi having made pleasure and pain, gain and loss, victory and defeat equal, engage in battle for the sake of battle; thus, you shall not incur sin.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.39
documents.sanskrit: एषा तेऽभिहिता सांख्ये बुद्धिर्योगे त्विमां श्रृणु।
documents.summary: This, which has been taught to you, is wisdom concerning Sankhya. Now listen to wisdom concerning Yoga, endowed with which, O Arjuna, you shall cast off the bonds of action.
documents.searchText: bg.2.39 bg.2.39 chapter 2 verse 39 एष तऽभहत सखय बदधरयग तवम शरण बदधययकत यय परथ करमबनध परहसयस 2.39 esha te bhihita sankhye buddhir yoge tvimam shrinu buddhya yukto yaya partha karma-bandham prahasyasi this which has been taught to you is wisdom concerning sankhya. now listen to wisdom concerning yoga endowed with which o arjuna you shall cast off the bonds of action.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.39 bg.2.39 chapter 2 verse 39 एषा तेऽभिहिता सांख्ये बुद्धिर्योगे त्विमां श्रृणु।

बुद्ध्यायुक्तो यया पार्थ कर्मबन्धं प्रहास्यसि।।2.39।। eṣhā te ’bhihitā sānkhye
buddhir yoge tvimāṁ śhṛiṇu
buddhyā yukto yayā pārtha
karma-bandhaṁ prahāsyasi this, which has been taught to you, is wisdom concerning sankhya. now listen to wisdom concerning yoga, endowed with which, o arjuna, you shall cast off the bonds of action.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.4
documents.summary: Arjuna said, "O Madhusudana, how can I fight in battle with arrows against Bhishma and Drona, who are worthy of being worshipped, O destroyer of enemies?"
documents.searchText: bg.2.4 bg.2.4 chapter 2 verse 4 अरजन उवच कथ भषममह सखय दरण च मधसदन इषभ परतयतसयम पजरहवरसदन 2.4 arjuna uvacha katham bhishmam aham sankhye dronam cha madhusudana ishubhih pratiyotsyami pujarhavari-sudana arjuna said o madhusudana how can i fight in battle with arrows against bhishma and drona who are worthy of being worshipped o destroyer of enemies
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.4 bg.2.4 chapter 2 verse 4 अर्जुन उवाच

कथं भीष्ममहं संख्ये द्रोणं च मधुसूदन।

इषुभिः प्रतियोत्स्यामि पूजार्हावरिसूदन।।2.4।। arjuna uvācha
kathaṁ bhīṣhmam ahaṁ sankhye droṇaṁ cha madhusūdana
iṣhubhiḥ pratiyotsyāmi pūjārhāvari-sūdana arjuna said, "o madhusudana, how can i fight in battle with arrows against bhishma and drona, who are worthy of being worshipped, o destroyer of enemies?"

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.40
documents.summary: In this, there is no loss of effort, nor is there any harm produced, nor any transgression. Even a little of this knowledge protects one from great fear.
documents.searchText: bg.2.40 bg.2.40 chapter 2 verse 40 नहभकरमनशऽसत परतयवय न वदयत सवलपमपयसय धरमसय तरयत महत भयत 2.40 nehabhikrama-nasho sti pratyavayo na vidyate svalpam apyasya dharmasya trayate mahato bhayat in this there is no loss of effort nor is there any harm produced nor any transgression. even a little of this knowledge protects one from great fear.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.40 bg.2.40 chapter 2 verse 40 नेहाभिक्रमनाशोऽस्ति प्रत्यवायो न विद्यते।

स्वल्पमप्यस्य धर्मस्य त्रायते महतो भयात्।।2.40।। nehābhikrama-nāśho ’sti pratyavāyo na vidyate
svalpam apyasya dharmasya trāyate mahato bhayāt in this, there is no loss of effort, nor is there any harm produced, nor any transgression. even a little of this knowledge protects one from great fear.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.41
documents.summary: Here, O joy of the Kurus, there is only one single-pointed determination; many-branched and endless are the thoughts of the indecisive.
documents.searchText: bg.2.41 bg.2.41 chapter 2 verse 41 वयवसयतमक बदधरकह करननदन बहशख हयननतशच बदधयऽवयवसयनम 2.41 vyavasayatmika buddhir ekeha kuru-nandana bahu-shakha hyanantash cha buddhayo vyavasayinam here o joy of the kurus there is only one single-pointed determination many-branched and endless are the thoughts of the indecisive.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.41 bg.2.41 chapter 2 verse 41 व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिरेकेह कुरुनन्दन।

बहुशाखा ह्यनन्ताश्च बुद्धयोऽव्यवसायिनाम्।।2.41।। vyavasāyātmikā buddhir ekeha kuru-nandana
bahu-śhākhā hyanantāśh cha buddhayo ’vyavasāyinām here, o joy of the kurus, there is only one single-pointed determination; many-branched and endless are the thoughts of the indecisive.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.42
documents.summary: The unwise, taking pleasure in the eulogizing words of the Vedas, utter flowery speech, saying, "There is nothing else," O Arjuna.
documents.searchText: bg.2.42 bg.2.42 chapter 2 verse 42 यमम पषपत वच परवदनतयवपशचत वदवदरत परथ ननयदसतत वदन 2.42 yamimam pushpitam vacham pravadanty-avipashchitah veda-vada-ratah partha nanyad astiti vadinah kamatmanah swarga-para janma-karma-phala-pradam kriya-vishesha-bahulam bhogaishwarya-gatim prati the unwise taking pleasure in the eulogizing words of the vedas utter flowery speech saying there is nothing else o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.42 bg.2.42 chapter 2 verse 42 यामिमां पुष्पितां वाचं प्रवदन्त्यविपश्चितः।

वेदवादरताः पार्थ नान्यदस्तीति वादिनः।।2.42।। yāmimāṁ puṣhpitāṁ vāchaṁ pravadanty-avipaśhchitaḥ
veda-vāda-ratāḥ pārtha nānyad astīti vādinaḥ
 kāmātmānaḥ swarga-parā janma-karma-phala-pradām
kriyā-viśheṣha-bahulāṁ bhogaiśhwarya-gatiṁ prati the unwise, taking pleasure in the eulogizing words of the vedas, utter flowery speech, saying, "there is nothing else," o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.43
documents.summary: Full of desires, with heaven as their goal, (they speak words that are directed to ends) leading to new births as the result of their works, and prescribe various methods abounding
documents.searchText: bg.2.43 bg.2.43 chapter 2 verse 43 कमतमन सवरगपर जनमकरमफलपरदम करयवशषबहल भगशवरयगत परत 2.43 kamatmanah svarga-para janma-karma-phala-pradam kriya-visesa-bahulam bhogaisvarya-gatim prati full of desires with heaven as their goal they speak words that are directed to ends leading to new births as the result of their works and prescribe various methods abounding in specific actions for the attainment of pleasure and power.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.43 bg.2.43 chapter 2 verse 43 कामात्मानः स्वर्गपरा जन्मकर्मफलप्रदाम्।

क्रियाविशेषबहुलां भोगैश्वर्यगतिं प्रति।।2.43।। kāmātmānaḥ svarga-parā 

 janma-karma-phala-pradām

 kriyā-viśeṣa-bahulāṁ

 bhogaiśvarya-gatiṁ prati full of desires, with heaven as their goal, (they speak words that are directed to ends) leading to new births as the result of their works, and prescribe various methods abounding in specific actions, for the attainment of pleasure and power.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.44
documents.summary: For those who are attached to pleasure and power, whose minds are drawn away by such teachings, their determinate reason is not formed which is steadily bent on meditation and Sama
documents.searchText: bg.2.44 bg.2.44 chapter 2 verse 44 भगशवरयपरसकतन तयपहतचतसम वयवसयतमक बदध समध न वधयत 2.44 bhogaiswvarya-prasaktanam tayapahrita-chetasam vyavasayatmika buddhih samadhau na vidhiyate for those who are attached to pleasure and power whose minds are drawn away by such teachings their determinate reason is not formed which is steadily bent on meditation and samadhi superconscious state .
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.44 bg.2.44 chapter 2 verse 44 भोगैश्वर्यप्रसक्तानां तयापहृतचेतसाम्।

व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिः समाधौ न विधीयते।।2.44।। bhogaiśwvarya-prasaktānāṁ tayāpahṛita-chetasām
vyavasāyātmikā buddhiḥ samādhau na vidhīyate for those who are attached to pleasure and power, whose minds are drawn away by such teachings, their determinate reason is not formed which is steadily bent on meditation and samadhi (superconscious state).

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.45
documents.summary: The Vedas deal with the three attributes; be thou above these three attributes. O Arjuna, free yourself from the pairs of opposites and ever remain in the quality of Sattva, freed
documents.searchText: bg.2.45 bg.2.45 chapter 2 verse 45 तरगणयवषय वद नसतरगणय भवरजन नरदवनदव नतयसततवसथ नरयगकषम आतमवन 2.45 trai-gunya-vishaya veda nistrai-gunyo bhavarjuna nirdvandvo nitya-sattva-stho niryoga-kshema atmavan the vedas deal with the three attributes be thou above these three attributes. o arjuna free yourself from the pairs of opposites and ever remain in the quality of sattva freed from acquisition and preservation and be established in the self.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.45 bg.2.45 chapter 2 verse 45 त्रैगुण्यविषया वेदा निस्त्रैगुण्यो भवार्जुन।

निर्द्वन्द्वो नित्यसत्त्वस्थो निर्योगक्षेम आत्मवान्।।2.45।। trai-guṇya-viṣhayā vedā nistrai-guṇyo bhavārjuna
nirdvandvo nitya-sattva-stho niryoga-kṣhema ātmavān the vedas deal with the three attributes; be thou above these three attributes. o arjuna, free yourself from the pairs of opposites and ever remain in the quality of sattva, freed from acquisition and preservation, and be established in the self.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.46
documents.summary: To the Brahmana who has known the Self, all the Vedas are of as much use as a reservoir of water would be in a place where there is a flood.
documents.searchText: bg.2.46 bg.2.46 chapter 2 verse 46 यवनरथ उदपन सरवत सपलतदक तवनसरवष वदष बरहमणसय वजनत 2.46 yavan artha udapane sarvatah samplutodake tavansarveshu vedeshu brahmanasya vijanatah to the brahmana who has known the self all the vedas are of as much use as a reservoir of water would be in a place where there is a flood.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.46 bg.2.46 chapter 2 verse 46 यावानर्थ उदपाने सर्वतः संप्लुतोदके।

तावान्सर्वेषु वेदेषु ब्राह्मणस्य विजानतः।।2.46।। yāvān artha udapāne sarvataḥ samplutodake
tāvānsarveṣhu vedeṣhu brāhmaṇasya vijānataḥ to the brahmana who has known the self, all the vedas are of as much use as a reservoir of water would be in a place where there is a flood.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.47
documents.summary: Your right is only to work, but not to its results; do not let the results of action be your motive, nor let your attachment be to inaction.
documents.searchText: bg.2.47 bg.2.47 chapter 2 verse 47 करमणयवधकरसत म फलष कदचन म करमफलहतरभरम त सङगऽसतवकरमण 2.47 karmany-evadhikaras te ma phaleshu kadachana ma karma-phala-hetur bhur ma te sango stvakarmani your right is only to work but not to its results do not let the results of action be your motive nor let your attachment be to inaction.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.47 bg.2.47 chapter 2 verse 47 कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन।

मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि।।2.47।। karmaṇy-evādhikāras te mā phaleṣhu kadāchana
mā karma-phala-hetur bhūr mā te saṅgo ’stvakarmaṇi your right is only to work, but not to its results; do not let the results of action be your motive, nor let your attachment be to inaction.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.48
documents.iast: yoga-sthaḥ kuru karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā dhanañjaya
documents.sanskrit: योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय।
documents.summary: Perform action, O Arjuna, being steadfast in Yoga, abandoning attachment and balanced in success and failure; evenness of mind is called Yoga.
documents.searchText: bg.2.48 bg.2.48 chapter 2 verse 48 यगसथ कर करमण सङग तयकतव धनञजय सदधयसदधय सम भतव समतव यग उचयत 2.48 yoga-sthah kuru karmani sangam tyaktva dhananjaya siddhy-asiddhyoh samo bhutva samatvam yoga uchyate perform action o arjuna being steadfast in yoga abandoning attachment and balanced in success and failure evenness of mind is called yoga.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.48 bg.2.48 chapter 2 verse 48 योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय।

सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते।।2.48।। yoga-sthaḥ kuru karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā dhanañjaya
siddhy-asiddhyoḥ samo bhūtvā samatvaṁ yoga uchyate perform action, o arjuna, being steadfast in yoga, abandoning attachment and balanced in success and failure; evenness of mind is called yoga.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.49
documents.summary: Far lower than the Yoga of wisdom is action, O Arjuna. Seek thou refuge in wisdom; wretched are those whose motive is the fruit.
documents.searchText: bg.2.49 bg.2.49 chapter 2 verse 49 दरण हयवर करम बदधयगदधनञजय बदध शरणमनवचछ कपण फलहतव 2.49 durena hy-avaram karma buddhi-yogad dhananjaya buddhau sharanam anvichchha kripanah phala-hetavah far lower than the yoga of wisdom is action o arjuna. seek thou refuge in wisdom wretched are those whose motive is the fruit.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.49 bg.2.49 chapter 2 verse 49 दूरेण ह्यवरं कर्म बुद्धियोगाद्धनञ्जय।

बुद्धौ शरणमन्विच्छ कृपणाः फलहेतवः।।2.49।। dūreṇa hy-avaraṁ karma buddhi-yogād dhanañjaya
buddhau śharaṇam anvichchha kṛipaṇāḥ phala-hetavaḥ far lower than the yoga of wisdom is action, o arjuna. seek thou refuge in wisdom; wretched are those whose motive is the fruit.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.5
documents.summary: Better it is, indeed, in this world to accept alms than to slay the most noble teachers. But if I were to kill them, even in this world, all my enjoyments of wealth and fulfilled d
documents.searchText: bg.2.5 bg.2.5 chapter 2 verse 5 गरनहतव ह महनभवन शरय भकत भकषयमपह लक हतवरथकमसत गरनहव भञजय भगन रधरपरदगधन 2.5 gurunahatva hi mahanubhavan shreyo bhoktum bhaikshyamapiha loke hatvartha-kamamstu gurunihaiva bhunjiya bhogan rudhira-pradigdhan better it is indeed in this world to accept alms than to slay the most noble teachers. but if i were to kill them even in this world all my enjoyments of wealth and fulfilled desires would be stained with their blood.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.5 bg.2.5 chapter 2 verse 5 गुरूनहत्वा हि महानुभावान्

श्रेयो भोक्तुं भैक्ष्यमपीह लोके।

हत्वार्थकामांस्तु गुरूनिहैव

भुञ्जीय भोगान् रुधिरप्रदिग्धान्।।2.5।। gurūnahatvā hi mahānubhāvān
śhreyo bhoktuṁ bhaikṣhyamapīha loke
hatvārtha-kāmāṁstu gurūnihaiva
bhuñjīya bhogān rudhira-pradigdhān better it is, indeed, in this world to accept alms than to slay the most noble teachers. but if i were to kill them, even in this world, all my enjoyments of wealth and fulfilled desires would be stained with their blood.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.50
documents.summary: Endowed with wisdom and evenness of mind, one casts off in this life both good and evil deeds; therefore, devote yourself to Yoga; Yoga is skill in action.
documents.searchText: bg.2.50 bg.2.50 chapter 2 verse 50 बदधयकत जहतह उभ सकतदषकत तसमदयगय यजयसव यग करमस कशलम 2.50 buddhi-yukto jahatiha ubhe sukrita-dushkrite tasmad yogaya yujyasva yogah karmasu kaushalam endowed with wisdom and evenness of mind one casts off in this life both good and evil deeds therefore devote yourself to yoga yoga is skill in action.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.50 bg.2.50 chapter 2 verse 50 बुद्धियुक्तो जहातीह उभे सुकृतदुष्कृते।

तस्माद्योगाय युज्यस्व योगः कर्मसु कौशलम्।।2.50।। buddhi-yukto jahātīha ubhe sukṛita-duṣhkṛite
tasmād yogāya yujyasva yogaḥ karmasu kauśhalam endowed with wisdom and evenness of mind, one casts off in this life both good and evil deeds; therefore, devote yourself to yoga; yoga is skill in action.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.51
documents.iast: karma-jaṁ buddhi-yuktā hi phalaṁ tyaktvā manīṣhiṇaḥ
documents.sanskrit: कर्मजं बुद्धियुक्ता हि फलं त्यक्त्वा मनीषिणः।
documents.summary: The wise, possessing knowledge, having abandoned the fruits of their actions, and being freed from the bonds of birth, go to the place which is beyond all evil.
documents.searchText: bg.2.51 bg.2.51 chapter 2 verse 51 करमज बदधयकत ह फल तयकतव मनषण जनमबनधवनरमकत पद गचछनतयनमयम 2.51 karma-jam buddhi-yukta hi phalam tyaktva manishinah janma-bandha-vinirmuktah padam gachchhanty-anamayam the wise possessing knowledge having abandoned the fruits of their actions and being freed from the bonds of birth go to the place which is beyond all evil.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.51 bg.2.51 chapter 2 verse 51 कर्मजं बुद्धियुक्ता हि फलं त्यक्त्वा मनीषिणः।

जन्मबन्धविनिर्मुक्ताः पदं गच्छन्त्यनामयम्।।2.51।। karma-jaṁ buddhi-yuktā hi phalaṁ tyaktvā manīṣhiṇaḥ
janma-bandha-vinirmuktāḥ padaṁ gachchhanty-anāmayam the wise, possessing knowledge, having abandoned the fruits of their actions, and being freed from the bonds of birth, go to the place which is beyond all evil.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.52
documents.summary: When your intellect passes beyond the mire of delusion, then you will attain indifference to what has been heard and what has yet to be heard.
documents.searchText: bg.2.52 bg.2.52 chapter 2 verse 52 यद त महकलल बदधरवयततरषयत तद गनतस नरवद शरतवयसय शरतसय च 2.52 yada te moha-kalilam buddhir vyatitarishyati tada gantasi nirvedam shrotavyasya shrutasya cha when your intellect passes beyond the mire of delusion then you will attain indifference to what has been heard and what has yet to be heard.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.52 bg.2.52 chapter 2 verse 52 यदा ते मोहकलिलं बुद्धिर्व्यतितरिष्यति।

तदा गन्तासि निर्वेदं श्रोतव्यस्य श्रुतस्य च।।2.52।। yadā te moha-kalilaṁ buddhir vyatitariṣhyati
tadā gantāsi nirvedaṁ śhrotavyasya śhrutasya cha when your intellect passes beyond the mire of delusion, then you will attain indifference to what has been heard and what has yet to be heard.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.53
documents.summary: When your intellect, which is perplexed by the Vedic texts you have read, stands immovable and steady in the Self, then you will attain Self-realization.
documents.searchText: bg.2.53 bg.2.53 chapter 2 verse 53 शरतवपरतपनन त यद सथसयत नशचल समधवचल बदधसतद यगमवपसयस 2.53 shruti-vipratipanna te yada sthasyati nishchala samadhav-achala buddhis tada yogam avapsyasi when your intellect which is perplexed by the vedic texts you have read stands immovable and steady in the self then you will attain self-realization.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.53 bg.2.53 chapter 2 verse 53 श्रुतिविप्रतिपन्ना ते यदा स्थास्यति निश्चला।

समाधावचला बुद्धिस्तदा योगमवाप्स्यसि।।2.53।। śhruti-vipratipannā te yadā sthāsyati niśhchalā
samādhāv-achalā buddhis tadā yogam avāpsyasi when your intellect, which is perplexed by the vedic texts you have read, stands immovable and steady in the self, then you will attain self-realization.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.54
documents.summary: Arjuna said, "O Krishna, what is the description of one who has steady wisdom and is merged in the superconscious state? How does one of steady wisdom speak, how do they sit, and h
documents.searchText: bg.2.54 bg.2.54 chapter 2 verse 54 अरजन उवच सथतपरजञसय क भष समधसथसय कशव सथतध क परभषत कमसत वरजत कम 2.54 arjuna uvacha sthita-prajnasya ka bhasha samadhi-sthasya keshava sthita-dhih kim prabhasheta kim asita vrajeta kim arjuna said o krishna what is the description of one who has steady wisdom and is merged in the superconscious state how does one of steady wisdom speak how do they sit and how do they walk
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.54 bg.2.54 chapter 2 verse 54 अर्जुन उवाच

स्थितप्रज्ञस्य का भाषा समाधिस्थस्य केशव।

स्थितधीः किं प्रभाषेत किमासीत व्रजेत किम्।।2.54।। arjuna uvācha
sthita-prajñasya kā bhāṣhā samādhi-sthasya keśhava
sthita-dhīḥ kiṁ prabhāṣheta kim āsīta vrajeta kim arjuna said, "o krishna, what is the description of one who has steady wisdom and is merged in the superconscious state? how does one of steady wisdom speak, how do they sit, and how do they walk?"

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.55
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, "When a man completely casts off, O Arjuna, all the desires of the mind and is satisfied in the Self by the Self, then he is said to be one of steady wisdom.
documents.searchText: bg.2.55 bg.2.55 chapter 2 verse 55 शर भगवनवच परजहत यद कमन सरवन परथ मनगतन आतमनयवतमन तषट सथतपरजञसतदचयत 2.55 shri bhagavan uvacha prajahati yada kaman sarvan partha mano-gatan atmany-evatmana tushtah sthita-prajnas tadochyate the blessed lord said when a man completely casts off o arjuna all the desires of the mind and is satisfied in the self by the self then he is said to be one of steady wisdom.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.55 bg.2.55 chapter 2 verse 55 श्री भगवानुवाच

प्रजहाति यदा कामान् सर्वान् पार्थ मनोगतान्।

आत्मन्येवात्मना तुष्टः स्थितप्रज्ञस्तदोच्यते।।2.55।। śhrī bhagavān uvācha
prajahāti yadā kāmān sarvān pārtha mano-gatān
ātmany-evātmanā tuṣhṭaḥ sthita-prajñas tadochyate the blessed lord said, "when a man completely casts off, o arjuna, all the desires of the mind and is satisfied in the self by the self, then he is said to be one of steady wisdom."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.56
documents.summary: He whose mind is not shaken by adversity, who does not long for pleasures, and is free from attachment, fear, and anger, is called a sage of steady wisdom.
documents.searchText: bg.2.56 bg.2.56 chapter 2 verse 56 दखषवनदवगनमन सखष वगतसपह वतरगभयकरध सथतधरमनरचयत 2.56 duhkheshv-anudvigna-manah sukheshu vigata-sprihah vita-raga-bhaya-krodhah sthita-dhir munir uchyate he whose mind is not shaken by adversity who does not long for pleasures and is free from attachment fear and anger is called a sage of steady wisdom.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.56 bg.2.56 chapter 2 verse 56 दुःखेष्वनुद्विग्नमनाः सुखेषु विगतस्पृहः।

वीतरागभयक्रोधः स्थितधीर्मुनिरुच्यते।।2.56।। duḥkheṣhv-anudvigna-manāḥ sukheṣhu vigata-spṛihaḥ
vīta-rāga-bhaya-krodhaḥ sthita-dhīr munir uchyate he whose mind is not shaken by adversity, who does not long for pleasures, and is free from attachment, fear, and anger, is called a sage of steady wisdom.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.57
documents.iast: yaḥ sarvatrānabhisnehas tat tat prāpya śhubhāśhubham
documents.summary: He who is everywhere without attachment, upon encountering anything good or bad, neither rejoices nor hastens; his wisdom is firm.
documents.searchText: bg.2.57 bg.2.57 chapter 2 verse 57 य सरवतरनभसनहसततततपरपय शभशभम नभननदत न दवषट तसय परजञ परतषठत 2.57 yah sarvatranabhisnehas tat tat prapya shubhashubham nabhinandati na dveshti tasya prajna pratishthita he who is everywhere without attachment upon encountering anything good or bad neither rejoices nor hastens his wisdom is firm.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.57 bg.2.57 chapter 2 verse 57 यः सर्वत्रानभिस्नेहस्तत्तत्प्राप्य शुभाशुभम्।

नाभिनन्दति न द्वेष्टि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता।।2.57।। yaḥ sarvatrānabhisnehas tat tat prāpya śhubhāśhubham
nābhinandati na dveṣhṭi tasya prajñā pratiṣhṭhitā he who is everywhere without attachment, upon encountering anything good or bad, neither rejoices nor hastens; his wisdom is firm.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.58
documents.summary: When, like the tortoise which withdraws all its limbs on all sides, he withdraws his senses from the sense-objects, then his wisdom becomes steady.
documents.searchText: bg.2.58 bg.2.58 chapter 2 verse 58 यद सहरत चय करमऽङगनव सरवश इनदरयणनदरयरथभयसतसय परजञ परतषठत 2.58 yada sanharate chayam kurmo nganiva sarvashah indriyanindriyarthebhyas tasya prajna pratishthita when like the tortoise which withdraws all its limbs on all sides he withdraws his senses from the sense-objects then his wisdom becomes steady.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.58 bg.2.58 chapter 2 verse 58 यदा संहरते चायं कूर्मोऽङ्गानीव सर्वशः।

इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता।।2.58।। yadā sanharate chāyaṁ kūrmo ’ṅgānīva sarvaśhaḥ
indriyāṇīndriyārthebhyas tasya prajñā pratiṣhṭhitā when, like the tortoise which withdraws all its limbs on all sides, he withdraws his senses from the sense-objects, then his wisdom becomes steady.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.59
documents.summary: The objects of the senses turn away from the abstinent man, leaving the longing behind; but his longing also turns away upon seeing the Supreme.
documents.searchText: bg.2.59 bg.2.59 chapter 2 verse 59 वषय वनवरतनत नरहरसय दहन रसवरज रसऽपयसय पर दषटव नवरतत 2.59 vishaya vinivartante niraharasya dehinah rasa-varjam raso pyasya param drishtva nivartate the objects of the senses turn away from the abstinent man leaving the longing behind but his longing also turns away upon seeing the supreme.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.59 bg.2.59 chapter 2 verse 59 विषया विनिवर्तन्ते निराहारस्य देहिनः।

रसवर्जं रसोऽप्यस्य परं दृष्ट्वा निवर्तते।।2.59।। viṣhayā vinivartante nirāhārasya dehinaḥ
rasa-varjaṁ raso ’pyasya paraṁ dṛiṣhṭvā nivartate the objects of the senses turn away from the abstinent man, leaving the longing behind; but his longing also turns away upon seeing the supreme.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.6
documents.summary: I can hardly tell which would be better, that we should conquer them or that they should conquer us. Even the sons of Dhritarashtra, whom we do not wish to slay, stand facing us.
documents.searchText: bg.2.6 bg.2.6 chapter 2 verse 6 न चतदवदम कतरनन गरय यदव जयम यद व न जयय यनव हतव न जजवषम सतऽवसथत परमख धरतरषटर 2.6 na chaitadvidmah kataranno gariyo yadva jayema yadi va no jayeyuh yaneva hatva na jijivishamas te vasthitah pramukhe dhartarashtrah i can hardly tell which would be better that we should conquer them or that they should conquer us. even the sons of dhritarashtra whom we do not wish to slay stand facing us.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.6 bg.2.6 chapter 2 verse 6 न चैतद्विद्मः कतरन्नो गरीयो

यद्वा जयेम यदि वा नो जयेयुः।

यानेव हत्वा न जिजीविषाम

स्तेऽवस्थिताः प्रमुखे धार्तराष्ट्राः।।2.6।। na chaitadvidmaḥ kataranno garīyo
yadvā jayema yadi vā no jayeyuḥ
yāneva hatvā na jijīviṣhāmas
te ’vasthitāḥ pramukhe dhārtarāṣhṭrāḥ i can hardly tell which would be better, that we should conquer them or that they should conquer us. even the sons of dhritarashtra, whom we do not wish to slay, stand facing us.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.60
documents.summary: The turbulent senses, O Arjuna, can violently carry away the mind of a wise person, even though they are striving to control them.
documents.searchText: bg.2.60 bg.2.60 chapter 2 verse 60 यतत हयप कनतय परषसय वपशचत इनदरयण परमथन हरनत परसभ मन 2.60 yatato hyapi kaunteya purushasya vipashchitah indriyani pramathini haranti prasabham manah the turbulent senses o arjuna can violently carry away the mind of a wise person even though they are striving to control them.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.60 bg.2.60 chapter 2 verse 60 यततो ह्यपि कौन्तेय पुरुषस्य विपश्चितः।

इन्द्रियाणि प्रमाथीनि हरन्ति प्रसभं मनः।।2.60।। yatato hyapi kaunteya puruṣhasya vipaśhchitaḥ
indriyāṇi pramāthīni haranti prasabhaṁ manaḥ the turbulent senses, o arjuna, can violently carry away the mind of a wise person, even though they are striving to control them.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.61
documents.iast: tāni sarvāṇi sanyamya yukta āsīta mat-paraḥ
documents.sanskrit: तानि सर्वाणि संयम्य युक्त आसीत मत्परः।
documents.summary: Having restrained them all, he should sit steadfast, intent on Me; his wisdom is steady whose senses are under control.
documents.searchText: bg.2.61 bg.2.61 chapter 2 verse 61 तन सरवण सयमय यकत आसत मतपर वश ह यसयनदरयण तसय परजञ परतषठत 2.61 tani sarvani sanyamya yukta asita mat-parah vashe hi yasyendriyani tasya prajna pratishthita having restrained them all he should sit steadfast intent on me his wisdom is steady whose senses are under control.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.61 bg.2.61 chapter 2 verse 61 तानि सर्वाणि संयम्य युक्त आसीत मत्परः।

वशे हि यस्येन्द्रियाणि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता।।2.61।। tāni sarvāṇi sanyamya yukta āsīta mat-paraḥ
vaśhe hi yasyendriyāṇi tasya prajñā pratiṣhṭhitā having restrained them all, he should sit steadfast, intent on me; his wisdom is steady whose senses are under control.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.62
documents.summary: When one thinks of objects, attachment to them arises; from attachment, desire is born; from desire, anger arises.
documents.searchText: bg.2.62 bg.2.62 chapter 2 verse 62 धययत वषयनपस सङगसतषपजयत सङगत सजयत कम कमतकरधऽभजयत 2.62 dhyayato vishayan pumsah sangas teshupajayate sangat sanjayate kamah kamat krodho bhijayate when one thinks of objects attachment to them arises from attachment desire is born from desire anger arises.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.62 bg.2.62 chapter 2 verse 62 ध्यायतो विषयान्पुंसः सङ्गस्तेषूपजायते।

सङ्गात् संजायते कामः कामात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते।।2.62।। dhyāyato viṣhayān puṁsaḥ saṅgas teṣhūpajāyate
saṅgāt sañjāyate kāmaḥ kāmāt krodho ’bhijāyate when one thinks of objects, attachment to them arises; from attachment, desire is born; from desire, anger arises.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.63
documents.summary: Anger leads to delusion, which causes loss of memory; this, in turn, leads to the destruction of discrimination, resulting in destruction.
documents.searchText: bg.2.63 bg.2.63 chapter 2 verse 63 करधदभवत समह समहतसमतवभरम समतभरशद बदधनश बदधनशतपरणशयत 2.63 krodhad bhavati sammohah sammohat smriti-vibhramah smriti-bhranshad buddhi-nasho buddhi-nashat pranashyati anger leads to delusion which causes loss of memory this in turn leads to the destruction of discrimination resulting in destruction.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.63 bg.2.63 chapter 2 verse 63 क्रोधाद्भवति संमोहः संमोहात्स्मृतिविभ्रमः।

स्मृतिभ्रंशाद् बुद्धिनाशो बुद्धिनाशात्प्रणश्यति।।2.63।। krodhād bhavati sammohaḥ sammohāt smṛiti-vibhramaḥ
smṛiti-bhranśhād buddhi-nāśho buddhi-nāśhāt praṇaśhyati anger leads to delusion, which causes loss of memory; this, in turn, leads to the destruction of discrimination, resulting in destruction.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.64
documents.summary: But the self-controlled man, moving among objects with the senses restrained and free from attraction and repulsion, attains peace.
documents.searchText: bg.2.64 bg.2.64 chapter 2 verse 64 रगदवषवयकतसत वषयननदरयशचरन आतमवशयरवधयतम परसदमधगचछत 2.64 raga-dvesha-viyuktais tu vishayan indriyaish charan atma-vashyair-vidheyatma prasadam adhigachchhati but the self-controlled man moving among objects with the senses restrained and free from attraction and repulsion attains peace.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.64 bg.2.64 chapter 2 verse 64 रागद्वेषवियुक्तैस्तु विषयानिन्द्रियैश्चरन्।

आत्मवश्यैर्विधेयात्मा प्रसादमधिगच्छति।।2.64।। rāga-dveṣha-viyuktais tu viṣhayān indriyaiśh charan
ātma-vaśhyair-vidheyātmā prasādam adhigachchhati but the self-controlled man, moving among objects with the senses restrained and free from attraction and repulsion, attains peace.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.65
documents.summary: In that peace, all pains are destroyed; for the intellect of the tranquil-minded soon becomes steady.
documents.searchText: bg.2.65 bg.2.65 chapter 2 verse 65 परसद सरवदखन हनरसयपजयत परसननचतस हयश बदध परयवतषठत 2.65 prasade sarva-duhkhanam hanir asyopajayate prasanna-chetaso hyashu buddhih paryavatishthate in that peace all pains are destroyed for the intellect of the tranquil-minded soon becomes steady.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.65 bg.2.65 chapter 2 verse 65 प्रसादे सर्वदुःखानां हानिरस्योपजायते।

प्रसन्नचेतसो ह्याशु बुद्धिः पर्यवतिष्ठते।।2.65।। prasāde sarva-duḥkhānāṁ hānir asyopajāyate
prasanna-chetaso hyāśhu buddhiḥ paryavatiṣhṭhate in that peace, all pains are destroyed; for the intellect of the tranquil-minded soon becomes steady.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.66
documents.summary: There is no knowledge of the Self for the unsteady, and no meditation is possible for the unsteady, and no peace for the unmeditative, and how can there be happiness for one who ha
documents.searchText: bg.2.66 bg.2.66 chapter 2 verse 66 नसत बदधरयकतसय न चयकतसय भवन न चभवयत शनतरशनतसय कत सखम 2.66 nasti buddhir-ayuktasya na chayuktasya bhavana na chabhavayatah shantir ashantasya kutah sukham there is no knowledge of the self for the unsteady and no meditation is possible for the unsteady and no peace for the unmeditative and how can there be happiness for one who has no peace
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.66 bg.2.66 chapter 2 verse 66 नास्ति बुद्धिरयुक्तस्य न चायुक्तस्य भावना।

न चाभावयतः शान्तिरशान्तस्य कुतः सुखम्।।2.66।। nāsti buddhir-ayuktasya na chāyuktasya bhāvanā
na chābhāvayataḥ śhāntir aśhāntasya kutaḥ sukham there is no knowledge of the self for the unsteady, and no meditation is possible for the unsteady, and no peace for the unmeditative, and how can there be happiness for one who has no peace?

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.67
documents.summary: For the mind, which follows in the wake of the wandering senses, carries away his discrimination, as the wind carries away a boat on the waters.
documents.searchText: bg.2.67 bg.2.67 chapter 2 verse 67 इनदरयण ह चरत यनमनऽनवधयत तदसय हरत परजञ वयरनवमवमभस 2.67 indriyanam hi charatam yan mano nuvidhiyate tadasya harati prajnam vayur navam ivambhasi for the mind which follows in the wake of the wandering senses carries away his discrimination as the wind carries away a boat on the waters.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.67 bg.2.67 chapter 2 verse 67 इन्द्रियाणां हि चरतां यन्मनोऽनुविधीयते।

तदस्य हरति प्रज्ञां वायुर्नावमिवाम्भसि।।2.67।। indriyāṇāṁ hi charatāṁ yan mano ’nuvidhīyate
tadasya harati prajñāṁ vāyur nāvam ivāmbhasi for the mind, which follows in the wake of the wandering senses, carries away his discrimination, as the wind carries away a boat on the waters.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.68
documents.summary: Therefore, O mighty-armed Arjuna, his knowledge is steady whose senses are completely restrained from sense objects.
documents.searchText: bg.2.68 bg.2.68 chapter 2 verse 68 तसमदयसय महबह नगहतन सरवश इनदरयणनदरयरथभयसतसय परजञ परतषठत 2.68 tasmad yasya maha-baho nigrihitani sarvashah indriyanindriyarthebhyas tasya prajna pratishthita therefore o mighty-armed arjuna his knowledge is steady whose senses are completely restrained from sense objects.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.68 bg.2.68 chapter 2 verse 68 तस्माद्यस्य महाबाहो निगृहीतानि सर्वशः।

इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता।।2.68।। tasmād yasya mahā-bāho nigṛihītāni sarvaśhaḥ
indriyāṇīndriyārthebhyas tasya prajñā pratiṣhṭhitā therefore, o mighty-armed arjuna, his knowledge is steady whose senses are completely restrained from sense objects.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.69
documents.iast: yā niśhā sarva-bhūtānāṁ tasyāṁ jāgarti sanyamī
documents.sanskrit: या निशा सर्वभूतानां तस्यां जागर्ति संयमी।
documents.summary: That which is night to all beings, in that the self-controlled man is awake; when all beings are awake, that is night for the sage who sees.
documents.searchText: bg.2.69 bg.2.69 chapter 2 verse 69 य नश सरवभतन तसय जगरत सयम यसय जगरत भतन स नश पशयत मन 2.69 ya nisha sarva-bhutanam tasyam jagarti sanyami yasyam jagrati bhutani sa nisha pashyato muneh that which is night to all beings in that the self-controlled man is awake when all beings are awake that is night for the sage who sees.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.69 bg.2.69 chapter 2 verse 69 या निशा सर्वभूतानां तस्यां जागर्ति संयमी।

यस्यां जाग्रति भूतानि सा निशा पश्यतो मुनेः।।2.69।। yā niśhā sarva-bhūtānāṁ tasyāṁ jāgarti sanyamī
yasyāṁ jāgrati bhūtāni sā niśhā paśhyato muneḥ that which is night to all beings, in that the self-controlled man is awake; when all beings are awake, that is night for the sage who sees.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.7
documents.summary: My heart is overpowered by the taint of pity; my mind is confused as to my duty. I ask Thee: Tell me decisively what is good for me. I am Thy disciple; instruct me, who has taken r
documents.searchText: bg.2.7 bg.2.7 chapter 2 verse 7 करपणयदषपहतसवभव पचछम तव धरमसमढचत यचछरय सयननशचत बरह तनम शषयसतऽह शध म तव परपननम 2.7 karpanya-doshopahata-svabhavah prichchhami tvam dharma-sammudha-chetah yach-chhreyah syannishchitam bruhi tanme shishyaste ham shadhi mam tvam prapannam my heart is overpowered by the taint of pity my mind is confused as to my duty. i ask thee tell me decisively what is good for me. i am thy disciple instruct me who has taken refuge in thee.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.7 bg.2.7 chapter 2 verse 7 कार्पण्यदोषोपहतस्वभावः

पृच्छामि त्वां धर्मसंमूढचेताः।

यच्छ्रेयः स्यान्निश्चितं ब्रूहि तन्मे

शिष्यस्तेऽहं शाधि मां त्वां प्रपन्नम्।।2.7।। kārpaṇya-doṣhopahata-svabhāvaḥ
pṛichchhāmi tvāṁ dharma-sammūḍha-chetāḥ
yach-chhreyaḥ syānniśhchitaṁ brūhi tanme
śhiṣhyaste ’haṁ śhādhi māṁ tvāṁ prapannam my heart is overpowered by the taint of pity; my mind is confused as to my duty. i ask thee: tell me decisively what is good for me. i am thy disciple; instruct me, who has taken refuge in thee.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.70
documents.summary: He attains peace into whom all desires enter, just as waters enter the ocean which, filled from all sides, remains unmoved; but not the man who is full of desires.
documents.searchText: bg.2.70 bg.2.70 chapter 2 verse 70 आपरयमणमचलपरतषठ समदरमप परवशनत यदवत तदवतकम य परवशनत सरव स शनतमपनत न कमकम 2.70 apuryamanam achala-pratishtham samudram apah pravishanti yadvat tadvat kama yam pravishanti sarve sa shantim apnoti na kama-kami he attains peace into whom all desires enter just as waters enter the ocean which filled from all sides remains unmoved but not the man who is full of desires.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.70 bg.2.70 chapter 2 verse 70 आपूर्यमाणमचलप्रतिष्ठं

समुद्रमापः प्रविशन्ति यद्वत्।

तद्वत्कामा यं प्रविशन्ति सर्वे

स शान्तिमाप्नोति न कामकामी।।2.70।। āpūryamāṇam achala-pratiṣhṭhaṁ
samudram āpaḥ praviśhanti yadvat
tadvat kāmā yaṁ praviśhanti sarve
sa śhāntim āpnoti na kāma-kāmī he attains peace into whom all desires enter, just as waters enter the ocean which, filled from all sides, remains unmoved; but not the man who is full of desires.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.71
documents.iast: vihāya kāmān yaḥ sarvān pumānśh charati niḥspṛihaḥ
documents.summary: That person attains peace who, abandoning all desires, moves about without longing, without the sense of ownership, and without egoism.
documents.searchText: bg.2.71 bg.2.71 chapter 2 verse 71 वहय कमनय सरवनपमशचरत नसपह नरमम नरहकर स शतमधगचछत 2.71 vihaya kaman yah sarvan pumansh charati nihsprihah nirmamo nirahankarah sa shantim adhigachchhati that person attains peace who abandoning all desires moves about without longing without the sense of ownership and without egoism.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.71 bg.2.71 chapter 2 verse 71 विहाय कामान्यः सर्वान्पुमांश्चरति निःस्पृहः।

निर्ममो निरहंकारः स शांतिमधिगच्छति।।2.71।। vihāya kāmān yaḥ sarvān pumānśh charati niḥspṛihaḥ
nirmamo nirahankāraḥ sa śhāntim adhigachchhati that person attains peace who, abandoning all desires, moves about without longing, without the sense of ownership, and without egoism.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.72
documents.iast: eṣhā brāhmī sthitiḥ pārtha naināṁ prāpya vimuhyati
documents.sanskrit: एषा ब्राह्मी स्थितिः पार्थ नैनां प्राप्य विमुह्यति।
documents.summary: O son of Pritha, this is the eternal state, the Brahmic seat. Attaining this, one is not deluded. Being established in it, one attains oneness with Brahman even at the end of life.
documents.searchText: bg.2.72 bg.2.72 chapter 2 verse 72 एष बरहम सथत परथ नन परपय वमहयत सथतवऽसयमनतकलऽप बरहमनरवणमचछत 2.72 esha brahmi sthitih partha nainam prapya vimuhyati sthitvasyam anta-kale pi brahma-nirvanam richchhati o son of pritha this is the eternal state the brahmic seat. attaining this one is not deluded. being established in it one attains oneness with brahman even at the end of life.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.72 bg.2.72 chapter 2 verse 72 एषा ब्राह्मी स्थितिः पार्थ नैनां प्राप्य विमुह्यति।

स्थित्वाऽस्यामन्तकालेऽपि ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृच्छति।।2.72।। eṣhā brāhmī sthitiḥ pārtha naināṁ prāpya vimuhyati
sthitvāsyām anta-kāle ’pi brahma-nirvāṇam ṛichchhati o son of pritha, this is the eternal state, the brahmic seat. attaining this, one is not deluded. being established in it, one attains oneness with brahman even at the end of life.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.8
documents.summary: I do not see that this sorrow that burns up my senses would be removed, even if I were to attain prosperous and unrivaled dominion on earth or lordship over the gods.
documents.searchText: bg.2.8 bg.2.8 chapter 2 verse 8 न ह परपशयम ममपनदय दयचछकमचछषणमनदरयणम अवपय भमवसपतनमदधम रजय सरणमप चधपतयम 2.8 na hi prapashyami mamapanudyad yach-chhokam uchchhoshanam-indriyanam avapya bhumav-asapatnamriddham rajyam suranamapi chadhipatyam i do not see that this sorrow that burns up my senses would be removed even if i were to attain prosperous and unrivaled dominion on earth or lordship over the gods.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.8 bg.2.8 chapter 2 verse 8 न हि प्रपश्यामि ममापनुद्या

द्यच्छोकमुच्छोषणमिन्द्रियाणाम्।

अवाप्य भूमावसपत्नमृद्धम्

राज्यं सुराणामपि चाधिपत्यम्।।2.8।। na hi prapaśhyāmi mamāpanudyād
yach-chhokam uchchhoṣhaṇam-indriyāṇām
avāpya bhūmāv-asapatnamṛiddhaṁ
rājyaṁ surāṇāmapi chādhipatyam i do not see that this sorrow that burns up my senses would be removed, even if i were to attain prosperous and unrivaled dominion on earth or lordship over the gods.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 2.9
documents.summary: Sanjaya said: Having spoken thus to Hrishikesha, the Lord of the senses, Arjuna, the conqueror of sleep and destroyer of foes, said, "I will not fight," and became silent.
documents.searchText: bg.2.9 bg.2.9 chapter 2 verse 9 सञजय उवच एवमकतव हषकश गडकश परनतप न यतसय इत गवनदमकतव तषण बभव ह 2.9 sanjaya uvacha evam-uktva hrishikesham gudakeshah parantapa na yotsya iti govindam uktva tushnim babhuva ha sanjaya said having spoken thus to hrishikesha the lord of the senses arjuna the conqueror of sleep and destroyer of foes said i will not fight and became silent.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.2.9 bg.2.9 chapter 2 verse 9 सञ्जय उवाच

एवमुक्त्वा हृषीकेशं गुडाकेशः परन्तप।

न योत्स्य इति गोविन्दमुक्त्वा तूष्णीं बभूव ह।।2.9।। sañjaya uvācha
evam-uktvā hṛiṣhīkeśhaṁ guḍākeśhaḥ parantapa
na yotsya iti govindam uktvā tūṣhṇīṁ babhūva ha sanjaya said: having spoken thus to hrishikesha, the lord of the senses, arjuna, the conqueror of sleep and destroyer of foes, said, "i will not fight," and became silent.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.1
documents.summary: Arjuna said: If Thou thinkest that knowledge is superior to action, O Krishna, why then, O Kesava, doest Thou ask me to engage in this terrible action?
documents.searchText: bg.3.1 bg.3.1 chapter 3 verse 1 अरजन उवच जययस चतकरमणसत मत बदधरजनरदन ततक करमण घर म नयजयस कशव 3.1 arjuna uvacha jyayasi chet karmanas te mata buddhir janardana tat kim karmani ghore mam niyojayasi keshava arjuna said if thou thinkest that knowledge is superior to action o krishna why then o kesava doest thou ask me to engage in this terrible action
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.1 bg.3.1 chapter 3 verse 1 अर्जुन उवाच

ज्यायसी चेत्कर्मणस्ते मता बुद्धिर्जनार्दन।

तत्किं कर्मणि घोरे मां नियोजयसि केशव।।3.1।। arjuna uvācha
jyāyasī chet karmaṇas te matā buddhir janārdana
tat kiṁ karmaṇi ghore māṁ niyojayasi keśhava arjuna said: if thou thinkest that knowledge is superior to action, o krishna, why then, o kesava, doest thou ask me to engage in this terrible action?

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.10
documents.summary: The Creator, having in the beginning created mankind together with sacrifice, said, "By this shall you propagate; let this be the milch cow of your desires—the cow that yields all
documents.searchText: bg.3.10 bg.3.10 chapter 3 verse 10 सहयजञ परज सषटव परवच परजपत अनन परसवषयधवमष वऽसतवषटकमधक 3.10 saha-yajnah prajah srishtva purovacha prajapatih anena prasavishyadhvam esha vo stvishta-kama-dhuk the creator having in the beginning created mankind together with sacrifice said by this shall you propagate let this be the milch cow of your desires the cow that yields all the desired objects.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.10 bg.3.10 chapter 3 verse 10 सहयज्ञाः प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा पुरोवाच प्रजापतिः।

अनेन प्रसविष्यध्वमेष वोऽस्त्विष्टकामधुक्।।3.10।। saha-yajñāḥ prajāḥ sṛiṣhṭvā purovācha prajāpatiḥ
anena prasaviṣhyadhvam eṣha vo ’stviṣhṭa-kāma-dhuk the creator, having in the beginning created mankind together with sacrifice, said, "by this shall you propagate; let this be the milch cow of your desires—the cow that yields all the desired objects."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.11
documents.iast: devān bhāvayatānena te devā bhāvayantu vaḥ
documents.summary: With this, nourish the gods, and may the gods nourish you; thus, nourishing each other, you shall attain the highest good.
documents.searchText: bg.3.11 bg.3.11 chapter 3 verse 11 दवनभवयतनन त दव भवयनत व परसपर भवयनत शरय परमवपसयथ 3.11 devan bhavayatanena te deva bhavayantu vah parasparam bhavayantah shreyah param avapsyatha with this nourish the gods and may the gods nourish you thus nourishing each other you shall attain the highest good.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.11 bg.3.11 chapter 3 verse 11 देवान्भावयतानेन ते देवा भावयन्तु वः।

परस्परं भावयन्तः श्रेयः परमवाप्स्यथ।।3.11।। devān bhāvayatānena te devā bhāvayantu vaḥ
parasparaṁ bhāvayantaḥ śhreyaḥ param avāpsyatha with this, nourish the gods, and may the gods nourish you; thus, nourishing each other, you shall attain the highest good.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.12
documents.iast: iṣhṭān bhogān hi vo devā dāsyante yajña-bhāvitāḥ
documents.summary: The gods, nourished by the sacrifice, will give you the desired objects. So, he who enjoys the objects given by the gods without offering anything in return is indeed a thief.
documents.searchText: bg.3.12 bg.3.12 chapter 3 verse 12 इषटनभगनह व दव दसयनत यजञभवत तरदततनपरदयभय य भङकत सतन एव स 3.12 ishtan bhogan hi vo deva dasyante yajna-bhavitah tair dattan apradayaibhyo yo bhunkte stena eva sah the gods nourished by the sacrifice will give you the desired objects. so he who enjoys the objects given by the gods without offering anything in return is indeed a thief.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.12 bg.3.12 chapter 3 verse 12 इष्टान्भोगान्हि वो देवा दास्यन्ते यज्ञभाविताः।

तैर्दत्तानप्रदायैभ्यो यो भुङ्क्ते स्तेन एव सः।।3.12।। iṣhṭān bhogān hi vo devā dāsyante yajña-bhāvitāḥ
tair dattān apradāyaibhyo yo bhuṅkte stena eva saḥ the gods, nourished by the sacrifice, will give you the desired objects. so, he who enjoys the objects given by the gods without offering anything in return is indeed a thief.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.13
documents.summary: The righteous who eat the remnants of the sacrifice are freed from all sins; but those sinful ones who cook food solely for their own sake indeed consume sin.
documents.searchText: bg.3.13 bg.3.13 chapter 3 verse 13 यजञशषटशन सनत मचयनत सरवकलबष भञजत त तवघ पप य पचनतयतमकरणत 3.13 yajna-shishtashinah santo muchyante sarva-kilbishaih bhunjate te tvagham papa ye pachantyatma-karanat the righteous who eat the remnants of the sacrifice are freed from all sins but those sinful ones who cook food solely for their own sake indeed consume sin.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.13 bg.3.13 chapter 3 verse 13 यज्ञशिष्टाशिनः सन्तो मुच्यन्ते सर्वकिल्बिषैः।

भुञ्जते ते त्वघं पापा ये पचन्त्यात्मकारणात्।।3.13।। yajña-śhiṣhṭāśhinaḥ santo muchyante sarva-kilbiṣhaiḥ
bhuñjate te tvaghaṁ pāpā ye pachantyātma-kāraṇāt the righteous who eat the remnants of the sacrifice are freed from all sins; but those sinful ones who cook food solely for their own sake indeed consume sin.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.14
documents.summary: From food come forth beings; from rain, food is produced; from sacrifice arises rain, and sacrifice is born of action.
documents.searchText: bg.3.14 bg.3.14 chapter 3 verse 14 अननदभवनत भतन परजनयदननसमभव यजञदभवत परजनय यजञ करमसमदभव 3.14 annad bhavanti bhutani parjanyad anna-sambhavah yajnad bhavati parjanyo yajnah karma-samudbhavah from food come forth beings from rain food is produced from sacrifice arises rain and sacrifice is born of action.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.14 bg.3.14 chapter 3 verse 14 अन्नाद्भवन्ति भूतानि पर्जन्यादन्नसम्भवः।

यज्ञाद्भवति पर्जन्यो यज्ञः कर्मसमुद्भवः।।3.14।। annād bhavanti bhūtāni parjanyād anna-sambhavaḥ
yajñād bhavati parjanyo yajñaḥ karma-samudbhavaḥ from food come forth beings; from rain, food is produced; from sacrifice arises rain, and sacrifice is born of action.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.15
documents.summary: Know that action comes from Brahma, and Brahma comes from the Imperishable. Therefore, the all-pervasive Brahma ever rests in sacrifice.
documents.searchText: bg.3.15 bg.3.15 chapter 3 verse 15 करम बरहमदभव वदध बरहमकषरसमदभवम तसमतसरवगत बरहम नतय यजञ परतषठतम 3.15 karma brahmodbhavam viddhi brahmakshara-samudbhavam tasmat sarva-gatam brahma nityam yajne pratishthitam know that action comes from brahma and brahma comes from the imperishable. therefore the all-pervasive brahma ever rests in sacrifice.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.15 bg.3.15 chapter 3 verse 15 कर्म ब्रह्मोद्भवं विद्धि ब्रह्माक्षरसमुद्भवम्।

तस्मात्सर्वगतं ब्रह्म नित्यं यज्ञे प्रतिष्ठितम्।।3.15।। karma brahmodbhavaṁ viddhi brahmākṣhara-samudbhavam
tasmāt sarva-gataṁ brahma nityaṁ yajñe pratiṣhṭhitam know that action comes from brahma, and brahma comes from the imperishable. therefore, the all-pervasive brahma ever rests in sacrifice.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.16
documents.summary: He who does not follow the wheel thus set in motion, who is of sinful life, rejoicing in the senses, lives in vain, O Arjuna.
documents.searchText: bg.3.16 bg.3.16 chapter 3 verse 16 एव परवरतत चकर ननवरतयतह य अघयरनदरयरम मघ परथ स जवत 3.16 evam pravartitam chakram nanuvartayatiha yah aghayur indriyaramo mogham partha sa jivati he who does not follow the wheel thus set in motion who is of sinful life rejoicing in the senses lives in vain o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.16 bg.3.16 chapter 3 verse 16 एवं प्रवर्तितं चक्रं नानुवर्तयतीह यः।

अघायुरिन्द्रियारामो मोघं पार्थ स जीवति।।3.16।। evaṁ pravartitaṁ chakraṁ nānuvartayatīha yaḥ
aghāyur indriyārāmo moghaṁ pārtha sa jīvati he who does not follow the wheel thus set in motion, who is of sinful life, rejoicing in the senses, lives in vain, o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.17
documents.iast: yas tvātma-ratir eva syād ātma-tṛiptaśh cha mānavaḥ
documents.summary: But for that man who rejoices only in the Self, who is satisfied with the Self and is content in the Self alone, indeed there is nothing to do.
documents.searchText: bg.3.17 bg.3.17 chapter 3 verse 17 यसतवतमरतरव सयदतमतपतशच मनव आतमनयव च सनतषटसतसय करय न वदयत 3.17 yas tvatma-ratir eva syad atma-triptash cha manavah atmanyeva cha santushtas tasya karyam na vidyate but for that man who rejoices only in the self who is satisfied with the self and is content in the self alone indeed there is nothing to do.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.17 bg.3.17 chapter 3 verse 17 यस्त्वात्मरतिरेव स्यादात्मतृप्तश्च मानवः।

आत्मन्येव च सन्तुष्टस्तस्य कार्यं न विद्यते।।3.17।। yas tvātma-ratir eva syād ātma-tṛiptaśh cha mānavaḥ
ātmanyeva cha santuṣhṭas tasya kāryaṁ na vidyate but for that man who rejoices only in the self, who is satisfied with the self and is content in the self alone, indeed there is nothing to do.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.18
documents.summary: For him, there is no interest whatsoever in what is done or not done; nor does he depend on any being for any purpose.
