documents.searchText: bg.3.18 bg.3.18 chapter 3 verse 18 नव तसय कतनरथ नकतनह कशचन न चसय सरवभतष कशचदरथवयपशरय 3.18 naiva tasya kritenartho nakriteneha kashchana na chasya sarva-bhuteshu kashchid artha-vyapashrayah for him there is no interest whatsoever in what is done or not done nor does he depend on any being for any purpose.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.18 bg.3.18 chapter 3 verse 18 नैव तस्य कृतेनार्थो नाकृतेनेह कश्चन।

न चास्य सर्वभूतेषु कश्चिदर्थव्यपाश्रयः।।3.18।। naiva tasya kṛitenārtho nākṛiteneha kaśhchana
na chāsya sarva-bhūteṣhu kaśhchid artha-vyapāśhrayaḥ for him, there is no interest whatsoever in what is done or not done; nor does he depend on any being for any purpose.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.19
documents.iast: tasmād asaktaḥ satataṁ kāryaṁ karma samāchara
documents.summary: Therefore, without attachment, always perform the actions that should be done; for by performing actions without attachment, one reaches the Supreme.
documents.searchText: bg.3.19 bg.3.19 chapter 3 verse 19 तसमदसकत सतत करय करम समचर असकत हयचरनकरम परमपनत परष 3.19 tasmad asaktah satatam karyam karma samachara asakto hyacharan karma param apnoti purushah therefore without attachment always perform the actions that should be done for by performing actions without attachment one reaches the supreme.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.19 bg.3.19 chapter 3 verse 19 तस्मादसक्तः सततं कार्यं कर्म समाचर।

असक्तो ह्याचरन्कर्म परमाप्नोति पूरुषः।।3.19।। tasmād asaktaḥ satataṁ kāryaṁ karma samāchara
asakto hyācharan karma param āpnoti pūruṣhaḥ therefore, without attachment, always perform the actions that should be done; for by performing actions without attachment, one reaches the supreme.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.2
documents.summary: With this seemingly perplexing speech, you seem to be confusing my understanding; therefore, tell me one certain way by which I may attain bliss.
documents.searchText: bg.3.2 bg.3.2 chapter 3 verse 2 वयमशरणव वकयन बदध महयसव म तदक वद नशचतय यन शरयऽहमपनयम 3.2 vyamishreneva vakyena buddhim mohayasiva me tad ekam vada nishchitya yena shreyo ham apnuyam with this seemingly perplexing speech you seem to be confusing my understanding therefore tell me one certain way by which i may attain bliss.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.2 bg.3.2 chapter 3 verse 2 व्यामिश्रेणेव वाक्येन बुद्धिं मोहयसीव मे।

तदेकं वद निश्चित्य येन श्रेयोऽहमाप्नुयाम्।।3.2।। vyāmiśhreṇeva vākyena buddhiṁ mohayasīva me
tad ekaṁ vada niśhchitya yena śhreyo ’ham āpnuyām with this seemingly perplexing speech, you seem to be confusing my understanding; therefore, tell me one certain way by which i may attain bliss.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.20
documents.summary: Janaka and others attained perfection indeed through action alone; even with the intention of protecting the masses, you should perform action.
documents.searchText: bg.3.20 bg.3.20 chapter 3 verse 20 करमणव ह ससदधमसथत जनकदय लकसगरहमवप सपशयनकरतमरहस 3.20 karmanaiva hi sansiddhim asthita janakadayah loka-sangraham evapi sampashyan kartum arhasi janaka and others attained perfection indeed through action alone even with the intention of protecting the masses you should perform action.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.20 bg.3.20 chapter 3 verse 20 कर्मणैव हि संसिद्धिमास्थिता जनकादयः।

लोकसंग्रहमेवापि संपश्यन्कर्तुमर्हसि।।3.20।। karmaṇaiva hi sansiddhim āsthitā janakādayaḥ
loka-saṅgraham evāpi sampaśhyan kartum arhasi janaka and others attained perfection indeed through action alone; even with the intention of protecting the masses, you should perform action.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.21
documents.iast: yad yad ācharati śhreṣhṭhas tat tad evetaro janaḥ
documents.summary: Whatever a great man does, others also do; whatever he establishes as the standard, the world follows.
documents.searchText: bg.3.21 bg.3.21 chapter 3 verse 21 यदयदचरत शरषठसतततदवतर जन स यतपरमण करत लकसतदनवरतत 3.21 yad yad acharati shreshthas tat tad evetaro janah sa yat pramanam kurute lokas tad anuvartate whatever a great man does others also do whatever he establishes as the standard the world follows.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.21 bg.3.21 chapter 3 verse 21 यद्यदाचरति श्रेष्ठस्तत्तदेवेतरो जनः।

स यत्प्रमाणं कुरुते लोकस्तदनुवर्तते।।3.21।। yad yad ācharati śhreṣhṭhas tat tad evetaro janaḥ
sa yat pramāṇaṁ kurute lokas tad anuvartate whatever a great man does, others also do; whatever he establishes as the standard, the world follows.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.22
documents.iast: na me pārthāsti kartavyaṁ triṣhu lokeṣhu kiñchana
documents.sanskrit: न मे पार्थास्ति कर्तव्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु किञ्चन।
documents.summary: There is nothing in the three worlds, O Arjuna, that needs to be done by Me, nor is there anything unattained that needs to be attained; yet I engage Myself in action.
documents.searchText: bg.3.22 bg.3.22 chapter 3 verse 22 न म परथसत करतवय तरष लकष कञचन ननवपतमवपतवय वरत एव च करमण 3.22 na me parthasti kartavyam trishu lokeshu kinchana nanavaptam avaptavyam varta eva cha karmani there is nothing in the three worlds o arjuna that needs to be done by me nor is there anything unattained that needs to be attained yet i engage myself in action.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.22 bg.3.22 chapter 3 verse 22 न मे पार्थास्ति कर्तव्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु किञ्चन।

नानवाप्तमवाप्तव्यं वर्त एव च कर्मणि।।3.22।। na me pārthāsti kartavyaṁ triṣhu lokeṣhu kiñchana
nānavāptam avāptavyaṁ varta eva cha karmaṇi there is nothing in the three worlds, o arjuna, that needs to be done by me, nor is there anything unattained that needs to be attained; yet i engage myself in action.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.23
documents.iast: yadi hyahaṁ na varteyaṁ jātu karmaṇyatandritaḥ
documents.sanskrit: यदि ह्यहं न वर्तेयं जातु कर्मण्यतन्द्रितः।
documents.summary: For, should I not ever engage myself in action, unwearied, people would in every way follow my path, O Arjuna.
documents.searchText: bg.3.23 bg.3.23 chapter 3 verse 23 यद हयह न वरतय जत करमणयतनदरत मम वरतमनवरतनत मनषय परथ सरवश 3.23 yadi hyaham na varteyam jatu karmanyatandritah mama vartmanuvartante manushyah partha sarvashah for should i not ever engage myself in action unwearied people would in every way follow my path o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.23 bg.3.23 chapter 3 verse 23 यदि ह्यहं न वर्तेयं जातु कर्मण्यतन्द्रितः।

मम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः।।3.23।। yadi hyahaṁ na varteyaṁ jātu karmaṇyatandritaḥ
mama vartmānuvartante manuṣhyāḥ pārtha sarvaśhaḥ for, should i not ever engage myself in action, unwearied, people would in every way follow my path, o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.24
documents.iast: utsīdeyur ime lokā na kuryāṁ karma ched aham
documents.sanskrit: उत्सीदेयुरिमे लोका न कुर्यां कर्म चेदहम्।
documents.summary: These worlds would perish if I did not perform action; I would be the author of confusion of castes and destruction of these beings.
documents.searchText: bg.3.24 bg.3.24 chapter 3 verse 24 उतसदयरम लक न करय करम चदहम सङकरसय च करत सयमपहनयमम परज 3.24 utsideyur ime loka na kuryam karma ched aham sankarasya cha karta syam upahanyam imah prajah these worlds would perish if i did not perform action i would be the author of confusion of castes and destruction of these beings.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.24 bg.3.24 chapter 3 verse 24 उत्सीदेयुरिमे लोका न कुर्यां कर्म चेदहम्।

सङ्करस्य च कर्ता स्यामुपहन्यामिमाः प्रजाः।।3.24।। utsīdeyur ime lokā na kuryāṁ karma ched aham
sankarasya cha kartā syām upahanyām imāḥ prajāḥ these worlds would perish if i did not perform action; i would be the author of confusion of castes and destruction of these beings.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.25
documents.summary: As the ignorant act out of attachment to action, O Bharata, so should the wise act without attachment, wishing for the welfare of the world.
documents.searchText: bg.3.25 bg.3.25 chapter 3 verse 25 सकत करमणयवदवस यथ करवनत भरत करयदवदवसतथसकतशचकरषरलकसगरहम 3.25 saktah karmanyavidvanso yatha kurvanti bharata kuryad vidvans tathasaktash chikirshur loka-sangraham as the ignorant act out of attachment to action o bharata so should the wise act without attachment wishing for the welfare of the world.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.25 bg.3.25 chapter 3 verse 25 सक्ताः कर्मण्यविद्वांसो यथा कुर्वन्ति भारत।

कुर्याद्विद्वांस्तथासक्तश्चिकीर्षुर्लोकसंग्रहम्।।3.25।। saktāḥ karmaṇyavidvānso yathā kurvanti bhārata
kuryād vidvāns tathāsaktaśh chikīrṣhur loka-saṅgraham as the ignorant act out of attachment to action, o bharata, so should the wise act without attachment, wishing for the welfare of the world.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.26
documents.summary: Let no wise man unsettle the minds of ignorant people who are attached to action; he should engage them in all actions, himself fulfilling them with devotion.
documents.searchText: bg.3.26 bg.3.26 chapter 3 verse 26 न बदधभद जनयदजञन करमसङगनम जषयतसरवकरमण वदवन यकत समचरन 3.26 na buddhi-bhedam janayed ajnanam karma-sanginam joshayet sarva-karmani vidvan yuktah samacharan let no wise man unsettle the minds of ignorant people who are attached to action he should engage them in all actions himself fulfilling them with devotion.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.26 bg.3.26 chapter 3 verse 26 न बुद्धिभेदं जनयेदज्ञानां कर्मसङ्गिनाम्।

जोषयेत्सर्वकर्माणि विद्वान् युक्तः समाचरन्।।3.26।। na buddhi-bhedaṁ janayed ajñānāṁ karma-saṅginām
joṣhayet sarva-karmāṇi vidvān yuktaḥ samācharan let no wise man unsettle the minds of ignorant people who are attached to action; he should engage them in all actions, himself fulfilling them with devotion.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.27
documents.summary: All actions are wrought in all cases by the qualities of Nature alone. He whose mind is deluded by egoism thinks, "I am the doer."
documents.searchText: bg.3.27 bg.3.27 chapter 3 verse 27 परकत करयमणन गण करमण सरवश अहङकरवमढतम करतऽहमत मनयत 3.27 prakriteh kriyamanani gunaih karmani sarvashah ahankara-vimudhatma kartaham iti manyate all actions are wrought in all cases by the qualities of nature alone. he whose mind is deluded by egoism thinks i am the doer.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.27 bg.3.27 chapter 3 verse 27 प्रकृतेः क्रियमाणानि गुणैः कर्माणि सर्वशः।

अहङ्कारविमूढात्मा कर्ताऽहमिति मन्यते।।3.27।। prakṛiteḥ kriyamāṇāni guṇaiḥ karmāṇi sarvaśhaḥ
ahankāra-vimūḍhātmā kartāham iti manyate all actions are wrought in all cases by the qualities of nature alone. he whose mind is deluded by egoism thinks, "i am the doer."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.28
documents.summary: But he who knows the Truth, O mighty-armed Arjuna, about the divisions of the qualities and their functions, knowing that the Gunas, as senses, move amidst the Gunas, as the sense-
documents.searchText: bg.3.28 bg.3.28 chapter 3 verse 28 तततववतत महबह गणकरमवभगय गण गणष वरतनत इत मतव न सजजत 3.28 tattva-vit tu maha-baho guna-karma-vibhagayoh guna guneshu vartanta iti matva na sajjate but he who knows the truth o mighty-armed arjuna about the divisions of the qualities and their functions knowing that the gunas as senses move amidst the gunas as the sense-objects is not attached.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.28 bg.3.28 chapter 3 verse 28 तत्त्ववित्तु महाबाहो गुणकर्मविभागयोः।

गुणा गुणेषु वर्तन्त इति मत्वा न सज्जते।।3.28।। tattva-vit tu mahā-bāho guṇa-karma-vibhāgayoḥ
guṇā guṇeṣhu vartanta iti matvā na sajjate but he who knows the truth, o mighty-armed arjuna, about the divisions of the qualities and their functions, knowing that the gunas, as senses, move amidst the gunas, as the sense-objects, is not attached.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.29
documents.summary: Those deluded by the qualities of Nature are attached to the functions of the qualities. The man of perfect knowledge should not unsettle the foolish one who is of imperfect knowle
documents.searchText: bg.3.29 bg.3.29 chapter 3 verse 29 परकतरगणसममढ सजजनत गणकरमस तनकतसनवद मनदनकतसनवनन वचलयत 3.29 prakriter guna-sammudhah sajjante guna-karmasu tan akritsna-vido mandan kritsna-vin na vichalayet those deluded by the qualities of nature are attached to the functions of the qualities. the man of perfect knowledge should not unsettle the foolish one who is of imperfect knowledge.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.29 bg.3.29 chapter 3 verse 29 प्रकृतेर्गुणसम्मूढाः सज्जन्ते गुणकर्मसु।

तानकृत्स्नविदो मन्दान्कृत्स्नविन्न विचालयेत्।।3.29।। prakṛiter guṇa-sammūḍhāḥ sajjante guṇa-karmasu
tān akṛitsna-vido mandān kṛitsna-vin na vichālayet those deluded by the qualities of nature are attached to the functions of the qualities. the man of perfect knowledge should not unsettle the foolish one who is of imperfect knowledge.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.3
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, "In this world, there is a twofold path, as I said before, O sinless one: the path of knowledge of the Sankhyas and the path of action of the Yogins."
documents.searchText: bg.3.3 bg.3.3 chapter 3 verse 3 शर भगवनवच लकऽसमनदववध नषठ पर परकत मयनघ जञनयगन सखयन करमयगन यगनम 3.3 shri bhagavan uvacha loke smin dvi-vidha nishtha pura prokta mayanagha jnana-yogena sankhyanam karma-yogena yoginam the blessed lord said in this world there is a twofold path as i said before o sinless one the path of knowledge of the sankhyas and the path of action of the yogins.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.3 bg.3.3 chapter 3 verse 3 श्री भगवानुवाच

लोकेऽस्मिन्द्विविधा निष्ठा पुरा प्रोक्ता मयानघ।

ज्ञानयोगेन सांख्यानां कर्मयोगेन योगिनाम्।।3.3।। śhrī bhagavān uvācha
loke’smin dvi-vidhā niṣhṭhā purā proktā mayānagha
jñāna-yogena sāṅkhyānāṁ karma-yogena yoginām the blessed lord said, "in this world, there is a twofold path, as i said before, o sinless one: the path of knowledge of the sankhyas and the path of action of the yogins."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.30
documents.summary: Renouncing all actions in Me, with the mind centered on the Self, free from hope and egoism, and from mental fever, fight thou.
documents.searchText: bg.3.30 bg.3.30 chapter 3 verse 30 मय सरवण करमण सनयसयधयतमचतस नरशरनरमम भतव यधयसव वगतजवर 3.30 mayi sarvani karmani sannyasyadhyatma-chetasa nirashir nirmamo bhutva yudhyasva vigata-jvarah renouncing all actions in me with the mind centered on the self free from hope and egoism and from mental fever fight thou.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.30 bg.3.30 chapter 3 verse 30 मयि सर्वाणि कर्माणि संन्यस्याध्यात्मचेतसा।

निराशीर्निर्ममो भूत्वा युध्यस्व विगतज्वरः।।3.30।। mayi sarvāṇi karmāṇi sannyasyādhyātma-chetasā
nirāśhīr nirmamo bhūtvā yudhyasva vigata-jvaraḥ renouncing all actions in me, with the mind centered on the self, free from hope and egoism, and from mental fever, fight thou.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.31
documents.iast: ye me matam idaṁ nityam anutiṣhṭhanti mānavāḥ
documents.summary: Those who constantly practice this teaching of Mine with faith and without caviling, they too are freed from actions.
documents.searchText: bg.3.31 bg.3.31 chapter 3 verse 31 य म मतमद नतयमनतषठनत मनव शरदधवनतऽनसयनत मचयनत तऽप करमभ 3.31 ye me matam idam nityam anutishthanti manavah shraddhavanto nasuyanto muchyante te pi karmabhih those who constantly practice this teaching of mine with faith and without caviling they too are freed from actions.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.31 bg.3.31 chapter 3 verse 31 ये मे मतमिदं नित्यमनुतिष्ठन्ति मानवाः।

श्रद्धावन्तोऽनसूयन्तो मुच्यन्ते तेऽपि कर्मभिः।।3.31।। ye me matam idaṁ nityam anutiṣhṭhanti mānavāḥ
śhraddhāvanto ’nasūyanto muchyante te ’pi karmabhiḥ those who constantly practice this teaching of mine with faith and without caviling, they too are freed from actions.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.32
documents.iast: ye tvetad abhyasūyanto nānutiṣhṭhanti me matam
documents.summary: But those who criticize My teaching and do not practice it, deprived of all knowledge and lacking discernment, know them to be doomed to destruction.
documents.searchText: bg.3.32 bg.3.32 chapter 3 verse 32 य तवतदभयसयनत ननतषठनत म मतम सरवजञनवमढसतनवदध नषटनचतस 3.32 ye tvetad abhyasuyanto nanutishthanti me matam sarva-jnana-vimudhans tan viddhi nashtan achetasah but those who criticize my teaching and do not practice it deprived of all knowledge and lacking discernment know them to be doomed to destruction.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.32 bg.3.32 chapter 3 verse 32 ये त्वेतदभ्यसूयन्तो नानुतिष्ठन्ति मे मतम्।

सर्वज्ञानविमूढांस्तान्विद्धि नष्टानचेतसः।।3.32।। ye tvetad abhyasūyanto nānutiṣhṭhanti me matam
sarva-jñāna-vimūḍhāns tān viddhi naṣhṭān achetasaḥ but those who criticize my teaching and do not practice it, deprived of all knowledge and lacking discernment, know them to be doomed to destruction.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.33
documents.iast: sadṛiśhaṁ cheṣhṭate svasyāḥ prakṛiter jñānavān api
documents.summary: Even a wise man acts in accordance with his own nature; beings will follow their nature; what can restraint do?
documents.searchText: bg.3.33 bg.3.33 chapter 3 verse 33 सदश चषटत सवसय परकतरजञनवनप परकत यनत भतन नगरह क करषयत 3.33 sadrisham cheshtate svasyah prakriter jnanavan api prakritim yanti bhutani nigrahah kim karishyati even a wise man acts in accordance with his own nature beings will follow their nature what can restraint do
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.33 bg.3.33 chapter 3 verse 33 सदृशं चेष्टते स्वस्याः प्रकृतेर्ज्ञानवानपि।

प्रकृतिं यान्ति भूतानि निग्रहः किं करिष्यति।।3.33।। sadṛiśhaṁ cheṣhṭate svasyāḥ prakṛiter jñānavān api
prakṛitiṁ yānti bhūtāni nigrahaḥ kiṁ kariṣhyati even a wise man acts in accordance with his own nature; beings will follow their nature; what can restraint do?

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.34
documents.summary: Attachment and aversion for the objects of the senses abide in the senses; let no one come under their sway; for, they are his enemies.
documents.searchText: bg.3.34 bg.3.34 chapter 3 verse 34 इनदरयसयनदरयसयरथ रगदवष वयवसथत तयरन वशमगचछतत हयसय परपनथन 3.34 indriyasyendriyasyarthe raga-dveshau vyavasthitau tayor na vasham agachchhet tau hyasya paripanthinau attachment and aversion for the objects of the senses abide in the senses let no one come under their sway for they are his enemies.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.34 bg.3.34 chapter 3 verse 34 इन्द्रियस्येन्द्रियस्यार्थे रागद्वेषौ व्यवस्थितौ।

तयोर्न वशमागच्छेत्तौ ह्यस्य परिपन्थिनौ।।3.34।। indriyasyendriyasyārthe rāga-dveṣhau vyavasthitau
tayor na vaśham āgachchhet tau hyasya paripanthinau attachment and aversion for the objects of the senses abide in the senses; let no one come under their sway; for, they are his enemies.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.35
documents.summary: Better is one's own duty, though devoid of merit, than the duty of another well discharged. Better is death in one's own duty; the duty of another is fraught with fear.
documents.searchText: bg.3.35 bg.3.35 chapter 3 verse 35 शरयनसवधरम वगण परधरमतसवनषठतत सवधरम नधन शरय परधरम भयवह 3.35 shreyan swa-dharmo vigunah para-dharmat sv-anushthitat swa-dharme nidhanam shreyah para-dharmo bhayavahah better is one s own duty though devoid of merit than the duty of another well discharged. better is death in one s own duty the duty of another is fraught with fear.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.35 bg.3.35 chapter 3 verse 35 श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात्।

स्वधर्मे निधनं श्रेयः परधर्मो भयावहः।।3.35।। śhreyān swa-dharmo viguṇaḥ para-dharmāt sv-anuṣhṭhitāt
swa-dharme nidhanaṁ śhreyaḥ para-dharmo bhayāvahaḥ better is one's own duty, though devoid of merit, than the duty of another well discharged. better is death in one's own duty; the duty of another is fraught with fear.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.36
documents.summary: Arjuna said, "But what compels man to commit sin, even against his wishes, O Varshneya (Krishna), as if constrained by force?"
documents.searchText: bg.3.36 bg.3.36 chapter 3 verse 36 अरजन उवच अथ कन परयकतऽय पप चरत परष अनचछननप वरषणय बलदव नयजत 3.36 arjuna uvacha atha kena prayukto yam papam charati purushah anichchhann api varshneya balad iva niyojitah arjuna said but what compels man to commit sin even against his wishes o varshneya krishna as if constrained by force
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.36 bg.3.36 chapter 3 verse 36 अर्जुन उवाच

अथ केन प्रयुक्तोऽयं पापं चरति पूरुषः।

अनिच्छन्नपि वार्ष्णेय बलादिव नियोजितः।।3.36।। arjuna uvācha
atha kena prayukto ’yaṁ pāpaṁ charati pūruṣhaḥ
anichchhann api vārṣhṇeya balād iva niyojitaḥ arjuna said, "but what compels man to commit sin, even against his wishes, o varshneya (krishna), as if constrained by force?"

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.37
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, "It is desire and it is anger, both of the quality of Rajas, all-devouring and all-sinful; know this as the foe here in this world."
documents.searchText: bg.3.37 bg.3.37 chapter 3 verse 37 शर भगवनवच कम एष करध एष रजगणसमदभव महशन महपपम वदधयनमह वरणम 3.37 shri bhagavan uvacha kama esha krodha esha rajo-guna-samudbhavah mahashano maha-papma viddhyenam iha vairinam the blessed lord said it is desire and it is anger both of the quality of rajas all-devouring and all-sinful know this as the foe here in this world.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.37 bg.3.37 chapter 3 verse 37 श्री भगवानुवाच

काम एष क्रोध एष रजोगुणसमुद्भवः।

महाशनो महापाप्मा विद्ध्येनमिह वैरिणम्।।3.37।। śhrī bhagavān uvācha
kāma eṣha krodha eṣha rajo-guṇa-samudbhavaḥ
mahāśhano mahā-pāpmā viddhyenam iha vairiṇam the blessed lord said, "it is desire and it is anger, both of the quality of rajas, all-devouring and all-sinful; know this as the foe here in this world."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.38
documents.summary: As fire is enveloped by smoke, as a mirror is covered by dust, and as an embryo is surrounded by the amniotic sac, so is this enveloped by that.
documents.searchText: bg.3.38 bg.3.38 chapter 3 verse 38 धमनवरयत वहनरयथऽऽदरश मलन च यथलबनवत गरभसतथ तनदमवतम 3.38 dhumenavriyate vahnir yathadarsho malena cha yatholbenavrito garbhas tatha tenedam avritam as fire is enveloped by smoke as a mirror is covered by dust and as an embryo is surrounded by the amniotic sac so is this enveloped by that.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.38 bg.3.38 chapter 3 verse 38 धूमेनाव्रियते वह्निर्यथाऽऽदर्शो मलेन च।

यथोल्बेनावृतो गर्भस्तथा तेनेदमावृतम्।।3.38।। dhūmenāvriyate vahnir yathādarśho malena cha
yatholbenāvṛito garbhas tathā tenedam āvṛitam as fire is enveloped by smoke, as a mirror is covered by dust, and as an embryo is surrounded by the amniotic sac, so is this enveloped by that.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.39
documents.summary: O Arjuna, wisdom is enveloped by this constant enemy of the wise, in the form of desire, which is insatiable like fire.
documents.searchText: bg.3.39 bg.3.39 chapter 3 verse 39 आवत जञनमतन जञनन नतयवरण कमरपण कनतय दषपरणनलन च 3.39 avritam jnanam etena jnanino nitya-vairina kama-rupena kaunteya dushpurenanalena cha o arjuna wisdom is enveloped by this constant enemy of the wise in the form of desire which is insatiable like fire.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.39 bg.3.39 chapter 3 verse 39 आवृतं ज्ञानमेतेन ज्ञानिनो नित्यवैरिणा।

कामरूपेण कौन्तेय दुष्पूरेणानलेन च।।3.39।। āvṛitaṁ jñānam etena jñānino nitya-vairiṇā
kāma-rūpeṇa kaunteya duṣhpūreṇānalena cha o arjuna, wisdom is enveloped by this constant enemy of the wise, in the form of desire, which is insatiable like fire.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.4
documents.summary: Man does not reach actionlessness by not performing actions; nor does he attain perfection by mere renunciation.
documents.searchText: bg.3.4 bg.3.4 chapter 3 verse 4 न करमणमनरमभननषकरमय परषऽशनत न च सनयसनदव सदध समधगचछत 3.4 na karmanam anarambhan naishkarmyam purusho shnute na cha sannyasanad eva siddhim samadhigachchhati man does not reach actionlessness by not performing actions nor does he attain perfection by mere renunciation.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.4 bg.3.4 chapter 3 verse 4 न कर्मणामनारम्भान्नैष्कर्म्यं पुरुषोऽश्नुते।

न च संन्यसनादेव सिद्धिं समधिगच्छति।।3.4।। na karmaṇām anārambhān naiṣhkarmyaṁ puruṣho ’śhnute
na cha sannyasanād eva siddhiṁ samadhigachchhati man does not reach actionlessness by not performing actions; nor does he attain perfection by mere renunciation.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.40
documents.summary: The senses, the mind, and the intellect are said to be its seat; through these, it deludes the embodied one, veiling their wisdom.
documents.searchText: bg.3.40 bg.3.40 chapter 3 verse 40 इनदरयण मन बदधरसयधषठनमचयत एतरवमहयतयष जञनमवतय दहनम 3.40 indriyani mano buddhir asyadhishthanam uchyate etair vimohayatyesha jnanam avritya dehinam the senses the mind and the intellect are said to be its seat through these it deludes the embodied one veiling their wisdom.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.40 bg.3.40 chapter 3 verse 40 इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिरस्याधिष्ठानमुच्यते।

एतैर्विमोहयत्येष ज्ञानमावृत्य देहिनम्।।3.40।। indriyāṇi mano buddhir asyādhiṣhṭhānam uchyate
etair vimohayatyeṣha jñānam āvṛitya dehinam the senses, the mind, and the intellect are said to be its seat; through these, it deludes the embodied one, veiling their wisdom.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.41
documents.summary: Therefore, O best of the Bharatas, control your senses first and then kill this sinful thing, which destroys knowledge and realization.
documents.searchText: bg.3.41 bg.3.41 chapter 3 verse 41 तसमततवमनदरयणयद नयमय भरतरषभ पपमन परजह हयन जञनवजञननशनम 3.41 tasmat tvam indriyanyadau niyamya bharatarshabha papmanam prajahi hyenam jnana-vijnana-nashanam therefore o best of the bharatas control your senses first and then kill this sinful thing which destroys knowledge and realization.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.41 bg.3.41 chapter 3 verse 41 तस्मात्त्वमिन्द्रियाण्यादौ नियम्य भरतर्षभ।

पाप्मानं प्रजहि ह्येनं ज्ञानविज्ञाननाशनम्।।3.41।। tasmāt tvam indriyāṇyādau niyamya bharatarṣhabha
pāpmānaṁ prajahi hyenaṁ jñāna-vijñāna-nāśhanam therefore, o best of the bharatas, control your senses first and then kill this sinful thing, which destroys knowledge and realization.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.42
documents.summary: They say that the senses are superior to the body; the mind is superior to the senses; the intellect is superior to the mind; and He (the Self) is superior even to the intellect.
documents.searchText: bg.3.42 bg.3.42 chapter 3 verse 42 इनदरयण परणयहरनदरयभय पर मन मनससत पर बदधरय बदध परतसत स 3.42 indriyani paranyahur indriyebhyah param manah manasas tu para buddhir yo buddheh paratas tu sah they say that the senses are superior to the body the mind is superior to the senses the intellect is superior to the mind and he the self is superior even to the intellect.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.42 bg.3.42 chapter 3 verse 42 इन्द्रियाणि पराण्याहुरिन्द्रियेभ्यः परं मनः।

मनसस्तु परा बुद्धिर्यो बुद्धेः परतस्तु सः।।3.42।। indriyāṇi parāṇyāhur indriyebhyaḥ paraṁ manaḥ
manasas tu parā buddhir yo buddheḥ paratas tu saḥ they say that the senses are superior to the body; the mind is superior to the senses; the intellect is superior to the mind; and he (the self) is superior even to the intellect.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.43
documents.iast: evaṁ buddheḥ paraṁ buddhvā sanstabhyātmānam ātmanā
documents.summary: Thus, knowing Him who is superior to the intellect and restraining the self by the Self, slay thou, O mighty-armed Arjuna, the enemy in the form of desire, hard to conquer.
documents.searchText: bg.3.43 bg.3.43 chapter 3 verse 43 एव बदध पर बदधव ससतभयतमनमतमन जह शतर महबह कमरप दरसदम 3.43 evam buddheh param buddhva sanstabhyatmanam atmana jahi shatrum maha-baho kama-rupam durasadam thus knowing him who is superior to the intellect and restraining the self by the self slay thou o mighty-armed arjuna the enemy in the form of desire hard to conquer.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.43 bg.3.43 chapter 3 verse 43 एवं बुद्धेः परं बुद्ध्वा संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना।

जहि शत्रुं महाबाहो कामरूपं दुरासदम्।।3.43।। evaṁ buddheḥ paraṁ buddhvā sanstabhyātmānam ātmanā
jahi śhatruṁ mahā-bāho kāma-rūpaṁ durāsadam thus, knowing him who is superior to the intellect and restraining the self by the self, slay thou, o mighty-armed arjuna, the enemy in the form of desire, hard to conquer.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.5
documents.iast: na hi kaśhchit kṣhaṇam api jātu tiṣhṭhatyakarma-kṛit
documents.summary: Verily, no one can remain for even a moment without performing action; for everyone is made to act helplessly, indeed, by the qualities born of Nature.
documents.searchText: bg.3.5 bg.3.5 chapter 3 verse 5 न ह कशचतकषणमप जत तषठतयकरमकत करयत हयवश करम सरव परकतजरगण 3.5 na hi kashchit kshanam api jatu tishthatyakarma-krit karyate hyavashah karma sarvah prakriti-jair gunaih verily no one can remain for even a moment without performing action for everyone is made to act helplessly indeed by the qualities born of nature.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.5 bg.3.5 chapter 3 verse 5 न हि कश्चित्क्षणमपि जातु तिष्ठत्यकर्मकृत्।

कार्यते ह्यवशः कर्म सर्वः प्रकृतिजैर्गुणैः।।3.5।। na hi kaśhchit kṣhaṇam api jātu tiṣhṭhatyakarma-kṛit
kāryate hyavaśhaḥ karma sarvaḥ prakṛiti-jair guṇaiḥ verily, no one can remain for even a moment without performing action; for everyone is made to act helplessly, indeed, by the qualities born of nature.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.6
documents.iast: karmendriyāṇi sanyamya ya āste manasā smaran
documents.sanskrit: कर्मेन्द्रियाणि संयम्य य आस्ते मनसा स्मरन्।
documents.summary: He who, restraining the organs of action, sits thinking of the sense-objects in his mind, he of deluded understanding is called a hypocrite.
documents.searchText: bg.3.6 bg.3.6 chapter 3 verse 6 करमनदरयण सयमय य आसत मनस समरन इनदरयरथनवमढतम मथयचर स उचयत 3.6 karmendriyani sanyamya ya aste manasa smaran indriyarthan vimudhatma mithyacharah sa uchyate he who restraining the organs of action sits thinking of the sense-objects in his mind he of deluded understanding is called a hypocrite.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.6 bg.3.6 chapter 3 verse 6 कर्मेन्द्रियाणि संयम्य य आस्ते मनसा स्मरन्।

इन्द्रियार्थान्विमूढात्मा मिथ्याचारः स उच्यते।।3.6।। karmendriyāṇi sanyamya ya āste manasā smaran
indriyārthān vimūḍhātmā mithyāchāraḥ sa uchyate he who, restraining the organs of action, sits thinking of the sense-objects in his mind, he of deluded understanding is called a hypocrite.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.7
documents.summary: But whoever, controlling the senses by the mind, O Arjuna, engages himself in Karma Yoga with the organs of action, without attachment, he excels.
documents.searchText: bg.3.7 bg.3.7 chapter 3 verse 7 यसतवनदरयण मनस नयमयरभतऽरजन करमनदरय करमयगमसकत स वशषयत 3.7 yas tvindriyani manasa niyamyarabhate rjuna karmendriyaih karma-yogam asaktah sa vishishyate but whoever controlling the senses by the mind o arjuna engages himself in karma yoga with the organs of action without attachment he excels.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.7 bg.3.7 chapter 3 verse 7 यस्त्विन्द्रियाणि मनसा नियम्यारभतेऽर्जुन।

कर्मेन्द्रियैः कर्मयोगमसक्तः स विशिष्यते।।3.7।। yas tvindriyāṇi manasā niyamyārabhate ’rjuna
karmendriyaiḥ karma-yogam asaktaḥ sa viśhiṣhyate but whoever, controlling the senses by the mind, o arjuna, engages himself in karma yoga with the organs of action, without attachment, he excels.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.8
documents.iast: niyataṁ kuru karma tvaṁ karma jyāyo hyakarmaṇaḥ
documents.sanskrit: नियतं कुरु कर्म त्वं कर्म ज्यायो ह्यकर्मणः।
documents.summary: Perform your bounden duty, for action is superior to inaction, and even the maintenance of the body would not be possible for you through inaction.
documents.searchText: bg.3.8 bg.3.8 chapter 3 verse 8 नयत कर करम तव करम जयय हयकरमण शररयतरप च त न परसदधयदकरमण 3.8 niyatam kuru karma tvam karma jyayo hyakarmanah sharira-yatrapi cha te na prasiddhyed akarmanah perform your bounden duty for action is superior to inaction and even the maintenance of the body would not be possible for you through inaction.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.8 bg.3.8 chapter 3 verse 8 नियतं कुरु कर्म त्वं कर्म ज्यायो ह्यकर्मणः।

शरीरयात्रापि च ते न प्रसिद्ध्येदकर्मणः।।3.8।। niyataṁ kuru karma tvaṁ karma jyāyo hyakarmaṇaḥ
śharīra-yātrāpi cha te na prasiddhyed akarmaṇaḥ perform your bounden duty, for action is superior to inaction, and even the maintenance of the body would not be possible for you through inaction.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 3.9
documents.summary: The world is bound by actions other than those performed for the sake of sacrifice; do thou, therefore, O son of Kunti (Arjuna), perform actions for that sake alone, free from atta
documents.searchText: bg.3.9 bg.3.9 chapter 3 verse 9 यजञरथतकरमणऽनयतर लकऽय करमबनधन तदरथ करम कनतय मकतसग समचर 3.9 yajnarthat karmano nyatra loko yam karma-bandhanah tad-artham karma kaunteya mukta-sangah samachara the world is bound by actions other than those performed for the sake of sacrifice do thou therefore o son of kunti arjuna perform actions for that sake alone free from attachment.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.3.9 bg.3.9 chapter 3 verse 9 यज्ञार्थात्कर्मणोऽन्यत्र लोकोऽयं कर्मबन्धनः।

तदर्थं कर्म कौन्तेय मुक्तसंगः समाचर।।3.9।। yajñārthāt karmaṇo ’nyatra loko ’yaṁ karma-bandhanaḥ
tad-arthaṁ karma kaunteya mukta-saṅgaḥ samāchara the world is bound by actions other than those performed for the sake of sacrifice; do thou, therefore, o son of kunti (arjuna), perform actions for that sake alone, free from attachment.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.1
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, "I taught this imperishable Yoga to Vivasvan; he then told it to Manu; Manu proclaimed it to Ikshvaku.
documents.searchText: bg.4.1 bg.4.1 chapter 4 verse 1 शर भगवनवच इम ववसवत यग परकतवनहमवययम ववसवन मनव परह मनरकषवकवऽबरवत 4.1 shri bhagavan uvacha imam vivasvate yogam proktavan aham avyayam vivasvan manave praha manur ikshvakave bravit the blessed lord said i taught this imperishable yoga to vivasvan he then told it to manu manu proclaimed it to ikshvaku.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.1 bg.4.1 chapter 4 verse 1 श्री भगवानुवाच

इमं विवस्वते योगं प्रोक्तवानहमव्ययम्।

विवस्वान् मनवे प्राह मनुरिक्ष्वाकवेऽब्रवीत्।।4.1।। śhrī bhagavān uvācha
imaṁ vivasvate yogaṁ proktavān aham avyayam
vivasvān manave prāha manur ikṣhvākave ’bravīt the blessed lord said, "i taught this imperishable yoga to vivasvan; he then told it to manu; manu proclaimed it to ikshvaku.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.10
documents.summary: Freed from attachment, fear, and anger, absorbed in Me, taking refuge in Me, purified by the fire of knowledge, many have attained My Being.
documents.searchText: bg.4.10 bg.4.10 chapter 4 verse 10 वतरगभयकरध मनमय ममपशरत बहव जञनतपस पत मदभवमगत 4.10 vita-raga-bhaya-krodha man-maya mam upashritah bahavo jnana-tapasa puta mad-bhavam agatah freed from attachment fear and anger absorbed in me taking refuge in me purified by the fire of knowledge many have attained my being.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.10 bg.4.10 chapter 4 verse 10 वीतरागभयक्रोधा मन्मया मामुपाश्रिताः।

बहवो ज्ञानतपसा पूता मद्भावमागताः।।4.10।। vīta-rāga-bhaya-krodhā man-mayā mām upāśhritāḥ
bahavo jñāna-tapasā pūtā mad-bhāvam āgatāḥ freed from attachment, fear, and anger, absorbed in me, taking refuge in me, purified by the fire of knowledge, many have attained my being.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.11
documents.iast: ye yathā māṁ prapadyante tāns tathaiva bhajāmyaham
documents.sanskrit: ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम्।
documents.summary: In whatever way men approach Me, even so do I reward them; My path do men tread in all ways, O Arjuna.
documents.searchText: bg.4.11 bg.4.11 chapter 4 verse 11 य यथ म परपदयनत तसतथव भजमयहम मम वरतमनवरतनत मनषय परथ सरवश 4.11 ye yatha mam prapadyante tans tathaiva bhajamyaham mama vartmanuvartante manushyah partha sarvashah in whatever way men approach me even so do i reward them my path do men tread in all ways o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.11 bg.4.11 chapter 4 verse 11 ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम्।

मम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः।।4.11।। ye yathā māṁ prapadyante tāns tathaiva bhajāmyaham
mama vartmānuvartante manuṣhyāḥ pārtha sarvaśhaḥ in whatever way men approach me, even so do i reward them; my path do men tread in all ways, o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.12
documents.iast: kāṅkṣhantaḥ karmaṇāṁ siddhiṁ yajanta iha devatāḥ
documents.sanskrit: काङ्क्षन्तः कर्मणां सिद्धिं यजन्त इह देवताः।
documents.summary: Those who long for success in action in this world sacrifice to the gods; for success is quickly attained by men through action.
documents.searchText: bg.4.12 bg.4.12 chapter 4 verse 12 कङकषनत करमण सदध यजनत इह दवत कषपर ह मनष लक सदधरभवत करमज 4.12 kankshantah karmanam siddhim yajanta iha devatah kshipram hi manushe loke siddhir bhavati karmaja those who long for success in action in this world sacrifice to the gods for success is quickly attained by men through action.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.12 bg.4.12 chapter 4 verse 12 काङ्क्षन्तः कर्मणां सिद्धिं यजन्त इह देवताः।

क्षिप्रं हि मानुषे लोके सिद्धिर्भवति कर्मजा।।4.12।। kāṅkṣhantaḥ karmaṇāṁ siddhiṁ yajanta iha devatāḥ
kṣhipraṁ hi mānuṣhe loke siddhir bhavati karmajā those who long for success in action in this world sacrifice to the gods; for success is quickly attained by men through action.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.13
documents.summary: The fourfold caste has been created by Me according to the differentiation of Guna and Karma; though I am the author of it, know Me as non-doer and immutable.
documents.searchText: bg.4.13 bg.4.13 chapter 4 verse 13 चतरवरणय मय सषट गणकरमवभगश तसय करतरमप म वदधयकरतरमवययम 4.13 chatur-varnyam maya srishtam guna-karma-vibhagashah tasya kartaram api mam viddhyakartaram avyayam the fourfold caste has been created by me according to the differentiation of guna and karma though i am the author of it know me as non-doer and immutable.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.13 bg.4.13 chapter 4 verse 13 चातुर्वर्ण्यं मया सृष्टं गुणकर्मविभागशः।

तस्य कर्तारमपि मां विद्ध्यकर्तारमव्ययम्।।4.13।। chātur-varṇyaṁ mayā sṛiṣhṭaṁ guṇa-karma-vibhāgaśhaḥ
tasya kartāram api māṁ viddhyakartāram avyayam the fourfold caste has been created by me according to the differentiation of guna and karma; though i am the author of it, know me as non-doer and immutable.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.14
documents.iast: na māṁ karmāṇi limpanti na me karma-phale spṛihā
documents.sanskrit: न मां कर्माणि लिम्पन्ति न मे कर्मफले स्पृहा।
documents.summary: Actions do not taint Me, nor do I have a desire for the fruit of actions. He who knows Me thus is not bound by actions.
documents.searchText: bg.4.14 bg.4.14 chapter 4 verse 14 न म करमण लमपनत न म करमफल सपह इत म यऽभजनत करमभरन स बधयत 4.14 na mam karmani limpanti na me karma-phale spriha iti mam yo bhijanati karmabhir na sa badhyate actions do not taint me nor do i have a desire for the fruit of actions. he who knows me thus is not bound by actions.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.14 bg.4.14 chapter 4 verse 14 न मां कर्माणि लिम्पन्ति न मे कर्मफले स्पृहा।

इति मां योऽभिजानाति कर्मभिर्न स बध्यते।।4.14।। na māṁ karmāṇi limpanti na me karma-phale spṛihā
iti māṁ yo ’bhijānāti karmabhir na sa badhyate actions do not taint me, nor do i have a desire for the fruit of actions. he who knows me thus is not bound by actions.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.15
documents.iast: evaṁ jñātvā kṛitaṁ karma pūrvair api mumukṣhubhiḥ
documents.sanskrit: एवं ज्ञात्वा कृतं कर्म पूर्वैरपि मुमुक्षुभिः।
documents.summary: Having known this, the ancient seekers of freedom also performed action; therefore, do thou also perform action, as the ancients did in days of yore.
documents.searchText: bg.4.15 bg.4.15 chapter 4 verse 15 एव जञतव कत करम परवरप ममकषभ कर करमव तसमततव परव परवतर कतम 4.15 evam jnatva kritam karma purvair api mumukshubhih kuru karmaiva tasmattvam purvaih purvataram kritam having known this the ancient seekers of freedom also performed action therefore do thou also perform action as the ancients did in days of yore.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.15 bg.4.15 chapter 4 verse 15 एवं ज्ञात्वा कृतं कर्म पूर्वैरपि मुमुक्षुभिः।

कुरु कर्मैव तस्मात्त्वं पूर्वैः पूर्वतरं कृतम्।।4.15।। evaṁ jñātvā kṛitaṁ karma pūrvair api mumukṣhubhiḥ
kuru karmaiva tasmāttvaṁ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraṁ kṛitam having known this, the ancient seekers of freedom also performed action; therefore, do thou also perform action, as the ancients did in days of yore.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.16
documents.iast: kiṁ karma kim akarmeti kavayo ’pyatra mohitāḥ
documents.summary: What is action? What is inaction? Even the wise are confused about this. Therefore, I shall teach you the nature of action and inaction, by knowing which you will be liberated from
documents.searchText: bg.4.16 bg.4.16 chapter 4 verse 16 क करम कमकरमत कवयऽपयतर महत ततत करम परवकषयम यजजञतव मकषयसऽशभत 4.16 kim karma kim akarmeti kavayo pyatra mohitah tat te karma pravakshyami yaj jnatva mokshyase shubhat what is action what is inaction even the wise are confused about this. therefore i shall teach you the nature of action and inaction by knowing which you will be liberated from the evil of samsara the wheel of birth and death.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.16 bg.4.16 chapter 4 verse 16 किं कर्म किमकर्मेति कवयोऽप्यत्र मोहिताः।

तत्ते कर्म प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात्।।4.16।। kiṁ karma kim akarmeti kavayo ’pyatra mohitāḥ
tat te karma pravakṣhyāmi yaj jñātvā mokṣhyase ’śhubhāt what is action? what is inaction? even the wise are confused about this. therefore, i shall teach you the nature of action and inaction, by knowing which you will be liberated from the evil of samsara, the wheel of birth and death.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.17
documents.iast: karmaṇo hyapi boddhavyaṁ boddhavyaṁ cha vikarmaṇaḥ
documents.sanskrit: कर्मणो ह्यपि बोद्धव्यं बोद्धव्यं च विकर्मणः।
documents.summary: For verily, the true nature of action enjoined by the scriptures should be known, as well as that of forbidden or unlawful action, and of inaction; the nature of action is hard to
documents.searchText: bg.4.17 bg.4.17 chapter 4 verse 17 करमण हयप बदधवय बदधवय च वकरमण अकरमणशच बदधवय गहन करमण गत 4.17 karmano hyapi boddhavyam boddhavyam cha vikarmanah akarmanash cha boddhavyam gahana karmano gatih for verily the true nature of action enjoined by the scriptures should be known as well as that of forbidden or unlawful action and of inaction the nature of action is hard to understand.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.17 bg.4.17 chapter 4 verse 17 कर्मणो ह्यपि बोद्धव्यं बोद्धव्यं च विकर्मणः।

अकर्मणश्च बोद्धव्यं गहना कर्मणो गतिः।।4.17।। karmaṇo hyapi boddhavyaṁ boddhavyaṁ cha vikarmaṇaḥ
akarmaṇaśh cha boddhavyaṁ gahanā karmaṇo gatiḥ for verily, the true nature of action enjoined by the scriptures should be known, as well as that of forbidden or unlawful action, and of inaction; the nature of action is hard to understand.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.18
documents.iast: karmaṇyakarma yaḥ paśhyed akarmaṇi cha karma yaḥ
documents.sanskrit: कर्मण्यकर्म यः पश्येदकर्मणि च कर्म यः।
documents.summary: He who sees inaction in action and action in inaction, he is wise among men; he is a yogi and performer of all actions.
documents.searchText: bg.4.18 bg.4.18 chapter 4 verse 18 करमणयकरम य पशयदकरमण च करम य स बदधमन मनषयष स यकत कतसनकरमकत 4.18 karmanyakarma yah pashyed akarmani cha karma yah sa buddhiman manushyeshu sa yuktah kritsna-karma-krit he who sees inaction in action and action in inaction he is wise among men he is a yogi and performer of all actions.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.18 bg.4.18 chapter 4 verse 18 कर्मण्यकर्म यः पश्येदकर्मणि च कर्म यः।

स बुद्धिमान् मनुष्येषु स युक्तः कृत्स्नकर्मकृत्।।4.18।। karmaṇyakarma yaḥ paśhyed akarmaṇi cha karma yaḥ
sa buddhimān manuṣhyeṣhu sa yuktaḥ kṛitsna-karma-kṛit he who sees inaction in action and action in inaction, he is wise among men; he is a yogi and performer of all actions.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.19
documents.summary: He whose undertakings are all devoid of desires and selfish purposes, and whose actions have been burned by the fire of knowledge, the wise call him a sage.
documents.searchText: bg.4.19 bg.4.19 chapter 4 verse 19 यसय सरव समरमभ कमसङकलपवरजत जञनगनदगधकरमण तमह पणडत बध 4.19 yasya sarve samarambhah kama-sankalpa-varjitah jnanagni-dagdha-karmanam tam ahuh panditam budhah he whose undertakings are all devoid of desires and selfish purposes and whose actions have been burned by the fire of knowledge the wise call him a sage.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.19 bg.4.19 chapter 4 verse 19 यस्य सर्वे समारम्भाः कामसङ्कल्पवर्जिताः।

ज्ञानाग्निदग्धकर्माणं तमाहुः पण्डितं बुधाः।।4.19।। yasya sarve samārambhāḥ kāma-saṅkalpa-varjitāḥ
jñānāgni-dagdha-karmāṇaṁ tam āhuḥ paṇḍitaṁ budhāḥ he whose undertakings are all devoid of desires and selfish purposes, and whose actions have been burned by the fire of knowledge, the wise call him a sage.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.2
documents.summary: This, handed down in regular succession by the royal sages, was known. This Yoga, however, has been lost here over time, O Parantapa (burner of the foes).
documents.searchText: bg.4.2 bg.4.2 chapter 4 verse 2 एव परमपरपरपतमम रजरषय वद स कलनह महत यग नषट परनतप 4.2 evam parampara-praptam imam rajarshayo viduh sa kaleneha mahata yogo nashtah parantapa this handed down in regular succession by the royal sages was known. this yoga however has been lost here over time o parantapa burner of the foes .
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.2 bg.4.2 chapter 4 verse 2 एवं परम्पराप्राप्तमिमं राजर्षयो विदुः।

स कालेनेह महता योगो नष्टः परन्तप।।4.2।। evaṁ paramparā-prāptam imaṁ rājarṣhayo viduḥ
sa kāleneha mahatā yogo naṣhṭaḥ parantapa this, handed down in regular succession by the royal sages, was known. this yoga, however, has been lost here over time, o parantapa (burner of the foes).

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.20
documents.summary: Having abandoned attachment to the fruits of the action, ever content, depending on nothing, he does not do anything even while being engaged in activity.
documents.searchText: bg.4.20 bg.4.20 chapter 4 verse 20 तयकतव करमफलसङग नतयतपत नरशरय करमणयभपरवततऽप नव कञचतकरत स 4.20 tyaktva karma-phalasangam nitya-tripto nirashrayah karmanyabhipravritto pi naiva kinchit karoti sah having abandoned attachment to the fruits of the action ever content depending on nothing he does not do anything even while being engaged in activity.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.20 bg.4.20 chapter 4 verse 20 त्यक्त्वा कर्मफलासङ्गं नित्यतृप्तो निराश्रयः।

कर्मण्यभिप्रवृत्तोऽपि नैव किञ्चित्करोति सः।।4.20।। tyaktvā karma-phalāsaṅgaṁ nitya-tṛipto nirāśhrayaḥ
karmaṇyabhipravṛitto ’pi naiva kiñchit karoti saḥ having abandoned attachment to the fruits of the action, ever content, depending on nothing, he does not do anything even while being engaged in activity.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.21
documents.summary: Without hope, controlling the mind and the self, having abandoned all covetousness, and performing only bodily actions, one incurs no sin.
documents.searchText: bg.4.21 bg.4.21 chapter 4 verse 21 नरशरयतचतततम तयकतसरवपरगरह शरर कवल करम करवननपनत कलबषम 4.21 nirashir yata-chittatma tyakta-sarva-parigrahah shariram kevalam karma kurvan napnoti kilbisham without hope controlling the mind and the self having abandoned all covetousness and performing only bodily actions one incurs no sin.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.21 bg.4.21 chapter 4 verse 21 निराशीर्यतचित्तात्मा त्यक्तसर्वपरिग्रहः।

शारीरं केवलं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम्।।4.21।। nirāśhīr yata-chittātmā tyakta-sarva-parigrahaḥ
śhārīraṁ kevalaṁ karma kurvan nāpnoti kilbiṣham without hope, controlling the mind and the self, having abandoned all covetousness, and performing only bodily actions, one incurs no sin.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.22
documents.summary: Content with what comes to him without effort, free from the pairs of opposites and envy, even-minded in success and failure, he acts yet is not bound.
documents.searchText: bg.4.22 bg.4.22 chapter 4 verse 22 यदचछलभसनतषट दवनदवतत वमतसर सम सदधवसदध च कतवप न नबधयत 4.22 yadrichchha-labha-santushto dvandvatito vimatsarah samah siddhavasiddhau cha kritvapi na nibadhyate content with what comes to him without effort free from the pairs of opposites and envy even-minded in success and failure he acts yet is not bound.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.22 bg.4.22 chapter 4 verse 22 यदृच्छालाभसन्तुष्टो द्वन्द्वातीतो विमत्सरः।

समः सिद्धावसिद्धौ च कृत्वापि न निबध्यते।।4.22।। yadṛichchhā-lābha-santuṣhṭo dvandvātīto vimatsaraḥ
samaḥ siddhāvasiddhau cha kṛitvāpi na nibadhyate content with what comes to him without effort, free from the pairs of opposites and envy, even-minded in success and failure, he acts yet is not bound.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.23
documents.summary: To one who is devoid of attachment, who is liberated, whose mind is established in knowledge, and who works for the sake of sacrifice (for the sake of God), the whole action is dis
documents.searchText: bg.4.23 bg.4.23 chapter 4 verse 23 गतसङगसय मकतसय जञनवसथतचतस यजञयचरत करम समगर परवलयत 4.23 gata-sangasya muktasya jnanavasthita-chetasah yajnayacharatah karma samagram praviliyate to one who is devoid of attachment who is liberated whose mind is established in knowledge and who works for the sake of sacrifice for the sake of god the whole action is dissolved.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.23 bg.4.23 chapter 4 verse 23 गतसङ्गस्य मुक्तस्य ज्ञानावस्थितचेतसः।

यज्ञायाचरतः कर्म समग्रं प्रविलीयते।।4.23।। gata-saṅgasya muktasya jñānāvasthita-chetasaḥ
yajñāyācharataḥ karma samagraṁ pravilīyate to one who is devoid of attachment, who is liberated, whose mind is established in knowledge, and who works for the sake of sacrifice (for the sake of god), the whole action is dissolved.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.24
documents.iast: brahmārpaṇaṁ brahma havir brahmāgnau brahmaṇā hutam
documents.summary: Brahman is the oblation; Brahman is the melted butter (ghee); by Brahman is the oblation poured into the fire of Brahman; Brahman indeed shall be attained by one who always sees Br
documents.searchText: bg.4.24 bg.4.24 chapter 4 verse 24 बरहमरपण बरहमहवरबरहमगन बरहमण हतम बरहमव तन गनतवय बरहमकरमसमधन 4.24 brahmarpanam brahma havir brahmagnau brahmana hutam brahmaiva tena gantavyam brahma-karma-samadhina brahman is the oblation brahman is the melted butter ghee by brahman is the oblation poured into the fire of brahman brahman indeed shall be attained by one who always sees brahman in action.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.24 bg.4.24 chapter 4 verse 24 ब्रह्मार्पणं ब्रह्महविर्ब्रह्माग्नौ ब्रह्मणा हुतम्।

ब्रह्मैव तेन गन्तव्यं ब्रह्मकर्मसमाधिना।।4.24।। brahmārpaṇaṁ brahma havir brahmāgnau brahmaṇā hutam
brahmaiva tena gantavyaṁ brahma-karma-samādhinā brahman is the oblation; brahman is the melted butter (ghee); by brahman is the oblation poured into the fire of brahman; brahman indeed shall be attained by one who always sees brahman in action.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.25
documents.summary: Some yogis perform sacrifice to the gods alone; while others, who have realized the Self, offer the Self as sacrifice in the fire of Brahman alone.
documents.searchText: bg.4.25 bg.4.25 chapter 4 verse 25 दवमवपर यजञ यगन परयपसत बरहमगनवपर यजञ यजञनवपजहवत 4.25 daivam evapare yajnam yoginah paryupasate brahmagnavapare yajnam yajnenaivopajuhvati some yogis perform sacrifice to the gods alone while others who have realized the self offer the self as sacrifice in the fire of brahman alone.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.25 bg.4.25 chapter 4 verse 25 दैवमेवापरे यज्ञं योगिनः पर्युपासते।

ब्रह्माग्नावपरे यज्ञं यज्ञेनैवोपजुह्वति।।4.25।। daivam evāpare yajñaṁ yoginaḥ paryupāsate
brahmāgnāvapare yajñaṁ yajñenaivopajuhvati some yogis perform sacrifice to the gods alone; while others, who have realized the self, offer the self as sacrifice in the fire of brahman alone.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.26
documents.summary: Some again offer the organ of hearing and other senses as a sacrifice in the fire of restraint; others offer sound and other objects of the senses as a sacrifice in the fire of the
documents.searchText: bg.4.26 bg.4.26 chapter 4 verse 26 शरतरदननदरयणयनय सयमगनष जहवत शबददनवषयननय इनदरयगनष जहवत 4.26 shrotradinindriyanyanye sanyamagnishu juhvati shabdadin vishayananya indriyagnishu juhvati some again offer the organ of hearing and other senses as a sacrifice in the fire of restraint others offer sound and other objects of the senses as a sacrifice in the fire of the senses.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.26 bg.4.26 chapter 4 verse 26 श्रोत्रादीनीन्द्रियाण्यन्ये संयमाग्निषु जुह्वति।

शब्दादीन्विषयानन्य इन्द्रियाग्निषु जुह्वति।।4.26।। śhrotrādīnīndriyāṇyanye sanyamāgniṣhu juhvati
śhabdādīn viṣhayānanya indriyāgniṣhu juhvati some again offer the organ of hearing and other senses as a sacrifice in the fire of restraint; others offer sound and other objects of the senses as a sacrifice in the fire of the senses.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.27
documents.summary: Others again sacrifice all the functions of the senses and those of the breath (vital energy, or Prana) in the fire of the Yoga of self-restraint, kindled by knowledge.
documents.searchText: bg.4.27 bg.4.27 chapter 4 verse 27 सरवणनदरयकरमण परणकरमण चपर आतमसयमयगगन जहवत जञनदपत 4.27 sarvanindriya-karmani prana-karmani chapare atma-sanyama-yogagnau juhvati jnana-dipite others again sacrifice all the functions of the senses and those of the breath vital energy or prana in the fire of the yoga of self-restraint kindled by knowledge.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.27 bg.4.27 chapter 4 verse 27 सर्वाणीन्द्रियकर्माणि प्राणकर्माणि चापरे।

आत्मसंयमयोगाग्नौ जुह्वति ज्ञानदीपिते।।4.27।। sarvāṇīndriya-karmāṇi prāṇa-karmāṇi chāpare
ātma-sanyama-yogāgnau juhvati jñāna-dīpite others again sacrifice all the functions of the senses and those of the breath (vital energy, or prana) in the fire of the yoga of self-restraint, kindled by knowledge.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.28
documents.summary: Others again offer wealth, austerity, and Yoga as sacrifice, while ascetics of self-restraint and rigid vows offer the study of scriptures and knowledge as sacrifice.
documents.searchText: bg.4.28 bg.4.28 chapter 4 verse 28 दरवययजञसतपयजञ यगयजञसतथपर सवधययजञनयजञशच यतय सशतवरत 4.28 dravya-yajnas tapo-yajna yoga-yajnas tathapare swadhyaya-jnana-yajnash cha yatayah sanshita-vratah others again offer wealth austerity and yoga as sacrifice while ascetics of self-restraint and rigid vows offer the study of scriptures and knowledge as sacrifice.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.28 bg.4.28 chapter 4 verse 28 द्रव्ययज्ञास्तपोयज्ञा योगयज्ञास्तथापरे।

स्वाध्यायज्ञानयज्ञाश्च यतयः संशितव्रताः।।4.28।। dravya-yajñās tapo-yajñā yoga-yajñās tathāpare
swādhyāya-jñāna-yajñāśh cha yatayaḥ sanśhita-vratāḥ others again offer wealth, austerity, and yoga as sacrifice, while ascetics of self-restraint and rigid vows offer the study of scriptures and knowledge as sacrifice.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.29
documents.summary: Others offer as sacrifice the outgoing breath into the incoming, and the incoming into the outgoing, restraining the flow of the outgoing and the incoming breaths, solely absorbed
documents.searchText: bg.4.29 bg.4.29 chapter 4 verse 29 अपन जहवत परण परणऽपन तथऽपर परणपनगत रदधव परणयमपरयण 4.29 apane juhvati pranam prane panam tathapare pranapana-gati ruddhva pranayama-parayanah apare niyataharah pranan praneshu juhvati sarve pyete yajna-vido yajna-kshapita-kalmashah others offer as sacrifice the outgoing breath into the incoming and the incoming into the outgoing restraining the flow of the outgoing and the incoming breaths solely absorbed in the restraint of the breath.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.29 bg.4.29 chapter 4 verse 29 अपाने जुह्वति प्राण प्राणेऽपानं तथाऽपरे।

प्राणापानगती रुद्ध्वा प्राणायामपरायणाः।।4.29।। apāne juhvati prāṇaṁ prāṇe ’pānaṁ tathāpare
prāṇāpāna-gatī ruddhvā prāṇāyāma-parāyaṇāḥ
 apare niyatāhārāḥ prāṇān prāṇeṣhu juhvati
sarve ’pyete yajña-vido yajña-kṣhapita-kalmaṣhāḥ others offer as sacrifice the outgoing breath into the incoming, and the incoming into the outgoing, restraining the flow of the outgoing and the incoming breaths, solely absorbed in the restraint of the breath.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.3
documents.iast: sa evāyaṁ mayā te ’dya yogaḥ proktaḥ purātanaḥ
documents.sanskrit: स एवायं मया तेऽद्य योगः प्रोक्तः पुरातनः।
documents.summary: That same ancient yoga has been today taught to you by me, for you are my devotee and my friend; it is the supreme secret.
documents.searchText: bg.4.3 bg.4.3 chapter 4 verse 3 स एवय मय तऽदय यग परकत परतन भकतऽस म सख चत रहसय हयतदततमम 4.3 sa evayam maya te dya yogah proktah puratanah bhakto si me sakha cheti rahasyam hyetad uttamam that same ancient yoga has been today taught to you by me for you are my devotee and my friend it is the supreme secret.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.3 bg.4.3 chapter 4 verse 3 स एवायं मया तेऽद्य योगः प्रोक्तः पुरातनः।

भक्तोऽसि मे सखा चेति रहस्यं ह्येतदुत्तमम्।।4.3।। sa evāyaṁ mayā te ’dya yogaḥ proktaḥ purātanaḥ
bhakto ’si me sakhā cheti rahasyaṁ hyetad uttamam that same ancient yoga has been today taught to you by me, for you are my devotee and my friend; it is the supreme secret.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.30
documents.summary: Others who regulate their diet offer life-breaths in each life-breath. All these are knowers of sacrifice, whose sins are destroyed through sacrifice.
documents.searchText: bg.4.30 bg.4.30 chapter 4 verse 30 अपर नयतहर परणनपरणष जहवत सरवऽपयत यजञवद यजञकषपतकलमष 4.30 apare niyataharah pranan pranesu juhvati sarve py ete yajna-vido yajna-ksapita-kalmasah others who regulate their diet offer life-breaths in each life-breath. all these are knowers of sacrifice whose sins are destroyed through sacrifice.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.30 bg.4.30 chapter 4 verse 30 अपरे नियताहाराः प्राणान्प्राणेषु जुह्वति।

सर्वेऽप्येते यज्ञविदो यज्ञक्षपितकल्मषाः।।4.30।। apare niyatāhārāḥ prāṇān  prāṇeṣu juhvati

sarve py 'ete yajña-vido yajña-kṣapita-kalmaṣāḥ others who regulate their diet offer life-breaths in each life-breath. all these are knowers of sacrifice, whose sins are destroyed through sacrifice.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.31
documents.summary: Those who eat the remnants of the sacrifice, which are like nectar, go to the eternal Brahman. This world is not for the one who does not perform sacrifice; how then can they have
documents.searchText: bg.4.31 bg.4.31 chapter 4 verse 31 यजञशषटमतभज यनत बरहम सनतनम नय लकऽसतययजञसय कतऽनय करसततम 4.31 yajna-shishtamrita-bhujo yanti brahma sanatanam nayam loko styayajnasya kuto nyah kuru-sattama those who eat the remnants of the sacrifice which are like nectar go to the eternal brahman. this world is not for the one who does not perform sacrifice how then can they have the other o arjuna
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.31 bg.4.31 chapter 4 verse 31 यज्ञशिष्टामृतभुजो यान्ति ब्रह्म सनातनम्।

नायं लोकोऽस्त्ययज्ञस्य कुतो़ऽन्यः कुरुसत्तम।।4.31।। yajña-śhiṣhṭāmṛita-bhujo yānti brahma sanātanam
nāyaṁ loko ’styayajñasya kuto ’nyaḥ kuru-sattama those who eat the remnants of the sacrifice, which are like nectar, go to the eternal brahman. this world is not for the one who does not perform sacrifice; how then can they have the other, o arjuna?

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.32
documents.iast: evaṁ bahu-vidhā yajñā vitatā brahmaṇo mukhe
documents.sanskrit: एवं बहुविधा यज्ञा वितता ब्रह्मणो मुखे।
documents.summary: Thus, manifold sacrifices are spread out before Brahman at the face of Brahman. Know them all to be born of action, and thus knowing, you shall be liberated.
documents.searchText: bg.4.32 bg.4.32 chapter 4 verse 32 एव बहवध यजञ वतत बरहमण मख करमजनवदध तनसरवनव जञतव वमकषयस 4.32 evam bahu-vidha yajna vitata brahmano mukhe karma-jan viddhi tan sarvan evam jnatva vimokshyase thus manifold sacrifices are spread out before brahman at the face of brahman. know them all to be born of action and thus knowing you shall be liberated.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.32 bg.4.32 chapter 4 verse 32 एवं बहुविधा यज्ञा वितता ब्रह्मणो मुखे।

कर्मजान्विद्धि तान्सर्वानेवं ज्ञात्वा विमोक्ष्यसे।।4.32।। evaṁ bahu-vidhā yajñā vitatā brahmaṇo mukhe
karma-jān viddhi tān sarvān evaṁ jñātvā vimokṣhyase thus, manifold sacrifices are spread out before brahman at the face of brahman. know them all to be born of action, and thus knowing, you shall be liberated.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.33
documents.summary: Superior is wisdom-sacrifice to the sacrifice with objects, O Parantapa (scorcher of the foes). All actions in their entirety, O Arjuna, culminate in knowledge.
documents.searchText: bg.4.33 bg.4.33 chapter 4 verse 33 शरयनदरवयमयदयजञजजञनयजञ परनतप सरव करमखल परथ जञन परसमपयत 4.33 shreyan dravya-mayad yajnaj jnana-yajnah parantapa sarvam karmakhilam partha jnane parisamapyate superior is wisdom-sacrifice to the sacrifice with objects o parantapa scorcher of the foes . all actions in their entirety o arjuna culminate in knowledge.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.33 bg.4.33 chapter 4 verse 33 श्रेयान्द्रव्यमयाद्यज्ञाज्ज्ञानयज्ञः परन्तप।

सर्वं कर्माखिलं पार्थ ज्ञाने परिसमाप्यते।।4.33।। śhreyān dravya-mayād yajñāj jñāna-yajñaḥ parantapa
sarvaṁ karmākhilaṁ pārtha jñāne parisamāpyate superior is wisdom-sacrifice to the sacrifice with objects, o parantapa (scorcher of the foes). all actions in their entirety, o arjuna, culminate in knowledge.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.34
documents.summary: Know that the wise who have realized the truth will instruct thee in that knowledge through long prostration, supplication, and service.
documents.searchText: bg.4.34 bg.4.34 chapter 4 verse 34 तदवदध परणपतन परपरशनन सवय उपदकषयनत त जञन जञननसतततवदरशन 4.34 tad viddhi pranipatena pariprashnena sevaya upadekshyanti te jnanam jnaninas tattva-darshinah know that the wise who have realized the truth will instruct thee in that knowledge through long prostration supplication and service.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.34 bg.4.34 chapter 4 verse 34 तद्विद्धि प्रणिपातेन परिप्रश्नेन सेवया।

उपदेक्ष्यन्ति ते ज्ञानं ज्ञानिनस्तत्त्वदर्शिनः।।4.34।। tad viddhi praṇipātena paripraśhnena sevayā
upadekṣhyanti te jñānaṁ jñāninas tattva-darśhinaḥ know that the wise who have realized the truth will instruct thee in that knowledge through long prostration, supplication, and service.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.35
documents.iast: yaj jñātvā na punar moham evaṁ yāsyasi pāṇḍava
documents.summary: Knowing that thou shalt not, O Arjuna, again be deluded like this; and by that thou shalt see all beings in thyself and also in me.
documents.searchText: bg.4.35 bg.4.35 chapter 4 verse 35 यजजञतव न पनरमहमव यसयस पणडव यन भतनयशषण दरकषयसयतमनयथ मय 4.35 yaj jnatva na punar moham evam yasyasi pandava yena bhutanyasheshena drakshyasyatmanyatho mayi knowing that thou shalt not o arjuna again be deluded like this and by that thou shalt see all beings in thyself and also in me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.35 bg.4.35 chapter 4 verse 35 यज्ज्ञात्वा न पुनर्मोहमेवं यास्यसि पाण्डव।

येन भूतान्यशेषेण द्रक्ष्यस्यात्मन्यथो मयि।।4.35।। yaj jñātvā na punar moham evaṁ yāsyasi pāṇḍava
yena bhūtānyaśheṣheṇa drakṣhyasyātmanyatho mayi knowing that thou shalt not, o arjuna, again be deluded like this; and by that thou shalt see all beings in thyself and also in me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.36
documents.iast: api ched asi pāpebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pāpa-kṛit-tamaḥ
documents.summary: Even if thou art the most sinful of all sinners, yet thou shalt surely cross over all sins by the raft of knowledge.
documents.searchText: bg.4.36 bg.4.36 chapter 4 verse 36 अप चदस पपभय सरवभय पपकततम सरव जञनपलवनव वजन सनतरषयस 4.36 api ched asi papebhyah sarvebhyah papa-krit-tamah sarvam jnana-plavenaiva vrijinam santarishyasi even if thou art the most sinful of all sinners yet thou shalt surely cross over all sins by the raft of knowledge.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.36 bg.4.36 chapter 4 verse 36 अपि चेदसि पापेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यः पापकृत्तमः।

सर्वं ज्ञानप्लवेनैव वृजिनं सन्तरिष्यसि।।4.36।। api ched asi pāpebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pāpa-kṛit-tamaḥ
sarvaṁ jñāna-plavenaiva vṛijinaṁ santariṣhyasi even if thou art the most sinful of all sinners, yet thou shalt surely cross over all sins by the raft of knowledge.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.37
documents.summary: As the blazing fire reduces fuel to ashes, O Arjuna, so does the fire of knowledge reduce all actions to ash.
documents.searchText: bg.4.37 bg.4.37 chapter 4 verse 37 यथधस समदधऽगनरभसमसतकरतऽरजन जञनगन सरवकरमण भसमसतकरत तथ 4.37 yathaidhansi samiddho gnir bhasma-sat kurute rjuna jnanagnih sarva-karmani bhasma-sat kurute tatha as the blazing fire reduces fuel to ashes o arjuna so does the fire of knowledge reduce all actions to ash.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.37 bg.4.37 chapter 4 verse 37 यथैधांसि समिद्धोऽग्निर्भस्मसात्कुरुतेऽर्जुन।

ज्ञानाग्निः सर्वकर्माणि भस्मसात्कुरुते तथा।।4.37।। yathaidhānsi samiddho ’gnir bhasma-sāt kurute ’rjuna
jñānāgniḥ sarva-karmāṇi bhasma-sāt kurute tathā as the blazing fire reduces fuel to ashes, o arjuna, so does the fire of knowledge reduce all actions to ash.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.38
documents.iast: na hi jñānena sadṛiśhaṁ pavitramiha vidyate
documents.sanskrit: न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते।
documents.summary: Verily, there is no purifier in this world like knowledge. He who is perfected in Yoga finds it within the Self in due time.
documents.searchText: bg.4.38 bg.4.38 chapter 4 verse 38 न ह जञनन सदश पवतरमह वदयत ततसवय यगससदध कलनतमन वनदत 4.38 na hi jnanena sadrisham pavitramiha vidyate tatsvayam yogasansiddhah kalenatmani vindati verily there is no purifier in this world like knowledge. he who is perfected in yoga finds it within the self in due time.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.38 bg.4.38 chapter 4 verse 38 न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते।

तत्स्वयं योगसंसिद्धः कालेनात्मनि विन्दति।।4.38।। na hi jñānena sadṛiśhaṁ pavitramiha vidyate
tatsvayaṁ yogasansiddhaḥ kālenātmani vindati verily, there is no purifier in this world like knowledge. he who is perfected in yoga finds it within the self in due time.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.39
documents.summary: The one who is full of faith, devoted to it, and has subdued their senses obtains this knowledge; and upon obtaining the knowledge, they attain the supreme peace immediately.
documents.searchText: bg.4.39 bg.4.39 chapter 4 verse 39 शरदधवललभत जञन ततपर सयतनदरय जञन लबधव पर शनतमचरणधगचछत 4.39 shraddhavan labhate jnanam tat-parah sanyatendriyah jnanam labdhva param shantim achirenadhigachchhati the one who is full of faith devoted to it and has subdued their senses obtains this knowledge and upon obtaining the knowledge they attain the supreme peace immediately.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.39 bg.4.39 chapter 4 verse 39 श्रद्धावाँल्लभते ज्ञानं तत्परः संयतेन्द्रियः।

ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा परां शान्तिमचिरेणाधिगच्छति।।4.39।। śhraddhāvān labhate jñānaṁ tat-paraḥ sanyatendriyaḥ
jñānaṁ labdhvā parāṁ śhāntim achireṇādhigachchhati the one who is full of faith, devoted to it, and has subdued their senses obtains this knowledge; and upon obtaining the knowledge, they attain the supreme peace immediately.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.4
documents.summary: Arjuna said, "Later was Thy birth, and prior to it was the birth of Vivasvan (the Sun); how am I to understand that Thou hast taught this Yoga from the beginning?"
documents.searchText: bg.4.4 bg.4.4 chapter 4 verse 4 अरजन उवच अपर भवत जनम पर जनम ववसवत कथमतदवजनय तवमद परकतवनत 4.4 arjuna uvacha aparam bhavato janma param janma vivasvatah katham etad vijaniyam tvam adau proktavan iti arjuna said later was thy birth and prior to it was the birth of vivasvan the sun how am i to understand that thou hast taught this yoga from the beginning
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.4 bg.4.4 chapter 4 verse 4 अर्जुन उवाच

अपरं भवतो जन्म परं जन्म विवस्वतः।

कथमेतद्विजानीयां त्वमादौ प्रोक्तवानिति।।4.4।। arjuna uvācha
aparaṁ bhavato janma paraṁ janma vivasvataḥ
katham etad vijānīyāṁ tvam ādau proktavān iti arjuna said, "later was thy birth, and prior to it was the birth of vivasvan (the sun); how am i to understand that thou hast taught this yoga from the beginning?"

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.40
documents.summary: The ignorant, the faithless, and the doubting self go to destruction; there is neither this world nor the other, nor happiness for the doubting one.
documents.searchText: bg.4.40 bg.4.40 chapter 4 verse 40 अजञशचशरददधनशच सशयतम वनशयत नय लकऽसत न पर न सख सशयतमन 4.40 ajnash chashraddadhanash cha sanshayatma vinashyati nayam loko sti na paro na sukham sanshayatmanah the ignorant the faithless and the doubting self go to destruction there is neither this world nor the other nor happiness for the doubting one.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.40 bg.4.40 chapter 4 verse 40 अज्ञश्चाश्रद्दधानश्च संशयात्मा विनश्यति।

नायं लोकोऽस्ति न परो न सुखं संशयात्मनः।।4.40।। ajñaśh chāśhraddadhānaśh cha sanśhayātmā vinaśhyati
nāyaṁ loko ’sti na paro na sukhaṁ sanśhayātmanaḥ the ignorant, the faithless, and the doubting self go to destruction; there is neither this world nor the other, nor happiness for the doubting one.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.41
documents.summary: He who has renounced actions through Yoga, whose doubts have been dispelled by knowledge, and who is self-possessed—such a one is not bound by actions, O Arjuna.
documents.searchText: bg.4.41 bg.4.41 chapter 4 verse 41 यगसनयसतकरमण जञनसछननसशयम आतमवनत न करमण नबधननत धनञजय 4.41 yoga-sannyasta-karmanam jnana-sanchhinna-sanshayam atmavantam na karmani nibadhnanti dhananjaya he who has renounced actions through yoga whose doubts have been dispelled by knowledge and who is self-possessed such a one is not bound by actions o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.41 bg.4.41 chapter 4 verse 41 योगसंन्यस्तकर्माणं ज्ञानसंछिन्नसंशयम्।

आत्मवन्तं न कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय।।4.41।। yoga-sannyasta-karmāṇaṁ jñāna-sañchhinna-sanśhayam
ātmavantaṁ na karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanañjaya he who has renounced actions through yoga, whose doubts have been dispelled by knowledge, and who is self-possessed—such a one is not bound by actions, o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.42
documents.summary: Therefore, with the sword of knowledge (of the Self), cut asunder the doubt of the self, born of ignorance, residing in your heart, and take refuge in Yoga. Arise, O Arjuna!
documents.searchText: bg.4.42 bg.4.42 chapter 4 verse 42 तसमदजञनसभत हतसथ जञनसनऽऽतमन छततवन सशय यगमतषठततषठ भरत 4.42 tasmad ajnana-sambhutam hrit-stham jnanasinatmanah chhittvainam sanshayam yogam atishthottishtha bharata therefore with the sword of knowledge of the self cut asunder the doubt of the self born of ignorance residing in your heart and take refuge in yoga. arise o arjuna
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.42 bg.4.42 chapter 4 verse 42 तस्मादज्ञानसंभूतं हृत्स्थं ज्ञानासिनाऽऽत्मनः।

छित्त्वैनं संशयं योगमातिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भारत।।4.42।। tasmād ajñāna-sambhūtaṁ hṛit-sthaṁ jñānāsinātmanaḥ
chhittvainaṁ sanśhayaṁ yogam ātiṣhṭhottiṣhṭha bhārata therefore, with the sword of knowledge (of the self), cut asunder the doubt of the self, born of ignorance, residing in your heart, and take refuge in yoga. arise, o arjuna!

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.5
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, "Many births of Mine have passed, as well as of thine, O Arjuna; I know them all, but thou knowest not, O Parantapa (scorcher of foes)."
documents.searchText: bg.4.5 bg.4.5 chapter 4 verse 5 शर भगवनवच बहन म वयततन जनमन तव चरजन तनयह वद सरवण न तव वतथ परनतप 4.5 shri bhagavan uvacha bahuni me vyatitani janmani tava charjuna tanyaham veda sarvani na tvam vettha parantapa the blessed lord said many births of mine have passed as well as of thine o arjuna i know them all but thou knowest not o parantapa scorcher of foes .
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.5 bg.4.5 chapter 4 verse 5 श्री भगवानुवाच

बहूनि मे व्यतीतानि जन्मानि तव चार्जुन।

तान्यहं वेद सर्वाणि न त्वं वेत्थ परन्तप।।4.5।। śhrī bhagavān uvācha
bahūni me vyatītāni janmāni tava chārjuna
tānyahaṁ veda sarvāṇi na tvaṁ vettha parantapa the blessed lord said, "many births of mine have passed, as well as of thine, o arjuna; i know them all, but thou knowest not, o parantapa (scorcher of foes)."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.6
documents.summary: Though I am unborn and of imperishable nature, and though I am the Lord of all beings, yet, governing my own nature, I am born by my own Maya.
documents.searchText: bg.4.6 bg.4.6 chapter 4 verse 6 अजऽप सननवययतम भतनमशवरऽप सन परकत सवमधषठय सभवमयतममयय 4.6 ajo pi sannavyayatma bhutanam ishvaro pi san prakritim svam adhishthaya sambhavamyatma-mayaya though i am unborn and of imperishable nature and though i am the lord of all beings yet governing my own nature i am born by my own maya.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.6 bg.4.6 chapter 4 verse 6 अजोऽपि सन्नव्ययात्मा भूतानामीश्वरोऽपि सन्।

प्रकृतिं स्वामधिष्ठाय संभवाम्यात्ममायया।।4.6।। ajo ’pi sannavyayātmā bhūtānām īśhvaro ’pi san
prakṛitiṁ svām adhiṣhṭhāya sambhavāmyātma-māyayā though i am unborn and of imperishable nature, and though i am the lord of all beings, yet, governing my own nature, i am born by my own maya.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.7
documents.iast: yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānir bhavati bhārata
documents.sanskrit: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत।
documents.summary: Whenever there is a decline of righteousness and an increase of unrighteousness, O Arjuna, then I manifest Myself.
documents.searchText: bg.4.7 bg.4.7 chapter 4 verse 7 यद यद ह धरमसय गलनरभवत भरत अभयतथनमधरमसय तदऽऽतमन सजमयहम 4.7 yada yada hi dharmasya glanir bhavati bharata abhyutthanam adharmasya tadatmanam srijamyaham whenever there is a decline of righteousness and an increase of unrighteousness o arjuna then i manifest myself.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.7 bg.4.7 chapter 4 verse 7 यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत।

अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदाऽऽत्मानं सृजाम्यहम्।।4.7।। yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānir bhavati bhārata
abhyutthānam adharmasya tadātmānaṁ sṛijāmyaham whenever there is a decline of righteousness and an increase of unrighteousness, o arjuna, then i manifest myself.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.8
documents.summary: For the protection of the good, for the destruction of the wicked, and for the establishment of righteousness, I am born in every age.
documents.searchText: bg.4.8 bg.4.8 chapter 4 verse 8 परतरणय सधन वनशय च दषकतम धरमससथपनरथय सभवम यग यग 4.8 paritranaya sadhunam vinashaya cha dushkritam dharma-sansthapanarthaya sambhavami yuge yuge for the protection of the good for the destruction of the wicked and for the establishment of righteousness i am born in every age.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.8 bg.4.8 chapter 4 verse 8 परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय च दुष्कृताम्।

धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय संभवामि युगे युगे।।4.8।। paritrāṇāya sādhūnāṁ vināśhāya cha duṣhkṛitām
dharma-sansthāpanārthāya sambhavāmi yuge yuge for the protection of the good, for the destruction of the wicked, and for the establishment of righteousness, i am born in every age.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 4.9
documents.iast: janma karma cha me divyam evaṁ yo vetti tattvataḥ
documents.sanskrit: जन्म कर्म च मे दिव्यमेवं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः।
documents.summary: He who thus knows, in their true light, My divine birth and actions, having abandoned the body, is not born again; he comes to Me, O Arjuna.
documents.searchText: bg.4.9 bg.4.9 chapter 4 verse 9 जनम करम च म दवयमव य वतत तततवत तयकतव दह पनरजनम नत ममत सऽरजन 4.9 janma karma cha me divyam evam yo vetti tattvatah tyaktva deham punar janma naiti mam eti so rjuna he who thus knows in their true light my divine birth and actions having abandoned the body is not born again he comes to me o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.4.9 bg.4.9 chapter 4 verse 9 जन्म कर्म च मे दिव्यमेवं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः।

त्यक्त्वा देहं पुनर्जन्म नैति मामेति सोऽर्जुन।।4.9।। janma karma cha me divyam evaṁ yo vetti tattvataḥ
tyaktvā dehaṁ punar janma naiti mām eti so ’rjuna he who thus knows, in their true light, my divine birth and actions, having abandoned the body, is not born again; he comes to me, o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.1
documents.summary: Arjuna said, "O Krishna, you praise renunciation of actions and also yoga. Please tell me conclusively which is better of the two."
documents.searchText: bg.5.1 bg.5.1 chapter 5 verse 1 अरजन उवच सनयस करमण कषण पनरयग च शसस यचछरय एतयरक तनम बरह सनशचतम 5.1 arjuna uvacha sannyasam karmanam krishna punar yogam cha shansasi yach chhreya etayor ekam tan me bruhi su-nishchitam arjuna said o krishna you praise renunciation of actions and also yoga. please tell me conclusively which is better of the two.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.1 bg.5.1 chapter 5 verse 1 अर्जुन उवाच

संन्यासं कर्मणां कृष्ण पुनर्योगं च शंससि।

यच्छ्रेय एतयोरेकं तन्मे ब्रूहि सुनिश्चितम्।।5.1।। arjuna uvācha
sannyāsaṁ karmaṇāṁ kṛiṣhṇa punar yogaṁ cha śhansasi
yach chhreya etayor ekaṁ tan me brūhi su-niśhchitam arjuna said, "o krishna, you praise renunciation of actions and also yoga. please tell me conclusively which is better of the two."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.10
documents.iast: brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā karoti yaḥ
documents.sanskrit: ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः।
documents.summary: He who does actions, offering them to Brahman and abandoning attachment, is not tainted by sin, just as a lotus leaf is not tainted by water.
documents.searchText: bg.5.10 bg.5.10 chapter 5 verse 10 बरहमणयधय करमण सङग तयकतव करत य लपयत न स पपन पदमपतरमवमभस 5.10 brahmanyadhaya karmani sangam tyaktva karoti yah lipyate na sa papena padma-patram ivambhasa he who does actions offering them to brahman and abandoning attachment is not tainted by sin just as a lotus leaf is not tainted by water.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.10 bg.5.10 chapter 5 verse 10 ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः।

लिप्यते न स पापेन पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा।।5.10।। brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā karoti yaḥ
lipyate na sa pāpena padma-patram ivāmbhasā he who does actions, offering them to brahman and abandoning attachment, is not tainted by sin, just as a lotus leaf is not tainted by water.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.11
documents.iast: kāyena manasā buddhyā kevalair indriyair api
documents.summary: Yogis, having abandoned attachment, perform actions only through the body, mind, intellect, and even the senses, for the purification of the self.
documents.searchText: bg.5.11 bg.5.11 chapter 5 verse 11 कयन मनस बदधय कवलरनदरयरप यगन करम करवनत सङग तयकतवऽऽतमशदधय 5.11 kayena manasa buddhya kevalair indriyair api yoginah karma kurvanti sangam tyaktvatma-shuddhaye yogis having abandoned attachment perform actions only through the body mind intellect and even the senses for the purification of the self.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.11 bg.5.11 chapter 5 verse 11 कायेन मनसा बुद्ध्या केवलैरिन्द्रियैरपि।

योगिनः कर्म कुर्वन्ति सङ्गं त्यक्त्वाऽऽत्मशुद्धये।।5.11।। kāyena manasā buddhyā kevalair indriyair api
yoginaḥ karma kurvanti saṅgaṁ tyaktvātma-śhuddhaye yogis, having abandoned attachment, perform actions only through the body, mind, intellect, and even the senses, for the purification of the self.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.12
documents.iast: yuktaḥ karma-phalaṁ tyaktvā śhāntim āpnoti naiṣhṭhikīm
documents.summary: The one who is united (the well-poised or harmonized) having abandoned the fruit of action attains eternal peace; whereas the one who is not united (the unsteady or unbalanced), im
documents.searchText: bg.5.12 bg.5.12 chapter 5 verse 12 यकत करमफल तयकतव शनतमपनत नषठकम अयकत कमकरण फल सकत नबधयत 5.12 yuktah karma-phalam tyaktva shantim apnoti naishthikim ayuktah kama-karena phale sakto nibadhyate the one who is united the well-poised or harmonized having abandoned the fruit of action attains eternal peace whereas the one who is not united the unsteady or unbalanced impelled by desire and attached to the fruit is bound.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.12 bg.5.12 chapter 5 verse 12 युक्तः कर्मफलं त्यक्त्वा शान्तिमाप्नोति नैष्ठिकीम्।

अयुक्तः कामकारेण फले सक्तो निबध्यते।।5.12।। yuktaḥ karma-phalaṁ tyaktvā śhāntim āpnoti naiṣhṭhikīm
ayuktaḥ kāma-kāreṇa phale sakto nibadhyate the one who is united (the well-poised or harmonized) having abandoned the fruit of action attains eternal peace; whereas the one who is not united (the unsteady or unbalanced), impelled by desire and attached to the fruit, is bound.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.13
