documents.summary: Mentally renouncing all actions and being self-controlled, the embodied one happily rests in the nine-gated city, neither acting nor causing others (body and senses) to act.
documents.searchText: bg.5.13 bg.5.13 chapter 5 verse 13 सरवकरमण मनस सनयसयसत सख वश नवदवर पर दह नव करवनन करयन 5.13 sarva-karmani manasa sannyasyaste sukham vashi nava-dvare pure dehi naiva kurvan na karayan mentally renouncing all actions and being self-controlled the embodied one happily rests in the nine-gated city neither acting nor causing others body and senses to act.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.13 bg.5.13 chapter 5 verse 13 सर्वकर्माणि मनसा संन्यस्यास्ते सुखं वशी।

नवद्वारे पुरे देही नैव कुर्वन्न कारयन्।।5.13।। sarva-karmāṇi manasā sannyasyāste sukhaṁ vaśhī
nava-dvāre pure dehī naiva kurvan na kārayan mentally renouncing all actions and being self-controlled, the embodied one happily rests in the nine-gated city, neither acting nor causing others (body and senses) to act.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.14
documents.iast: na kartṛitvaṁ na karmāṇi lokasya sṛijati prabhuḥ
documents.sanskrit: न कर्तृत्वं न कर्माणि लोकस्य सृजति प्रभुः।
documents.summary: Neither does the Lord create agency nor actions for the world, nor union with the fruits of actions; rather, it is Nature that acts.
documents.searchText: bg.5.14 bg.5.14 chapter 5 verse 14 न करततव न करमण लकसय सजत परभ न करमफलसयग सवभवसत परवरतत 5.14 na kartritvam na karmani lokasya srijati prabhuh na karma-phala-sanyogam svabhavas tu pravartate neither does the lord create agency nor actions for the world nor union with the fruits of actions rather it is nature that acts.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.14 bg.5.14 chapter 5 verse 14 न कर्तृत्वं न कर्माणि लोकस्य सृजति प्रभुः।

न कर्मफलसंयोगं स्वभावस्तु प्रवर्तते।।5.14।। na kartṛitvaṁ na karmāṇi lokasya sṛijati prabhuḥ
na karma-phala-saṅyogaṁ svabhāvas tu pravartate neither does the lord create agency nor actions for the world, nor union with the fruits of actions; rather, it is nature that acts.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.15
documents.iast: nādatte kasyachit pāpaṁ na chaiva sukṛitaṁ vibhuḥ
documents.sanskrit: नादत्ते कस्यचित्पापं न चैव सुकृतं विभुः।
documents.summary: The Lord takes neither the demerit nor the merit of any; knowledge is enveloped by ignorance, and beings are deluded.
documents.searchText: bg.5.15 bg.5.15 chapter 5 verse 15 नदतत कसयचतपप न चव सकत वभ अजञननवत जञन तन महयनत जनतव 5.15 nadatte kasyachit papam na chaiva sukritam vibhuh ajnanenavritam jnanam tena muhyanti jantavah the lord takes neither the demerit nor the merit of any knowledge is enveloped by ignorance and beings are deluded.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.15 bg.5.15 chapter 5 verse 15 नादत्ते कस्यचित्पापं न चैव सुकृतं विभुः।

अज्ञानेनावृतं ज्ञानं तेन मुह्यन्ति जन्तवः।।5.15।। nādatte kasyachit pāpaṁ na chaiva sukṛitaṁ vibhuḥ
ajñānenāvṛitaṁ jñānaṁ tena muhyanti jantavaḥ the lord takes neither the demerit nor the merit of any; knowledge is enveloped by ignorance, and beings are deluded.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.16
documents.iast: jñānena tu tad ajñānaṁ yeṣhāṁ nāśhitam ātmanaḥ
documents.summary: But to those whose ignorance is destroyed by knowledge of the Self, like the sun, knowledge reveals the Supreme Brahman.
documents.searchText: bg.5.16 bg.5.16 chapter 5 verse 16 जञनन त तदजञन यष नशतमतमन तषमदतयवजजञन परकशयत ततपरम 5.16 jnanena tu tad ajnanam yesham nashitam atmanah tesham aditya-vaj jnanam prakashayati tat param but to those whose ignorance is destroyed by knowledge of the self like the sun knowledge reveals the supreme brahman.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.16 bg.5.16 chapter 5 verse 16 ज्ञानेन तु तदज्ञानं येषां नाशितमात्मनः।

तेषामादित्यवज्ज्ञानं प्रकाशयति तत्परम्।।5.16।। jñānena tu tad ajñānaṁ yeṣhāṁ nāśhitam ātmanaḥ
teṣhām āditya-vaj jñānaṁ prakāśhayati tat param but to those whose ignorance is destroyed by knowledge of the self, like the sun, knowledge reveals the supreme brahman.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.17
documents.summary: Their intellect absorbed in That, their self being That, established in That, with That as their supreme goal, they go whence there is no return, their sins dispelled by knowledge.
documents.searchText: bg.5.17 bg.5.17 chapter 5 verse 17 तदबदधयसतदतमनसतननषठसततपरयण गचछनतयपनरवतत जञननरधतकलमष 5.17 tad-buddhayas tad-atmanas tan-nishthas tat-parayanah gachchhantyapunar-avrittim jnana-nirdhuta-kalmashah their intellect absorbed in that their self being that established in that with that as their supreme goal they go whence there is no return their sins dispelled by knowledge.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.17 bg.5.17 chapter 5 verse 17 तद्बुद्धयस्तदात्मानस्तन्निष्ठास्तत्परायणाः।

गच्छन्त्यपुनरावृत्तिं ज्ञाननिर्धूतकल्मषाः।।5.17।। tad-buddhayas tad-ātmānas tan-niṣhṭhās tat-parāyaṇāḥ
gachchhantyapunar-āvṛittiṁ jñāna-nirdhūta-kalmaṣhāḥ their intellect absorbed in that, their self being that, established in that, with that as their supreme goal, they go whence there is no return, their sins dispelled by knowledge.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.18
documents.summary: Sages look with an equal eye on a Brahmana endowed with learning and humility, on a cow, an elephant, a dog, and even an outcaste.
documents.searchText: bg.5.18 bg.5.18 chapter 5 verse 18 वदयवनयसपनन बरहमण गव हसतन शन चव शवपक च पणडत समदरशन 5.18 vidya-vinaya-sampanne brahmane gavi hastini shuni chaiva shva-pake cha panditah sama-darshinah sages look with an equal eye on a brahmana endowed with learning and humility on a cow an elephant a dog and even an outcaste.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.18 bg.5.18 chapter 5 verse 18 विद्याविनयसंपन्ने ब्राह्मणे गवि हस्तिनि।

शुनि चैव श्वपाके च पण्डिताः समदर्शिनः।।5.18।। vidyā-vinaya-sampanne brāhmaṇe gavi hastini
śhuni chaiva śhva-pāke cha paṇḍitāḥ sama-darśhinaḥ sages look with an equal eye on a brahmana endowed with learning and humility, on a cow, an elephant, a dog, and even an outcaste.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.19
documents.iast: ihaiva tair jitaḥ sargo yeṣhāṁ sāmye sthitaṁ manaḥ
documents.sanskrit: इहैव तैर्जितः सर्गो येषां साम्ये स्थितं मनः।
documents.summary: Even here in this world, those whose minds rest in reality overcome birth; Brahman is indeed spotless and real; therefore they are established in Brahman.
documents.searchText: bg.5.19 bg.5.19 chapter 5 verse 19 इहव तरजत सरग यष समय सथत मन नरदष ह सम बरहम तसमदबरहमण त सथत 5.19 ihaiva tair jitah sargo yesham samye sthitam manah nirdosham hi samam brahma tasmad brahmani te sthitah even here in this world those whose minds rest in reality overcome birth brahman is indeed spotless and real therefore they are established in brahman.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.19 bg.5.19 chapter 5 verse 19 इहैव तैर्जितः सर्गो येषां साम्ये स्थितं मनः।

निर्दोषं हि समं ब्रह्म तस्माद्ब्रह्मणि ते स्थिताः।।5.19।। ihaiva tair jitaḥ sargo yeṣhāṁ sāmye sthitaṁ manaḥ
nirdoṣhaṁ hi samaṁ brahma tasmād brahmaṇi te sthitāḥ even here in this world, those whose minds rest in reality overcome birth; brahman is indeed spotless and real; therefore they are established in brahman.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.2
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, "Renunciation and the Yoga of action both lead to the highest bliss; but of the two, the Yoga of action is superior to the renunciation of action."
documents.searchText: bg.5.2 bg.5.2 chapter 5 verse 2 शर भगवनवच सनयस करमयगशच नशरयसकरवभ तयसत करमसनयसतकरमयग वशषयत 5.2 shri bhagavan uvacha sannyasah karma-yogash cha nihshreyasa-karavubhau tayos tu karma-sannyasat karma-yogo vishishyate the blessed lord said renunciation and the yoga of action both lead to the highest bliss but of the two the yoga of action is superior to the renunciation of action.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.2 bg.5.2 chapter 5 verse 2 श्री भगवानुवाच

संन्यासः कर्मयोगश्च निःश्रेयसकरावुभौ।

तयोस्तु कर्मसंन्यासात्कर्मयोगो विशिष्यते।।5.2।। śhrī bhagavān uvācha
sannyāsaḥ karma-yogaśh cha niḥśhreyasa-karāvubhau
tayos tu karma-sannyāsāt karma-yogo viśhiṣhyate the blessed lord said, "renunciation and the yoga of action both lead to the highest bliss; but of the two, the yoga of action is superior to the renunciation of action."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.20
documents.iast: na prahṛiṣhyet priyaṁ prāpya nodvijet prāpya chāpriyam
documents.summary: Resting in Brahman, with a steady intellect and undeluded, the knower of Brahman neither rejoices upon obtaining what is pleasant nor grieves upon obtaining what is unpleasant.
documents.searchText: bg.5.20 bg.5.20 chapter 5 verse 20 न परहषयतपरय परपय नदवजतपरपय चपरयम सथरबदधरसममढ बरहमवदबरहमण सथत 5.20 na prahrishyet priyam prapya nodvijet prapya chapriyam sthira-buddhir asammudho brahma-vid brahmani sthitah resting in brahman with a steady intellect and undeluded the knower of brahman neither rejoices upon obtaining what is pleasant nor grieves upon obtaining what is unpleasant.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.20 bg.5.20 chapter 5 verse 20 न प्रहृष्येत्प्रियं प्राप्य नोद्विजेत्प्राप्य चाप्रियम्।

स्थिरबुद्धिरसम्मूढो ब्रह्मविद्ब्रह्मणि स्थितः।।5.20।। na prahṛiṣhyet priyaṁ prāpya nodvijet prāpya chāpriyam
sthira-buddhir asammūḍho brahma-vid brahmaṇi sthitaḥ resting in brahman, with a steady intellect and undeluded, the knower of brahman neither rejoices upon obtaining what is pleasant nor grieves upon obtaining what is unpleasant.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.21
documents.summary: With the self unattached to external contacts, he finds happiness in the Self; with the self engaged in the meditation of Brahman, he attains endless happiness.
documents.searchText: bg.5.21 bg.5.21 chapter 5 verse 21 बहयसपरशषवसकततम वनदतयतमन यतसखम स बरहमयगयकततम सखमकषयमशनत 5.21 bahya-sparsheshvasaktatma vindatyatmani yat sukham sa brahma-yoga-yuktatma sukham akshayam ashnute with the self unattached to external contacts he finds happiness in the self with the self engaged in the meditation of brahman he attains endless happiness.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.21 bg.5.21 chapter 5 verse 21 बाह्यस्पर्शेष्वसक्तात्मा विन्दत्यात्मनि यत्सुखम्।

स ब्रह्मयोगयुक्तात्मा सुखमक्षयमश्नुते।।5.21।। bāhya-sparśheṣhvasaktātmā vindatyātmani yat sukham
sa brahma-yoga-yuktātmā sukham akṣhayam aśhnute with the self unattached to external contacts, he finds happiness in the self; with the self engaged in the meditation of brahman, he attains endless happiness.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.22
documents.iast: ye hi sansparśha-jā bhogā duḥkha-yonaya eva te
documents.sanskrit: ये हि संस्पर्शजा भोगा दुःखयोनय एव ते।
documents.summary: The enjoyments that arise from contact are only sources of pain, for they have a beginning and an end, O Arjuna; the wise do not rejoice in them.
documents.searchText: bg.5.22 bg.5.22 chapter 5 verse 22 य ह ससपरशज भग दखयनय एव त आदयनतवनत कनतय न तष रमत बध 5.22 ye hi sansparsha-ja bhoga duhkha-yonaya eva te adyantavantah kaunteya na teshu ramate budhah the enjoyments that arise from contact are only sources of pain for they have a beginning and an end o arjuna the wise do not rejoice in them.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.22 bg.5.22 chapter 5 verse 22 ये हि संस्पर्शजा भोगा दुःखयोनय एव ते।

आद्यन्तवन्तः कौन्तेय न तेषु रमते बुधः।।5.22।। ye hi sansparśha-jā bhogā duḥkha-yonaya eva te
ādyantavantaḥ kaunteya na teṣhu ramate budhaḥ the enjoyments that arise from contact are only sources of pain, for they have a beginning and an end, o arjuna; the wise do not rejoice in them.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.23
documents.summary: He who is able, while still here in this world, to withstand the impulse born out of desire and anger before the liberation from the body, he is a Yogi, and he is a happy man.
documents.searchText: bg.5.23 bg.5.23 chapter 5 verse 23 शकनतहव य सढ परकशररवमकषणत कमकरधदभव वग स यकत स सख नर 5.23 shaknotihaiva yah sodhum prak sharira-vimokshanat kama-krodhodbhavam vegam sa yuktah sa sukhi narah he who is able while still here in this world to withstand the impulse born out of desire and anger before the liberation from the body he is a yogi and he is a happy man.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.23 bg.5.23 chapter 5 verse 23 शक्नोतीहैव यः सोढुं प्राक्शरीरविमोक्षणात्।

कामक्रोधोद्भवं वेगं स युक्तः स सुखी नरः।।5.23।। śhaknotīhaiva yaḥ soḍhuṁ prāk śharīra-vimokṣhaṇāt
kāma-krodhodbhavaṁ vegaṁ sa yuktaḥ sa sukhī naraḥ he who is able, while still here in this world, to withstand the impulse born out of desire and anger before the liberation from the body, he is a yogi, and he is a happy man.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.24
documents.summary: He who is happy within, who rejoices within, and who is illuminated within, that Yogi attains absolute freedom, or Moksha, becoming Brahman himself.
documents.searchText: bg.5.24 bg.5.24 chapter 5 verse 24 यऽनतसखऽनतररमसतथनतरजयतरव य स यग बरहमनरवण बरहमभतऽधगचछत 5.24 yo ntah-sukho ntar-aramas tathantar-jyotir eva yah sa yogi brahma-nirvanam brahma-bhuto dhigachchhati he who is happy within who rejoices within and who is illuminated within that yogi attains absolute freedom or moksha becoming brahman himself.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.24 bg.5.24 chapter 5 verse 24 योऽन्तःसुखोऽन्तरारामस्तथान्तर्ज्योतिरेव यः।

स योगी ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं ब्रह्मभूतोऽधिगच्छति।।5.24।। yo 'ntaḥ-sukho 'ntar-ārāmas tathāntar-jyotir eva yaḥ
sa yogī brahma-nirvāṇaṁ brahma-bhūto 'dhigachchhati he who is happy within, who rejoices within, and who is illuminated within, that yogi attains absolute freedom, or moksha, becoming brahman himself.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.25
documents.summary: The sages obtain absolute freedom or Moksha when their sins have been destroyed, their dualities have been torn asunder, they are self-controlled, and they are intent on the welfar
documents.searchText: bg.5.25 bg.5.25 chapter 5 verse 25 लभनत बरहमनरवणमषय कषणकलमष छननदवध यततमन सरवभतहत रत 5.25 labhante brahma-nirvanam rishayah kshina-kalmashah chhinna-dvaidha yatatmanah sarva-bhuta-hite ratah the sages obtain absolute freedom or moksha when their sins have been destroyed their dualities have been torn asunder they are self-controlled and they are intent on the welfare of all beings.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.25 bg.5.25 chapter 5 verse 25 लभन्ते ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृषयः क्षीणकल्मषाः।

छिन्नद्वैधा यतात्मानः सर्वभूतहिते रताः।।5.25।। labhante brahma-nirvāṇam ṛiṣhayaḥ kṣhīṇa-kalmaṣhāḥ
chhinna-dvaidhā yatātmānaḥ sarva-bhūta-hite ratāḥ the sages obtain absolute freedom or moksha when their sins have been destroyed, their dualities have been torn asunder, they are self-controlled, and they are intent on the welfare of all beings.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.26
documents.summary: Absolute freedom exists on all sides for those self-controlled ascetics who are free from desire and anger, who have controlled their thoughts, and who have realized the Self.
documents.searchText: bg.5.26 bg.5.26 chapter 5 verse 26 कमकरधवयकतन यतन यतचतसम अभत बरहमनरवण वरतत वदततमनम 5.26 kama-krodha-viyuktanam yatinam yata-chetasam abhito brahma-nirvanam vartate viditatmanam absolute freedom exists on all sides for those self-controlled ascetics who are free from desire and anger who have controlled their thoughts and who have realized the self.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.26 bg.5.26 chapter 5 verse 26 कामक्रोधवियुक्तानां यतीनां यतचेतसाम्।

अभितो ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं वर्तते विदितात्मनाम्।।5.26।। kāma-krodha-viyuktānāṁ yatīnāṁ yata-chetasām
abhito brahma-nirvāṇaṁ vartate viditātmanām absolute freedom exists on all sides for those self-controlled ascetics who are free from desire and anger, who have controlled their thoughts, and who have realized the self.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.27
documents.iast: sparśhān kṛitvā bahir bāhyānśh chakṣhuśh chaivāntare bhruvoḥ
documents.summary: Shutting out all external contacts and fixing the gaze between the eyebrows, realizing the outgoing and incoming breaths moving within the nostrils.
documents.searchText: bg.5.27 bg.5.27 chapter 5 verse 27 सपरशनकतव बहरबहयशचकषशचवनतर भरव परणपन सम कतव नसभयनतरचरण 5.27 sparshan kritva bahir bahyansh chakshush chaivantare bhruvoh pranapanau samau kritva nasabhyantara-charinau yatendriya-mano-buddhir munir moksha-parayanah vigatechchha-bhaya-krodho yah sada mukta eva sah shutting out all external contacts and fixing the gaze between the eyebrows realizing the outgoing and incoming breaths moving within the nostrils.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.27 bg.5.27 chapter 5 verse 27 स्पर्शान्कृत्वा बहिर्बाह्यांश्चक्षुश्चैवान्तरे भ्रुवोः।

प्राणापानौ समौ कृत्वा नासाभ्यन्तरचारिणौ।।5.27।। sparśhān kṛitvā bahir bāhyānśh chakṣhuśh chaivāntare bhruvoḥ
prāṇāpānau samau kṛitvā nāsābhyantara-chāriṇau
 yatendriya-mano-buddhir munir mokṣha-parāyaṇaḥ
vigatechchhā-bhaya-krodho yaḥ sadā mukta eva saḥ shutting out all external contacts and fixing the gaze between the eyebrows, realizing the outgoing and incoming breaths moving within the nostrils.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.28
documents.iast: yatendriya-mano-buddhir  munir   mokṣa-parāyaṇaḥ vigatecchā-bhaya-krodho yaḥ sadā    mukta   eva saḥ
documents.summary: With the senses, mind, and intellect ever controlled, having liberation as their supreme goal, free from desire, fear, and anger, the sage is truly liberated forever.
documents.searchText: bg.5.28 bg.5.28 chapter 5 verse 28 यतनदरयमनबदधरमनरमकषपरयण वगतचछभयकरध य सद मकत एव स 5.28 yatendriya-mano-buddhir munir moksa-parayanah vigateccha-bhaya-krodho yah sada mukta eva sah with the senses mind and intellect ever controlled having liberation as their supreme goal free from desire fear and anger the sage is truly liberated forever.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.28 bg.5.28 chapter 5 verse 28 यतेन्द्रियमनोबुद्धिर्मुनिर्मोक्षपरायणः।

विगतेच्छाभयक्रोधो यः सदा मुक्त एव सः।।5.28।। yatendriya-mano-buddhir  munir   mokṣa-parāyaṇaḥ vigatecchā-bhaya-krodho yaḥ sadā    mukta   eva saḥ with the senses, mind, and intellect ever controlled, having liberation as their supreme goal, free from desire, fear, and anger, the sage is truly liberated forever.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.29
documents.summary: He who knows Me as the enjoyer of sacrifices and austerities, the great Lord of all the worlds, and the friend of all beings, attains peace.
documents.searchText: bg.5.29 bg.5.29 chapter 5 verse 29 भकतर यजञतपस सरवलकमहशवरम सहद सरवभतन जञतव म शनतमचछत 5.29 bhoktaram yajna-tapasam sarva-loka-maheshvaram suhridam sarva-bhutanam jnatva mam shantim richchhati he who knows me as the enjoyer of sacrifices and austerities the great lord of all the worlds and the friend of all beings attains peace.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.29 bg.5.29 chapter 5 verse 29 भोक्तारं यज्ञतपसां सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम्।

सुहृदं सर्वभूतानां ज्ञात्वा मां शान्तिमृच्छति।।5.29।। bhoktāraṁ yajña-tapasāṁ sarva-loka-maheśhvaram
suhṛidaṁ sarva-bhūtānāṁ jñātvā māṁ śhāntim ṛichchhati he who knows me as the enjoyer of sacrifices and austerities, the great lord of all the worlds, and the friend of all beings, attains peace.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.3
documents.iast: jñeyaḥ sa nitya-sannyāsī yo na dveṣhṭi na kāṅkṣhati
documents.sanskrit: ज्ञेयः स नित्यसंन्यासी यो न द्वेष्टि न काङ्क्षति।
documents.summary: He should be known as a perpetual Sannyasi who neither hates nor desires; for, free from the pairs of opposites, O mighty-armed Arjuna, he is easily freed from bondage.
documents.searchText: bg.5.3 bg.5.3 chapter 5 verse 3 जञय स नतयसनयस य न दवषट न कङकषत नरदवनदव ह महबह सख बनधतपरमचयत 5.3 jneyah sa nitya-sannyasi yo na dveshti na kankshati nirdvandvo hi maha-baho sukham bandhat pramuchyate he should be known as a perpetual sannyasi who neither hates nor desires for free from the pairs of opposites o mighty-armed arjuna he is easily freed from bondage.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.3 bg.5.3 chapter 5 verse 3 ज्ञेयः स नित्यसंन्यासी यो न द्वेष्टि न काङ्क्षति।

निर्द्वन्द्वो हि महाबाहो सुखं बन्धात्प्रमुच्यते।।5.3।। jñeyaḥ sa nitya-sannyāsī yo na dveṣhṭi na kāṅkṣhati
nirdvandvo hi mahā-bāho sukhaṁ bandhāt pramuchyate he should be known as a perpetual sannyasi who neither hates nor desires; for, free from the pairs of opposites, o mighty-armed arjuna, he is easily freed from bondage.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.4
documents.iast: sānkhya-yogau pṛithag bālāḥ pravadanti na paṇḍitāḥ
documents.summary: Children, not the wise, speak of knowledge and the Yoga of action, or the performance of action, as though they are distinct and different; he who is truly established in one, obta
documents.searchText: bg.5.4 bg.5.4 chapter 5 verse 4 सखययग पथगबल परवदनत न पणडत एकमपयसथत समयगभयरवनदत फलम 5.4 sankhya-yogau prithag balah pravadanti na panditah ekamapyasthitah samyag ubhayor vindate phalam children not the wise speak of knowledge and the yoga of action or the performance of action as though they are distinct and different he who is truly established in one obtains the fruits of both.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.4 bg.5.4 chapter 5 verse 4 सांख्ययोगौ पृथग्बालाः प्रवदन्ति न पण्डिताः।

एकमप्यास्थितः सम्यगुभयोर्विन्दते फलम्।।5.4।। sānkhya-yogau pṛithag bālāḥ pravadanti na paṇḍitāḥ
ekamapyāsthitaḥ samyag ubhayor vindate phalam children, not the wise, speak of knowledge and the yoga of action, or the performance of action, as though they are distinct and different; he who is truly established in one, obtains the fruits of both.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.5
documents.iast: yat sānkhyaiḥ prāpyate sthānaṁ tad yogair api gamyate
documents.summary: That place which is reached by the Sankhyas or the Jnanis is also reached by the Yogis (Karma Yogis). He who sees knowledge and the performance of action (Karma Yoga) as one, sees
documents.searchText: bg.5.5 bg.5.5 chapter 5 verse 5 यतसखय परपयत सथन तदयगरप गमयत एक सखय च यग च य पशयत स पशयत 5.5 yat sankhyaih prapyate sthanam tad yogair api gamyate ekam sankhyam cha yogam cha yah pashyati sa pashyati that place which is reached by the sankhyas or the jnanis is also reached by the yogis karma yogis . he who sees knowledge and the performance of action karma yoga as one sees truly.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.5 bg.5.5 chapter 5 verse 5 यत्सांख्यैः प्राप्यते स्थानं तद्योगैरपि गम्यते।

एकं सांख्यं च योगं च यः पश्यति स पश्यति।।5.5।। yat sānkhyaiḥ prāpyate sthānaṁ tad yogair api gamyate
ekaṁ sānkhyaṁ cha yogaṁ cha yaḥ paśhyati sa paśhyati that place which is reached by the sankhyas or the jnanis is also reached by the yogis (karma yogis). he who sees knowledge and the performance of action (karma yoga) as one, sees truly.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.6
documents.iast: sannyāsas tu mahā-bāho duḥkham āptum ayogataḥ
documents.summary: But, O mighty-armed Arjuna, renunciation is hard to attain without Yoga; the sage who is in harmony with Yoga quickly goes to Brahman.
documents.searchText: bg.5.6 bg.5.6 chapter 5 verse 6 सनयससत महबह दखमपतमयगत यगयकत मनरबरहम नचरणधगचछत 5.6 sannyasas tu maha-baho duhkham aptum ayogatah yoga-yukto munir brahma na chirenadhigachchhati but o mighty-armed arjuna renunciation is hard to attain without yoga the sage who is in harmony with yoga quickly goes to brahman.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.6 bg.5.6 chapter 5 verse 6 संन्यासस्तु महाबाहो दुःखमाप्तुमयोगतः।

योगयुक्तो मुनिर्ब्रह्म नचिरेणाधिगच्छति।।5.6।। sannyāsas tu mahā-bāho duḥkham āptum ayogataḥ
yoga-yukto munir brahma na chireṇādhigachchhati but, o mighty-armed arjuna, renunciation is hard to attain without yoga; the sage who is in harmony with yoga quickly goes to brahman.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.7
documents.summary: He who is devoted to the path of action, whose mind is pure, who has conquered the self, who has subdued his senses, and who realizes his Self as the Self in all beings, though act
documents.searchText: bg.5.7 bg.5.7 chapter 5 verse 7 यगयकत वशदधतम वजततम जतनदरय सरवभततमभततम करवननप न लपयत 5.7 yoga-yukto vishuddhatma vijitatma jitendriyah sarva-bhutatma-bhutatma kurvann api na lipyate he who is devoted to the path of action whose mind is pure who has conquered the self who has subdued his senses and who realizes his self as the self in all beings though acting is not tainted.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.7 bg.5.7 chapter 5 verse 7 योगयुक्तो विशुद्धात्मा विजितात्मा जितेन्द्रियः।

सर्वभूतात्मभूतात्मा कुर्वन्नपि न लिप्यते।।5.7।। yoga-yukto viśhuddhātmā vijitātmā jitendriyaḥ
sarva-bhūtātma-bhūtātmā kurvann api na lipyate he who is devoted to the path of action, whose mind is pure, who has conquered the self, who has subdued his senses, and who realizes his self as the self in all beings, though acting, is not tainted.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.8
documents.iast: naiva kiñchit karomīti yukto manyeta tattva-vit
documents.summary: I do nothing at all," thus would the harmonized knower of Truth think, seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, going, sleeping, and breathing.
documents.searchText: bg.5.8 bg.5.8 chapter 5 verse 8 नव कचतकरमत यकत मनयत तततववत पशयन शरणवनसपशञजघरननशननगचछनसवपन शवसन 5.8 naiva kinchit karomiti yukto manyeta tattva-vit pashyan shrinvan sprishanjighrann ashnangachchhan svapanshvasan pralapan visrijan grihnann unmishan nimishann api indriyanindriyartheshu vartanta iti dharayan i do nothing at all thus would the harmonized knower of truth think seeing hearing touching smelling eating going sleeping and breathing.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.8 bg.5.8 chapter 5 verse 8 नैव किंचित्करोमीति युक्तो मन्येत तत्त्ववित्।

पश्यन् श्रृणवन्स्पृशञ्जिघ्रन्नश्नन्गच्छन्स्वपन् श्वसन्।।5.8।। naiva kiñchit karomīti yukto manyeta tattva-vit
paśhyañ śhṛiṇvan spṛiśhañjighrann aśhnangachchhan svapañśhvasan
 pralapan visṛijan gṛihṇann unmiṣhan nimiṣhann api
indriyāṇīndriyārtheṣhu vartanta iti dhārayan i do nothing at all," thus would the harmonized knower of truth think, seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, going, sleeping, and breathing.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 5.9
documents.iast: pralapan visṛjan gṛhṇann unmiṣan nimiṣann api indriyāṇīndriyārtheṣu vartanta iti dhārayan
documents.summary: Speaking, letting go, seizing, opening, and closing the eyes, one should be convinced that the senses move among the sense-objects.
documents.searchText: bg.5.9 bg.5.9 chapter 5 verse 9 परलपनवसजनगहणनननमषननमषननप इनदरयणनदरयरथष वरतनत इत धरयन 5.9 pralapan visrjan grhnann unmisan nimisann api indriyanindriyarthesu vartanta iti dharayan speaking letting go seizing opening and closing the eyes one should be convinced that the senses move among the sense-objects.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.5.9 bg.5.9 chapter 5 verse 9 प्रलपन्विसृजन्गृह्णन्नुन्मिषन्निमिषन्नपि।

इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेषु वर्तन्त इति धारयन्।।5.9।। pralapan visṛjan gṛhṇann unmiṣan nimiṣann api indriyāṇīndriyārtheṣu vartanta iti dhārayan speaking, letting go, seizing, opening, and closing the eyes, one should be convinced that the senses move among the sense-objects.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.1
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said: He who performs his bounden duty without depending on the fruits of his actions—he is a sannyasi and a yogi, not he who is without fire and without action.
documents.searchText: bg.6.1 bg.6.1 chapter 6 verse 1 शर भगवनवच अनशरत करमफल करय करम करत य स सनयस च यग च न नरगनरन चकरय 6.1 shri bhagavan uvacha anashritah karma-phalam karyam karma karoti yah sa sannyasi cha yogi cha na niragnir na chakriyah the blessed lord said he who performs his bounden duty without depending on the fruits of his actions he is a sannyasi and a yogi not he who is without fire and without action.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.1 bg.6.1 chapter 6 verse 1 श्री भगवानुवाच

अनाश्रितः कर्मफलं कार्यं कर्म करोति यः।

स संन्यासी च योगी च न निरग्निर्न चाक्रियः।।6.1।। śhrī bhagavān uvācha
anāśhritaḥ karma-phalaṁ kāryaṁ karma karoti yaḥ
sa sannyāsī cha yogī cha na niragnir na chākriyaḥ the blessed lord said: he who performs his bounden duty without depending on the fruits of his actions—he is a sannyasi and a yogi, not he who is without fire and without action.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.10
documents.iast: yogī yuñjīta satatam ātmānaṁ rahasi sthitaḥ
documents.summary: Let the yogi constantly strive to keep the mind steady, remaining in solitude, alone, with the body and mind controlled, and free from hope and greed.
documents.searchText: bg.6.10 bg.6.10 chapter 6 verse 10 यग यञजत सततमतमन रहस सथत एकक यतचतततम नरशरपरगरह 6.10 yogi yunjita satatam atmanam rahasi sthitah ekaki yata-chittatma nirashir aparigrahah let the yogi constantly strive to keep the mind steady remaining in solitude alone with the body and mind controlled and free from hope and greed.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.10 bg.6.10 chapter 6 verse 10 योगी युञ्जीत सततमात्मानं रहसि स्थितः।

एकाकी यतचित्तात्मा निराशीरपरिग्रहः।।6.10।। yogī yuñjīta satatam ātmānaṁ rahasi sthitaḥ
ekākī yata-chittātmā nirāśhīr aparigrahaḥ let the yogi constantly strive to keep the mind steady, remaining in solitude, alone, with the body and mind controlled, and free from hope and greed.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.11
documents.iast: śhuchau deśhe pratiṣhṭhāpya sthiram āsanam ātmanaḥ
documents.summary: In a clean spot, having established a firm seat of his own, neither too high nor too low, made of cloth, skin, and kusha grass layered one over the other.
documents.searchText: bg.6.11 bg.6.11 chapter 6 verse 11 शच दश परतषठपय सथरमसनमतमन नतयचछरत नतनच चलजनकशततरम 6.11 shuchau deshe pratishthapya sthiram asanam atmanah natyuchchhritam nati-nicham chailajina-kushottaram in a clean spot having established a firm seat of his own neither too high nor too low made of cloth skin and kusha grass layered one over the other.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.11 bg.6.11 chapter 6 verse 11 शुचौ देशे प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्थिरमासनमात्मनः।

नात्युच्छ्रितं नातिनीचं चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम्।।6.11।। śhuchau deśhe pratiṣhṭhāpya sthiram āsanam ātmanaḥ
nātyuchchhritaṁ nāti-nīchaṁ chailājina-kuśhottaram in a clean spot, having established a firm seat of his own, neither too high nor too low, made of cloth, skin, and kusha grass layered one over the other.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.12
documents.summary: There, having made the mind one-pointed, with the actions of the mind and senses controlled, let him, seated on the seat, practice Yoga for the purification of the self.
documents.searchText: bg.6.12 bg.6.12 chapter 6 verse 12 ततरकगर मन कतव यतचततनदरयकरय उपवशयसन यञजयदयगमतमवशदधय 6.12 tatraikagram manah kritva yata-chittendriya-kriyah upavishyasane yunjyad yogam atma-vishuddhaye there having made the mind one-pointed with the actions of the mind and senses controlled let him seated on the seat practice yoga for the purification of the self.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.12 bg.6.12 chapter 6 verse 12 तत्रैकाग्रं मनः कृत्वा यतचित्तेन्द्रियक्रियः।

उपविश्यासने युञ्ज्याद्योगमात्मविशुद्धये।।6.12।। tatraikāgraṁ manaḥ kṛitvā yata-chittendriya-kriyaḥ
upaviśhyāsane yuñjyād yogam ātma-viśhuddhaye there, having made the mind one-pointed, with the actions of the mind and senses controlled, let him, seated on the seat, practice yoga for the purification of the self.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.13
documents.summary: Let him firmly hold his body, head, and neck erect and still, gazing at the tip of his nose without looking around.
documents.searchText: bg.6.13 bg.6.13 chapter 6 verse 13 सम कयशरगरव धरयननचल सथर सपरकषय नसकगर सव दशशचनवलकयन 6.13 samam kaya-shiro-grivam dharayann achalam sthirah samprekshya nasikagram svam dishash chanavalokayan let him firmly hold his body head and neck erect and still gazing at the tip of his nose without looking around.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.13 bg.6.13 chapter 6 verse 13 समं कायशिरोग्रीवं धारयन्नचलं स्थिरः।

संप्रेक्ष्य नासिकाग्रं स्वं दिशश्चानवलोकयन्।।6.13।। samaṁ kāya-śhiro-grīvaṁ dhārayann achalaṁ sthiraḥ
samprekṣhya nāsikāgraṁ svaṁ diśhaśh chānavalokayan let him firmly hold his body, head, and neck erect and still, gazing at the tip of his nose without looking around.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.14
documents.summary: Serene-minded, fearless, firm in the vow of a Brahmachari, having controlled their mind, thinking of Me and balanced in mind, let them sit, having Me as their supreme goal.
documents.searchText: bg.6.14 bg.6.14 chapter 6 verse 14 परशनततम वगतभरबरहमचरवरत सथत मन सयमय मचचतत यकत आसत मतपर 6.14 prashantatma vigata-bhir brahmachari-vrate sthitah manah sanyamya mach-chitto yukta asita mat-parah serene-minded fearless firm in the vow of a brahmachari having controlled their mind thinking of me and balanced in mind let them sit having me as their supreme goal.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.14 bg.6.14 chapter 6 verse 14 प्रशान्तात्मा विगतभीर्ब्रह्मचारिव्रते स्थितः।

मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः।।6.14।। praśhāntātmā vigata-bhīr brahmachāri-vrate sthitaḥ
manaḥ sanyamya mach-chitto yukta āsīta mat-paraḥ serene-minded, fearless, firm in the vow of a brahmachari, having controlled their mind, thinking of me and balanced in mind, let them sit, having me as their supreme goal.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.15
documents.summary: Thus, always keeping the mind balanced, the yogi, with the mind controlled, attains the peace abiding in Me, culminating in liberation.
documents.searchText: bg.6.15 bg.6.15 chapter 6 verse 15 यञजननव सदऽऽतमन यग नयतमनस शनत नरवणपरम मतससथमधगचछत 6.15 yunjann evam sadatmanam yogi niyata-manasah shantim nirvana-paramam mat-sanstham adhigachchhati thus always keeping the mind balanced the yogi with the mind controlled attains the peace abiding in me culminating in liberation.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.15 bg.6.15 chapter 6 verse 15 युञ्जन्नेवं सदाऽऽत्मानं योगी नियतमानसः।

शान्तिं निर्वाणपरमां मत्संस्थामधिगच्छति।।6.15।। yuñjann evaṁ sadātmānaṁ yogī niyata-mānasaḥ
śhantiṁ nirvāṇa-paramāṁ mat-sansthām adhigachchhati thus, always keeping the mind balanced, the yogi, with the mind controlled, attains the peace abiding in me, culminating in liberation.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.16
documents.summary: Verily, Yoga is not possible for him who eats too much, nor for him who does not eat at all, nor for him who sleeps too much, nor for him who is always awake, O Arjuna.
documents.searchText: bg.6.16 bg.6.16 chapter 6 verse 16 नतयशनतसत यगऽसत न चकनतमनशनत न चतसवपनशलसय जगरत नव चरजन 6.16 natyashnatastu yogo sti na chaikantam anashnatah na chati-svapna-shilasya jagrato naiva charjuna verily yoga is not possible for him who eats too much nor for him who does not eat at all nor for him who sleeps too much nor for him who is always awake o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.16 bg.6.16 chapter 6 verse 16 नात्यश्नतस्तु योगोऽस्ति न चैकान्तमनश्नतः।

न चातिस्वप्नशीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चार्जुन।।6.16।। nātyaśhnatastu yogo ’sti na chaikāntam anaśhnataḥ
na chāti-svapna-śhīlasya jāgrato naiva chārjuna verily, yoga is not possible for him who eats too much, nor for him who does not eat at all, nor for him who sleeps too much, nor for him who is always awake, o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.17
documents.summary: Yoga becomes the destroyer of pain for him who is moderate in eating and recreation (such as walking, etc.), who exercises moderation in action, and who is moderate in sleep and wa
documents.searchText: bg.6.17 bg.6.17 chapter 6 verse 17 यकतहरवहरसय यकतचषटसय करमस यकतसवपनवबधसय यग भवत दखह 6.17 yuktahara-viharasya yukta-cheshtasya karmasu yukta-svapnavabodhasya yogo bhavati duhkha-ha yoga becomes the destroyer of pain for him who is moderate in eating and recreation such as walking etc. who exercises moderation in action and who is moderate in sleep and wakefulness.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.17 bg.6.17 chapter 6 verse 17 युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु।

युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा।।6.17।। yuktāhāra-vihārasya yukta-cheṣhṭasya karmasu
yukta-svapnāvabodhasya yogo bhavati duḥkha-hā yoga becomes the destroyer of pain for him who is moderate in eating and recreation (such as walking, etc.), who exercises moderation in action, and who is moderate in sleep and wakefulness.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.18
documents.summary: When the perfectly controlled mind rests in the Self alone, free from longing for any of the objects of desire, then it is said, 'He is united'.
documents.searchText: bg.6.18 bg.6.18 chapter 6 verse 18 यद वनयत चततमतमनयववतषठत नसपह सरवकमभय यकत इतयचयत तद 6.18 yada viniyatam chittam atmanyevavatishthate nihsprihah sarva-kamebhyo yukta ityuchyate tada when the perfectly controlled mind rests in the self alone free from longing for any of the objects of desire then it is said he is united .
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.18 bg.6.18 chapter 6 verse 18 यदा विनियतं चित्तमात्मन्येवावतिष्ठते।

निःस्पृहः सर्वकामेभ्यो युक्त इत्युच्यते तदा।।6.18।। yadā viniyataṁ chittam ātmanyevāvatiṣhṭhate
niḥspṛihaḥ sarva-kāmebhyo yukta ityuchyate tadā when the perfectly controlled mind rests in the self alone, free from longing for any of the objects of desire, then it is said, 'he is united'.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.19
documents.iast: yathā dīpo nivāta-stho neṅgate sopamā smṛitā
documents.sanskrit: यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता।
documents.summary: As a lamp placed in a windless spot does not flicker, so is the Yogi of a controlled mind, who practices Yoga in the Self, compared.
documents.searchText: bg.6.19 bg.6.19 chapter 6 verse 19 यथ दप नवतसथ नङगत सपम समत यगन यतचततसय यञजत यगमतमन 6.19 yatha dipo nivata-stho nengate sopama smrita yogino yata-chittasya yunjato yogam atmanah as a lamp placed in a windless spot does not flicker so is the yogi of a controlled mind who practices yoga in the self compared.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.19 bg.6.19 chapter 6 verse 19 यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता।

योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः।।6.19।। yathā dīpo nivāta-stho neṅgate sopamā smṛitā
yogino yata-chittasya yuñjato yogam ātmanaḥ as a lamp placed in a windless spot does not flicker, so is the yogi of a controlled mind, who practices yoga in the self, compared.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.2
documents.iast: yaṁ sannyāsam iti prāhur yogaṁ taṁ viddhi pāṇḍava
documents.sanskrit: यं संन्यासमिति प्राहुर्योगं तं विद्धि पाण्डव।
documents.summary: Do you, O Arjuna, know that Yoga is what they call renunciation; no one indeed becomes a Yogi who has not renounced their thoughts.
documents.searchText: bg.6.2 bg.6.2 chapter 6 verse 2 य सनयसमत परहरयग त वदध पणडव न हयसनयसतसङकलप यग भवत कशचन 6.2 yam sannyasam iti prahur yogam tam viddhi pandava na hyasannyasta-sankalpo yogi bhavati kashchana do you o arjuna know that yoga is what they call renunciation no one indeed becomes a yogi who has not renounced their thoughts.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.2 bg.6.2 chapter 6 verse 2 यं संन्यासमिति प्राहुर्योगं तं विद्धि पाण्डव।

न ह्यसंन्यस्तसङ्कल्पो योगी भवति कश्चन।।6.2।। yaṁ sannyāsam iti prāhur yogaṁ taṁ viddhi pāṇḍava
na hyasannyasta-saṅkalpo yogī bhavati kaśhchana do you, o arjuna, know that yoga is what they call renunciation; no one indeed becomes a yogi who has not renounced their thoughts.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.20
documents.summary: When the mind, restrained by the practice of yoga, attains quietude, and when one sees the Self by the Self, they are satisfied in their own Self.
documents.searchText: bg.6.20 bg.6.20 chapter 6 verse 20 यतरपरमत चतत नरदध यगसवय यतर चवतमनऽऽतमन पशयननतमन तषयत 6.20 yatroparamate chittam niruddham yoga-sevaya yatra chaivatmanatmanam pashyann atmani tushyati when the mind restrained by the practice of yoga attains quietude and when one sees the self by the self they are satisfied in their own self.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.20 bg.6.20 chapter 6 verse 20 यत्रोपरमते चित्तं निरुद्धं योगसेवया।

यत्र चैवात्मनाऽऽत्मानं पश्यन्नात्मनि तुष्यति।।6.20।। yatroparamate chittaṁ niruddhaṁ yoga-sevayā
yatra chaivātmanātmānaṁ paśhyann ātmani tuṣhyati when the mind, restrained by the practice of yoga, attains quietude, and when one sees the self by the self, they are satisfied in their own self.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.21
documents.iast: sukham ātyantikaṁ yat tad buddhi-grāhyam atīndriyam
documents.summary: When he (the Yogi) feels that infinite bliss which can be grasped by the pure intellect and which transcends the senses, and is established therein, never moving away from the real
documents.searchText: bg.6.21 bg.6.21 chapter 6 verse 21 सखमतयनतक यततदबदधगरहयमतनदरयम वतत यतर न चवय सथतशचलत तततवत 6.21 sukham atyantikam yat tad buddhi-grahyam atindriyam vetti yatra na chaivayam sthitash chalati tattvatah when he the yogi feels that infinite bliss which can be grasped by the pure intellect and which transcends the senses and is established therein never moving away from the reality.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.21 bg.6.21 chapter 6 verse 21 सुखमात्यन्तिकं यत्तद्बुद्धिग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम्।

वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः।।6.21।। sukham ātyantikaṁ yat tad buddhi-grāhyam atīndriyam
vetti yatra na chaivāyaṁ sthitaśh chalati tattvataḥ when he (the yogi) feels that infinite bliss which can be grasped by the pure intellect and which transcends the senses, and is established therein, never moving away from the reality.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.22
documents.iast: yaṁ labdhvā chāparaṁ lābhaṁ manyate nādhikaṁ tataḥ
documents.sanskrit: यं लब्ध्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः।
documents.summary: Having obtained it, he thinks there is no other gain superior to it; established in it, he is not moved even by heavy sorrow.
documents.searchText: bg.6.22 bg.6.22 chapter 6 verse 22 य लबधव चपर लभ मनयत नधक तत यसमनसथत न दखन गरणप वचलयत 6.22 yam labdhva chaparam labham manyate nadhikam tatah yasmin sthito na duhkhena gurunapi vichalyate having obtained it he thinks there is no other gain superior to it established in it he is not moved even by heavy sorrow.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.22 bg.6.22 chapter 6 verse 22 यं लब्ध्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः।

यस्मिन्स्थितो न दुःखेन गुरुणापि विचाल्यते।।6.22।। yaṁ labdhvā chāparaṁ lābhaṁ manyate nādhikaṁ tataḥ
yasmin sthito na duḥkhena guruṇāpi vichālyate having obtained it, he thinks there is no other gain superior to it; established in it, he is not moved even by heavy sorrow.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.23
documents.summary: Let this be known by the name of Yoga, the severance from union with pain. This Yoga should be practiced with determination and with an undespairing mind.
documents.searchText: bg.6.23 bg.6.23 chapter 6 verse 23 त वदयद दखसयगवयग यगसजञतम स नशचयन यकतवय यगऽनरवणणचतस 6.23 tam vidyad duhkha-sanyoga-viyogam yogasanjnitam sa nishchayena yoktavyo yogo nirvinna-chetasa let this be known by the name of yoga the severance from union with pain. this yoga should be practiced with determination and with an undespairing mind.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.23 bg.6.23 chapter 6 verse 23 तं विद्याद् दुःखसंयोगवियोगं योगसंज्ञितम्।

स निश्चयेन योक्तव्यो योगोऽनिर्विण्णचेतसा।।6.23।। taṁ vidyād duḥkha-sanyoga-viyogaṁ yogasaṅjñitam
sa niśhchayena yoktavyo yogo ’nirviṇṇa-chetasā let this be known by the name of yoga, the severance from union with pain. this yoga should be practiced with determination and with an undespairing mind.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.24
documents.summary: Abandoning unreservedly all desires born of Sankalpa (thought and imagination) and completely restraining the whole group of senses by the mind from all sides.
documents.searchText: bg.6.24 bg.6.24 chapter 6 verse 24 सङकलपपरभवनकमसतयकतव सरवनशषत मनसवनदरयगरम वनयमय समनतत 6.24 sankalpa-prabhavan kamans tyaktva sarvan asheshatah manasaivendriya-gramam viniyamya samantatah abandoning unreservedly all desires born of sankalpa thought and imagination and completely restraining the whole group of senses by the mind from all sides.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.24 bg.6.24 chapter 6 verse 24 सङ्कल्पप्रभवान्कामांस्त्यक्त्वा सर्वानशेषतः।

मनसैवेन्द्रियग्रामं विनियम्य समन्ततः।।6.24।। saṅkalpa-prabhavān kāmāns tyaktvā sarvān aśheṣhataḥ
manasaivendriya-grāmaṁ viniyamya samantataḥ abandoning unreservedly all desires born of sankalpa (thought and imagination) and completely restraining the whole group of senses by the mind from all sides.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.25
documents.summary: Little by little, let him attain steadiness of the intellect by holding it firmly; having made the mind establish itself in the Self, let him not think of anything else.
documents.searchText: bg.6.25 bg.6.25 chapter 6 verse 25 शन शनरपरमद बदधय धतगहतय आतमससथ मन कतव न कञचदप चनतयत 6.25 shanaih shanair uparamed buddhya dhriti-grihitaya atma-sanstham manah kritva na kinchid api chintayet little by little let him attain steadiness of the intellect by holding it firmly having made the mind establish itself in the self let him not think of anything else.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.25 bg.6.25 chapter 6 verse 25 शनैः शनैरुपरमेद् बुद्ध्या धृतिगृहीतया।

आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत्।।6.25।। śhanaiḥ śhanair uparamed buddhyā dhṛiti-gṛihītayā
ātma-sansthaṁ manaḥ kṛitvā na kiñchid api chintayet little by little, let him attain steadiness of the intellect by holding it firmly; having made the mind establish itself in the self, let him not think of anything else.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.26
documents.iast: yato yato niśhcharati manaśh chañchalam asthiram
documents.summary: From whatever cause the restless and unsteady mind wanders away, let him restrain it from that and bring it under the control of the Self alone.
documents.searchText: bg.6.26 bg.6.26 chapter 6 verse 26 यत यत नशचरत मनशचञचलमसथरम ततसतत नयमयतदतमनयव वश नयत 6.26 yato yato nishcharati manash chanchalam asthiram tatas tato niyamyaitad atmanyeva vasham nayet from whatever cause the restless and unsteady mind wanders away let him restrain it from that and bring it under the control of the self alone.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.26 bg.6.26 chapter 6 verse 26 यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम्।

ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत्।।6.26।। yato yato niśhcharati manaśh chañchalam asthiram
tatas tato niyamyaitad ātmanyeva vaśhaṁ nayet from whatever cause the restless and unsteady mind wanders away, let him restrain it from that and bring it under the control of the self alone.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.27
documents.summary: Supreme Bliss indeed comes to this Yogi whose mind is made peaceful, whose passion is quelled, who has become Brahman, and who is free from sin.
documents.searchText: bg.6.27 bg.6.27 chapter 6 verse 27 परशनतमनस हयन यगन सखमततमम उपत शनतरजस बरहमभतमकलमषम 6.27 prashanta-manasam hyenam yoginam sukham uttamam upaiti shanta-rajasam brahma-bhutam akalmasham supreme bliss indeed comes to this yogi whose mind is made peaceful whose passion is quelled who has become brahman and who is free from sin.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.27 bg.6.27 chapter 6 verse 27 प्रशान्तमनसं ह्येनं योगिनं सुखमुत्तमम्।

उपैति शान्तरजसं ब्रह्मभूतमकल्मषम्।।6.27।। praśhānta-manasaṁ hyenaṁ yoginaṁ sukham uttamam
upaiti śhānta-rajasaṁ brahma-bhūtam akalmaṣham supreme bliss indeed comes to this yogi whose mind is made peaceful, whose passion is quelled, who has become brahman, and who is free from sin.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.28
documents.summary: The yogi, always engaging the mind thus (in the practice of yoga), is freed from sins and easily enjoys the infinite bliss of contact with Brahman (the Eternal).
documents.searchText: bg.6.28 bg.6.28 chapter 6 verse 28 यञजननव सदऽऽतमन यग वगतकलमष सखन बरहमससपरशमतयनत सखमशनत 6.28 yunjann evam sadatmanam yogi vigata-kalmashah sukhena brahma-sansparsham atyantam sukham ashnute the yogi always engaging the mind thus in the practice of yoga is freed from sins and easily enjoys the infinite bliss of contact with brahman the eternal .
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.28 bg.6.28 chapter 6 verse 28 युञ्जन्नेवं सदाऽऽत्मानं योगी विगतकल्मषः।

सुखेन ब्रह्मसंस्पर्शमत्यन्तं सुखमश्नुते।।6.28।। yuñjann evaṁ sadātmānaṁ yogī vigata-kalmaṣhaḥ
sukhena brahma-sansparśham atyantaṁ sukham aśhnute the yogi, always engaging the mind thus (in the practice of yoga), is freed from sins and easily enjoys the infinite bliss of contact with brahman (the eternal).

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.29
documents.summary: With the mind harmonized by Yoga, he sees the Self abiding in all beings and all beings in the Self; he sees the same everywhere.
documents.searchText: bg.6.29 bg.6.29 chapter 6 verse 29 सरवभतसथमतमन सरवभतन चतमन ईकषत यगयकततम सरवतर समदरशन 6.29 sarva-bhuta-stham atmanam sarva-bhutani chatmani ikshate yoga-yuktatma sarvatra sama-darshanah with the mind harmonized by yoga he sees the self abiding in all beings and all beings in the self he sees the same everywhere.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.29 bg.6.29 chapter 6 verse 29 सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि।

ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः।।6.29।। sarva-bhūta-stham ātmānaṁ sarva-bhūtāni chātmani
īkṣhate yoga-yuktātmā sarvatra sama-darśhanaḥ with the mind harmonized by yoga, he sees the self abiding in all beings and all beings in the self; he sees the same everywhere.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.3
documents.iast: ārurukṣhor muner yogaṁ karma kāraṇam uchyate
documents.summary: For a sage who wishes to attain to Yoga, action is said to be the means; for the same sage who has attained Yoga, inaction is said to be the means.
documents.searchText: bg.6.3 bg.6.3 chapter 6 verse 3 आररकषरमनरयग करम करणमचयत यगरढसय तसयव शम करणमचयत 6.3 arurukshor muner yogam karma karanam uchyate yogarudhasya tasyaiva shamah karanam uchyate for a sage who wishes to attain to yoga action is said to be the means for the same sage who has attained yoga inaction is said to be the means.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.3 bg.6.3 chapter 6 verse 3 आरुरुक्षोर्मुनेर्योगं कर्म कारणमुच्यते।

योगारूढस्य तस्यैव शमः कारणमुच्यते।।6.3।। ārurukṣhor muner yogaṁ karma kāraṇam uchyate
yogārūḍhasya tasyaiva śhamaḥ kāraṇam uchyate for a sage who wishes to attain to yoga, action is said to be the means; for the same sage who has attained yoga, inaction is said to be the means.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.30
documents.iast: yo māṁ paśhyati sarvatra sarvaṁ cha mayi paśhyati
documents.sanskrit: यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति।
documents.summary: He who sees Me everywhere and sees everything in Me, never becomes separated from Me, nor do I from him.
documents.searchText: bg.6.30 bg.6.30 chapter 6 verse 30 य म पशयत सरवतर सरव च मय पशयत तसयह न परणशयम स च म न परणशयत 6.30 yo mam pashyati sarvatra sarvam cha mayi pashyati tasyaham na pranashyami sa cha me na pranashyati he who sees me everywhere and sees everything in me never becomes separated from me nor do i from him.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.30 bg.6.30 chapter 6 verse 30 यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति।

तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति।।6.30।। yo māṁ paśhyati sarvatra sarvaṁ cha mayi paśhyati
tasyāhaṁ na praṇaśhyāmi sa cha me na praṇaśhyati he who sees me everywhere and sees everything in me, never becomes separated from me, nor do i from him.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.31
documents.summary: He who, being established in unity, worships Me, who dwells in all beings, that yogi abides in Me, whatever their mode of living may be.
documents.searchText: bg.6.31 bg.6.31 chapter 6 verse 31 सरवभतसथत य म भजतयकतवमसथत सरवथ वरतमनऽप स यग मय वरतत 6.31 sarva-bhuta-sthitam yo mam bhajatyekatvam asthitah sarvatha vartamano pi sa yogi mayi vartate he who being established in unity worships me who dwells in all beings that yogi abides in me whatever their mode of living may be.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.31 bg.6.31 chapter 6 verse 31 सर्वभूतस्थितं यो मां भजत्येकत्वमास्थितः।

सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्तते।।6.31।। sarva-bhūta-sthitaṁ yo māṁ bhajatyekatvam āsthitaḥ
sarvathā vartamāno ’pi sa yogī mayi vartate he who, being established in unity, worships me, who dwells in all beings, that yogi abides in me, whatever their mode of living may be.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.32
documents.summary: He who, through the likeness of the Self, O Arjuna, sees reality everywhere, be it pleasure or pain, is regarded as the highest Yogi.
documents.searchText: bg.6.32 bg.6.32 chapter 6 verse 32 आतमपमयन सरवतर सम पशयत यऽरजन सख व यद व दख स यग परम मत 6.32 atmaupamyena sarvatra samam pashyati yo rjuna sukham va yadi va duhkham sa yogi paramo matah he who through the likeness of the self o arjuna sees reality everywhere be it pleasure or pain is regarded as the highest yogi.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.32 bg.6.32 chapter 6 verse 32 आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन।

सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं सः योगी परमो मतः।।6.32।। ātmaupamyena sarvatra samaṁ paśhyati yo ’rjuna
sukhaṁ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṁ sa yogī paramo mataḥ he who, through the likeness of the self, o arjuna, sees reality everywhere, be it pleasure or pain, is regarded as the highest yogi.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.33
documents.summary: Arjuna said, "O Krishna, I do not see how this Yoga of equanimity, which you have taught me, can be maintained steadily, due to the restlessness of the mind."
documents.searchText: bg.6.33 bg.6.33 chapter 6 verse 33 अरजन उवच यऽय यगसतवय परकत समयन मधसदन एतसयह न पशयम चञचलतवत सथत सथरम 6.33 arjuna uvacha yo yam yogas tvaya proktah samyena madhusudana etasyaham na pashyami chanchalatvat sthitim sthiram arjuna said o krishna i do not see how this yoga of equanimity which you have taught me can be maintained steadily due to the restlessness of the mind.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.33 bg.6.33 chapter 6 verse 33 अर्जुन उवाच

योऽयं योगस्त्वया प्रोक्तः साम्येन मधुसूदन।

एतस्याहं न पश्यामि चञ्चलत्वात् स्थितिं स्थिराम्।।6.33।। arjuna uvācha
yo ’yaṁ yogas tvayā proktaḥ sāmyena madhusūdana
etasyāhaṁ na paśhyāmi chañchalatvāt sthitiṁ sthirām arjuna said, "o krishna, i do not see how this yoga of equanimity, which you have taught me, can be maintained steadily, due to the restlessness of the mind."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.34
documents.iast: chañchalaṁ hi manaḥ kṛiṣhṇa pramāthi balavad dṛiḍham
documents.sanskrit: चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद्दृढम्।
documents.summary: The mind is indeed restless, turbulent, strong, and unyielding, O Krishna; I consider it as difficult to control as controlling the wind.
documents.searchText: bg.6.34 bg.6.34 chapter 6 verse 34 चञचल ह मन कषण परमथ बलवददढम तसयह नगरह मनय वयरव सदषकरम 6.34 chanchalam hi manah krishna pramathi balavad dridham tasyaham nigraham manye vayor iva su-dushkaram the mind is indeed restless turbulent strong and unyielding o krishna i consider it as difficult to control as controlling the wind.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.34 bg.6.34 chapter 6 verse 34 चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद्दृढम्।

तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोरिव सुदुष्करम्।।6.34।। chañchalaṁ hi manaḥ kṛiṣhṇa pramāthi balavad dṛiḍham
tasyāhaṁ nigrahaṁ manye vāyor iva su-duṣhkaram the mind is indeed restless, turbulent, strong, and unyielding, o krishna; i consider it as difficult to control as controlling the wind.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.35
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, "Undoubtedly, O mighty-armed Arjuna, the mind is difficult to control and restless; but with practice and dispassion, it can be restrained."
documents.searchText: bg.6.35 bg.6.35 chapter 6 verse 35 शर भगवनवच असशय महबह मन दरनगरह चल अभयसन त कनतय वरगयण च गहयत 6.35 shri bhagavan uvacha asanshayam maha-baho mano durnigraham chalam abhyasena tu kaunteya vairagyena cha grihyate the blessed lord said undoubtedly o mighty-armed arjuna the mind is difficult to control and restless but with practice and dispassion it can be restrained.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.35 bg.6.35 chapter 6 verse 35 श्री भगवानुवाच

असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलं।

अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते।।6.35।। śhrī bhagavān uvācha
asanśhayaṁ mahā-bāho mano durnigrahaṁ chalam
abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa cha gṛihyate the blessed lord said, "undoubtedly, o mighty-armed arjuna, the mind is difficult to control and restless; but with practice and dispassion, it can be restrained."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.36
documents.iast: asaṅyatātmanā yogo duṣhprāpa iti me matiḥ
documents.sanskrit: असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः।
documents.summary: I think Yoga is hard to be attained by one with an uncontrolled self, but the self-controlled and striving one can attain it by the appropriate means.
documents.searchText: bg.6.36 bg.6.36 chapter 6 verse 36 असयततमन यग दषपरप इत म मत वशयतमन त यतत शकयऽवपतमपयत 6.36 asanyatatmana yogo dushprapa iti me matih vashyatmana tu yatata shakyo vaptum upayatah i think yoga is hard to be attained by one with an uncontrolled self but the self-controlled and striving one can attain it by the appropriate means.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.36 bg.6.36 chapter 6 verse 36 असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः।

वश्यात्मना तु यतता शक्योऽवाप्तुमुपायतः।।6.36।। asaṅyatātmanā yogo duṣhprāpa iti me matiḥ
vaśhyātmanā tu yatatā śhakyo ’vāptum upāyataḥ i think yoga is hard to be attained by one with an uncontrolled self, but the self-controlled and striving one can attain it by the appropriate means.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.37
documents.summary: Arjuna said, "He who is unable to control himself, even though he has faith, and whose mind wanders away from Yoga, what end does he meet, having failed to attain perfection in Yog
documents.searchText: bg.6.37 bg.6.37 chapter 6 verse 37 अरजन उवच अयत शरदधयपत यगचचलतमनस अपरपय यगससदध क गत कषण गचछत 6.37 arjuna uvacha ayatih shraddhayopeto yogach chalita-manasah aprapya yoga-sansiddhim kan gatim krishna gachchhati arjuna said he who is unable to control himself even though he has faith and whose mind wanders away from yoga what end does he meet having failed to attain perfection in yoga o krishna
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.37 bg.6.37 chapter 6 verse 37 अर्जुन उवाच

अयतिः श्रद्धयोपेतो योगाच्चलितमानसः।

अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति।।6.37।। arjuna uvācha
ayatiḥ śhraddhayopeto yogāch chalita-mānasaḥ
aprāpya yoga-sansiddhiṁ kāṅ gatiṁ kṛiṣhṇa gachchhati arjuna said, "he who is unable to control himself, even though he has faith, and whose mind wanders away from yoga, what end does he meet, having failed to attain perfection in yoga, o krishna?"

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.38
documents.summary: Fallen from both, does he not perish like a rent cloud, supportless, O mighty-armed one, deluded on the path of Brahman?
documents.searchText: bg.6.38 bg.6.38 chapter 6 verse 38 कचचननभयवभरषटशछननभरमव नशयत अपरतषठ महबह वमढ बरहमण पथ 6.38 kachchin nobhaya-vibhrashtash chhinnabhram iva nashyati apratishtho maha-baho vimudho brahmanah pathi fallen from both does he not perish like a rent cloud supportless o mighty-armed one deluded on the path of brahman
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.38 bg.6.38 chapter 6 verse 38 कच्चिन्नोभयविभ्रष्टश्छिन्नाभ्रमिव नश्यति।

अप्रतिष्ठो महाबाहो विमूढो ब्रह्मणः पथि।।6.38।। kachchin nobhaya-vibhraṣhṭaśh chhinnābhram iva naśhyati
apratiṣhṭho mahā-bāho vimūḍho brahmaṇaḥ pathi fallen from both, does he not perish like a rent cloud, supportless, o mighty-armed one, deluded on the path of brahman?

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.39
documents.iast: etan me sanśhayaṁ kṛiṣhṇa chhettum arhasyaśheṣhataḥ
documents.summary: O Krishna, please completely dispel this doubt of mine, for it is not possible for anyone but You to do so.
documents.searchText: bg.6.39 bg.6.39 chapter 6 verse 39 एतनम सशय कषण छततमरहसयशषत तवदनय सशयसयसय छतत न हयपपदयत 6.39 etan me sanshayam krishna chhettum arhasyasheshatah tvad-anyah sanshayasyasya chhetta na hyupapadyate o krishna please completely dispel this doubt of mine for it is not possible for anyone but you to do so.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.39 bg.6.39 chapter 6 verse 39 एतन्मे संशयं कृष्ण छेत्तुमर्हस्यशेषतः।

त्वदन्यः संशयस्यास्य छेत्ता न ह्युपपद्यते।।6.39।। etan me sanśhayaṁ kṛiṣhṇa chhettum arhasyaśheṣhataḥ
tvad-anyaḥ sanśhayasyāsya chhettā na hyupapadyate o krishna, please completely dispel this doubt of mine, for it is not possible for anyone but you to do so.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.4
documents.summary: When a person is not attached to the sense-objects or to actions, having renounced all thoughts, then they are said to have attained Yoga.
documents.searchText: bg.6.4 bg.6.4 chapter 6 verse 4 यद ह ननदरयरथष न करमसवनषजजत सरवसङकलपसनयस यगरढसतदचयत 6.4 yada hi nendriyartheshu na karmasv-anushajjate sarva-sankalpa-sannyasi yogarudhas tadochyate when a person is not attached to the sense-objects or to actions having renounced all thoughts then they are said to have attained yoga.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.4 bg.6.4 chapter 6 verse 4 यदा हि नेन्द्रियार्थेषु न कर्मस्वनुषज्जते।

सर्वसङ्कल्पसंन्यासी योगारूढस्तदोच्यते।।6.4।। yadā hi nendriyārtheṣhu na karmasv-anuṣhajjate
sarva-saṅkalpa-sannyāsī yogārūḍhas tadochyate when a person is not attached to the sense-objects or to actions, having renounced all thoughts, then they are said to have attained yoga.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.40
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, "O Arjuna, neither in this world nor in the next will there be destruction for him; none, indeed, who does good, O my son, ever comes to grief."
documents.searchText: bg.6.40 bg.6.40 chapter 6 verse 40 शर भगवनवच परथ नवह नमतर वनशसतसय वदयत नह कलयणकतकशचददरगत तत गचछत 6.40 shri bhagavan uvacha partha naiveha namutra vinashas tasya vidyate na hi kalyana-krit kashchid durgatim tata gachchhati the blessed lord said o arjuna neither in this world nor in the next will there be destruction for him none indeed who does good o my son ever comes to grief.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.40 bg.6.40 chapter 6 verse 40 श्री भगवानुवाच

पार्थ नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते।

नहि कल्याणकृत्कश्चिद्दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति।।6.40।। śhrī bhagavān uvācha
pārtha naiveha nāmutra vināśhas tasya vidyate
na hi kalyāṇa-kṛit kaśhchid durgatiṁ tāta gachchhati the blessed lord said, "o arjuna, neither in this world nor in the next will there be destruction for him; none, indeed, who does good, o my son, ever comes to grief."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.41
documents.iast: prāpya puṇya-kṛitāṁ lokān uṣhitvā śhāśhvatīḥ samāḥ
documents.summary: Having attained to the worlds of the righteous and having dwelt there for everlasting years, he who fell from Yoga is born in a house of the pure and wealthy.
documents.searchText: bg.6.41 bg.6.41 chapter 6 verse 41 परपय पणयकत लकनषतव शशवत सम शचन शरमत गह यगभरषटऽभजयत 6.41 prapya punya-kritam lokan ushitva shashvatih samah shuchinam shrimatam gehe yoga-bhrashto bhijayate having attained to the worlds of the righteous and having dwelt there for everlasting years he who fell from yoga is born in a house of the pure and wealthy.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.41 bg.6.41 chapter 6 verse 41 प्राप्य पुण्यकृतां लोकानुषित्वा शाश्वतीः समाः।

शुचीनां श्रीमतां गेहे योगभ्रष्टोऽभिजायते।।6.41।। prāpya puṇya-kṛitāṁ lokān uṣhitvā śhāśhvatīḥ samāḥ
śhuchīnāṁ śhrīmatāṁ gehe yoga-bhraṣhṭo’bhijāyate having attained to the worlds of the righteous and having dwelt there for everlasting years, he who fell from yoga is born in a house of the pure and wealthy.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.42
documents.iast: atha vā yoginām eva kule bhavati dhīmatām
documents.summary: Or he is born in a family of even the wisest of yogis; verily, such a birth is very difficult to obtain in this world.
documents.searchText: bg.6.42 bg.6.42 chapter 6 verse 42 अथव यगनमव कल भवत धमतम एतदध दरलभतर लक जनम यददशम 6.42 atha va yoginam eva kule bhavati dhimatam etad dhi durlabhataram loke janma yad idrisham or he is born in a family of even the wisest of yogis verily such a birth is very difficult to obtain in this world.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.42 bg.6.42 chapter 6 verse 42 अथवा योगिनामेव कुले भवति धीमताम्।

एतद्धि दुर्लभतरं लोके जन्म यदीदृशम्।।6.42।। atha vā yoginām eva kule bhavati dhīmatām
etad dhi durlabhataraṁ loke janma yad īdṛiśham or he is born in a family of even the wisest of yogis; verily, such a birth is very difficult to obtain in this world.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.43
documents.summary: Then he comes into contact with the knowledge acquired in his former body and strives even more for perfection, O Arjuna.
documents.searchText: bg.6.43 bg.6.43 chapter 6 verse 43 ततर त बदधसयग लभत परवदहकम यतत च तत भय ससदध करननदन 6.43 tatra tam buddhi-sanyogam labhate paurva-dehikam yatate cha tato bhuyah sansiddhau kuru-nandana then he comes into contact with the knowledge acquired in his former body and strives even more for perfection o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.43 bg.6.43 chapter 6 verse 43 तत्र तं बुद्धिसंयोगं लभते पौर्वदेहिकम्।

यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ कुरुनन्दन।।6.43।। tatra taṁ buddhi-sanyogaṁ labhate paurva-dehikam
yatate cha tato bhūyaḥ sansiddhau kuru-nandana then he comes into contact with the knowledge acquired in his former body and strives even more for perfection, o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.44
documents.summary: By that same former practice, he is borne on in spite of himself. Even he who merely wishes to know Yoga goes beyond the Brahmanic word.
documents.searchText: bg.6.44 bg.6.44 chapter 6 verse 44 परवभयसन तनव हरयत हयवशऽप स जजञसरप यगसय शबदबरहमतवरतत 6.44 purvabhyasena tenaiva hriyate hyavasho pi sah jijnasur api yogasya shabda-brahmativartate by that same former practice he is borne on in spite of himself. even he who merely wishes to know yoga goes beyond the brahmanic word.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.44 bg.6.44 chapter 6 verse 44 पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव ह्रियते ह्यवशोऽपि सः।

जिज्ञासुरपि योगस्य शब्दब्रह्मातिवर्तते।।6.44।। pūrvābhyāsena tenaiva hriyate hyavaśho ’pi saḥ
jijñāsur api yogasya śhabda-brahmātivartate by that same former practice, he is borne on in spite of himself. even he who merely wishes to know yoga goes beyond the brahmanic word.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.45
documents.summary: But the Yogi who strives assiduously, purified of sins and perfected gradually over many births, reaches the highest goal.
documents.searchText: bg.6.45 bg.6.45 chapter 6 verse 45 परयतनदयतमनसत यग सशदधकलबष अनकजनमससदधसतत यत पर गतम 6.45 prayatnad yatamanas tu yogi sanshuddha-kilbishah aneka-janma-sansiddhas tato yati param gatim but the yogi who strives assiduously purified of sins and perfected gradually over many births reaches the highest goal.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.45 bg.6.45 chapter 6 verse 45 प्रयत्नाद्यतमानस्तु योगी संशुद्धकिल्बिषः।

अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम्।।6.45।। prayatnād yatamānas tu yogī sanśhuddha-kilbiṣhaḥ
aneka-janma-sansiddhas tato yāti parāṁ gatim but the yogi who strives assiduously, purified of sins and perfected gradually over many births, reaches the highest goal.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.46
documents.summary: The yogi is thought to be superior to the ascetics, even superior to those who have knowledge obtained through the study of scriptures; he is also superior to men of action; theref
documents.searchText: bg.6.46 bg.6.46 chapter 6 verse 46 तपसवभयऽधक यग जञनभयऽप मतऽधक करमभयशचधक यग तसमदयग भवरजन 6.46 tapasvibhyo dhiko yogi jnanibhyo pi mato dhikah karmibhyash chadhiko yogi tasmad yogi bhavarjuna the yogi is thought to be superior to the ascetics even superior to those who have knowledge obtained through the study of scriptures he is also superior to men of action therefore be thou a yogi o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.46 bg.6.46 chapter 6 verse 46 तपस्विभ्योऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि मतोऽधिकः।

कर्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी तस्माद्योगी भवार्जुन।।6.46।। tapasvibhyo ’dhiko yogī
jñānibhyo ’pi mato ’dhikaḥ
karmibhyaśh chādhiko yogī
tasmād yogī bhavārjuna the yogi is thought to be superior to the ascetics, even superior to those who have knowledge obtained through the study of scriptures; he is also superior to men of action; therefore, be thou a yogi, o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.47
documents.summary: And among all the Yogis, he who, full of faith and with his inner self merged in Me, worships Me is deemed by Me to be the most devoted.
documents.searchText: bg.6.47 bg.6.47 chapter 6 verse 47 यगनमप सरवष मदगतननतरतमन शरदधवनभजत य म स म यकततम मत 6.47 yoginam api sarvesham mad-gatenantar-atmana shraddhavan bhajate yo mam sa me yuktatamo matah and among all the yogis he who full of faith and with his inner self merged in me worships me is deemed by me to be the most devoted.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.47 bg.6.47 chapter 6 verse 47 योगिनामपि सर्वेषां मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना।

श्रद्धावान्भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः।।6.47।। yoginām api sarveṣhāṁ mad-gatenāntar-ātmanā
śhraddhāvān bhajate yo māṁ sa me yuktatamo mataḥ and among all the yogis, he who, full of faith and with his inner self merged in me, worships me is deemed by me to be the most devoted.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.5
documents.summary: One should raise oneself by one's own self alone; let not one lower oneself; for the self alone is one's own friend, and the self alone is one's own enemy.
documents.searchText: bg.6.5 bg.6.5 chapter 6 verse 5 उदधरदतमनऽऽतमन नतमनमवसदयत आतमव हयतमन बनधरतमव रपरतमन 6.5 uddhared atmanatmanam natmanam avasadayet atmaiva hyatmano bandhur atmaiva ripur atmanah one should raise oneself by one s own self alone let not one lower oneself for the self alone is one s own friend and the self alone is one s own enemy.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.5 bg.6.5 chapter 6 verse 5 उद्धरेदात्मनाऽऽत्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत्।

आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः।।6.5।। uddhared ātmanātmānaṁ nātmānam avasādayet
ātmaiva hyātmano bandhur ātmaiva ripur ātmanaḥ one should raise oneself by one's own self alone; let not one lower oneself; for the self alone is one's own friend, and the self alone is one's own enemy.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.6
documents.summary: The Self is the friend of the self of him by whom the Self has been conquered; but to the unconquered self, this Self stands in the position of an enemy, like an external foe.
documents.searchText: bg.6.6 bg.6.6 chapter 6 verse 6 बनधरतमऽऽतमनसतसय यनतमवतमन जत अनतमनसत शतरतव वरतततमव शतरवत 6.6 bandhur atmatmanas tasya yenatmaivatmana jitah anatmanas tu shatrutve vartetatmaiva shatru-vat the self is the friend of the self of him by whom the self has been conquered but to the unconquered self this self stands in the position of an enemy like an external foe.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.6 bg.6.6 chapter 6 verse 6 बन्धुरात्माऽऽत्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवात्मना जितः।

अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत्।।6.6।। bandhur ātmātmanas tasya yenātmaivātmanā jitaḥ
anātmanas tu śhatrutve vartetātmaiva śhatru-vat the self is the friend of the self of him by whom the self has been conquered; but to the unconquered self, this self stands in the position of an enemy, like an external foe.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.7
documents.summary: The Supreme Self of him who is self-controlled and peaceful remains balanced in cold and heat, pleasure and pain, as well as in honor and dishonor.
documents.searchText: bg.6.7 bg.6.7 chapter 6 verse 7 जततमन परशनतसय परमतम समहत शतषणसखदखष तथ मनपमनय 6.7 jitatmanah prashantasya paramatma samahitah shitoshna-sukha-duhkheshu tatha manapamanayoh the supreme self of him who is self-controlled and peaceful remains balanced in cold and heat pleasure and pain as well as in honor and dishonor.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.7 bg.6.7 chapter 6 verse 7 जितात्मनः प्रशान्तस्य परमात्मा समाहितः।

शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु तथा मानापमानयोः।।6.7।। jitātmanaḥ praśhāntasya paramātmā samāhitaḥ
śhītoṣhṇa-sukha-duḥkheṣhu tathā mānāpamānayoḥ the supreme self of him who is self-controlled and peaceful remains balanced in cold and heat, pleasure and pain, as well as in honor and dishonor.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.8
documents.summary: The Yogi who is satisfied with the knowledge and wisdom of the Self, who has conquered the senses, and to whom a clod of earth, a piece of stone, and gold are all the same, is said
documents.searchText: bg.6.8 bg.6.8 chapter 6 verse 8 जञनवजञनतपततम कटसथ वजतनदरय यकत इतयचयत यग समलषटशमकञचन 6.8 jnana-vijnana-triptatma kuta-stho vijitendriyah yukta ityuchyate yogi sama-loshtashma-kanchanah the yogi who is satisfied with the knowledge and wisdom of the self who has conquered the senses and to whom a clod of earth a piece of stone and gold are all the same is said to have attained nirvikalpa samadhi.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.8 bg.6.8 chapter 6 verse 8 ज्ञानविज्ञानतृप्तात्मा कूटस्थो विजितेन्द्रियः।

युक्त इत्युच्यते योगी समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः।।6.8।। jñāna-vijñāna-tṛiptātmā kūṭa-stho vijitendriyaḥ
yukta ityuchyate yogī sama-loṣhṭāśhma-kāñchanaḥ the yogi who is satisfied with the knowledge and wisdom of the self, who has conquered the senses, and to whom a clod of earth, a piece of stone, and gold are all the same, is said to have attained nirvikalpa samadhi.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 6.9
documents.summary: He who is of the same mind towards the good-hearted, friends, enemies, the indifferent, the neutral, the hateful, the relatives, the righteous, and the unrighteous, excels.
documents.searchText: bg.6.9 bg.6.9 chapter 6 verse 9 सहनमतररयदसनमधयसथदवषयबनधष सधषवप च पपष समबदधरवशषयत 6.9 suhrin-mitraryudasina-madhyastha-dveshya-bandhushu sadhushvapi cha papeshu sama-buddhir vishishyate he who is of the same mind towards the good-hearted friends enemies the indifferent the neutral the hateful the relatives the righteous and the unrighteous excels.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.6.9 bg.6.9 chapter 6 verse 9 सुहृन्मित्रार्युदासीनमध्यस्थद्वेष्यबन्धुषु।

साधुष्वपि च पापेषु समबुद्धिर्विशिष्यते।।6.9।। suhṛin-mitrāryudāsīna-madhyastha-dveṣhya-bandhuṣhu
sādhuṣhvapi cha pāpeṣhu sama-buddhir viśhiṣhyate he who is of the same mind towards the good-hearted, friends, enemies, the indifferent, the neutral, the hateful, the relatives, the righteous, and the unrighteous, excels.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.1
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, "O Arjuna, hear how you shall, without doubt, know Me fully, with your mind intent on Me, practicing Yoga and taking refuge in Me."
documents.searchText: bg.7.1 bg.7.1 chapter 7 verse 1 शर भगवनवच मययसकतमन परथ यग यञजनमदशरय असशय समगर म यथ जञसयस तचछण 7.1 shri bhagavan uvacha mayyasakta-manah partha yogam yunjan mad-ashrayah asanshayam samagram mam yatha jnasyasi tach chhrinu the blessed lord said o arjuna hear how you shall without doubt know me fully with your mind intent on me practicing yoga and taking refuge in me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.1 bg.7.1 chapter 7 verse 1 श्री भगवानुवाच

मय्यासक्तमनाः पार्थ योगं युञ्जन्मदाश्रयः।

असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु।।7.1।। śhrī bhagavān uvācha
mayyāsakta-manāḥ pārtha yogaṁ yuñjan mad-āśhrayaḥ
asanśhayaṁ samagraṁ māṁ yathā jñāsyasi tach chhṛiṇu the blessed lord said, "o arjuna, hear how you shall, without doubt, know me fully, with your mind intent on me, practicing yoga and taking refuge in me."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.10
documents.iast: bījaṁ māṁ sarva-bhūtānāṁ viddhi pārtha sanātanam
documents.sanskrit: बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम्।
documents.summary: Know Me, O Arjuna, as the eternal seed of all beings; I am the intelligence of the intelligent, and the splendour of the splendid objects.
documents.searchText: bg.7.10 bg.7.10 chapter 7 verse 10 बज म सरवभतन वदध परथ सनतनम बदधरबदधमतमसम तजसतजसवनमहम 7.10 bijam mam sarva-bhutanam viddhi partha sanatanam buddhir buddhimatam asmi tejas tejasvinam aham know me o arjuna as the eternal seed of all beings i am the intelligence of the intelligent and the splendour of the splendid objects.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.10 bg.7.10 chapter 7 verse 10 बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम्।

बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम्।।7.10।। bījaṁ māṁ sarva-bhūtānāṁ viddhi pārtha sanātanam
buddhir buddhimatām asmi tejas tejasvinām aham know me, o arjuna, as the eternal seed of all beings; i am the intelligence of the intelligent, and the splendour of the splendid objects.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.11
documents.summary: Of the strong, I am the strength devoid of desire and attachment, and in all beings, I am the desire in accordance with Dharma, O Arjuna.
documents.searchText: bg.7.11 bg.7.11 chapter 7 verse 11 बल बलवत चह कमरगववरजतम धरमवरदध भतष कमऽसम भरतरषभ 7.11 balam balavatam chaham kama-raga-vivarjitam dharmaviruddho bhuteshu kamo smi bharatarshabha of the strong i am the strength devoid of desire and attachment and in all beings i am the desire in accordance with dharma o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.11 bg.7.11 chapter 7 verse 11 बलं बलवतां चाहं कामरागविवर्जितम्।

धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामोऽस्मि भरतर्षभ।।7.11।। balaṁ balavatāṁ chāhaṁ kāma-rāga-vivarjitam
dharmāviruddho bhūteṣhu kāmo ’smi bharatarṣhabha of the strong, i am the strength devoid of desire and attachment, and in all beings, i am the desire in accordance with dharma, o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.12
documents.iast: ye chaiva sāttvikā bhāvā rājasās tāmasāśh cha ye
documents.sanskrit: ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये।
documents.summary: Whatever beings (and objects) that are pure, active, and inert, know that they proceed from Me. They are in Me, yet I am not in them.
documents.searchText: bg.7.12 bg.7.12 chapter 7 verse 12 य चव सततवक भव रजससतमसशच य मतत एवत तनवदध नतवह तष त मय 7.12 ye chaiva sattvika bhava rajasas tamasash cha ye matta eveti tan viddhi na tvaham teshu te mayi whatever beings and objects that are pure active and inert know that they proceed from me. they are in me yet i am not in them.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.12 bg.7.12 chapter 7 verse 12 ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये।

मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि नत्वहं तेषु ते मयि।।7.12।। ye chaiva sāttvikā bhāvā rājasās tāmasāśh cha ye
matta eveti tān viddhi na tvahaṁ teṣhu te mayi whatever beings (and objects) that are pure, active, and inert, know that they proceed from me. they are in me, yet i am not in them.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.13
documents.iast: tribhir guṇa-mayair bhāvair ebhiḥ sarvam idaṁ jagat
documents.summary: Deluded by these Natures, composed of the three qualities of Nature, all this world does not know Me as distinct from them and immutable.
documents.searchText: bg.7.13 bg.7.13 chapter 7 verse 13 तरभरगणमयरभवरभ सरवमद जगत महत नभजनत ममभय परमवययम 7.13 tribhir guna-mayair bhavair ebhih sarvam idam jagat mohitam nabhijanati mamebhyah param avyayam deluded by these natures composed of the three qualities of nature all this world does not know me as distinct from them and immutable.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.13 bg.7.13 chapter 7 verse 13 त्रिभिर्गुणमयैर्भावैरेभिः सर्वमिदं जगत्।

मोहितं नाभिजानाति मामेभ्यः परमव्ययम्।।7.13।। tribhir guṇa-mayair bhāvair ebhiḥ sarvam idaṁ jagat
mohitaṁ nābhijānāti māmebhyaḥ param avyayam deluded by these natures, composed of the three qualities of nature, all this world does not know me as distinct from them and immutable.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.14
documents.iast: daivī hyeṣhā guṇa-mayī mama māyā duratyayā
documents.sanskrit: दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया।
documents.summary: Verily, this divine illusion of Mine, composed of the three qualities, is difficult to cross over; those who take refuge in Me alone, can cross over this illusion.
documents.searchText: bg.7.14 bg.7.14 chapter 7 verse 14 दव हयष गणमय मम मय दरतयय ममव य परपदयनत मयमत तरनत त 7.14 daivi hyesha guna-mayi mama maya duratyaya mam eva ye prapadyante mayam etam taranti te verily this divine illusion of mine composed of the three qualities is difficult to cross over those who take refuge in me alone can cross over this illusion.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.14 bg.7.14 chapter 7 verse 14 दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया।

मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते।।7.14।। daivī hyeṣhā guṇa-mayī mama māyā duratyayā
mām eva ye prapadyante māyām etāṁ taranti te verily, this divine illusion of mine, composed of the three qualities, is difficult to cross over; those who take refuge in me alone, can cross over this illusion.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.15
documents.iast: na māṁ duṣhkṛitino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ
documents.sanskrit: न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः।
documents.summary: The evil-doers and the deluded, who are the lowest of men, do not seek Me; those whose knowledge is destroyed by illusion follow the ways of demons.
documents.searchText: bg.7.15 bg.7.15 chapter 7 verse 15 न म दषकतन मढ परपदयनत नरधम मययपहतजञन आसर भवमशरत 7.15 na mam dushkritino mudhah prapadyante naradhamah mayayapahrita-jnana asuram bhavam ashritah the evil-doers and the deluded who are the lowest of men do not seek me those whose knowledge is destroyed by illusion follow the ways of demons.
documents.searchTextRaw:
