bg.7.15 bg.7.15 chapter 7 verse 15 न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः।

माययापहृतज्ञाना आसुरं भावमाश्रिताः।।7.15।। na māṁ duṣhkṛitino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ
māyayāpahṛita-jñānā āsuraṁ bhāvam āśhritāḥ the evil-doers and the deluded, who are the lowest of men, do not seek me; those whose knowledge is destroyed by illusion follow the ways of demons.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.16
documents.summary: Four kinds of virtuous men worship Me, O Arjuna, and they are the distressed, the seekers of knowledge, the seekers of wealth, and the wise, O Lord of the Bharatas.
documents.searchText: bg.7.16 bg.7.16 chapter 7 verse 16 चतरवध भजनत म जन सकतनऽरजन आरत जजञसररथरथ जञन च भरतरषभ 7.16 chatur-vidha bhajante mam janah sukritino rjuna arto jijnasur artharthi jnani cha bharatarshabha four kinds of virtuous men worship me o arjuna and they are the distressed the seekers of knowledge the seekers of wealth and the wise o lord of the bharatas.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.16 bg.7.16 chapter 7 verse 16 चतुर्विधा भजन्ते मां जनाः सुकृतिनोऽर्जुन।

आर्तो जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च भरतर्षभ।।7.16।। chatur-vidhā bhajante māṁ janāḥ sukṛitino ’rjuna
ārto jijñāsur arthārthī jñānī cha bharatarṣhabha four kinds of virtuous men worship me, o arjuna, and they are the distressed, the seekers of knowledge, the seekers of wealth, and the wise, o lord of the bharatas.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.17
documents.summary: Of them, the wise who are ever steadfast and devoted to the One, excel; for I am exceedingly dear to the wise, and they are dear to Me.
documents.searchText: bg.7.17 bg.7.17 chapter 7 verse 17 तष जञन नतययकत एकभकतरवशषयत परय ह जञननऽतयरथमह स च मम परय 7.17 tesham jnani nitya-yukta eka-bhaktir vishishyate priyo hi jnanino tyartham aham sa cha mama priyah of them the wise who are ever steadfast and devoted to the one excel for i am exceedingly dear to the wise and they are dear to me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.17 bg.7.17 chapter 7 verse 17 तेषां ज्ञानी नित्ययुक्त एकभक्तिर्विशिष्यते।

प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः।।7.17।। teṣhāṁ jñānī nitya-yukta eka-bhaktir viśhiṣhyate
priyo hi jñānino ’tyartham ahaṁ sa cha mama priyaḥ of them, the wise who are ever steadfast and devoted to the one, excel; for i am exceedingly dear to the wise, and they are dear to me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.18
documents.iast: udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me matam
documents.sanskrit: उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम्।
documents.summary: Indeed, all these are noble; however, I consider the wise man as My very Self; for, he is steadfast in mind and established in Me alone as the supreme goal.
documents.searchText: bg.7.18 bg.7.18 chapter 7 verse 18 उदर सरव एवत जञन तवतमव म मतम आसथत स ह यकततम ममवनततम गतम 7.18 udarah sarva evaite jnani tvatmaiva me matam asthitah sa hi yuktatma mam evanuttamam gatim indeed all these are noble however i consider the wise man as my very self for he is steadfast in mind and established in me alone as the supreme goal.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.18 bg.7.18 chapter 7 verse 18 उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम्।

आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम्।।7.18।। udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me matam
āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā mām evānuttamāṁ gatim indeed, all these are noble; however, i consider the wise man as my very self; for, he is steadfast in mind and established in me alone as the supreme goal.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.19
documents.iast: bahūnāṁ janmanām ante jñānavān māṁ prapadyate
documents.summary: At the end of many births, the wise man comes to Me, realizing that all this is Vaasudeva (the innermost Self); such a great soul (Mahatma) is very hard to find.
documents.searchText: bg.7.19 bg.7.19 chapter 7 verse 19 बहन जनमनमनत जञनवनम परपदयत वसदव सरवमत स महतम सदरलभ 7.19 bahunam janmanam ante jnanavan mam prapadyate vasudevah sarvam iti sa mahatma su-durlabhah at the end of many births the wise man comes to me realizing that all this is vaasudeva the innermost self such a great soul mahatma is very hard to find.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.19 bg.7.19 chapter 7 verse 19 बहूनां जन्मनामन्ते ज्ञानवान्मां प्रपद्यते।

वासुदेवः सर्वमिति स महात्मा सुदुर्लभः।।7.19।। bahūnāṁ janmanām ante jñānavān māṁ prapadyate
vāsudevaḥ sarvam iti sa mahātmā su-durlabhaḥ at the end of many births, the wise man comes to me, realizing that all this is vaasudeva (the innermost self); such a great soul (mahatma) is very hard to find.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.2
documents.summary: I will declare to you in full this knowledge combined with realization, after knowing which nothing else remains to be known here.
documents.searchText: bg.7.2 bg.7.2 chapter 7 verse 2 जञन तऽह सवजञनमद वकषयमयशषत यजजञतव नह भयऽनयजजञतवयमवशषयत 7.2 jnanam te ham sa-vijnanam idam vakshyamyasheshatah yaj jnatva neha bhuyo nyaj jnatavyam-avashishyate i will declare to you in full this knowledge combined with realization after knowing which nothing else remains to be known here.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.2 bg.7.2 chapter 7 verse 2 ज्ञानं तेऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः।

यज्ज्ञात्वा नेह भूयोऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते।।7.2।। jñānaṁ te ’haṁ sa-vijñānam idaṁ vakṣhyāmyaśheṣhataḥ
yaj jñātvā neha bhūyo ’nyaj jñātavyam-avaśhiṣhyate i will declare to you in full this knowledge combined with realization, after knowing which nothing else remains to be known here.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.20
documents.summary: Those whose wisdom has been taken away by this or that desire, go to other gods, following this or that rite, led by their own nature.
documents.searchText: bg.7.20 bg.7.20 chapter 7 verse 20 कमसतसतरहतजञन परपदयनतऽनयदवत त त नयममसथय परकतय नयत सवय 7.20 kamais tais tair hrita-jnanah prapadyante nya-devatah tam tam niyamam asthaya prakritya niyatah svaya those whose wisdom has been taken away by this or that desire go to other gods following this or that rite led by their own nature.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.20 bg.7.20 chapter 7 verse 20 कामैस्तैस्तैर्हृतज्ञानाः प्रपद्यन्तेऽन्यदेवताः।

तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया।।7.20।। kāmais tais tair hṛita-jñānāḥ prapadyante ’nya-devatāḥ
taṁ taṁ niyamam āsthāya prakṛityā niyatāḥ svayā those whose wisdom has been taken away by this or that desire, go to other gods, following this or that rite, led by their own nature.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.21
documents.iast: yo yo yāṁ yāṁ tanuṁ bhaktaḥ śhraddhayārchitum ichchhati
documents.sanskrit: यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति।
documents.summary: Whatever form any devotee desires to worship with faith, I make that same faith of his firm and unflinching.
documents.searchText: bg.7.21 bg.7.21 chapter 7 verse 21 य य य य तन भकत शरदधयरचतमचछत तसय तसयचल शरदध तमव वदधमयहम 7.21 yo yo yam yam tanum bhaktah shraddhayarchitum ichchhati tasya tasyachalam shraddham tam eva vidadhamyaham whatever form any devotee desires to worship with faith i make that same faith of his firm and unflinching.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.21 bg.7.21 chapter 7 verse 21 यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति।

तस्य तस्याचलां श्रद्धां तामेव विदधाम्यहम्।।7.21।। yo yo yāṁ yāṁ tanuṁ bhaktaḥ śhraddhayārchitum ichchhati
tasya tasyāchalāṁ śhraddhāṁ tām eva vidadhāmyaham whatever form any devotee desires to worship with faith, i make that same faith of his firm and unflinching.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.22
documents.iast: sa tayā śhraddhayā yuktas tasyārādhanam īhate
documents.summary: Endowed with that faith, he engages in the worship of that form and obtains his desired outcome, which is ordained by Me alone.
documents.searchText: bg.7.22 bg.7.22 chapter 7 verse 22 स तय शरदधय यकतसतसयरधनमहत लभत च तत कमनमयव वहतन ह तन 7.22 sa taya shraddhaya yuktas tasyaradhanam ihate labhate cha tatah kaman mayaiva vihitan hi tan endowed with that faith he engages in the worship of that form and obtains his desired outcome which is ordained by me alone.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.22 bg.7.22 chapter 7 verse 22 स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते।

लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान् हि तान्।।7.22।। sa tayā śhraddhayā yuktas tasyārādhanam īhate
labhate cha tataḥ kāmān mayaiva vihitān hi tān endowed with that faith, he engages in the worship of that form and obtains his desired outcome, which is ordained by me alone.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.23
documents.iast: antavat tu phalaṁ teṣhāṁ tad bhavatyalpa-medhasām
documents.summary: Verily, the reward (fruit) that accrues to those men of small intelligence is finite. The worshippers of the gods go to them, whereas My devotees come to Me.
documents.searchText: bg.7.23 bg.7.23 chapter 7 verse 23 अनतवतत फल तष तदभवतयलपमधसम दवनदवयज यनत मदभकत यनत ममप 7.23 antavat tu phalam tesham tad bhavatyalpa-medhasam devan deva-yajo yanti mad-bhakta yanti mam api verily the reward fruit that accrues to those men of small intelligence is finite. the worshippers of the gods go to them whereas my devotees come to me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.23 bg.7.23 chapter 7 verse 23 अन्तवत्तु फलं तेषां तद्भवत्यल्पमेधसाम्।

देवान्देवयजो यान्ति मद्भक्ता यान्ति मामपि।।7.23।। antavat tu phalaṁ teṣhāṁ tad bhavatyalpa-medhasām
devān deva-yajo yānti mad-bhaktā yānti mām api verily, the reward (fruit) that accrues to those men of small intelligence is finite. the worshippers of the gods go to them, whereas my devotees come to me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.24
documents.iast: avyaktaṁ vyaktim āpannaṁ manyante mām abuddhayaḥ
documents.summary: The foolish think of Me, the Unmanifest, as having manifestation, not knowing My higher, immutable, and most excellent nature.
documents.searchText: bg.7.24 bg.7.24 chapter 7 verse 24 अवयकत वयकतमपनन मनयनत ममबदधय पर भवमजननत ममवययमनततमम 7.24 avyaktam vyaktim apannam manyante mam abuddhayah param bhavam ajananto mamavyayam anuttamam the foolish think of me the unmanifest as having manifestation not knowing my higher immutable and most excellent nature.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.24 bg.7.24 chapter 7 verse 24 अव्यक्तं व्यक्तिमापन्नं मन्यन्ते मामबुद्धयः।

परं भावमजानन्तो ममाव्ययमनुत्तमम्।।7.24।। avyaktaṁ vyaktim āpannaṁ manyante mām abuddhayaḥ
paraṁ bhāvam ajānanto mamāvyayam anuttamam the foolish think of me, the unmanifest, as having manifestation, not knowing my higher, immutable, and most excellent nature.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.25
documents.summary: I am not manifest to all, veiled as I am by the Yoga-Maya. This deluded world does not know Me, who am unborn and imperishable.
documents.searchText: bg.7.25 bg.7.25 chapter 7 verse 25 नह परकश सरवसय यगमयसमवत मढऽय नभजनत लक ममजमवययम 7.25 naham prakashah sarvasya yoga-maya-samavritah mudho yam nabhijanati loko mam ajam avyayam i am not manifest to all veiled as i am by the yoga-maya. this deluded world does not know me who am unborn and imperishable.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.25 bg.7.25 chapter 7 verse 25 नाहं प्रकाशः सर्वस्य योगमायासमावृतः।

मूढोऽयं नाभिजानाति लोको मामजमव्ययम्।।7.25।। nāhaṁ prakāśhaḥ sarvasya yoga-māyā-samāvṛitaḥ
mūḍho ’yaṁ nābhijānāti loko mām ajam avyayam i am not manifest to all, veiled as i am by the yoga-maya. this deluded world does not know me, who am unborn and imperishable.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.26
documents.summary: I know, O Arjuna, the beings of the past, the present, and the future; however, no one knows Me.
documents.searchText: bg.7.26 bg.7.26 chapter 7 verse 26 वदह समततन वरतमनन चरजन भवषयण च भतन म त वद न कशचन 7.26 vedaham samatitani vartamanani charjuna bhavishyani cha bhutani mam tu veda na kashchana i know o arjuna the beings of the past the present and the future however no one knows me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.26 bg.7.26 chapter 7 verse 26 वेदाहं समतीतानि वर्तमानानि चार्जुन।

भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन।।7.26।। vedāhaṁ samatītāni vartamānāni chārjuna
bhaviṣhyāṇi cha bhūtāni māṁ tu veda na kaśhchana i know, o arjuna, the beings of the past, the present, and the future; however, no one knows me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.27
documents.summary: O Bharata, all beings are subject to delusion at birth due to the delusion of the pairs of opposites arising from desire and aversion, O Parantapa.
documents.searchText: bg.7.27 bg.7.27 chapter 7 verse 27 इचछदवषसमतथन दवनदवमहन भरत सरवभतन समह सरग यनत परनतप 7.27 ichchha-dvesha-samutthena dvandva-mohena bharata sarva-bhutani sammoham sarge yanti parantapa o bharata all beings are subject to delusion at birth due to the delusion of the pairs of opposites arising from desire and aversion o parantapa.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.27 bg.7.27 chapter 7 verse 27 इच्छाद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन भारत।

सर्वभूतानि संमोहं सर्गे यान्ति परन्तप।।7.27।। ichchhā-dveṣha-samutthena dvandva-mohena bhārata
sarva-bhūtāni sammohaṁ sarge yānti parantapa o bharata, all beings are subject to delusion at birth due to the delusion of the pairs of opposites arising from desire and aversion, o parantapa.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.28
documents.summary: But those men of virtuous deeds, whose sins have come to an end and who are freed from the delusion of the pairs of opposites, worship Me steadfastly, with their vows.
documents.searchText: bg.7.28 bg.7.28 chapter 7 verse 28 यष तवनतगत पप जनन पणयकरमणम त दवनदवमहनरमकत भजनत म दढवरत 7.28 yesham tvanta-gatam papam jananam punya-karmanam te dvandva-moha-nirmukta bhajante mam dridha-vratah but those men of virtuous deeds whose sins have come to an end and who are freed from the delusion of the pairs of opposites worship me steadfastly with their vows.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.28 bg.7.28 chapter 7 verse 28 येषां त्वन्तगतं पापं जनानां पुण्यकर्मणाम्।

ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मुक्ता भजन्ते मां दृढव्रताः।।7.28।। yeṣhāṁ tvanta-gataṁ pāpaṁ janānāṁ puṇya-karmaṇām
te dvandva-moha-nirmuktā bhajante māṁ dṛiḍha-vratāḥ but those men of virtuous deeds, whose sins have come to an end and who are freed from the delusion of the pairs of opposites, worship me steadfastly, with their vows.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.29
documents.summary: Those who strive for liberation from old age and death, taking refuge in Me, realize in full that Brahman, the whole knowledge of the Self, and all action.
documents.searchText: bg.7.29 bg.7.29 chapter 7 verse 29 जरमरणमकषय ममशरतय यतनत य त बरहम तदवद कतसनमधयतम करम चखलम 7.29 jara-marana-mokshaya mam ashritya yatanti ye te brahma tadviduh kritsnam adhyatmam karma chakhilam those who strive for liberation from old age and death taking refuge in me realize in full that brahman the whole knowledge of the self and all action.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.29 bg.7.29 chapter 7 verse 29 जरामरणमोक्षाय मामाश्रित्य यतन्ति ये।

ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम्।।7.29।। jarā-maraṇa-mokṣhāya mām āśhritya yatanti ye
te brahma tadviduḥ kṛitsnam adhyātmaṁ karma chākhilam those who strive for liberation from old age and death, taking refuge in me, realize in full that brahman, the whole knowledge of the self, and all action.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.3
documents.summary: Among thousands of men, one may perchance strive for perfection; even among those successful strivers, only one may perchance know Me in essence.
documents.searchText: bg.7.3 bg.7.3 chapter 7 verse 3 मनषयण सहसरष कशचदयतत सदधय यततमप सदधन कशचनम वतत तततवत 7.3 manushyanam sahasreshu kashchid yatati siddhaye yatatam api siddhanam kashchin mam vetti tattvatah among thousands of men one may perchance strive for perfection even among those successful strivers only one may perchance know me in essence.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.3 bg.7.3 chapter 7 verse 3 मनुष्याणां सहस्रेषु कश्चिद्यतति सिद्धये।

यततामपि सिद्धानां कश्चिन्मां वेत्ति तत्त्वतः।।7.3।। manuṣhyāṇāṁ sahasreṣhu kaśhchid yatati siddhaye
yatatām api siddhānāṁ kaśhchin māṁ vetti tattvataḥ among thousands of men, one may perchance strive for perfection; even among those successful strivers, only one may perchance know me in essence.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.30
documents.iast: sādhibhūtādhidaivaṁ māṁ sādhiyajñaṁ cha ye viduḥ
documents.sanskrit: साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः।
documents.summary: Those who know Me with the Adhibhuta (pertaining to the elements), Adhidaiva (pertaining to the gods), and the Adhiyajna (pertaining to the sacrifice) know Me even at the time of d
documents.searchText: bg.7.30 bg.7.30 chapter 7 verse 30 सधभतधदव म सधयजञ च य वद परयणकलऽप च म त वदरयकतचतस 7.30 sadhibhutadhidaivam mam sadhiyajnam cha ye viduh prayana-kale pi cha mam te vidur yukta-chetasah those who know me with the adhibhuta pertaining to the elements adhidaiva pertaining to the gods and the adhiyajna pertaining to the sacrifice know me even at the time of death remaining steadfast in mind.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.30 bg.7.30 chapter 7 verse 30 साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः।

प्रयाणकालेऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः।।7.30।। sādhibhūtādhidaivaṁ māṁ sādhiyajñaṁ cha ye viduḥ
prayāṇa-kāle ’pi cha māṁ te vidur yukta-chetasaḥ those who know me with the adhibhuta (pertaining to the elements), adhidaiva (pertaining to the gods), and the adhiyajna (pertaining to the sacrifice) know me even at the time of death, remaining steadfast in mind.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.4
documents.iast: bhūmir-āpo ’nalo vāyuḥ khaṁ mano buddhir eva cha
documents.sanskrit: भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च।
documents.summary: Earth, water, fire, air, ether, mind, intellect, and egoism—thus is My Nature divided eightfold.
documents.searchText: bg.7.4 bg.7.4 chapter 7 verse 4 भमरपऽनल वय ख मन बदधरव च अहङकर इतय म भनन परकतरषटध 7.4 bhumir-apo nalo vayuh kham mano buddhir eva cha ahankara itiyam me bhinna prakritir ashtadha earth water fire air ether mind intellect and egoism thus is my nature divided eightfold.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.4 bg.7.4 chapter 7 verse 4 भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च।

अहङ्कार इतीयं मे भिन्ना प्रकृतिरष्टधा।।7.4।। bhūmir-āpo ’nalo vāyuḥ khaṁ mano buddhir eva cha
ahankāra itīyaṁ me bhinnā prakṛitir aṣhṭadhā earth, water, fire, air, ether, mind, intellect, and egoism—thus is my nature divided eightfold.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.5
documents.iast: apareyam itas tvanyāṁ prakṛitiṁ viddhi me parām
documents.summary: O mighty-armed Arjuna, this is the inferior Prakriti; know it as distinct from My higher Prakriti, the very life-element, by which this world is upheld.
documents.searchText: bg.7.5 bg.7.5 chapter 7 verse 5 अपरयमतसतवनय परकत वदध म परम जवभत महबह ययद धरयत जगत 7.5 apareyam itas tvanyam prakritim viddhi me param jiva-bhutam maha-baho yayedam dharyate jagat o mighty-armed arjuna this is the inferior prakriti know it as distinct from my higher prakriti the very life-element by which this world is upheld.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.5 bg.7.5 chapter 7 verse 5 अपरेयमितस्त्वन्यां प्रकृतिं विद्धि मे पराम्।

जीवभूतां महाबाहो ययेदं धार्यते जगत्।।7.5।। apareyam itas tvanyāṁ prakṛitiṁ viddhi me parām
jīva-bhūtāṁ mahā-bāho yayedaṁ dhāryate jagat o mighty-armed arjuna, this is the inferior prakriti; know it as distinct from my higher prakriti, the very life-element, by which this world is upheld.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.6
documents.summary: Know that these two are the womb of all beings; thus, I am the source and dissolution of the whole universe.
documents.searchText: bg.7.6 bg.7.6 chapter 7 verse 6 एतदयनन भतन सरवणतयपधरय अह कतसनसय जगत परभव परलयसतथ 7.6 etad-yonini bhutani sarvanityupadharaya aham kritsnasya jagatah prabhavah pralayas tatha know that these two are the womb of all beings thus i am the source and dissolution of the whole universe.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.6 bg.7.6 chapter 7 verse 6 एतद्योनीनि भूतानि सर्वाणीत्युपधारय।

अहं कृत्स्नस्य जगतः प्रभवः प्रलयस्तथा।।7.6।। etad-yonīni bhūtāni sarvāṇītyupadhāraya
ahaṁ kṛitsnasya jagataḥ prabhavaḥ pralayas tathā know that these two are the womb of all beings; thus, i am the source and dissolution of the whole universe.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.7
documents.iast: mattaḥ parataraṁ nānyat kiñchid asti dhanañjaya
documents.summary: There is nothing higher than Me, O Arjuna. All this is strung on Me, like clusters of gems on a string.
documents.searchText: bg.7.7 bg.7.7 chapter 7 verse 7 मतत परतर ननयतकञचदसत धनञजय मय सरवमद परत सतर मणगण इव 7.7 mattah parataram nanyat kinchid asti dhananjaya mayi sarvam idam protam sutre mani-gana iva there is nothing higher than me o arjuna. all this is strung on me like clusters of gems on a string.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.7 bg.7.7 chapter 7 verse 7 मत्तः परतरं नान्यत्किञ्चिदस्ति धनञ्जय।

मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव।।7.7।। mattaḥ parataraṁ nānyat kiñchid asti dhanañjaya
mayi sarvam idaṁ protaṁ sūtre maṇi-gaṇā iva there is nothing higher than me, o arjuna. all this is strung on me, like clusters of gems on a string.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.8
documents.summary: I am the flavor in water, O Arjuna; I am the light in the moon and the sun; I am the syllable Om in all the Vedas, sound in the ether and virility in men.
documents.searchText: bg.7.8 bg.7.8 chapter 7 verse 8 रसऽहमपस कनतय परभसम शशसरयय परणव सरववदष शबद ख परष नष 7.8 raso ham apsu kaunteya prabhasmi shashi-suryayoh pranavah sarva-vedeshu shabdah khe paurusham nrishu i am the flavor in water o arjuna i am the light in the moon and the sun i am the syllable om in all the vedas sound in the ether and virility in men.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.8 bg.7.8 chapter 7 verse 8 रसोऽहमप्सु कौन्तेय प्रभास्मि शशिसूर्ययोः।

प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु।।7.8।। raso ’ham apsu kaunteya prabhāsmi śhaśhi-sūryayoḥ
praṇavaḥ sarva-vedeṣhu śhabdaḥ khe pauruṣhaṁ nṛiṣhu i am the flavor in water, o arjuna; i am the light in the moon and the sun; i am the syllable om in all the vedas, sound in the ether and virility in men.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 7.9
documents.iast: puṇyo gandhaḥ pṛithivyāṁ cha tejaśh chāsmi vibhāvasau
documents.sanskrit: पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ।
documents.summary: I am the sweet fragrance in the earth and the brilliance in the fire, the life in all beings, and I am the austerity of ascetics.
documents.searchText: bg.7.9 bg.7.9 chapter 7 verse 9 पणय गनध पथवय च तजशचसम वभवस जवन सरवभतष तपशचसम तपसवष 7.9 punyo gandhah prithivyam cha tejash chasmi vibhavasau jivanam sarva-bhuteshu tapash chasmi tapasvishu i am the sweet fragrance in the earth and the brilliance in the fire the life in all beings and i am the austerity of ascetics.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.7.9 bg.7.9 chapter 7 verse 9 पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ।

जीवनं सर्वभूतेषु तपश्चास्मि तपस्विषु।।7.9।। puṇyo gandhaḥ pṛithivyāṁ cha tejaśh chāsmi vibhāvasau
jīvanaṁ sarva-bhūteṣhu tapaśh chāsmi tapasviṣhu i am the sweet fragrance in the earth and the brilliance in the fire, the life in all beings, and i am the austerity of ascetics.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.1
documents.summary: Arjuna said, "What is Brahman? What is Adhyatma? What is action, O best among men? What is Adhibhuta declared to be? And, what is Adhidaiva said to be?"
documents.searchText: bg.8.1 bg.8.1 chapter 8 verse 1 अरजन उवच क तदबरहम कमधयतम क करम परषततम अधभत च क परकतमधदव कमचयत 8.1 arjuna uvacha kim tad brahma kim adhyatmam kim karma purushottama adhibhutam cha kim proktam adhidaivam kim uchyate arjuna said what is brahman what is adhyatma what is action o best among men what is adhibhuta declared to be and what is adhidaiva said to be
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.1 bg.8.1 chapter 8 verse 1 अर्जुन उवाच

किं तद्ब्रह्म किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम।

अधिभूतं च किं प्रोक्तमधिदैवं किमुच्यते।।8.1।। arjuna uvācha
kiṁ tad brahma kim adhyātmaṁ kiṁ karma puruṣhottama
adhibhūtaṁ cha kiṁ proktam adhidaivaṁ kim uchyate arjuna said, "what is brahman? what is adhyatma? what is action, o best among men? what is adhibhuta declared to be? and, what is adhidaiva said to be?"

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.10
documents.summary: At the time of death, with an unwavering mind, endowed with devotion, by the power of Yoga, fixing the whole life-breath in the middle of the two eyebrows, he reaches that resplend
documents.searchText: bg.8.10 bg.8.10 chapter 8 verse 10 परयणकल मनसऽचलन भकतय यकत यगबलन चव भरवरमधय परणमवशय समयक स त पर परषमपत दवयम 8.10 prayana-kale manasachalena bhaktya yukto yoga-balena chaiva bhruvor madhye pranam aveshya samyak sa tam param purusham upaiti divyam at the time of death with an unwavering mind endowed with devotion by the power of yoga fixing the whole life-breath in the middle of the two eyebrows he reaches that resplendent supreme person.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.10 bg.8.10 chapter 8 verse 10 प्रयाणकाले मनसाऽचलेन

भक्त्या युक्तो योगबलेन चैव।

भ्रुवोर्मध्ये प्राणमावेश्य सम्यक्

स तं परं पुरुषमुपैति दिव्यम्।।8.10।। prayāṇa-kāle manasāchalena
bhaktyā yukto yoga-balena chaiva
bhruvor madhye prāṇam āveśhya samyak
sa taṁ paraṁ puruṣham upaiti divyam at the time of death, with an unwavering mind, endowed with devotion, by the power of yoga, fixing the whole life-breath in the middle of the two eyebrows, he reaches that resplendent supreme person.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.11
documents.summary: That which is declared to be Imperishable by those who know the Vedas, that which the self-controlled (ascetics or Sannyasins) and passion-free enter, that goal, desiring which cel
documents.searchText: bg.8.11 bg.8.11 chapter 8 verse 11 यदकषर वदवद वदनत वशनत यदयतय वतरग यदचछनत बरहमचरय चरनत ततत पद सगरहण परवकषय 8.11 yad aksharam veda-vido vadanti vishanti yad yatayo vita-ragah yad ichchhanto brahmacharyam charanti tat te padam sangrahena pravakshye that which is declared to be imperishable by those who know the vedas that which the self-controlled ascetics or sannyasins and passion-free enter that goal desiring which celibacy is practised i will declare to thee in brief.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.11 bg.8.11 chapter 8 verse 11 यदक्षरं वेदविदो वदन्ति

विशन्ति यद्यतयो वीतरागाः।

यदिच्छन्तो ब्रह्मचर्यं चरन्ति

तत्ते पदं संग्रहेण प्रवक्ष्ये।।8.11।। yad akṣharaṁ veda-vido vadanti
viśhanti yad yatayo vīta-rāgāḥ
yad ichchhanto brahmacharyaṁ charanti
tat te padaṁ saṅgraheṇa pravakṣhye that which is declared to be imperishable by those who know the vedas, that which the self-controlled (ascetics or sannyasins) and passion-free enter, that goal, desiring which celibacy is practised, i will declare to thee in brief.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.12
documents.iast: sarva-dvārāṇi sanyamya mano hṛidi nirudhya cha
documents.sanskrit: सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुध्य च।
documents.summary: Having closed all the gates, confined the mind in the heart, and fixed the life-breath in the head, engage in the practice of concentration.
documents.searchText: bg.8.12 bg.8.12 chapter 8 verse 12 सरवदवरण सयमय मन हद नरधय च मरधनयधयतमन परणमसथत यगधरणम 8.12 sarva-dvarani sanyamya mano hridi nirudhya cha murdhnyadhayatmanah pranam asthito yoga-dharanam having closed all the gates confined the mind in the heart and fixed the life-breath in the head engage in the practice of concentration.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.12 bg.8.12 chapter 8 verse 12 सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुध्य च।

मूर्ध्न्याधायात्मनः प्राणमास्थितो योगधारणाम्।।8.12।। sarva-dvārāṇi sanyamya mano hṛidi nirudhya cha
mūrdhnyādhāyātmanaḥ prāṇam āsthito yoga-dhāraṇām having closed all the gates, confined the mind in the heart, and fixed the life-breath in the head, engage in the practice of concentration.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.13
documents.iast: oṁ ityekākṣharaṁ brahma vyāharan mām anusmaran
documents.summary: Uttering the one-syllabled Om, the Brahman, and remembering Me, he who departs, leaving the body, attains the Supreme Goal.
documents.searchText: bg.8.13 bg.8.13 chapter 8 verse 13 ओमतयककषर बरहम वयहरनममनसमरन य परयत तयजनदह स यत परम गतम 8.13 om ityekaksharam brahma vyaharan mam anusmaran yah prayati tyajan deham sa yati paramam gatim uttering the one-syllabled om the brahman and remembering me he who departs leaving the body attains the supreme goal.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.13 bg.8.13 chapter 8 verse 13 ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म व्याहरन्मामनुस्मरन्।

यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम्।।8.13।। oṁ ityekākṣharaṁ brahma vyāharan mām anusmaran
yaḥ prayāti tyajan dehaṁ sa yāti paramāṁ gatim uttering the one-syllabled om, the brahman, and remembering me, he who departs, leaving the body, attains the supreme goal.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.14
documents.iast: ananya-chetāḥ satataṁ yo māṁ smarati nityaśhaḥ
documents.sanskrit: अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः।
documents.summary: I am easily attainable by that ever-steadfast yogi who constantly and daily remembers me for a long time, not thinking of anything else with a single-minded or one-pointed focus, O
documents.searchText: bg.8.14 bg.8.14 chapter 8 verse 14 अननयचत सतत य म समरत नतयश तसयह सलभ परथ नतययकतसय यगन 8.14 ananya-chetah satatam yo mam smarati nityashah tasyaham sulabhah partha nitya-yuktasya yoginah i am easily attainable by that ever-steadfast yogi who constantly and daily remembers me for a long time not thinking of anything else with a single-minded or one-pointed focus o partha.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.14 bg.8.14 chapter 8 verse 14 अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः।

तस्याहं सुलभः पार्थ नित्ययुक्तस्य योगिनः।।8.14।। ananya-chetāḥ satataṁ yo māṁ smarati nityaśhaḥ
tasyāhaṁ sulabhaḥ pārtha nitya-yuktasya yoginaḥ i am easily attainable by that ever-steadfast yogi who constantly and daily remembers me for a long time, not thinking of anything else with a single-minded or one-pointed focus, o partha.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.15
documents.iast: mām upetya punar janma duḥkhālayam aśhāśhvatam
documents.summary: Having attained Me, these great souls do not take birth again here—a place of pain and impermanence—but have reached the highest perfection of liberation.
documents.searchText: bg.8.15 bg.8.15 chapter 8 verse 15 ममपतय पनरजनम दखलयमशशवतम नपनवनत महतमन ससदध परम गत 8.15 mam upetya punar janma duhkhalayam ashashvatam napnuvanti mahatmanah sansiddhim paramam gatah having attained me these great souls do not take birth again here a place of pain and impermanence but have reached the highest perfection of liberation.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.15 bg.8.15 chapter 8 verse 15 मामुपेत्य पुनर्जन्म दुःखालयमशाश्वतम्।

नाप्नुवन्ति महात्मानः संसिद्धिं परमां गताः।।8.15।। mām upetya punar janma duḥkhālayam aśhāśhvatam
nāpnuvanti mahātmānaḥ sansiddhiṁ paramāṁ gatāḥ having attained me, these great souls do not take birth again here—a place of pain and impermanence—but have reached the highest perfection of liberation.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.16
documents.summary: All the worlds, including the world of Brahma, are subject to return again, O Arjuna; but he who reaches Me, O son of Kunti, has no rebirth.
documents.searchText: bg.8.16 bg.8.16 chapter 8 verse 16 आबरहमभवनललक पनरवरतनऽरजन ममपतय त कनतय पनरजनम न वदयत 8.16 a-brahma-bhuvanal lokah punar avartino rjuna mam upetya tu kaunteya punar janma na vidyate all the worlds including the world of brahma are subject to return again o arjuna but he who reaches me o son of kunti has no rebirth.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.16 bg.8.16 chapter 8 verse 16 आब्रह्मभुवनाल्लोकाः पुनरावर्तिनोऽर्जुन।

मामुपेत्य तु कौन्तेय पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते।।8.16।। ā-brahma-bhuvanāl lokāḥ punar āvartino ’rjuna
mām upetya tu kaunteya punar janma na vidyate all the worlds, including the world of brahma, are subject to return again, o arjuna; but he who reaches me, o son of kunti, has no rebirth.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.17
documents.summary: Those who know the day of Brahma, which lasts a thousand Yugas, and the night, which also lasts a thousand Yugas, know day and night.
documents.searchText: bg.8.17 bg.8.17 chapter 8 verse 17 सहसरयगपरयनतमहरयदबरहमण वद रतर यगसहसरनत तऽहरतरवद जन 8.17 sahasra-yuga-paryantam ahar yad brahmano viduh ratrim yuga-sahasrantam te ho-ratra-vido janah those who know the day of brahma which lasts a thousand yugas and the night which also lasts a thousand yugas know day and night.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.17 bg.8.17 chapter 8 verse 17 सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तमहर्यद्ब्रह्मणो विदुः।

रात्रिं युगसहस्रान्तां तेऽहोरात्रविदो जनाः।।8.17।। sahasra-yuga-paryantam ahar yad brahmaṇo viduḥ
rātriṁ yuga-sahasrāntāṁ te ’ho-rātra-vido janāḥ those who know the day of brahma, which lasts a thousand yugas, and the night, which also lasts a thousand yugas, know day and night.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.18
documents.summary: From the Unmanifested, all the manifested worlds proceed upon the arrival of the 'day'; upon the arrival of the 'night', they dissolve indeed into that which is known as the Unmani
documents.searchText: bg.8.18 bg.8.18 chapter 8 verse 18 अवयकतदवयकतय सरव परभवनतयहरगम रतरयगम परलयनत ततरववयकतसजञक 8.18 avyaktad vyaktayah sarvah prabhavantyahar-agame ratryagame praliyante tatraivavyakta-sanjnake from the unmanifested all the manifested worlds proceed upon the arrival of the day upon the arrival of the night they dissolve indeed into that which is known as the unmanifested.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.18 bg.8.18 chapter 8 verse 18 अव्यक्ताद्व्यक्तयः सर्वाः प्रभवन्त्यहरागमे।

रात्र्यागमे प्रलीयन्ते तत्रैवाव्यक्तसंज्ञके।।8.18।। avyaktād vyaktayaḥ sarvāḥ prabhavantyahar-āgame
rātryāgame pralīyante tatraivāvyakta-sanjñake from the unmanifested, all the manifested worlds proceed upon the arrival of the 'day'; upon the arrival of the 'night', they dissolve indeed into that which is known as the unmanifested.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.19
documents.iast: bhūta-grāmaḥ sa evāyaṁ bhūtvā bhūtvā pralīyate
documents.sanskrit: भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते।
documents.summary: This same multitude of beings, being born again and again, helplessly dissolves, O Arjuna, into the Unmanifested at the coming of the night and comes forth at the coming of the day
documents.searchText: bg.8.19 bg.8.19 chapter 8 verse 19 भतगरम स एवय भतव भतव परलयत रतरयगमऽवश परथ परभवतयहरगम 8.19 bhuta-gramah sa evayam bhutva bhutva praliyate ratryagame vashah partha prabhavatyahar-agame this same multitude of beings being born again and again helplessly dissolves o arjuna into the unmanifested at the coming of the night and comes forth at the coming of the day.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.19 bg.8.19 chapter 8 verse 19 भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते।

रात्र्यागमेऽवशः पार्थ प्रभवत्यहरागमे।।8.19।। bhūta-grāmaḥ sa evāyaṁ bhūtvā bhūtvā pralīyate
rātryāgame ’vaśhaḥ pārtha prabhavatyahar-āgame this same multitude of beings, being born again and again, helplessly dissolves, o arjuna, into the unmanifested at the coming of the night and comes forth at the coming of the day.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.2
documents.summary: Who and how is Adhiyajna here in this body, O destroyer of Madhu? And how, at the time of death, are You to be known by the self-controlled?
documents.searchText: bg.8.2 bg.8.2 chapter 8 verse 2 अधयजञ कथ कऽतर दहऽसमनमधसदन परयणकल च कथ जञयऽस नयततमभ 8.2 adhiyajnah katham ko tra dehe smin madhusudana prayana-kale cha katham jneyo si niyatatmabhih who and how is adhiyajna here in this body o destroyer of madhu and how at the time of death are you to be known by the self-controlled
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.2 bg.8.2 chapter 8 verse 2 अधियज्ञः कथं कोऽत्र देहेऽस्मिन्मधुसूदन।

प्रयाणकाले च कथं ज्ञेयोऽसि नियतात्मभिः।।8.2।। adhiyajñaḥ kathaṁ ko ’tra dehe ’smin madhusūdana
prayāṇa-kāle cha kathaṁ jñeyo ’si niyatātmabhiḥ who and how is adhiyajna here in this body, o destroyer of madhu? and how, at the time of death, are you to be known by the self-controlled?

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.20
documents.summary: But verily, there exists higher than this Unmanifested, another Unmanifested Eternal, which is not destroyed even when all beings are destroyed.
documents.searchText: bg.8.20 bg.8.20 chapter 8 verse 20 परसतसमतत भवऽनयऽवयकतऽवयकततसनतन य स सरवष भतष नशयतस न वनशयत 8.20 paras tasmat tu bhavo nyo vyakto vyaktat sanatanah yah sa sarveshu bhuteshu nashyatsu na vinashyati but verily there exists higher than this unmanifested another unmanifested eternal which is not destroyed even when all beings are destroyed.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.20 bg.8.20 chapter 8 verse 20 परस्तस्मात्तु भावोऽन्योऽव्यक्तोऽव्यक्तात्सनातनः।

यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नश्यत्सु न विनश्यति।।8.20।। paras tasmāt tu bhāvo ’nyo ’vyakto ’vyaktāt sanātanaḥ
yaḥ sa sarveṣhu bhūteṣhu naśhyatsu na vinaśhyati but verily, there exists higher than this unmanifested, another unmanifested eternal, which is not destroyed even when all beings are destroyed.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.21
documents.iast: avyakto ’kṣhara ityuktas tam āhuḥ paramāṁ gatim
documents.summary: What is known as the Unmanifested and the Imperishable, That is said to be the highest goal. Those who reach It do not return (to this Samsara). That is My supreme abode (place or
documents.searchText: bg.8.21 bg.8.21 chapter 8 verse 21 अवयकतऽकषर इतयकतसतमह परम गतम य परपय न नवरतनत तदधम परम मम 8.21 avyakto kshara ityuktas tam ahuh paramam gatim yam prapya na nivartante tad dhama paramam mama what is known as the unmanifested and the imperishable that is said to be the highest goal. those who reach it do not return to this samsara . that is my supreme abode place or state .
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.21 bg.8.21 chapter 8 verse 21 अव्यक्तोऽक्षर इत्युक्तस्तमाहुः परमां गतिम्।

यं प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम।।8.21।। avyakto ’kṣhara ityuktas tam āhuḥ paramāṁ gatim
yaṁ prāpya na nivartante tad dhāma paramaṁ mama what is known as the unmanifested and the imperishable, that is said to be the highest goal. those who reach it do not return (to this samsara). that is my supreme abode (place or state).

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.22
documents.iast: puruṣhaḥ sa paraḥ pārtha bhaktyā labhyas tvananyayā
documents.sanskrit: पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया।
documents.summary: That highest Purusha, O Arjuna, is attainable by unswerving devotion to Him alone, within Whom all beings dwell and by Whom all this is pervaded.
documents.searchText: bg.8.22 bg.8.22 chapter 8 verse 22 परष स पर परथ भकतय लभयसतवननयय यसयनतसथन भतन यन सरवमद ततम 8.22 purushah sa parah partha bhaktya labhyas tvananyaya yasyantah-sthani bhutani yena sarvam idam tatam that highest purusha o arjuna is attainable by unswerving devotion to him alone within whom all beings dwell and by whom all this is pervaded.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.22 bg.8.22 chapter 8 verse 22 पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया।

यस्यान्तःस्थानि भूतानि येन सर्वमिदं ततम्।।8.22।। puruṣhaḥ sa paraḥ pārtha bhaktyā labhyas tvananyayā
yasyāntaḥ-sthāni bhūtāni yena sarvam idaṁ tatam that highest purusha, o arjuna, is attainable by unswerving devotion to him alone, within whom all beings dwell and by whom all this is pervaded.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.23
documents.iast: yatra kāle tvanāvṛittim āvṛittiṁ chaiva yoginaḥ
documents.summary: Now I will tell you, O chief of the Bharatas, the times of departure at which the Yogis will return or not return.
documents.searchText: bg.8.23 bg.8.23 chapter 8 verse 23 यतर कल तवनवततमवतत चव यगन परयत यनत त कल वकषयम भरतरषभ 8.23 yatra kale tvanavrittim avrittim chaiva yoginah prayata yanti tam kalam vakshyami bharatarshabha now i will tell you o chief of the bharatas the times of departure at which the yogis will return or not return.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.23 bg.8.23 chapter 8 verse 23 यत्र काले त्वनावृत्तिमावृत्तिं चैव योगिनः।

प्रयाता यान्ति तं कालं वक्ष्यामि भरतर्षभ।।8.23।। yatra kāle tvanāvṛittim āvṛittiṁ chaiva yoginaḥ
prayātā yānti taṁ kālaṁ vakṣhyāmi bharatarṣhabha now i will tell you, o chief of the bharatas, the times of departure at which the yogis will return or not return.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.24
documents.iast: agnir jyotir ahaḥ śhuklaḥ ṣhaṇ-māsā uttarāyaṇam
documents.summary: Fire, light, daytime, the bright fortnight, the six months of the northern path of the sun (the northern solstice) departing, then men who know Brahman go to Brahman.
documents.searchText: bg.8.24 bg.8.24 chapter 8 verse 24 अगनरजयतरह शकल षणमस उततरयणम ततर परयत गचछनत बरहम बरहमवद जन 8.24 agnir jyotir ahah shuklah shan-masa uttarayanam tatra prayata gachchhanti brahma brahma-vido janah fire light daytime the bright fortnight the six months of the northern path of the sun the northern solstice departing then men who know brahman go to brahman.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.24 bg.8.24 chapter 8 verse 24 अग्निर्ज्योतिरहः शुक्लः षण्मासा उत्तरायणम्।

तत्र प्रयाता गच्छन्ति ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदो जनाः।।8.24।। agnir jyotir ahaḥ śhuklaḥ ṣhaṇ-māsā uttarāyaṇam
tatra prayātā gachchhanti brahma brahma-vido janāḥ fire, light, daytime, the bright fortnight, the six months of the northern path of the sun (the northern solstice) departing, then men who know brahman go to brahman.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.25
documents.iast: dhūmo rātris tathā kṛiṣhṇaḥ ṣhaṇ-māsā dakṣhiṇāyanam
documents.summary: Attaining the lunar light through smoke, night time, the dark fortnight, and the six months of the southern path of the sun (the southern solstice), the yogi returns.
documents.searchText: bg.8.25 bg.8.25 chapter 8 verse 25 धम रतरसतथ कषण षणमस दकषणयनम ततर चनदरमस जयतरयग परपय नवरतत 8.25 dhumo ratris tatha krishnah shan-masa dakshinayanam tatra chandramasam jyotir yogi prapya nivartate attaining the lunar light through smoke night time the dark fortnight and the six months of the southern path of the sun the southern solstice the yogi returns.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.25 bg.8.25 chapter 8 verse 25 धूमो रात्रिस्तथा कृष्णः षण्मासा दक्षिणायनम्।

तत्र चान्द्रमसं ज्योतिर्योगी प्राप्य निवर्तते।।8.25।। dhūmo rātris tathā kṛiṣhṇaḥ ṣhaṇ-māsā dakṣhiṇāyanam
tatra chāndramasaṁ jyotir yogī prāpya nivartate attaining the lunar light through smoke, night time, the dark fortnight, and the six months of the southern path of the sun (the southern solstice), the yogi returns.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.26
documents.iast: śhukla-kṛiṣhṇe gatī hyete jagataḥ śhāśhvate mate
documents.sanskrit: शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते।
documents.summary: The bright and dark paths of the world are thought to be eternal; one leads to no return, and the other leads to return.
documents.searchText: bg.8.26 bg.8.26 chapter 8 verse 26 शकलकषण गत हयत जगत शशवत मत एकय यतयनवततमनययऽऽवरतत पन 8.26 shukla-krishne gati hyete jagatah shashvate mate ekaya yatyanavrittim anyayavartate punah the bright and dark paths of the world are thought to be eternal one leads to no return and the other leads to return.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.26 bg.8.26 chapter 8 verse 26 शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते।

एकया यात्यनावृत्तिमन्ययाऽऽवर्तते पुनः।।8.26।। śhukla-kṛiṣhṇe gatī hyete jagataḥ śhāśhvate mate
ekayā yātyanāvṛittim anyayāvartate punaḥ the bright and dark paths of the world are thought to be eternal; one leads to no return, and the other leads to return.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.27
documents.iast: naite sṛitī pārtha jānan yogī muhyati kaśhchana
documents.sanskrit: नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्योगी मुह्यति कश्चन।
documents.summary: Knowing these paths, O Arjuna, no yogi is deluded; therefore, at all times, be steadfast in yoga.
documents.searchText: bg.8.27 bg.8.27 chapter 8 verse 27 नत सत परथ जननयग महयत कशचन तसमतसरवष कलष यगयकत भवरजन 8.27 naite sriti partha janan yogi muhyati kashchana tasmat sarveshu kaleshu yoga-yukto bhavarjuna knowing these paths o arjuna no yogi is deluded therefore at all times be steadfast in yoga.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.27 bg.8.27 chapter 8 verse 27 नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्योगी मुह्यति कश्चन।

तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु योगयुक्तो भवार्जुन।।8.27।। naite sṛitī pārtha jānan yogī muhyati kaśhchana
tasmāt sarveṣhu kāleṣhu yoga-yukto bhavārjuna knowing these paths, o arjuna, no yogi is deluded; therefore, at all times, be steadfast in yoga.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.28
documents.summary: Whatever fruit of merit is declared (in the scriptures) to accrue from (the study of) the Vedas, (the performance of) sacrifices, (the practice of) austerities, and gifts, beyond a
documents.searchText: bg.8.28 bg.8.28 chapter 8 verse 28 वदष यजञष तपस चव दनष यतपणयफल परदषटम अतयत ततसरवमद वदतव यग पर सथनमपत चदयम 8.28 vedeshu yajneshu tapahsu chaiva daneshu yat punya-phalam pradishtam atyeti tat sarvam idam viditva yogi param sthanam upaiti chadyam whatever fruit of merit is declared in the scriptures to accrue from the study of the vedas the performance of sacrifices the practice of austerities and gifts beyond all this goes the yogi having known this and he attains to the supreme primeval first or ancient abode.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.28 bg.8.28 chapter 8 verse 28 वेदेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु चैव

दानेषु यत्पुण्यफलं प्रदिष्टम्।

अत्येति तत्सर्वमिदं विदित्वा

योगी परं स्थानमुपैति चाद्यम्।।8.28।। vedeṣhu yajñeṣhu tapaḥsu chaiva
dāneṣhu yat puṇya-phalaṁ pradiṣhṭam
atyeti tat sarvam idaṁ viditvā
yogī paraṁ sthānam upaiti chādyam whatever fruit of merit is declared (in the scriptures) to accrue from (the study of) the vedas, (the performance of) sacrifices, (the practice of) austerities, and gifts, beyond all this goes the yogi, having known this; and he attains to the supreme, primeval (first or ancient) abode.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.3
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, "Brahman is the Imperishable, the Supreme; its essential nature is called Self-knowledge; the offering (to the gods) that causes the existence and manifestat
documents.searchText: bg.8.3 bg.8.3 chapter 8 verse 3 शर भगवनवच अकषर बरहम परम सवभवऽधयतममचयत भतभवदभवकर वसरग करमसजञत 8.3 shri bhagavan uvacha aksharam brahma paramam svabhavo dhyatmam uchyate bhuta-bhavodbhava-karo visargah karma-sanjnitah the blessed lord said brahman is the imperishable the supreme its essential nature is called self-knowledge the offering to the gods that causes the existence and manifestation of beings and sustains them is called action.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.3 bg.8.3 chapter 8 verse 3 श्री भगवानुवाच

अक्षरं ब्रह्म परमं स्वभावोऽध्यात्ममुच्यते।

भूतभावोद्भवकरो विसर्गः कर्मसंज्ञितः।।8.3।। śhrī bhagavān uvācha
akṣharaṁ brahma paramaṁ svabhāvo ’dhyātmam uchyate
bhūta-bhāvodbhava-karo visargaḥ karma-sanjñitaḥ the blessed lord said, "brahman is the imperishable, the supreme; its essential nature is called self-knowledge; the offering (to the gods) that causes the existence and manifestation of beings and sustains them is called action."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.4
documents.summary: Adhibhuta—knowledge of the elements—pertains to My perishable nature, and the Purusha, or the Soul, is the Adhidaiva; I alone am the Adhiyajna here in this body, O best among the e
documents.searchText: bg.8.4 bg.8.4 chapter 8 verse 4 अधभत कषर भव परषशचधदवतम अधयजञऽहमवतर दह दहभत वर 8.4 adhibhutam ksharo bhavah purushash chadhidaivatam adhiyajno ham evatra dehe deha-bhritam vara adhibhuta knowledge of the elements pertains to my perishable nature and the purusha or the soul is the adhidaiva i alone am the adhiyajna here in this body o best among the embodied.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.4 bg.8.4 chapter 8 verse 4 अधिभूतं क्षरो भावः पुरुषश्चाधिदैवतम्।

अधियज्ञोऽहमेवात्र देहे देहभृतां वर।।8.4।। adhibhūtaṁ kṣharo bhāvaḥ puruṣhaśh chādhidaivatam
adhiyajño ’ham evātra dehe deha-bhṛitāṁ vara adhibhuta—knowledge of the elements—pertains to my perishable nature, and the purusha, or the soul, is the adhidaiva; i alone am the adhiyajna here in this body, o best among the embodied.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.5
documents.iast: anta-kāle cha mām eva smaran muktvā kalevaram
documents.summary: And whoever, leaving their body, goes forth remembering Me alone at the time of death, they will attain My Being; there is no doubt about this.
documents.searchText: bg.8.5 bg.8.5 chapter 8 verse 5 अनतकल च ममव समरनमकतव कलवरम य परयत स मदभव यत नसतयतर सशय 8.5 anta-kale cha mam eva smaran muktva kalevaram yah prayati sa mad-bhavam yati nastyatra sanshayah and whoever leaving their body goes forth remembering me alone at the time of death they will attain my being there is no doubt about this.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.5 bg.8.5 chapter 8 verse 5 अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन्मुक्त्वा कलेवरम्।

यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः।।8.5।। anta-kāle cha mām eva smaran muktvā kalevaram
yaḥ prayāti sa mad-bhāvaṁ yāti nāstyatra sanśhayaḥ and whoever, leaving their body, goes forth remembering me alone at the time of death, they will attain my being; there is no doubt about this.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.6
documents.iast: yaṁ yaṁ vāpi smaran bhāvaṁ tyajatyante kalevaram
documents.sanskrit: यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम्।
documents.summary: Whoever at the end leaves the body, thinking of any being, to that being only does he go, O son of Kunti (Arjuna), due to his constant thought of that being.
documents.searchText: bg.8.6 bg.8.6 chapter 8 verse 6 य य वप समरनभव तयजतयनत कलवरम त तमवत कनतय सद तदभवभवत 8.6 yam yam vapi smaran bhavam tyajatyante kalevaram tam tam evaiti kaunteya sada tad-bhava-bhavitah whoever at the end leaves the body thinking of any being to that being only does he go o son of kunti arjuna due to his constant thought of that being.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.6 bg.8.6 chapter 8 verse 6 यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम्।

तं तमेवैति कौन्तेय सदा तद्भावभावितः।।8.6।। yaṁ yaṁ vāpi smaran bhāvaṁ tyajatyante kalevaram
taṁ tam evaiti kaunteya sadā tad-bhāva-bhāvitaḥ whoever at the end leaves the body, thinking of any being, to that being only does he go, o son of kunti (arjuna), due to his constant thought of that being.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.7
documents.iast: tasmāt sarveṣhu kāleṣhu mām anusmara yudhya cha
documents.summary: Therefore, at all times, remember Me only and fight. With your mind and intellect fixed on Me, you will undoubtedly come to Me alone.
documents.searchText: bg.8.7 bg.8.7 chapter 8 verse 7 तसमतसरवष कलष ममनसमर यधय च मययरपतमनबदधरममवषयसयसशयम 8.7 tasmat sarveshu kaleshu mam anusmara yudhya cha mayyarpita-mano-buddhir mam evaishyasyasanshayam therefore at all times remember me only and fight. with your mind and intellect fixed on me you will undoubtedly come to me alone.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.7 bg.8.7 chapter 8 verse 7 तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च।

मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयम्।।8.7।। tasmāt sarveṣhu kāleṣhu mām anusmara yudhya cha
mayyarpita-mano-buddhir mām evaiṣhyasyasanśhayam therefore, at all times, remember me only and fight. with your mind and intellect fixed on me, you will undoubtedly come to me alone.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.8
documents.summary: With the mind not moving towards any other thing, made steadfast through the practice of habitual meditation, and constantly meditating, one goes to the Supreme Person, the Resplen
documents.searchText: bg.8.8 bg.8.8 chapter 8 verse 8 अभयसयगयकतन चतस ननयगमन परम परष दवय यत परथनचनतयन 8.8 abhyasa-yoga-yuktena chetasa nanya-gamina paramam purusham divyam yati parthanuchintayan with the mind not moving towards any other thing made steadfast through the practice of habitual meditation and constantly meditating one goes to the supreme person the resplendent o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.8 bg.8.8 chapter 8 verse 8 अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन चेतसा नान्यगामिना।

परमं पुरुषं दिव्यं याति पार्थानुचिन्तयन्।।8.8।। abhyāsa-yoga-yuktena chetasā nānya-gāminā
paramaṁ puruṣhaṁ divyaṁ yāti pārthānuchintayan with the mind not moving towards any other thing, made steadfast through the practice of habitual meditation, and constantly meditating, one goes to the supreme person, the resplendent, o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 8.9
documents.summary: Whosoever meditates on the Omniscient, the Ancient, the Ruler of the whole world, minuter than an atom, the supporter of all, of inconceivable form, effulgent like the sun and beyo
documents.searchText: bg.8.9 bg.8.9 chapter 8 verse 9 कव परणमनशसतर मणरणयसमनसमरदय सरवसय धतरमचनतयरप मदतयवरण तमस परसतत 8.9 kavim puranam anushasitaram anor aniyansam anusmared yah sarvasya dhataram achintya-rupam aditya-varnam tamasah parastat whosoever meditates on the omniscient the ancient the ruler of the whole world minuter than an atom the supporter of all of inconceivable form effulgent like the sun and beyond the darkness of ignorance.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.8.9 bg.8.9 chapter 8 verse 9 कविं पुराणमनुशासितार

मणोरणीयांसमनुस्मरेद्यः।

सर्वस्य धातारमचिन्त्यरूप

मादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात्।।8.9।। kaviṁ purāṇam anuśhāsitāram
aṇor aṇīyānsam anusmared yaḥ
sarvasya dhātāram achintya-rūpam
āditya-varṇaṁ tamasaḥ parastāt whosoever meditates on the omniscient, the ancient, the ruler of the whole world, minuter than an atom, the supporter of all, of inconceivable form, effulgent like the sun and beyond the darkness of ignorance.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.1
documents.summary: The Blessed Lord said, "I shall now declare to thee, who does not cavil, the greatest secret—the knowledge combined with experience (Self-realisation). Having known this, thou shal
documents.searchText: bg.9.1 bg.9.1 chapter 9 verse 1 शर भगवनवच इद त त गहयतम परवकषयमयनसयव जञन वजञनसहत यजजञतव मकषयसऽशभत 9.1 shri bhagavan uvacha idam tu te guhyatamam pravakshyamyanasuyave jnanam vijnana-sahitam yaj jnatva mokshyase shubhat the blessed lord said i shall now declare to thee who does not cavil the greatest secret the knowledge combined with experience self-realisation . having known this thou shalt be free from evil.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.1 bg.9.1 chapter 9 verse 1 श्री भगवानुवाच

इदं तु ते गुह्यतमं प्रवक्ष्याम्यनसूयवे।

ज्ञानं विज्ञानसहितं यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात्।।9.1।। śhrī bhagavān uvācha
idaṁ tu te guhyatamaṁ pravakṣhyāmyanasūyave
jñānaṁ vijñāna-sahitaṁ yaj jñātvā mokṣhyase ’śhubhāt the blessed lord said, "i shall now declare to thee, who does not cavil, the greatest secret—the knowledge combined with experience (self-realisation). having known this, thou shalt be free from evil."

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.10
documents.summary: Under Me, as supervisor, Nature produces the moving and the unmoving; therefore, O Arjuna, the world revolves.
documents.searchText: bg.9.10 bg.9.10 chapter 9 verse 10 मयऽधयकषण परकत सयत सचरचरम हतनऽनन कनतय जगदवपरवरतत 9.10 mayadhyakshena prakritih suyate sa-characharam hetunanena kaunteya jagad viparivartate under me as supervisor nature produces the moving and the unmoving therefore o arjuna the world revolves.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.10 bg.9.10 chapter 9 verse 10 मयाऽध्यक्षेण प्रकृतिः सूयते सचराचरम्।

हेतुनाऽनेन कौन्तेय जगद्विपरिवर्तते।।9.10।। mayādhyakṣheṇa prakṛitiḥ sūyate sa-charācharam
hetunānena kaunteya jagad viparivartate under me, as supervisor, nature produces the moving and the unmoving; therefore, o arjuna, the world revolves.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.11
documents.iast: avajānanti māṁ mūḍhā mānuṣhīṁ tanum āśhritam
documents.summary: Fools disregard Me, clad in human form, not knowing My higher Being as the great Lord of all beings.
documents.searchText: bg.9.11 bg.9.11 chapter 9 verse 11 अवजननत म मढ मनष तनमशरतम पर भवमजननत मम भतमहशवरम 9.11 avajananti mam mudha manushim tanum ashritam param bhavam ajananto mama bhuta-maheshvaram fools disregard me clad in human form not knowing my higher being as the great lord of all beings.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.11 bg.9.11 chapter 9 verse 11 अवजानन्ति मां मूढा मानुषीं तनुमाश्रितम्।

परं भावमजानन्तो मम भूतमहेश्वरम्।।9.11।। avajānanti māṁ mūḍhā mānuṣhīṁ tanum āśhritam
paraṁ bhāvam ajānanto mama bhūta-maheśhvaram fools disregard me, clad in human form, not knowing my higher being as the great lord of all beings.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.12
documents.summary: They are possessed of the deceitful nature of demons and undivine beings, filled with vain hopes, vain actions, and vain knowledge that is senseless.
documents.searchText: bg.9.12 bg.9.12 chapter 9 verse 12 मघश मघकरमण मघजञन वचतस रकषसमसर चव परकत महन शरत 9.12 moghasha mogha-karmano mogha-jnana vichetasah rakshasim asurim chaiva prakritim mohinim shritah they are possessed of the deceitful nature of demons and undivine beings filled with vain hopes vain actions and vain knowledge that is senseless.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.12 bg.9.12 chapter 9 verse 12 मोघाशा मोघकर्माणो मोघज्ञाना विचेतसः।

राक्षसीमासुरीं चैव प्रकृतिं मोहिनीं श्रिताः।।9.12।। moghāśhā mogha-karmāṇo mogha-jñānā vichetasaḥ
rākṣhasīm āsurīṁ chaiva prakṛitiṁ mohinīṁ śhritāḥ they are possessed of the deceitful nature of demons and undivine beings, filled with vain hopes, vain actions, and vain knowledge that is senseless.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.13
documents.iast: mahātmānas tu māṁ pārtha daivīṁ prakṛitim āśhritāḥ
documents.summary: But the great souls, O Arjuna, partaking of My divine nature, worship Me with a single-minded devotion, knowing Me as the imperishable source of all beings.
documents.searchText: bg.9.13 bg.9.13 chapter 9 verse 13 महतमनसत म परथ दव परकतमशरत भजनतयननयमनस जञतव भतदमवययम 9.13 mahatmanas tu mam partha daivim prakritim ashritah bhajantyananya-manaso jnatva bhutadim avyayam but the great souls o arjuna partaking of my divine nature worship me with a single-minded devotion knowing me as the imperishable source of all beings.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.13 bg.9.13 chapter 9 verse 13 महात्मानस्तु मां पार्थ दैवीं प्रकृतिमाश्रिताः।

भजन्त्यनन्यमनसो ज्ञात्वा भूतादिमव्ययम्।।9.13।। mahātmānas tu māṁ pārtha daivīṁ prakṛitim āśhritāḥ
bhajantyananya-manaso jñātvā bhūtādim avyayam but the great souls, o arjuna, partaking of my divine nature, worship me with a single-minded devotion, knowing me as the imperishable source of all beings.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.14
documents.iast: satataṁ kīrtayanto māṁ yatantaśh cha dṛiḍha-vratāḥ
documents.summary: Always glorifying Me, striving, firm in their vows, prostrating themselves before Me, they worship Me with steadfast devotion.
documents.searchText: bg.9.14 bg.9.14 chapter 9 verse 14 सतत करतयनत म यतनतशच दढवरत नमसयनतशच म भकतय नतययकत उपसत 9.14 satatam kirtayanto mam yatantash cha dridha-vratah namasyantash cha mam bhaktya nitya-yukta upasate always glorifying me striving firm in their vows prostrating themselves before me they worship me with steadfast devotion.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.14 bg.9.14 chapter 9 verse 14 सततं कीर्तयन्तो मां यतन्तश्च दृढव्रताः।

नमस्यन्तश्च मां भक्त्या नित्ययुक्ता उपासते।।9.14।। satataṁ kīrtayanto māṁ yatantaśh cha dṛiḍha-vratāḥ
namasyantaśh cha māṁ bhaktyā nitya-yuktā upāsate always glorifying me, striving, firm in their vows, prostrating themselves before me, they worship me with steadfast devotion.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.15
documents.summary: Others also, sacrificing with the wisdom-sacrifice, worship Me, the All-Faced, as one, distinct, and manifold.
documents.searchText: bg.9.15 bg.9.15 chapter 9 verse 15 जञनयजञन चपयनय यजनत ममपसत एकतवन पथकतवन बहध वशवतमखम 9.15 jnana-yajnena chapyanye yajanto mam upasate ekatvena prithaktvena bahudha vishvato-mukham others also sacrificing with the wisdom-sacrifice worship me the all-faced as one distinct and manifold.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.15 bg.9.15 chapter 9 verse 15 ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामुपासते।

एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम्।।9.15।। jñāna-yajñena chāpyanye yajanto mām upāsate
ekatvena pṛithaktvena bahudhā viśhvato-mukham others also, sacrificing with the wisdom-sacrifice, worship me, the all-faced, as one, distinct, and manifold.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.16
documents.iast: ahaṁ kratur ahaṁ yajñaḥ svadhāham aham auṣhadham
documents.summary: I am Kratu; I am Yajna; I am the offering to the manes; I am the medicinal herbs and all plants; I am the Mantra; I am also the ghee or melted butter; I am the fire; I am the oblat
documents.searchText: bg.9.16 bg.9.16 chapter 9 verse 16 अह करतरह यजञ सवधऽहमहमषधम मतरऽहमहमवजयमहमगनरह हतम 9.16 aham kratur aham yajnah svadhaham aham aushadham mantro ham aham evajyam aham agnir aham hutam i am kratu i am yajna i am the offering to the manes i am the medicinal herbs and all plants i am the mantra i am also the ghee or melted butter i am the fire i am the oblation.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.16 bg.9.16 chapter 9 verse 16 अहं क्रतुरहं यज्ञः स्वधाऽहमहमौषधम्।

मंत्रोऽहमहमेवाज्यमहमग्निरहं हुतम्।।9.16।। ahaṁ kratur ahaṁ yajñaḥ svadhāham aham auṣhadham
mantro ’ham aham evājyam aham agnir ahaṁ hutam i am kratu; i am yajna; i am the offering to the manes; i am the medicinal herbs and all plants; i am the mantra; i am also the ghee or melted butter; i am the fire; i am the oblation.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.17
documents.iast: pitāham asya jagato mātā dhātā pitāmahaḥ
documents.summary: I am the father of this world, the mother, the dispenser of the fruits of actions, and the grandfather; the one thing to be known, the purifier, the sacred monosyllable (Om), and a
documents.searchText: bg.9.17 bg.9.17 chapter 9 verse 17 पतऽहमसय जगत मत धत पतमह वदय पवतरमकर ऋक सम यजरव च 9.17 pitaham asya jagato mata dhata pitamahah vedyam pavitram omkara rik sama yajur eva cha i am the father of this world the mother the dispenser of the fruits of actions and the grandfather the one thing to be known the purifier the sacred monosyllable om and also the rik sama and yajur vedas.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.17 bg.9.17 chapter 9 verse 17 पिताऽहमस्य जगतो माता धाता पितामहः।

वेद्यं पवित्रमोंकार ऋक् साम यजुरेव च।।9.17।। pitāham asya jagato mātā dhātā pitāmahaḥ
vedyaṁ pavitram oṁkāra ṛik sāma yajur eva cha i am the father of this world, the mother, the dispenser of the fruits of actions, and the grandfather; the one thing to be known, the purifier, the sacred monosyllable (om), and also the rik, sama, and yajur vedas.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.18
documents.iast: gatir bhartā prabhuḥ sākṣhī nivāsaḥ śharaṇaṁ suhṛit
documents.sanskrit: गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत्।
documents.summary: I am the goal, the supporter, the Lord, the witness, the abode, the shelter, the friend, the origin, the dissolution, the foundation, the treasure-house, and the imperishable seed.
documents.searchText: bg.9.18 bg.9.18 chapter 9 verse 18 गतरभरत परभ सकष नवस शरण सहत परभव परलय सथन नधन बजमवययम 9.18 gatir bharta prabhuh sakshi nivasah sharanam suhrit prabhavah pralayah sthanam nidhanam bijam avyayam i am the goal the supporter the lord the witness the abode the shelter the friend the origin the dissolution the foundation the treasure-house and the imperishable seed.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.18 bg.9.18 chapter 9 verse 18 गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत्।

प्रभवः प्रलयः स्थानं निधानं बीजमव्ययम्।।9.18।। gatir bhartā prabhuḥ sākṣhī nivāsaḥ śharaṇaṁ suhṛit
prabhavaḥ pralayaḥ sthānaṁ nidhānaṁ bījam avyayam i am the goal, the supporter, the lord, the witness, the abode, the shelter, the friend, the origin, the dissolution, the foundation, the treasure-house, and the imperishable seed.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.19
documents.summary: As the sun, I give heat; I withhold and send forth the rain; I am immortality and also death, existence and non-existence, O Arjuna.
documents.searchText: bg.9.19 bg.9.19 chapter 9 verse 19 तपमयहमह वरष नगहणमयतसजम च अमत चव मतयशच सदसचचहमरजन 9.19 tapamyaham aham varsham nigrihnamyutsrijami cha amritam chaiva mrityush cha sad asach chaham arjuna as the sun i give heat i withhold and send forth the rain i am immortality and also death existence and non-existence o arjuna.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.19 bg.9.19 chapter 9 verse 19 तपाम्यहमहं वर्षं निगृह्णाम्युत्सृजामि च।

अमृतं चैव मृत्युश्च सदसच्चाहमर्जुन।।9.19।। tapāmyaham ahaṁ varṣhaṁ nigṛihṇāmyutsṛijāmi cha
amṛitaṁ chaiva mṛityuśh cha sad asach chāham arjuna as the sun, i give heat; i withhold and send forth the rain; i am immortality and also death, existence and non-existence, o arjuna.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.2
documents.summary: This is the royal science, the royal secret, the supreme purifier, realizable by direct intuitive knowledge, according to righteousness, very easy to perform and imperishable.
documents.searchText: bg.9.2 bg.9.2 chapter 9 verse 2 रजवदय रजगहय पवतरमदमततमम परतयकषवगम धरमय ससख करतमवययम 9.2 raja-vidya raja-guhyam pavitram idam uttamam pratyakshavagamam dharmyam su-sukham kartum avyayam this is the royal science the royal secret the supreme purifier realizable by direct intuitive knowledge according to righteousness very easy to perform and imperishable.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.2 bg.9.2 chapter 9 verse 2 राजविद्या राजगुह्यं पवित्रमिदमुत्तमम्।

प्रत्यक्षावगमं धर्म्यं सुसुखं कर्तुमव्ययम्।।9.2।। rāja-vidyā rāja-guhyaṁ pavitram idam uttamam
pratyakṣhāvagamaṁ dharmyaṁ su-sukhaṁ kartum avyayam this is the royal science, the royal secret, the supreme purifier, realizable by direct intuitive knowledge, according to righteousness, very easy to perform and imperishable.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.20
documents.summary: The knowers of the three Vedas, the drinkers of Soma, purified of all sins, worshipping Me through sacrifices, pray for the way to heaven; they reach the holy world of the Lord of
documents.searchText: bg.9.20 bg.9.20 chapter 9 verse 20 तरवदय म समप पतपप यजञरषटव सवरगत पररथयनत त पणयमसदय सरनदरलक मशननत दवयनदव दवभगन 9.20 trai-vidya mam soma-pah puta-papa yajnair ishtva svar-gatim prarthayante te punyam asadya surendra-lokam ashnanti divyan divi deva-bhogan the knowers of the three vedas the drinkers of soma purified of all sins worshipping me through sacrifices pray for the way to heaven they reach the holy world of the lord of the gods and enjoy the divine pleasures of the gods in heaven.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.20 bg.9.20 chapter 9 verse 20 त्रैविद्या मां सोमपाः पूतपापा

यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा स्वर्गतिं प्रार्थयन्ते।

ते पुण्यमासाद्य सुरेन्द्रलोक

मश्नन्ति दिव्यान्दिवि देवभोगान्।।9.20।। trai-vidyā māṁ soma-pāḥ pūta-pāpā
yajñair iṣhṭvā svar-gatiṁ prārthayante
te puṇyam āsādya surendra-lokam
aśhnanti divyān divi deva-bhogān the knowers of the three vedas, the drinkers of soma, purified of all sins, worshipping me through sacrifices, pray for the way to heaven; they reach the holy world of the lord of the gods and enjoy the divine pleasures of the gods in heaven.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.21
documents.summary: They, having enjoyed the vast heaven, enter the world of mortals when their merit is exhausted; thus abiding by the injunctions of the three (Vedas) and desiring objects of desires
documents.searchText: bg.9.21 bg.9.21 chapter 9 verse 21 त त भकतव सवरगलक वशल कषण पणय मरतयलक वशनत एव तरयधरममनपरपनन गतगत कमकम लभनत 9.21 te tam bhuktva swarga-lokam vishalam kshine punye martya-lokam vishanti evam trayi-dharmam anuprapanna gatagatam kama-kama labhante they having enjoyed the vast heaven enter the world of mortals when their merit is exhausted thus abiding by the injunctions of the three vedas and desiring objects of desires they attain to the state of coming and going.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.21 bg.9.21 chapter 9 verse 21 ते तं भुक्त्वा स्वर्गलोकं विशालं

क्षीणे पुण्ये मर्त्यलोकं विशन्ति।

एव त्रयीधर्ममनुप्रपन्ना

गतागतं कामकामा लभन्ते।।9.21।। te taṁ bhuktvā swarga-lokaṁ viśhālaṁ
kṣhīṇe puṇye martya-lokaṁ viśhanti
evaṁ trayī-dharmam anuprapannā
gatāgataṁ kāma-kāmā labhante they, having enjoyed the vast heaven, enter the world of mortals when their merit is exhausted; thus abiding by the injunctions of the three (vedas) and desiring objects of desires, they attain to the state of coming and going.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.22
documents.iast: ananyāśh chintayanto māṁ ye janāḥ paryupāsate
documents.summary: For those men who worship Me alone, thinking of no one else, for those ever-united, I secure what they have not already possessed and preserve what they already possess.
documents.searchText: bg.9.22 bg.9.22 chapter 9 verse 22 अननयशचनतयनत म य जन परयपसत तष नतयभयकतन यगकषम वहमयहम 9.22 ananyash chintayanto mam ye janah paryupasate tesham nityabhiyuktanam yoga-kshemam vahamyaham for those men who worship me alone thinking of no one else for those ever-united i secure what they have not already possessed and preserve what they already possess.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.22 bg.9.22 chapter 9 verse 22 अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते।

तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम्।।9.22।। ananyāśh chintayanto māṁ ye janāḥ paryupāsate
teṣhāṁ nityābhiyuktānāṁ yoga-kṣhemaṁ vahāmyaham for those men who worship me alone, thinking of no one else, for those ever-united, i secure what they have not already possessed and preserve what they already possess.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.23
documents.summary: Even those devotees who, endowed with faith, worship other gods, worship Me alone, O Arjuna, but by the wrong method.
documents.searchText: bg.9.23 bg.9.23 chapter 9 verse 23 यऽपयनयदवत भकत यजनत शरदधयऽनवत तऽप ममव कनतय यजनतयवधपरवकम 9.23 ye pyanya-devata-bhakta yajante shraddhayanvitah te pi mam eva kaunteya yajantyavidhi-purvakam even those devotees who endowed with faith worship other gods worship me alone o arjuna but by the wrong method.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.23 bg.9.23 chapter 9 verse 23 येऽप्यन्यदेवता भक्ता यजन्ते श्रद्धयाऽन्विताः।

तेऽपि मामेव कौन्तेय यजन्त्यविधिपूर्वकम्।।9.23।। ye ’pyanya-devatā-bhaktā yajante śhraddhayānvitāḥ
te ’pi mām eva kaunteya yajantyavidhi-pūrvakam even those devotees who, endowed with faith, worship other gods, worship me alone, o arjuna, but by the wrong method.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.24
documents.iast: ahaṁ hi sarva-yajñānāṁ bhoktā cha prabhureva cha
documents.sanskrit: अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च।
documents.summary: For I alone am the enjoyer and Lord of all sacrifices; but they do not know Me in reality, and thus they return to this mortal world.
documents.searchText: bg.9.24 bg.9.24 chapter 9 verse 24 अह ह सरवयजञन भकत च परभरव च न त ममभजननत तततवनतशचयवनत त 9.24 aham hi sarva-yajnanam bhokta cha prabhureva cha na tu mam abhijananti tattvenatash chyavanti te for i alone am the enjoyer and lord of all sacrifices but they do not know me in reality and thus they return to this mortal world.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.24 bg.9.24 chapter 9 verse 24 अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च।

न तु मामभिजानन्ति तत्त्वेनातश्च्यवन्ति ते।।9.24।। ahaṁ hi sarva-yajñānāṁ bhoktā cha prabhureva cha
na tu mām abhijānanti tattvenātaśh chyavanti te for i alone am the enjoyer and lord of all sacrifices; but they do not know me in reality, and thus they return to this mortal world.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.25
documents.iast: yānti deva-vratā devān pitṝīn yānti pitṛi-vratāḥ
documents.summary: The worshippers of the gods go to them; the ancestor-worshippers go to the manes; the worshippers of the deities who preside over the elements go to them; but My devotees come to M
documents.searchText: bg.9.25 bg.9.25 chapter 9 verse 25 यनत दववरत दवन पतनयनत पतवरत भतन यनत भतजय यनत मदयजनऽप मम 9.25 yanti deva-vrata devan pitrin yanti pitri-vratah bhutani yanti bhutejya yanti mad-yajino pi mam the worshippers of the gods go to them the ancestor-worshippers go to the manes the worshippers of the deities who preside over the elements go to them but my devotees come to me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.25 bg.9.25 chapter 9 verse 25 यान्ति देवव्रता देवान् पितृ़न्यान्ति पितृव्रताः।

भूतानि यान्ति भूतेज्या यान्ति मद्याजिनोऽपि माम्।।9.25।। yānti deva-vratā devān pitṝīn yānti pitṛi-vratāḥ
bhūtāni yānti bhūtejyā yānti mad-yājino ’pi mām the worshippers of the gods go to them; the ancestor-worshippers go to the manes; the worshippers of the deities who preside over the elements go to them; but my devotees come to me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.26
documents.iast: patraṁ puṣhpaṁ phalaṁ toyaṁ yo me bhaktyā prayachchhati
documents.sanskrit: पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति।
documents.summary: Whoever offers Me with devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or a little water, that, so offered devotedly by the pure-minded, I accept.
documents.searchText: bg.9.26 bg.9.26 chapter 9 verse 26 पतर पषप फल तय य म भकतय परयचछत तदह भकतयपहतमशनम परयततमन 9.26 patram pushpam phalam toyam yo me bhaktya prayachchhati tadaham bhaktyupahritam ashnami prayatatmanah whoever offers me with devotion a leaf a flower a fruit or a little water that so offered devotedly by the pure-minded i accept.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.26 bg.9.26 chapter 9 verse 26 पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति।

तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः।।9.26।। patraṁ puṣhpaṁ phalaṁ toyaṁ yo me bhaktyā prayachchhati
tadahaṁ bhaktyupahṛitam aśhnāmi prayatātmanaḥ whoever offers me with devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or a little water, that, so offered devotedly by the pure-minded, i accept.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.27
documents.iast: yat karoṣhi yad aśhnāsi yaj juhoṣhi dadāsi yat
documents.summary: Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer in sacrifice, whatever you give, whatever austerity you practice, O Arjuna, do it as an offering to Me.
documents.searchText: bg.9.27 bg.9.27 chapter 9 verse 27 यतकरष यदशनस यजजहष ददस यत यततपसयस कनतय ततकरषव मदरपणम 9.27 yat karoshi yad ashnasi yaj juhoshi dadasi yat yat tapasyasi kaunteya tat kurushva mad-arpanam whatever you do whatever you eat whatever you offer in sacrifice whatever you give whatever austerity you practice o arjuna do it as an offering to me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.27 bg.9.27 chapter 9 verse 27 यत्करोषि यदश्नासि यज्जुहोषि ददासि यत्।

यत्तपस्यसि कौन्तेय तत्कुरुष्व मदर्पणम्।।9.27।। yat karoṣhi yad aśhnāsi yaj juhoṣhi dadāsi yat
yat tapasyasi kaunteya tat kuruṣhva mad-arpaṇam whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer in sacrifice, whatever you give, whatever austerity you practice, o arjuna, do it as an offering to me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.28
documents.summary: Thus, you shall be freed from the bonds of actions yielding good and evil fruits; with the mind steadfast in the Yoga of renunciation, and liberated, you shall come to Me.
documents.searchText: bg.9.28 bg.9.28 chapter 9 verse 28 शभशभफलरव मकषयस करमबनधन सनयसयगयकततम वमकत ममपषयस 9.28 shubhashubha-phalair evam mokshyase karma-bandhanaih sannyasa-yoga-yuktatma vimukto mam upaishyasi thus you shall be freed from the bonds of actions yielding good and evil fruits with the mind steadfast in the yoga of renunciation and liberated you shall come to me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.28 bg.9.28 chapter 9 verse 28 शुभाशुभफलैरेवं मोक्ष्यसे कर्मबन्धनैः।

संन्यासयोगयुक्तात्मा विमुक्तो मामुपैष्यसि।।9.28।। śhubhāśhubha-phalair evaṁ mokṣhyase karma-bandhanaiḥ
sannyāsa-yoga-yuktātmā vimukto mām upaiṣhyasi thus, you shall be freed from the bonds of actions yielding good and evil fruits; with the mind steadfast in the yoga of renunciation, and liberated, you shall come to me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.29
documents.iast: samo ’haṁ sarva-bhūteṣhu na me dveṣhyo ’sti na priyaḥ
documents.sanskrit: समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः।
documents.summary: I am the same to all beings; there is none hateful or dear to Me; but those who worship Me with devotion are in Me, and I am also in them.
documents.searchText: bg.9.29 bg.9.29 chapter 9 verse 29 समऽह सरवभतष न म दवषयऽसत न परय य भजनत त म भकतय मय त तष चपयहम 9.29 samo ham sarva-bhuteshu na me dveshyo sti na priyah ye bhajanti tu mam bhaktya mayi te teshu chapyaham i am the same to all beings there is none hateful or dear to me but those who worship me with devotion are in me and i am also in them.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.29 bg.9.29 chapter 9 verse 29 समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः।

ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम्।।9.29।। samo ’haṁ sarva-bhūteṣhu na me dveṣhyo ’sti na priyaḥ
ye bhajanti tu māṁ bhaktyā mayi te teṣhu chāpyaham i am the same to all beings; there is none hateful or dear to me; but those who worship me with devotion are in me, and i am also in them.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.3
documents.summary: Those who have no faith in this Dharma, O Parantapa, return to the path of this world without attaining Me.
documents.searchText: bg.9.3 bg.9.3 chapter 9 verse 3 अशरददधन परष धरमसयसय परनतप अपरपय म नवरतनत मतयससरवरतमन 9.3 ashraddadhanah purusha dharmasyasya parantapa aprapya mam nivartante mrityu-samsara-vartmani those who have no faith in this dharma o parantapa return to the path of this world without attaining me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.3 bg.9.3 chapter 9 verse 3 अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा धर्मस्यास्य परन्तप।

अप्राप्य मां निवर्तन्ते मृत्युसंसारवर्त्मनि।।9.3।। aśhraddadhānāḥ puruṣhā dharmasyāsya parantapa
aprāpya māṁ nivartante mṛityu-samsāra-vartmani those who have no faith in this dharma, o parantapa, return to the path of this world without attaining me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.30
documents.iast: api chet su-durāchāro bhajate mām ananya-bhāk
documents.summary: Even if the most sinful worships Me, with devotion to no one else, he should indeed be regarded as righteous, for he has rightly resolved.
documents.searchText: bg.9.30 bg.9.30 chapter 9 verse 30 अप चतसदरचर भजत ममननयभक सधरव स मनतवय समयगवयवसत ह स 9.30 api chet su-duracharo bhajate mam ananya-bhak sadhur eva sa mantavyah samyag vyavasito hi sah even if the most sinful worships me with devotion to no one else he should indeed be regarded as righteous for he has rightly resolved.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.30 bg.9.30 chapter 9 verse 30 अपि चेत्सुदुराचारो भजते मामनन्यभाक्।

साधुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यग्व्यवसितो हि सः।।9.30।। api chet su-durāchāro bhajate mām ananya-bhāk
sādhur eva sa mantavyaḥ samyag vyavasito hi saḥ even if the most sinful worships me, with devotion to no one else, he should indeed be regarded as righteous, for he has rightly resolved.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.31
documents.summary: Soon he becomes righteous and attains eternal peace; O Arjuna, proclaim thou for certain that My devotee never perishes.
documents.searchText: bg.9.31 bg.9.31 chapter 9 verse 31 कषपर भवत धरमतम शशवचछनत नगचछत कनतय परतजनह न म भकत परणशयत 9.31 kshipram bhavati dharmatma shashvach-chhantim nigachchhati kaunteya pratijanihi na me bhaktah pranashyati soon he becomes righteous and attains eternal peace o arjuna proclaim thou for certain that my devotee never perishes.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.31 bg.9.31 chapter 9 verse 31 क्षिप्रं भवति धर्मात्मा शश्वच्छान्तिं निगच्छति।

कौन्तेय प्रतिजानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति।।9.31।। kṣhipraṁ bhavati dharmātmā śhaśhvach-chhāntiṁ nigachchhati
kaunteya pratijānīhi na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśhyati soon he becomes righteous and attains eternal peace; o arjuna, proclaim thou for certain that my devotee never perishes.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.32
documents.iast: māṁ hi pārtha vyapāśhritya ye ’pi syuḥ pāpa-yonayaḥ
documents.sanskrit: मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः।
documents.summary: For, taking refuge in Me, they who, O Arjuna, may be of a sinful birth—women, Vaisyas, and Sudras—attain the Supreme Goal.
documents.searchText: bg.9.32 bg.9.32 chapter 9 verse 32 म ह परथ वयपशरतय यऽप सय पपयनय सतरय वशयसतथ शदरसतऽप यनत पर गतम 9.32 mam hi partha vyapashritya ye pi syuh papa-yonayah striyo vaishyas tatha shudras te pi yanti param gatim for taking refuge in me they who o arjuna may be of a sinful birth women vaisyas and sudras attain the supreme goal.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.32 bg.9.32 chapter 9 verse 32 मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः।

स्त्रियो वैश्यास्तथा शूद्रास्तेऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम्।।9.32।। māṁ hi pārtha vyapāśhritya ye ’pi syuḥ pāpa-yonayaḥ
striyo vaiśhyās tathā śhūdrās te ’pi yānti parāṁ gatim for, taking refuge in me, they who, o arjuna, may be of a sinful birth—women, vaisyas, and sudras—attain the supreme goal.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.33
documents.iast: kiṁ punar brāhmaṇāḥ puṇyā bhaktā rājarṣhayas tathā
documents.summary: How much more easily, then, do Brahmins and devoted royal saints attain the goal? Having come to this impermanent and unhappy world, do thou worship Me.
documents.searchText: bg.9.33 bg.9.33 chapter 9 verse 33 क पनरबरहमण पणय भकत रजरषयसतथ अनतयमसख लकमम परपय भजसव मम 9.33 kim punar brahmanah punya bhakta rajarshayas tatha anityam asukham lokam imam prapya bhajasva mam how much more easily then do brahmins and devoted royal saints attain the goal having come to this impermanent and unhappy world do thou worship me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.33 bg.9.33 chapter 9 verse 33 किं पुनर्ब्राह्मणाः पुण्या भक्ता राजर्षयस्तथा।
