अनित्यमसुखं लोकमिमं प्राप्य भजस्व माम्।।9.33।। kiṁ punar brāhmaṇāḥ puṇyā bhaktā rājarṣhayas tathā
anityam asukhaṁ lokam imaṁ prāpya bhajasva mām how much more easily, then, do brahmins and devoted royal saints attain the goal? having come to this impermanent and unhappy world, do thou worship me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.34
documents.iast: man-manā bhava mad-bhakto mad-yājī māṁ namaskuru
documents.sanskrit: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु।
documents.summary: Fix your mind on Me; be devoted to Me; sacrifice to Me; bow down to Me; having thus united your whole self to Me, taking Me as the supreme goal, you will come to Me.
documents.searchText: bg.9.34 bg.9.34 chapter 9 verse 34 मनमन भव मदभकत मदयज म नमसकर ममवषयस यकतववमतमन मतपरयण 9.34 man-mana bhava mad-bhakto mad-yaji mam namaskuru mam evaishyasi yuktvaivam atmanam mat-parayanah fix your mind on me be devoted to me sacrifice to me bow down to me having thus united your whole self to me taking me as the supreme goal you will come to me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.34 bg.9.34 chapter 9 verse 34 मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु।

मामेवैष्यसि युक्त्वैवमात्मानं मत्परायणः।।9.34।। man-manā bhava mad-bhakto mad-yājī māṁ namaskuru
mām evaiṣhyasi yuktvaivam ātmānaṁ mat-parāyaṇaḥ fix your mind on me; be devoted to me; sacrifice to me; bow down to me; having thus united your whole self to me, taking me as the supreme goal, you will come to me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.4
documents.iast: mayā tatam idaṁ sarvaṁ jagad avyakta-mūrtinā
documents.summary: All of this world is pervaded by Me in My unmanifest aspect; all beings exist within Me, but I do not dwell within them.
documents.searchText: bg.9.4 bg.9.4 chapter 9 verse 4 मय ततमद सरव जगदवयकतमरतन मतसथन सरवभतन न चह तषववसथत 9.4 maya tatam idam sarvam jagad avyakta-murtina mat-sthani sarva-bhutani na chaham teshvavasthitah all of this world is pervaded by me in my unmanifest aspect all beings exist within me but i do not dwell within them.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.4 bg.9.4 chapter 9 verse 4 मया ततमिदं सर्वं जगदव्यक्तमूर्तिना।

मत्स्थानि सर्वभूतानि न चाहं तेष्ववस्थितः।।9.4।। mayā tatam idaṁ sarvaṁ jagad avyakta-mūrtinā
mat-sthāni sarva-bhūtāni na chāhaṁ teṣhvavasthitaḥ all of this world is pervaded by me in my unmanifest aspect; all beings exist within me, but i do not dwell within them.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.5
documents.iast: na cha mat-sthāni bhūtāni paśhya me yogam aiśhwaram
documents.sanskrit: न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्।
documents.summary: Nor do beings exist in Me (in reality); behold, My divine Yoga, which supports all beings, but does not dwell in them, is My Self, the efficient cause of beings.
documents.searchText: bg.9.5 bg.9.5 chapter 9 verse 5 न च मतसथन भतन पशय म यगमशवरम भतभनन च भतसथ ममतम भतभवन 9.5 na cha mat-sthani bhutani pashya me yogam aishwaram bhuta-bhrin na cha bhuta-stho mamatma bhuta-bhavanah nor do beings exist in me in reality behold my divine yoga which supports all beings but does not dwell in them is my self the efficient cause of beings.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.5 bg.9.5 chapter 9 verse 5 न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्।

भूतभृन्न च भूतस्थो ममात्मा भूतभावनः।।9.5।। na cha mat-sthāni bhūtāni paśhya me yogam aiśhwaram
bhūta-bhṛin na cha bhūta-stho mamātmā bhūta-bhāvanaḥ nor do beings exist in me (in reality); behold, my divine yoga, which supports all beings, but does not dwell in them, is my self, the efficient cause of beings.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.6
documents.summary: As the mighty wind, moving everywhere, always rests in the ether, so too, know that all beings rest in Me.
documents.searchText: bg.9.6 bg.9.6 chapter 9 verse 6 यथऽऽकशसथत नतय वय सरवतरग महन तथ सरवण भतन मतसथनतयपधरय 9.6 yathakasha-sthito nityam vayuh sarvatra-go mahan tatha sarvani bhutani mat-sthanityupadharaya as the mighty wind moving everywhere always rests in the ether so too know that all beings rest in me.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.6 bg.9.6 chapter 9 verse 6 यथाऽऽकाशस्थितो नित्यं वायुः सर्वत्रगो महान्।

तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि मत्स्थानीत्युपधारय।।9.6।। yathākāśha-sthito nityaṁ vāyuḥ sarvatra-go mahān
tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni mat-sthānītyupadhāraya as the mighty wind, moving everywhere, always rests in the ether, so too, know that all beings rest in me.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.7
documents.summary: All beings, O Arjuna, go into My Nature at the end of a Kalpa; I send them forth again at the beginning of the next Kalpa.
documents.searchText: bg.9.7 bg.9.7 chapter 9 verse 7 सरवभतन कनतय परकत यनत ममकम कलपकषय पनसतन कलपद वसजमयहम 9.7 sarva-bhutani kaunteya prakritim yanti mamikam kalpa-kshaye punas tani kalpadau visrijamyaham all beings o arjuna go into my nature at the end of a kalpa i send them forth again at the beginning of the next kalpa.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.7 bg.9.7 chapter 9 verse 7 सर्वभूतानि कौन्तेय प्रकृतिं यान्ति मामिकाम्।

कल्पक्षये पुनस्तानि कल्पादौ विसृजाम्यहम्।।9.7।। sarva-bhūtāni kaunteya prakṛitiṁ yānti māmikām
kalpa-kṣhaye punas tāni kalpādau visṛijāmyaham all beings, o arjuna, go into my nature at the end of a kalpa; i send them forth again at the beginning of the next kalpa.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.8
documents.iast: prakṛitiṁ svām avaṣhṭabhya visṛijāmi punaḥ punaḥ
documents.summary: Animating My Nature, I again and again send forth all this multitude of beings, helpless under the force of Nature.
documents.searchText: bg.9.8 bg.9.8 chapter 9 verse 8 परकत सवमवषटभय वसजम पन पन भतगरममम कतसनमवश परकतरवशत 9.8 prakritim svam avashtabhya visrijami punah punah bhuta-gramam imam kritsnam avasham prakriter vashat animating my nature i again and again send forth all this multitude of beings helpless under the force of nature.
documents.searchTextRaw:
bg.9.8 bg.9.8 chapter 9 verse 8 प्रकृतिं स्वामवष्टभ्य विसृजामि पुनः पुनः।

भूतग्राममिमं कृत्स्नमवशं प्रकृतेर्वशात्।।9.8।। prakṛitiṁ svām avaṣhṭabhya visṛijāmi punaḥ punaḥ
bhūta-grāmam imaṁ kṛitsnam avaśhaṁ prakṛiter vaśhāt animating my nature, i again and again send forth all this multitude of beings, helpless under the force of nature.

documents.title: Bhagavad Gītā 9.9
